original: iti yogiyājñavalkyasmṛteḥ kathaṃ patañjaler yogaśāstrakartṛtvam ity āśaṅkya sūtrakāreṇānuśāsanam ity uktam| śiṣṭasya śāsanam anuśāsanam ity arthaḥ| yadāyam athaśabdo'dhikārārthas tadaiṣa vākyārthaḥ saṃpadyata ity āha --- yogānuśāsanaṃ śāstram adhikṛtam iti| nanu vyutpādyamānatayā yogo'trādhikṛto na tu śāstram ity ata āha --- veditavyam iti|
analyzed: iti yogi yājñavalkya smṛteḥ katham patañjaleḥ yoga śāstra kartṛ tvam iti āśaṅkya sūtrakāreṇa anuśāsanam iti uktam śiṣṭasya śāsanam anuśāsanam iti arthaḥ yadā ayam atha śabda udhikāra arthaḥ tadā eṣa vākya arthaḥ saṃpadyate iti āha yoga anuśāsanam śāstram adhikṛtam iti nanu vyutpādyamāna tayā yoga utra adhikṛtaḥ na tu śāstram iti atas āha veditavyam iti

original: satyaṃ vyutpādyamānatayā yogaḥ prastutaḥ, sa tu tadviṣayeṇa śāstreṇa karaṇena vyutpādyaḥ| karaṇagocaraś ca vyutpādakasya vyāpāro na karmagocara iti kartṛvyāpāravivakṣayā yogaviṣayasya śāstrasyādhikṛtatvaṃ veditavyam| śāstravyāpāragocaratayā tu yoga evādhikṛta iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: satyam vyutpādyamāna tayā yogaḥ prastutaḥ sa tu tad viṣayeṇa śāstreṇa karaṇena vyutpādyaḥ karaṇa gocaraḥ ca vyutpādakasya vyāpāraḥ na karma gocaraḥ iti kartṛ vyāpāra vivakṣayā yoga viṣayasya śāstrasya adhikṛta tvam veditavyam śāstra vyāpāra gocara tayā tu yogaḥ eva adhikṛtaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: adhikārārthasya cāthaśabdasyānyārthaṃ nīyamānodakumbhadarśanam iva śravaṇaṃ maṅgalāyāpi kalpata iti mantavyam| śabdasaṃdehanimittam arthasaṃdeham apanayati --- yogaḥ samādhir iti| "yuja samādhau" ity asmād vyutpannaḥ samādhyartho na tu "yujir yoge" ity asmāt saṃyogārtha ity arthaḥ| nanu samādhir api vakṣyamāṇasyāṅgino yogasyāṅgam|
analyzed: adhikāra arthasya ca atha śabdasya anya artham nīyamāna udakumbha darśanam iva śravaṇam maṅgalāya api kalpate iti mantavyam śabda saṃdeha nimittam artha saṃdeham apanayati yogaḥ samādhiḥ iti yujaḥ samādhau iti asmāt vyutpannaḥ samādhi arthaḥ na tu yujiḥ yoge iti asmāt saṃyoga arthaḥ iti arthaḥ nanu samādhiḥ api vakṣyamāṇasya aṅginaḥ yogasya aṅgam

original: na cāṅgam evāṅgīty ata āha --- sa ca sārvabhaumaḥ| cas tvartho'ṅgād aṅginaṃ bhinatti| bhūmayo'vasthā vakṣyamāṇā madhumatī madhupratīkā viśokā saṃskāraśeṣās tāś cittasya, tāsu sarvāsu viditaḥ sārvabhaumaś cittavṛttinirodhalakṣaṇo yogaḥ| tadaṅgaṃ tu samādhir naivaṃbhūtaḥ| vyutpattinimittamātrābhidhānaṃ caitad yogaḥ samādhir iti|
analyzed: na ca aṅgam eva aṅgī iti atas āha sa ca sārvabhaumaḥ caḥ tu artha uṅgāt aṅginam bhinatti vakṣyamāṇāḥ madhumatī madhupratīkā viśokā saṃskāra śeṣāḥ tāḥ cittasya tāsu sarvāsu viditaḥ sārvabhaumaḥ citta vṛtti nirodha lakṣaṇaḥ yogaḥ tad aṅgam tu samādhiḥ na evaṃbhūtaḥ vyutpatti nimitta mātra abhidhānam ca etat yogaḥ samādhiḥ iti

original: aṅgāṅginor abhedavivakṣāmātreṇa pravṛttinimittaṃ tu yogaśabdasya cittavṛttinirodha eveti paramārthaḥ| vṛttayo jñānāny ātmāśrayāṇy atas tannirodho 'py ātmāśraya eveti ye paśyanti tannirāsāyāha --- cittasya dharma iti| cittaśabdenāntaḥkaraṇaṃ buddhim upalakṣayati|
analyzed: aṅga aṅginoḥ abheda vivakṣā mātreṇa pravṛtti nimittam tu yoga śabdasya citta vṛtti nirodhaḥ eva iti paramārthaḥ vṛttayaḥ jñānāni ātma āśrayāṇi atas ātma āśrayaḥ eva iti ye paśyanti tad nirāsāya āha cittasya dharmaḥ iti citta śabdena antaḥkaraṇam buddhim upalakṣayati

original: na hi kūṭasthanityā citiśaktir apariṇāminī jñānadharmā bhavitum arhati buddhis tu bhaved iti bhāvaḥ| syād etat sārvabhaumaś ced yogo hanta bhoḥ kṣitamūḍhavikṣiptā api cittabhūmayaḥ| asti ca parasparāpekṣayā vṛttinirodho'py āsv iti tatrāpi yogatvaprasaṅga ity āśaṅkya heyopādeyabhūmīr upanyasyati --- kṣiptam ityādi|
analyzed: na hi kūṭastha nityā citi śaktiḥ apariṇāminī jñāna dharmā bhavitum arhati buddhiḥ tu bhavet iti bhāvaḥ syāt etat sārvabhaumaḥ ced yogaḥ hanta bhoḥ kṣita mūḍha vikṣiptāḥ api citta bhūmayaḥ asti ca paraspara apekṣayā vṛtti nirodhaḥ api āsu iti tatra api yoga tva prasaṅgaḥ iti āśaṅkya heya upādeya bhūmīḥ upanyasyati kṣiptam ityādi

original: kṣiptaṃ sadaiva rajasā teṣu teṣu viṣayeṣu kṣipyamāṇam atyantam asthiram| mūḍhaṃ tu tamaḥsamudrekān nidrāvṛttimat| kṣiptād viśiṣṭaṃ vikṣiptam| viśeṣo'sthemabahulasya kādācitkaḥ sthemā| sā cāsyāsthemabahulatā sāṃsiddhikī vā vakṣyamāṇavyādhistyānādyantarāyajanitā vā| ekāgram ekatānam| niruddhasakalavṛttikaṃ saṃskāramātraśeṣaṃ cittaṃ niruddham|
analyzed: kṣiptam sadā eva rajasā teṣu teṣu viṣayeṣu kṣipyamāṇam atyantam asthiram mūḍham tu tamaḥ samudrekāt nidrā vṛttimat kṣiptāt viśiṣṭam vikṣiptam viśeṣaḥ sthema bahulasya kādācitkaḥ sthemā sā ca asya asthema bahula tā sāṃsiddhikī vā vakṣyamāṇa vyādhiḥ tyāna ādi antarāya janitā vā ekāgram ekatānam niruddha sakala vṛttikam saṃskāra mātra śeṣam cittam niruddham

original: tatra kṣiptamūḍhayoḥ saty api parasparāpekṣayā vṛttinirodhe pāramparyeṇāpi niḥśreyasahetubhāvābhāvāt tadupaghātakatvāc ca yogapakṣād dūrotsāritatvam iti na tayor yogtvaṃ niṣiddham| vikṣiptasya tu kādācitkasadbhūtaviṣayasthemaśālinaḥ saṃbhāvyeta yogatvam iti niṣedhati|
analyzed: tatra kṣipta mūḍhayoḥ sati api paraspara apekṣayā vṛtti nirodhe pāramparyeṇa api niḥśreyasa hetu bhāva abhāvāt tad upaghātaka tvāt ca yoga pakṣāt dūra utsārita tvam iti na tayoḥ yog tvam niṣiddham vikṣiptasya tu kādācitka sadbhūta viṣaya sthema śālinaḥ saṃbhāvyeta yoga tvam iti niṣedhati

original: tatra vikṣipte cetasi samādhiḥ kādācitkasadbhūtaviṣayasya cittasya sthemā na yogapakṣe vartate| kasmāt| yatas tadvipakṣavikṣepopasarjanībhūtaḥ| vipakṣavargāntargatasya hi svarūpam eva durlabhaṃ prāg eva kāryakaraṇaṃ na khalu dahanāntargataṃ bījaṃ tricaturākṣaṇāvasthitam uptam apy aṅkurāya kalpata iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tatra vikṣipte cetasi samādhiḥ kādācitka sadbhūta viṣayasya cittasya sthemā na yoga pakṣe vartate kasmāt yatas tad vipakṣa vikṣepa upasarjanī bhūtaḥ vipakṣa varga antargatasya hi svarūpam eva durlabham prāk eva kārya karaṇam na khalu dahana antargatam bījam tricatura akṣaṇa avasthitam uptam api aṅkurāya kalpate iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadi vikṣepopasarjanībhūtaḥ samādhir na yogaḥ kas tarhīty ata āha --- yas tv ekāgre cetasīti| bhūtam iti samāropitam arthaṃ nivartayati| nidrāvṛttir api svālambane tamasi bhūte bhavaty ekāgrety ata uktam --- sad iti| śobhanaṃ nitāntāvirbhūtaṃ sattvaṃ tamaḥsamudrekas tv aśobhanas tasya kleśahetutvād iti|
analyzed: yadi vikṣepa upasarjanī bhūtaḥ samādhiḥ na yogaḥ kaḥ tarhi iti atas āha yaḥ tu ekāgre cetasi iti bhūtam iti samāropitam artham nivartayati nidrā vṛttiḥ api sva ālambane tamasi bhūte bhavati ekāgrā iti atas uktam sat iti śobhanam nitānta āvirbhūtam sattvam tamaḥ samudrekaḥ tu aśobhanaḥ tasya kleśa hetu tvāt iti

original: dyotanaṃ hi tattvajñānam āgamād vānumānād vā bhavad api parokṣarūpatayā na sākṣātkāravatīm avidyām ucchinatti dvicandradiṅmohādiṣv anucchedakatvād ata āha --- preti| prakāro hi prakarṣaṃ dyotayan sākṣātkāraṃ sūcayati|
analyzed: dyotanam hi tattva jñānam āgamāt vā anumānāt vā bhavat api parokṣa rūpa tayā na sākṣātkāravatīm avidyām ucchinatti dvi candra diś moha ādiṣu an ucchedaka tvāt atas āha pra iti prakāraḥ hi prakarṣam dyotayan sākṣātkāram sūcayati

original: avidyāmūlatvād asmitādīnāṃ kleśānāṃ, vidyāyāś cāvidyocchedarūpatvād vidyodaye cāvidyādikleśasamucchedo virodhitvāt kāraṇavināśāc cety āha --- kṣiṇoti ceti| ata eva karmarūpāṇi bandhanāni ślathayati| karma cātrāpūrvam abhimataṃ kārye kāraṇopacārāt| ślathayati svakāryād avasādayati| vakṣyati hi --- "sati mūle tadvipākaḥ" iti|
analyzed: avidyā mūla tvāt asmitā ādīnām kleśānām vidyāyāḥ ca avidyā uccheda rūpa tvāt vidyā udaye ca avidyā ādi kleśa samucchedaḥ virodhi tvāt kāraṇa vināśāt ca iti āha kṣiṇoti ca iti atas eva karma rūpāṇi bandhanāni ślathayati karma ca atra apūrvam abhimatam kārye kāraṇa upacārāt ślathayati sva kāryāt avasādayati vakṣyati hi sati mūle tad vipākaḥ iti

original: kiṃ ca nirodham abhumukhaṃ karoty abhimukhīkaroti| sa ca saṃprajñātaś catuṣprakāra ity āha --- sa ceti| asaṃprajñātam āha --- sarvavṛttīti| rajastamomayī kila pramāṇādivṛttiḥ sāttvikīṃ vṛttim upādāya saṃprajñāte niruddhā| asaṃprajñāte tu sarvāsām eva nirodha ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: kim ca nirodham abhumukham karoti abhimukhīkaroti sa ca saṃprajñātaḥ catuṣprakāraḥ iti āha sa ca iti asaṃprajñātam āha sarva vṛtti iti rajaḥ tamaḥ mayī kila pramāṇa ādi vṛttiḥ sāttvikīm vṛttim upādāya saṃprajñāte niruddhā asaṃprajñāte tu sarvāsām eva nirodhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tad iha bhūmidvaye samāptā yā madhumatyādayo bhūmayas tāḥ sarvās tāsu viditaḥ sārvabhauma iti siddham||1.1||
analyzed: tat iha bhūmi dvaye samāptāḥ yāḥ madhumatī ādayaḥ bhūmayaḥ tāḥ sarvāḥ tāsu viditaḥ sārvabhaumaḥ iti siddham

original: yogaś cittavṛttinirodhaḥ||1.2||

dvitīyaṃ sūtram avatārayati --- tasya lakṣaṇeti| tasyeti pūrvasūtropāttaṃ dvividhaṃ yogaṃ parāmṛśati --- yogaś cittavṛttinirodhaḥ| nirudhyante yasmin pramāṇādivṛttayo 'vasthāviśeṣe cittasya so'vasthāviśeṣo yogaḥ| nanu saṃprajñātasya yogasyāvyāpakatvād alakṣaṇam idam| aniruddhā hi tatra sāttvikī cittavṛttir ity ata āha --- sarvaśabdāgrahaṇād iti|
analyzed: dvitīyam sūtram avatārayati tasya lakṣaṇā iti tasya iti pūrva sūtra upāttam dvividham yogam parāmṛśati yogaḥ citta vṛtti nirodhaḥ nirudhyante yasmin pramāṇa ādi vṛttayaḥ vasthā viśeṣe cittasya saḥ vasthā viśeṣaḥ yogaḥ nanu saṃprajñātasya yogasya avyāpaka tvāt alakṣaṇam idam aniruddhā hi tatra sāttvikī citta vṛttiḥ iti atas āha sarva śabda agrahaṇāt iti

original: yadi sarvacittavṛttinirodha ity ucyeta bhaved avyāpakaṃ saṃprajñātasya| kleśakarmavipākāśayaparipanthī cittavṛttinirodhas tu tam api saṃgṛhṇāti| tatrāpi rājasatāmasacittavṛttinirodhāt tasya ca tadbhāvād ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: yadi sarva citta vṛtti nirodhaḥ iti ucyeta bhavet avyāpakam saṃprajñātasya kleśa karma vipāka āśaya paripanthī citta vṛtti nirodhaḥ tu tam api saṃgṛhṇāti tatra api rājasa tāmasa citta vṛtti nirodhāt tasya ca tad bhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: kutaḥ punar ekasya cittasya kṣiptādibhūmisaṃbandhaḥ kimarthaṃ caivamavasthasya cittasya vṛttayo niroddhavyā ity āśaṅkya prathamaṃ tāvad avasthāsaṃbandhe hetum upanyasyati --- cittaṃ hīti| prakhyāśīlatvāt sattvaguṇam| pravṛttiśīlatvād rajoguṇam| sthitiśīlatvāt tamoguṇam| prakhyāgrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārtham|
analyzed: kutas punar ekasya cittasya kṣipta ādi bhūmi saṃbandhaḥ kimartham ca evamavasthasya cittasya vṛttayaḥ niroddhavyāḥ iti āśaṅkya prathamam tāvat avasthā saṃbandhe hetum upanyasyati cittam hi iti prakhyā śīla tvāt sattva guṇam pravṛtti śīla tvāt rajaḥ guṇam sthiti śīla tvāt tamaḥ guṇam prakhyā grahaṇam upalakṣaṇa artham

original: tenānye'pi sāttvikāḥ prasādalāghavaprītyādayaḥ sūcyante| pravṛttyā ca paritāpaśokādayā rājasāḥ| pravṛttivirodhī tamovṛttidharmaḥ sthitiḥ| sthitigrahaṇād gauravāvaraṇadainyādaya upalakṣyante| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- ekam api cittaṃ triguṇanirmitatayā guṇānāṃ ca vaiṣamyeṇa parasparavimardavaicitryād vicitrapariṇāmaṃ sad anekāvastham upapadyata iti|
analyzed: tena anye api sāttvikāḥ prasāda lāghava prīti ādayaḥ sūcyante pravṛttyā ca paritāpa śoka ādayāḥ rājasāḥ pravṛtti virodhī tamaḥ vṛtti dharmaḥ sthitiḥ sthiti grahaṇāt gaurava āvaraṇa dainya ādayaḥ upalakṣyante etat uktam bhavati ekam api cittam triguṇa nirmita tayā guṇānām ca vaiṣamyeṇa paraspara vimarda vaicitryāt vicitra pariṇāmam sat aneka avastham upapadyate iti

original: kṣiptādyā eva cittasya bhūmīr yathāsaṃbhavam avāntarāvasthābhedavatīr ādarśayati --- prakhyārūpaṃ hīti| cittarūpeṇa pariṇataṃ sattvaṃ cittasattvam| tad evaṃ prakhyārūpatayā sattvaprādhānyaṃ cittasya darśitam|

original: yadā hi tamo rajo vijitya prasṛtaṃ tadā cittasattvāvarakatamaḥsamutsāraṇe 'śaktatvād rajasas tamaḥsthagitaṃ cittam adharmādy upagacchati| ajñānaṃ ca viparyayajñānam| abhāvapratyayālambanaṃ ca nidrājñānam uktam| tataś ca mūḍhāvasthāpi sūciteti| anaiśvaryaṃ sarvatrecchāpratīghātaḥ| adharmādivyāptaṃ cittaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ|
analyzed: yadā hi tamaḥ rajaḥ vijitya prasṛtam tadā citta sattva āvaraka tamaḥ samutsāraṇe śakta tvāt rajasaḥ tamaḥ sthagitam cittam adharma ādi upagacchati ajñānam ca viparyaya jñānam abhāva pratyaya ālambanam ca nidrā jñānam uktam tatas ca mūḍha avasthā api sūcitā iti anaiśvaryam sarvatra icchā pratīghātaḥ adharma ādi vyāptam cittam bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: yadā tu tad eva cittasattvam āvirbhūtasattvam apagatatamaḥpaṭalaṃ sarajaskaṃ bhavati tadā dharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryāṇy upagacchatīty āha --- prakṣīṇetyādi| mohas tamas tad eva cāvaraṇaṃ prakarṣeṇa kṣīṇaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| ata eva sarvato viśeṣāviśeṣaliṅgamātrāliṅgapuruṣeṣu pradyotamānam|
analyzed: yadā tu tat eva citta sattvam āvirbhūta sattvam apagata tamaḥ paṭalam sarajaskam bhavati tadā dharma jñāna vairāgya aiśvaryāṇi upagacchati iti āha prakṣīṇa ityādi mohaḥ tamaḥ tat eva ca āvaraṇam prakarṣeṇa kṣīṇam yasya tat tathā uktam atas eva sarvatas viśeṣa aviśeṣa liṅga mātra aliṅga puruṣeṣu pradyotamānam

original: tathāpi na dharmāyaiśvaryāya ca kalpate pravṛttyabhāvād ity ata āha --- anuviddhaṃ rajomātrayā| rajasaḥ pravartakatvād asti dharmādipravṛttir ity arthaḥ| tad anena saṃprajñātasamādhisaṃpannayor madhubhūmikaprajñājyotiṣor madhyamayor yoginoś cittasattvaṃ saṃgṛhītam|
analyzed: tathā api na dharmāya aiśvaryāya ca kalpate pravṛtti abhāvāt iti atas āha anuviddham rajaḥ mātrayā rajasaḥ pravartaka tvāt asti dharma ādi pravṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ tat anena saṃprajñāta samādhi saṃpannayoḥ madhubhūmika prajñā jyotiṣoḥ madhyamayoḥ yoginoḥ citta sattvam saṃgṛhītam

original: saṃpraty atikrāntabhāvanīyasya dhyāyinaś caturthasya cittāvasthām āha --- tad eva cittaṃ rajoleśān malād apetam ata eva svarūpapratiṣṭham|
analyzed: saṃprati atikrānta bhāvanīyasya dhyāyinaḥ caturthasya citta avasthām āha tat eva cittam rajaḥ leśāt malāt apetam atas eva sva rūpa pratiṣṭham

original: abhyāsavairāgyapuṭapākaprabandhavidhūtarajastamomalasya hi buddhisattvatapanīyasya svarūpapratiṣṭhasya viṣayendriyapratyāhṛtasyānavasitādhikāratayā ca kāryakāriṇo vivekakhyātiḥ paraṃ kāryam avaśiṣyata ity āha --- sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātimātraṃ cittaṃ dharmameghadhyānopagaṃ bhavati| dharmameghaś ca vakṣyate|
analyzed: abhyāsa vairāgya puṭapāka prabandha vidhūta rajaḥ tamaḥ malasya hi buddhi sattva tapanīyasya sva rūpa pratiṣṭhasya viṣaya indriya pratyāhṛtasya anavasita adhikāra tayā ca kārya kāriṇaḥ viveka khyātiḥ param kāryam avaśiṣyate iti āha sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātram cittam dharma megha dhyāna upagam bhavati dharma meghaḥ ca vakṣyate

original: atraiva yogijanaprasiddhim āha --- tad iti| sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātimātraṃ cittaṃ dharmameghaparyantaṃ paraṃ prasaṃkhyānam ity ācakṣate dhyāyinaḥ| cittasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca dharmadharmiṇor abhedavivakṣayā draṣṭavyam|
analyzed: atra eva yogi jana prasiddhim āha tat iti sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātram cittam dharmamegha paryantam param prasaṃkhyānam iti ācakṣate dhyāyinaḥ citta sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca dharma dharmiṇoḥ abheda vivakṣayā draṣṭavyam

original: vivekakhyāter hānahetuṃ citiśakteś copādānahetuṃ nirodhasamādhim avatārayituṃ citiśakteḥ sādhutām asādhutāṃ ca vivekakhyāter darśayati --- citiśaktir ityādi| sukhaduḥkhamohātmakatvam aśuddhiḥ| sukhamohāv api hi vivekinaṃ duḥkhākurutaḥ| ato duḥkhavad dheyau| tathā cātisundaram apy antavad dunoti| tena tad api heyam eva vivekinaḥ|
analyzed: viveka khyāteḥ hāna hetum citi śakteḥ ca upādāna hetum nirodha samādhim avatārayitum citi śakteḥ sādhu tām asādhu tām ca viveka khyāteḥ darśayati citi śaktiḥ ityādi sukha duḥkha moha ātmaka tvam aśuddhiḥ sukha mohau api hi vivekinam duḥkhākurutaḥ atas duḥkha vat dheyau tathā ca ati sundaram api anta vat dunoti tena tat api heyam eva vivekinaḥ

original: seyam aśuddhir antaś ca citiśaktau puruṣe na sta ity uktam --- śuddhā cānantā ceti| nanu sukhaduḥkhamohātmakaśabdādīn iyaṃ cetayamānā tadākārāpannā kathaṃ viśuddhā tadākāraparigrahaparivarjane ca kurvatī katham anantety ata uktam --- darśitaviṣayeti| darśito viṣayaḥ śabdādir yasyai sā tathoktā|
analyzed: sā iyam aśuddhiḥ antar ca citi śaktau puruṣe na staḥ iti uktam śuddhā ca anantā ca iti nanu sukha duḥkha moha ātmaka śabda ādīn iyam cetayamānā tad ākāra āpannā katham viśuddhā tad ākāra parigraha parivarjane ca kurvatī katham anantā iti atas uktam darśita viṣayā iti darśitaḥ viṣayaḥ śabda ādiḥ yasyai sā tathā uktā

original: bhaved etad evaṃ yadi buddhivac citiśaktir viṣayākāratām āpadyeta, kiṃ tu buddhir eva viṣayākāreṇa pariṇatā saty atadākārāyai citiśaktyai viṣayam ādarśayati| tataḥ puruṣaś cetayata ity ucyate| nanu viṣayākārāṃ buddhim anārūḍhāyāś citiśakteḥ kathaṃ viṣayavedanaṃ viṣayārohe vā kathaṃ na tadākārāpattir ity ata uktam --- apratisaṃkrameti|
analyzed: bhavet etat evam yadi buddhi vat citiśaktiḥ viṣaya ākāra tām āpadyeta kim tu buddhiḥ eva viṣaya ākāreṇa pariṇatā satī a tad ākārāyai citiśaktyai viṣayam ādarśayati tatas puruṣaḥ cetayate iti ucyate nanu viṣaya ākārām buddhim an ārūḍhāyāḥ citiśakteḥ katham viṣaya vedanam viṣaya ārohe vā katham na tad ākāra āpattiḥ iti atas uktam a pratisaṃkrama iti

original: pratisaṃkramaḥ saṃcāraḥ| sa citer nāstīty arthaḥ| sa eva kuto'syā nāstīty ata uktam --- apariṇāminīti| na cites trividho 'pi dharmalakṣaṇāvasthālakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmo'sti| yena kriyārūpeṇa pariṇatā satī buddhisaṃyogena pariṇameta citiśaktiḥ| asaṃkrāntāyā api viṣayasaṃvedanam upapādayiṣyate| tat siddhaṃ citiśaktiḥ śobhaneti|
analyzed: pratisaṃkramaḥ saṃcāraḥ sa citeḥ na asti iti arthaḥ saḥ eva kutas asyāḥ na asti iti atas uktam apariṇāminī iti na citeḥ trividhaḥ dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā lakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmaḥ asti yena kriyā rūpeṇa pariṇatā satī buddhi saṃyogena pariṇameta citi śaktiḥ asaṃkrāntāyāḥ api viṣaya saṃvedanam upapādayiṣyate tat siddham citi śaktiḥ śobhanā iti

original: vivekakhyātis tu buddhisattvātmikāśobhanety uktam --- ataś citiśakter viparīteti| yadā ca vivekakhyātir api heyā tadā kaiva kathā vṛttyantarāṇāṃ doṣabahulānām iti bhāvaḥ| tatas taddhetor nirodhasamādher avatāro yujyata ity āha --- atas tasyām iti| jñānaprasādamātreṇa hi pareṇa vairāgyeṇa vivekakhyātim api niruṇaddhīty arthaḥ|
analyzed: viveka khyātiḥ tu buddhi sattva ātmikā aśobhanā iti uktam atas citiśakteḥ viparītā iti yadā ca viveka khyātiḥ api heyā tadā kā eva kathā vṛtti antarāṇām doṣa bahulānām iti bhāvaḥ tatas tad hetoḥ nirodha samādheḥ avatāraḥ yujyate iti āha atas tasyām iti jñāna prasāda mātreṇa hi pareṇa vairāgyeṇa viveka khyātim api niruṇaddhi iti arthaḥ

original: atha niruddhāśeṣavṛttiṃ cittaṃ kīdṛśam ity ata āha --- tadavastham ityādi| sa nirodho'vasthā yasya tat tathoktam| nirodhasya svarūpam āha --- sa nirbīja iti| kleśasahitaḥ karmāśayo jātyāyurbhogabījaṃ tasmān nirgata iti nirbījaḥ| asyaiva yogijanaprasiddhām anvarthasaṃjñām ādarśayati --- na tatreti|
analyzed: atha niruddha aśeṣa vṛttim cittam kīdṛśam iti atas āha tad avastham ityādi sa nirodhaḥ avasthā yasya tat tathā uktam nirodhasya svarūpam āha sa nirbījaḥ iti kleśa sahitaḥ karma āśayaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhoga bījam tasmāt nirgataḥ iti nirbījaḥ asya eva yogi jana prasiddhām anvartha saṃjñām ādarśayati na tatra iti

original: upasaṃharati --- dvividhaḥ sa yogaś cittavṛttinirodha iti||1.2||
analyzed: upasaṃharati dvividhaḥ sa yogaḥ citta vṛtti nirodhaḥ iti

original: tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe'vasthānam||1.3||
analyzed: tadā draṣṭuḥ sva rūpa iva sthānam

original: saṃpraty uttarasūtram avatārayituṃ codayati --- tadavasthe cetasīti| kim ākṣepe| tattadākārapariṇatabuddhibodhātmā khalv ayaṃ puruṣaḥ sadānubhūyate na tu buddhibodharahito'to 'sya puruṣasya buddhibodhaḥ svabhāvaḥ savitur iva prakāśaḥ| na ca saṃskāraśeṣe cetasi so'sti| na ca svabhāvam apahāya bhāvo vartitum arhatīti bhāvaḥ| syād etat|
analyzed: saṃprati uttara sūtram avatārayitum codayati tad avasthe cetasi iti kim ākṣepe tad tad ākāra pariṇata buddhi bodha ātmā khalu ayam puruṣaḥ sadā anubhūyate na tu puruṣasya buddhi bodhaḥ svabhāvaḥ savituḥ iva prakāśaḥ na ca saṃskāra śeṣe cetasi saḥ usti na ca svabhāvam apahāya bhāvaḥ vartitum arhati iti bhāvaḥ syāt etat

original: saṃskāraśeṣām api buddhiṃ kasmāt puruṣo na budhyata ity ata āha --- viṣayābhāvād iti| na buddhimātraṃ puruṣasya viṣayo'pi tu puruṣārthavatī buddhiḥ| vivekakhyātiviṣayabhogau ca puruṣārthau| tau ca niruddhāvasthāyāṃ na sta iti siddho viṣayābhāva ity arthaḥ| sūtreṇa pariharati --- tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe 'vasthānam|
analyzed: saṃskāra śeṣām api buddhim kasmāt puruṣaḥ na budhyate iti atas āha viṣaya abhāvāt iti na buddhi mātram puruṣasya tu puruṣa arthavatī buddhiḥ viveka khyāti viṣaya bhogau ca puruṣa arthau tau ca niruddha avasthāyām na staḥ iti siddhaḥ viṣaya abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ sūtreṇa pariharati tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe vasthānam

original: svarūpa ity āropitaṃ śāntaghoramūḍhasvarūpaṃ nivartayati| puruṣasya hi caitanyaṃ svarūpam anaupādhikaṃ na tu buddhibodhaḥ śāntādirūpa aupādhiko hi sa sphaṭikasyeva svabhāvasvacchadhavalasya japākusumasaṃnidhānopādhir aruṇimā| na copādhinivṛttāv upahitanivṛttir atiprasaṅgād iti bhāvaḥ| svarūpasya cābhede'pi bhedaṃ vikalpyādhikaraṇabhāva ukta iti|
analyzed: sva rūpe iti āropitam śānta ghora mūḍha svarūpam nivartayati puruṣasya hi caitanyam sva rūpam anaupādhikam na tu buddhi bodhaḥ śānta ādi rūpaḥ aupādhikaḥ hi sa sphaṭikasya iva svabhāva svaccha dhavalasya japā kusuma saṃnidhāna upādhiḥ aruṇimā na ca upādhi nivṛttau upahita nivṛttiḥ atiprasaṅgāt iti bhāvaḥ sva rūpasya ca abhede api bhedam vikalpya adhikaraṇa bhāvaḥ uktaḥ iti

original: ayam evārtho bhāṣyakṛtā dyotyate --- svarūpapratiṣṭheti| tadānīṃ nirodhāvasthāyāṃ na vyutthānāvasthāyām iti bhāvaḥ| syād etad vyutthānāvasthāyām apratiṣṭhitā svarūpe citiśaktir nirodhāvasthāyāṃ pratitiṣṭhantī pariṇāminī syāt| vyutthāne vā svarūpapratiṣṭhāne vyutthānanirodhayor aviśeṣa ity ata āha --- vyutthānacitte tv iti|
analyzed: ayam eva arthaḥ bhāṣyakṛtā dyotyate sva rūpa pratiṣṭhā iti tadānīm nirodha avasthāyām na vyutthāna avasthāyām iti bhāvaḥ syāt etat vyutthāna avasthāyām apratiṣṭhitā sva rūpe citi śaktiḥ nirodha avasthāyām pratitiṣṭhantī pariṇāminī syāt vyutthāne vā sva rūpa pratiṣṭhāne vyutthāna nirodhayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ iti atas āha vyutthāna citte tu iti

original: na jātu kūṭasthanityā citiśaktiḥ svarūpāc cyavate tena yathā nirodhe tathaiva vyutthāne'pi| na khalu śuktikāyāḥ pramāṇaviparyayajñānagocaratve'pi svarūpodayavyayau bhavataḥ| pratipattā tu tathābhūtam apy atathātvenābhimanyate| nirodhasamādhim apekṣya saṃprajñāto'pi vyutthānam eveti||1.3||
analyzed: na jātu kūṭastha nityā citi śaktiḥ svarūpāt cyavate tena yathā nirodhe tathā eva vyutthāne api na khalu śuktikāyāḥ pramāṇa viparyaya jñāna gocara tve pi svarūpa udaya vyayau bhavataḥ pratipattā tu tathābhūtam api a tathātvena abhimanyate nirodha samādhim apekṣya saṃprajñātaḥ api vyutthānam eva iti

original: vṛttisārūpyam itaratra||1.4||
analyzed: vṛtti sārūpyam itaratra

original: sūtrāntaram avatārayituṃ pṛcchati --- kathaṃ tarhīti| yadi tathā bhavantī na tathā kena tarhi prakāreṇa prakāśata ity arthaḥ| hetupadam adhyāhṛtya sūtraṃ paṭhati --- darśitaviṣayatvād vṛttisārūpyam itaratra| itaratra vyutthāne yāś cittavṛttayaḥ śāntaghoramūḍhās tā evāviśiṣṭā abhinnā vṛttayo yasya puruṣasya sa tathoktaḥ|
analyzed: sūtra antaram avatārayitum pṛcchati katham tarhi iti yadi tathā bhavantī na tathā kena tarhi prakāreṇa prakāśate iti arthaḥ hetu padam adhyāhṛtya sūtram paṭhati darśita viṣaya tvāt vṛtti sārūpyam itaratra itaratra vyutthāne yāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ śānta ghora mūḍhāḥ tāḥ eva a viśiṣṭāḥ abhinnāḥ vṛttayaḥ yasya puruṣasya sa tathā uktaḥ

original: sārūpyam ity atra saśabda ekaparyāyaḥ| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- japākusumasphaṭikayor iva buddhipuruṣayoḥ saṃnidhānād abhedagrahe buddhivṛttīḥ puruṣe samāropya śānto'smi duḥkhito'smi mūḍho'smīty adhyavasyati| yathā maline darpaṇatale pratibimbitaṃ mukhaṃ malinam āropya śocaty ātmānaṃ malino'smīti|
analyzed: sārūpyam iti atra sa śabdaḥ eka paryāyaḥ etat uktam bhavati japā kusuma sphaṭikayoḥ iva buddhi puruṣayoḥ saṃnidhānāt abheda grahe buddhi vṛttīḥ puruṣe samāropya śāntaḥ asmi duḥkhitaḥ asmi mūḍhaḥ asmi iti adhyavasyati yathā maline darpaṇa tale pratibimbitam mukham malinam āropya śocati ātmānam malinaḥ asmi iti

original: yady api puruṣasamāropo'pi śabdādivijñānavad buddhivṛttir yady api ca prākṛtatvenācidrūpatayānubhāvyas tathāpi buddheḥ puruṣatvam āpādayan puruṣavṛttir ivānubhava ivāvabhāsate| tathā cāyam aviparyayo'py ātmā viparyayavān ivābhoktāpi bhokteva vivekakhyātirahito'pi tatsahita iva vivekakhyātyā prakāśate|
analyzed: yadi api puruṣa samāropaḥ api śabda ādi vijñāna vat buddhi vṛttiḥ yadi api ca prākṛta tvena a cit rūpa tayā anubhāvyaḥ tathā api buddheḥ puruṣa tvam āpādayan puruṣa vṛttiḥ iva anubhavaḥ iva avabhāsate tathā ca ayam aviparyayaḥ upi ātmā viparyayavān iva abhoktā api bhoktā iva viveka khyāti rahitaḥ api tad sahitaḥ iva viveka khyātyā prakāśate

original: etac ca "citer apratisaṃkramāyās tadākārāpattau svabuddhisaṃvedanam" ity atra "sattvapuruṣayor atyantāsaṃkīrṇayoḥ pratyayāviśeṣo bhogaḥ" ity atra copapādayiṣyate| etac ca matāntare'pi siddham ity āha --- tathā ceti| pañcaśikhācāryasya sūtram "ekam eva darśanaṃ khyātir eva darśanam" iti|
analyzed: etat ca citeḥ apratisaṃkramāyāḥ tad ākāra āpattau sva buddhi saṃvedanam iti atra sattva puruṣayoḥ atyanta asaṃkīrṇayoḥ pratyaya aviśeṣaḥ bhogaḥ iti atra ca upapādayiṣyate etat ca mata antare api siddham iti āha tathā ca iti pañcaśikha ācāryasya sūtram ekam eva darśanam khyātiḥ eva darśanam iti

original: nanu katham ekaṃ darśanaṃ yāvatā buddheḥ śabdādiviṣayā vivekaviṣayā ca vṛttiḥ prākṛtatayā jaḍatvenānubhāvyā darśanaṃ tato'nyat puruṣasya caitanyam anubhavo darśanam ity ata āha --- khyātir eva darśanam iti| udayavyayadharmiṇīṃ vṛttiṃ khyātiṃ laukikīm abhipretyaitad uktam --- ekam eveti| caitanyaṃ tu puruṣasya svabhāvo na khyāteḥ|
analyzed: nanu katham ekam darśanam yāvatā buddheḥ śabda ādi viṣayā viveka viṣayā ca vṛttiḥ prākṛta tayā jaḍa tvena anubhāvyā darśanam tatonyat puruṣasya caitanyam anubhavaḥ darśanam iti atas āha khyātiḥ eva darśanam iti udaya vyaya dharmiṇīm vṛttim khyātim laukikīm abhipretya etat uktam ekam eva iti caitanyam tu puruṣasya svabhāvaḥ na khyāteḥ

original: tat tu na lokapratyakṣagocaro'pi tv āgamānumānagocara ity arthaḥ| tad anena vyutthānāvasthāyāṃ mūlakāraṇam avidyāṃ darśayatā taddhetukaḥ saṃyogo bhogahetuḥ svasvāmibhāvo'pi sūcita iti tam upapādayann āha --- cittaṃ svaṃ bhavati puruṣasya svāmina iti saṃbandhaḥ| nanu cittajanitam upakāraṃ bhajamāno hi cetanaś cittasyeśitā|
analyzed: tat tu na loka pratyakṣa gocaraḥ api tu āgama anumāna gocaraḥ iti arthaḥ tat anena vyutthāna avasthāyām mūla kāraṇam avidyām darśayatā tad hetukaḥ saṃyogaḥ bhoga hetuḥ sva svāmi bhāvaḥ api sūcitaḥ iti tam upapādayan āha cittam svam bhavati puruṣasya svāminaḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ nanu citta janitam upakāram bhajamānaḥ hi cetanaḥ cittasya īśitā

original: na cāsya tajjanitopakārasaṃbhavas tadasaṃbandhād anupakāryatvāt tatsaṃyogatadupakārabhāgitve pariṇāmaprasaṅgād ity ata āha --- ayaskāntamaṇikalpaṃ saṃnidhimātropakāri dṛśyatveneti| na puruṣasaṃyuktaṃ cittam api tu tatsaṃnihitam| saṃnidhiś ca puruṣasya na deśataḥ kālato vā tadasaṃyogāt kiṃ tu yogyatālakṣaṇaḥ|
analyzed: na ca asya tad janita upakāra saṃbhavaḥ tad asaṃbandhāt anupakārya tvāt tad saṃyoga tad upakāra bhāgi tve pariṇāma prasaṅgāt iti atas āha ayaskānta maṇi kalpam saṃnidhi mātra upakāri dṛśya tvena iti na puruṣa saṃyuktam cittam api tu tat saṃnihitam saṃnidhiḥ ca puruṣasya na deśataḥ kālataḥ vā tad asaṃyogāt kim tu yogyatā lakṣaṇaḥ

original: asti ca puruṣasya bhoktṛśaktiś cittasya bhogaśaktiḥ| tad uktam --- dṛśyatveneti| śabdādyākārapariṇatasya bhogyatvenety arthaḥ| bhogaś ca yady api śabdādyākārā vṛttiś cittasya dharmas tathāpi cittacaitanyayor abhedasamāropād vṛttisārūpyāt puruṣasyety uktam| tasmāc cittenāsaṃyoge'pi tajjanitopakārabhāgitā puruṣasyāpariṇāmitā ceti siddham|
analyzed: asti ca puruṣasya bhoktṛ śaktiḥ cittasya bhoga śaktiḥ tat uktam dṛśya tvena iti śabda ādi ākāra pariṇatasya bhogya tvena iti arthaḥ bhogaḥ ca yadi api śabda ādi ākārā vṛttiḥ cittasya dharmaḥ tathā api citta caitanyayoḥ abheda samāropāt vṛtti sārūpyāt puruṣasya iti uktam tasmāt cittena asaṃyoge pi tad janita upakāra bhāgi tā puruṣasya apariṇāmi tā ca iti siddham

original: nanu svasvāmisaṃbandho bhogahetur avidyānimitto 'vidyā tu kiṃnimittā na khalv animittaṃ kāryam utpadyate| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: nanu sva svāmi saṃbandhaḥ bhoga hetuḥ avidyā nimittaḥ vidyā tu kiṃnimittā na khalu animittam kāryam utpadyate yathā āhuḥ

original: "svapnādivad avidyāyāḥ pravṛttis tasya kiṃkṛtā"|
analyzed: svapna ādi vat avidyāyāḥ pravṛttiḥ tasya kiṃkṛtā

original: iti śaṅkām upasaṃhāravyājenoddharati --- tasmāc cittavṛttibodhe śāntaghoramūḍhākāracittavṛttyupabhoge'nādyavidyānimittatvād anādiḥ saṃyogo hetur avidyāvāsanayoś ca saṃtāno bījāṅkurasaṃtānavad anādir iti bhāvaḥ||1.4||
analyzed: iti śaṅkām upasaṃhāra vyājena uddharati tasmāt citta vṛtti bodhe śānta ghora mūḍha ākāra cittavṛtti upabhogena ādya vidyā nimitta tvāt anādiḥ saṃyogaḥ hetuḥ avidyā vāsanayoḥ ca saṃtānaḥ bīja aṅkura saṃtāna vat anādiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ kliṣṭākliṣṭāḥ||1.5||
analyzed: vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ kliṣṭa akliṣṭāḥ

original: syād etat puruṣo hi śakya upadiśyate| na ca vṛttinirodho vṛttīr avijñāya śakyaḥ| na ca sahasreṇāpi puruṣāyuṣair alam imāḥ kaścit parigaṇayitum| asaṃkhyātāś ca kathaṃ niroddhavyā ity āśaṅkya tāsām iyattāsvarūpapratipādanaparaṃ sūtram avatārayati --- tāḥ punar niroddhavyā bahutve sati cittasya --- vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ kliṣṭākliṣṭāḥ|
analyzed: syāt etat puruṣaḥ hi śakyaḥ upadiśyate na ca vṛtti nirodhaḥ vṛttīḥ a vijñāya śakyaḥ na ca sahasreṇa api puruṣa āyuṣaiḥ alam imāḥ kaścid parigaṇayitum asaṃkhyātāḥ ca katham niroddhavyāḥ iti āśaṅkya tāsām iyattā svarūpa pratipādana param sūtram avatārayati tāḥ punar niroddhavyāḥ bahu tve sati cittasya vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ kliṣṭa akliṣṭāḥ

original: vṛttirūpo'vayavy ekas tasya pramāṇādayo'vayavāḥ pañca| tatas tadavayavā pañcatayī pañcāvayavā vṛttir bhavati| tāś ca vṛttayaś caitramaitrādicittabhedād bahvya iti bahuvacanam upapannam| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- caitro vā maitro vānyo vā kaścit sarveṣām eva teṣāṃ vṛttayaḥ pañcatayya eva nādhikā iti| cittasyeti caikavacanaṃ jātyabhiprāyam|
analyzed: vṛtti rūpaḥ vayavī ekaḥ tasya pramāṇa ādayaḥ vayavāḥ pañca tatas tad avayavā pañcatayī pañca avayavā vṛttiḥ bhavati tāḥ ca vṛttayaḥ caitra maitra ādi citta bhedāt bahvyaḥ iti bahuvacanam upapannam etat uktam bhavati caitraḥ vā maitraḥ vā anyaḥ vā kaścid sarveṣām eva teṣām vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ eva na adhikāḥ iti cittasya iti ca ekavacanam jāti abhiprāyam

original: cittānām iti tu draṣṭavyam| tāsām avāntaraviśeṣam anuṣṭhānopayoginaṃ darśayati --- kliṣṭākliṣṭā iti| akliṣṭā upādāya kliṣṭā niroddhavyās tā api pareṇa vairāgyeṇeti| asya vyākhyānaṃ --- kleśahetukā iti| kleśā asmitādayo hetavaḥ pravṛttikāraṇaṃ yāsāṃ vṛttīnāṃ tās tathoktāḥ|
analyzed: cittānām iti tu draṣṭavyam tāsām avāntara viśeṣam anuṣṭhāna upayoginam darśayati kliṣṭa akliṣṭāḥ iti akliṣṭāḥ upādāya kliṣṭāḥ niroddhavyāḥ tāḥ api pareṇa vairāgyeṇa iti asya vyākhyānam kleśa hetukāḥ iti kleśāḥ asmitā ādayaḥ hetavaḥ pravṛtti kāraṇam yāsām vṛttīnām tāḥ tathā uktāḥ

original: yad vā puruṣārthapradhānasya rajastamomayīnāṃ hi vṛttīnāṃ kleśakāraṇatvena kleśāyaiva pravṛttiḥ| kleśaḥ kliṣṭaṃ tad āsām astīti kliṣṭā iti| yata eva kleśopārjanārtham amūṣāṃ pravṛttir ata eva karmāśayapracaye kṣetrībhūtāḥ|
analyzed: yat vā puruṣa artha pradhānasya rajaḥ tamaḥ mayīnām hi vṛttīnām kleśa kāraṇa tvena kleśāya eva pravṛttiḥ kleśaḥ kliṣṭam tat āsām asti iti kliṣṭāḥ iti yatas eva kleśa upārjana artham amūṣām pravṛttiḥ atas eva karma āśaya pracaye kṣetrībhūtāḥ

original: pramāṇādinā khalv ayaṃ pratipattārtham avasāya tatra sakto dviṣṭo vā karmāśayam ācinotīti bhavanti dharmādharmapracayaprasavabhūmayo vṛttayaḥ kliṣṭā iti| akliṣṭā vyācaṣṭe --- khyātiviṣayā iti| vidhūtarajastamaso buddhisattvasya praśāntavāhinaḥ prajñāprasādaḥ khyātis tayā viṣayiṇyā tadviṣayaṃ sattvapuruṣavivekam upalakṣayati|
analyzed: pramāṇa ādinā khalu ayam pratipattā artham avasāya tatra saktaḥ dviṣṭaḥ vā karma āśayam ācinoti iti bhavanti dharma adharma pracaya prasava bhūmayaḥ vṛttayaḥ kliṣṭāḥ iti akliṣṭāḥ vyācaṣṭe khyāti viṣayāḥ iti vidhūta rajaḥ tamasaḥ buddhi sattvasya praśānta vāhinaḥ prajñā prasādaḥ khyātiḥ tayā viṣayiṇyā tad viṣayam sattva puruṣa vivekam upalakṣayati

original: tena sattvapuruṣavivekaviṣayā yato'ta eva guṇādhikāravirodhinyaḥ| kāryārambhaṇaṃ hi guṇānām adhikāro vivekakhyātiparyavasānaṃ ca tad iti caritādhikārāṇāṃ guṇānām adhikāraṃ virundhantīti| atas tā akliṣṭāḥ pramāṇaprabhṛtayo vṛttayaḥ| syād etad vītarāgajanmādarśanāt kliṣṭavṛttaya eva sarve prāṇabhṛtaḥ|
analyzed: tena sattva puruṣa viveka viṣayāḥ yatā uta eva guṇa adhikāra virodhinyaḥ kārya ārambhaṇam hi guṇānām adhikāraḥ viveka khyāti paryavasānam ca tat iti carita adhikārāṇām guṇānām adhikāram virundhanti iti atas tāḥ akliṣṭāḥ pramāṇa prabhṛtayaḥ vṛttayaḥ syāt etat vīta rāga janma adarśanāt kliṣṭa vṛttayaḥ eva sarve prāṇabhṛtaḥ

original: na ca kliṣṭavṛttipravāhe bhavitum arhanty akliṣṭā vṛttayo na cāmūṣāṃ bhāve'pi kāryakāritā virodhim adhyapātitvāt tasmāt kliṣṭānām akliṣṭābhir nirodhas tāsāṃ ca vairāgyeṇa pareṇeti manorathamātram ity ata āha --- kliṣṭapravāheti|
analyzed: na ca kliṣṭa vṛtti pravāhe bhavitum arhanti akliṣṭāḥ vṛttayaḥ na ca amūṣām bhāve pi kārya kāri tā virodhim adhyapāti tvāt tasmāt kliṣṭānām akliṣṭābhiḥ nirodhaḥ tāsām ca vairāgyeṇa pareṇa iti manoratha mātram iti atas āha kliṣṭa pravāha iti

original: āgamānumānācāryopadeśapariśīlanalabdhajanmanī abhyāsavairāgye kliṣṭacchidram antarā tatra patitāḥ svayam akliṣṭā eva yady api kliṣṭapravāhapatitāḥ| na khalu śālagrāme kirātaśatasaṃkīrṇe prativasann api brāhmaṇaḥ kirāto bhavati| akliṣṭacchidreṣv iti nidarśanam| kliṣṭāntaravartitayā ca kliṣṭābhir anabhibhūtā akliṣṭāḥ|
analyzed: āgama anumāna ācārya upadeśa pariśīlana labdha janmanī abhyāsa vairāgye kliṣṭa chidram antarā tatra patitāḥ svayam akliṣṭāḥ eva yadi api kliṣṭa pravāha patitāḥ na khalu śālagrāme kirāta śata saṃkīrṇe prativasan api brāhmaṇaḥ kirātaḥ bhavati akliṣṭa chidreṣu iti nidarśanam kliṣṭa antara varti tayā ca kliṣṭābhiḥ anabhibhūtāḥ akliṣṭāḥ

original: svasaṃskāraparipākakrameṇa kliṣṭā eva tāvad abhibhavantīty āha --- tathājātīyakā iti| akliṣṭābhir vṛttibhir akliṣṭāḥ saṃskārā ity arthaḥ| tad idaṃ vṛttisaṃskāracakram aniśam āvartate, ā nirodhasamādheḥ| tad evaṃbhūtaṃ cittaṃ nirodhāvasthaṃ saṃskāraśeṣaṃ bhūtvātmakalpenāvatiṣṭhata ity āpātataḥ pralayaṃ vā gacchatīti paramārthataḥ|
analyzed: sva saṃskāra paripāka krameṇa kliṣṭāḥ eva tāvat abhibhavanti iti āha tathājātīyakāḥ iti akliṣṭābhiḥ vṛttibhiḥ akliṣṭāḥ saṃskārāḥ iti arthaḥ tat idam vṛtti saṃskāra cakram aniśam āvartate ā nirodha samādheḥ tat evaṃbhūtam cittam nirodha avastham saṃskāra śeṣam bhūtvā ātma kalpena avatiṣṭhate iti āpātataḥ pralayam vā gacchati iti paramārthataḥ

original: piṇḍīkṛtya sūtrārtham āha --- tā iti| pañcadhety arthakathanamātraṃ na tu śabdavṛttivyākhyānam| tayapaḥ prakāre'smaraṇāt||1.5||
analyzed: piṇḍīkṛtya sūtra artham āha tāḥ iti pañcadhā iti artha kathana mātram na tu śabda vṛtti vyākhyānam

original: pramāṇaviparyayavikalpanidrāsmṛtayaḥ||1.6||
analyzed: pramāṇa viparyaya vikalpa nidrā smṛtayaḥ

original: tāḥ svasaṃjñābhir uddiśati --- pramāṇaviparyayavikalpanidrāsmṛtayaḥ| nirdeśe yathāvacanaṃ vigrahaś cārthe dvaṃdvaḥ samāsa itaretarayoge|
analyzed: tāḥ sva saṃjñābhiḥ uddiśati pramāṇa viparyaya vikalpa nidrā smṛtayaḥ nirdeśe yathāvacanam vigrahaḥ ca arthe dvaṃdvaḥ samāsaḥ itaretara yoge

original: yathā --- anityāśuciduḥkhānātmasu nityaśucisukhātmakhyātir avidyā ity ukte'pi na diṅmohālātacakrādivibhramā vyudasyanta evam ihāpi pramāṇādyabhidhāne'pi vṛttyantarasadbhāvaśaṅkā na vyudasyateti tannirāsāya vaktavyaṃ pañcatayya iti| etāvatya eva vṛttayo nāparāḥ santīti darśitaṃ bhavati||1.6||
analyzed: yathā anitya aśuci duḥkha anātmasu nitya śuci sukha ātma khyātiḥ avidyā iti ukte api na diś moha alāta cakra ādi vibhramāḥ vyudasyante evam iha api pramāṇa ādi abhidhāne api vṛtti antara sadbhāva śaṅkā na vyudasyate iti tad nirāsāya vaktavyam pañcatayyaḥ iti etāvatyaḥ eva vṛttayaḥ na aparāḥ santi iti darśitam bhavati

original: pratyakṣānumānāgamāḥ pramāṇāni||1.7||
analyzed: pratyakṣa anumāna āgamāḥ pramāṇāni

original: tatra pramāṇavṛttiṃ vibhajan sāmānyalakṣaṇam āha --- pratyakṣānumānāgamāḥ pramāṇāni| anadhigatatattvabodhaḥ pauruṣeyo vyavahārahetuḥ pramā| tatkāraṇaṃ pramāṇam| vibhāgavacanaṃ ca nyūnādhikasaṃkhyāvyavacchedārtham| tatra sakalapramāṇamūlatvāt prathamataḥ pratyakṣaṃ lakṣayati --- indriyeti| arthasyeti samāropitatvaṃ niṣedhati|
analyzed: tatra pramāṇa vṛttim vibhajan sāmānya lakṣaṇam āha pratyakṣa anumāna āgamāḥ pramāṇāni anadhigata tattva bodhaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ vyavahāra hetuḥ pramā tad kāraṇam pramāṇam vibhāga vacanam ca nyūna adhika saṃkhyā vyavaccheda artham tatra sakala pramāṇa mūla tvāt prathamatas pratyakṣam lakṣayati indriya iti arthasya iti samāropita tvam niṣedhati

original: tadviṣayeti bāhyagocaratayā jñānākāragocaratvaṃ nivārayati| cittavartino jñānākārasya bāhyajñeyasaṃbandhaṃ darśayati --- bāhyavastūparāgād iti| vyavahitasya taduparāge hetum āha --- indriyapraṇālikayeti| sāmānyamātram artha ity eke| viśeṣā evety anye| sāmānyaviśeṣatadvattety apare vādinaḥ pratipannās tannirāsāyāha --- sāmānyaviśeṣātmana iti|
analyzed: tad viṣaya iti bāhya gocara tayā jñāna ākāra gocara tvam nivārayati citta vartinaḥ jñāna ākārasya bāhya jñeya saṃbandham darśayati bāhya vastu uparāgāt iti vyavahitasya tad uparāge hetum āha indriya praṇālikayā iti sāmānya mātram arthaḥ iti eke viśeṣāḥ eva iti anye sāmānya viśeṣa tadvat tā iti apare vādinaḥ pratipannāḥ tad nirāsāya āha sāmānya viśeṣa ātmanaḥ iti

original: na tadvattā kiṃ tu tādātmyam arthasya| etac caikāntānabhypagama ity atra pratipādayiṣyate| anumānāgamaviṣayāt pratyakṣaviṣayaṃ vyavacchinatti --- viśeṣāvadhāraṇapradhāneti| yady api sāmānyam api pratyakṣe pratibhāsate tathāpi viśeṣaṃ pratyupasarjanībhūtam ity arthaḥ| etac ca sākṣātkāropalakṣaṇaparam| tathā ca vivekakhyātir api lakṣitā bhavati|
analyzed: na tadvattā kim tu tādātmyam arthasya etat ca ekānta anabhypagamaḥ iti atra pratipādayiṣyate anumāna āgama viṣayāt pratyakṣa viṣayam vyavacchinatti viśeṣa avadhāraṇa pradhānā iti yadi api sāmānyam api pratyakṣe pratibhāsate tathā api viśeṣam pratyupasarjanībhūtam iti arthaḥ etat ca sākṣātkāra upalakṣaṇa param tathā ca viveka khyātiḥ api lakṣitā bhavati

original: phalavipratipattiṃ nirākaroti --- phalaṃ pauruṣeyaś cittavṛttibodha iti| nanu puruṣavartī bodhaḥ kathaṃ cittagatāyā vṛtteḥ phalam| na hi khadiragocaravyāpāreṇa paraśunā palāśe chidā kriyata ity ata āha --- aviśiṣṭa iti|
analyzed: phala vipratipattim nirākaroti phalam pauruṣeyaḥ citta vṛtti bodhaḥ iti nanu puruṣa vartī bodhaḥ katham citta gatāyāḥ vṛtteḥ phalam na hi khadira gocara vyāpāreṇa paraśunā palāśe chidā kriyate iti atas āha aviśiṣṭaḥ iti

original: na hi puruṣagato bodho janyate, api tu caitanyam eva buddhidarpaṇapratibimbitaṃ buddhivṛttyārthākārayā tadākāratām āpadyamānaṃ phalam| tac ca tathābhūtaṃ buddher aviśiṣṭaṃ buddhyātmakaṃ, vṛttiś ca buddhyātmiketi sāmānādhikaraṇyād yuktaḥ pramāṇaphalabhāva ity arthaḥ| etac copapādayiṣyāma ity āha --- pratisaṃvedīti|
analyzed: na hi puruṣa gataḥ bodhaḥ janyate api tu caitanyam eva buddhi darpaṇa pratibimbitam buddhi vṛttyā artha ākārayā tad ākāra tām āpadyamānam phalam tat ca tathābhūtam buddheḥ aviśiṣṭam buddhi ātmakam vṛttiḥ ca buddhi ātmikā iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt yuktaḥ pramāṇa phala bhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ etat ca upapādayiṣyāmaḥ iti āha pratisaṃvedi iti

original: pratyakṣānantaraṃ pravṛttyādiliṅgakaśrotṛbuddhyanumānaprabhavasaṃbandhadarśanasamutthatayāgamasyānumānajatvād anumitasya cāgamenānvākhyānād āgamāt prāg anumānaṃ lakṣayati --- anumeyasyeti|
analyzed: pratyakṣa anantaram pravṛtti ādi liṅgaka śrotṛ buddhi anumāna prabhava saṃbandha darśana samuttha tayā āgamasya anumāna ja tvāt anumitasya ca āgamena anvākhyānāt āgamāt prāk anumānam lakṣayati anumeyasya iti

original: jijñāsitadharmaviśiṣṭo dharmyanumeyas tasya tulyajātīyāḥ sādhyadharmasāmānyena samānārthāḥ sapakṣās teṣv anuvṛtta ity anena viruddhatvam asādhāraṇatvaṃ ca sādhanadharmasya nirākaroti| bhinnajātīyā asapakṣās te ca sapakṣād anye tadviruddhās tadabhāvavantaś ca, tebhyo vyāvṛttas tad anena sādhāraṇānaikāntikatvam apākaroti|
analyzed: jijñāsita dharma viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī anumeyaḥ tasya tulya jātīyāḥ sādhya dharma sāmānyena samāna arthāḥ sapakṣāḥ teṣu anuvṛttaḥ iti anena viruddha tvam asādhāraṇa tvam ca sādhana dharmasya nirākaroti bhinna jātīyāḥ asapakṣāḥ te ca sapakṣāt anye tad viruddhāḥ tad abhāvavantaḥ ca tebhyaḥ vyāvṛttaḥ tat anena sādhāraṇa anaikāntika tvam apākaroti

original: saṃbadhyata iti saṃbandho liṅgam anena pakṣadharmatāṃ darśayann asiddhatāṃ nivārayati| tadviṣayā tannibandhanā, "ṣiñ bandhane" ity asmād viṣayapadavyutpatteḥ| sāmānyāvadhāraṇeti pratyakṣaviṣayād vyavacchinatti| saṃbandhasaṃvedanādhīnajanmānumānaṃ viśeṣeṣu saṃbandhagrahaṇābhāvena sāmānyam eva sukarasaṃbandhagrahaṇaṃ gocarayatīti|
analyzed: saṃbadhyate iti saṃbandhaḥ liṅgam anena pakṣa dharma tām darśayan asiddha tām nivārayati tad viṣayā tad nibandhanā bandhane iti asmāt viṣaya pada vyutpatteḥ sāmānya avadhāraṇā iti pratyakṣa viṣayāt vyavacchinatti saṃbandha saṃvedana adhīna janma anumānam viśeṣeṣu saṃbandha grahaṇa abhāvena sāmānyam eva sukara saṃbandha grahaṇam gocarayati iti

original: udāharaṇam āha --- yatheti| co hetvarthe| vindhyo 'gatir yatas tasmāt tasyāprāptir ato gatinivṛttau prāpter nivṛttir deśāntaraprāpter gatimac candratārakaṃ caitravad iti siddham| āgamasya vṛtter lakṣaṇam āha --- āpteneti| tattvadarśanakāruṇyakaraṇapāṭavābhisaṃbandha āptis tayā vartata ity āptas tena dṛṣṭo'numito vārthaḥ|
analyzed: udāharaṇam āha yathā iti caḥ hetvarthe vindhyaḥ gatiḥ yatas tasmāt tasya aprāptiḥ atas gati nivṛttau prāpteḥ nivṛttiḥ deśa antara prāpteḥ gatimat candra tārakam caitra vat iti siddham āgamasya vṛtteḥ lakṣaṇam āha āptena iti tattva darśana kāruṇya karaṇa pāṭava abhisaṃbandhaḥ āptiḥ tayā vartate iti āptaḥ tena dṛṣṭaḥ anumitaḥ vā arthaḥ

original: śrutasya pṛthag anupādānaṃ tasya dṛṣṭānumitamūlatvena tābhyām eva caritārthatvād āptacittavartijñānasadṛśasya jñānasya śrotṛcitte samutpādaḥ svabodhasaṃkrāntis tasyai, artha upadiśyate śrotṛhitāhitaprāptiparihāropāyatayā prajñāpyate| śeṣaṃ sugamam| yasyāgamasyāśraddheyārtho vaktā, yathā yāny eva daśa dāḍimāni tāni ṣaḍ apūpā bhaviṣyantīti|
analyzed: śrutasya pṛthak anupādānam tasya dṛṣṭa anumita mūla tvena tābhyām eva caritārtha tvāt āpta cittavarti jñāna sadṛśasya jñānasya śrotṛ citte samutpādaḥ sva bodha saṃkrāntiḥ tasyai arthaḥ upadiśyate śrotṛ hita ahita prāpti parihāra upāya tayā prajñāpyate śeṣam sugamam yasya āgamasya aśraddheya arthaḥ vaktā yathā yāni eva daśa dāḍimāni tāni ṣaṭ apūpāḥ bhaviṣyanti iti

original: na dṛṣṭānumitārtho yathā caityaṃ vandeta svargakāma iti| sa āgamaḥ plavate| nanv evaṃ manvādīnām apy āgamaḥ plaveta| na hi te'pi dṛṣṭānumitārthāḥ| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: na dṛṣṭa anumita arthaḥ yathā caityam vandeta svarga kāmaḥ iti saḥ āgamaḥ plavate nanu evam manu ādīnām api āgamaḥ plaveta na hi te api dṛṣṭa anumita arthāḥ yathā āhuḥ

original: "yaḥ kaścit kasyacid dharmo manunā parikīrtitaḥ| sa sarvo'bhihito vede sarvajñānamayo hi saḥ|"
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid kasyacid dharmaḥ manunā parikīrtitaḥ sa vede sarva jñāna mayaḥ hi saḥ

original: ity ata āha --- mūlavaktari tv iti| mūlavaktā hi tatreśvaro dṛṣṭānumitārtha ity arthaḥ||1.7||
analyzed: iti atas āha mūla vaktari tu iti mūla vaktā hi tatra īśvaraḥ dṛṣṭa anumita arthaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: viparyayo mithyājñānam atadrūpapratiṣṭham||1.8||
analyzed: viparyayaḥ mithyājñānam a tad rūpa pratiṣṭham

original: viparyayo mithyājñānam atadrūpapratiṣṭham| viparyaya iti lakṣyanirdeśaḥ| mithyājñānam ityādi lakṣaṇam| yaj jñānapratibhāsirūpaṃ, tadrūpāpratiṣṭham evātadrūpapratiṣṭham| yathāśrāddhabhojīti| ataḥ saṃśayo'pi saṃgṛhītaḥ| etāvāṃs tu viśeṣaḥ --- tatra jñānārūḍhaivāpratiṣṭhatā dvicandrādes tu bādhajñānena|
analyzed: viparyayaḥ mithyājñānam a tad rūpa pratiṣṭham viparyayaḥ iti lakṣya nirdeśaḥ mithyājñānam ityādi lakṣaṇam yat jñāna pratibhāsi rūpam tad rūpa apratiṣṭham eva a tad rūpa pratiṣṭham yathā śrāddha bhoji iti atas saṃśayaḥ api saṃgṛhītaḥ etāvān tu viśeṣaḥ tatra jñāna ārūḍhā eva apratiṣṭha tā dvi candra ādeḥ tu bādha jñānena

original: nanv evaṃ vikalpo'pi tadrūpāpratiṣṭhānād vicārato viparyayaḥ prasajyetety ata āha --- mithyājñānam iti| anena hi sarvajanīnānubhavasiddho bādha uktaḥ| sa cāsti viparyaye na tu vikalpe, tena vyavahārāt| paṇḍitarūpāṇām eva tu vicārayatāṃ tatra bādhabuddher iti| codayati --- sa kasmān na pramāṇam|
analyzed: nanu evam vikalpaḥ api tad rūpa apratiṣṭhānāt vicārataḥ viparyayaḥ prasajyeta iti atas āha mithyājñānam iti anena hi sarvajanīna anubhava siddhaḥ bādhaḥ uktaḥ sa ca asti viparyaye na tu vikalpe tena vyavahārāt paṇḍita rūpāṇām eva tu vicārayatām tatra bādha buddheḥ iti codayati sa kasmāt na pramāṇam

original: nottareṇopajātavirodhinā jñānena pūrvaṃ bādhanīyam api tu pūrveṇaiva prathamam upajātenānupajātavirodhinā param iti bhāvaḥ| pariharati --- yataḥ pramāṇeneti| yatra hi pūrvāpekṣā parotpattis tatraivam iha tu svakāraṇād anyonyānapekṣe jñāne jāyete|
analyzed: na uttareṇa upajāta virodhinā jñānena pūrvam bādhanīyam api tu pūrveṇa eva prathamam upajātena anupajāta virodhinā param iti bhāvaḥ pariharati yatas pramāṇena iti yatra hi pūrva apekṣā para utpattiḥ tatra evam iha tu sva kāraṇāt anyonya anapekṣe jñāne jāyete

original: tenottarasya pūrvam anupamṛdyodayam anāsādayatas tadapabādhātmaivodayo na tu pūrvasyottarabādhātmā, tasya tadānīm aprasakteḥ| tasmād anupajātavirodhitā bādhyatve hetur upajātavirodhitā ca bādhakatve| tasmād bhūtārthaviṣayatvāt pramāṇenāpramāṇasya bādhanaṃ siddham| udāharaṇam āha --- tatra pramāṇeneti|
analyzed: tena uttarasya pūrvam an upamṛdya udayam an āsādayataḥ tad apabādha ātmā eva udayaḥ na tu pūrvasya uttara bādhā ātmā tasya tadānīm aprasakteḥ tasmāt anupajāta virodhi tā bādhya tve hetuḥ upajāta virodhi tā ca bādhaka tve tasmāt bhūta artha viṣaya tvāt pramāṇena apramāṇasya bādhanam siddham udāharaṇam āha tatra pramāṇena iti

original: asya kutsitatvaṃ hānāya darśayati --- seyaṃ pañceti| avidyāsāmānyam avidyāsmitādiṣu pañcasu parvasv ity arthaḥ| avyaktamahadahaṃkārapañcatanmātreṣv aṣṭasv anātmasv ātmabuddhir avidyā tamaḥ| evaṃ yoginām aṣṭasv aṇimādikeṣv aiśvaryeṣv aśreyaḥsu śreyobuddhir aṣṭavidho mohaḥ pūrvasmāj jaghanyaḥ| sa cāsmitocyate|
analyzed: asya kutsita tvam hānāya darśayati sā iyam pañca iti avidyā sāmānyam avidyā asmitā ādiṣu pañcasu parvasu iti arthaḥ avyakta mahat ahaṃkāra pañca tanmātreṣu aṣṭasu anātmasu ātma buddhiḥ avidyā tamaḥ evam yoginām aṣṭasu aṇima ādikeṣu aiśvaryeṣu aśreyaḥsu śreyaḥ buddhiḥ aṣṭavidhaḥ mohaḥ pūrvasmāt jaghanyaḥ sa ca asmitā ucyate

original: yathā yogenāṣṭavidham aiśvaryam upādāya siddho bhūtvā dṛṣṭānuśravikāñ śabdādīn daśa viṣayān bhokṣya ityevamātmikā pratipattir mahāmoho rāgaḥ| evam etenaivābhisaṃdhinā pravartamānasya kenacit pratibaddhatvād aṇimādīnām anutpattau tannibandhanasya dṛṣṭānuśravikaviṣayopabhogasyāsiddheḥ pratibandhakaviṣayaḥ krodhaḥ sa tāmisrākhyo dveṣaḥ|
analyzed: yathā yogena aṣṭavidham aiśvaryam upādāya siddhaḥ bhūtvā dṛṣṭa ānuśravikān śabda ādīn daśa viṣayān bhokṣye iti evam ātmikā pratipattiḥ mahā mohaḥ rāgaḥ evam etena eva abhisaṃdhinā pravartamānasya kenacid pratibaddha tvāt aṇima ādīnām anutpattau tad nibandhanasya dṛṣṭa ānuśravika viṣaya upabhogasya asiddheḥ pratibandhaka viṣayaḥ krodhaḥ sa tāmisra ākhyaḥ dveṣaḥ

original: evam aṇimādiguṇasaṃpattau dṛṣṭānuśravikaviṣayapratyupasthāne ca kalpānte sarvam etan naṅkṣyatīti yas trāsaḥ so'bhiniveśo 'ndhatāmisraḥ| tad uktam ---
analyzed: evam aṇima ādi guṇa saṃpattau dṛṣṭa ānuśravika viṣaya pratyupasthāne ca kalpa ante sarvam etat naṅkṣyati iti yaḥ trāsaḥ sa abhiniveśaḥ ndhatāmisraḥ tat uktam

original: "bhedas tamaso'ṣṭavidho mohasya ca daśavidho mahāmohaḥ| tāmisro 'ṣṭādaśadhā tathā bhavaty andhatāmisraḥ" iti||1.8||
analyzed: bhedaḥ tamasā uṣṭavidhaḥ mohasya ca daśavidhaḥ mahāmohaḥ tāmisraḥ ṣṭādaśadhā tathā bhavati andhatāmisraḥ iti

original: śabdajñānānupātī vastuśūnyo vikalpaḥ||1.9||
analyzed: śabda jñāna anupātī vastu śūnyaḥ vikalpaḥ

original: śabdajñānānupātī vastuśūnyo vikalpaḥ| nanu śabdajñānānupātī ced āgamapramāṇāntaragato (āgamapramāṇāntargato) vikalpaḥ prasajyeta nirvastukatve vā viparyayaḥ syād ity ata āha --- sa neti| na pramāṇaviparyayāntargataḥ| kasmād yato vastuśūnyatve'pīti pramāṇāntargatiṃ niṣedhati| śabdajñānamāhātmyanibandhana iti viparyayāntargatim|
analyzed: śabda jñāna anupātī vastu śūnyaḥ vikalpaḥ nanu śabda jñāna anupātī ced āgama pramāṇa antara gataḥ āgama pramāṇa antargataḥ vikalpaḥ prasajyeta nirvastuka tve vā viparyayaḥ syāt iti atas āha sa na iti na pramāṇa viparyaya antargataḥ kasmāt yatas vastu śūnya tve pi iti pramāṇa antargatim niṣedhati śabda jñāna māhātmya nibandhanaḥ iti viparyaya antargatim

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- kvacid abhede bhedam āropayati kvacit punar bhinnānām abhedam| tato bhedasyābhedasya ca vastuno'bhāvāt tadābhāso vikalpo na pramāṇaṃ nāpi viparyayo vyavahārāvisaṃvādād iti| śāstraprasiddham udāharaṇam āha --- tadyatheti| kiṃ viśeṣyaṃ kena vyapadiśyate viśeṣyate nābhede viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo na hi gavā gaur viśeṣyate|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati kvacid abhede bhedam āropayati kvacid punar bhinnānām abhedam tatas bhedasya abhedasya ca vastunaḥ bhāvāt tad ābhāsaḥ vikalpaḥ na pramāṇam na api viparyayaḥ vyavahāra avisaṃvādāt iti śāstra prasiddham udāharaṇam āha tat yathā iti kim viśeṣyam kena vyapadiśyate viśeṣyate na abhede viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāvaḥ na hi gavā gauḥ viśeṣyate

original: kiṃ tu bhinnenaiva caitreṇa| tad idam āha --- bhavati ca vyapadeśe vṛttiḥ| vyapadeśavyapadeśyayor bhāvo vyapadeśaḥ| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva iti yāvat| tasmin vṛttir vākyasya yathā caitrasya gaur iti| śāstrīyam evodāharaṇāntaraṃ samuccinoti --- tatheti| pratiṣiddho vastunaḥ pṛthivyāder dharmaḥ parispando yasya sa tathoktaḥ| ko'sau niṣkriyaḥ puruṣaḥ|
analyzed: kim tu bhinnena eva caitreṇa tat idam āha bhavati ca vyapadeśe vṛttiḥ vyapadeśa vyapadeśyayoḥ bhāvaḥ vyapadeśaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ iti yāvat tasmin vṛttiḥ vākyasya yathā caitrasya gauḥ iti śāstrīyam eva udāharaṇa antaram samuccinoti tathā iti pratiṣiddhaḥ vastunaḥ pṛthivī ādeḥ dharmaḥ parispandaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ kaḥ asau niṣkriyaḥ puruṣaḥ

original: na khalu sāṃkhyīye rāddhānte'bhāvo nāma kaścid asti vastudharmo yena puruṣo viśeṣyetety arthaḥ| kvacit pāṭhaḥ pratiṣiddhā vastudharmā iti| tasyārthaḥ --- pratiṣedhavyāptāḥ pratiṣiddhā na vastudharmāṇāṃ tadvyāpyatā bhāvābhāvayor asaṃbandhād atha ca tathā pratītir iti| laukikam udāharaṇam āha --- tiṣṭhati bāṇa iti|
analyzed: na khalu sāṃkhyīye rāddhānte bhāvaḥ nāma kaścid asti vastu dharmaḥ yena puruṣaḥ viśeṣyeta iti arthaḥ kvacid pāṭhaḥ pratiṣiddhāḥ vastu dharmāḥ iti tasya arthaḥ pratiṣedha vyāptāḥ pratiṣiddhāḥ na vastu dharmāṇām tad vyāpya tā bhāva abhāvayoḥ asaṃbandhāt atha ca tathā pratītiḥ iti laukikam udāharaṇam āha tiṣṭhati bāṇaḥ iti

original: yathā hi pacati bhinattīty atra pūrvāparībhūtaḥ karmakṣaṇapracaya ekaphalāvacchinnaḥ pratīyata evaṃ tiṣṭhatīty atrāpi| pūrvāparībhāvam evāha --- sthāsyati sthita iti| nanu bhavatu pākavat pūrvāparībhūtayāvasthānakriyayā bāṇād bhinnayā bāṇasya vyapadeśa ity ata āha --- gatinivṛttau dhātvarthamātraṃ gamyate|
analyzed: yathā hi pacati bhinatti iti atra pūrvāparībhūtaḥ karma kṣaṇa pracayaḥ eka phala avacchinnaḥ pratīyate evam tiṣṭhati iti atra api pūrvāparībhāvam eva āha sthāsyati sthitaḥ iti nanu bhavatu pāka vat pūrvāparībhūtayā avasthāna kriyayā bāṇāt bhinnayā bāṇasya vyapadeśaḥ iti atas āha gati nivṛttau dhātu artha mātram gamyate

original: gatinivṛttir eva tāvat kalpitā tasyā api bhāvarūpatvaṃ tatrāpi pūrvāparībhāva ity aho kalpanāparamparety arthaḥ| abhāvaḥ kalpito bhāva iva cānugata iva ca sarvapuruṣeṣu gamyate na punaḥ puruṣavyatirikto dharmaḥ kaścid ity udāharaṇāntaram āha --- tathānutpattidharmeti| pramāṇaviparyayābhyām anyā na vikalpavṛttir iti vādino bahavaḥ pratipedire|
analyzed: gati nivṛttiḥ eva tāvat kalpitā tasyāḥ api bhāva rūpa tvam tatra api pūrvāparībhāvaḥ iti aho kalpanā paramparā iti arthaḥ abhāvaḥ kalpitaḥ bhāvaḥ iva ca anugataḥ iva ca sarva puruṣeṣu gamyate na punar puruṣa vyatiriktaḥ dharmaḥ kaścid iti udāharaṇa antaram āha tathā anutpatti dharma iti pramāṇa viparyayābhyām anyā na vikalpa vṛttiḥ iti vādinaḥ bahavaḥ pratipedire

original: tatpratibodhanāyodāharaṇaprapañca iti mantavyam||1.9||
analyzed: tad pratibodhanāya udāharaṇa prapañcaḥ iti mantavyam

original: abhāvapratyayālambanā vṛttir nidrā||1.10||

abhāvapratyayālambanā vṛttir nidrā| adhikṛtaṃ hi vṛttipadam anuvādakam| pramāṇaviparyayavikalpasmṛtīnāṃ vṛttitvaṃ prati parīkṣakāṇām avipratipatteḥ| atas tad anūdyate viśeṣavidhānāya| nidrāyās tu vṛttitve parīkṣakāṇām asti vipratipattir iti vṛttitvaṃ vidheyam| na ca prakṛtam anuvādakaṃ vidhānāya kalpata iti punar vṛttigrahaṇam|
analyzed: abhāva pratyaya ālambanā vṛttiḥ nidrā adhikṛtam hi vṛtti padam anuvādakam pramāṇa viparyaya vikalpa smṛtīnām vṛtti tvam prati parīkṣakāṇām avipratipatteḥ atas tat anūdyate viśeṣa vidhānāya nidrāyāḥ tu vṛtti tve parīkṣakāṇām asti vipratipattiḥ iti vṛtti tvam vidheyam na ca prakṛtam anuvādakam vidhānāya kalpate iti punar vṛtti grahaṇam

original: jāgratsvapnavṛttīnām abhāvas tasya pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ buddhisattvāc chādakaṃ tamas tad evālambanaṃ viṣayo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā vṛttir nidrā| buddhisattve hi triguṇe yadā sattvarajasī abhibhūya samastakaraṇāvarakam āvirasti tamas tadā buddher viṣayākārapariṇāmābhāvād udbhūtatamomayīṃ buddhim avabudhyamānaḥ puruṣaḥ suṣupto'ntaḥsaṃjña ity ucyate|
analyzed: jāgrat svapna vṛttīnām abhāvaḥ tasya pratyayaḥ kāraṇam buddhi sattvāt chādakam tamaḥ tat eva ālambanam viṣayaḥ yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā vṛttiḥ nidrā buddhi sattve hi triguṇe yadā sattva rajasī abhibhūya samasta karaṇa āvarakam āvirasti tamaḥ tadā buddheḥ viṣaya ākāra pariṇāma abhāvāt udbhūta tamaḥ mayīm buddhim avabudhyamānaḥ puruṣaḥ suṣuptaḥ untaḥsaṃjñaḥ iti ucyate

original: kasmāt punar niruddhakaivalyayor iva vṛttyabhāva eva na nidrety ata āha --- sā ca saṃprabodhe pratyavamarśāt sopapattikāt smaraṇāt pratyayaviśeṣaḥ| kathaṃ, yadā hi sattvasacivaṃ tama āvirasti tadedṛśaḥ pratyavamarśaḥ suptotthitasya bhavati sukham aham asvāpsaṃ prasannaṃ me manaḥ prajñāṃ me viśāradīkaroti svacchīkarotīti|
analyzed: kasmāt punar niruddha kaivalyayoḥ iva vṛtti abhāvaḥ eva na nidrā iti atas āha sā ca saṃprabodhe pratyavamarśāt sa upapattikāt smaraṇāt pratyaya viśeṣaḥ katham yadā hi sattva sacivam tamaḥ āvis asti tadā īdṛśaḥ pratyavamarśaḥ supta utthitasya bhavati sukham aham asvāpsam prasannam me manaḥ prajñām me viśāradīkaroti svacchīkaroti iti

original: yadā tu rajaḥsacivaṃ tama āvirasti tadedṛśaḥ pratyavamarśa ity āha --- duḥkham aham asvāpsaṃ styānam akarmaṇyaṃ me manaḥ kasmād yato bhramaty anavasthitam| nitāntābhibhūtarajaḥsattve tamaḥsamullāse svāpe prabuddhasya pratyavamarśam āha --- gāḍhaṃ mūḍho'ham asvāpsaṃ gurūṇi me gātrāṇi klāntaṃ me cittamalasaṃ muṣitam iva tiṣṭhatīti|
analyzed: yadā tu rajaḥ sacivam tamaḥ āvis asti tadā īdṛśaḥ pratyavamarśaḥ iti āha duḥkham aham asvāpsam styānam akarmaṇyam me manaḥ kasmāt yatas bhramati anavasthitam nitānta abhibhūta rajaḥ sattve tamaḥ samullāse svāpe prabuddhasya pratyavamarśam āha gāḍham mūḍhaḥ aham asvāpsam gurūṇi me gātrāṇi klāntam me cittam alasam muṣitam iva tiṣṭhati iti

original: sādhyavyatireke hetuvyatirekam āha --- na khalv ayam iti| prabuddhasya prabuddhamātrasya| tadāśritāś ceti bodhakāle, pratyayānubhave vṛttyabhāvakāraṇānubhava ity arthaḥ| nanu pramāṇādayo vyutthānacittādhikaraṇā nirudhyantāṃ samādhipratipakṣatvān nidrāyās tv ekāgravṛttitulyāyāḥ kathaṃ samādhipratipakṣatety ata āha --- sā ca samādhāv iti|
analyzed: sādhya vyatireke hetu vyatirekam āha na khalu ayam iti prabuddhasya prabuddha mātrasya tad āśritāḥ ca iti bodha kāle pratyaya anubhave vṛtti abhāva kāraṇa anubhave iti arthaḥ nanu pramāṇa ādayaḥ vyutthāna citta adhikaraṇāḥ nirudhyantām samādhi pratipakṣa tvāt nidrāyāḥ tu ekāgra vṛtti tulyāyāḥ katham samādhi pratipakṣa tā iti atas āha sā ca samādhau iti

original: ekāgratulyāpi tāmasatvena nidrā sabījanirbījasamādhipratipakṣeti sāpi niroddhavyety arthaḥ||1.10||
analyzed: ekāgra tulyā api tāmasa tvena nidrā sa bīja nirbīja samādhi pratipakṣā iti sā api niroddhavyā iti arthaḥ

original: anubhūtaviṣayāsaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtiḥ||1.11||
analyzed: anubhūta viṣaya asaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtiḥ

original: anubhūtaviṣayāsaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtiḥ| pramāṇādibhir anubhūte viṣaye yo'saṃpramoṣo 'steyaṃ sā smṛtiḥ| saṃskāramātrajasya hi jñānasya saṃskārakāraṇānubhavāvabhāsito viṣaya ātmīyas tadadhikaviṣayaparigrahas tu saṃpramoṣaḥ steyam| kasmāt sādṛśyāt| "muṣa steye" ity asmāt pramoṣapadavyutpatteḥ|
analyzed: anubhūta viṣaya asaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtiḥ pramāṇa ādibhiḥ anubhūte viṣaye steyam sā smṛtiḥ saṃskāra mātra jasya hi jñānasya saṃskāra kāraṇa anubhava avabhāsitaḥ viṣayaḥ ātmīyaḥ tad adhika viṣaya parigrahaḥ tu saṃpramoṣaḥ steyam kasmāt sādṛśyāt steye iti asmāt pramoṣa pada vyutpatteḥ

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- sarve pramāṇādayo'nadhigatam arthaṃ sāmānyataḥ prakārato vādhigamayanti| smṛtiḥ punar na pūrvānubhavamaryādām atikrāmati| tadviṣayā tadūnaviṣayā vā na tu tadadhikaviṣayā| so'yaṃ vṛttyantarād viśeṣaḥ smṛter iti| vimṛśati --- kiṃ pratyayasyeti|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati sarve pramāṇa ādayaḥ anadhigatam artham sāmānyatas prakārataḥ vā adhigamayanti smṛtiḥ punar na pūrva anubhava maryādām atikrāmati tad viṣayā tad ūna viṣayā vā na tu tad adhika viṣayā saḥ yam vṛtti antarāt viśeṣaḥ smṛteḥ iti vimṛśati kim pratyayasya iti

original: grāhyapravaṇatvād anubhavasya svānubhavābhāvāt tajjaḥ saṃskāro grāhyam eva smārayatīti pratibhāti| anubhavamātrajanitatvāc cānubhavam eveti| vimṛśyopapattita ubhayasmaraṇam avadhārayati --- grāhyapravaṇatayā grāhyoparaktaḥ| paramārthatas tu grāhyagrahaṇe evobhayaṃ tayor ākāraṃ svarūpaṃ nirbhāsayati prakāśayati|
analyzed: grāhya pravaṇa tvāt anubhavasya sva anubhava abhāvāt tad jaḥ saṃskāraḥ grāhyam eva smārayati iti pratibhāti anubhava mātra janita tvāt ca anubhavam eva iti vimṛśya upapattitaḥ ubhaya smaraṇam avadhārayati grāhya pravaṇa tayā grāhya uparaktaḥ paramārthataḥ tu grāhya grahaṇe eva ubhayam tayoḥ ākāram sva rūpam nirbhāsayati prakāśayati

original: svavyañjakaṃ kāraṇam añjanam ākāro yasya sa tathoktaḥ| svakāraṇākāra ity arthaḥ| vyañjakam udbodhakaṃ tenāñjanaṃ phalābhimukhīkaraṇaṃ yasyeti vety arthaḥ| nanu yadi kāraṇavicāreṇa buddhismaraṇayoḥ sārūpyaṃ kas tarhi bheda ity ata āha --- tatra grahaṇeti| grahaṇam upādānaṃ, na ca gṛhītasyopāttasyopādānaṃ saṃbhavati|
analyzed: sva vyañjakam kāraṇam añjanam ākāraḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ sva kāraṇa ākāraḥ iti arthaḥ vyañjakam udbodhakam tena añjanam phala abhimukhīkaraṇam yasya iti vā iti arthaḥ nanu yadi kāraṇa vicāreṇa buddhi smaraṇayoḥ sārūpyam kaḥ tarhi bhedaḥ iti atas āha tatra grahaṇa iti grahaṇam upādānam na ca gṛhītasya upāttasya upādānam saṃbhavati

original: tad anenānadhigatabodhanaṃ buddhir ity uktam| grahaṇākāro grahaṇarūpaṃ pūrvaṃ pradhānaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| vikalpitaś cāyam abhede'pi guṇapradhānabhāva iti| grāhyākāraḥ pūrvaḥ prathamo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| idam eva ca grāhyākārasya grāhyasya pūrvatvaṃ yad vṛttyantaraviṣayīkṛtatvam arthasya|
analyzed: tat anena anadhigata bodhanam buddhiḥ iti uktam grahaṇa ākāraḥ grahaṇa rūpam pūrvam pradhānam yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā vikalpitaḥ ca ayam abhede pi guṇa pradhāna bhāvaḥ iti grāhya ākāraḥ pūrvaḥ prathamaḥ yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā idam eva ca grāhya ākārasya grāhyasya pūrva tvam yat vṛtti antara viṣayīkṛta tvam arthasya

original: tad anena vṛttyantaraviṣayīkṛtagocarā smṛtir ity uktaṃ bhavati| so'yam asaṃpramoṣa iti| nanv asti smṛter api saṃpramoṣaḥ| darśayati hi pitrāder atītasya deśakālāntarānubhūtasyānanubhūtacaradeśakālāntarasaṃbandhaḥ svapna ity ata āha --- sā ca dvayīti| bhāvitaḥ kalpitaḥ smartavyo yayā sā tathoktā| abhāvito'kalpitaḥ pāramārthika iti yāvat|
analyzed: tat anena vṛtti antara viṣayīkṛta gocarā smṛtiḥ iti uktam bhavati saḥ ayam asaṃpramoṣaḥ iti nanu asti smṛteḥ api saṃpramoṣaḥ darśayati hi pitṛ ādeḥ atītasya deśa kāla antara anubhūtasya ananubhūta cara deśa kāla antara saṃbandhaḥ svapnaḥ iti atas āha sā ca dvayī iti bhāvitaḥ kalpitaḥ smartavyaḥ yayā sā tathā uktā abhāvita ukalpitaḥ pāramārthikaḥ iti yāvat

original: neyaṃ smṛtir api tu viparyayas tallakṣaṇopapannatvāt smṛtyābhāsatayā tu smṛtir uktā| pramāṇābhāsam iva pramāṇam iti bhāvaḥ| kasmāt punar ante smṛter upanyāsa ity ata āha --- sarvāḥ smṛtaya iti| anubhavaḥ prāptiḥ| prāptipūrvā vṛttiḥ smṛtis tataḥ smṛtīnām upajana ity arthaḥ| nanu ye puruṣaṃ kliśnanti te niroddhavyāḥ prekṣāvatā| kleśāś ca tathā|
analyzed: na iyam smṛtiḥ api tu viparyayaḥ tad lakṣaṇa upapanna tvāt smṛti ābhāsa tayā tu smṛtiḥ uktā pramāṇa ābhāsam iva pramāṇam iti bhāvaḥ kasmāt punar ante smṛteḥ upanyāsaḥ iti atas āha sarvāḥ smṛtayaḥ iti anubhavaḥ prāptiḥ prāpti pūrvā vṛttiḥ smṛtiḥ tatas smṛtīnām upajanaḥ iti arthaḥ nanu ye puruṣam kliśnanti te niroddhavyāḥ prekṣāvatā kleśāḥ ca tathā

original: na ca vṛttayaḥ, tat kimartham āsāṃ nirodha ity ata āha --- sarvāś caitā iti| sugamam||1.11||
analyzed: na ca vṛttayaḥ tat kimartham āsām nirodhaḥ iti atas āha sarvāḥ ca etāḥ iti sugamam

original: abhyāsavairāgyābhyāṃ tannirodhaḥ||1.12||
analyzed: abhyāsa vairāgyābhyām tad nirodhaḥ

original: nirodhopāyaṃ pṛcchati --- atheti| sūtreṇottaram āha --- abhyāsavairāgyābhyāṃ tannirodhaḥ| abhyāsavairāgyayor nirodhe janayitavye'vāntaravyāpārabhedena samuccayo na tu vikalpa ity āha --- cittanadīti| prāgbhāraḥ prabandhaḥ| nimnatā gambhīratā, agādhateti yāvat||1.12||
analyzed: nirodha upāyam pṛcchati atha iti sūtreṇa uttaram āha abhyāsa vairāgyābhyām tad nirodhaḥ abhyāsa vairāgyayoḥ nirodhe janayitavyā iva antara vyāpāra bhedena samuccayaḥ na tu vikalpaḥ iti āha citta nadī iti prāgbhāraḥ prabandhaḥ nimnatā gambhīra tā agādha tā iti yāvat

original: tatra sthitau yatno'bhyāsaḥ||1.13||
analyzed: tatra sthitau yatnaḥ abhyāsaḥ

original: tatrābhyāsasya svarūpaprayojanābhyāṃ lakṣaṇam āha --- tatra sthitau yatno'bhyāsaḥ| tad vyācaṣṭe --- cittasyāvṛttikasya rājasatāmasavṛttirahitasya praśāntavāhitā vimalatā sāttvikavṛttivāhitaikāgratā sthitiḥ| tadartha iti| sthitāv iti nimittasaptamī vyākhyātā| yathā "carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti" iti|
analyzed: tatra abhyāsasya svarūpa prayojanābhyām lakṣaṇam āha tatra sthitau yatnaḥ abhyāsaḥ tat vyācaṣṭe cittasya avṛttikasya rājasa tāmasa vṛtti rahitasya praśānta vāhi tā vimala tā sāttvika vṛtti vāhita ekāgra tā sthitiḥ tad arthaḥ iti sthitau iti nimitta saptamī vyākhyātā yathā carmaṇi dvīpinam hanti iti

original: prayatnam eva paryāyābhyāṃ viśadayati --- vīryam utsāha iti| tasyecchāyonitām āha --- tatsaṃpipādayiṣayā| tad iti sthitiṃ parāmṛśati| prayatnasya viṣayam āha --- tatsādhaneti| sthitisādhanāny antaraṅgabahiraṅgāṇi yamaniyamādīni| sādhanagocaraḥ kartṛvyāpāro na phalagocara iti||1.13||
analyzed: prayatnam eva paryāyābhyām viśadayati vīryam utsāhaḥ iti tasya icchā yoni tām āha tad saṃpipādayiṣayā tat iti sthitim parāmṛśati prayatnasya viṣayam āha tad sādhana iti sthiti sādhanāni antaraṅga bahiraṅgāṇi yama niyama ādīni sādhana gocaraḥ kartṛ vyāpāraḥ na phala gocaraḥ iti

original: sa tu dīrghakālanairantaryasatkārāsevito dṛḍhabhūmiḥ||1.14||
analyzed: sa tu dīrgha kāla nairantarya satkāra āsevitaḥ dṛḍha bhūmiḥ

original: nanu vyutthānasaṃskāreṇānādinā paripanthinā pratibaddho 'bhyāsaḥ kathaṃ sthityai kalpata ity ata āha --- sa tu dīrghakālanairantaryasatkārāsevito dṛḍhabhūmiḥ| so'yam abhyāso viśeṣaṇatrayasaṃpannaḥ san dṛḍhāvastho na sahasā vyutthānasaṃskārair abhibhūtasthitirūpaviṣayo bhavati|
analyzed: nanu vyutthāna saṃskāreṇa anādinā paripanthinā pratibaddhaḥ bhyāsaḥ katham sthityai kalpate iti atas āha sa tu dīrgha kāla nairantarya satkāra āsevitaḥ dṛḍha bhūmiḥ saḥ ayam abhyāsaḥ viśeṣaṇa traya saṃpannaḥ san dṛḍha avasthaḥ na sahasā vyutthāna saṃskāraiḥ abhibhūta sthiti rūpa viṣayaḥ bhavati

original: yadi punar evaṃbhūtam apy abhyāsaṃ kṛtvoparamet tataḥ kālaparivāsenābhibhūyeta| tasmān noparantavyam iti bhāvaḥ||1.14||
analyzed: yadi punar evaṃbhūtam api abhyāsam kṛtvā uparamet tatas kāla parivāsena abhibhūyeta tasmāt na uparantavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: dṛṣṭānuśravikaviṣayavitṛṣṇasya vaśīkārasaṃjñā vairāgyam||1.15||
analyzed: dṛṣṭa ānuśravika viṣaya vitṛṣṇasya vaśīkāra saṃjñā vairāgyam

original: vairāgyam āha --- dṛṣṭānuśravikaviṣayavitṛṣṇasya vaśīkārasaṃjñā vairāgyam| cetanācetaneṣu dṛṣṭaviṣayeṣu vitṛṣṇatām āha --- striya iti| aiśvaryam ādhipatyam| anuśravo vedas tato'dhigatā ānuśravikāḥ svargādayaḥ| tatrāpi vaitṛṣṇyam āha --- svargeti| deharahitā videhāḥ karaṇeṣu līnās teṣāṃ bhāvo vaidehyam|
analyzed: vairāgyam āha dṛṣṭa ānuśravika viṣaya vitṛṣṇasya vaśīkāra saṃjñā vairāgyam cetana acetaneṣu dṛṣṭa viṣayeṣu vitṛṣṇa tām āha striyaḥ iti aiśvaryam ādhipatyam anuśravaḥ vedaḥ tatas adhigatāḥ ānuśravikāḥ svarga ādayaḥ tatra api vaitṛṣṇyam āha svarga iti deha rahitāḥ videhāḥ karaṇeṣu līnāḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ vaidehyam

original: anye tu prakṛtim evātmānam abhimanyamānāḥ prakṛtyupāsakāḥ prakṛtau sādhikārāyām eva līnās teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ prakṛtilayatvaṃ tatprāptiviṣaye, ānuśravikaviṣaye vitṛṣṇasyānuśravikaviṣaye vitṛṣṇo hi svargādiprāptiviṣaye vitṛṣṇa ity ucyate| nanu yadi vaitṛṣṇyamātraṃ vairāgyaṃ hanta viṣayāprāptāv api tad astīti vairāgyaṃ syād ity ata āha --- divyādivyeti|
analyzed: anye tu prakṛtim eva ātmānam abhimanyamānāḥ prakṛti upāsakāḥ prakṛtau sādhikārāyām eva līnāḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ prakṛti laya tvam tad prāpti viṣaye ānuśravika viṣaye vitṛṣṇasya ānuśravika viṣaye vitṛṣṇaḥ hi svarga ādi prāpti viṣaye vitṛṣṇaḥ iti ucyate nanu yadi vaitṛṣṇya mātram vairāgyam hanta viṣaya aprāptau api tat asti iti vairāgyam syāt iti atas āha divya adivya iti

original: na vaitṛṣṇyamātraṃ vairāgyam api tu divyādivyaviṣaysaṃprayoge 'pi cittasyānābhogātmikā| tām eva spaṣṭayati --- heyopādeyaśūnyā| āsaṅgadveṣarahitopekṣābuddhir vaśīkārasaṃjñā| kutaḥ punar iyam ity atrāha --- prasaṃkhyānabalād iti| tāpatrayaparītatā viṣayāṇāṃ doṣas tatparibhāvanayā tatsākṣātkāraḥ prasaṃkhyānaṃ tadbalād ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: na vaitṛṣṇya mātram vairāgyam api tu divya adivya viṣaya saṃprayoge cittasya anābhoga ātmikā tām eva spaṣṭayati heya upādeya śūnyā āsaṅga dveṣa rahita upekṣā buddhiḥ vaśīkāra saṃjñā kutas punar iyam iti atra āha prasaṃkhyāna balāt iti tāpa traya parīta tā viṣayāṇām doṣaḥ tad paribhāvanayā tad sākṣātkāraḥ prasaṃkhyānam tad balāt iti arthaḥ

original: yatamānasaṃjñā, vyatirekasaṃjñā, ekendriyasaṃjñā, vaśīkārasaṃjñā ceti catasraḥ saṃjñā ity āgaminaḥ| rāgādayaḥ khalu kaṣāyāś cittavartinas tair indriyāṇi yathāsvaṃ viṣayeṣu pravartante, tan mā pravartiṣatendriyāṇi tattadviṣayeṣv iti tatparipācanāyārambhaḥ prayatnaḥ sā yatamānasaṃjñā| tadārambhe sati kecit kaṣāyāḥ pakvāḥ pacyante pakṣyante ca kecit|
analyzed: yatamāna saṃjñā vyatireka saṃjñā eka indriya saṃjñā vaśīkāra saṃjñā ca iti catasraḥ saṃjñāḥ iti āgaminaḥ rāga ādayaḥ khalu kaṣāyāḥ citta vartinaḥ taiḥ indriyāṇi yathāsvam viṣayeṣu pravartante tat mā pravartiṣata indriyāṇi tad tad viṣayeṣu iti tad paripācanāya ārambhaḥ prayatnaḥ sā yatamāna saṃjñā tad ārambhe sati kecid kaṣāyāḥ pakvāḥ pacyante pakṣyante ca kecid

original: tatra pakṣyamāṇebhyaḥ pakvānāṃ vyatirekeṇāvadhāraṇaṃ vyatirekasaṃjñā| indriyapravartanāsamarthatayā pakvānām autsukyamātreṇa manasi vyavasthānam ekendriyasaṃjñā| autsukyamātrasyāpi nivṛttir upasthiteṣv api divyādivyaviṣayeṣūpekṣābuddhiḥ saṃjñātrayāt parā vaśīkārasaṃjñā|
analyzed: tatra pakṣyamāṇebhyaḥ pakvānām vyatirekeṇa avadhāraṇam vyatireka saṃjñā indriya pravartana asamartha tayā pakvānām autsukya mātreṇa manasi vyavasthānam eka indriya saṃjñā autsukya mātrasya api nivṛttiḥ upasthiteṣu api divya adivya viṣayeṣu upekṣā buddhiḥ saṃjñā trayāt parā vaśīkāra saṃjñā
