original: etayaiva ca pūrvāsāṃ caritārthatvān na tāḥ pṛthag uktā iti sarvam avadātam||1.15||
analyzed: etayā eva ca pūrvāsām caritārtha tvāt na tāḥ pṛthak uktāḥ iti sarvam avadātam

original: tat paraṃ puruṣakhyāter guṇavaitṛṣṇyam||1.16||
analyzed: tat param puruṣa khyāteḥ guṇa vaitṛṣṇyam

original: aparaṃ vairāgyam uktvā param āha --- tat paraṃ puruṣakhyāter guṇavaitṛṣṇyam| aparavairāgyasya paraṃ vairāgyaṃ prati kāraṇatvam| tatra ca dvāram ādarśayati --- dṛṣṭānuśravikaviṣayadoṣadarśī virakta iti| anenāparaṃ vairāgyaṃ darśitam|
analyzed: aparam vairāgyam uktvā param āha tat param puruṣa khyāteḥ guṇa vaitṛṣṇyam apara vairāgyasya param vairāgyam prati kāraṇa tvam tatra ca dvāram ādarśayati dṛṣṭa ānuśravika viṣaya doṣa darśī viraktaḥ iti anena aparam vairāgyam darśitam

original: puruṣadarśanābhyāsād āgamānumānācāryopadeśasamadhigatasya puruṣasya darśanaṃ tasyābhyāsaḥ paunaḥpunyena niṣevaṇaṃ tasmāt tasya darśanasya śuddhī rajastamaḥparihāṇyā sattvaikatānatā tayā yo guṇapuruṣayoḥ prakarṣeṇa vivekaḥ puruṣaḥ śuddho 'nantas tadviparītā guṇā iti, tenāpyāyitā buddhir yasya yoginaḥ sa tathoktaḥ|
analyzed: puruṣa darśana abhyāsāt āgama anumāna ācārya upadeśa samadhigatasya puruṣasya darśanam tasya abhyāsaḥ paunaḥpunyena niṣevaṇam tasmāt tasya darśanasya śuddhī rajaḥ tamaḥ parihāṇyā sattva eka tāna tā tayā yaḥ guṇa puruṣayoḥ prakarṣeṇa vivekaḥ puruṣaḥ śuddhaḥ nantaḥ tad viparītāḥ guṇāḥ iti tena āpyāyitā buddhiḥ yasya yoginaḥ sa tathā uktaḥ

original: tad anena dharmameghākhyaḥ samādhir uktaḥ| sa tathābhūto yogī guṇebhyo vyaktāvyaktadharmakebhyaḥ sarvathā viraktaḥ sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātāv api guṇātmikāyāṃ yāvad virakta iti| tat tasmād dvayaṃ vairāgyam| pūrvaṃ hi vairāgyaṃ sattvasamudrekavidhūtatamasi rajaḥkaṇakalaṅkasaṃpṛkte cittasattve| tac ca tauṣṭikānām api samānam|
analyzed: tat anena dharmamegha ākhyaḥ samādhiḥ uktaḥ sa tathābhūtaḥ yogī guṇebhyaḥ vyakta avyakta dharmakebhyaḥ sarvathā viraktaḥ sattva puruṣa anya tā khyātau api guṇa ātmikāyām yāvat viraktaḥ iti tat tasmāt dvayam vairāgyam pūrvam hi vairāgyam sattva samudreka vidhūta tamasi rajaḥ kaṇa kalaṅka saṃpṛkte citta sattve tat ca tauṣṭikānām api samānam

original: te hi tenaiva prakṛtilayā babhūvuḥ| yathoktam --- vairāgyāt prakṛtilaya iti| tatra tayor dvayor madhye yad uttaraṃ tajjñānaprasādamātram| mātragrahaṇena nirviṣayatāṃ sūcayati| tad eva hi tādṛśaṃ cittasattvaṃ rajoleśamalenāpy aparāmṛṣṭam asyāśrayo'ta eva jñānaprasāda ity ucyate|
analyzed: te hi tena eva prakṛti layāḥ babhūvuḥ yathā uktam vairāgyāt prakṛti layaḥ iti tatra tayoḥ dvayoḥ madhye yat uttaram tat jñāna prasāda mātram mātra grahaṇena nirviṣaya tām sūcayati tat eva hi tādṛśam citta sattvam rajaḥ leśa malena api aparāmṛṣṭam asya āśraya utaḥ eva jñāna prasādaḥ iti ucyate

original: cittasattvaṃ hi prasādasvabhāvam api rajastamaḥsaṃparkān malinatām anubhavati| vairāgyābhyāsavimalavāridhārādhautasamastarajastamomalaṃ tv atiprasannaṃ jñānaprasādamātrapariśeṣaṃ bhavati| tasya guṇānupādeyatvāya darśayati --- yasyodaye sati yogī pratyuditakhyātiḥ| khyātiviśeṣe sati vartamānakhyātimān ity arthaḥ| prāpaṇīyaṃ kaivalyaṃ prāptam|
analyzed: citta sattvam hi prasāda svabhāvam api rajaḥ tamaḥ saṃparkāt malina tām anubhavati vairāgya abhyāsa vimala vāri dhārā dhauta samasta rajaḥ tamaḥ malam tu ati prasannam jñāna prasāda mātra pariśeṣam bhavati tasya guṇa anupādeya tvāya darśayati yasya udaye sati yogī pratyudita khyātiḥ khyāti viśeṣe sati vartamāna khyātimān iti arthaḥ prāpaṇīyam kaivalyam prāptam

original: yathā vakṣyati --- jīvann eva vidvān mukto bhavati| saṃskāramātrasya cchinnamūlasya siddhatvād iti bhāvaḥ| kutaḥ prāptaṃ, yataḥ --- kṣīṇāḥ kṣetavyāḥ kleśā avidyādayaḥ savāsanāḥ| nanv asti dharmādharmasamūho bhavasya janmamaraṇaprabandhasya saṃkramaḥ prāṇinām| tat kutaḥ kaivalyam ity ata āha --- chinna iti|
analyzed: yathā vakṣyati jīvan eva vidvān muktaḥ bhavati saṃskāra mātrasya chinna mūlasya siddha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ kutas prāptam yatas kṣīṇāḥ kṣetavyāḥ kleśāḥ avidyā ādayaḥ sa vāsanāḥ nanu asti dharma adharma samūhaḥ bhavasya janma maraṇa prabandhasya saṃkramaḥ prāṇinām tat kutas kaivalyam iti atas āha chinnaḥ iti

original: śliṣṭāni niḥsaṃdhīni parvāṇi yasya sa tathoktaḥ| dharmādharmasamūhasya samūhinaḥ parvāṇi tāni śliṣṭāni| na hi jātu jantur maraṇajanmaprabandhena tyakṣyate| so'yaṃ bhavasaṃkramaḥ kleśakṣaye chinnaḥ| yathā vakṣyati --- "kleśamūlaḥ karmāśayaḥ" "sati mūle tadvipākaḥ" iti|
analyzed: śliṣṭāni niḥsaṃdhīni parvāṇi yasya sa tathā uktaḥ dharma adharma samūhasya samūhinaḥ parvāṇi tāni śliṣṭāni na hi jātu jantuḥ maraṇa janma prabandhena tyakṣyate saḥ ayam bhava saṃkramaḥ kleśa kṣaye chinnaḥ yathā vakṣyati kleśa mūlaḥ karma āśayaḥ sati mūle tad vipākaḥ iti

original: nanu prasaṃkhyānaparipākaṃ dharmameghaṃ ca nirodham antarā kiṃ tad asti yaj jñānaprasādamātram ity ata āha --- jñānasyaiveti| dharmameghabheda eva paraṃ vairāgyaṃ nānyat| yathā vakṣyati --- "prasaṃkhyāne'py akusīdasya sarvathā vivekakhyāter dharmameghaḥ samādhiḥ" [iti,] "tadā sarvāvaraṇamalāpetasya jñānasyānantyāj jñeyam alpam" iti ca|
analyzed: nanu prasaṃkhyāna paripākam dharma megham ca nirodham antarā kim tat asti yat jñāna prasāda mātram iti atas āha jñānasya eva iti dharma megha bhedaḥ eva param vairāgyam na anyat yathā vakṣyati prasaṃkhyāne api akusīdasya sarvathā viveka khyāteḥ dharma meghaḥ samādhiḥ iti tadā sarva āvaraṇa mala apetasya jñānasya ānantyāt jñeyam alpam iti ca

original: tasmād etasya hi nāntarīyakam avinābhāvi kaivalyam iti||1.16||
analyzed: tasmāt etasya hi nāntarīyakam avinābhāvi kaivalyam iti

original: vitarkavicārānandāsmitārūpānugamāt saṃprajñātaḥ||1.17||
analyzed: vitarka vicāra ānanda asmitā rūpa anugamāt saṃprajñātaḥ

original: upāyam abhidhāya saprakāropeyakathanāya pṛcchati --- athopāyadvayeneti| vitarkavicārānandāsmitārūpānugamāt saṃprajñātaḥ| saṃprajñātapūrvakatvād asaṃprajñātasya prathamaṃ saṃprajñātopavarṇanam| saṃprajñātasāmānyaṃ vitarkavicārānandāsmitānāṃ rūpaiḥ svarūpair anugamāt pratipattavyam| vitarkaṃ vivṛṇoti --- cittasyeti|
analyzed: upāyam abhidhāya sa prakāra upeya kathanāya pṛcchati atha upāya dvayena iti vitarka vicāra ānanda asmitā rūpa anugamāt saṃprajñātaḥ saṃprajñāta pūrvaka tvāt asaṃprajñātasya prathamam saṃprajñāta upavarṇanam saṃprajñāta sāmānyam vitarka vicāra ānanda asmitānām rūpaiḥ sva rūpaiḥ anugamāt pratipattavyam vitarkam vivṛṇoti cittasya iti

original: svarūpasākṣātkāravatī prajñābhogaḥ| sa ca sthūlaviṣayatvāt sthūlaḥ| yathā hi prāthamiko dhānuṣkaḥ sthūlam eva lakṣyaṃ vidhyaty atha sūkṣmam evaṃ prāthamiko yogī sthūlam eva pāñcabhautikaṃ caturbhujādi dhyeyaṃ sākṣātkaroty atha sūkṣmam iti| evaṃ cittasyālambane sūkṣma ābhogaḥ| sthūlakāraṇabhūtasūkṣmapañcatanmātraliṅgāliṅgaviṣayo vicāraḥ|
analyzed: svarūpa sākṣātkāravatī prajñā bhogaḥ sa ca sthūla viṣaya tvāt sthūlaḥ yathā hi prāthamikaḥ dhānuṣkaḥ sthūlam eva lakṣyam vidhyati atha sūkṣmam evam prāthamikaḥ yogī sthūlam eva pāñcabhautikam caturbhuja ādi dhyeyam sākṣātkaroti atha sūkṣmam iti evam cittasya ālambane sūkṣmaḥ ābhogaḥ sthūla kāraṇa bhūta sūkṣma pañca tanmātra liṅga aliṅga viṣayaḥ vicāraḥ

original: tad evaṃ grāhyaviṣayaṃ darśayitvā grahaṇaviṣayaṃ darśayati --- ānanda iti| indriye sthūla ālambane cittasyābhogo hlāda ānandaḥ| prakāśaśīlatayāṃ khalu sattvapradhānād ahaṃkārād indriyāṇy utpannāni| sattvaṃ sukham iti tāny api sukhānīti tasminn ābhogo hlāda iti| grahītṛviṣayaṃ saṃprajñātam āha --- ekātmikā saṃvid iti| asmitāprabhavānīndriyāṇi|
analyzed: tat evam grāhya viṣayam darśayitvā grahaṇa viṣayam darśayati ānandaḥ iti indriye sthūle ālambane cittasya ābhogaḥ hlādaḥ ānandaḥ prakāśa śīla tayām khalu sattva pradhānāt ahaṃkārāt indriyāṇi utpannāni sattvam sukham iti tāni api sukhāni iti tasmin ābhogaḥ hlādaḥ iti grahītṛ viṣayam saṃprajñātam āha eka ātmikā saṃvid iti asmitā prabhavāni indriyāṇi

original: tenaiṣām asmitā sūkṣmaṃ rūpam| sā cātmanā grahītrā saha buddhir ekātmikā saṃvit| tasyāṃ ca grahītur antarbhāvād bhavati grahītṛviṣayaḥ saṃprajñāta iti| caturṇām aparam apy avāntaraviśeṣam āha --- tatra prathama iti| kāryaṃ kāraṇānupraviṣṭaṃ na kāraṇaṃ kāryeṇa tad ayaṃ sthūla ābhogaḥ sthūlasūkṣmendriyāsmitākāraṇacatuṣṭayānugato bhavati|
analyzed: tena eṣām asmitā sūkṣmam rūpam sā ca ātmanā grahītrā saha buddhiḥ eka ātmikā saṃvid tasyām ca grahītuḥ antarbhāvāt bhavati grahītṛ viṣayaḥ saṃprajñātaḥ iti caturṇām aparam api avāntara viśeṣam āha tatra prathamaḥ iti kāryam kāraṇa anupraviṣṭam na kāraṇam kāryeṇa tat ayam sthūlaḥ ābhogaḥ sthūla sūkṣma indriya asmitā kāraṇa catuṣṭaya anugataḥ bhavati

original: uttare tu tridvyekakāraṇakās tridvyekarūpā bhavanti| asaṃprajñātād bhinatti --- sarva eta iti||1.17||
analyzed: uttare tu tri dvi eka kāraṇakāḥ tri dvi eka rūpāḥ bhavanti asaṃprajñātāt bhinatti sarve ete iti

original: virāmapratyayābhyāsapūrvaḥ saṃskāraśeṣo'nyaḥ||1.18||
analyzed: virāma pratyaya abhyāsa pūrvaḥ saṃskāra śeṣaḥ nyaḥ

original: kramaprāptam asaṃprajñātam avatārayituṃ pṛcchati --- atheti| virāmapratyayābhyāsapūrvaḥ saṃskāraśeṣo'nyaḥ| pūrvapadenopāyakathanam uttarābhyāṃ ca svarūpakathanam| madhyamaṃ padaṃ vivṛṇoti --- sarvavṛttīti| prathamaṃ padaṃ vyācaṣṭe --- tasya param iti|
analyzed: krama prāptam asaṃprajñātam avatārayitum pṛcchati atha iti virāma pratyaya abhyāsa pūrvaḥ saṃskāra śeṣaḥ nyaḥ pūrva padena upāya kathanam uttarābhyām ca svarūpa kathanam madhyamam padam vivṛṇoti sarva vṛtti iti prathamam padam vyācaṣṭe tasya param iti

original: virāmo vṛttīnām abhāvas tasya pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ tasyābhyāsas tadanuṣṭhānaṃ paunaḥpunyaṃ tad eva pūrvaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| athāparaṃ vairāgyaṃ nirodhakāraṇaṃ kasmān na bhavatīty ata āha --- sālambano hīti| kāryasarūpaṃ kāraṇaṃ yujyate na virūpam| virūpaṃ cāparaṃ vairāgyaṃ sālambanaṃ nirālambanasamādhinā kāryeṇa|
analyzed: virāmaḥ vṛttīnām abhāvaḥ tasya pratyayaḥ kāraṇam tasya abhyāsaḥ tad anuṣṭhānam paunaḥpunyam tat eva pūrvam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ atha aparam vairāgyam nirodha kāraṇam kasmāt na bhavati iti atas āha sa ālambanaḥ hi iti kārya sarūpam kāraṇam yujyate na virūpam virūpam ca aparam vairāgyam sa ālambanam nirālambana samādhinā kāryeṇa

original: tasmān nirālambanād eva jñānaprasādamātrāt tasyotpattir yuktā| dharmameghasamādhir eva hi nitāntavigalitarajastamomalād buddhisattvād upajātas tattadviṣayātikrameṇa pravartamāno'nanto viṣayāvadyadarśī samastaviṣayaparityāgāc ca svarūpapratiṣṭhaḥ san nirālambanaḥ saṃskāramātraśeṣasya nirālambanasya samādheḥ kāraṇam upapadyate sārūpyād iti|
analyzed: tasmāt nirālambanāt eva jñāna prasāda mātrāt tasya utpattiḥ yuktā dharmamegha samādhiḥ eva hi nitānta vigalita rajaḥ tamaḥ malāt buddhi sattvāt upajātaḥ tad tad viṣaya atikrameṇa pravartamānaḥ anantaḥ viṣaya avadya darśī samasta viṣaya parityāgāt ca svarūpa pratiṣṭhaḥ san nirālambanaḥ saṃskāra mātra śeṣasya nirālambanasya samādheḥ kāraṇam upapadyate sārūpyāt iti

original: ālambanīkaraṇam āśrayaṇam abhāvaprāptam iva vṛttirūpakāryākaraṇān nirbījo nirālambanaḥ| athavā bījaṃ kleśakarmāśayās te niṣkrāntā yasmāt sa tathā||1.18||
analyzed: ālambanīkaraṇam āśrayaṇam abhāva prāptam iva vṛtti rūpa kārya akaraṇāt nirbījaḥ nirālambanaḥ athavā bījam kleśa karma āśayāḥ te niṣkrāntāḥ yasmāt sa tathā

original: bhavapratyayo videhaprakṛtilayānām||1.19||
analyzed: bhava pratyayaḥ videha prakṛti layānām

original: nirodhasamādher avāntarabhedaṃ hānopādānāṅgam ādarśayati --- sa khalv ayaṃ nirodhasamādhir dvividhaḥ --- upāyapratyayo bhavapratyayaś ca| upāyo vakṣyamāṇaḥ śraddhādiḥ pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasya nirodhasamādheḥ sa tathoktaḥ|
analyzed: nirodha samādheḥ avāntarabhedam hāna upādāna aṅgam ādarśayati sa khalu ayam nirodha samādhiḥ dvividhaḥ upāya pratyayaḥ bhava pratyayaḥ ca upāyaḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ śraddhā ādiḥ pratyayaḥ kāraṇam yasya nirodha samādheḥ sa tathā uktaḥ

original: bhavanti jāyante 'syāṃ jantava iti bhavo'vidyā, bhūtendriyeṣu vā vikāreṣu prakṛtiṣu vāvyaktamahadahaṃkārapañcatanmātreṣv anātmasv ātmakhyātis tauṣṭikānāṃ vairāgyasaṃpannānāṃ, sa khalv ayaṃ bhavaḥ pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasya nirodhasamādheḥ sa bhavapratyayaḥ| tatra tayor madhya upāyapratyayo yogināṃ mokṣyamāṇānāṃ bhavati|
analyzed: bhavanti jāyante syām jantavaḥ iti bhavaḥ vidyā bhūta indriyeṣu vā vikāreṣu prakṛtiṣu vā avyakta mahat ahaṃkāra pañca tanmātreṣu anātmasu ātma khyātiḥ tauṣṭikānām vairāgya saṃpannānām sa khalu ayam bhavaḥ pratyayaḥ kāraṇam yasya nirodha samādheḥ sa bhava pratyayaḥ tatra tayoḥ madhye upāya pratyayaḥ yoginām mokṣyamāṇānām bhavati

original: viśeṣavidhānena śeṣasya mumukṣusaṃbandhaṃ niṣedhati| keṣāṃ tarhi bhavapratyaya ity atra sūtreṇottaram āha --- bhavapratyayo videhaprakṛtilayānām| videhāś ca prakṛtilayāś ca teṣām ity arthaḥ| tad vyācaṣṭe --- videhānāṃ devānāṃ bhavapratyayaḥ|
analyzed: viśeṣa vidhānena śeṣasya mumukṣu saṃbandham niṣedhati keṣām tarhi bhava pratyayaḥ iti atra sūtreṇa uttaram āha bhava pratyayaḥ videha prakṛti layānām videhāḥ ca prakṛti layāḥ ca teṣām iti arthaḥ tat vyācaṣṭe videhānām devānām bhava pratyayaḥ

original: bhūtendriyāṇām anyatamadātmatvena (anyatamam ātmatvena) pratipannās tadupāsanayā tadvāsanāvāsitāntaḥkaraṇāḥ piṇḍapātānantaram indriyeṣu bhūteṣu vā līnāḥ saṃskāramātrāvaśeṣamanasaḥ ṣāṭkauśikaśarīrarahitā videhāḥ| te hi svasaṃskāramātropayogena cittena kaivalyapadam ivānubhavantaḥ prāpnuvanto videhāḥ|
analyzed: bhūta indriyāṇām anyatamat ātma tvena anyatamam ātma tvena pratipannāḥ tad upāsanayā tad vāsanā vāsita antaḥkaraṇāḥ piṇḍapāta anantaram indriyeṣu bhūteṣu vā līnāḥ saṃskāra mātra avaśeṣa manasaḥ ṣāṭkauśika śarīra rahitāḥ videhāḥ te hi sva saṃskāra mātra upayogena cittena kaivalya padam iva anubhavantaḥ prāpnuvantaḥ videhāḥ

original: avṛttikatvaṃ ca kaivalyena sārūpyaṃ, sādhikārasaṃskāraśeṣatā ca vairūpyam| saṃskāramātropabhogeneti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| tasyārthaḥ --- saṃskāramātram evopabhogo yasya na tu cittavṛttir ity arthaḥ| prāptāvadhayaḥ svasaṃskāravipākaṃ tathājātīyakam ativāhayanty atikrāmanti punar api saṃsāre viśanti| tathā ca vāyuproktam ---
analyzed: avṛttika tvam ca kaivalyena sārūpyam sa adhikāra saṃskāra śeṣa tā ca vairūpyam saṃskāra mātra upabhogena iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ tasya arthaḥ saṃskāra mātram eva upabhogaḥ yasya na tu citta vṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ prāpta avadhayaḥ sva saṃskāra vipākam tathājātīyakam ativāhayanti atikrāmanti punar api saṃsāre viśanti tathā ca vāyuproktam

original: "daśa manvantarāṇīha tiṣṭhantīndriyacintakāḥ| bhautikās tu śataṃ pūrṇam" iti|
analyzed: daśa manvantarāṇi iha tiṣṭhanti indriya cintakāḥ bhautikāḥ tu śatam pūrṇam iti

original: tathā prakṛtilayāś cāvyaktamahadahaṃkārapañcatanmātreṣv anyatamadātmatvena (anyatamam ātmatvena) pratipannās tadupāsanayā tadvāsanāvāsitāntaḥkaraṇāḥ piṇḍapātānantaram avyaktādīnām anyatamasmiṃl līnāḥ (anyatame līnāḥ) sādhikāre'caritārthe|
analyzed: tathā prakṛti layāḥ ca avyakta mahat ahaṃkāra pañca tanmātreṣu anyatama dātmatvena anyatamam ātmatvena pratipannāḥ tad upāsanayā tad vāsanā vāsita antaḥkaraṇāḥ piṇḍapāta anantaram avyakta ādīnām anyatamasmin līnāḥ anyatame līnāḥ sa adhikāre caritārthe

original: evaṃ hi caritārthaṃ cetaḥ syād yadi vivekakhyātim api janayed ajanitasattvapuruṣānyatākhyātes tu cetaso'caritārthasyāsti sādhikārateti| sādhikāre cetasi prakṛtilīne kaivalyapadam ivānubhavanti, yāvan na punar āvartate 'dhikāravaśāc cittam iti| prakṛtisāmyam upagatam apy avadhiṃ prāpya punar api prādurbhavati tato vivicyate|
analyzed: evam hi caritārtham cetaḥ syāt yadi viveka khyātim api janayet a janita sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāteḥ tu cetasā ucaritārthasya asti sādhikāra tā iti sādhikāre cetasi prakṛti līne kaivalya padam iva anubhavanti yāvat na punar āvartate dhikāra vaśāt cittam iti prakṛti sāmyam upagatam api avadhim prāpya punar api prādurbhavati tatas vivicyate

original: yathā varṣātipāte mṛdbhāvam upagato maṇḍūkadehaḥ punar ambhodavāridhārāvasekān maṇḍūkadehabhāvam anubhavatīti| tathā ca vāyuproktam ---
analyzed: yathā varṣā atipāte mṛd bhāvam upagataḥ maṇḍūka dehaḥ punar ambhoda vāri dhārā avasekāt maṇḍūka deha bhāvam anubhavati iti tathā ca vāyuproktam

original: "sahasraṃ tv ābhimānikāḥ| bauddhā daśa sahasrāṇi tiṣṭhanti vigatajvarāḥ|| pūrṇaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu tiṣṭhanty avyaktacintakāḥ| puruṣaṃ nirguṇaṃ prāpya kālasaṃkhyā na vidyate" iti||
analyzed: sahasram tu ābhimānikāḥ bauddhāḥ daśa sahasrāṇi tiṣṭhanti vigata jvarāḥ pūrṇam śata sahasram tu tiṣṭhanti avyakta cintakāḥ puruṣam nirguṇam prāpya kāla saṃkhyā na vidyate iti

original: tas asya punarbhavaprāptihetutayā heyatvaṃ siddham||1.19||
analyzed: asya punarbhava prāpti hetutayā heya tvam siddham

original: śraddhāvīryasmṛtisamādhiprajñāpūrvaka itareṣām||1.20||
analyzed: śraddhā vīrya smṛti samādhi prajñā pūrvakaḥ itareṣām

original: yogināṃ tu samādher upāyakramam āha --- śraddhāvīryasmṛtisamādhiprajñāpūrvaka itareṣām| nanv indriyādicintakā api śraddhāvanta evety ata āha --- śraddhā cetasaḥ saṃprasādaḥ|
analyzed: yoginām tu samādheḥ upāya kramam āha śraddhā vīrya smṛti samādhi prajñā pūrvakaḥ itareṣām nanu indriya ādi cintakāḥ api śraddhāvantaḥ eva iti atas āha śraddhā cetasaḥ saṃprasādaḥ

original: sa cāgamānumānācāryopadeśasamadhigatatattvaviṣayo bhavati hi cetasaḥ saṃprasādo 'bhirucir atīcchā śraddhā nendriyādiṣv ātmābhimāninām abhirucir asaṃprasādo hi sa vyāmohamūlatvād ity arthaḥ| kuto'sāv eva śraddhety ata āha --- sā hi jananīva kalyāṇī yoginaṃ pāti vimārgapātajanmano 'narthāt|
analyzed: sa ca āgama anumāna ācārya upadeśa samadhigata tattva viṣayaḥ bhavati hi cetasaḥ saṃprasādaḥ bhiruciḥ ati icchā śraddhā na indriya ādiṣu ātma abhimāninām abhiruciḥ asaṃprasādaḥ hi sa vyāmoha mūla tvāt iti arthaḥ kutas asau eva śraddhā iti atas āha sā hi jananī iva kalyāṇī yoginam pāti vimārga pāta janmanaḥ narthāt

original: so'yam icchāviśeṣa iṣyamāṇaviṣayaṃ prayatnaṃ prasūta ity āha --- tasya hi śraddadhānasya| tasya vivaraṇaṃ --- vivekārthino vīryam upajāyate| smṛtir dhyānam anākulam avikṣiptaṃ, samādhīyate yogāṅgasamādhiyuktaṃ bhavati| yamaniyamādināntarīyakasamādhyupanyāsena ca yamaniyamādayo'pi sūcitāḥ|
analyzed: saḥ ayam icchā viśeṣaḥ iṣyamāṇa viṣayam prayatnam prasūtaḥ iti āha tasya hi śraddadhānasya tasya vivaraṇam viveka arthinaḥ vīryam upajāyate smṛtiḥ dhyānam an ākulam avikṣiptam samādhīyate yoga aṅga samādhi yuktam bhavati yama niyama ādi nāntarīyaka samādhi upanyāsena ca yama niyama ādayaḥ api sūcitāḥ

original: tad evam akhilayogāṅgasaṃpannasya saṃprajñāto jāyata ity āha --- samāhitacittasyeti| prajñāyā vivekaḥ prakarṣa upajāyate| saṃprajñātapūrvam asaṃprajñātotpādam āha --- tadabhyāsāt tatraiva tattadbhūmiprāptau tattadviṣayāc ca vairāgyād asaṃprajñātaḥ samādhir bhavati|
analyzed: tat evam akhila yoga aṅga saṃpannasya saṃprajñātaḥ jāyate iti āha samāhita cittasya iti prajñāyāḥ vivekaḥ prakarṣaḥ upajāyate saṃprajñāta pūrvam asaṃprajñāta utpādam āha tad abhyāsāt tatra eva tad tad bhūmi prāptau tad tad viṣayāt ca vairāgyāt asaṃprajñātaḥ samādhiḥ bhavati

original: sa hi kaivalyahetuḥ sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātipūrvo hi nirodhaś cittam akhilakāryakaraṇena caritārtham adhikārād avasādayati||1.20||
analyzed: sa hi kaivalya hetuḥ sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti pūrvaḥ hi nirodhaḥ cittam akhila kārya karaṇena caritārtham adhikārāt avasādayati

original: tīvrasaṃvegānām āsannaḥ||1.21||
analyzed: tīvra saṃvegānām āsannaḥ

original: nanu śraddhādayaś ced yogopāyās tarhi sarveṣām aviśeṣeṇa samādhitatphale syātām| dṛśyate tu kasyacit siddhiḥ kasyacid asiddhiḥ kasyacic cireṇa siddhiḥ kasyacic ciratareṇa kasyacit kṣipram ity ata āha --- te khalu nava yogina iti| upāyāḥ śraddhādayo mṛdumadhyādhimātrāḥ prāgbhavīyasaṃskārādṛṣṭavaśād yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ|
analyzed: nanu śraddhā ādayaḥ ced yoga upāyāḥ tarhi sarveṣām aviśeṣeṇa samādhi tad phale syātām dṛśyate tu kasyacid siddhiḥ kasyacid asiddhiḥ kasyacid cireṇa siddhiḥ kasyacid ciratareṇa kasyacid kṣipram iti atas āha te khalu nava yoginaḥ iti upāyāḥ śraddhā ādayaḥ mṛdu madhya adhimātrāḥ prāc bhavīya saṃskāra adṛṣṭa vaśāt yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ

original: saṃvego vairāgyaṃ tasyāpi mṛdumadhyatīvratā prāgbhavīyavāsanādṛṣṭavaśād eveti teṣu yādṛśāṃ kṣepīyasī siddhis tān darśayati sūtreṇa --- tīvrasaṃvegānām āsanna iti sūtram| śeṣaṃ bhāṣyam| samādheḥ saṃprajñātasya phalam asaṃprajñātas tasyāpi kaivalyam||1.21||
analyzed: saṃvegaḥ vairāgyam tasya api mṛdu madhya tīvra tā prāgbhavīya vāsanā dṛṣṭa vaśāt eva iti teṣu yādṛśām kṣepīyasī siddhiḥ tān darśayati sūtreṇa tīvra saṃvegānām āsanne iti sūtram śeṣam bhāṣyam samādheḥ saṃprajñātasya phalam asaṃprajñātaḥ tasya api kaivalyam

original: mṛdumadhyādhimātratvāt tato'pi viśeṣaḥ||1.22||
analyzed: mṛdu madhya adhimātra tvāt viśeṣaḥ

original: mṛdumadhyādhimātratvāt tato'pi viśeṣaḥ| nigadavyākhyātena bhāṣyeṇa vyākhyātam iti||1.22||
analyzed: mṛdu madhya adhimātra tvāt viśeṣaḥ nigada vyākhyātena bhāṣyeṇa vyākhyātam iti

original: īśvarapraṇidhānād vā||1.23||
analyzed: īśvara praṇidhānāt vā

original: sūtrāntaraṃ pātayituṃ vimṛśati --- kim etasmād eveti| na vāśabdaḥ saṃśayanivartakaḥ| īśvarapraṇidhānād vā| vyācaṣṭe --- praṇidhānād bhaktiviśeṣān mānasād vācikāt kāyikād vāvarjito'bhimukhīkṛtas tam anugṛhṇāti| abhidhyānam anāgatārthecchā --- idam asyābhimatam astv iti| tanmātreṇa na vyāpārāntareṇa| śeṣaṃ sugamam||1.23||
analyzed: sūtra antaram pātayitum vimṛśati kim etasmāt eva iti na vā śabdaḥ saṃśaya nivartakaḥ īśvara praṇidhānāt vā vyācaṣṭe praṇidhānāt bhakti viśeṣāt mānasāt vācikāt kāyikāt vā āvarjita abhimukhīkṛtaḥ tam anugṛhṇāti abhidhyānam anāgata artha icchā idam asya abhimatam astu iti tad mātreṇa na vyāpāra antareṇa śeṣam sugamam

original: kleśakarmavipākāśayair aparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ||1.24||
analyzed: kleśa karma vipāka āśayaiḥ aparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ

original: nanu cetnācetanābhyām eva vyūḍhaṃ nānyena viśvam| īśvaraś ced acetanas tarhi pradhānaṃ pradhānavikārāṇām api pradhānam adhyapātāt tathā ca na tasyāvarjanam acetanatvād atha cetanas tathāpi citiśakter audāsīnyād asaṃsāritayā cāsmitādivirahāt kuta āvarjanam| kutaś cābhidhyānam ity āśayavān āha --- atha pradhāneti|
analyzed: nanu cetnā acetanābhyām eva vyūḍham na anyena viśvam īśvaraḥ ced acetanaḥ tarhi pradhānam pradhāna vikārāṇām api pradhānam adhyapātāt tathā ca na tasya āvarjanam acetana tvāt atha cetanaḥ tathā api citi śakteḥ audāsīnyāt asaṃsāri tayā ca asmitā ādi virahāt kutas āvarjanam kutas ca abhidhyānam iti āśayavān āha atha pradhāna iti

original: atra sūtreṇottaram āha --- kleśakarmavipākāśayair aparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ| avidyādayaḥ kleśāḥ kliśnanti khalv amī puruṣaṃ sāṃsārikaṃ vividhaduḥkhaprahāreṇeti| kuśalākuśalānīti dharmādharmās teṣāṃ ca karmajatvād upacārāt karmatvam| vipāko jātyāyurbhogāḥ| vipākānuguṇā vāsanās tāś cittabhūmāv āśerata ity āśayāḥ|
analyzed: atra sūtreṇa uttaram āha kleśa karma vipāka āśayaiḥ aparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ avidyā ādayaḥ kleśāḥ kliśnanti khalu amī puruṣam sāṃsārikam vividha duḥkha prahāreṇa iti kuśala akuśalāni iti dharma adharmāḥ teṣām ca karma ja tvāt upacārāt karma tvam vipākaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhogāḥ vipāka anuguṇāḥ vāsanāḥ tāḥ cittabhūmau āśerate iti āśayāḥ

original: na hi karabhajātinirvartakaṃ karma prāgbhavīyakarabhabhogabhāvitāṃ bhāvanāṃ na yāvad abhivyanakti tāvat karabhocitāya bhogāya kalpate| tasmād bhavati karabhajātyanubhavajanmā bhāvanā karabhavipākānuguṇeti|
analyzed: na hi karabha jāti nirvartakam karma prāgbhavīya karabha bhoga bhāvitām bhāvanām na yāvat abhivyanakti tāvat karabha ucitāya bhogāya kalpate tasmāt bhavati karabha jāti anubhava janmā bhāvanā karabha vipāka anuguṇā iti

original: nanv amī kleśādayo buddhidharmā na kathaṃcid api puruṣaṃ parāmṛśanti, tasmāt puruṣagrahaṇād eva tadaparāmarśasiddheḥ kṛtaṃ kleśakarmetyādinety ata āha --- te ca manasi vartamānāḥ sāṃsārike puruṣe vyapadiśyante| kasmāt, sa hi tatphalasya bhoktā cetayiteti|
analyzed: nanu amī kleśa ādayaḥ buddhi dharmāḥ na kathaṃcid api puruṣam parāmṛśanti tasmāt puruṣa grahaṇāt eva tad a parāmarśa siddheḥ kṛtam kleśa karma ityādinā iti atas āha te ca manasi vartamānāḥ sāṃsārike puruṣe vyapadiśyante kasmāt sa hi tad phalasya bhoktā cetayitā iti

original: tasmāt puruṣatvād īśvarasyāpi tatsaṃbandhaḥ prāpta iti tatpratiṣedha upapadyata ity āha --- yo hy anena buddhisthenāpi puruṣamātrasādhāraṇena bhogenāparāmṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ| viśiṣyata iti viśeṣaḥ puruṣāntarād vyavacchidyate| viśeṣapadasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayitukāmaḥ paricodanāpūrvaṃ pariharati --- kaivalyaṃ prāptās tarhīti|
analyzed: tasmāt puruṣa tvāt īśvarasya api tad saṃbandhaḥ prāptaḥ iti tad pratiṣedhaḥ upapadyate iti āha yaḥ hi anena buddhi sthena api puruṣa mātra sādhāraṇena bhogena aparāmṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ viśiṣyate iti viśeṣaḥ puruṣa antarāt vyavacchidyate viśeṣa padasya vyāvartyam darśayitu kāmaḥ paricodanā pūrvam pariharati kaivalyam prāptāḥ tarhi iti

original: prakṛtilayānāṃ prākṛto bandhaḥ| vaikāriko bandho videhānām| dakṣiṇādibandho divyādivyaviṣayabhogabhājām| tāny amūni trīṇi bandhanāni| prakṛtibhāvanāsaṃskṛtamanaso hi dehapātānantaram eva prakṛtilayatām āpannā itītareṣāṃ pūrvā bandhakoṭiḥ prajñāyate, tenottarakoṭividhānamātram iha tu pūrvāparakoṭiniṣedha iti|
analyzed: prakṛti layānām prākṛtaḥ bandhaḥ vaikārikaḥ bandhaḥ videhānām dakṣiṇa ādi bandhaḥ divya adivya viṣaya bhogabhājām tāni amūni trīṇi bandhanāni prakṛti bhāvanā saṃskṛta manasaḥ hi dehapāta anantaram eva prakṛti laya tām āpannāḥ iti itareṣām pūrvā bandha koṭiḥ prajñāyate tena uttara koṭi vidhāna mātram iha tu pūrva apara koṭi niṣedhaḥ iti

original: saṃkṣipya viśeṣaṃ darśayati --- sa tu sadaiva muktaḥ sadaiveśvara iti| jñānakriyāśaktisaṃpad aiśvaryam| atra pṛcchati --- yo'sāv iti| jñānakriye hi na cicchakter apariṇāminyāḥ saṃbhavata iti rajastamorahitaviśuddhacittasattvāśraye vaktavye|
analyzed: saṃkṣipya viśeṣam darśayati sa tu sadā eva muktaḥ sadā eva īśvaraḥ iti jñāna kriyā śakti saṃpad aiśvaryam atra pṛcchati yaḥ asau iti jñāna kriye hi na cicchakteḥ apariṇāminyāḥ saṃbhavataḥ iti rajaḥ tamaḥ rahita viśuddha citta sattva āśraye vaktavye

original: na ceśvarasya sadā muktasyāvidyāprabhavacittasattvasamutkarṣeṇa saha svasvāmibhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavatīty ata uktaṃ --- prakṛṣṭasattvopādānād iti| neśvarasya pṛthagjanasyevāvidyānibandhanaś cittasattvena svasvāmibhāvaḥ| kiṃ tu tāpatrayaparītān pretyabhāvamahārṇavāj jantūn uddhariṣyāmi jñānadharmopadeśena|
analyzed: na ca īśvarasya sadā muktasya avidyā prabhava citta sattva samutkarṣeṇa saha sva svāmi bhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavati iti atas uktam prakṛṣṭa sattva upādānāt iti na īśvarasya pṛthagjanasya iva avidyā nibandhanaḥ citta sattvena sva svāmi bhāvaḥ kim tu tāpa traya parītān pretyabhāva mahā arṇavāt jantūn uddhariṣyāmi jñāna dharma upadeśena

original: na ca jñānakriyāsāmarthyātiśayasaṃpattim antareṇa tadupadeśaḥ| na ceyam apahatarajastamomalaviśuddhasattvopādānaṃ vinety ālocya sattvaprakarṣam upādatte bhagavān aparāmṛṣṭo 'py avidyayā| avidyābhimānī cāvidyāyās tattvam avidvān bhavati na punar avidyām avidyātvena sevamānaḥ| na khalu śailūṣo rāmatvam āropya tās tāś ceṣṭā darśayan bhrānto bhavati|

analyzed: abhinnam pradhāna vikāraḥ jagat iti hi pratipādayiṣyate sadṛśa pariṇāmasya ca visadṛśa pariṇāma tā dṛṣṭā yathā kṣīra ikṣu rasa ādeḥ dadhi guḍa ādi rūpam visadṛśa pariṇāmasya pūrvam sadṛśa pariṇāma tā ca dṛṣṭā tat iha pradhānena api mahat ahaṃkāra ādi rūpa visadṛśa pariṇāmena satā bhāvyam kadācid sadṛśa pariṇāmena api sadṛśa pariṇāmaḥ ca asya sāmya avasthā

original: sa ca mahāpralayaḥ| tasmān mantrāyurvedapraṇayanāt tāvad bhagavato vigalitarajastamomalāvaraṇatayā paritaḥ pradyotamānaṃ buddhisattvam āstheyam| tathā cābhyudayaniḥśreyasopadeśaparo'pi vedarāśir īśvarapraṇītas tadbuddhisattvaprakarṣād eva bhavitum arhati| na ca sattvotkarṣe rajastamaḥprabhavau vibhramavipralambhau saṃbhavataḥ|

original: tat siddhaṃ prakṛṣṭasattvanimittaṃ śāstram iti| syād etat| prakarṣakāryatayā prakarṣaṃ bodhayac chāstraṃ śeṣavad anumānaṃ bhaven na tv āgama ity ata āha --- etayor iti| na kāryatvena bodhayaty api tv anādivācyavācakabhāvasaṃbandhena bodhayatīty arthaḥ| īśvarasya hi buddhisattve prakarṣo vartate, śāstram api tadvācakatvena tatra vartata iti|
analyzed: tat siddham prakṛṣṭa sattva nimittam śāstram iti syāt etat prakarṣa kārya tayā prakarṣam bodhayat śāstram śeṣavat anumānam bhavet na tu āgamaḥ iti atas āha etayoḥ iti na kāryatvena bodhayati api tu anādi vācya vācaka bhāva saṃbandhena bodhayati iti arthaḥ īśvarasya hi buddhi sattve prakarṣaḥ vartate śāstram api tad vācaka tvena tatra vartate iti

original: tena śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇalakṣaṇād āgamata āgacchanti buddhim ārohanti asmād abhyudayaniḥśreyasopāyā ity āgamaḥ, tasmāt saṃjñādiviśeṣapratipattiḥ| saṃjñāviśeṣaḥ śiveśvarādiḥ śrutyādiṣu prasiddhaḥ| ādipadena ṣaḍaṅgatādaśāvyayate saṃgṛhīte| yathoktaṃ vāyupurāṇe ---

original: syād etat, nityatṛptasya bhagavato vairāgyātiśayasaṃpannasya svārthe tṛṣṇāsaṃbhavāt kāruṇikasya ca sukhaikatānajanasarjanaparasya duḥkhabahulajīvalokajananānupapatter aprayojanasya ca prekṣāvataḥ pravṛttyanupapatteḥ kriyāśaktiśālino'pi na jagatkriyety ata āha --- tasyātmānugrahābhāve'pīti|
analyzed: syāt etat nitya tṛptasya bhagavataḥ vairāgya atiśaya saṃpannasya svārthe tṛṣṇā asaṃbhavāt kāruṇikasya ca sukha ekatāna jana sarjana parasya duḥkha bahula jīvaloka janana anupapatteḥ aprayojanasya ca prekṣāvataḥ pravṛtti anupapatteḥ kriyāśakti śālinaḥ api na jagatkriyā iti atas āha tasya ātma anugraha abhāve pi iti

original: bhūtānāṃ prāṇinām anugrahaḥ prayojanaṃ, śabdādyupabhogavivekakhyātirūpakāryakaraṇāt kila caritārthaṃ cittaṃ nivartate| tataḥ puruṣaḥ kevalī bhavati| atas tatprayojanāya kāruṇiko vivekakhyātyupāyaṃ kathayati| tenācaritārthatvāc cittasya jantūnīśvaraḥ puṇyāpuṇyasahāyaḥ sukhaduḥkhe bhāvayann api nākāruṇikaḥ|
analyzed: bhūtānām prāṇinām anugrahaḥ prayojanam śabda ādi upabhoga viveka khyāti rūpa kārya karaṇāt kila caritārtham cittam nivartate tatas puruṣaḥ kevalī bhavati atas tad prayojanāya kāruṇikaḥ viveka khyāti upāyam kathayati tena ācaritārtha tvāt cittasya jantūn īśvaraḥ puṇya apuṇya sahāyaḥ sukha duḥkhe bhāvayan api na akāruṇikaḥ

original: vivekakhyātyupāyakathanāya bhūtānugrahaṃ dvāram āha --- jñānadharmopadeśeneti| jñānaṃ ca dharmaś ca jñānadharmau tayor upadeśena jñānadharmasamuccayāl labdhavivekakhyātiparipākāt kalpapralaye brahmaṇo dināvasāne yatra satyalokavarjaṃ jagad astameti|
analyzed: viveka khyāti upāya kathanāya bhūta anugraham dvāram āha jñāna dharma upadeśena iti jñānam ca dharmaḥ ca jñāna dharmau tayoḥ upadeśena jñāna dharma samuccayāt labdha viveka khyāti paripākāt kalpa pralaye brahmaṇaḥ dina avasāne yatra satya loka varjam jagat astam eti

original: mahāpralaye sasatyalokasya brahmaṇo'pi nidhane saṃsāriṇaḥ svakāraṇagāmino 'tas tadā maraṇaduḥkhabhājaḥ, kalpety upalakṣaṇam anyadāpi svārjitakarmapākavaśena janmamaraṇādibhājaḥ puruṣānuddhariṣyāmīti kaivalyaṃ prāpya puruṣā uddhṛtā bhavantīty arthaḥ|
analyzed: mahāpralaye sasatyalokasya brahmaṇaḥ api nidhane saṃsāriṇaḥ tadā maraṇa duḥkha bhājaḥ tadā maraṇa duḥkha bhājaḥ upalakṣaṇam anyadā api sva arjita karma pāka vaśena janma maraṇa ādi bhājaḥ puruṣān uddhariṣyāmi iti kaivalyam prāpya puruṣāḥ uddhṛtāḥ bhavanti iti arthaḥ

original: etac ca karuṇāprayuktasya jñānadharmopadeśanaṃ kāpilānām api siddham ity āha --- tathā coktaṃ pañcaśikhācāryeṇa --- ādividvān kapila iti| ādividvān iti pañcaśikhācāryavacanam ādimuktasvasaṃtānādiguruviṣayaṃ na tv anādimuktaparamaguruviṣayam| ādimukteṣu kadācin mukteṣu vidvatsu kapilo'smākam ādividvān muktaḥ sa eva ca gurur iti|
analyzed: etat ca karuṇā prayuktasya jñāna dharma upadeśanam kāpilānām api siddham iti āha tathā ca uktam pañcaśikha ācāryeṇa ādi vidvān kapilaḥ iti ādi vidvān iti pañcaśikha ācārya vacanam ādi mukta sva saṃtāna ādi guru viṣayam na tu anādi mukta parama guru viṣayam ādi mukteṣu kadācid mukteṣu vidvatsu kapilaḥ usmākam ādi vidvān muktaḥ saḥ eva ca guruḥ iti

original: kapilasyāpi jāyamānasya maheśvarānugrahād eva jñānaprāptiḥ śrūyata iti| kapilo nāma viṣṇor avatāraviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ| svayaṃbhūs tu hiraṇyagarbhaḥ| tasyāpi sāṃkhyayogaprāptir vede śrūyata iti| sa eveśvara ādividvān kapilo viṣṇur na svayaṃbhūr iti bhāvaḥ| svāyaṃbhuvānāṃ tv īśvara iti bhāvaḥ||1.25||
analyzed: kapilasya api jāyamānasya maheśvara anugrahāt eva jñāna prāptiḥ śrūyate iti kapilaḥ nāma viṣṇoḥ avatāra viśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ tu hiraṇyagarbhaḥ tasya api sāṃkhya yoga prāptiḥ vede śrūyate iti saḥ eva īśvaraḥ ādi vidvān kapilaḥ viṣṇuḥ na svayaṃbhūḥ iti bhāvaḥ svāyaṃbhuvānām tu īśvaraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: pūrveṣām api guruḥ kālenānavacchedāt||1.26||
analyzed: pūrveṣām api guruḥ kālena anavacchedāt

original: saṃprati bhagavato brahmādibhyo viśeṣam āha --- sa eṣa iti| pātanikā --- sa eṣa iti| sūtram --- pūrveṣām api guruḥ kālenānavacchedāt| vyācaṣṭe --- pūrve hīti| kālas tu śatavarṣādir avacchedārthenāvacchedena prayojanena nopāvartate na vartate| prakarṣasya gatiḥ prāptiḥ| pratyetavya āgamāt||1.26||
analyzed: saṃprati bhagavataḥ brahma ādibhyaḥ viśeṣam āha saḥ eṣaḥ iti pātanikā saḥ eṣaḥ iti sūtram pūrveṣām api guruḥ kālena anavacchedāt vyācaṣṭe pūrve hi iti kālaḥ tu śata varṣa ādiḥ avaccheda arthena avacchedena prayojanena na upāvartate na vartate prakarṣasya gatiḥ prāptiḥ pratyetavyaḥ āgamāt

original: tasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ||1.27||
analyzed: tasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ

original: tad anena prabandhena bhagavān īśvaro darśitaḥ| saṃprati tatpraṇidhānaṃ darśayituṃ tasya vācakam āha --- tasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- vācya iti| tatra pareṣāṃ mataṃ vimarśadvāreṇopanyasyati --- kim asyeti| vācakatvaṃ pratipādakatvam ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: tat anena prabandhena bhagavān īśvaraḥ darśitaḥ saṃprati tad praṇidhānam darśayitum tasya vācakam āha tasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ vyācaṣṭe vācyaḥ iti tatra pareṣām matam vimarśa dvāreṇa upanyasyati kim asya iti vācaka tvam pratipādaka tvam iti arthaḥ

original: pare hi paśyanti yadi svābhāvikaḥ śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ saṃketenāsmāc chabdād ayam arthaḥ pratyetavya ityevamātmakenābhivyajyeta tato yatra nāsti sa saṃbandhas tatra saṃketaśatenāpi na vyajyeta| na hi pradīpavyaṅgyo ghaṭo yatra nāsti tatra pradīpasahasreṇāpi śakyo vyaṅktum| kṛtasaṃketas tu karabhaśabdo vāraṇe vāraṇapratipādako dṛṣṭaḥ|
analyzed: pare hi paśyanti yadi svābhāvikaḥ śabda arthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ saṃketena asmāt śabdāt ayam arthaḥ pratyetavyaḥ iti evamātmakena abhivyajyeta tatas yatra na asti sa saṃbandhaḥ tatra saṃketa śatena api na vyajyeta na hi pradīpa vyaṅgyaḥ ghaṭaḥ yatra na asti tatra pradīpa sahasreṇa api śakyaḥ vyaṅktum kṛta saṃketaḥ tu karabha śabdaḥ vāraṇe vāraṇa pratipādakaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ

original: tataḥ saṃketakṛtam eva vācakatvam iti| vimṛśyābhimatam avadhārayati --- sthito'syeti| ayam abhiprāyaḥ --- sarva eva śabdāḥ sarvākārārthābhidhānasamarthā iti| sthita evaiṣāṃ sarvākārair arthaiḥ svābhāvikaḥ saṃbandhaḥ| īśvarasaṃketas tu prakāśakaś ca niyāmakaś ca| tasyeśvarasaṃketāsaṃketakṛtaś cāsya vācakāpabhraṃśavibhāgaḥ|
analyzed: tatas saṃketa kṛtam eva vācaka tvam iti vimṛśya abhimatam avadhārayati sthitaḥ usya iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ sarve eva śabdāḥ sarva ākāra artha abhidhāna samarthāḥ iti sthitaḥ eva eṣām sarva ākāraiḥ arthaiḥ svābhāvikaḥ saṃbandhaḥ īśvara saṃketaḥ tu prakāśakaḥ ca niyāmakaḥ ca tasya īśvara saṃketa a saṃketa kṛtaḥ ca asya vācaka apabhraṃśa vibhāgaḥ

original: tad idam āha --- saṃketas tv īśvarasyeti| nidarśanam āha --- yatheti| nanu śabdasya prādhānikasya mahāpralayasamaye pradhānabhāvam upagatasya śaktir api pralīnā, tato mahadādikrameṇotpannasyāvācakasyaiva māheśvareṇa saṃketena na śakyā vācakaśaktir abhivyañjayituṃ vinaṣṭaśaktitvād ity ata āha --- sargāntareṣv apīti|
analyzed: tat idam āha saṃketaḥ tu īśvarasya iti nidarśanam āha yathā iti nanu śabdasya prādhānikasya mahāpralaya samaye pradhāna bhāvam upagatasya śaktiḥ api pralīnā tatas mahat ādi krameṇa utpannasya a vācakasya eva māheśvareṇa saṃketena na śakyā vācaka śaktiḥ abhivyañjayitum vinaṣṭa śakti tvāt iti atas āha sarga antareṣu api iti

original: yady api saha śaktyā pradhānasāmyam upagataḥ śabdas tathāpi punar āvirbhavaṃs tacchaktiyukta evāvirbhavati varṣātipātasamadhigatamṛdbhāva ivodbhijjo meghavisṛṣṭavāridhārāvasekāt| tena pūrvasaṃbandhasaṃketānusāreṇa saṃketaḥ kriyate bhagavateti|
analyzed: yadi api saha śaktyā pradhāna sāmyam upagataḥ śabdaḥ tathā api punar āvirbhavan tad śakti yuktaḥ eva āvirbhavati varṣa atipāta samadhigata mṛd bhāvaḥ iva udbhijjaḥ megha visṛṣṭa vāri dhārā avasekāt tena pūrva saṃbandha saṃketa anusāreṇa saṃketaḥ kriyate bhagavatā iti

original: tasmāt saṃpratipatteḥ sadṛśavyavahāraparamparāyā nityatayā nityaḥ śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandho na kūṭasthanitya ity āgamikāḥ pratijānate, na punar āgamanirapekṣāḥ sargāntareṣv api tādṛśa eva saṃketa iti pratipattum īśata iti bhāvaḥ||1.27||
analyzed: tasmāt saṃpratipatteḥ sadṛśa vyavahāra paramparāyāḥ nitya tayā nityaḥ śabda arthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ na kūṭastha nityaḥ iti āgamikāḥ pratijānate na punar āgama nirapekṣāḥ sarga antareṣu api tādṛśaḥ eva saṃketaḥ iti pratipattum īśate iti bhāvaḥ

original: tajjapas tadarthabhāvanam||1.28||
analyzed: tad japaḥ tad artha bhāvanam

original: vācakam ākhyāya praṇidhānam āha --- tajjapas tadarthabhāvanam| vyācaṣṭe --- praṇavasyeti| bhāvanaṃ punaḥ punaś citte niveśanam| tataḥ kiṃ sidhyatīty ata āha --- praṇavam iti| ekasmin bhagavaty āramati cittam| atraiva vaiyāsikīṃ gāthām udāharati --- tathā ceti| tata īśvaraḥ samādhitatphalalābhena tam anugṛhṇāti||1.28||
analyzed: vācakam ākhyāya praṇidhānam āha tad japaḥ tad artha bhāvanam vyācaṣṭe praṇavasya iti bhāvanam punar punar citte niveśanam tatas kim sidhyati iti atas āha praṇavam iti ekasmin bhagavati āramati cittam atra eva vaiyāsikīm gāthām udāharati tathā ca iti tatas īśvaraḥ samādhi tad phala lābhena tam anugṛhṇāti

original: tataḥ pratyakcetanādhigamo'py antarāyābhāvaś ca||1.29||
analyzed: tatas pratyak cetanā adhigamaḥ api antarāya abhāvaḥ ca

original: kiṃ cāparam asmāt --- tataḥ pratyakcetanādhigamo'py antarāyābhāvaś ca| pratīpaṃ viparītam añcati vijānātīti pratyak sa cāsau cetanaś ceti pratyakcetano'vidyāvān puruṣaḥ| tad aneneśvarāc chāśvatikasattvotkarṣasaṃpannād vidyāvato nivartayati| pratīcaś cetanasyādhigamo jñānaṃ svarūpato 'sya bhavaty antarāyā vakṣyamāṇās tadabhāvaś ca|
analyzed: kim ca aparam asmāt tatas pratyak cetanā adhigamaḥ upi antarāya abhāvaḥ ca pratīpam viparītam añcati vijānāti iti pratyak sa ca asau cetanaḥ ca iti pratyak cetanaḥ vidyāvān puruṣaḥ tat anena īśvarāt śāśvatika sattva utkarṣa saṃpannāt vidyāvataḥ nivartayati pratīcaḥ cetanasya adhigamaḥ jñānam svarūpataḥ sya bhavati antarāyāḥ vakṣyamāṇāḥ tad abhāvaḥ ca

original: asya vivaraṇaṃ --- ye tāvad iti| svam ātmā tasya rūpam| rūpagrahaṇenāvidyāsamāropitān dharmān niṣedhati| nanv īśvarapraṇidhānam īśvaraviṣayaṃ katham iva pratyakcetanaṃ sākṣātkaroty atiprasaṅgād ity ata āha --- yathaiveśvara iti| śuddhaḥ kūṭasthanityatayodayavyayarahitaḥ prasannaḥ kleśavarjitaḥ kevalo dharmādharmāpetaḥ| ata evānupasargaḥ|
analyzed: asya vivaraṇam ye tāvat iti svam ātmā tasya rūpam rūpa grahaṇena avidyā samāropitān dharmān niṣedhati nanu īśvara praṇidhānam īśvara viṣayam katham iva pratyak cetanam sākṣātkaroti atiprasaṅgāt iti atas āha yathā eva īśvaraḥ iti śuddhaḥ kūṭastha nitya tayā udaya vyaya rahitaḥ prasannaḥ kleśa varjitaḥ kevalaḥ dharma adharma apetaḥ atas eva anupasargaḥ

original: upasargā jātyāyurbhogāḥ| sādṛśyasya kiṃcid bhedādhiṣṭhānatvād īśvarād bhinatti --- buddheḥ pratisaṃvedīti| tad anena pratyaggrahaṇaṃ vyākhyātam| atyantavidharmiṇor anyatarārthānucintanaṃ na taditarasya sākṣātkārāya kalpate| sadṛśārthānucintanaṃ tu sadṛśāntarasākṣātkāropayogitām anubhavati ekaśāstrābhyāsa iva tatsadṛśārthaśāstrāntarajñānopayogitām|
analyzed: upasargāḥ jāti āyuḥ bhogāḥ sādṛśyasya kiṃcid bheda adhiṣṭhāna tvāt īśvarāt bhinatti buddheḥ pratisaṃvedi iti tat anena pratyak grahaṇam vyākhyātam atyanta vidharmiṇoḥ anyatara artha anucintanam na tad itarasya sākṣātkārāya kalpate sadṛśa artha anucintanam tu sadṛśa antara sākṣātkāra upayogi tām anubhavati eka śāstra abhyāsaḥ iva tad sadṛśa artha śāstra antara jñāna upayogi tām

original: pratyāsattis tu svātmani sākṣātkārahetur na parātmanīti sarvam avadātam||1.29||
analyzed: pratyāsattiḥ tu sva ātmani sākṣātkāra hetuḥ na para ātmani iti sarvam avadātam

original: vyādhistyānasaṃśayapramādālasyāviratibhrāntidarśanālabdhabhūmikatvānavasthitatvāni cittavikṣepās te'ntarāyāḥ||1.30||
analyzed: vyādhiḥ tyāna saṃśaya pramāda ālasya avirati bhrānti darśana a labdha bhūmika tva anavasthita tvāni citta vikṣepāḥ tentarāyāḥ

original: pṛcchati --- atha ka iti| sāmānyenottaram --- ya iti| viśeṣasaṃkhye pṛcchati --- ka iti| uttaraṃ vyādhītyādisūtram| antarāyā nava| etāś cittavṛttayo yogāntarāyā yogavirodhinaś cittasya vikṣepakāś cittaṃ khalv amī vyādhyādayo yogād vikṣipanty apanayantīti vikṣepāḥ| yogapratipakṣatve hetum āha --- sahaita iti|
analyzed: pṛcchati atha ke iti sāmānyena uttaram ye iti viśeṣa saṃkhye pṛcchati ke iti uttaram vyādhi ityādi sūtram antarāyāḥ nava etāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ yoga antarāyāḥ yoga virodhinaḥ cittasya vikṣepakāḥ cittam khalu amī vyādhi ādayaḥ yogāt vikṣipanti apanayanti iti vikṣepāḥ yoga pratipakṣa tve hetum āha saha ete iti

original: saṃśayabhrāntidarśane tāvad vṛttitayā vṛttinirodhapratipakṣau| ye'pi na vṛttayo vyādhiprabhṛtayas te'pi vṛttisāhacaryāt tatpratipakṣā ity arthaḥ| padārthān vyācaṣṭe --- vyādhir iti| dhātavo vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ śarīradhāraṇāt| aśitapītāhārapariṇāmaviśeṣo rasaḥ| karaṇānīndriyāṇi teṣāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ nyūnādhikabhāva iti| akarmaṇyatā karmānarhatā|
analyzed: saṃśaya bhrānti darśane tāvat vṛtti tayā vṛtti nirodha pratipakṣau ye api na vṛttayaḥ vyādhi prabhṛtayaḥ te api vṛtti sāhacaryāt tad pratipakṣāḥ iti arthaḥ padārthān vyācaṣṭe vyādhiḥ iti dhātavaḥ vāta pitta śleṣmāṇaḥ śarīra dhāraṇāt aśita pīta āhāra pariṇāma viśeṣaḥ rasaḥ karaṇāni indriyāṇi teṣām vaiṣamyam nyūna adhika bhāvaḥ iti akarmaṇya tā karma anarha tā

original: saṃśaya ubhayakoṭispṛgvijñānam| saty apy atadrūpapratiṣṭhatvena saṃśayaviparyāsayor abhede, ubhayakoṭisparśāsparśarūpāvāntaraviśeṣavivakṣayātra bhedenopanyāsaḥ| abhāvanam akaraṇaṃ tatrāprayatna iti yāvat| kāyasya gurutvaṃ kaphādinā, cittasya gurutvaṃ tamasā| gardhas tṛṣṇā| madhumatyādayaḥ samādhibhūmayaḥ|
analyzed: saṃśayaḥ ubhaya koṭi spṛś vijñānam sati api a tad rūpa pratiṣṭha tvena saṃśaya viparyāsayoḥ abhede ubhaya koṭi sparśa asparśa rūpa avāntara viśeṣa vivakṣayā atra bhedena upanyāsaḥ abhāvanam akaraṇam tatra aprayatnaḥ iti yāvat kāyasya guru tvam kapha ādinā cittasya guru tvam tamasā gardhaḥ tṛṣṇā madhumatī ādayaḥ samādhi bhūmayaḥ

original: labdhabhūmer yadi tāvataiva susthitaṃmanyasya samādhibhreṣaḥ syāt tatas tasyā api bhūmer apāyaḥ syāt| yasmāt samādhipratilambhe tadavasthitaṃ syāt tasmāt tatra prayatitavyam iti||1.30||
analyzed: labdha bhūmeḥ yadi tāvatā eva susthitaṃmanyasya samādhi bhreṣaḥ syāt tatas tasyāḥ api bhūmeḥ apāyaḥ syāt yasmāt samādhi pratilambhe tat avasthitam syāt tasmāt tatra prayatitavyam iti

original: duḥkhadaurmanasyāṅgamejayatvaśvāsapraśvāsā vikṣepasahabhuvaḥ||1.31||
analyzed: duḥkha daurmanasya aṅgamejayatva śvāsa praśvāsāḥ vikṣepa sahabhuvaḥ

original: na kevalaṃ navāntarāyā duḥkhādayo'py asya tatsahabhuvo bhavantīty āha --- duḥkhetyādi| pratikūlavedanīyaṃ duḥkham ādhyātmikaṃ śārīraṃ vyādhivaśān mānasaṃ ca kāmādivaśāt| ādhibhautikaṃ vyāghrādijanitam| ādhidaivikaṃ grahapīḍādijanitam| tac cedaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāṇimātrasya pratikūlavedanīyatayā heyam ity āha --- yenābhihatā iti|

original: asmanmate tv akṣaṇikaṃ cittaṃ svaviṣaya ekasminn anekasmin vānavasthitaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ tattadviṣayopādānaparityāgābhyāṃ viṣayāniyataṃ vikṣiptam ato vikṣepapariṇāmam apanīya śakyaikāgratādhātum iti tadupadeśapravṛttyor nānarthakatvam ity āha --- yadi punar idam iti| upasaṃharati --- ato neti| vaināśikam utthāpayati --- yo'pīti|
analyzed: asmad mate tu akṣaṇikam cittam sva viṣaye ekasmin anekasmin vā anavasthitam pratikṣaṇam tad tad viṣaya upādāna parityāgābhyām viṣaya aniyatam vikṣiptam atas vikṣepa pariṇāmam apanīya śakya ekāgra tā dhātum iti tad upadeśa pravṛttyoḥ na anarthaka tvam iti āha yadi punar idam iti upasaṃharati atas na iti vaināśikam utthāpayati yopī iti

original: mā bhūd ekasmin kṣaṇike citta ekāgratādhānaprayatnaḥ| cittasaṃtāne tv anādāv akṣaṇike vikṣepam apanīyaikāgratādhāsyata ity arthaḥ| tad etad vikalpya dūṣayati --- tasyeti| tasya darśana ekāgratā yadi pravāhacittasya cittasaṃtānasya vā dharmaḥ| tatraikaṃ kramavad utpādeṣu pratyayeṣv anugataṃ nāsti pravāhacittam|
analyzed: mā bhūt ekasmin kṣaṇike citte ekāgra tā ādhāna prayatnaḥ citta saṃtāne tu anādau akṣaṇike vikṣepam apanīya ekāgra tā ādhāsyate iti arthaḥ tat etat vikalpya dūṣayati tasya iti tasya darśane ekāgra tā yadi pravāha cittasya citta saṃtānasya vā dharmaḥ tatra ekam kramavat utpādeṣu pratyayeṣu anugatam na asti pravāha cittam

original: kutaḥ, yad yāvad asti tasya sarvasya kṣaṇikatvād akṣaṇikasya cāsattvād bhavatāṃ darśana iti bhāvaḥ| dvitīyaṃ kalpaṃ gṛhṇāti --- atheti| sāṃvṛtasya pravāhasyāṃśaḥ pratyayaḥ paramārthasaṃs tasya pratyayasyaikāgratā prayatnasādhyo dharmaḥ| dūṣayati --- sa sarvaḥ sāṃvṛtapravāhāpekṣayā sadṛśapratyayapravāhī vā visadṛśapratyayapravāhī vā|
analyzed: kutas yat yāvat asti tasya sarvasya kṣaṇika tvāt akṣaṇikasya ca asattvāt bhavatām darśane iti bhāvaḥ dvitīyam kalpam gṛhṇāti atha iti sāṃvṛtasya pravāhasya aṃśaḥ pratyayaḥ paramārtha san tasya pratyayasya ekāgra tā prayatna sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ dūṣayati sa sarvaḥ sāṃvṛta pravāha apekṣayā sadṛśa pratyaya pravāhī vā visadṛśa pratyaya pravāhī vā

original: ataḥ paramārthasattārūpeṇa pratyarthaniyatatvād yadarthāvabhāsa utpannas tatra samāptatvād ekāgra eveti vikṣiptacittānupapattiḥ, yad apanayenaikāgratādhīyata iti| upasaṃharati --- tasmād iti| ito'pi cittam ekam anekārtham avasthitaṃ cety āha --- yadi ceti| yathā hi maitreṇādhītasya śāstrasya na caitraḥ smarati|
analyzed: atas paramārtha sattā rūpeṇa prati artha niyata tvāt yad artha avabhāsaḥ utpannaḥ tatra samāpta tvāt ekāgraḥ eva iti vikṣipta citta anupapattiḥ yat apanayena ekāgra tā ādhīyate iti upasaṃharati tasmāt iti itas pi cittam ekam aneka artham avasthitam ca iti āha yadi ca iti yathā hi maitreṇa adhītasya śāstrasya na caitraḥ smarati

original: yathā vā maitreṇāpacitasya puṇyasya pāpasya vā karmāśayasya phalaṃ tadasaṃbandhī caitro na bhuṅkte, evaṃ pratyayāntaradṛṣṭasya pratyayāntaraṃ na smaret| pratyayāntaropacitasya vā karmāśayasya phalaṃ ca na pratyayāntaram upabhuñjītety arthaḥ|
analyzed: yathā vā maitreṇa apacitasya puṇyasya pāpasya vā karma āśayasya phalam tad asaṃbandhī caitraḥ na bhuṅkte evam pratyaya antara dṛṣṭasya pratyaya antaram na smaret pratyaya antara upacitasya vā karma āśayasya phalam ca na pratyaya antaram upabhuñjīta iti arthaḥ

original: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ --- kaḥ khalv ekasaṃtānavartināṃ pratyayānāṃ saṃtānāntaravartibhyaḥ pratyayebhyo viśeṣo yenaikasaṃtānavartinā pratyayenānubhūtasyopacitasya ca karmāśayasya tatsaṃtānavarty eva pratyayaḥ smartā bhoktā ca syān nānyasaṃtānavartī| na hi saṃtāno nāma kaścid asti vastusan| ya enaṃ saṃtānaṃ saṃtānāntaravartibhyo bhindyāt|
analyzed: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ kaḥ khalu eka saṃtāna vartinām pratyayānām saṃtāna antara vartibhyaḥ pratyayebhyaḥ viśeṣaḥ yena eka saṃtāna vartinā pratyayena anubhūtasya upacitasya ca karma āśayasya tad saṃtāna vartī eva pratyayaḥ smartā bhoktā ca syāt na anya saṃtāna vartī na hi saṃtānaḥ nāma kaścid asti vastu san yaḥ enam saṃtānam saṃtāna antara vartibhyaḥ bhindyāt

original: na ca kālpaniko bhedaḥ kriyāyām upapadyate| na khalu kalpitāgnibhāvo māṇavakaḥ pacati| na ca kāryakāraṇabhāvasaṃbandho 'pi vāstavaḥ| sahabhuvoḥ savyetaraviṣāṇayor ivābhāvād asahabhuvor api pratyutpannāśrayatvāyogāt| na hy atītānāgatau vyāsajjya pratyutpannaṃ vartitum arhataḥ|
analyzed: na ca kālpanikaḥ bhedaḥ kriyāyām upapadyate na khalu kalpita agni bhāvaḥ māṇavakaḥ pacati na ca kārya kāraṇa bhāva saṃbandhaḥ vāstavaḥ sahabhuvoḥ savyetara viṣāṇayoḥ iva abhāvāt a sahabhuvoḥ api pratyutpanna āśraya tva ayogāt na hi atīta anāgatau vyāsajjya pratyutpannam vartitum arhataḥ

original: tasmāt saṃtānena vā kāryakāraṇabhāvena vā svābhāvikenānupahitāḥ paramārthasantaḥ pratyayāḥ parasparāsaṃsparśitvena svasaṃtānavartibhyaḥ parasaṃtānavartibhyo vā pratyayāntarebhyo na bhidyante| so'yaṃ gomayaṃ ca pāyasaṃ cādhikṛtya pravṛtto nyāyo gomayaṃ pāyasaṃ gavyatvād ubhayasiddhapāyasavad iti| tam ākṣipati nyāyābhāsatvena tato'py adhikatvād iti|
analyzed: tasmāt saṃtānena vā kārya kāraṇa bhāvena vā svābhāvikena anupahitāḥ paramārtha santaḥ pratyayāḥ paraspara a saṃsparśi tvena sva saṃtāna vartibhyaḥ para saṃtāna vartibhyaḥ vā pratyaya antarebhyaḥ na bhidyante saḥ ayam gomayam ca pāyasam ca adhikṛtya pravṛttaḥ nyāyaḥ gomayam pāyasam gavya tvāt ubhaya siddha pāyasa vat iti tam ākṣipati nyāya ābhāsa tvena tatas api adhika tvāt iti

original: na cātra kṛtanāśākṛtābhyāgamaṃ codyam| yataś cittam eva karmaṇāṃ kartṛ tad eva tajjanitābhyāṃ sukhaduḥkhābhyāṃ yujyate| sukhaduḥkhe ca citicchāyāpannaṃ cittaṃ bhuṅkta iti puruṣe bhogābhimānaś citicittayor abhedagrahād iti| svapratyayaṃ pratītya samutpannānāṃ svabhāva evaiṣāṃ tādṛśo yat ta eva smaranti phalaṃ copabhuñjate na tv anye|
analyzed: na ca atra kṛta nāśa akṛta abhyāgamam codyam yatas cittam eva karmaṇām kartṛ tat eva tad janitābhyām sukha duḥkhābhyām yujyate sukha duḥkhe ca citi chāyā āpannam cittam bhuṅkte iti puruṣe bhoga abhimānaḥ citi cittayoḥ abheda grahāt iti sva pratyayam pratītya samutpannānām svabhāvaḥ eva eṣām tādṛśaḥ yat te eva smaranti phalam ca upabhuñjate na tu anye

original: na ca svabhāvā niyogaparyanuyogāv arhanti evaṃ bhavata maivaṃ bhūteti vā kasmān naivam iti ceti| yaḥ pūrvokte na parituṣyati taṃ pratyāha --- kiṃ ca svātmeti| udayavyayadharmāṇām anubhavānām anubhavasmṛtīnāṃ ca nānātve'pi tadāśrayam abhinnaṃ cittam aham iti pratyayaḥ pratisaṃdadhānaḥ katham atyantabhinnān pratyayān ālambeta|
analyzed: na ca svabhāvāḥ niyoga paryanuyogau arhanti evam bhavata mā evam bhūta iti vā kasmāt na evam iti ca iti yaḥ pūrva ukte na parituṣyati tam pratyāha kim ca svātmā iti udaya vyaya dharmāṇām anubhavānām anubhava smṛtīnām ca nānātve api tad āśrayam abhinnam cittam aham iti pratyayaḥ pratisaṃdadhānaḥ katham atyanta bhinnān pratyayān ālambeta

original: nanu grahaṇasmaraṇarūpakāraṇabhedāt pārokṣyāpārokṣyarūpaviruddhadharmasaṃsargād vā na pratyabhijñānaṃ nāmaikaḥ pratyayo yataḥ pratyayinaś cittasyaikatā syād ity ata āha --- svānubhaveti| nanu kāraṇabhedaviruddhadharmasaṃsargāv evātra bādhakāv uktāv ity ata āha --- na ca pratyakṣasyeti|
analyzed: nanu grahaṇa smaraṇa rūpa kāraṇa bhedāt pārokṣya apārokṣya rūpa viruddha dharma saṃsargāt vā na pratyabhijñānam nāma ekaḥ pratyayaḥ yatas pratyayinaḥ cittasya ekatā syāt iti atas āha sva anubhava iti nanu kāraṇa bheda viruddha dharma saṃsargau eva atra bādhakau uktau iti atas āha na ca pratyakṣasya iti

original: maitrīkaruṇāmuditopekṣāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhapuṇyāpuṇyaviṣayāṇāṃ bhāvanātaś cittaprasādanam||1.33||

original: aparikarmitamanaso'sūyādimataḥ samādhitadupāyasaṃpattyanutpādāc cittaprasādanopāyān asūyādivirodhinaḥ pratipādayitum upakramate --- yasya cittasyāvasthitasyedam iti| maitrīkaruṇetyādiprasādanāntam| sukhiteṣu maitrīṃ sauhārdaṃ bhāvayata īrṣyākāluṣyaṃ nivartate cittasya|
analyzed: a parikarmita manasā usūyā ādimataḥ samādhi tad upāya saṃpatti anutpādāt citta prasādana upāyān asūyā ādi virodhinaḥ pratipādayitum upakramate yasya cittasya avasthitasya idam iti maitrī karuṇā ityādi prasādana antam sukhiteṣu maitrīm sauhārdam bhāvayataḥ īrṣyā kāluṣyam nivartate cittasya

original: duḥkhiteṣu ca karuṇām ātmanīva parasmin duḥkhaprahāṇecchāṃ bhāvayataḥ parāpakāracikīrṣākāluṣyaṃ cetaso nivartate| puṇyaśīleṣu prāṇiṣu muditāṃ harṣaṃ bhāvayato'sūyākāluṣyaṃ cetaso nivartate| apuṇyaśīleṣu copekṣāṃ mādhyasthyaṃ bhāvayato'marṣakāluṣyaṃ cetaso nivartate| tataś cāsya rājasatāmasadharmanivṛttau sāttvikaḥ śuklo dharma upajāyate|
analyzed: duḥkhiteṣu ca karuṇām ātmani iva parasmin duḥkha prahāṇa icchām bhāvayataḥ para apakāra cikīrṣā kāluṣyam cetasaḥ nivartate puṇya śīleṣu prāṇiṣu muditām harṣam bhāvayatā usūyā kāluṣyam cetasaḥ nivartate apuṇya śīleṣu ca upekṣām mādhyasthyam bhāvayatā umarṣa kāluṣyam cetasaḥ nivartate tatas ca asya rājasa tāmasa dharma nivṛttau sāttvikaḥ śuklaḥ dharmaḥ upajāyate

original: sattvotkarṣasaṃpannaḥ saṃbhavati vṛttinirodhapakṣe| tasya prasādasvābhāvyāc cittaṃ prasīdati| prasannaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇebhya upāyebhya ekāgraṃ sthitipadaṃ labhate| asatyāṃ punar maitryādibhāvanāyāṃ na ta upāyāḥ sthityai kalpanta iti||1.33||
analyzed: sattva utkarṣa saṃpannaḥ saṃbhavati vṛtti nirodha pakṣe tasya prasāda svābhāvyāt cittam prasīdati prasannam ca vakṣyamāṇebhyaḥ upāyebhyaḥ ekāgram sthiti padam labhate asatyām punar maitrī ādi bhāvanāyām na te upāyāḥ sthityai kalpante iti

original: pracchardanavidhāraṇābhyāṃ vā prāṇasya||1.34||

original: tān idānīṃ sthityupāyān āha --- pracchardanavidhāraṇābhyāṃ vā prāṇasya| vāśabdo vakṣyamāṇopāyāntarāpekṣo vikalpārthaḥ, na maitryādibhāvanāpekṣayā tayā saha samuccayāt| pracchardanaṃ vivṛṇoti --- kauṣṭhyasyeti| prayatnaviśeṣād yogaśāstravihitād yena kauṣṭhyo vāyur nāsikāpuṭābhyāṃ śanai recyate| vidhāraṇaṃ vivṛṇoti --- vidhāraṇaṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ|
analyzed: tān idānīm sthiti upāyān āha pracchardana vidhāraṇābhyām vā prāṇasya vā śabdaḥ vakṣyamāṇa upāya antara apekṣaḥ vikalpa arthaḥ na maitrī ādi bhāvanā apekṣayā tayā saha samuccayāt pracchardanam vivṛṇoti kauṣṭhyasya iti prayatna viśeṣāt yoga śāstra vihitāt yena kauṣṭhyaḥ vāyuḥ nāsikā puṭābhyām śanais recyate vidhāraṇam vivṛṇoti vidhāraṇam prāṇāyāmaḥ

original: recitasya prāṇasya kauṣṭhyasya vāyor yad āyāmo bahir eva sthāpanaṃ na tu sahasā praveśanam| tad etābhyāṃ pracchardanavidhāraṇābhyāṃ vāyor laghukṛtaśarīrasya manaḥ sthitipadaṃ labhate| atra cottarasūtragatāt sthitinibandhanītipadāt sthitigrahaṇam ākṛṣya saṃpādayed ity arthaprāptena saṃbandhanīyam||1.34||
analyzed: recitasya prāṇasya kauṣṭhyasya vāyoḥ yat āyāmaḥ bahis eva sthāpanam na tu sahasā praveśanam tat etābhyām pracchardana vidhāraṇābhyām vāyoḥ laghukṛta śarīrasya manaḥ sthiti padam labhate atra ca uttara sūtra gatāt sthiti nibandhanīti padāt sthiti grahaṇam ākṛṣya saṃpādayet iti artha prāptena saṃbandhanīyam

original: viṣayavatī vā pravṛttir utpannā manasaḥ sthitinibandhanī||1.35||
analyzed: viṣayavatī vā pravṛttiḥ utpannā manasaḥ sthiti nibandhanī

original: sthityupāyāntaram āha --- viṣayavatī vā pravṛttir utpannā manasaḥ sthitinibandhanī| vyācaṣṭe --- nāsikāgre dhārayata iti| dhāraṇādhyānasamādhīn kurvatas tajjayādyā divyagandhasaṃvittatsākṣātkāraḥ| evam anyāsv api pravṛttiṣu yojyam| etac cāgamāt pratyetavyaṃ nopapattitaḥ|
analyzed: sthiti upāya antaram āha viṣayavatī vā pravṛttiḥ utpannā manasaḥ sthiti nibandhanī vyācaṣṭe nāsikā agre dhārayataḥ iti dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhīn kurvataḥ tad jaya ādyā divya gandha saṃvid tad sākṣātkāraḥ evam anyāsu api pravṛttiṣu yojyam etat ca āgamāt pratyetavyam na upapattitaḥ

original: syād etat kim etādṛgbhir vṛttibhiḥ kaivalyaṃ pratyanupayoginībhir ity ata āha --- etā vṛttayo'lpenaiva kālenotpannāś cittam īśvaraviṣayāyāṃ vā vivekakhyātiviṣayāyāṃ vā sthitau nibadhnanti| nanv anyaviṣayā vṛttiḥ katham anyatra sthitiṃ nibadhnātīty ata āha --- saṃśayaṃ vidhamanti apasārayanti ata eva samādhiprajñāyām iti|
analyzed: syāt etat kim etādṛgbhiḥ vṛttibhiḥ kaivalyam pratyanupayoginībhiḥ iti atas āha etāḥ vṛttayaḥ alpena eva kālena utpannāḥ cittam īśvara viṣayāyām vā viveka khyāti viṣayāyām vā sthitau nibadhnanti nanu anya viṣayā vṛttiḥ katham anyatra sthitim nibadhnāti iti atas āha saṃśayam vidhamanti apasārayanti atas eva samādhi prajñāyām iti

original: vṛttyantarāṇām apy āgamasiddhānāṃ viṣayavattvam atidiśati --- eteneti| nanv āgamādibhir avagateṣv artheṣu kutaḥ saṃśaya ity ata āha --- yady api hīti| śraddhāmūlo hi yoga upadiṣṭārthaikadeśapratyakṣīkaraṇe ca śraddhātiśayo jāyate| tanmūlāś ca dhyānādayo'syāpratyūhaṃ bhavantīty arthaḥ||1.35||
analyzed: vṛtti antarāṇām api āgama siddhānām viṣayavat tvam atidiśati etena iti nanu āgama ādibhiḥ avagateṣu artheṣu kutas saṃśayaḥ iti atas āha yadi api hi iti śraddhā mūlaḥ hi yogaḥ upadiṣṭa artha eka deśa pratyakṣīkaraṇe ca śraddhā atiśayaḥ jāyate tad mūlāḥ ca dhyāna ādayaḥ asya apratyūham bhavanti iti arthaḥ

original: viśokā vā jyotiṣmatī||1.36||
analyzed: viśokā vā jyotiṣmatī

original: viśokā vā jyotiṣmatī| vigataśokā duḥkharahitā jyotiṣmatī jyotir asyā astīti jyotiṣmatī prakāśarūpā| hṛdayapuṇḍarīka iti| udarorasor madhye yat padmam adhomukhaṃ tiṣṭhaty aṣṭadalaṃ recakaprāṇāyāmena tad ūrdhvamukhaṃ kṛtvā tatra cittaṃ dhārayet| tanmadhye sūryamaṇḍalam akāro jāgaritasthānaṃ tasyopari candramaṇḍalam ukāraḥ svapnasthānam|
analyzed: viśokā vā jyotiṣmatī vigata śokā duḥkha rahitā jyotiṣmatī jyotiḥ asyāḥ asti iti jyotiṣmatī prakāśa rūpā hṛdaya puṇḍarīke iti udara urasoḥ madhye yat padmam adhomukham tiṣṭhati aṣṭadalam recaka prāṇāyāmena tat ūrdhva mukham kṛtvā tatra cittam dhārayet tad madhye sūrya maṇḍalam akāraḥ jāgarita sthānam tasya upari candra maṇḍalam ukāraḥ svapna sthānam

original: tasyopari vahnimaṇḍalaṃ makāraḥ suṣuptisthānam| tasyopari paravyomātmakaṃ brahmanādaṃ turīyasthānam ardhamātram udāharanti brahmavādinaḥ| tatra karṇikāyām ūrdhvamukhī sūryādimaṇḍalamadhyagā brahmanāḍī| tato'py ūrdhvaṃ pravṛttā suṣumnā nāma nāḍī| tayā khalu bāhyāny api sūryādīni maṇḍalāni protāni| sa hi cittasthānam|
analyzed: tasya upari vahni maṇḍalam makāraḥ suṣupti sthānam tasya upari para vyoma ātmakam brahmanādam turīya sthānam ardha mātram udāharanti brahma vādinaḥ tatra karṇikāyām ūrdhva mukhī sūrya ādi maṇḍala madhya gā brahmanāḍī tatas upi ūrdhvam pravṛttā suṣumnā nāma nāḍī tayā khalu bāhyāni api sūrya ādīni maṇḍalāni protāni sa hi citta sthānam

original: tasyāṃ dhārayato yoginaś cittasaṃvid upajāyate| upapattipūrvakaṃ buddhisaṃvida ākāram ādarśayati --- buddhisattvaṃ hīti| ākāśakalpam iti vyāpitām āha| sūryādīnāṃ prabhās tāsāṃ rūpaṃ tadākāreṇa vikalpate nānārūpā bhavati| manaś cātra buddhir abhimataṃ na tu mahattattvam|
analyzed: tasyām dhārayataḥ yoginaḥ citta saṃvid upajāyate upapatti pūrvakam buddhi saṃvidaḥ ākāram ādarśayati buddhi sattvam hi iti ākāśa kalpam iti vyāpitām āha sūrya ādīnām prabhāḥ tāsām rūpam tad ākāreṇa vikalpate nānā rūpā bhavati manaḥ ca atra buddhiḥ abhimatam na tu mahat tattvam

original: tasya ca suṣumnāsthasya vaikārikāhaṃkārajanmanaḥ sattvabahulatayā jyotīrūpatā vivakṣitā| tattadviṣayagocaratayā ca vyāpitvam api siddham| asmitākārye manasi samāpattiṃ darśayitvāsmitāsamāpatteḥ svarūpam āha --- tatheti| śāntam apagatarajastamastaraṅgam| anantaṃ vyāpi| asmitāmātraṃ na punar nānāprabhārūpam|
analyzed: tasya ca suṣumnā sthasya vaikārika ahaṃkāra janmanaḥ sattva bahula tayā jyotīrūpa tā vivakṣitā tad tad viṣaya gocara tayā ca vyāpi tvam api siddham asmitā kārye manasi samāpattim darśayitvā asmitā samāpatteḥ svarūpam āha tathā iti śāntam apagata rajaḥ tamaḥ taraṅgam anantam vyāpi asmitā mātram na punar nānā prabhā rūpam

original: āgamāntareṇa svamataṃ samīkaroti --- yatredam uktaṃ pañcaśikhena tam aṇuṃ duradhigamatvād ātmānam ahaṃkārāspadam anuvidyānucintyāsmītyevaṃ tāvat saṃjānīta iti| syād etat| nānāprabhārūpā bhavatu jyotiṣmatī katham asmitāmātrarūpā jyotiṣmatīty ata āha --- eṣā dvayīti| vidhūtarajastamomalāsmitaiva sattvamayī jyotir iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: āgama antareṇa sva matam samīkaroti yatra idam uktam pañcaśikhena tam aṇum duradhigama tvāt ātmānam ahaṃkāra āspadam anuvidya anucintyā asmi iti evam tāvat saṃjānīta iti syāt etat nānā prabhā rūpā bhavatu jyotiṣmatī katham asmitā mātra rūpā jyotiṣmatī iti atas āha eṣā dvayī iti vidhūta rajaḥ tamaḥ mala asmitā eva sattva mayī jyotiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: dvividhāyā api jyotiṣmatyāḥ phalam āha --- yayeti||1.36||
analyzed: dvividhāyāḥ api jyotiṣmatyāḥ phalam āha yayā iti

original: vītarāgaviṣayaṃ vā cittam||1.37||
analyzed: vīta rāga viṣayam vā cittam

original: vītarāgaviṣayaṃ vā cittam| vītarāgāḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaprabhṛtayas teṣāṃ cittaṃ tad evālambanaṃ tenoparaktam iti||1.37||
analyzed: vīta rāga viṣayam vā cittam vīta rāgāḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyana prabhṛtayaḥ teṣām cittam tat eva ālambanam tena uparaktam iti

original: svapnanidrājñānālambanaṃ vā||1.38||
analyzed: svapna nidrā jñāna ālambanam vā

original: svapnanidrājñānālambanaṃ vā| yadā khalv ayaṃ svapne viviktavanasaṃniveśavartinīm utkīrṇām iva candramaṇḍalāt komalamṛṇālaśakalānukāribhir aṅgapratyaṅgair upapannām abhijātacandrakāntamaṇimayīm atisurabhimālatīmallikāmālāhāriṇīṃ manoharāṃ bhagavato maheśvarasya pratimām ārādhayann eva prabuddhaḥ prasannamanās tadā tām eva svapnajñānālambanībhūtām
analyzed: svapna nidrā jñāna ālambanam vā yadā khalu ayam svapne vivikta vana saṃniveśa vartinīm utkīrṇām iva candra maṇḍalāt komala mṛṇāla śakala anukāribhiḥ aṅga pratyaṅgaiḥ upapannām abhijāta candrakānta maṇi mayīm ati surabhi mālatī mallikā mālā hāriṇīm manoharām bhagavataḥ maheśvarasya pratimām ārādhayan eva prabuddhaḥ prasanna manāḥ tadā tām eva svapna jñāna ālambanībhūtām

original: anucintayatas tasya tadekākāramanasas tatraiva cittaṃ sthitipadaṃ labhate| nidrā ceha sāttvikī grahītavyā| yasyāḥ prabuddhasya sukham aham asvāpsam iti pratyavamarśo bhavati| ekāgraṃ hi tasyāṃ mano bhavati| tāvanmātreṇa coktam --- etad eva brahmavido brahmaṇo rūpam udāharanti suptāvastheti|
analyzed: anucintayataḥ tasya tad eka ākāra manasaḥ tatra eva cittam sthiti padam labhate nidrā ca iha sāttvikī grahītavyā yasyāḥ prabuddhasya sukham aham asvāpsam iti pratyavamarśaḥ bhavati ekāgram hi tasyām manaḥ bhavati tāvat mātreṇa ca uktam etat eva brahma vidaḥ brahmaṇaḥ rūpam udāharanti supta avasthā iti

original: jñānaṃ ca jñeyarahitaṃ na śakyaṃ gocarayitum iti jñeyam api gocarīkriyate||1.38||
analyzed: jñānam ca jñeya rahitam na śakyam gocarayitum iti jñeyam api gocarīkriyate

original: yathābhimatadhyānād vā||1.39||
analyzed: yathā abhimata dhyānāt vā

original: yathābhimatadhyānād vā| kiṃ bahunā yad evābhimataṃ tattaddevatārūpam iti||1.39||
analyzed: yathā abhimata dhyānāt vā kim bahunā yat eva abhimatam tat tat devatā rūpam iti

original: paramāṇuparamamahattvānto'sya vaśīkāraḥ||1.40||
analyzed: paramāṇu parama mahā tva antaḥ sya vaśīkāraḥ

original: kathaṃ punaḥ sthitipadasātmībhāvo'vagantavya ity ata āha --- paramāṇuparamamahattvānto'sya vaśīkāraḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- sūkṣma iti| uktam arthaṃ piṇḍīkṛtya vaśīkārapadārtham āha --- evaṃ tām ubhayīm iti| vaśīkārasyāvantaraphalam āha --- tadvaśīkārād iti||1.40||
analyzed: katham punar sthiti pada sātmībhāvaḥ uvagantavyaḥ iti atas āha paramāṇu parama mahā tva antaḥ sya vaśīkāraḥ vyācaṣṭe sūkṣmaḥ iti uktam artham piṇḍīkṛtya vaśīkāra padārtham āha evam tām ubhayīm iti vaśīkārasya au antara phalam āha tad vaśīkārāt iti

original: kṣīṇavṛtter abhijātasyeva maṇer grahītṛgrahaṇagrāhyeṣu tatsthatadañjanatā samāpattiḥ||1.41||
analyzed: kṣīṇa vṛtteḥ abhijātasya iva maṇeḥ grahītṛ grahaṇa grāhyeṣu tad stha tad añjana tā samāpattiḥ

original: tad evaṃ cittasthiter upāyā darśitāḥ| labdhasthitikasya cittasya vaśīkāro'pi darśitaḥ| saṃprati labdhasthitikasya cetasaḥ kiṃviṣayaḥ kiṃrūpaś ca saṃprajñāto bhavatīti pṛcchati --- atheti| atrottaraṃ sūtram avatārayati --- tad ucyata iti| sūtraṃ paṭhati --- kṣīṇavṛtter ityādi samāpattyantam| tad vyācaṣṭe --- kṣīṇeti|
analyzed: tat evam citta sthiteḥ upāyāḥ darśitāḥ labdha sthitikasya cittasya vaśīkāraḥ api darśitaḥ saṃprati labdha sthitikasya cetasaḥ kiṃviṣayaḥ kiṃrūpaḥ ca saṃprajñātaḥ bhavati iti pṛcchati atha iti atra uttaram sūtram avatārayati tat ucyate iti sūtram paṭhati kṣīṇa vṛtteḥ ityādi samāpatti antam tat vyācaṣṭe kṣīṇa iti

original: abhyāsavairāgyābhyāṃ kṣīṇarājasatāmasapramāṇādivṛtteś cittasya| tasya vyākhyānaṃ --- pratyastamitapratyayasyeti| tad anena cittasattvasya svabhāvasvacchasya rajastamobhyām anabhibhava uktaḥ| dṛṣṭāntaṃ spaṣṭayati --- yatheti| upāśraya upādhir japākusumādir uparaktas tacchāyāpannaḥ|
analyzed: abhyāsa vairāgyābhyām kṣīṇa rājasa tāmasa pramāṇa ādi vṛtteḥ cittasya tasya vyākhyānam pratyastamita pratyayasya iti tat anena citta sattvasya svabhāva svacchasya rajaḥ tamobhyām anabhibhavaḥ uktaḥ dṛṣṭāntam spaṣṭayati yathā iti upāśrayaḥ upādhiḥ japā kusuma ādiḥ uparaktaḥ tad chāyā āpannaḥ

original: upāśrayasya yad ātmīyaṃ rūpaṃ lohitanīlādi tad evākāras tena lakṣito nirbhāsate| dārṣṭāntike yojayati --- tathā grāhyeti| grāhyaṃ ca tadālambanaṃ ca tenoparaktaṃ tadanuviddhaṃ, tad anena grahītṛgrahaṇābhyāṃ vyavacchinatti| ātmīyam antaḥkaraṇarūpam apidhāya grāhyasamāpannaṃ grāhyatām iva prāptam iti yāvat| ato grāhyasvarūpākāreṇa nirbhāsate|
analyzed: upāśrayasya yat ātmīyam rūpam lohita nīla ādi tat eva ākāraḥ tena lakṣitaḥ nirbhāsate dārṣṭāntike yojayati tathā grāhya iti grāhyam ca tat ālambanam ca tena uparaktam tad anuviddham tat anena grahītṛ grahaṇābhyām vyavacchinatti ātmīyam antaḥkaraṇa rūpam apidhāya grāhya samāpannam grāhya tām iva prāptam iti yāvat atas grāhya svarūpa ākāreṇa nirbhāsate

original: grāhyoparāgam eva sūkṣmasthūlatābhyāṃ vibhajate --- bhūtasūkṣmeti| viśvabhedaś cetanācetanasvabhāvo gavādir ghaṭādiś ca draṣṭavyaḥ| tad anena vitarkavicārānugatau samādhī darśitau| tathā grahaṇeṣv apīndriyeṣv iti| gṛhyanta ebhir arthā iti grahaṇānīndriyāṇi| etad eva spaṣṭayati --- grahaṇālambaneti|
analyzed: grāhya uparāgam eva sūkṣma sthūla tābhyām vibhajate bhūta sūkṣma iti viśva bhedaḥ cetana acetana svabhāvaḥ go ādiḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ ca draṣṭavyaḥ tat anena vitarka vicāra anugatau samādhī darśitau tathā grahaṇeṣu api indriyeṣu iti gṛhyante ebhiḥ arthāḥ iti grahaṇāni indriyāṇi etat eva spaṣṭayati grahaṇa ālambana iti

original: grahaṇaṃ cālambanaṃ ca tad iti grahaṇālambanaṃ tenoparaktam anuviddham ātmīyam antaḥkaraṇarūpam apidhāya grahaṇam iva bahiṣkaraṇam ivāpannam iti| tad anenānandānugatam uktvāsmitānugatam āha --- tathā grahītṛpuruṣeti| asmitāspadaṃ hi grahītā puruṣa iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: grahaṇam ca ālambanam ca tat iti grahaṇa ālambanam tena uparaktam anuviddham ātmīyam antaḥkaraṇa rūpam apidhāya grahaṇam iva bahiṣkaraṇam iva āpannam iti tat anena ānanda anugatam uktvā asmitā anugatam āha tathā grahītṛ puruṣa iti asmitā āspadam hi grahītā puruṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: puruṣatvāviśeṣād anenaiva mukto'pi puruṣaḥ śukaprahlādādiḥ samādhiviṣayatayā saṃgrahītavya ity āha --- tathā mukteti| upasaṃharaṃs tatsthatadañjanatāpadaṃ vyācaṣṭe --- tad evam iti|
analyzed: puruṣa tva aviśeṣāt anena eva muktaḥ api puruṣaḥ śuka prahlāda ādiḥ samādhi viṣaya tayā saṃgrahītavyaḥ iti āha tathā mukta iti upasaṃharan tad stha tad añjana tā padam vyācaṣṭe tat evam iti

original: teṣu grahītṛgrahaṇagrāhyeṣu sthitasya dhāritasya dhyānaparipākavaśād apahatarajastamomalasya cittasattvasya yā tatsthatadañjanatā tadākāratā sā samāpattiḥ saṃprajñātalakṣaṇo yoga ucyate| tatra ca grahītṛgrahaṇagrāhyeṣv iti sautraḥ pāṭhakramo 'rthakramavirodhān nādartavyaḥ|
analyzed: teṣu grahītṛ grahaṇa grāhyeṣu sthitasya dhāritasya dhyāna paripāka vaśāt apahata rajaḥ tamaḥ malasya citta sattvasya yā tad stha tad añjana tā tad ākāra tā sā samāpattiḥ saṃprajñāta lakṣaṇaḥ yogaḥ ucyate tatra ca grahītṛ grahaṇa grāhyeṣu iti sautraḥ pāṭha kramaḥ rtha krama virodhāt na ādartavyaḥ

original: evaṃ bhāṣye'pi prathamaṃ bhūtasūkṣmopanyāso'py anādaraṇīya iti sarvaṃ ramaṇīyam||1.41||
analyzed: evam bhāṣye api prathamam bhūta sūkṣma upanyāsaḥ api an ādaraṇīyaḥ iti sarvam ramaṇīyam

original: tatra śabdārthajñānavikalpaiḥ saṃkīrṇā savitarkā samāpattiḥ||1.42||
analyzed: tatra śabda artha jñāna vikalpaiḥ saṃkīrṇā sa vitarkā samāpattiḥ

original: sāmānyataḥ samāpattir uktā| seyam avāntarabhedāc caturvidhā bhavati| tadyathā savitarkā nirvitarkā savicārā nirvicārā ceti| tatra savitarkāyāḥ samāpatter lakṣaṇam āha --- tatretyādi| tāsu samāpattiṣu madhye savitarkā samāpattiḥ pratipattavyā| kīdṛśī śabdaś cārthaś ca jñānaṃ ca teṣāṃ vikalpāḥ|
analyzed: sāmānyatas samāpattiḥ uktā sā iyam avāntarabhedāt caturvidhā bhavati tat yathā sa vitarkā nirvitarkā sa vicārā nirvicārā ca iti tatra sa vitarkāyāḥ samāpatteḥ lakṣaṇam āha tatra ityādi tāsu samāpattiṣu madhye sa vitarkā samāpattiḥ pratipattavyā kīdṛśī śabdaḥ ca arthaḥ ca jñānam ca teṣām vikalpāḥ

original: vastuto bhinnānām api śabdādīnām itaretarādhyāsād vikalpo'py ekasmin bhedam ādarśayati bhinneṣu cābhedam| tena śabdārthajñānavikalpaiḥ saṃkīrṇā vyāmiśrety arthaḥ| tadyathā gaur iti śabda iti| gaur ity upāttayor arthajñānayoḥ śabdābhedavikalpo darśitaḥ| gaur ity artha iti| gaur ity upāttayoḥ śabdajñānayor arthābhedavikalpaḥ| gaur iti jñānam iti|
analyzed: vastutas bhinnānām api śabda ādīnām itaretara adhyāsāt vikalpaḥ api ekasmin bhedam ādarśayati bhinneṣu ca abhedam tena śabda artha jñāna vikalpaiḥ saṃkīrṇā vyāmiśrā iti arthaḥ tat yathā gauḥ iti śabdaḥ iti gauḥ iti upāttayoḥ artha jñānayoḥ śabda abheda vikalpaḥ darśitaḥ gauḥ iti arthaḥ iti gauḥ iti upāttayoḥ śabda jñānayoḥ artha abheda vikalpaḥ gauḥ iti jñānam iti

original: gaur ity upāttayoḥ śabdārthayor jñānābhedavikalpaḥ| tad evam avinirbhāgena (avinirbhāgeṇa) vibhaktānām api śabdārthajñānānāṃ grahaṇaṃ loke dṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyam|
analyzed: gauḥ iti upāttayoḥ śabda arthayoḥ jñāna abheda vikalpaḥ tat evam a vinirbhāgena a vinirbhāgeṇa vibhaktānām api śabda artha jñānānām grahaṇam loke dṛṣṭam draṣṭavyam

original: yady avibhāgena grahaṇaṃ kutas tarhi vibhāga ity ata āha --- vibhajyamānāś cānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ parīkṣakair anye śabdadharmā dhvanipariṇāmamātrasya śabdasyodāttādayo dharmā anye'rthasya jaḍatvamūrtatvādayaḥ, anye prakāśamūrtivirahādayo jñānasya dharmā iti| tasmād eteṣāṃ vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ svarūpabhedonnayanamārgaḥ|
analyzed: yadi avibhāgena grahaṇam kutas tarhi vibhāgaḥ iti atas āha vibhajyamānāḥ ca anvaya vyatirekābhyām parīkṣakaiḥ anye śabda dharmāḥ dhvani pariṇāma mātrasya śabdasya udātta ādayaḥ dharmāḥ anye ṛthasya jaḍa tva mūrta tva ādayaḥ anye prakāśa mūrti viraha ādayaḥ jñānasya dharmāḥ iti tasmāt eteṣām vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ svarūpa bheda unnayana mārgaḥ
