original: tatra vikalpate gavādyarthe samāpannasyeti| tad anena yogino'paraṃ pratyakṣam uktam| śeṣaṃ sugamam||1.42||
analyzed: tatra vikalpate go ādi arthe samāpannasya iti tat anena yoginā uparam pratyakṣam uktam śeṣam sugamam

original: smṛtipariśuddhau svarūpaśūnyevārthamātranirbhāsā nirvitarkā||1.43||
analyzed: smṛti pariśuddhau sva rūpa śūnyā iva artha mātra nirbhāsā nirvitarkā

original: sūtraṃ yojayituṃ prathamatas tāvan nirvitarkāṃ vyācaṣṭe --- yadā punar iti| pariśuddhir apanayaḥ| śabdasaṃketasmaraṇapūrve khalv āgamānumāne pravartete| saṃketaś cāyaṃ gaur iti śabdārthajñānānām itaretarādhyāsātmā| tataś cāgamānumānajñānavikalpau bhavataḥ| tena tatpūrvā samādhiprajñā savitarkā|
analyzed: sūtram yojayitum prathamatas tāvat nirvitarkām vyācaṣṭe yadā punar iti pariśuddhiḥ apanayaḥ śabda saṃketa smaraṇa pūrve khalu āgama anumāne pravartete saṃketaḥ ca ayam gauḥ iti śabda artha jñānānām itaretara adhyāsa ātmā tatas ca āgama anumāna jñāna vikalpau bhavataḥ tena tad pūrvā samādhi prajñā sa vitarkā

original: yadā punar arthamātrapravaṇena cetasārthamātrādṛtena tadabhyāsān nāntarīyakatām upagatā saṃketasmṛtis tyaktā, tattyāge ca śrutānumānajñānavikalpau tanmūlau tyaktau, tadā tacchūnyāyāṃ samādhiprajñāyāṃ svarūpamātreṇāvasthito'rthas tatsvarūpamātratayaiva na tu vikalpitenākāreṇa paricchidyate| sā nirvitarkā samāpattir iti|
analyzed: yadā punar artha mātra pravaṇena cetasā artha mātra ādṛtena tad abhyāsāt nāntarīyaka tām upagatā saṃketa smṛtiḥ tyaktā tad tyāge ca śruta anumāna jñāna vikalpau tad mūlau tyaktau tadā tad śūnyāyām samādhi prajñāyām sva rūpa mātreṇa avasthita ūrthaḥ tad sva rūpa mātra tayā eva na tu vikalpitena ākāreṇa paricchidyate sā nirvitarkā samāpattiḥ iti

original: tad yogināṃ paraṃ pratyakṣam asadāropagandhasyāpy abhāvāt| syād etat pareṇa pratyakṣeṇārthatattvaṃ gṛhītvā yogina upadiśanty upapādayanti ca| kathaṃ cātadviṣayābhyām āgamaparārthānumānābhyāṃ so'rtha upadiśyata upapādyate ca| tasmād āgamānumāne tadviṣaye te ca vikalpāv iti param api pratyakṣaṃ vikalpa evety ata āha --- tac ca śruteti|
analyzed: tat yoginām param pratyakṣam asat āropa gandhasya api abhāvāt syāt etat pareṇa pratyakṣeṇa artha tattvam gṛhītvā yoginaḥ upadiśanti upapādayanti ca katham ca a tad viṣayābhyām āgama parārtha anumānābhyām saḥ ūrthaḥ upadiśyate upapādyate ca tasmāt āgama anumāne tad viṣaye te ca vikalpau iti param api pratyakṣam vikalpaḥ eva iti atas āha tat ca śruta iti

original: yadi hi savitarkam iva śrutānumānasahabhūtaṃ tadanuṣaktaṃ syād bhavet saṃkīrṇaṃ tayos tu bījam evaitat tato hi śrutānumāne prabhavataḥ| na ca yad yasya kāraṇaṃ tat tadviṣayaṃ bhavati| na hi dhūmajñānaṃ vahnijñānakāraṇam iti vahniviṣayam| tasmād avikalpena pratyakṣeṇa gṛhītvā vikalpyopadiśanti copapādayanti ca| upasaṃharati --- tasmād iti|
analyzed: yadi hi sa vitarkam iva śruta anumāna sahabhūtam tad anuṣaktam syāt bhavet saṃkīrṇam tayoḥ tu bījam eva etat tatas hi śruta anumāne prabhavataḥ na ca yat yasya kāraṇam tat tad viṣayam bhavati na hi dhūma jñānam vahni jñāna kāraṇam iti vahni viṣayam tasmāt avikalpena pratyakṣeṇa gṛhītvā vikalpya upadiśanti ca upapādayanti ca upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: vyākhyeyaṃ sūtraṃ yojayati --- nirvitarkāyā iti| smṛtipariśuddhāv ityādi sūtram| śabdasaṃketaś ca śrutaṃ cānumānaṃ ca teṣāṃ jñānam eva vikalpas tasmāt smṛtis tasyāḥ pariśuddhir apagamas tasyām| tatra ca saṃketasmṛtipariśuddhir hetuḥ| śrutānumānasmṛtipariśuddhiś ca hetumatī| anumānaśabdaś ca karmasādhano'numeyavācakaḥ|
analyzed: vyākhyeyam sūtram yojayati nirvitarkāyāḥ iti smṛti pariśuddhau ityādi sūtram śabda saṃketaḥ ca śrutam ca anumānam ca teṣām jñānam eva vikalpaḥ tasmāt smṛtiḥ tasyāḥ pariśuddhiḥ apagamaḥ tasyām tatra ca saṃketa smṛti pariśuddhiḥ hetuḥ śruta anumāna smṛti pariśuddhiḥ ca hetumatī anumāna śabdaḥ ca karma sādhana unumeya vācakaḥ

original: svam ivetīvakāro bhinnakramas tyaktvetipadānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| viṣayavipratipattiṃ nirākaroti --- tasyā eketi| ekāṃ buddhim upakramata ārabhata ity ekabuddhyupakramaḥ| tad anena paramāṇavo nānātmāno na nirvitarkaviṣayā ity uktaṃ bhavati| yogyatve'pi teṣāṃ paramasūkṣmāṇāṃ nānābhūtānāṃ mahattvaikārthasamavetaikatvanirbhāsapratyayaviṣayatvāyogāt|
analyzed: svam iva iti ivakāraḥ bhinnakramaḥ tyaktvā iti pada anantaram draṣṭavyaḥ viṣaya vipratipattim nirākaroti tasyāḥ ekā iti ekām buddhim upakramate ārabhate iti eka buddhi upakramaḥ tat anena paramāṇavaḥ nānā ātmānaḥ na nirvitarka viṣayāḥ iti uktam bhavati yogya tve pi teṣām parama sūkṣmāṇām nānā bhūtānām mahat tva eka artha samaveta eka tva nirbhāsa pratyaya viṣaya tva ayogāt

original: astu tarhi paramārthasatsu paramāṇuṣu sāṃvṛtaḥ pratibhāsadharmaḥ sthaulyam ity ata āha --- arthātmeti| nāsati bādhake sthūlam anubhavasiddhaṃ śakyāpahnavam iti bhāvaḥ| tatra ye paśyanti dvyaṇukādikrameṇa goghaṭādaya upajāyanta iti tān pratyāha --- aṇupracayeti|
analyzed: astu tarhi paramārtha satsu paramāṇuṣu sāṃvṛtaḥ pratibhāsa dharmaḥ sthaulyam iti atas āha artha ātmā iti na asati bādhake sthūlam anubhava siddham śakya apahnavam iti bhāvaḥ tatra ye paśyanti dvyaṇuka ādi krameṇa go ghaṭa ādayaḥ upajāyante iti tān pratyāha aṇu pracaya iti

original: aṇūnāṃ pracayaḥ sthūlarūpapariṇāmaḥ, sa ca viśiṣyate'nyasmāt pariṇāmāntarāt sa evātmā svarūpaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| gavādir bhogāyatanam| ghaṭādir viṣayaḥ| tac caitad ubhayam api lokyata iti lokaḥ| nanv eṣa bhūtasūkṣmebhyo bhinno'bhinno vā syād bhinnaś cet kathaṃ tadāśrayaḥ kathaṃ ca tadākāraḥ| na hi ghaṭaḥ paṭād anyas tadākāras tadāśrayo vā|
analyzed: aṇūnām pracayaḥ sthūla rūpa pariṇāmaḥ sa ca viśiṣyate nyasmāt pariṇāma antarāt saḥ eva ātmā svarūpam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ gavādiḥ bhogāyatanam ghaṭa ādiḥ viṣayaḥ tat ca etat ubhayam api lokyate iti lokaḥ nanu eṣa bhūta sūkṣmebhyaḥ bhinnaḥ bhinnaḥ vā syāt bhinnaḥ ced katham tad āśrayaḥ katham ca tad ākāraḥ na hi ghaṭaḥ paṭāt anyaḥ tad ākāraḥ tad āśrayaḥ vā

original: abhinnaś cet tadvad eva sūkṣmo'sādhāraṇaś ca syād ata āha --- sa ceti| ayam abhiprāyaḥ --- naikāntataḥ paramāṇubhyo bhinno ghaṭādir abhinno vā, bhinnatve gavāśvavad dharmadharmibhāvānupapatteḥ| abhinnatve dharmirūpavad eva tadanupapatteḥ| tasmāt kathaṃcid bhinnaḥ kathaṃcid abhinnaś cāstheyas tathā ca sarvam upapadyate|
analyzed: abhinnaḥ ced tadvat eva sūkṣmaḥ usādhāraṇaḥ ca syāt atas āha sa ca iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ na ekāntataḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ bhinnaḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ abhinnaḥ vā bhinna tve gavāśva vat dharma dharmi bhāva anupapatteḥ abhinna tve dharmi rūpa vat eva tad anupapatteḥ tasmāt kathaṃcid bhinnaḥ kathaṃcid abhinnaḥ ca astheyaḥ tathā ca sarvam upapadyate

original: bhūtasūkṣmāṇām iti ṣaṣṭhyā kathaṃcid bhedaṃ sūcayati ātmabhūta iti cābhedam| phalena vyaktena tadanubhavalakṣaṇena tadvyavahāralakṣaṇena ca vyaktena vipratipannaṃ pratyanumāpitaḥ| kāraṇābhede ca kāraṇākāratopapannety āha --- svavyañjakāñjana iti| sa kiṃ tadātmabhūto dharmo nityo nety āha --- dharmāntarasya kapālāder udaya iti|
analyzed: bhūta sūkṣmāṇām iti ṣaṣṭhyā kathaṃcid bhedam sūcayati ātma bhūtaḥ iti ca abhedam phalena vyaktena tad anubhava lakṣaṇena tad vyavahāra lakṣaṇena ca vyaktena vipratipannam pratyanumāpitaḥ kāraṇa abhede ca kāraṇa ākāra tā upapannā iti āha sva vyañjaka añjanaḥ iti sa kim tad ātma bhūtaḥ dharmaḥ nityaḥ na iti āha dharma antarasya kapāla ādeḥ udayaḥ iti

original: tasyāvayavinaḥ paramāṇubhyo vyāvṛttaṃ rūpam ādarśayati --- sa eṣa iti| paramāṇusādhyāyāḥ kriyāyā anyā kriyā madhūdakādidhāraṇalakṣaṇā taddharmaka iti| na kevalam anubhavād api tu vyavahārato'pi tannibandhanatvāl lokayātrāyā ity āha --- teneti| syād etad asati bādhake'nubhavo 'vayavinaṃ vyavasthāpayet|
analyzed: tasya avayavinaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ vyāvṛttam rūpam ādarśayati saḥ eṣaḥ iti paramāṇu sādhyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ anyā kriyā madhu udaka ādi dhāraṇa lakṣaṇā tad dharmakaḥ iti na kevalam anubhavāt api tu vyavahārataḥ api tad nibandhana tvāt lokayātrāyāḥ iti āha tena iti syāt etat asati vayavinam vyavasthāpayet

original: asti ca bādhakaṃ yat sat tat sarvam anavayavaṃ yathā vijñānam| sac ca goghaṭādīti svabhāvahetuḥ| sattvaṃ hi viruddhadharmasaṃsargarahitatvena vyāptaṃ, tadviruddhaś ca viruddhadharmasaṃsargaḥ sāvayava upalabhyamāno vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhyā sattvam api nivartayati|
analyzed: asti ca bādhakam yat sat tat sarvam anavayavam yathā vijñānam sat ca go ghaṭa ādi iti svabhāva hetuḥ sattvam hi viruddha dharma saṃsarga rahita tvena vyāptam tad viruddhaḥ ca viruddha dharma saṃsargaḥ sāvayavaḥ upalabhyamānaḥ vyāpaka viruddha upalabdhyā sattvam api nivartayati

original: asti cāvayavini taddeśatvātaddeśatvāvṛtatvānāvṛtatvaraktatvāraktatvacalatvācalatvalakṣaṇo viruddhadharmasaṃsarga ity ata āha --- yasya punar iti| ayam abhiprāyaḥ --- anubhavasiddhaṃ sattvaṃ hetuḥ kriyate yat kila pāṃśulapāduko hāliko'pi pratipadyate| anyad vānubhavasiddhāt| tatrānyad asiddhatvād ahetuḥ|
analyzed: asti ca avayavini tad deśa tva a tad deśa tva āvṛta tva an āvṛta tva rakta tva ārakta tva calatva acalatva lakṣaṇaḥ viruddha dharma saṃsargaḥ iti atas āha yasya punar iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ anubhava siddham sattvam hetuḥ kriyate yat kila pāṃśula pādukaḥ hālikaḥ api pratipadyate anyat vā anubhava siddhāt tatra anyat asiddha tvāt ahetuḥ

original: anubhavasiddhaṃ tu ghaṭādīnāṃ sattvam arthakriyākāritvarūpaṃ na sthūlād anyat| so'yaṃ hetuḥ sthūlatvam apākurvann ātmānam eva vyāhanti| nanu na sthūlatvam eva sattvam api tv asato vyāvṛttiḥ| asthaulyavyāvṛttiś ca sthaulyaṃ, vyāvartyabhedāc ca vyāvṛttayo bhidyante| ataḥ sthaulyābhāve'pi na sattvavyāhatiḥ| anyatvāt|
analyzed: anubhava siddham tu ghaṭa ādīnām sattvam arthakriyā kāri tva rūpam na sthūlāt anyat saḥ ayam hetuḥ sthūla tvam apākurvan ātmānam eva vyāhanti nanu na sthūla tvam eva sattvam api tu asataḥ vyāvṛttiḥ a sthaulya vyāvṛttiḥ ca sthaulyam vyāvartya bhedāt ca vyāvṛttayaḥ bhidyante atas sthaulya abhāve api na sattva vyāhatiḥ anyatvāt

original: bhavatu vā vyāvṛttibhedād avasāyaviṣayabhedaḥ| yatpūrvakās tv avasāyās tasyānubhavasyāvikalpasya pramāṇasya ko viṣaya iti nirūpayatu bhavān rūpaparamāṇavo nirantarotpādā agṛhītaparamasūkṣmatattvā iti cet, hantaite gandharasasparśaparamāṇubhir antaritā na nirantarāḥ|
analyzed: bhavatu vā vyāvṛtti bhedāt avasāya viṣaya bhedaḥ yad pūrvakāḥ tu avasāyāḥ tasya anubhavasya avikalpasya pramāṇasya kaḥ viṣayaḥ iti nirūpayatu bhavān rūpa paramāṇavaḥ nirantara utpādāḥ agṛhīta parama sūkṣma tattvāḥ iti ced hanta ete gandha rasa sparśa paramāṇubhiḥ antaritāḥ na nirantarāḥ

original: tasmād antarālāgraha ekaghanavanapratyayavat paramāṇvālambanaḥ sann ayaṃ vikalpo mithyeti tatprabhavavikalpā na pāramparyeṇāpi vastupratibaddhā iti kutas tadavasitasya sattvasyānavayavatvasādhakatvam| tasmād avikalpasya pratyakṣasya prāmāṇyam icchatā tadanubhūyamānasthaulyasyaiva sattvam avikalpāvaseyam akāmenāpy abhyupeyam|
analyzed: tasmāt antarāla āgrahaḥ eka ghana vana pratyaya vat paramāṇu ālambanaḥ san ayam vikalpaḥ mithyā iti tad prabhava vikalpāḥ na pāramparyeṇa api vastu pratibaddhāḥ iti kutas tad avasitasya sattvasya anavayavatva sādhaka tvam tasmāt avikalpasya pratyakṣasya prāmāṇyam icchatā tad anubhūyamāna sthaulyasya eva sattvam a vikalpa avaseyam akāmena api abhyupeyam

original: tathā ca tadbādhamānaṃ sattvam ātmānam evāpabādheta| paramasūkṣmāḥ paramāṇavo vijātīyaparamāṇvanantaritā anubhavaviṣayā iti vyāhatam aṅgīkaraṇam| tad idam uktaṃ --- yasya punar avastukaḥ sa pracayaviśeṣo nirvikalpaviṣayaḥ| santu tarhi sūkṣmāḥ paramāṇavo nirvikalpaviṣayā ity ata āha --- sūkṣmaṃ ca kāraṇam anupalabhyam avikalpasyeti|
analyzed: tathā ca tat bādhamānam sattvam ātmānam eva apabādheta parama sūkṣmāḥ paramāṇavaḥ vijātīya paramāṇu anantaritāḥ anubhava viṣayāḥ iti vyāhatam aṅgīkaraṇam tat idam uktam yasya punar avastukaḥ sa pracaya viśeṣaḥ nirvikalpa viṣayaḥ santu tarhi sūkṣmāḥ paramāṇavaḥ nirvikalpa viṣayāḥ iti atas āha sūkṣmam ca kāraṇam anupalabhyam avikalpasya iti

original: tasyāvayavyabhāvād dhetor atadrūpapratiṣṭhaṃ mithyājñānam iti lakṣaṇena sarvam evaṃ (eva) prāptaṃ mithyājñānaṃ yat sthaulyālambanaṃ yac ca tadadhiṣṭhānasattvālambanam ity arthaḥ| nanv etāvatāpi na jñānam ātmani mithyā bhavati tasyāvayavitvenāprakāśād ity ata āha --- prāyeṇeti| nanu kim etāvatāpīty ata āha --- tadā ceti|
analyzed: tasya avayavi abhāvāt hetoḥ a tad rūpa pratiṣṭham mithyājñānam iti lakṣaṇena sarvam evam eva prāptam mithyājñānam yat sthaulya ālambanam yat ca tad adhiṣṭhāna sattva ālambanam iti arthaḥ nanu etāvatā api na jñānam ātmani mithyā bhavati tasya avayavi tvena aprakāśāt iti atas āha prāyeṇa iti nanu kim etāvatā api iti atas āha tadā ca iti

original: sattvādijñānaṃ cen mithyā tadā sattvādihetukam anavayavitvādijñānam api mithyaiva tasyāpi hi nirvikalpagocarasthūlam evāvaseyatayā viṣayaḥ, sa ca nāstīti tātparyārthaḥ| viṣayābhāva eva kuta ity ata āha --- yad yad iti| virodhaś ca pariṇāmavaicitryeṇa bhedābhedena coktopapattyanusāreṇoddhartavya iti sarvaṃ ramaṇīyam||1.43||

analyzed: etayā eva sa vicārā nirvicārā ca sūkṣma viṣayā vyākhyātāḥ abhivyaktaḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ dharmaḥ yaiḥ te tathā uktāḥ ghaṭa ādi dharma upagṛhītāḥ iti yāvat deśaḥ upari adhas pārśva ādiḥ kālaḥ vartamānaḥ nimittam pārthivasya paramāṇoḥ gandha tanmātra pradhānebhyaḥ pañca tanmātrebhyaḥ utpattiḥ

original: tad idaṃ nimittaṃ bhūtasūkṣmāṇām|) eteṣāṃ deśakālanimittānām anubhavaḥ, tenāvacchinneṣu nānanubhūtaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhir upajāyata ity arthaḥ| nanu savitarkayā saha kiṃ sārūpyaṃ savicārāyā ity ata āha --- tan nāpīti| pārthivo hi paramāṇuḥ pañcatanmātrapracayātmaikabuddhinirgrāhyaḥ|
analyzed: tat idam nimittam bhūta sūkṣmāṇām eteṣām deśa kāla nimittānām anubhavaḥ tena avacchinneṣu na ananubhūta viśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhiḥ upajāyate iti arthaḥ nanu sa vitarkayā saha kim sārūpyam sa vicārāyāḥ iti atas āha tat na api iti pārthivaḥ hi paramāṇuḥ pañca tanmātra pracaya ātmā eka buddhi nirgrāhyaḥ

original: evam āpyādayo'pi catustridvyekatanmātrātmāna ekabuddhinirgrāhyā vedvyatavyāḥ (veditavyāḥ)| udito vartamāno dharmas tena viśiṣṭam| etāvatā cātra saṃketasmṛtyāgamānumānavikalpānuvedhaḥ sūcitaḥ| na hi pratyakṣeṇa sthūle dṛśyamāne paramāṇavaḥ prakāśante| api tv āgamānumānābhyām| tasmād upapannam asyāḥ saṃkīrṇatvam iti| nirvicārām āha --- yā punar iti|
analyzed: evam āpi ādayaḥ api catur tri dvi eka tanmātra ātmānaḥ eka buddhi nirgrāhyāḥ veditavyāḥ uditaḥ vartamānaḥ dharmaḥ tena viśiṣṭam etāvatā ca atra saṃketa smṛti āgama anumāna vikalpa anuvedhaḥ sūcitaḥ na hi pratyakṣeṇa sthūle dṛśyamāne paramāṇavaḥ prakāśante api tu āgama anumānābhyām tasmāt upapannam asyāḥ saṃkīrṇa tvam iti nirvicārām āha yā punar iti

analyzed: sarvathā sarveṇa nīla pīta ādinā prakāreṇa sarvatas iti sārvavibhaktikaḥ tasiḥ sarvaiḥ deśa kāla nimitta anubhavaiḥ iti arthaḥ tat anena sva rūpeṇa kāla anavacchedaḥ paramāṇūnām iti darśitam nā api tad ārabdha dharma dvāreṇa iti āha śāntāḥ atītāḥ uditāḥ vartamānāḥ a vyapadeśyāḥ bhaviṣyantaḥ dharmāḥ taiḥ anavacchinneṣu

original: anavacchinnā dharmaiḥ paramāṇavaḥ kim asaṃbaddhā eva tair ity ata āha --- sarvadharmānupātiṣv iti| katamena saṃbandhena dharmān anupatanti paramāṇava ity ata āha --- sarvadharmātmakeṣu| kathaṃcid bhedaḥ kathaṃcid abhedo dharmāṇāṃ paramāṇubhya ity arthaḥ| kasmāt punar iyaṃ samāpattir etadviṣayety ata āha --- evaṃsvarūpaṃ hīti|
analyzed: anavacchinnāḥ dharmaiḥ paramāṇavaḥ kim asaṃbaddhāḥ eva taiḥ iti atas āha sarva dharma anupātiṣu iti katamena saṃbandhena dharmān anupatanti paramāṇavaḥ iti atas āha sarva dharma ātmakeṣu kathaṃcid bhedaḥ kathaṃcid abhedaḥ dharmāṇām paramāṇubhyaḥ iti arthaḥ kasmāt punar iyam samāpattiḥ etad viṣayā iti atas āha evaṃsvarūpam hi iti

original: vastutattvagrāhiṇī nātattve pravartata ity arthaḥ| viṣayam abhidhāyāsyāḥ svarūpam āha --- prajñā ceti| saṃkalayya svarūpabhedopayogiviṣayam āha --- tatreti| upasaṃharati --- evam iti| ubhayor ātmanaś ca nirvicārāyāś ceti||1.44||
analyzed: vastu tattva grāhiṇī na atattve pravartate iti arthaḥ viṣayam abhidhāya asyāḥ svarūpam āha prajñā ca iti saṃkalayya svarūpa bheda upayogi viṣayam āha tatra iti upasaṃharati evam iti ubhayoḥ ātmanaḥ ca nirvicārāyāḥ ca iti

original: sūkṣmaviṣayatvaṃ cāliṅgaparyavasānam||1.45||

original: kiṃ bhūtasūkṣma eva grāhyaviṣayā samāpattiḥ samāpyate| na| kiṃ tu --- sūkṣmaviṣayatvaṃ cāliṅgaparyavasānam| pārthivasya paramāṇoḥ saṃbandhinī yā gandhatanmātratā sā samāpatteḥ sūkṣmo viṣayaḥ| evam uttaratrāpi yojyam| liṅgamātraṃ mahattattvaṃ tad dhi layaṃ gacchati pradhāna iti| aliṅgaṃ pradhānaṃ tad dhi na kvacil layaṃ gacchatīty arthaḥ|
analyzed: kim bhūta sūkṣme eva grāhya viṣayā samāpattiḥ samāpyate na kim tu sūkṣma viṣaya tvam ca aliṅga paryavasānam pārthivasya paramāṇoḥ saṃbandhinī yā gandha tanmātra tā sā samāpatteḥ sūkṣmaḥ viṣayaḥ evam uttaratra api yojyam liṅgamātram mahat tattvam tat hi layam gacchati pradhāne iti aliṅgam pradhānam tat hi na kvacid layam gacchati iti arthaḥ

original: aliṅgaparyavasānatvam āha --- na cāliṅgāt param iti| codayati --- nanu puruṣo'pi sūkṣmo nāliṅgam evety arthaḥ| pariharati --- satyam iti| upādānatayā saukṣmyam aliṅga eva nānyatrety arthaḥ| tatra puruṣārthanimittatvān mahadahaṃkārādeḥ puruṣo'pi kāraṇam aliṅgavad iti| kuta evaṃlakṣaṇam aliṅgasyaiva saukṣmyam ity āśayavān pṛcchati --- kiṃ tv iti|
analyzed: aliṅga paryavasāna tvam āha na ca aliṅgāt param iti codayati nanu puruṣaḥ api sūkṣmaḥ na aliṅgam eva iti arthaḥ pariharati satyam iti upādānatayā saukṣmyam aliṅge eva na anyatra iti arthaḥ tatra puruṣa artha nimitta tvāt mahat ahaṃkāra ādeḥ puruṣaḥ api kāraṇam aliṅga vat iti kutas evaṃlakṣaṇam aliṅgasya eva saukṣmyam iti āśayavān pṛcchati kim tu iti

original: uttaram āha --- liṅgasyeti| satyaṃ kāraṇaṃ na tūpādānam| yathā hi pradhānaṃ mahadādibhāvena pariṇamate na tathā puruṣas taddhetur apīty arthaḥ| upasaṃharati --- ataḥ pradhāna eva saukṣmyaṃ niratiśayaṃ vyākhyātam||1.45||
analyzed: uttaram āha liṅgasya iti satyam kāraṇam na tu upādānam yathā hi pradhānam mahat ādi bhāvena pariṇamate na tathā puruṣaḥ tad hetuḥ api iti arthaḥ upasaṃharati atas pradhāne eva saukṣmyam niratiśayam vyākhyātam

original: tā eva sabījaḥ samādhiḥ||1.46||

original: catasṛṇām api samāpattīnāṃ grāhyaviṣayāṇāṃ saṃprajñātatvam āha --- tā eva sabījaḥ samādhiḥ| evakāro bhinnakramaḥ sabīja ity asyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| tataś catasraḥ samāpattayo grāhyaviṣayāḥ sabījatayā niyamyante| sabījatā tv aniyatā grahītṛgrahaṇagocarāyām api samāpattau vikalpāvikalpabhedenāniṣiddhā vyavatiṣṭhate|
analyzed: catasṛṇām api samāpattīnām grāhya viṣayāṇām saṃprajñāta tvam āha tāḥ eva sa bījaḥ samādhiḥ eva kāraḥ bhinnakramaḥ sa bījaḥ iti asya anantaram draṣṭavyaḥ tatas catasraḥ samāpattayaḥ grāhya viṣayāḥ sa bīja tayā niyamyante sa bīja tā tu aniyatā grahītṛ grahaṇa gocarāyām api samāpattau vikalpa avikalpa bhedena aniṣiddhā vyavatiṣṭhate

analyzed: tena grāhye catasraḥ samāpattayaḥ grahītṛ grahaṇayoḥ catasraḥ iti aṣṭau siddhāḥ bhavanti iti nigada vyākhyātam bhāṣyam

original: nirvicāravaiśāradye'dhyātmaprasādaḥ||1.47||
analyzed: nirvicāra vaiśāradye ahi ātma prasādaḥ

original: catasṛṣv api samāpattiṣu grāhyaviṣayāsu nirvicārāyāḥ śobhanatvam āha --- nirvicāravaiśāradye'dhyātmaprasādaḥ| vaiśāradyapadārtham āha --- aśuddhīti| rajastamasor upacayo 'śuddhiḥ saivāvaraṇalakṣaṇo malas tasmād apetasya prakāśātmanaḥ prakāśasvabhāvasya buddhisattvasyāta evānabhibhūta iti|
analyzed: catasṛṣu api samāpattiṣu grāhya viṣayāsu nirvicārāyāḥ śobhana tvam āha nirvicāra vaiśāradye ahi ātma prasādaḥ vaiśāradya padārtham āha aśuddhi iti rajaḥ tamasoḥ śuddhiḥ sā eva āvaraṇa lakṣaṇaḥ malaḥ tasmāt apetasya prakāśa ātmanaḥ prakāśa svabhāvasya buddhi sattvasya atas eva anabhibhūtaḥ iti

original: syād etad grāhyaviṣayā cet samāpattiḥ katham ātmaviṣayaḥ prasāda ity ata āha --- bhūtārthaviṣaya iti| nātmaviṣayaḥ kiṃ tu tadādhāra ity arthaḥ| kramānanurodhī yugapad ity arthaḥ| atraiva pāramarṣīṃ gāthām udāharati --- tathā ceti| jñānālokaprakarṣeṇātmānaṃ sarveṣām upari paśyan duḥkhatrayaparītāñ śocato janāñ jānāti||1.47||

original: ṛtaṃbharā tatra prajñā||1.48||

original: buddhisattvaṃ hi prakāśasvabhāvaṃ sarvārthadarśanasamartham api tamasāvṛtaṃ yatraiva rajasodghāṭyate tatraiva gṛhṇāti| yadā tv abhyāsavairāgyābhyām apāstarajastamomalam anavadyavaiśāradyam udyotate tadāsyātipatitasamastamānameyasīmnaḥ prakāśānantye sati kiṃ nāma yan na gocara iti bhāvaḥ|

analyzed: vyācaṣṭe śrutam āgama vijñānam āgama vijñānam tat sāmānya viṣayam kasmāt na hi āgamena śakyaḥ viśeṣaḥ abhidhātum kutas yasmāt ānantyāt vyabhicārāt ca na viśeṣeṇa kṛta saṃketaḥ śabdaḥ yasmāt asya viśeṣeṇa saha vācya vācaka saṃbandhaḥ pratīyeta na ca vākya arthaḥ upīdṛśaḥ viśeṣaḥ saṃbhavati

original: anumāne'pi liṅgaliṅgisaṃbandhagrahaṇādhīnajanmani gatir eṣaivety āha --- tathānumānam iti| yatra prāptir ity atra yatratatraśabdayoḥ sthānaparivartanena vyāpyavyāpakabhāvo 'vagamayitavyaḥ| ato'trānumānena sāmānyenopasaṃhāraḥ| upasaṃharati --- tasmād iti|

analyzed: astu tarhi saṃbandha graha anapekṣam loka pratyakṣam na tat sāmānya viṣayam iti atas āha na ca asya ityādi mā bhūt saṃbandha graha adhīnam loka pratyakṣam indriya adhīnam tu bhavati eva na ca indriyāṇām asmin asti yogyatā iti arthaḥ nanu ca yadi āgama anumāna pratyakṣa agocaraḥ viśeṣaḥ tarhi na asti pramāṇa virahāt iti atas āha na ca iti

original: na hi pramāṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ kāraṇaṃ vā prameyasya yena tannivṛttau nivarteta| no khalu kalāvataś candrasya parabhāgavartihariṇasadbhāvaṃ prati na saṃdihate prāmāṇikā ity arthaḥ| iti tasmāt samādhiprajñānirgrāhya eveti|
analyzed: na hi pramāṇam vyāpakam kāraṇam vā prameyasya yena tad nivṛttau nivarteta no khalu kalāvataḥ candrasya parabhāga varti hariṇa sadbhāvam prati na saṃdihate prāmāṇikāḥ iti arthaḥ iti tasmāt samādhi prajñā nirgrāhyaḥ eva iti

original: atra ca vivādādhyāsitāḥ paramāṇava ātmānaś ca prātisvikaviśeṣaśālino dravyatve sati parasparaṃ vyāvartamānatvād ye dravyatve sati parasparaṃ vyāvartante te prātisvikaviśeṣaśālino yathā khaṇḍamuṇḍādaya ity anumānenāgamena ca ṛtaṃbharaprajñopadeśapareṇa yady api viśeṣo nirūpyate tadanirūpaṇe saṃśayaḥ syān nyāyaprāptatvāt tathāpy adūraviprakarṣeṇa
analyzed: atra ca vivāda adhyāsitāḥ paramāṇavaḥ ātmānaḥ ca prātisvika viśeṣa śālinaḥ dravya tve sati parasparam vyāvartamāna tvāt ye dravya tve sati parasparam vyāvartante te prātisvika viśeṣa śālinaḥ yathā khaṇḍa muṇḍa ādayaḥ iti anumānena āgamena ca ṛtaṃbhara prajñā upadeśa pareṇa yadi api viśeṣaḥ nirūpyate tad anirūpaṇe saṃśayaḥ syāt nyāya prāpta tvāt tathā api adūra viprakarṣeṇa

original: tatsattvaṃ kathaṃcid gocarayataḥ śrutānumāne na tu sākṣāc cārtham iva samuccayādipadāni liṅgasaṃkhyāyogitayā| tasmāt siddhaṃ śrutānumānaprajñābhyām anyaviṣayeti||1.49||
analyzed: tat sattvam kathaṃcid gocarayataḥ śruta anumāne na tu sākṣāt ca artham iva samuccaya ādi padāni liṅga saṃkhyā yogi tayā tasmāt siddham śruta anumāna prajñābhyām anya viṣaya iti

original: tajjaḥ saṃskāro'nyasaṃskārapratibandhī||1.50||
analyzed: tad jaḥ saṃskāraḥ anya saṃskāra pratibandhī

original: syād etat| bhavatu paramārthaviṣayaḥ saṃprajñāto yathoktopāyābhyāsād anādinā tu vyutthānasaṃskāreṇa nirūḍhanibiḍatayā pratibandhanīyā samādhiprajñā sā vātyāvartamadhyavartipradīpaparamāṇur iveti śaṅkām apanetuṃ sūtram avatārayati --- samādhiprajñeti| sūtraṃ paṭhati --- tajjaḥ saṃskāro'nyasaṃskārapratibandhī|
analyzed: syāt etat bhavatu paramārtha viṣayaḥ saṃprajñātaḥ yathā ukta upāya abhyāsāt anādinā tu vyutthāna saṃskāreṇa nirūḍha nibiḍa tayā pratibandhanīyā samādhi prajñā sā vā ati āvarta madhya varti pradīpa paramāṇuḥ iva iti śaṅkām apanetum sūtram avatārayati samādhi prajñā iti sūtram paṭhati tad jaḥ saṃskāraḥ nya saṃskāra pratibandhī

original: tad iti nirvicārāṃ samāpattiṃ parāmṛśati| anyeti vyutthānam āha| bhūtārthapakṣapāto hi dhiyāṃ svabhāvas tāvad eveyam anavasthitā bhrāmyati na yāvat tattvaṃ pratilabhate| tatpratilambhe tatra sthitapadā satī saṃskārabuddhiḥ saṃskārabuddhicakrakrameṇāvartamānānādim apy atattvasaṃskārabuddhikramaṃ bādhata eveti| tathā ca bāhyā apy āhuḥ ---
analyzed: tat iti nirvicārām samāpattim parāmṛśati anyā iti vyutthānam āha bhūta artha pakṣapātaḥ hi dhiyām svabhāvaḥ tāvat eva iyam anavasthitā bhrāmyati na yāvat tattvam pratilabhate tad pratilambhe tatra sthita padā satī saṃskāra buddhiḥ saṃskāra buddhi cakra krameṇa āvartamānā anādim api a tattva saṃskāra buddhi kramam bādhate eva iti tathā ca bāhyāḥ api āhuḥ

original: "nirupadravabhūtārthasvabhāvasya viparyayaiḥ| na bādho'nādimattve 'pi buddhes tatpakṣapātataḥ" iti||
analyzed: nirupadrava bhūta artha svabhāvasya viparyayaiḥ na buddheḥ tad pakṣapātataḥ iti

original: syād etat samādhiprajñāto'stu vyutthānajasya saṃskārasya nirodhaḥ| samādhijas tu saṃskārātiśayaḥ samādhiprajñāprasavahetur asty avikala iti tadavasthaiva cittasya sādhikārateti codayati --- katham asāv iti| pariharati --- na ta iti| cittasya hi kāryadvayaṃ śabdādyupabhhogo vivekakhyātiś ceti| tatra kleśakarmāśayasahitaṃ śabdādyupabhoge vartate|
analyzed: syāt etat samādhi prajñātoḥ tu vyutthāna jasya saṃskārasya nirodhaḥ samādhi jaḥ tu saṃskāra atiśayaḥ samādhi prajñā prasava hetuḥ asti avikalaḥ iti tad avasthā eva cittasya sādhikāra tā iti codayati katham asau iti pariharati na te iti cittasya hi kārya dvayam śabda ādi upabhogaḥ viveka khyātiḥ ca iti tatra kleśa karma āśaya sahitam śabda ādi upabhoge vartate

original: prajñāprabhavasaṃskāronmūlitanikhilakleśakarmāśayasya tu cetaso'vasitaprāyādhikārabhāvasya vivekakhyātimātram avaśiṣyate kāryam| tasmāt samādhisaṃskārāś cittasya na bhogādhikārahetavaḥ pratyuta tatparipanthina iti| svakāryād bhogalakṣaṇād avasādayanti asamarthaṃ kurvantīty arthaḥ|
analyzed: prajñā prabhava saṃskāra unmūlita nikhila kleśa karma āśayasya tu viveka khyāti mātram avaśiṣyate kāryam tasmāt samādhi saṃskārāḥ cittasya na bhoga adhikāra hetavaḥ pratyuta tad paripanthinaḥ iti sva kāryāt bhoga lakṣaṇāt avasādayanti asamartham kurvanti iti arthaḥ

original: kasmāt khyātiparyavasānaṃ hi cittaceṣṭitaṃ, tāvad vibhogāya (dhi bhogāya) cittaṃ ceṣṭate na yāvad vivekakhyātim anubhavati| saṃjātavivekakhyātinas tu kleśanivṛttau na bhogādhikāra ity arthaḥ||1.50||
analyzed: kasmāt khyāti paryavasānam hi citta ceṣṭitam tāvat vibhogāya dhi bhogāya cittam ceṣṭate na yāvat viveka khyātim anubhavati saṃjāta viveka khyātinaḥ tu kleśa nivṛttau na bhoga adhikāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tasyāpi nirodhe sarvanirodhān nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ||1.51||
analyzed: tasya api nirodhe sarva nirodhāt nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ

original: (iti śrīpatañjaliviracitayogasūtreṣu prathamaḥ samādhipādaḥ||1||)
analyzed: iti śrī patañjali viracita yoga sūtreṣu prathamaḥ samādhi pādaḥ

original: tad atra bhogādhikārapraśāntiḥ prayojanaṃ prajñāsaṃskārāṇām ity uktam| pṛcchati --- kiṃ ceti| kiṃ cāsya bhavati prajñāsaṃskāravac cittaṃ prajñāsaṃskārapravāhajanakatayā tathaiva sādhikāram ity adhikārāpanuttaye'nyad api kiṃcid apekṣaṇīyam astīty arthaḥ| sūtreṇottaram āha --- tasyāpi nirodhe sarvanirodhān nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ|
analyzed: tat atra bhoga adhikāra praśāntiḥ prayojanam prajñā saṃskārāṇām iti uktam pṛcchati kim ca iti kim ca asya bhavati prajñā saṃskāravat cittam prajñā saṃskāra pravāha janaka tayā tathā eva sa adhikāram iti adhikāra apanuttaye nyat api kiṃcid apekṣaṇīyam asti iti arthaḥ sūtreṇa uttaram āha tasya api nirodhe sarva nirodhāt nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ

original: pareṇa vairāgyeṇa jñānaprasādamātralakṣaṇena saṃskāropajananadvārā tasyāpi prajñākṛtasaṃskārasya nirodhe, na kevalaṃ prajñāyā ity apiśabdārthaḥ| sarvasyotpadyamānasya saṃskāraprajñāpravāhasya nirodhāt kāraṇābhāvena kāryānutpādāt so'yaṃ nirbījaḥ samādhir bhavati|
analyzed: pareṇa vairāgyeṇa jñāna prasāda mātra lakṣaṇena saṃskāra upajanana dvārā tasya api prajñā kṛta saṃskārasya nirodhe na kevalam prajñāyāḥ iti apiśabda arthaḥ sarvasya utpadyamānasya saṃskāra prajñā pravāhasya nirodhāt kāraṇa abhāvena kārya anutpādāt saḥ ayam nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ bhavati

original: vyācaṣṭe --- sa nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ samādhiprajñāvirodhinaḥ parasmād vairāgyād upajāyamānaḥ svakāraṇadvāreṇa na kevalaṃ samādhiprajñāvirodhī prajñākṛtānām apy asau saṃskārāṇāṃ paripanthī bhavati| nanu vairāgyajaṃ vijñānaṃ sadvijñānaṃ prajñāmātraṃ bādhatāṃ saṃskāraṃ tv avijñānarūpaṃ kathaṃ bādhate|
analyzed: vyācaṣṭe sa nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ samādhi prajñā virodhinaḥ parasmāt vairāgyāt upajāyamānaḥ sva kāraṇa dvāreṇa na kevalam samādhi prajñā virodhī prajñā kṛtānām api asau saṃskārāṇām paripanthī bhavati nanu vairāgya jam vijñānam sat vijñānam prajñā mātram bādhatām saṃskāram tu avijñāna rūpam katham bādhate

original: dṛṣṭā hi jāgrato'pi svapnadṛṣṭārthasmṛtir ity āśayavān pṛcchati --- kasmād iti| uttaraṃ --- nirodhaja iti| nirudhyate'nena prajñeti nirodhaḥ paraṃ vairāgyam| tato jāto nirodhajaḥ saṃskāraḥ| saṃskārād eva dīrghakālanairantaryasatkārāsevitaparavairāgyajanmanaḥ prajñāsaṃskārabādho na tu vijñānād ity arthaḥ| syād etat|
analyzed: dṛṣṭā hi jāgrataḥ api svapna dṛṣṭa artha smṛtiḥ iti āśayavān pṛcchati kasmāt iti uttaram nirodha jaḥ iti nirudhyate enena prajñā iti nirodhaḥ param vairāgyam tatas jātaḥ nirodha jaḥ saṃskāraḥ saṃskārāt eva dīrgha kāla nairantarya satkāra āsevita para vairāgya janmanaḥ prajñā saṃskāra bādhaḥ na tu vijñānāt iti arthaḥ syāt etat

original: nirodhajasaṃskārasadbhāve kiṃ pramāṇaṃ sa hi pratyakṣeṇa vānubhūyeta smṛtyā vā kāryeṇānumīyeta| na ca sarvavṛttinirodhe pratyakṣam asti yoginaḥ| nāpi smṛtiḥ| tasya vṛttimātranirodhatayā smṛtijanakatvāsaṃbhavād ity ata āha --- nirodheti| nirodhe sthitiś cittasya niruddhāvasthety arthaḥ| tasyāḥ kālakramo muhūrtārdhayāmayāmāhorātrādis tadanubhavena|
analyzed: nirodha ja saṃskāra sadbhāve kim pramāṇam sa hi pratyakṣeṇa vā anubhūyeta smṛtyā vā kāryeṇa anumīyeta na ca sarva vṛtti nirodhe pratyakṣam asti yoginaḥ nā api smṛtiḥ tasya vṛtti mātra nirodha tayā smṛti janaka tva asaṃbhavāt iti atas āha nirodha iti nirodhe sthitiḥ cittasya niruddha avasthā iti arthaḥ tasyāḥ kāla kramaḥ muhūrta ardha yāma yāma ahorātra ādiḥ tad anubhavena

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- vairāgyābhyāsaprakarṣānurodhī nirodhaprakarṣo muhūrtārdhayāmādivyāpitayānubhūyate yoginā| na ca vairāgyakṣaṇāḥ kramaniyatatayā parasparam asaṃbhavantas tattatkālavyāpitayā sātiśayaṃ nirodhaṃ kartum īśata iti tattadvairāgyakṣaṇapracayajanyaḥ sthāyī saṃskārapracaya eṣitavya iti bhāvaḥ| nanūcchidyantāṃ prajñāsaṃskārāḥ|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati vairāgya abhyāsa prakarṣa anurodhī nirodha prakarṣaḥ muhūrta ardha yāma ādi vyāpi tayā anubhūyate yoginā na ca vairāgya kṣaṇāḥ krama niyata tayā parasparam asaṃbhavantaḥ tad tad kāla vyāpi tayā sa atiśayam nirodham kartum īśate iti tad tad vairāgya kṣaṇa pracaya janyaḥ sthāyī saṃskāra pracayaḥ eṣitavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu ucchidyantām prajñā saṃskārāḥ

original: nirodhasaṃskārās tu kutaḥ samucchidyante| anucchede vā sādhikāratvam evety ata āha --- vyutthāneti| vyutthānaṃ ca tasya nirodhasamādhiś ca saṃprajñātas tatprabhavāḥ saṃskārāḥ kaivalyabhāgīyā nirodhajāḥ saṃskārā ity arthaḥ| vyutthānaprajñāsaṃskārāś citte pralīnā iti bhavati cittaṃ vyutthānaprajñāsaṃskāravat|
analyzed: nirodha saṃskārāḥ tu kutas samucchidyante anucchede vā sādhikāra tvam eva iti atas āha vyutthāna iti vyutthānam ca tasya nirodha samādhiḥ ca saṃprajñātaḥ tad prabhavāḥ saṃskārāḥ kaivalya bhāgīyāḥ nirodha jāḥ saṃskārāḥ iti arthaḥ vyutthāna prajñā saṃskārāḥ citte pralīnāḥ iti bhavati cittam vyutthāna prajñā saṃskāra vat

original: nirodhasaṃskāras tu pratyudita evāste citte| nirodhasaṃskāre saty api cittam anadhikāravat| puruṣārthajanakaṃ cittaṃ hi sādhikāraṃ śabdādyupabhogavivekakhyātī ca tathā puruṣārthaḥ| saṃskāraśeṣatāyāṃ tu na buddheḥ pratisaṃvedī puruṣa iti nāsau puruṣārthaḥ| videhaprakṛtilayānāṃ na nirodhabhāgitayā sādhikāraṃ cittam|
analyzed: nirodha saṃskāraḥ tu pratyuditaḥ eva āste citte nirodha saṃskāre sati api cittam anadhikāravat puruṣa artha janakam cittam hi sa adhikāram śabda ādi upabhoga viveka khyātī ca tathā puruṣa arthaḥ saṃskāra śeṣa tāyām tu na buddheḥ pratisaṃvedī puruṣaḥ iti na asau puruṣa arthaḥ videha prakṛti layānām na nirodha bhāgi tayā sa adhikāram cittam

original: api tu kleśavāsitatayety āśayavān āha --- yasmād iti| śeṣaṃ sugamam||1.51||
analyzed: api tu kleśa vāsita tayā iti āśayavān āha yasmāt iti śeṣam sugamam

original: yogasyoddeśanirdeśau tadarthaṃ vṛttilakṣaṇam| yogopāyāḥ prabhedāś ca pāde'sminn upavarṇitāḥ||1||
analyzed: yogasya uddeśa nirdeśau tad artham vṛtti lakṣaṇam yoga upāyāḥ prabhedāḥ ca pādesmin upavarṇitāḥ

original: iti śrīvācaspatimiśraviracitāyāṃ pātañjalayogasūtrabhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ prathamaḥ samādhipādaḥ||1||
analyzed: iti śrī vācaspatimiśra viracitāyām pātañjala yoga sūtra bhāṣya vyākhyāyām prathamaḥ samādhi pādaḥ

original: tatra dvitīyaḥ sādhanapādaḥ|
analyzed: tatra dvitīyaḥ sādhana pādaḥ

original: tapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānāni kriyāyogaḥ||2.1||
analyzed: tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni kriyā yogaḥ

original: nanu prathamapādenaiva sopāyaḥ sāvāntaraprabhedaḥ saphalo yoga uktas tat kim aparam avaśiṣyate yadarthaṃ dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ prārabhyetety ata āha --- uddiṣṭa iti| abhyāsavairāgye hi yogopāyau prathame pāda uktau| na ca tau vyutthitacittasya drāg ity eva saṃbhavata iti dvitīyapādopadeśyān upāyān apekṣate sattvaśuddhyartham|
analyzed: nanu prathama pādena eva sa upāyaḥ sa avāntara prabhedaḥ sa phalaḥ yogaḥ uktaḥ tat kim aparam avaśiṣyate yad artham dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ prārabhyeta iti atas āha uddiṣṭaḥ iti abhyāsa vairāgye hi yoga upāyau prathame pāde uktau na ca tau vyutthita cittasya drāk iti eva saṃbhavataḥ iti dvitīya pāda upadeśyān upāyān apekṣate sattva śuddhi artham

original: tato hi viśuddhasattvaḥ kṛtarakṣāsaṃvidhāno'bhyāsavairāgye pratyahaṃ bhāvayati| samāhitatvam avikṣiptatvam| kathaṃ vyutthānacitto'py upadekṣyamāṇair upāyair yuktaḥ san yogī syād ity arthaḥ| tatra vakṣyamāṇeṣu niyameṣv ākṛṣya prāthamikaṃ pratyupayuktataratayā prathamataḥ kriyāyogam upadiśati sūtrakāraḥ --- tapaḥsvādhyāyetyādi|
analyzed: tatas hi viśuddha sattvaḥ kṛta rakṣā saṃvidhāna ubhyāsa vairāgye pratyaham bhāvayati samāhita tvam avikṣipta tvam katham vyutthāna cittaḥ api upadekṣyamāṇaiḥ upāyaiḥ yuktaḥ san yogī syāt iti arthaḥ tatra vakṣyamāṇeṣu niyameṣu ākṛṣya prāthamikam pratyupayuktatara tayā prathamatas kriyā yogam upadiśati sūtrakāraḥ tapaḥ svādhyāya ityādi

original: kriyaiva yogaḥ kriyāyogo yogasādhanatvāt| ata eva viṣṇupurāṇe khāṇḍikyakeśidhvajasaṃvāde ---
analyzed: kriyā eva yogaḥ kriyāyogaḥ yoga sādhana tvāt atas eva viṣṇupurāṇe khāṇḍikya keśidhvaja saṃvāde

original: "yogayuk prathamaṃ yogī yuñjamāno'bhidhīyate"
analyzed: yoga yuj prathamam yogī yuñjamānaḥ abhidhīyate

original: ity upakramya tapaḥsvādhyāyādayo darśitāḥ| vyatirekamukhena (vyatirekamukheṇa) tapasa upāyatvam āha --- nātapasvina iti| tapaso'vāntaravyāpāram upāyatopayoginaṃ darśayati --- anādīti| anādibhyāṃ karmakleśavāsanābhyāṃ citrāta eva pratyupasthitam upanataṃ viṣayajālaṃ yasyāṃ sā tathoktā| aśuddhī rajastamaḥsamudreko nāntareṇa tapaḥ saṃbhedam āpadyate|
analyzed: iti upakramya tapaḥ svādhyāya ādayaḥ darśitāḥ vyatireka mukhena vyatireka mukheṇa tapasaḥ upāya tvam āha na atapasvinaḥ iti tapasaḥ uvāntara vyāpāram upāya tā upayoginam darśayati anādi iti anādibhyām karma kleśa vāsanābhyām citrātaḥ eva pratyupasthitam upanatam viṣaya jālam yasyām sā tathā uktā aśuddhī rajaḥ tamaḥ samudrekaḥ na antareṇa tapaḥ saṃbhedam āpadyate

original: sāndrasya nitāntaviralatā saṃbhedaḥ| nanūpādīyamānam api tapo dhātuvaiṣamyahetutayā yogapratipakṣa iti kathaṃ tadupāya ity ata āha --- tac ceti| tāvanmātram eva tapaś caraṇīyaṃ na yāvatā dhātuvaiṣamyam āpadyata ity arthaḥ| praṇavādayaḥ puruṣasūktarudramaṇḍalabrāhmaṇādayo vaidikāḥ, paurāṇikāś ca brahmapārāyaṇādayaḥ|
analyzed: sāndrasya nitānta virala tā saṃbhedaḥ nanu upādīyamānam api tapaḥ dhātu vaiṣamya hetutayā yoga pratipakṣaḥ iti katham tad upāyaḥ iti atas āha tat ca iti tāvat mātram eva tapaḥ caraṇīyam na yāvatā dhātu vaiṣamyam āpadyate iti arthaḥ praṇava ādayaḥ puruṣasūkta rudra maṇḍala brāhmaṇa ādayaḥ vaidikāḥ paurāṇikāḥ ca brahma pārāyaṇa ādayaḥ

original: tatphalasaṃnyāso vā phalānabhisaṃdhānena kāryakaraṇam| yatredam uktam ---
analyzed: tad phala saṃnyāsaḥ vā phala an abhisaṃdhānena kārya karaṇam yatra idam uktam

original: "karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana| mā karmaphalahetur bhūr mā te saṅgo'stv akarmaṇi" ||2.1||
analyzed: karmaṇi eva adhikāraḥ te mā phaleṣu kadācana mā karma phala hetuḥ bhūḥ mā te saṅgoḥ tu akarmaṇi

original: samādhibhāvanārthaḥ kleśatanūkaraṇārthaś ca||2.2||
analyzed: samādhi bhāvanā arthaḥ kleśa tanūkaraṇa arthaḥ ca

original: tasya prayojanābhidhānāya sūtram avatārayati --- sa hīti| sūtraṃ --- samādhibhāvanārthaḥ kleśatanūkaraṇārthaś ca| nanu kriyāyoga eva cet kleśān pratanūkaroti kṛtaṃ tarhi prasaṃkhyānenety ata āha --- pratanūkṛtān iti| kriyāyogasya pratanūkaraṇamātre vyāpāro na tu vandhyatve kleśānāṃ prasaṃkhyānasya tu tadvandhyatve|
analyzed: tasya prayojana abhidhānāya sūtram avatārayati sa hi iti sūtram samādhi bhāvanā arthaḥ kleśa tanūkaraṇa arthaḥ ca nanu kriyāyogaḥ eva ced kleśān pratanūkaroti kṛtam tarhi prasaṃkhyānena iti atas āha pratanūkṛtān iti kriyāyogasya pratanūkaraṇa mātre vyāpāraḥ na tu vandhya tve kleśānām prasaṃkhyānasya tu tad vandhya tve

original: dagdhabījakalpān iti vandhyatvena dagdhakalamabījasārūpyam uktam| syād etat| prasaṃkhyānam eva cet kleśān aprasavadharmiṇaḥ kariṣyati, kṛtam eṣāṃ pratanūkaraṇenety ata āha --- teṣām iti| kleśānām atānave hi balavadvirodhigrastā sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātir udetum eva notsahate|
analyzed: dagdha bīja kalpān iti vandhya tvena dagdha kalama bīja sārūpyam uktam syāt etat prasaṃkhyānam eva ced kleśān aprasava dharmiṇaḥ kariṣyati kṛtam eṣām pratanūkaraṇena iti atas āha teṣām iti kleśānām atānave hi balavat virodhi grastā sattva puruṣa anya tā khyātiḥ udetum eva nā utsahate

original: prāg eva tadvandhyabhāvaṃ kartuṃ praviralīkṛteṣu tu kleśeṣu durbaleṣu tadvirodhiny api vairāgyābhyāsābhyām upajāyate| upajātā ca tair aparāmṛṣṭānabhibhūtā naiva yāvat parāmṛśyata iti| sattvapuruṣānyatāmātrakhyātiḥ sūkṣmā prajñātīndriyatayā sūkṣmo'syā viṣaya iti sūkṣmā prajñā pratiprasavāya pravilayāya kalpiṣyate|
analyzed: prāk eva tad vandhya bhāvam kartum praviralīkṛteṣu tu kleśeṣu durbaleṣu tad virodhinī api vairāgya abhyāsābhyām upajāyate upajātā ca taiḥ aparāmṛṣṭā anabhibhūtā na eva yāvat parāmṛśyate iti sattva puruṣa anya tā mātra khyātiḥ sūkṣmā prajñā atīndriya tayā sūkṣmaḥ usyāḥ viṣayaḥ iti sūkṣmā prajñā pratiprasavāya pravilayāya kalpiṣyate

original: kutaḥ, samāptādhikārā yataḥ samāpto'dhikāraḥ kāryārambhaṇaṃ guṇānāṃ yayā hetubhūtayā sā tathokteti||2.2||
analyzed: kutas samāpta adhikārā yatas samāpta udhikāraḥ kārya ārambhaṇam guṇānām yayā hetu bhūtayā sā tathā uktā iti

original: avidyāsmitārāgadveṣābhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ||2.3||
analyzed: avidyā asmitā rāga dveṣa abhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ

original: pṛcchati --- atheti| avidyeti sūtreṇa parihāraḥ| avidyāsmitārāgadveṣābhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- pañca viparyayā iti| avidyā tāvad viparyaya eva| asmitādayo 'py avidyopādānās tadavinirbhāgavartina iti viparyayāḥ| tataś cāvidyāsamucchede teṣām api samucchedo yukta iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: pṛcchati atha iti avidyā iti sūtreṇa parihāraḥ avidyā asmitā rāga dveṣa abhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ vyācaṣṭe pañca viparyayāḥ iti avidyā tāvat viparyayaḥ eva asmitā ādayaḥ pi avidyā upādānāḥ tad avinirbhāga vartinaḥ iti viparyayāḥ tatas ca avidyā samucchede teṣām api samucchedaḥ yuktaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: teṣām ucchettavyatāhetuṃ saṃsārakāraṇatvam āha --- te spandamānāḥ samudācaranto guṇānām adhikāraṃ draḍhayanti balavantaṃ kurvanty ata eva pariṇāmam avasthāpayanti avyaktamahadahaṃkāraparamparayā hi kāryakāraṇasrota unnamayanty udbhāvayanti| yadarthaṃ sarvam etat kurvanti tad darśayati --- paraspareti|
analyzed: teṣām ucchettavya tā hetum saṃsāra kāraṇa tvam āha te spandamānāḥ samudācarantaḥ guṇānām adhikāram draḍhayanti balavantam kurvanti atas eva pariṇāmam avasthāpayanti avyakta mahat ahaṃkāra paramparayā hi kārya kāraṇa srotaḥ unnamayanti udbhāvayanti yad artham sarvam etat kurvanti tat darśayati paraspara iti

original: karmaṇāṃ vipāko jātyāyurbhogalakṣaṇaḥ puruṣārthas tam amī kleśā abhinirharanti niṣpādayanti| kiṃ pratyekaṃ nety āha --- parasparānugraheti| karmabhiḥ kleśāḥ kleśaiś ca karmāṇīti||2.3||
analyzed: karmaṇām vipākaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhoga lakṣaṇaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ tam amī kleśāḥ abhinirharanti niṣpādayanti kim pratyekam na iti āha paraspara anugraha iti karmabhiḥ kleśāḥ kleśaiḥ ca karmāṇi iti

original: avidyā kṣetram uttareṣāṃ prasuptatanuvicchinnodārāṇām||2.4||
analyzed: avidyā kṣetram uttareṣām prasupta tanu vicchinna udārāṇām

original: heyānāṃ kleśānām avidyāmūlatvaṃ darśayati --- avidyā kṣetram uttareṣāṃ prasuptatanuvicchinnodārāṇām| tatra kā prasuptir iti| svocitām arthakriyām akurvatāṃ kleśānāṃ sadbhāve na pramāṇam astīty abhiprāyaḥ pṛcchataḥ| uttaraṃ --- cetasīti| mā nāmārthakriyāṃ kārṣuḥ kleśā videhaprakṛtilayānāṃ bījabhāvaṃ prāptās tu te śaktimātreṇa santi kṣīra iva dadhi|
analyzed: heyānām kleśānām avidyā mūla tvam darśayati avidyā kṣetram uttareṣām prasupta tanu vicchinna udārāṇām tatra kā prasuptiḥ iti svocitām arthakriyām akurvatām kleśānām sadbhāve na pramāṇam asti iti abhiprāyaḥ pṛcchataḥ uttaram cetasi iti mā nāma arthakriyām kārṣuḥ kleśāḥ videha prakṛti layānām bīja bhāvam prāptāḥ tu te śakti mātreṇa santi kṣīre iva dadhi

original: na hi vivekakhyāter anyad asti kāraṇaṃ tadvandhyatāyām| ato videhaprakṛtilayā vivekakhyātivirahiṇaḥ prasuptakleśā na yāvat tadavadhikālaṃ prāpnuvanti| tatprāptau tu punarāvṛttāḥ santaḥ kleśās teṣu teṣu viṣayeṣu saṃmukhībhavanti| śaktimātreṇa pratiṣṭhā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| tad anenotpattiśaktir uktā| bījabhāvopagama iti ca kāryaśaktir iti|
analyzed: na hi viveka khyāteḥ anyat asti kāraṇam tat vandhya tāyām atas videha prakṛti layāḥ viveka khyāti virahiṇaḥ prasupta kleśāḥ na yāvat tad avadhi kālam prāpnuvanti tad prāptau tu punar āvṛttāḥ santaḥ kleśāḥ teṣu teṣu viṣayeṣu saṃmukhībhavanti śakti mātreṇa pratiṣṭhā yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ tat anena utpatti śaktiḥ uktā bīja bhāva upagamaḥ iti ca kārya śaktiḥ iti

original: nanu vivekakhyātimato'pi kleśāḥ kasmān na prasuptā ity ata āha --- prasaṃkhyānavata iti| caramadeho na tasya dehāntaram utpatsyate yadapekṣayāsya dehaḥ pūrva ity arthaḥ| nānyatra videhādiṣv ity arthaḥ| nanu sato nātyantavināśa iti kim iti tadīyayogarddhibalena viṣayasaṃmukhībhāve na kleśāḥ prabudhyanta ity ata āha --- satām iti|
analyzed: nanu viveka khyātimataḥ api kleśāḥ kasmāt na prasuptāḥ iti atas āha prasaṃkhyānavataḥ iti carama dehaḥ na tasya deha antaram utpatsyate yad apekṣayā asya dehaḥ pūrvaḥ iti arthaḥ na anyatra videha ādiṣu iti arthaḥ nanu sataḥ na atyanta vināśaḥ iti kim iti tadīya yoga ṛddhi balena viṣaya saṃmukhībhāve na kleśāḥ prabudhyante iti atas āha satām iti

original: santu kleśā dagdhas tv eṣāṃ prasaṃkhyānāgninā bījabhāva ity arthaḥ| kleśapratipakṣaḥ kriyāyogas tasya bhāvanam anuṣṭhānaṃ tenopahatās tanavaḥ| athavā samyagjñānam avidyāyāḥ pratipakṣo bhedadarśanam asmitāyā mādhyasthyaṃ rāgadveṣayor anubandhabuddhinivṛttir abhiniveśasyeti| vicchittim āha --- tatheti|
analyzed: santu kleśāḥ dagdhaḥ tu eṣām prasaṃkhyāna agninā bīja bhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ kleśa pratipakṣaḥ kriyā yogaḥ tasya bhāvanam anuṣṭhānam tena upahatāḥ tanavaḥ athavā samyak jñānam avidyāyāḥ pratipakṣaḥ bheda darśanam asmitāyāḥ mādhyasthyam rāga dveṣayoḥ anubandha buddhi nivṛttiḥ abhiniveśasya iti vicchittim āha tathā iti

original: kleśānām anyatamena samudācaratābhibhavād vātyantaviṣayasevayā vā vicchidya vicchidya tena tenātmanā samudācaranty āvirbhavanti vājīkaraṇādyupayogena vābhibhāvakadaurbalyena veti| vīpsayā vicchedasamudācārayoḥ paunaḥpunyaṃ darśayatā yathoktāt prasuptād bheda uktaḥ|
analyzed: kleśānām anyatamena samudācaratā abhibhavāt vā atyanta viṣaya sevayā vā vicchidya vicchidya tena tena ātmanā samudācaranti āvirbhavanti vājīkaraṇa ādi upayogena vā abhibhāvaka daurbalyena vā iti vīpsayā viccheda samudācārayoḥ paunaḥpunyam darśayatā yathā uktāt prasuptāt bhedaḥ uktaḥ

original: rāgeṇa vā samudācaratā vijātīyaḥ krodho'bhibhūyate sajātīyena vā viṣayāntaravartinā rāgeṇaiva viṣayāntaravartī rāgo'bhibhūyata ity āha --- rāgeti| bhaviṣyadvṛttes trayī gatir yathāyogaṃ veditavyety āha --- sa hīti| bhaviṣyadvṛttikleśamātraparāmarśi sarvanāma na caitrarāgaparāmarśi tasya vicchinnatvād eveti| udāram āha --- viṣaya iti|
analyzed: rāgeṇa vā samudācaratā vijātīyaḥ krodhaḥ abhibhūyate sajātīyena vā viṣaya antara vartinā rāgeṇa eva viṣaya antara vartī rāgaḥ abhibhūyate iti āha rāga iti bhaviṣyat vṛtteḥ trayī gatiḥ yathāyogam veditavyā iti āha sa hi iti bhaviṣyat vṛtti kleśa mātra parāmarśi sarva nāma na caitra rāga parāmarśi tasya vicchinna tvāt eva iti udāram āha viṣayaḥ iti

original: nanūdāra eva puruṣān kliśnātīti bhavatu kleśo'nye tv akliśnantaḥ kathaṃ kleśā ity ata āha --- sarva evaita iti| kleśaviṣayatvaṃ kleśapadavācyatvaṃ nātikrāmanty udāratām āpadyamānāḥ| ata eva te'pi heyā iti bhāvaḥ| kleśatvenaikatāṃ manyamānaś codayati --- kas tarhīti|
analyzed: nanu udāraḥ eva puruṣān kliśnāti iti bhavatu kleśaḥ nye tu a kliśnantaḥ katham kleśāḥ iti atas āha sarve eva ete iti kleśa viṣaya tvam kleśa pada vācya tvam na atikrāmanti udāra tām āpadyamānāḥ atas eva te api heyāḥ iti bhāvaḥ kleśa tvena ekatām manyamānaḥ codayati kaḥ tarhi iti

original: kleśatvena samānatve'pi yathoktāvasthābhedād viśeṣa iti pariharati --- ucyate satyam iti| syād etat| avidyāto bhavantu kleśāḥ, tathāpy avidyānivṛttau kasmān nivartante| na khalu paṭaḥ kuvindanivṛttau nivartata ity ata āha --- sarva eveti| bhedā iva bhedās tadavinirbhāgavartina iti yāvat| pṛcchati --- kasmāt| uttaraṃ --- sarveṣv iti|
analyzed: kleśa tvena samāna tve api yathā ukta avasthā bhedāt viśeṣaḥ iti pariharati ucyate satyam iti syāt etat avidyātaḥ bhavantu kleśāḥ tathā api avidyā nivṛttau kasmāt nivartante na khalu paṭaḥ kuvinda nivṛttau nivartate iti atas āha sarve eva iti bhedāḥ iva bhedāḥ tad avinirbhāga vartinaḥ iti yāvat pṛcchati kasmāt uttaram sarveṣu iti

original: tad eva sphuṭayati --- yad iti| ākāryate samāropyate| śeṣaṃ sugamam|
analyzed: tat eva sphuṭayati yat iti ākāryate samāropyate śeṣam sugamam

original: "prasuptās tattvalīnānāṃ tanvavasthāś ca yoginām| vicchinnodārarūpāś ca kleśā viṣayasaṅginām" iti saṃgrahaḥ||2.4||
analyzed: prasuptāḥ tattva līnānām tanu avasthāḥ ca yoginām vicchinna udāra rūpāḥ ca kleśāḥ viṣaya saṅginām iti saṃgrahaḥ

original: anityāśuciduḥkhānātmasu nityaśucisukhātmakhyātir avidyā||2.5||
analyzed: anitya aśuci duḥkha anātmasu nitya śuci sukha ātma khyātiḥ avidyā

original: anityāśuciduḥkhānātmasu nityaśucisukhātmakhyātir avidyā| anityatvopayogiviśeṣaṇaṃ --- kārya iti| kecit kila bhūtāni nityatvenābhimanyamānās tadrūpam abhīpsavas tāny evopāsate| evaṃ dhūmādimārgān upāsate candrasūryatārakādyulokān nityān abhimanyamānās tatprāptaye| evaṃ divaukaso devān amṛtān abhimanyamānās tabhāvāya somaṃ pibanti|
analyzed: anitya aśuci duḥkha anātmasu nitya śuci sukha ātma khyātiḥ avidyā anitya tva upayogi viśeṣaṇam kāryaḥ iti kecid kila bhūtāni nitya tvena abhimanyamānāḥ tad rūpam abhīpsavaḥ tāni eva upāsate evam dhūma ādi mārgān upāsate candra sūrya tārakā div lokān nityān abhimanyamānāḥ tad prāptaye evam divaukasaḥ devān amṛtān abhimanyamānāḥ tad bhāvāya somam pibanti

original: āmnāyate hi --- "apāma somam amṛtā abhūma" iti| seyam anityeṣu nityakhyātir avidyā| tathāśucau paramabībhatse kāye| ardhokta eva kāyabībhatsatāyāṃ vaiyāsikīṃ gāthāṃ paṭhati --- sthānād iti| mātur udaraṃ mūtrādyupahataṃ sthānaṃ, pitror lohitaretasīṃ bījam| aśitapītāhārarasādibhāva upaṣṭambhas tena śarīraṃ dhāryate| niḥsyandaḥ prasvedaḥ|
analyzed: āmnāyate hi apāma somam amṛtāḥ abhūma iti sā iyam anityeṣu nitya khyātiḥ avidyā tathā aśucau parama bībhatse kāye ardha ukte eva kāya bībhatsa tāyām vaiyāsikīm gāthām paṭhati sthānāt iti mātuḥ udaram mūtra ādi upahatam sthānam pitroḥ lohita retasīm bījam aśita pīta āhāra rasa ādi bhāvaḥ upaṣṭambhaḥ tena śarīram dhāryate niḥsyandaḥ prasvedaḥ

original: nidhanaṃ ca śrotriyaśarīram apy apavitrayati tatsparśe snānavidhānāt| nanu yadi śarīram aśuci kṛtaṃ tarhi mṛjjalādikṣālanenety ata āha --- ādheyaśaucatvād iti| svabhāvenāśucer api śarīrasya śaucam ādheyaṃ sugandhiteva kāminīnām aṅgarāgādibhiḥ| ardhoktaṃ pūrayati --- ity uktebhyo hetubhyo'śucau śarīra iti| śucikhyātim āha --- naveti|
analyzed: nidhanam ca śrotriya śarīram api apavitrayati tad sparśe snāna vidhānāt nanu yadi śarīram aśuci kṛtam tarhi mṛd jala ādi kṣālanena iti atas āha ādheya śauca tvāt iti svabhāvena aśuceḥ api śarīrasya śaucam ādheyam sugandhi tā iva kāminīnām aṅgarāga ādibhiḥ ardha uktam pūrayati iti uktebhyaḥ hetubhyaḥ śucau śarīre iti śuci khyātim āha nava iti

original: hāvaḥ śṛṅgārajā līlā| kasya strīkāyasya paramabībhatsasya kena mandatamasādṛśyena śaśāṅkalekhādinā saṃbandhaḥ| etenāśucau strīkāye śucikhyātipradarśanena| apuṇye hiṃsādau saṃsāramocakādīnāṃ puṇyapratyayaḥ| evam arjanarakṣaṇādiduḥkhabahulatayānarthe dhanādāv arthapratyayā vyākhyātāḥ sarveṣāṃ jugupsitatvenāśucitvāt| tathā duḥkha iti| sugamam|
analyzed: hāvaḥ śṛṅgāra jā līlā kasya strīkāyasya parama bībhatsasya kena mandatama sādṛśyena śaśāṅka lekhā ādinā saṃbandhaḥ etena aśucau strīkāye śuci khyāti pradarśanena apuṇye hiṃsā ādau saṃsāra mocaka ādīnām puṇya pratyayaḥ evam arjana rakṣaṇa ādi duḥkha bahula tayā anarthe dhana ādau artha pratyayāḥ vyākhyātāḥ sarveṣām jugupsita tvena aśuci tvāt tathā duḥkhe iti sugamam

original: tathānātmanīti| sugamam| tathaitad atroktaṃ pañcaśikhena| vyaktaṃ cetanaṃ putradārapaśvādi| avyaktam acetanaṃ śayyāsanāśanādi| sa sarvo'pratibuddho mūḍhaḥ| catvāri padāni sthānāny asyā iti catuṣpadā| nanv anyāpi diṅmohālātacakrādiviṣayānantapadāvidyā tat kim ucyate catuṣpadety ata āha --- mūlam asyeti|
analyzed: tathā anātmani iti sugamam tathā etat atra uktam pañcaśikhena vyaktam cetanam putra dāra paśu ādi avyaktam acetanam śayyā āsana aśana ādi sa sarva upratibuddhaḥ mūḍhaḥ catvāri padāni sthānāni asyāḥ iti catuṣpadā nanu anyā api diś moha alāta cakra ādi viṣaya ananta pada avidyā tat kim ucyate catuṣpadā iti atas āha mūlam asya iti

original: santu nāmānyā apy avidyāḥ saṃsārabījaṃ tu catuṣpadaiveti| nanv avidyeti nañsamāsaḥ pūrvapadārthapradhāno vā syād yathāmakṣikam iti| uttarapadārthapradhāno vā yathārājapuruṣa iti| anyapadārthapradhāno vā yathāmakṣiko deśa iti| tatra pūrvapadārthapradhānatve vidyāyāḥ prasajyapratiṣedho gamyeta| na cāsyāḥ kleśādikāraṇatvam|
analyzed: santu nāma anyāḥ api avidyāḥ saṃsāra bījam tu catuṣpadā eva iti nanu avidyā iti nañ samāsaḥ pūrva padārtha pradhānaḥ vā syāt yathā amakṣikam iti uttara padārtha pradhānaḥ vā yathā rāja puruṣaḥ iti anya padārtha pradhānaḥ vā yathā amakṣikaḥ deśaḥ iti tatra pūrva padārtha pradhāna tve vidyāyāḥ prasajya pratiṣedhaḥ gamyeta na ca asyāḥ kleśa ādi kāraṇa tvam

original: uttarapadārthapradhānatve vā vidyaiva kasyacid abhāvena viśiṣṭā gamyeta| sā ca kleśādiparipanthinī na tu tadbījam| na hi pradhānopaghātī pradhānaguṇo yuktaḥ| tadanupaghātāya guṇe tv anyāyyakalpanā| tasmād vidyāsvarūpānupaghātāya naño'nyathākaraṇam apy āhāro vā niṣedhyasyeti| anyapadārthapradhānatve tv avidyamānavidyā buddhir vaktavyā|

analyzed: viveka darśane rāga ādīnām vinivṛtteḥ avidyā āpādita asmitā rāga ādīnām nidānam iti asmitā anantaram rāga ādīn lakṣayati sukha anuśayī rāgaḥ anabhijñasya smṛteḥ abhāvāt sukha abhijñasya iti uktam smaryamāṇe sukhe rāgaḥ sukha anusmṛti pūrvakaḥ anubhūyamāne tu sukhe na anusmṛtim apekṣate tad sādhane tu smaryamāṇe dṛśyamāne vā sukha anusmṛti pūrvaḥ eva rāgaḥ

original: svarasavāhī viduṣo'pi tathā rūḍho'bhiniveśaḥ| abhiniveśapadārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe --- sarvasya pāṇina iti| iyam ātmāśīr ātmani prārthanā mā na bhūvaṃ mābhāvī bhūvaṃ bhūyāsaṃ jīvyāsam iti| na cānanubhūtamaraṇadharmakasya, ananubhūto maraṇadharmo yena jantunā na tasyaiṣā bhavaty ātmāśīr abhiniveśo maraṇabhayam|
analyzed: sva rasa vāhī viduṣaḥ api tathā rūḍhaḥ abhiniveśaḥ abhiniveśa padārtham vyācaṣṭe sarvasya pāṇinaḥ iti iyam ātma āśīḥ ātmani prārthanā mā na bhūvam mā bhāvī bhūvam bhūyāsam jīvyāsam iti na ca ananubhūta maraṇa dharmakasya ananubhūtaḥ maraṇa dharmaḥ yena jantunā na tasya eṣā bhavati ātma āśīḥ abhiniveśaḥ maraṇa bhayam

original: prasaṅgato janmāntaraṃ pratyācakṣāṇaṃ nāstikaṃ nirākaroti --- etayā ceti| pratyuditasya śarīrasya dhriyamāṇatvāt pūrvajanmānubhavaḥ pratīyate| nikāyaviśiṣṭābhir apūrvābhir dehendriyabuddhivedanābhir abhisaṃbandho janma tasyānubhavaḥ prāptiḥ sā pratīyate katham ity ata āha --- sa cāyam abhiniveśaḥ| ardhoktāv evāsya kleśatvam āha --- kleśa iti|
analyzed: prasaṅgataḥ janmāntaram pratyācakṣāṇam nāstikam nirākaroti etayā ca iti pratyuditasya śarīrasya dhriyamāṇa tvāt pūrva janma anubhavaḥ pratīyate nikāya viśiṣṭābhiḥ apūrvābhiḥ deha indriya buddhi vedanābhiḥ abhisaṃbandhaḥ janma tasya anubhavaḥ prāptiḥ sā pratīyate katham iti atas āha sa ca ayam abhiniveśaḥ ardha uktau eva asya kleśa tvam āha kleśaḥ iti

original: ayam ahitakarmādinā jantūn kliśnāti duḥkhākarotīti kleśaḥ| vaktum upakrāntaṃ parisamāpayati --- svarasavāhīti| svabhāvena vāsanārūpeṇa vahanaśīlo na punar āgantukaḥ|
analyzed: ayam ahita karma ādinā jantūn kliśnāti duḥkhākaroti iti kleśaḥ vaktum upakrāntam parisamāpayati sva rasa vāhi iti svabhāvena vāsanā rūpeṇa vahana śīlaḥ na punar āgantukaḥ

original: kṛmer api jātamātrasya duḥkhabahulasya nikṛṣṭatamacaitanyasyānāgantukatve hetum āha --- pratyakṣānumānāgamaiḥ pratyudite janmany asaṃbhāvito 'saṃpādito maraṇatrāsa ucchedadṛṣṭyātmakaḥ pūrvajanmānubhūtaṃ maraṇaduḥkham anumāpayati|
analyzed: kṛmeḥ api jāta mātrasya duḥkha bahulasya nikṛṣṭatama caitanyasya anāgantuka tve hetum āha pratyakṣa anumāna āgamaiḥ pratyudite janmani saṃpāditaḥ maraṇa trāsaḥ uccheda dṛṣṭi ātmakaḥ pūrva janma anubhūtam maraṇa duḥkham anumāpayati

original: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ --- jātamātra eva hi bālako mārakavastudarśanād vepamānaḥ kampaviśeṣād anumitamaraṇapratyāsattis tato bibhyad upalabhyate| duḥkhād duḥkhahetoś ca bhayaṃ dṛṣṭam| na cāsmiñ janmany anena maraṇam anubhūtam anumitaṃ śrutaṃ vā, prāg evāsya duḥkhatvaṃ taddhetutvaṃ vāvagamyeta, tasmāt tasya tathābhūtasya smṛtiḥ pariśiṣyate|

original: na ceyaṃ saṃskārād ṛte| na cāyaṃ saṃskāro'nubhavaṃ vinā| na cāsmiñ janmany anubhava iti prāgbhavīyaḥ pariśiṣyata ity āsīt pūrvajanmasaṃbandha iti| tathāpadaṃ yathāpadam ākāṅkṣatīty arthaprāpte yathāpade sati yādṛśo vākyārtho bhavati tādṛśaṃ darśayati --- yathā cāyam iti| atyantamūḍheṣu mandatamacaitanyeṣu|
analyzed: na ca iyam saṃskārāt ṛte na ca ayam saṃskāraḥ anubhavam vinā na ca asmin janmani anubhavaḥ iti prāk bhavīyaḥ pariśiṣyate iti āsīt pūrva janma saṃbandhaḥ iti tathāpadam yathāpadam ākāṅkṣati iti artha prāpte yathāpade sati yādṛśaḥ vākya arthaḥ bhavati tādṛśam darśayati yathā ca ayam iti atyanta mūḍheṣu mandatama caitanyeṣu

original: vidvattāṃ darśayati --- vijñātapūrvāparāntasya| antaḥ koṭiḥ| puruṣasya hi pūrvā koṭiḥ saṃsāra uttarā ca kaivalyaṃ saiva vijñātā śrutānumānābhyāṃ yena sa tathoktaḥ| so'yaṃ maraṇatrāsa ā kṛmer ā ca viduṣo rūḍhaḥ prasiddha iti| nanv aviduṣo bhavatu maraṇatrāso viduṣas tu na saṃbhavati vidyayonmūlitatvāt|
analyzed: vidvat tām darśayati vijñāta pūrva apara antasya antaḥ koṭiḥ puruṣasya hi pūrvā koṭiḥ saṃsāraḥ uttarā ca kaivalyam sā eva vijñātā śruta anumānābhyām yena sa tathā uktaḥ saḥ ayam maraṇa trāsaḥ ā kṛmeḥ ā ca viduṣaḥ rūḍhaḥ prasiddhaḥ iti nanu a viduṣaḥ bhavatu maraṇa trāsaḥ viduṣaḥ tu na saṃbhavati vidyayā unmūlita tvāt
