original: puruṣaprayatnasya prasaṃkhyānagocarasyāvadhim āha --- yāvad iti| sūkṣmīkṛtā iti vivṛṇoti --- dagdheti| atraiva dṛṣṭāntam āha --- yathā vastrāṇām iti| yatnena kṣālanādinopāyena kṣārasaṃyogādinā| sthūlasūkṣmamātratayā dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ sāmyaṃ na punaḥ prayatnāpaneyatayā pratiprasavaheyeṣu tadasaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: puruṣa prayatnasya prasaṃkhyāna gocarasya avadhim āha yāvat iti sūkṣmīkṛtāḥ iti vivṛṇoti dagdha iti atra eva dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā vastrāṇām iti yatnena kṣālana ādinā upāyena kṣāra saṃyoga ādinā sthūla sūkṣma mātra tayā dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntikayoḥ sāmyam na punar prayatna apaneya tayā pratiprasava heyeṣu tad asaṃbhavāt

original: svalpaḥ pratipakṣa ucchedahetur yāsāṃ tās tathoktāḥ| mahān pratipakṣa ucchedahetur yāsāṃ tās tathoktāḥ| pratiprasavasya cādhastāt prasaṃkhyānam ity avaratayā svalpatvam uktam||2.11||
analyzed: su alpaḥ pratipakṣaḥ uccheda hetuḥ yāsām tāḥ tathā uktāḥ mahān pratipakṣaḥ uccheda hetuḥ yāsām tāḥ tathā uktāḥ pratiprasavasya ca adhastāt prasaṃkhyānam iti avara tayā su alpa tvam uktam

original: kleśamūlaḥ karmāśayo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭajanmavedanīyaḥ||2.12||
analyzed: kleśa mūlaḥ karma āśayaḥ dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ

original: syād etaj jātyāyurbhogahetavaḥ puruṣaṃ kliśnantaḥ kleśāḥ karmāśayaś ca tathā, na tv avidyādayas tat katham avidyādayaḥ kleśā ity ata āha --- kleśamūlaḥ karmāśayo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭajanmavedanīyaḥ| kleśā mūlaṃ yasyotpāde ca kāryakaraṇe ca sa tathoktaḥ|
analyzed: syāt etat jāti āyuḥ bhoga hetavaḥ puruṣam kliśnantaḥ kleśāḥ karma āśayaḥ ca tathā na tu avidyā ādayaḥ tat katham avidyā ādayaḥ kleśāḥ iti atas āha kleśa mūlaḥ karma āśayaḥ dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ kleśāḥ mūlam yasya utpāde ca kārya karaṇe ca sa tathā uktaḥ

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- avidyādimūlo hi karmāśayo jātyāyurbhogahetur ity avidyādayo 'pi taddhetavo'taḥ kleśā iti| vyācaṣṭe --- tatreti| āśerate sāṃsārikāḥ puruṣā asminn ity āśayaḥ karmaṇām āśayo dharmādharmau| kāmāt kāmyakarmapravṛttau svargādihetur dharmo bhavati| evaṃ lobhāt paradravyāpahārādāv adharmaḥ|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati avidyā ādi mūlaḥ hi karma āśayaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhoga hetuḥ iti avidyā ādayaḥ api tad hetavaḥ ūtaḥ kleśāḥ iti vyācaṣṭe tatra iti āśerate sāṃsārikāḥ puruṣāḥ asmin iti āśayaḥ karmaṇām āśayaḥ dharma adharmau kāmāt kāmya karma pravṛttau svarga ādi hetuḥ dharmaḥ bhavati evam lobhāt para dravya apahāra ādau adharmaḥ

original: mohād adharme hiṃsādau dharmabuddheḥ pravartamānasyādharma eva| na tv asti mohajo dharmaḥ| asti krodhajo dharmaḥ| tadyathā dhruvasya janakāpamānajanmanaḥ krodhāt tajjigīṣayā cittena karmāśayena puṇyenāntarikṣalokavāsinām uparisthānam| adharmas tu krodhajo brahmavadhādijanmā prasiddha eva bhūtānām| tasya dvaividhyam āha --- sa dṛṣṭajanmeti|
analyzed: mohāt adharme hiṃsā ādau dharma buddheḥ pravartamānasya adharme eva na tu asti moha jaḥ dharmaḥ asti krodha jaḥ dharmaḥ tat yathā dhruvasya janaka apamāna janmanaḥ krodhāt tad jigīṣayā cittena karma āśayena puṇyena antarikṣa loka vāsinām upari sthānam adharmaḥ tu krodha jaḥ brahma vadha ādi janmā prasiddhaḥ eva bhūtānām tasya dvaividhyam āha sa dṛṣṭa janmā iti

original: dṛṣṭajanmavedanīyam āha --- tīvrasaṃvegeneti| yathāsaṃkhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntāv āha --- yathā nandīśvara iti| tatra nārakāṇām iti| yena karmāśayena kumbhīpākādayo narakabhedāḥ prāpyante tatkāriṇo nārakās teṣāṃ nāsti dṛṣṭajanmavedanīyaḥ karmāśayaḥ| na hi manuṣyaśarīreṇa tatpariṇāmabhedena vā sā tādṛśī vatsarasahasrādinirantaropabhogyā vedanā saṃbhavatīti|
analyzed: dṛṣṭa janma vedanīyam āha tīvra saṃvegena iti yathāsaṃkhyam dṛṣṭāntau āha yathā nandīśvaraḥ iti tatra nārakāṇām iti yena karma āśayena kumbhīpāka ādayaḥ naraka bhedāḥ prāpyante tad kāriṇaḥ nārakāḥ teṣām na asti dṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ karma āśayaḥ na hi manuṣya śarīreṇa tad pariṇāma bhedena vā sā tādṛśī vatsara sahasra ādi nirantara upabhogyā vedanā saṃbhavati iti

original: śeṣaṃ sugamam||2.12||
analyzed: śeṣam sugamam

original: sati mūle tadvipāko jātyāyurbhogāḥ||2.13||
analyzed: sati mūle tad vipākaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhogāḥ

original: syād etad avidyāmūlatve karmāśayasya vidyotpāde saty avidyāvināśān mā nāma karmāśayāntaraṃ caiṣīt| prācāṃ tu karmāśayānām anādibhavaparamparāsaṃcitānām asaṃkhyātānām aniyatavipākakālānāṃ bhogena kṣapayitum aśakyatvād aśakyocchedaḥ saṃsāraḥ syād ity ata āha --- sati mūle tadvipāko jātyāyurbhogāḥ|
analyzed: syāt etat avidyā mūla tve karmāśayasya vidyā utpāde sati avidyā vināśāt mā nāma karmāśaya antaram caiṣīt prācām tu karmāśayānām anādi bhava paramparā saṃcitānām asaṃkhyātānām aniyata vipāka kālānām bhogena kṣapayitum aśakya tvāt aśakya ucchedaḥ saṃsāraḥ syāt iti atas āha sati mūle tad vipākaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhogāḥ

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- sukhaduḥkhaphalo hi karmāśayas tādarthyena tannāntarīyakatayā janmāyuṣī api prasūte| sukhaduḥkhe ca rāgadveṣānuṣakte tadavinirbhāgavartinī tadabhāve na bhavataḥ| na cāsti saṃbhavo na ca tatra yas tuṣyati vodvijate vā tac ca tasya sukhaṃ vā duḥkhaṃ veti|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati sukha duḥkha phalaḥ hi karma āśayaḥ tādarthyena tad nāntarīyaka tayā janma āyuṣī api prasūte sukha duḥkhe ca rāga dveṣa anuṣakte tad avinirbhāga vartinī tad abhāve na bhavataḥ na ca asti saṃbhavaḥ na ca tatra yaḥ tuṣyati vā udvijate vā tat ca tasya sukham vā duḥkham vā iti

original: tad iyam ātmabhūmiḥ kleśasalilāvasiktā karmaphalaprasavakṣetram ity asti kleśānāṃ phalopajanane'pi karmāśayasahakāriteti kleśasamucchede sahakārivaikalyāt sann apy ananto'py aniyatavipākakālo'pi prasaṃkhyānadagdhabījabhāvo na phalāya kalpata iti| uktam arthaṃ bhāṣyam eva dyotayati --- satsv iti| atraiva dṛṣṭāntam āha --- yathā tuṣeti|
analyzed: tat iyam ātma bhūmiḥ kleśa salila avasiktā karma phala prasava kṣetram iti asti kleśānām phala upajanane pi karma āśaya sahakāri tā iti kleśa samucchede sahakāri vaikalyāt san api anantaḥ api aniyata vipāka kālaḥ api prasaṃkhyāna dagdha bīja bhāvaḥ na phalāya kalpate iti uktam artham bhāṣyam eva dyotayati satsu iti atra eva dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā tuṣa iti

original: satuṣā api dagdhabījabhāvāḥ svedādibhiḥ| dārṣṭāntike yojayati --- tatheti| nanu na kleśāḥ śakyā apanetuṃ na hi satām apanaya ity ata āha --- na prasaṃkhyānadagdhakleśabījabhāva iti| vipākasya traividhyam āha --- sa ceti| vipacyate sādhyate karmabhir iti vipākaḥ| karmaikatvaṃ dhruvaṃ kṛtvā janmaikatvānekatvagocarā prathamā vicāraṇā|
analyzed: sa tuṣāḥ api dagdha bīja bhāvāḥ sveda ādibhiḥ dārṣṭāntike yojayati tathā iti nanu na kleśāḥ śakyāḥ apanetum na hi satām apanayaḥ iti atas āha na prasaṃkhyāna dagdha kleśa bīja bhāvaḥ iti vipākasya traividhyam āha sa ca iti vipacyate sādhyate karmabhiḥ iti vipākaḥ karma ekatvam dhruvam kṛtvā janma ekatva anekatva gocarā prathamā vicāraṇā

original: dvitīyā tu karmānekatvaṃ dhruvaṃ kṛtvā janmaikatvānekatvagocarā| tad evaṃ catvāro vikalpāḥ| tatra prathamaṃ vikalpam apākaroti --- na tāvad ekaṃ karmaikasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam| pṛcchati --- kasmād iti|
analyzed: dvitīyā tu karma anekatvam dhruvam kṛtvā janma eka tva anekatva gocarā tat evam catvāraḥ vikalpāḥ tatra prathamam vikalpam apākaroti na tāvat ekam karma ekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam pṛcchati kasmāt iti

original: uttaram --- anādikālaikaikajanmapracitasyāta evāsaṃkhyeyasyaikaikajanmakṣapitād ekaikasmāt karmaṇo 'vaśiṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ sāṃpratikasya ca phalakramānigamād anāśvāso lokasya prasaktaḥ sa cāniṣṭa iti|
analyzed: uttaram anādi kāla ekaika janma pracitasya atas eva asaṃkhyeyasya ekaika janma kṣapitāt ekaikasmāt karmaṇaḥ karmaṇaḥ sāṃpratikasya ca phala krama anigamāt anāśvāsaḥ lokasya prasaktaḥ sa ca aniṣṭaḥ iti

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- karmakṣayasya viralatvāt tadutpattibāhulyāc cānyonyasaṃpīḍitāḥ karmāśayā nirantarotpattayo nirucchvāsāḥ svavipākaṃ pratīti na phalakramaḥ śakyo 'vadhārayituṃ prekṣāvatety anāśvāsaḥ puṇyānuṣṭhānaṃ prati prasakta iti| dvitīyaṃ vikalpaṃ nirākaroti --- na caikaṃ karmānekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam| pṛcchati --- kasmād iti|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati karma kṣayasya virala tvāt tad utpatti bāhulyāt ca anyonya saṃpīḍitāḥ karma āśayāḥ nirantara utpattayaḥ nirucchvāsāḥ sva vipākam prati iti na phala kramaḥ śakyaḥ vadhārayitum prekṣāvatā iti anāśvāsaḥ puṇya anuṣṭhānam prati prasaktaḥ iti dvitīyam vikalpam nirākaroti na ca ekam karma anekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam pṛcchati kasmāt iti

original: uttaram --- anekasmiñ janmany āhitam ekaikam eva karmānekasya janmalakṣaṇasya vipākasya nimittam ity avaśiṣṭasya vipākakālābhāvaḥ prasaktaḥ sa cāpy aniṣṭaḥ karmavaiphalyena tadananuṣṭhānaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: uttaram anekasmin janmani āhitam ekaikam eva karma anekasya janma lakṣaṇasya vipākasya nimittam iti avaśiṣṭasya vipāka kāla abhāvaḥ prasaktaḥ sa ca api aniṣṭaḥ karma vaiphalyena tad ananuṣṭhāna prasaṅgāt

original: yadaikajanmasamucchedye karmaṇy ekasmin phalakramāniyamād anāśvāsas tadā kaiva kathā bahujanmasamuccedye karmaṇy ekasmiṃs tatra hy avasarābhāvād vipākakālābhāva eva sāṃpratikasyeti bhāvaḥ| tṛtīyaṃ vikalpaṃ nirākaroti --- na cānekaṃ karmānekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam| tatra hetum āha --- tad anekaṃ janma yugapan na saṃbhavaty ayogina iti krameṇa vācyam|
analyzed: yadā eka janma samucchedye karmaṇi ekasmin phala krama aniyamāt anāśvāsaḥ tadā kā eva kathā bahu janma samuccedye karmaṇi ekasmin tatra hi avasara abhāvāt vipāka kāla abhāvaḥ eva sāṃpratikasya iti bhāvaḥ tṛtīyam vikalpam nirākaroti na ca anekam karma anekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam tatra hetum āha tat anekam janma yugapad na saṃbhavati ayoginaḥ iti krameṇa vācyam

original: yadi hi karmasahasraṃ yugapaj janmasahasraṃ prasuvīta tata eva karmasahasraprakṣayād avaśiṣṭasya vipākakālaḥ phalakramaniyamaś ca syātām| na hy asti janmanāṃ yaugapadyam| evam eva prathamapakṣoktaṃ dūṣaṇam ity arthaḥ| tad evaṃ pakṣatraye nirākṛte pāriśeṣyād anekaṃ karmaikasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam iti pakṣo vyavatiṣṭhata ity āha --- tasmāj janmeti|
analyzed: yadi hi karma sahasram yugapad janma sahasram prasuvīta tatas eva karma sahasra prakṣayāt avaśiṣṭasya vipāka kālaḥ phala krama niyamaḥ ca syātām na hi asti janmanām yaugapadyam evam eva prathama pakṣa uktam dūṣaṇam iti arthaḥ tat evam pakṣa traye nirākṛte pāriśeṣyāt anekam karma ekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam iti pakṣaḥ vyavatiṣṭhate iti āha tasmāt janma iti

original: janma ca prāyaṇaṃ ca janmaprāyaṇe tayor antaraṃ madhyaṃ tasmin vicitrasukhaduḥkhaphalopahāreṇa vicitraḥ, yad atyantam udbhūtam anantaram eva phalaṃ dāsyati tat pradhānaṃ, yat tu kiṃcid vilambena tad upasarjanaṃ, prāyaṇaṃ maraṇaṃ tenābhivyaktaḥ svakāryārambhaṇābhimukham upanīta ekapraghaṭṭakena yugapat saṃmūrchito janmādilakṣaṇe kārye kartavya
analyzed: janma ca prāyaṇam ca janma prāyaṇe tayoḥ antaram madhyam tasmin vicitra sukha duḥkha phala upahāreṇa vicitraḥ yat atyantam udbhūtam anantaram eva phalam dāsyati tat pradhānam yat tu kiṃcid vilambena tat upasarjanam prāyaṇam maraṇam tena abhivyaktaḥ sva kārya ārambhaṇa abhimukham upanītaḥ eka praghaṭṭakena yugapad saṃmūrchitaḥ janma ādi lakṣaṇe kārye kartavya artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha

original: ekalolībhāvam āpanna ekam eva janma karoti nānekam| tac ca janma manuṣyādibhāvas tenaiva karmaṇā labdhāyuṣkaṃ kālabhedān niyatajīvitaṃ bhavati| tasminn āyuṣi tenaiva karmaṇā bhogaḥ sukhaduḥkhasākṣātkāraḥ svasaṃbandhitayā saṃpadyata iti| tasmād asau karmāśayo jātyāyurbhogahetutvāt trivipāko 'bhidhīyate|
analyzed: eka lolībhāvam āpannaḥ ekam eva janma karoti na anekam tat ca janma manuṣya ādi bhāvaḥ tena eva karmaṇā labdha āyuṣkam kāla bhedāt niyata jīvitam bhavati tasmin āyuṣi tena eva karmaṇā bhogaḥ sukha duḥkha sākṣātkāraḥ sva saṃbandhi tayā saṃpadyate iti tasmāt asau karma āśayaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhoga hetu tvāt tri vipākaḥ abhidhīyate

original: autsargikam upasaṃharati --- ata ekabhavikaḥ karmāśaya ukta iti| eko bhava ekabhavaḥ| "pūrvakāla" ityādinā samāsaḥ| ekabhavo 'syāstīti matvarthīyaṣ ṭhan| kvacit pāṭha aikabhavika iti| tatraikabhavaśabdād bhavārthe ṭhakpratyayaḥ| ekajanmāvacchinnam asya bhavanam ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: autsargikam upasaṃharati atas ekabhavikaḥ karma āśayaḥ uktaḥ iti ekaḥ bhavaḥ eka bhavaḥ pūrva kālaḥ ityādinā samāsaḥ sya asti iti kvacid aikabhavikaḥ iti tatra eka bhava śabdāt bhava arthe ṭhak pratyayaḥ eka janma avacchinnam asya bhavanam iti arthaḥ

original: tad evam autsargikasyaikabhavikasya trivipākatvam uktvā dṛṣṭajanmavedanīyasyaihikasya karmaṇas trivipākatvaṃ vyavacchinatti --- dṛṣṭeti|
analyzed: tat evam autsargikasya eka bhavikasya tri vipāka tvam uktvā dṛṣṭa janma vedanīyasya aihikasya karmaṇaḥ tri vipāka tvam vyavacchinatti dṛṣṭa iti

original: nandīśvarasya khalv aṣṭavarṣāvacchinnāyuṣo manuṣyajanmanas tīvrasaṃvegādhimātropāyajanmā puṇyabheda āyurbhogahetutvād dvipākaḥ (dvivipākaḥ) nahuṣasya tu pārṣṇiprahāravirodhināgastyasyendrapadaprāptihetunaiva karmaṇāyuṣo vihitatvād apuṇyabhedo bhogamātrahetuḥ|
analyzed: nandīśvarasya khalu aṣṭa varṣa avacchinna āyuṣaḥ manuṣya janmanaḥ tīvra saṃvega adhimātra upāya janmā puṇya bhedaḥ āyuḥ bhoga hetu tvāt dvi pākaḥ dvi vipākaḥ nahuṣasya tu pārṣṇi prahāra virodhinā agastyasya indra pada prāpti hetunā eva karmaṇā āyuṣaḥ vihita tvāt apuṇya bhedaḥ bhoga mātra hetuḥ

original: nanu yathaikabhavikaḥ karmāśayas tathā kiṃ kleśavāsanā bhogānukūlāś ca karmavipākānubhavavāsanās tathā ca manuṣyas tiryagyonim āpanno na tajjātīyocitaṃ bhuñjītety ata āha --- kleśeti| saṃmūrchitam ekalolībhāvam āpannam| dharmādharmābhyāṃ vyavacchettuṃ vāsanāyāḥ svarūpam āha --- ye saṃskārā iti|
analyzed: nanu yathā eka bhavikaḥ karma āśayaḥ tathā kim kleśa vāsanāḥ bhoga anukūlāḥ ca karma vipāka anubhava vāsanāḥ tathā ca manuṣyaḥ tiryagyonim āpannaḥ na tad jātīya ucitam bhuñjīta iti atas āha kleśa iti saṃmūrchitam eka lolībhāvam āpannam dharma adharmābhyām vyavacchettum vāsanāyāḥ svarūpam āha ye saṃskārāḥ iti

original: autsargikam ekabhavikatvaṃ kvacid apavadituṃ bhūmikām āracayati --- yas tv asāv iti| tuśabdena vāsanāto vyavacchinatti| dṛṣṭajanmavedanīyasya niyatavipākasyaivāyam ekabhavikatvaniyamo na tv adṛṣṭajanmavedanīyasya| kiṃbhūtasyāniyatavipākasyeti| hetuṃ pṛcchati --- kasmād iti| hetum āha --- yo hīti| ekāṃ tāvad gatim āha --- kṛtasyeti|
analyzed: autsargikam eka bhavika tvam kvacid apavaditum bhūmikām āracayati yaḥ tu asau iti tuśabdena vāsanātaḥ vyavacchinatti dṛṣṭa janma vedanīyasya niyata vipākasya eva ayam eka bhavika tva niyamaḥ na tu adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyasya kiṃbhūtasya aniyata vipākasya iti hetum pṛcchati kasmāt iti hetum āha yaḥ hi iti ekām tāvat gatim āha kṛtasya iti

original: dvitīyām āha --- pradhāneti| tṛtīyām āha --- niyateti| tatra prathamāṃ vibhajate --- tatra kṛtasyeti| saṃnyāsikarmabhyo'śuklākṛṣṇebhyo'nyāni trīṇy eva karmāṇi kṛṣṇakṛṣṇaśuklaśuklāni| tad iha tapaḥsvādhyāyādisādhyaḥ śuklaḥ karmāśaya udita evādattaphalasya kṛṣṇasya nāśako'viśeṣāc ca śabalasyāpi kṛṣṇabhāgayogād iti mantavyam|
analyzed: dvitīyām āha pradhāna iti tṛtīyām āha niyata iti tatra prathamām vibhajate tatra kṛtasya iti trīṇi eva karmāṇi kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa śukla śuklāni tat iha tapaḥ svādhyāya ādi sādhyaḥ śuklaḥ karma āśayaḥ uditaḥ eva ādatta phalasya kṛṣṇasya ca śabalasya api kṛṣṇa bhāga yogāt iti mantavyam

original: atraiva bhagavān āmnāyam udāharati --- yatredam iti| dve dve ha vai karmaṇī kṛṣṇakṛṣṇaśukle apahantīti saṃbandhaḥ| vīpsayā bhūyiṣṭhatā sūcitā| kasyety ata āha --- pāpakasya puṃsaḥ| ko'sāv apahantīty ata āha --- eko rāśiḥ puṇyakṛtaḥ| samūhasya samūhisādhyatvāt| tad anena śuklaḥ karmāśayas tṛtīya uktaḥ|
analyzed: atra eva bhagavān āmnāyam udāharati yatra idam iti dve dve ha vai karmaṇī kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa śukle apahanti iti saṃbandhaḥ vīpsayā bhūyiṣṭhatā sūcitā kasya iti atas āha pāpakasya puṃsaḥ kaḥ asau apahanti iti atas āha ekaḥ rāśiḥ puṇya kṛtaḥ samūhasya samūhi sādhya tvāt tat anena śuklaḥ karma āśayaḥ tṛtīyaḥ uktaḥ

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- īdṛśo nāmāyaṃ parapīḍādirahitasādhanasādhyaḥ śuklaḥ karmāśayo yad eko'pi san kṛṣṇān kṛṣṇaśuklāṃś cātyantavirodhinaḥ karmāśayān bhūyaso'py apahanti| tat tasmād icchasveti cchāndasatvād ātmanepadam| śeṣaṃ sugamam| atra ca śuklakarmodayasyaiva sa ko'pi mahimā yata itareṣām abhāvo na tu svādhyāyādijanmano duḥkhāt|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati īdṛśaḥ nāma ayam para pīḍā ādi rahita sādhana sādhyaḥ śuklaḥ karma āśayaḥ yat ekaḥ api san kṛṣṇān kṛṣṇa śuklān ca atyanta virodhinaḥ karma āśayān bhūyasaḥ api apahanti tat tasmāt icchasva iti chāndasatvāt ātmanepadam śeṣam sugamam atra ca śukla karma udayasya eva sa kaḥ api mahimā yatas itareṣām abhāvaḥ na tu svādhyāya ādi janmanaḥ duḥkhāt

original: na hi duḥkhamātravirodhyadharmo'pi tu svakāryaduḥkhavirodhī| na ca svādhyāyādijanyaṃ duḥkhaṃ tasya kāryaṃ tatkāryatve svādhyāyādividhānānarthakyāt tadbalād eva tadutpatteḥ| anutpattau vā kumbhīpākādy api vidhīyeta| avidhāne tu tadanutpatter iti sarvaṃ caturasram|
analyzed: na hi duḥkha mātra virodhya dharmaḥ api tu sva kārya duḥkha virodhī na ca svādhyāya ādi janyam duḥkham tasya kāryam tad kārya tve svādhyāya ādi vidhāna ānarthakyāt tad balāt eva tad utpatteḥ anutpattau vā kumbhīpāka ādi api vidhīyeta avidhāne tu tad anutpatteḥ iti sarvam caturasram

original: dvitīyāṃ gatiṃ vibhajate --- pradhāne karmaṇi jyotiṣṭomādike tadaṅgasya paśuhiṃsāder āvāpagamanam| dve khalu hiṃsādeḥ kārye --- pradhānāṅgatvena vidhānāt tadupakāraḥ, "na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni" iti hiṃsāyāḥ pratiṣiddhatvād anarthaś ca|
analyzed: dvitīyām gatim vibhajate pradhāne karmaṇi jyotiṣṭoma ādike tad aṅgasya paśu hiṃsā ādeḥ āvāpa gamanam dve khalu hiṃsā ādeḥ kārye pradhāna aṅga tvena vidhānāt tad upakāraḥ na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni iti hiṃsāyāḥ pratiṣiddha tvāt anarthaḥ ca

original: tatra pradhānāṅgatvenānuṣṭhānād apradhānataivety ato na drāg ity eva pradhānanirapekṣā satī svaphalam anarthaṃ prasotum arhati, kiṃ tv ārabdhavipāke pradhāne sāhāyakam ācarantī vyavatiṣṭhate| pradhānasāhāyakam ācarantyāś ca svakārye bījamātratayāvasthānaṃ pradhāne karmaṇy āvāpagamanam|
analyzed: tatra pradhāna aṅga tvena anuṣṭhānāt apradhānatā eva iti atas na drāk iti eva pradhāna nirapekṣā satī sva phalam anartham prasotum arhati kim tu ārabdha vipāke pradhāne sāhāyakam ācarantī vyavatiṣṭhate pradhāna sāhāyakam ācarantyāḥ ca sva kārye bīja mātra tayā avasthānam pradhāne karmaṇi āvāpa gamanam

original: yatredam uktaṃ pañcaśikhena svalpaḥ saṃkaro jyotiṣṭomādijanmanaḥ pradhānāpūrvasya paśuhiṃsādijanmanānarthahetunāpūrveṇa saparihāraḥ śakyo hi kiyatā prāyaścittena parihartum|
analyzed: yatra idam uktam pañcaśikhena su alpaḥ saṃkaraḥ jyotiṣṭoma ādi janmanaḥ pradhāna apūrvasya paśu hiṃsā ādi janmanā anartha hetunā apūrveṇa sa parihāraḥ śakyaḥ hi kiyatā prāyaścittena parihartum

original: atha pramādataḥ prāyaścittam api nācaritaṃ pradhānakarmavipākasamaye ca vipacyeta tathāpi yāvan tam asāv anarthaṃ prasūte tāvān sapratyavamarṣo mṛṣyante hi puṇyasaṃbhāropanītasukhasudhāmahāhradāvagāhinaḥ kuśalāḥ pāpamātropapāditāṃ duḥkhavahnikaṇikām| ataḥ kuśalasya sumahataḥ puṇyasya nāpakarṣāya prakṣayāya paryāptaḥ| pṛcchati --- kasmāt|
analyzed: atha pramādataḥ prāyaścittam api na ācaritam pradhāna karma vipāka samaye ca vipacyeta tathā api yāvat tam asau anartham prasūte tāvān sa pratyavamarṣaḥ mṛṣyante hi puṇya saṃbhāra upanīta sukha sudhā mahā hrada avagāhinaḥ kuśalāḥ pāpa mātra upapāditām duḥkha vahni kaṇikām atas kuśalasya su mahataḥ puṇyasya na apakarṣāya prakṣayāya paryāptaḥ pṛcchati kasmāt

original: puṇyavata uttaraṃ --- kuśalaṃ hi me bahv anyad asti pradhānakarma parikaratayā vyavasthitaṃ dīkṣaṇīyādidakṣiṇāntam| yatrāyaṃ saṃkaraḥ svalpaḥ svarge'py asya phale saṃkīrṇapuṇyalabdhajanmanaḥ svargāt sarvathā duḥkhenāparāmṛṣṭād apakarṣam alpam alpaduḥkhasaṃbhedaṃ kariṣyatīti| tṛtīyāṃ gatiṃ vibhajate --- niyateti|
analyzed: puṇyavataḥ uttaram kuśalam hi me bahu anyat asti pradhāna karma parikara tayā vyavasthitam dīkṣaṇīya ādi dakṣiṇā antam yatra ayam saṃkaraḥ su alpaḥ svarge api asya phale saṃkīrṇa puṇya labdha janmanaḥ svargāt sarvathā duḥkhena aparāmṛṣṭāt apakarṣam alpam alpa duḥkha saṃbhedam kariṣyati iti tṛtīyām gatim vibhajate niyata iti

original: balīyastveneha prādhānyam abhimataṃ na tv aṅgitayā| balīyastvaṃ ca niyatavipākatvenānyadānavakāśatvāt| aniyatavipākasya tu durbalatvam anyadā sāvakāśatvāt| ciram avasthānaṃ bījabhāvamātreṇa na punaḥ pradhānopakāritayā tasya svatantratvāt|
analyzed: balīyaḥ tvena iha prādhānyam abhimatam na tu aṅgi tayā balīyaḥ tvam ca niyata vipāka tvena anyadā anavakāśa tvāt aniyata vipākasya tu durbala tvam anyadā sāvakāśa tvāt ciram avasthānam bīja bhāva mātreṇa na punar pradhāna upakāri tayā tasya svatantra tvāt

original: nanu prāyaṇenaikadaiva karmāśayo'bhivyajyata ity uktam idānīṃ ca cirāvasthānam ucyate tat kathaṃ paraṃ pūrveṇa na virudhyata ity āśayavān pṛcchati --- katham iti| uttaram --- adṛṣṭeti| jātyabhiprāyam ekavacanam| taditarasya gatim uktām avadhārayati --- yat tv adṛṣṭeti| śeṣaṃ sugamam||2.13||
analyzed: nanu prāyaṇena ekadā eva karma āśayaḥ abhivyajyate iti uktam idānīm ca cira avasthānam ucyate tat katham param pūrveṇa na virudhyate iti āśayavān pṛcchati katham iti uttaram adṛṣṭā iti jāti abhiprāyam ekavacanam tad itarasya gatim uktām avadhārayati yat tu adṛṣṭā iti śeṣam sugamam

original: te hlādaparitāpaphalāḥ puṇyāpuṇyahetutvāt||2.14||
analyzed: te hlāda paritāpa phalāḥ puṇya apuṇya hetu tvāt

original: uktaṃ kleśamūlatvaṃ karmaṇām| karmamūlatvaṃ ca vipākānām atha vipākāḥ kasya mūlaṃ yenāmī tyaktavyā ity ata āha --- te hlādaparitāpaphalāḥ puṇyāpuṇyahetutvāt| vyācaṣṭe --- te janmāyurbhogā iti|
analyzed: uktam kleśa mūla tvam karmaṇām karma mūla tvam ca vipākānām atha vipākāḥ kasya mūlam yena amī tyaktavyāḥ iti atas āha te hlāda paritāpa phalāḥ puṇya apuṇya hetu tvāt vyācaṣṭe te janma āyuḥ bhogāḥ iti

original: yady api janmāyuṣor eva hlādaparitāpapūrvabhāvitayā tatphalatvaṃ na tu bhogasya hlādaparitāpodayānantarabhāvinas tadanubhavātmanas tathāpy anubhāvyatayā bhogyatayā bhogakarmatāmātreṇa bhogaphalatvam iti mantavyam| nanv apuṇyahetukā jātyāyurbhogāḥ paritāpaphalā bhavantu heyāḥ pratikūlavedanīyatvāt|
analyzed: yadi api janma āyuṣoḥ eva hlāda paritāpa pūrva bhāvi tayā tad phala tvam na tu bhogasya hlāda paritāpa udaya anantara bhāvinaḥ tad anubhava ātmanaḥ tathā api anubhāvya tayā bhogya tayā bhoga karmatā mātreṇa bhoga phala tvam iti mantavyam nanu apuṇya hetukāḥ jāti āyuḥ bhogāḥ paritāpa phalāḥ bhavantu heyāḥ pratikūla vedanīya tvāt

original: kasmāt punaḥ puṇyahetavas tyajyante sukhaphalā anukūlavedanīyatvāt| na caiṣāṃ pratyātmavedanīyānukūlatā śakyā sahasreṇāpy anumānāgamair apākartum| na ca hlādaparitāpau parasparāvinābhūtau yato hlāda upādīyamāne paritāpe'py avarjanīyatayāpatet| tayor bhinnahetukatvād bhinnarūpatvāc cety ata āha --- yathā cedam iti||2.14||
analyzed: kasmāt punar puṇya hetavaḥ tyajyante sukha phalāḥ anukūla vedanīya tvāt na ca eṣām pratyātma vedanīya anukūla tā śakyā sahasreṇa api anumāna āgamaiḥ apākartum na ca hlāda paritāpau paraspara avinābhūtau yatas hlāde upādīyamāne paritāpe pi avarjanīya tayā āpatet tayoḥ bhinna hetuka tvāt bhinna rūpa tvāt ca iti atas āha yathā ca idam iti

original: pariṇāmatāpasaṃskāraduḥkhair guṇavṛttivirodhāc ca duḥkham eva sarvaṃ vivekinaḥ||2.15||
analyzed: pariṇāma tāpa saṃskāra duḥkhaiḥ guṇa vṛtti virodhāt ca duḥkham eva sarvam vivekinaḥ

original: yady api na pṛthagjanaiḥ pratikūlātmatayā viṣayasukhakāle saṃvedyate duḥkhaṃ tathāpi saṃvedyate yogibhir iti praśnapūrvakaṃ tadupapādanāya sūtram avatārayati --- kathaṃ, tadupapadyata (tadupapādyata) iti| pariṇāmetyādisūtram| pariṇāmaś ca tāpaś ca saṃskāraś caitāny eva duḥkhāni tair iti|
analyzed: yadi api na pṛthagjanaiḥ pratikūla ātma tayā viṣaya sukha kāle saṃvedyate duḥkham tathā api saṃvedyate yogibhiḥ iti praśna pūrvakam tad upapādanāya sūtram avatārayati katham tat upapadyata tat upapādyate iti pariṇāma ityādi sūtram pariṇāmaḥ ca tāpaḥ ca saṃskāraḥ ca etāni eva duḥkhāni taiḥ iti

original: pariṇāmaduḥkhatayā viṣayasukhasya duḥkhatām āha --- sarvasyāyam iti| na khalu sukhaṃ rāgānuvedham antareṇa saṃbhavati| na hy asti saṃbhavo na tatra tuṣyati tac ca tasya sukham iti| rāgasya ca pravṛttihetutvāt pravṛtteś ca puṇyāpuṇyopacayahetutvāt tatrāsti rāgajaḥ karmāśayo'sato 'nupajananāt|
analyzed: pariṇāma duḥkha tayā viṣaya sukhasya duḥkha tām āha sarvasya ayam iti na khalu sukham rāga anuvedham antareṇa saṃbhavati na hi asti saṃbhavaḥ na tatra tuṣyati tat ca tasya sukham iti rāgasya ca pravṛtti hetu tvāt pravṛtteḥ ca puṇya apuṇya upacaya hetu tvāt tatra asti rāga jaḥ karma āśayaḥ usataḥ n upajananāt

original: tadā (tathā) ca sukhaṃ bhuñjānas tatra sakto 'pi vicchinnāvasthena dveṣeṇa dveṣṭi duḥkhasādhanāni, tāni parihartum aśakto muhyati ceti dveṣamohakṛto'py asti karmāśayaḥ| dveṣavan mohasyāpi viparyayāparanāmnaḥ karmāśayahetutvam aviruddham|
analyzed: tadā tathā ca sukham bhuñjānaḥ tatra saktaḥ api vicchinna avasthena dveṣeṇa dveṣṭi duḥkha sādhanāni tāni parihartum aśaktaḥ muhyati ca iti dveṣa moha kṛtaḥ api asti karma āśayaḥ dveṣa vat mohasya api viparyaya apara nāmnaḥ karma āśaya hetu tvam aviruddham

original: nanu kathaṃ rakto dveṣṭi muhyati vā rāgasamaye dveṣamohayor adarśanād ity ata āha --- tathā coktaṃ vicchinnāvasthān kleśān upapādayadbhir asmābhiḥ| tad anena vāṅmanasapravṛttijanmanī puṇyāpuṇye darśite| rāgādijanmanaḥ kartavyam idam iti mānasasya saṃkalpasya sābhilāṣatvena vācanikatvasyāpy aviśeṣāt| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: nanu katham raktaḥ dveṣṭi muhyati vā rāga samaye dveṣa mohayoḥ adarśanāt iti atas āha tathā ca uktam vicchinna avasthān kleśān upapādayadbhiḥ asmābhiḥ tat anena vāc manasa pravṛtti janmanī puṇya apuṇye darśite rāga ādi janmanaḥ kartavyam idam iti mānasasya saṃkalpasya sa abhilāṣa tvena vācanika tvasya api aviśeṣāt yathā āhuḥ

original: "sābhilāṣaś ca saṃkalpo vācyārthān nātiricyate" iti|
analyzed: sa abhilāṣaḥ ca saṃkalpaḥ vācya arthāt na atiricyate iti

original: śārīram api karmāśayaṃ darśayati --- nānupahatyeti| ata eva dharmaśāstrakārāḥ "pañca sūnā gṛhasthasya" ity āhuḥ| syād etan na pratyātmavedanīyasya viṣayasukhasya pratyākhyānam ucitaṃ yoginām anubhavavirodhād ity ata āha --- viṣayasukhaṃ cāvidyety uktaṃ caturvidhaviparyāsalakṣaṇām avidyāṃ darśayadbhir iti| nāpātamātram ādriyante vṛddhāḥ|
analyzed: śārīram api karma āśayam darśayati na an upahatya iti atas eva dharma śāstra kārāḥ pañca sūnāḥ gṛhasthasya iti āhuḥ syāt etat na pratyātma vedanīyasya viṣaya sukhasya pratyākhyānam ucitam yoginām anubhava virodhāt iti atas āha viṣaya sukham ca avidyā iti uktam caturvidha viparyāsa lakṣaṇām avidyām darśayadbhiḥ iti na āpāta mātram ādriyante vṛddhāḥ

original: asti khalv āpātato madhuviṣasaṃpṛktān nopabhoge'pi sukhānubhavaḥ pratyātmavedanīyaḥ kiṃ tv āyatyām asukham| iyaṃ ca darśitā bhagavataiva ---
analyzed: asti khalu āpātataḥ madhu viṣa saṃpṛktāt na upabhoge pi sukha anubhavaḥ pratyātma vedanīyaḥ kim tu āyatyām asukham iyam ca darśitāḥ bhagavatā eva

original: "viṣayendriyasaṃyogād yat tad agre'mṛtopamam| pariṇāme viṣam iva tat sukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam" iti||
analyzed: viṣaya indriya saṃyogāt yat tat agra imṛta upamam pariṇāme viṣam iva tat sukham rājasam smṛtam iti

original: codayati --- yā bhogeṣv iti| na vayaṃ viṣayahlādaṃ sukham ātiṣṭhāmahe kiṃ tu tṛpyatāṃ (tṛptatāṃ) puṃsām| tattadviṣayaprārthanāparikliṣṭacetasāṃ tṛṣṇaiva mahad duḥkham| na ceyam upabhogam antareṇa śāmyati| na cāsyāḥ praśamo rāgādyanuviddha iti nāsya pariṇāmaduḥkhateti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: codayati yāḥ bhogeṣu iti na vayam viṣaya hlādam sukham ātiṣṭhāmahe kim tu tṛpyatām tṛpta tām puṃsām tad tad viṣaya prārthanā parikliṣṭa cetasām tṛṣṇā eva mahat duḥkham na ca iyam upabhogam antareṇa śāmyati na ca asyāḥ praśamaḥ rāga ādi anuviddhaḥ iti na asya pariṇāma duḥkha tā iti bhāvaḥ

original: tṛptes tṛṣṇākṣayād dhetor indriyāṇām upaśāntir apravartanaṃ viṣayeṣv ity arthaḥ| etad eva vyatirekamukhena (vyatirekamukheṇa) spaṣṭayati --- yā laulyād iti| pariharati --- na cendriyāṇām iti| hetāv anoḥ prayogaḥ| satyaṃ tṛṣṇākṣayaḥ sukham anavadyaṃ tasya tu na bhogābhyāso hetur api tu tṛṣṇāyā eva tadvirodhinyāḥ| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: tṛpteḥ tṛṣṇā kṣayāt hetoḥ indriyāṇām upaśāntiḥ apravartanam viṣayeṣu iti arthaḥ etat eva vyatireka mukhena vyatireka mukheṇa spaṣṭayati yā laulyāt iti pariharati na ca indriyāṇām iti hetau anoḥ prayogaḥ satyam tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ sukham anavadyam tasya tu na bhoga abhyāsaḥ hetuḥ api tu tṛṣṇāyāḥ eva tad virodhinyāḥ yathā āhuḥ

original: "na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati| haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate iti||"
analyzed: na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmā iva bhūyas eva abhivardhate iti

original: śeṣam atirohitam| tāpaduḥkhatāṃ pṛcchati --- atha keti| uttaraṃ --- sarvasyeti| sarvajanaprasiddhatvena tatsvarūpaprapañcam akṛtvā tāpaduḥkhatāpi pariṇāmaduḥkhatāsamatayā prapañciteti| saṃskāraduḥkhatāṃ pṛcchati --- keti| uttaraṃ --- sukheti| sukhānubhavo hi saṃskāram ādhatte|
analyzed: śeṣam ati rohitam tāpa duḥkhatām pṛcchati atha kā iti uttaram sarvasya iti sarva jana prasiddha tvena tad svarūpa prapañcam a kṛtvā tāpa duḥkhatā api pariṇāma duḥkha tā samatayā prapañcitā iti saṃskāra duḥkhatām pṛcchati kā iti uttaram sukhā iti sukha anubhavaḥ hi saṃskāram ādhatte

original: sa ca sukhasmaraṇaṃ tac ca rāgaṃ sa ca manaḥkāyavacanaceṣṭāṃ sā ca puṇyāpuṇye tato vipākānubhavas tato vāsanety evam anāditeti| atra ca sukhaduḥkhasaṃskārātiśayāt tatsmaraṇaṃ tasmāc ca rāgadveṣau tābhyāṃ karmāṇi karmabhyo vipāka iti yojanā| tad evaṃ duḥkhasrotaḥ prasṛtaṃ yoginam eva kliśnāti netaraṃ pṛthagjanam ity āha --- evam idam anādīti|
analyzed: sa ca sukha smaraṇam tat ca rāgam sa ca manaḥ kāya vacana ceṣṭām sā ca puṇya apuṇye tatas vipāka anubhavaḥ tatas vāsanā iti evam anāditā iti atra ca sukha duḥkha saṃskāra atiśayāt tad smaraṇam tasmāt ca rāga dveṣau tābhyām karmāṇi karmabhyaḥ vipākaḥ iti yojanā tat evam duḥkha srotaḥ prasṛtam yoginam eva kliśnāti na itaram pṛthagjanam iti āha evam idam anādi iti

original: itaraṃ tu triparvāṇas tāpā anuplavanta iti saṃbandhaḥ| ādhibhautikādhidaivikayos tāpayor bāhyatvenaikatvaṃ vivakṣitam| citte vṛttir asyā ity avidyā cittavṛttis tayā hātavya eva buddhīndriyaśarīrādau dārāpatyādau cāhaṃkāramamakārānupātinam iti| tad atra na samyagdarśanād anyat paritrāṇam astīty āha --- tad evam iti|
analyzed: itaram tu tri parvāṇaḥ tāpāḥ anuplavante iti saṃbandhaḥ ādhibhautika ādhidaivikayoḥ tāpayoḥ bāhya tvena eka tvam vivakṣitam citte vṛttiḥ asyāḥ iti avidyā citta vṛttiḥ tayā hātavyaḥ eva buddhīndriya śarīra ādau dāra apatya ādau ca ahaṃkāra mamakāra anupātinam iti tat atra na samyak darśanāt anyat paritrāṇam asti iti āha tat evam iti

original: tad evam aupādhikaṃ viṣayasukhasya pariṇāmataḥ saṃskāratas tāpasaṃyogāc ca duḥkhatvam abhidhāya svābhāvikam ādarśayati --- guṇavṛttivirodhāc ceti|
analyzed: tat evam aupādhikam viṣaya sukhasya pariṇāmataḥ saṃskārataḥ tāpa saṃyogāt ca duḥkha tvam abhidhāya svābhāvikam ādarśayati guṇa vṛtti virodhāt ca iti

original: vyācaṣṭe --- prakhyāpravṛttisthitirūpā buddhirūpeṇa pariṇatā guṇāḥ sattvarajastamāṃsi parasparānugrahatantrāḥ śāntaṃ sukhātmakaṃ ghoraṃ duḥkhātmakaṃ mūḍhaṃ viṣādātmakam eva pratyayaṃ sukhopabhogarūpam api triguṇam ārabhante| na ca so 'pi tādṛśapratyayarūpo'sya pariṇāmaḥ sthira ity āha --- calaṃ ca guṇavṛttam iti kṣiprapariṇāmi cittam uktam|
analyzed: vyācaṣṭe prakhyā pravṛtti sthiti rūpāḥ buddhi rūpeṇa pariṇatāḥ guṇāḥ sattva rajaḥ tamāṃsi paraspara anugraha tantrāḥ śāntam sukha ātmakam ghoram duḥkha ātmakam mūḍham viṣāda ātmakam eva pratyayam sukha upabhoga rūpam api triguṇam ārabhante na ca tādṛśa pratyaya rūpaḥ usya pariṇāmaḥ sthiraḥ iti āha calam ca guṇa vṛttam iti kṣipra pariṇāmi cittam uktam

original: nanv ekaḥ pratyayaḥ kathaṃ parasparaviruddhaśāntaghoramūḍhatvāny ekadā pratipadyata ity ata āha --- rūpātiśayā vṛttyatiśayāś ca paraspareṇa virudhyante| rūpāṇi aṣṭau bhāvā dharmādayo vṛttayaḥ sukhādyās tad iha dharmeṇa vipacyamānenādharmas tādṛśo virudhyate| evaṃ jñānavairāgyaiśvaryaiḥ sukhādibhiś ca tādṛśāny eva tadviparītāni virudhyante|
analyzed: nanu ekaḥ pratyayaḥ katham paraspara viruddha śānta ghora mūḍha tvāni ekadā pratipadyate iti atas āha rūpa atiśayāḥ vṛtti atiśayāḥ ca paraspareṇa virudhyante rūpāṇi aṣṭau bhāvāḥ dharma ādayaḥ vṛttayaḥ sukha ādyāḥ tat iha dharmeṇa vipacyamānena adharmaḥ tādṛśaḥ virudhyate evam jñāna vairāgya aiśvaryaiḥ sukha ādibhiḥ ca tādṛśāni eva tad viparītāni virudhyante

original: sāmānyāni tv asamudācaradrupāṇy atiśayaiḥ samudācaradbhiḥ sahāvirodhāt pravartanta iti| nanu gṛhṇīma etat tathāpi viṣayasukhasya kutaḥ svābhāvikī duḥkhatety ata āha --- evam eta iti| upādānābhedād upādānātmakatvāc copādeyasyāpy abheda ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: sāmānyāni tu a samudācarat rupāṇi atiśayaiḥ samudācaradbhiḥ saha avirodhāt pravartante iti nanu gṛhṇīmaḥ etat tathā api viṣaya sukhasya kutas svābhāvikī duḥkha tā iti atas āha evam ete iti upādāna abhedāt upādāna ātmaka tvāt ca upādeyasya api abhedaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tat kim idānīm ātyantikam eva tādātmyaṃ tathā ca buddhivyapadeśabhedau na kalpete ity ata āha --- guṇapradhāneti| sāmānyātmanā guṇabhāvo 'tiśayātmanā ca prādhānyam| tasmād upādhitaḥ svabhāvataś ca duḥkham eva sarvaṃ vivekina iti| duḥkhaṃ ca heyaṃ prekṣāvatā| na ca tannidānahānam antareṇa tad dheyaṃ bhavitum arhati|
analyzed: tat kim idānīm ātyantikam eva tādātmyam tathā ca buddhi vyapadeśa bhedau na kalpete iti atas āha guṇa pradhāna iti sāmānya ātmanā ca prādhānyam tasmāt upādhitaḥ svabhāvataḥ ca duḥkham eva sarvam vivekinaḥ iti duḥkham ca heyam prekṣāvatā na ca tad nidāna hānam antareṇa tat dheyam bhavitum arhati

original: na cāparijñātaṃ nidānaṃ śakyaṃ hātum iti mūlanidānam asya darśayati --- tad asyeti| duḥkhasamudāyasya prabhava utpattir yatas tadbījam ity arthaḥ| taducchedahetuṃ darśayati --- tasyāś ceti| idānīm asya śāstrasya sarvānugrahārthaṃ pravṛttasya tadvidhenaiva śāstreṇa sādṛśyaṃ darśayati --- yatheti|
analyzed: na ca aparijñātam nidānam śakyam hātum iti mūla nidānam asya darśayati tat asya iti duḥkha samudāyasya prabhavaḥ utpattiḥ yatas tat bījam iti arthaḥ tad uccheda hetum darśayati tasyāḥ ca iti idānīm asya śāstrasya sarva anugraha artham pravṛttasya tadvidhena eva śāstreṇa sādṛśyam darśayati yathā iti

original: catvāro vyūhāḥ saṃkṣiptāvayavaracanā yasya tat tathoktam| nanu duḥkhaṃ heyam uktvā saṃsāraṃ heyam abhidadhataḥ kuto na virodha ity ata āha --- tatra duḥkhabahula iti| yatkṛtvāvidyā saṃsāraṃ karoti tad asyā avāntaravyāpāraṃ saṃsārahetum āha --- pradhānapuruṣayor iti| mokṣasvarūpam āha --- saṃyogasyeti| mokṣopāyam āha --- hānopāya iti|
analyzed: catvāraḥ vyūhāḥ saṃkṣipta avayava racanāḥ yasya tat tathā uktam nanu duḥkham heyam uktvā saṃsāram heyam abhidadhataḥ kutas na virodhaḥ iti atas āha tatra duḥkha bahulaḥ iti yat kṛtvā avidyā saṃsāram karoti tat asyāḥ avāntara vyāpāram saṃsāra hetum āha pradhāna puruṣayoḥ iti mokṣa svarūpam āha saṃyogasya iti mokṣa upāyam āha hāna upāyaḥ iti

original: kecit paśyanti, hātuḥ svarūpoccheda eva mokṣaḥ| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: kecid paśyanti hātuḥ svarūpa ucchedaḥ eva mokṣaḥ yathā āhuḥ

original: "pradīpasyeva nirvāṇaṃ vimokṣas tasya cetasaḥ" iti|
analyzed: pradīpasya iva nirvāṇam vimokṣaḥ tasya cetasaḥ iti

original: anye tu savāsanakleśasamucchedād viśuddhavijñānotpāda eva mokṣa ity ācakṣate tān pratyāha --- tatreti| tatra hānaṃ tāvad dūṣayati --- hāne tasyeti| na hi prekṣāvān kaścid ātmocchedāya yatate| nanu dṛśyante tīvragadonmūlitasakalasukhāṃ duḥkhamayīm iva mūrtim udvahantaḥ svocchedāya yatamānāḥ| satyam|
analyzed: anye tu sa vāsana kleśa samucchedāt viśuddha vijñāna utpādaḥ eva mokṣaḥ iti ācakṣate tān pratyāha tatra iti tatra hānam tāvat dūṣayati hāne tasya iti na hi prekṣāvān kaścid ātma ucchedāya yatate nanu dṛśyante tīvra gada unmūlita sakala sukhām duḥkha mayīm iva mūrtim udvahantaḥ sva ucchedāya yatamānāḥ satyam

original: kecid eva te, na tv evaṃ saṃsāriṇo vividhavicitradevādyānandabhogabhāginas te 'pi ca mokṣamāṇā dṛśyante tasmād apuruṣārthatvaprasakter na hātuḥ svarūpocchedo mokṣo'bhyupeyaḥ| astu tarhi hātuḥ svarūpam upādeyam ity ata āha --- upādāne ca hetuvādaḥ| upādāne hi kāryatvenānityatve sati mokṣatvād eva cyaveta| amṛtatvaṃ hi mokṣaḥ|
analyzed: kecid eva te na tu evam saṃsāriṇaḥ vividha vicitra deva ādi ānanda bhoga bhāginaḥ te ca mokṣamāṇāḥ dṛśyante tasmāt apuruṣa artha tva prasakteḥ na hātuḥ svarūpa ucchedaḥ mokṣaḥ abhyupeyaḥ astu tarhi hātuḥ svarūpam upādeyam iti atas āha upādāne ca hetuvādaḥ upādāne hi kārya tvena anitya tve sati mokṣa tvāt eva cyaveta amṛta tvam hi mokṣaḥ

original: nāpi viśuddho vijñānasaṃtāno bhavaty amṛtaḥ| saṃtānibhyo vyatiriktasya saṃtānasya vastusato'bhāvāt| saṃtānināṃ cānityatvāt| tasmāt tathā yatitavyaṃ yathā śāśvatavādo bhavati| tathā ca puruṣārthatāpavargasyety āha --- ubhayapratyākhyāna iti| tasmāt svarūpāvasthānam evātmano mokṣa iti| etad eva samyagdarśanam||2.15||
analyzed: na api viśuddhaḥ vijñāna saṃtānaḥ bhavati amṛtaḥ saṃtānibhyaḥ vyatiriktasya saṃtānasya vastu satobhāvāt saṃtāninām ca anitya tvāt tasmāt tathā yatitavyam yathā śāśvata vādaḥ bhavati tathā ca puruṣa artha tā apavargasya iti āha ubhaya pratyākhyāne iti tasmāt svarūpa avasthānam eva ātmanaḥ mokṣaḥ iti etat eva samyak darśanam

original: heyaṃ duḥkham anāgatam||2.16||
analyzed: heyam duḥkham anāgatam

original: tad etac chāstraṃ caturvyūham ity abhidhīyate --- heyaṃ duḥkham anāgatam| anāgatam ity atītavartamāne vyavacchinne| tatropapattim āha --- duḥkham atītam iti| nanu vartamānam upabhujyamānaṃ na bhogenātivāhitam iti kasmān na heyam ity ata āha --- vartamānaṃ ceti| sugamam||2.16||
analyzed: tat etat śāstram catur vyūham iti abhidhīyate heyam duḥkham anāgatam anāgatam iti atīta vartamāne vyavacchinne tatra upapattim āha duḥkham atītam iti nanu vartamānam upabhujyamānam na bhogena ativāhitam iti kasmāt na heyam iti atas āha vartamānam ca iti sugamam

original: draṣṭṛdṛśyayoḥ saṃyogo heyahetuḥ||2.17||
analyzed: draṣṭṛ dṛśyayoḥ saṃyogaḥ heya hetuḥ

original: heyam uktaṃ tasya nidānam ucyate --- draṣṭṛdṛśyayoḥ saṃyogo heyahetuḥ| draṣṭuḥ svarūpam āha --- draṣṭeti| citicchāyāpattir eva buddher buddhipratisaṃveditvam udāsīnasyāpi puṃsaḥ| nanv etāvatāpi buddhir evānena dṛśyeta, na dṛśyerañ śabdādayo'tyantavyavahitā ity ata āha --- dṛśyā buddhisattveti|
analyzed: heyam uktam tasya nidānam ucyate draṣṭṛ dṛśyayoḥ saṃyogaḥ heya hetuḥ draṣṭuḥ svarūpam āha draṣṭā iti citi chāyā āpattiḥ eva buddheḥ buddhi pratisaṃvedi tvam udāsīnasya api puṃsaḥ nanu etāvatā api buddhiḥ eva anena dṛśyeta na dṛśyeran śabda ādayaḥ atyanta vyavahitāḥ iti atas āha dṛśyāḥ buddhi sattva iti

original: indriyapraṇālikayā buddhau śabdādyākāreṇa pariṇatāyāṃ dṛśyāyāṃ bhavanti śabdādayo'pi dharmā dṛśyā ity arthaḥ| nanu tadākārāpattyā buddhiḥ śabdādyākārā bhavatu puṃsas tu buddhisaṃbandhe'bhyupagamyamāne pariṇāmitvam asaṃbandhe vā kathaṃ teṣāṃ buddhisattvopārūḍhānām api śabdādīnāṃ dṛśyatvam|
analyzed: indriya praṇālikayā buddhau śabda ādi ākāreṇa pariṇatāyām dṛśyāyām bhavanti śabda ādayaḥ api dharmāḥ dṛśyāḥ iti arthaḥ nanu tad ākāra āpattyā buddhiḥ śabda ādi ākārā bhavatu puṃsaḥ tu buddhi saṃbandha abhyupagamyamāne pariṇāmi tvam asaṃbandhe vā katham teṣām buddhi sattva upārūḍhānām api śabda ādīnām dṛśya tvam

original: na hi dṛśināsaṃspṛṣṭaṃ dṛśyaṃ dṛṣṭam ity ata āha --- tad etad dṛśyam iti| prapañcitam idam asmābhiḥ prathamapāda eva yathā cityāsaṃpṛktam api buddhisattvam atyantasvacchatayā citibimbodgrāhitayā samāpannacaitanyam iva śabdādy anubhavatīti|
analyzed: na hi dṛśinā a saṃspṛṣṭam dṛśyam dṛṣṭam iti atas āha tat etat dṛśyam iti prapañcitam idam asmābhiḥ prathama pāde eva yathā cityā asaṃpṛktam api buddhi sattvam atyanta svaccha tayā citi bimba udgrāhi tayā samāpanna caitanyam iva śabda ādi anubhavati iti

original: ata eva ca śabdādyākārapariṇatabuddhisattvopanītāñ śabdādīn bhuñjānaḥ svāmī bhavati draṣṭā tādṛśaṃ cāsya buddhisattvaṃ svaṃ bhavati| tad etad buddhisattvaṃ śabdādyākāravad dṛśyam ayaskāntamaṇikalpaṃ puruṣasya svaṃ bhavati dṛśirūpasya svāminaḥ| kasmāt, anubhavakarmaviṣayatām āpannaṃ yataḥ|
analyzed: atas eva ca śabda ādi ākāra pariṇata buddhi sattva upanītān śabda ādīn bhuñjānaḥ svāmī bhavati draṣṭā tādṛśam ca asya buddhi sattvam svam bhavati tat etat buddhi sattvam śabda ādi ākāravat dṛśyam ayaskānta maṇi kalpam puruṣasya svam bhavati dṛśi rūpasya svāminaḥ kasmāt anubhava karma viṣaya tām āpannam yatas

original: anubhavo bhogaḥ puruṣasya karma kriyā tadviṣayatāṃ bhujyamānatām āpannaṃ yasmād ataḥ svaṃ bhavati| nanu svayaṃprakāśaṃ buddhisattvaṃ katham anubhavaviṣaya ity ata āha --- anyasvarūpeṇeti| yadi hi caitanyarūpaṃ vastuto buddhisattvaṃ syād bhavet svayaṃprakāśaṃ kiṃ tu svaṃ caitanyād anyaj jaḍarūpaṃ tena pratilabdhātmakaṃ tasmāt tadanubhavaviṣayaḥ|
analyzed: anubhavaḥ bhogaḥ puruṣasya karma kriyā tad viṣaya tām bhujyamāna tām āpannam yasmāt atas svam bhavati nanu svayam prakāśam buddhi sattvam katham anubhava viṣayaḥ iti atas āha anya svarūpeṇa iti yadi hi caitanya rūpam vastutas buddhi sattvam syāt bhavet svayam prakāśam kim tu svam caitanyāt anyat jaḍa rūpam tena pratilabdha ātmakam tasmāt tad anubhava viṣayaḥ

original: nanu yasya hi yatra kiṃcid āyatate tat tadadhīnam| na ca buddhisattvasya puruṣam udāsīnaṃ prati kiṃcid āyatata iti kathaṃ tattantram| tathā ca na tasya karmety ata āha --- svatantram api parārthatvāt puruṣārthatvāt paratantraṃ puruṣatantram| nanv ayaṃ dṛgdarśanaśaktyoḥ saṃbandhaḥ svābhāviko vā syān naimittiko vā|
analyzed: nanu yasya hi yatra kiṃcid āyatate tat tad adhīnam na ca buddhi sattvasya puruṣam udāsīnam prati kiṃcid āyatate iti katham tat tantram tathā ca na tasya karma iti atas āha svatantram api para artha tvāt puruṣa artha tvāt paratantram puruṣa tantram nanu ayam dṛś darśana śaktyoḥ saṃbandhaḥ svābhāvikaḥ vā syāt naimittikaḥ vā

original: svābhāvikatve saṃbandhinor nityatvād aśakyocchedaḥ saṃbandhas tathā ca saṃsāranityatvam| naimittikatve tu kleśakarmatadvāsanānām antaḥkaraṇavṛttitayā saty antaḥkaraṇe bhāvād antaḥkaraṇasya ca tannimittatve parasparāśrayaprasaṅgād anāditvasya ca sargādāv asaṃbhavād anutpāda eva saṃsārasya syāt| yathoktam ---
analyzed: svābhāvika tve saṃbandhinoḥ nitya tvāt aśakya ucchedaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tathā ca saṃsāra nitya tvam naimittika tve tu kleśa karma tad vāsanānām antaḥkaraṇa vṛtti tayā sati antaḥkaraṇe bhāvāt antaḥkaraṇasya ca tad nimitta tve paraspara āśraya prasaṅgāt anādi tvasya ca sarga ādau asaṃbhavāt anutpādaḥ eva saṃsārasya syāt yathā uktam

original: "pumān akartā yeṣāṃ tu teṣām api guṇaiḥ kriyā| katham ādau bhavet tatra karma tāvan na vidyate|| mithyājñānaṃ na tatrāsti rāgadveṣādayo'pi vā| manovṛttir hi sarveṣāṃ na cotpannaṃ manas tadā||"
analyzed: pumān akartā yeṣām tu teṣām api guṇaiḥ kriyā katham ādau bhavet tatra karma tāvat na vidyate mithyājñānam na tatra asti rāga dveṣa ādayaḥ api vā manaḥ vṛttiḥ hi sarveṣām na ca utpannam manaḥ tadā

original: iti śaṅkām apanayati --- tayor dṛgdarśanaśaktyor anādir arthakṛtaḥ saṃyogo heyahetuḥ| satyam| na svābhāvikaḥ saṃbandho naimittikas tu| na caivam ādimān anādinimittaprabhavatayā tasyāpy anāditvāt|

original: bhogāpavargārtham iti sūtrāvayavam avatārayati --- tat tu nāprayojanam api tu prayojanam urarīkṛtya pravartate| bhogaṃ vivṛṇoti --- tatreti| sukhaduḥkhe hi triguṇāyā buddheḥ svarūpe tasyās tathātvena pariṇāmāt tathāpi guṇagatatayāvadhāraṇe na bhoga ity ata āha --- avibhāgāpannam iti| etac cāsakṛd vivecitam| apavargaṃ vivṛṇoti --- bhoktur iti|

original: paramārthatas tu --- buddher eva puruṣārthāparisamāptir iti| etena bhogāpavargayoḥ puruṣasaṃbandhitvakathanamārgeṇa grahaṇādayo'pi puruṣasaṃbandhino veditavyāḥ| tatra svarūpamātreṇārthajñānaṃ grahaṇaṃ, tatra smṛtir dhāraṇaṃ, tadgatānāṃ viśeṣāṇām ūhanam ūhaḥ, samāropitānāṃ ca yuktyāpanayo'pohaḥ| tābhyām evohāpohābhyāṃ tadavadhāraṇaṃ tattvajñānam|

original: rājasasya karmendiyāṇi| manas tūbhayātmakam ubhayapradhānasyeti mantavyam| atra ca pañcatanmātrāṇi buddhikāraṇakāny aviśeṣatvād asmitāvad iti| vikārahetutvaṃ cāviśeṣatvaṃ tanmātreṣu cāsmitāyāṃ cāviśiṣṭam| saṃkalayya viśeṣān parigaṇayati --- guṇānām eṣa iti| aviśeṣān api gaṇayati --- ṣaḍ iti| saṃkalayyodāharati --- tadyatheti|
analyzed: rājasasya karma indiyāṇi manaḥ tu ubhaya ātmakam ubhaya pradhānasya iti mantavyam atra ca pañca tanmātrāṇi buddhi kāraṇakāni aviśeṣa tvāt asmitā vat iti vikāra hetu tvam ca aviśeṣa tvam tanmātreṣu ca asmitāyām ca aviśiṣṭam saṃkalayya viśeṣān parigaṇayati guṇānām eṣaḥ iti aviśeṣān api gaṇayati ṣaṣ iti saṃkalayya udāharati tat yathā iti

original: viśiṣṭaṃ hy aparaṃ pareṇeti gandha ātmanā pañcalakṣaṇo rasa ātmanā caturlakṣaṇo rūpam ātmanā trilakṣaṇaṃ sparśa ātmanā dvilakṣaṇaḥ śabdaḥ śabdalakṣaṇa eveti| kasya punar amī ṣaḍaviśeṣāḥ kāryam ity ata āha --- ete sattāmātrasyātmana iti| puruṣārthakriyākṣamaṃ sat tasya bhāvaḥ sattā tanmātraṃ tan mahattattvam|
analyzed: viśiṣṭam hi aparam pareṇa iti gandhaḥ ātmanā pañca lakṣaṇaḥ rasaḥ ātmanā catur lakṣaṇaḥ rūpam ātmanā tri lakṣaṇam sparśaḥ ātmanā dvi lakṣaṇaḥ śabdaḥ śabda lakṣaṇaḥ eva iti kasya punar amī ṣaṣ aviśeṣāḥ kāryam iti atas āha ete sattā mātrasya ātmanaḥ iti puruṣa artha kriyā kṣamam sat tasya bhāvaḥ sattā tanmātram tat mahat tattvam

original: yāvatī kācit puruṣārthakriyā śabdādibhogalakṣaṇā sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātilakṣaṇā vāsti sā sarvā mahati buddhau samāpyata ity arthaḥ| ātmana iti svarūpopadarśanena tucchatvaṃ niṣedhati| prakṛter ayam ādyaḥ pariṇāmo vāstavo na tu tadvivarta iti yāvat|
analyzed: yāvatī kācid puruṣa arthakriyā śabda ādi bhoga lakṣaṇā sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti lakṣaṇā vā asti sā sarvā mahati buddhau samāpyate iti arthaḥ ātmanaḥ iti svarūpa upadarśanena tuccha tvam niṣedhati prakṛteḥ ayam ādyaḥ pariṇāmaḥ vāstavaḥ na tu tad vivartaḥ iti yāvat

original: yat tatparaṃ viprakṛṣṭakālam aviśeṣebhyas tadapekṣayā saṃnikṛṣṭakālebhyo liṅgamātraṃ mahattattvaṃ tasminn ete ṣaḍaviśeṣāḥ sattāmātre mahaty ātmany avasthāya satkāryavādasiddher vivṛddhikāṣṭhām anubhavanti prāpnuvanti| ye punar aviśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣapariṇāmās teṣāṃ ca dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāḥ pariṇāmā iti| seyam eṣāṃ vivṛddhikāṣṭhā pariṇāmakāṣṭheti|
analyzed: yat tat param viprakṛṣṭa kālam aviśeṣebhyaḥ tad apekṣayā saṃnikṛṣṭa kālebhyaḥ liṅgamātram mahat tattvam tasmin ete ṣaṣ aviśeṣāḥ sattā mātre mahati ātmani avasthāya satkārya vāda siddheḥ vivṛddhi kāṣṭhām anubhavanti prāpnuvanti ye punar aviśeṣāṇām viśeṣa pariṇāmāḥ teṣām ca dharma lakṣaṇa avasthāḥ pariṇāmāḥ iti sā iyam eṣām vivṛddhi kāṣṭhā pariṇāma kāṣṭhā iti

original: tad evam utpattikramam abhidhāya pralayakramam āha --- pratisaṃsṛjyamānāḥ pralīyamānāḥ svātmani līnaviśeṣā aviśeṣās tasminn eva sattāmātre mahaty ātmany avasthāya vilīya sahaiva mahatā te 'viśeṣā avyaktam anyatra layaṃ na gacchatīty aliṅgaṃ pratiyanti|
analyzed: tat evam utpatti kramam abhidhāya pralaya kramam āha pratisaṃsṛjyamānāḥ pralīyamānāḥ sva ātmani līna viśeṣāḥ aviśeṣāḥ tasmin eva sattā mātre mahati ātmani avasthāya vilīya saha eva mahatā te viśeṣāḥ avyaktam anyatra layam na gacchati iti aliṅgam pratiyanti

original: tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ niḥsattāsattaṃ sattā puruṣārthakriyākṣamatvam, asattā tucchatā niṣkrāntaṃ sattāyā asattāyāś ca yat tat tathoktam| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- sattvarajastamasāṃ sāmyāvasthā na kvacit puruṣārtha upayujyata iti na satī nāpi gaganakamalinīva tucchasvabhāvā tena nāsaty apīti| syād etat|
analyzed: tasya eva viśeṣaṇam niḥsattā asattam sattā puruṣa artha kriyā kṣama tvam asattā tuccha tā niṣkrāntam sattāyāḥ asattāyāḥ ca yat tat tathā uktam etat uktam bhavati sattva rajaḥ tamasām sāmya avasthā na kvacid puruṣa arthe upayujyate iti na satī nā api gagana kamalinī iva tuccha svabhāvā tena nā asatī api iti syāt etat

original: avyaktāvasthāyām apy asti mahadādi tadātmanā, na hi sato vināśo vināśe vā na punarutpādo na hy asata utpāda iti mahadādisadbhāvāt puruṣārthakriyā pravarteta tat kathaṃ niḥsattvam avyaktam ity ata āha --- niḥsadasad iti| niṣkrāntaṃ kāraṇaṃ sataḥ kāryāt|
analyzed: avyakta avasthāyām api asti mahat ādi tad ātmanā na hi sataḥ vināśaḥ vināśe vā na punarutpādaḥ na hi asataḥ utpādaḥ iti mahat ādi sadbhāvāt puruṣa arthakriyā pravarteta tat katham niḥsattvam avyaktam iti atas āha niḥsadasat iti niṣkrāntam kāraṇam sataḥ kāryāt

original: yady api kāraṇāvasthāyāṃ sad eva śaktyātmanā kāryaṃ tathāpi svocitām arthakriyām akurvad asad ity uktam| na caitat kāraṇaṃ śaśaviṣāṇāyamānakāryam ity āha --- nirasad iti| niṣkrāntam asatas tuccharūpāt kāryāt tathā sati hi vyomāravindam ivāsmān na kāryam utpadyeteti bhāvaḥ| pratisargam uktam upasaṃharati --- eṣa teṣām iti|
analyzed: yadi api kāraṇa avasthāyām sat eva śakti ātmanā kāryam tathā api svocitām arthakriyām akurvat asat iti uktam na ca etat kāraṇam śaśaviṣāṇāyamāna kāryam iti āha nirasat iti niṣkrāntam asataḥ tuccha rūpāt kāryāt tathā sati hi vyoma aravindam iva asmāt na kāryam utpadyeta iti bhāvaḥ pratisargam uktam upasaṃharati eṣa teṣām iti

original: eṣa ity anantaroktāt pūrvasya parāmarśaḥ| liṅgamātrādyavasthāḥ puruṣārthakṛtatvād anityā aliṅgāvasthā tu puruṣārthenākṛtatvān nityety atra hetum āha --- aliṅgāvasthāyām iti| kasmāt punar na puruṣārtho hetur ity ata āha --- nāliṅgāvasthāyām iti| bhavatinā viṣayeṇa viṣayijñānam upalakṣayati|
analyzed: eṣaḥ iti anantara uktāt pūrvasya parāmarśaḥ liṅga mātra ādi avasthāḥ puruṣa artha kṛta tvāt anityāḥ aliṅga avasthā tu puruṣa arthena akṛta tvāt nityā iti atra hetum āha aliṅga avasthāyām iti kasmāt punar na puruṣa arthaḥ hetuḥ iti atas āha na aliṅga avasthāyām iti bhavatinā viṣayeṇa viṣayi jñānam upalakṣayati

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- evaṃ hi puruṣārthatā kāraṇam aliṅgāvasthāyāṃ jñāyeta| yady aliṅgāvasthā śabdādyupabhogaṃ vā sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātiṃ vā puruṣārthaṃ nirvartayet tannirvartane hi na sāmyāvasthā syāt| tasmāt puruṣārthakāraṇatvam asyāṃ na jñāyata iti nāsyāḥ puruṣārthatā hetuḥ| upasaṃharati --- nāsāv iti| itis tasmādarthe|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati evam hi puruṣa artha tā kāraṇam aliṅga avasthāyām jñāyeta yadi aliṅga avasthā śabda ādi upabhogam vā sattva puruṣa anya tā khyātim vā puruṣa artham nirvartayet tad nirvartane hi na sāmya avasthā syāt tasmāt puruṣa artha kāraṇa tvam asyām na jñāyate iti na asyāḥ puruṣa artha tā hetuḥ upasaṃharati na asau iti itiḥ tasmāt arthe

original: anityām avasthām āha --- trayāṇāṃ liṅgamātrāviśeṣaviśeṣāṇām iti| parvasvarūpaṃ darśayitvā guṇasvarūpam āha --- guṇās tv iti| nidarśanam āha --- yathā devadatta iti| yatrātyantabhinnānāṃ gavām upacayāpacayau devadattopacayāpacayahetū tatra kaiva kathā guṇebhyo bhinnābhinnānāṃ vyaktīnām upajanāpāyayor ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: anityām avasthām āha trayāṇām liṅga mātrā viśeṣa viśeṣāṇām iti parva svarūpam darśayitvā guṇa svarūpam āha guṇāḥ tu iti nidarśanam āha yathā devadattaḥ iti yatra atyanta bhinnānām gavām upacaya apacayau devadatta upacaya apacaya hetū tatra kā eva kathā guṇebhyaḥ bhinna abhinnānām vyaktīnām upajana apāyayoḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sargakramaḥ kim aniyato nety āha --- liṅgamātram iti| na khalu nyagrodhadhānā ahnāyaiva nyagrodhaśākhinaṃ sāndraśādvaladalajaṭilaśākhākāṇḍanipītamārtaṇḍacaṇḍātapamaṇḍalam ārabhante kiṃ tu kṣitisalilatejaḥsaṃparkāt paramparayopajāyamānāṅkurapatrakāṇḍanālādikrameṇa| evam ihāpi yuktyāgamasiddhaḥ krama āstheya iti|
analyzed: nanu sarga kramaḥ kim aniyataḥ na iti āha liṅga mātram iti na khalu nyagrodha dhānāḥ ahnāya eva nyagrodha śākhinam sāndra śādvala dala jaṭila śākhā kāṇḍa nipīta mārtaṇḍa caṇḍa ātapa maṇḍalam ārabhante kim tu kṣiti salila tejaḥ saṃparkāt paramparayā upajāyamāna aṅkura patra kāṇḍa nāla ādi krameṇa evam iha api yukti āgama siddhaḥ kramaḥ āstheyaḥ iti

original: kathaṃ bhūtendriyāṇy aviśeṣasaṃsṛṣṭānīty ata āha --- tathā coktaṃ purastād idam eva sūtraṃ prathamaṃ vyācakṣāṇaiḥ| atha viśeṣāṇāṃ kasmān na tattvāntarapariṇāma ukta ity ata āha --- na viśeṣebhya iti| tat kim idānīm apariṇāmina eva viśeṣās tathā ca nityāḥ prasajyerann ity ata āha --- teṣāṃ tv iti||2.19||
analyzed: katham bhūta indriyāṇi aviśeṣa saṃsṛṣṭāni iti atas āha tathā ca uktam purastāt idam eva sūtram prathamam vyācakṣāṇaiḥ atha viśeṣāṇām kasmāt na tattva antara pariṇāmaḥ uktaḥ iti atas āha na viśeṣebhyaḥ iti tat kim idānīm apariṇāminaḥ eva viśeṣāḥ tathā ca nityāḥ prasajyeran iti atas āha teṣām tu iti

original: draṣṭā dṛśimātraḥ śuddho'pi pratyayānupaśyaḥ||2.20||
analyzed: draṣṭā dṛśi mātraḥ śuddhaḥ api pratyaya anupaśyaḥ

original: vyākhyātaṃ dṛśyaṃ draṣṭuḥ svarūpāvadhāraṇārtham idam ārabhyate --- draṣṭā dṛśimātraḥ śuddho'pi pratyayānupaśyaḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- dṛśimātra iti| viśeṣaṇāni dharmās tair aparāmṛṣṭā| tad anena mātragrahaṇasya tātparyaṃ darśitam| syād etat| yadi sarvaviśeṣaṇarahitā dṛkśaktir na tarhi śabdādayo dṛśyeran|
analyzed: vyākhyātam dṛśyam draṣṭuḥ svarūpa avadhāraṇa artham idam ārabhyate draṣṭā dṛśi mātraḥ śuddhaḥ api pratyaya anupaśyaḥ vyācaṣṭe dṛśi mātraḥ iti viśeṣaṇāni dharmāḥ taiḥ aparāmṛṣṭā tat anena mātra grahaṇasya tātparyam darśitam syāt etat yadi sarva viśeṣaṇa rahitā dṛkśaktiḥ na tarhi śabda ādayaḥ dṛśyeran

original: na hi dṛśināsaṃspṛṣṭaṃ dṛśyaṃ bhavatīty ata āha --- sa puruṣa iti| buddhidarpaṇe puruṣapratibimbasaṃkrāntir eva buddhipratisaṃveditvaṃ puṃsaḥ| tathā ca dṛśicchāyāpannayā buddhyā saṃsṛṣṭāḥ śabdādayo bhavanti dṛśyā ity arthaḥ| syād etat|
analyzed: na hi dṛśinā a saṃspṛṣṭam dṛśyam bhavati iti atas āha sa puruṣaḥ iti buddhi darpaṇe puruṣa pratibimba saṃkrāntiḥ eva buddhi pratisaṃvedi tvam puṃsaḥ tathā ca dṛśi chāyā āpannayā buddhyā saṃsṛṣṭāḥ śabda ādayaḥ bhavanti dṛśyāḥ iti arthaḥ syāt etat

original: pāramārthikam eva buddhicaitanyayoḥ kasmād aikyaṃ nopeyate kim anayā tacchāyāpattyety ata āha --- sa buddher na sarūpa iti| tathāsarūpasya tacchāyāpattir api durghaṭety ata āha --- nātyantaṃ virūpa iti| tatra sārūpyaṃ niṣedhati --- na tāvad iti| hetuṃ pṛcchati --- kasmāt| sahetukaṃ vairūpye hetum āha --- jñāteti|
analyzed: pāramārthikam eva buddhi caitanyayoḥ kasmāt aikyam nā upeyate kim anayā tad chāyā āpattyā iti atas āha sa buddheḥ na sarūpaḥ iti tathā asarūpasya tad chāyā āpattiḥ api durghaṭā iti atas āha na atyantam virūpaḥ iti tatra sārūpyam niṣedhati na tāvat iti hetum pṛcchati kasmāt sa hetukam vairūpye hetum āha jñātā iti

original: pariṇāminī buddhir yasmāt tasmād virūpā| yadā khalv iyaṃ śabdādyākārā bhavati tadā jñāto 'syāḥ śabdādilakṣaṇo bhavati viṣayas tadanākāratve tv ajñātas tathā ca kadācid eva tadākāratāṃ dadhatī pariṇāminīti| prayogaś ca bhavati --- buddhiḥ pariṇāminī jñātājñātaviṣayatvāc chrotrādivad iti|
analyzed: pariṇāminī buddhiḥ yasmāt tasmāt virūpā yadā khalu iyam śabda ādi ākārā bhavati tadā syāḥ śabda ādi lakṣaṇaḥ bhavati viṣayaḥ tad anākāra tve tu ajñātaḥ tathā ca kadācid eva tad ākāra tām dadhatī pariṇāminī iti prayogaḥ ca bhavati buddhiḥ pariṇāminī jñāta ajñāta viṣaya tvāt śrotra ādi vat iti

original: tadvaidharmyaṃ puruṣasya tadviparītād dhetoḥ sidhyatīty āha --- sadeti| syād etat| sadājñātaviṣayaś cet puruṣo na tarhi kevalī syād ity āśayavān pṛcchati --- kasmād iti| uttaram --- na hi buddhiś ca nāmeti| buddhyagrahaṇayor asti sahasaṃbhavo nirodhāvasthāyām ata ukta virodhasūcanāya puruṣaviṣayaś ceti|
analyzed: tad vaidharmyam puruṣasya tad viparītāt hetoḥ sidhyati iti āha sadā iti syāt etat sadā ajñāta viṣayaḥ ced puruṣaḥ na tarhi kevalī syāt iti āśayavān pṛcchati kasmāt iti uttaram na hi buddhiḥ ca nāma iti buddhi agrahaṇayoḥ asti saha saṃbhavaḥ nirodha avasthāyām atas ukta virodha sūcanāya puruṣa viṣayaḥ ca iti

original: tenādyaś cakāro buddhiṃ viṣayatvena samuccinoti| pariśiṣṭau tu virodhadyotakau cakārāv iti| prayogas tu puruṣo'pariṇāmī sadāsaṃprajñātavyutthānāvasthayor jñātaviṣayatvāt| yas tu pariṇāmī nāsau sadājñātaviṣayo yathā śrotrādir iti vyatirekī hetuḥ| aparam api vaidharmyam āha --- kiṃ ca parārtheti|
analyzed: tena ādyaḥ cakāraḥ buddhim viṣaya tvena samuccinoti pariśiṣṭau tu virodha dyotakau cakārau iti prayogaḥ tu puruṣa upariṇāmī sadā saṃprajñāta vyutthāna avasthayoḥ jñāta viṣaya tvāt yaḥ tu pariṇāmī na asau sadā ajñāta viṣayaḥ yathā śrotra ādiḥ iti vyatirekī hetuḥ aparam api vaidharmyam āha kim ca parārtha iti

original: buddhiḥ khalu kleśakarmavāsanādibhir viṣayendriyādibhiś ca saṃhatya puruṣārtham abhinirvartayantī parārthā| prayogaś ca parārthā buddhiḥ saṃhatyakāritvāc chayanāsanābhyaṅgavad iti| puruṣas tu na tathety āha --- svārthaḥ puruṣa iti| sarvaṃ puruṣāya kalpate| puruṣas tu na kasmaicid ity arthaḥ| vaidharmyāntaram āha --- sarveti|
analyzed: buddhiḥ khalu kleśa karma vāsanā ādibhiḥ viṣaya indriya ādibhiḥ ca saṃhatya puruṣa artham abhinirvartayantī parārthā prayogaḥ ca parārthā buddhiḥ saṃhatya kāri tvāt śayana āsana abhyaṅga vat iti puruṣaḥ tu na tathā iti āha svārthaḥ puruṣaḥ iti sarvam puruṣāya kalpate puruṣaḥ tu na kasmaicid iti arthaḥ vaidharmya antaram āha sarva iti

original: sarvān arthāñ śāntaghoramūḍhāṃs tadākārapariṇatā buddhir adhyavasyati sattvarajastamasāṃ caite pariṇāmā iti siddhā triguṇā buddhir iti| na caivaṃ puruṣa ity āha --- guṇānām iti| tatpratibimbitaḥ paśyati na tu tadākārapariṇata ity arthaḥ| upasaṃharati --- ata iti| astu tarhi virūpa iti| nātyantaṃ virūpaḥ kasmād yataḥ śuddho'pi pratyayānupaśyaḥ|
analyzed: sarvān arthān śānta ghora mūḍhān tad ākāra pariṇatā buddhiḥ adhyavasyati sattva rajaḥ tamasām ca ete pariṇāmāḥ iti siddhā triguṇā buddhiḥ iti na ca evam puruṣaḥ iti āha guṇānām iti tad pratibimbitaḥ paśyati na tu tad ākāra pariṇataḥ iti arthaḥ upasaṃharati atas iti astu tarhi virūpaḥ iti na atyantam virūpaḥ kasmāt yatas śuddhaḥ api pratyaya anupaśyaḥ

original: yathā caitat tathoktaṃ "vṛttisārūpyam itaratra" ity atra| tathā coktaṃ pañcaśikhenāpariṇāminī hi bhoktṛśaktir ātmā| ata eva buddhāv apratisaṃkramā ca pariṇāmini buddhirūpe 'rthe saṃkrānteva tadvṛttiṃ buddhivṛttim anupatati| nanv asaṃkrāntā kathaṃ saṃkrānteva kathaṃ vā vṛttiṃ vinānupatatīty ata āha --- tasyāś ceti|
analyzed: yathā ca etat tathā uktam vṛtti sārūpyam itaratra iti atra tathā ca uktam pañcaśikhena apariṇāminī hi bhoktṛ śaktiḥ ātmā atas eva buddhau apratisaṃkramā ca pariṇāmini buddhi rūpe rthe saṃkrāntā iva tad vṛttim buddhi vṛttim anupatati nanu asaṃkrāntā katham saṃkrāntā iva katham vā vṛttim vinā anupatati iti atas āha tasyāḥ ca iti

original: prāptaś caitanyopagraha uparāgo yena rūpeṇa tat tathā prāptacaitanyopagrahaṃ rūpaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- yathā nirmale jale 'saṃkrānto'pi candramāḥ saṃkrāntapratibimbatayā saṃkrānta iva, evam atrāpy asaṃkrāntāpi saṃkrāntapratibimbā citiśaktiḥ saṃkrānteva| tena buddhyātmatvam āpannā buddhivṛttim anupatatīti|
analyzed: prāptaḥ caitanya upagrahaḥ uparāgaḥ yena rūpeṇa tat tathā prāpta caitanya upagraham rūpam yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā etat uktam bhavati yathā nirmale jale saṃkrāntaḥ api candramāḥ saṃkrānta pratibimba tayā saṃkrāntaḥ iva evam atra api a saṃkrāntā api saṃkrānta pratibimbā citi śaktiḥ saṃkrāntā iva tena buddhi ātma tvam āpannā buddhi vṛttim anupatati iti

original: tad anenānupaśya iti vyākhyātaṃ tām anukāreṇa paśyatīty anupaśya iti||2.20||
analyzed: tat anena anupaśye iti vyākhyātam tām anukāreṇa paśyati iti anupaśye iti

original: tadartha eva dṛśyasyātmā||2.21||
analyzed: tad arthaḥ eva dṛśyasya ātmā

original: draṣṭṛdṛśyayoḥ svarūpam uktvā svasvāmilakṣaṇasaṃbandhāṅgaṃ dṛśyasya draṣṭrarthatvam āha --- tadartha eva dṛśyasyātmā| vyācaṣṭe --- dṛśirūpasya puruṣasya bhoktuḥ karmarūpatāṃ bhogyatām āpannaṃ dṛśyam iti tasmāt tadartha eva draṣṭrartha eva dṛśyasyātmā bhavati na tu dṛśyārthaḥ| nanu nātmātmārtha ity ata āha --- svarūpaṃ bhavatīti|
analyzed: draṣṭṛ dṛśyayoḥ svarūpam uktvā sva svāmi lakṣaṇa saṃbandha aṅgam dṛśyasya draṣṭṛ artha tvam āha tad arthaḥ eva dṛśyasya ātmā vyācaṣṭe dṛśi rūpasya puruṣasya bhoktuḥ karma rūpa tām bhogya tām āpannam dṛśyam iti tasmāt tad arthaḥ eva draṣṭṛ arthaḥ eva dṛśyasya ātmā bhavati na tu dṛśya arthaḥ nanu na ātmā ātma arthaḥ iti atas āha sva rūpam bhavati iti

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- sukhaduḥkhātmakaṃ dṛśyaṃ bhogyam| sukhaduḥkhe cānukūlayitṛpratikūlayitṛṇī tattvena tadarthe eva vyavatiṣṭhete| viṣayā api hi śabdādayas tādātmyād eva cānukūlayitāraḥ pratikūlayitāraś ca| na cātmaivaiṣām anukūlanīyaḥ pratikūlanīyaś ca svātmani vṛttivirodhād ataḥ pāriśeṣyāc citiśaktir evānukūlanīyā pratikūlanīyā ca|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati sukha duḥkha ātmakam dṛśyam bhogyam sukha duḥkhe ca anukūlayitṛ pratikūlayitṛṇī tattvena tad arthe eva vyavatiṣṭhete viṣayāḥ api hi śabda ādayaḥ tādātmyāt eva ca anukūlayitāraḥ pratikūlayitāraḥ ca na ca ātmā eva eṣām anukūlanīyaḥ pratikūlanīyaḥ ca svātmani vṛtti virodhāt atas pāriśeṣyāt citi śaktiḥ eva anukūlanīyā pratikūlanīyā ca

original: tasmāt tadartham eva dṛśyaṃ na tu dṛśyārtham| ataś ca tadartha eva dṛśyasyātmā na dṛśyārtho yat svarūpam asya yāvat puruṣārtham anuvartate| nirvartite ca puruṣārthe nivartata ity āha --- svarūpam iti| svarūpaṃ tu dṛśyasya jaḍaṃ pararūpeṇātmarūpeṇa caitanyena pratilabdhātmakam anubhūtasvarūpaṃ bhogāpavargārthatāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ puruṣeṇa na dṛśyate|
analyzed: tasmāt tad artham eva dṛśyam na tu dṛśya artham atas ca tad arthaḥ eva dṛśyasya ātmā na dṛśya arthaḥ yat sva rūpam asya yāvat puruṣa artham anuvartate nirvartite ca puruṣa arthe nivartate iti āha sva rūpam iti sva rūpam tu dṛśyasya jaḍam para rūpeṇa ātma rūpeṇa caitanyena pratilabdha ātmakam anubhūta sva rūpam bhoga apavarga artha tāyām kṛtāyām puruṣeṇa na dṛśyate

original: bhogaḥ sukhādyākāraḥ śabdādyanubhavo 'pavargaḥ sattvapuruṣānyatānubhavas tac caitad ubhayam apy ājānato jaḍāyā buddheḥ puruṣacchāyāpattyeti puruṣasyaiva| tathā ca puruṣabhogāpavargayoḥ kṛtayor dṛśyasya bhogāpavargārthatā samāpyata iti bhogāpavargārthatāyāṃ kṛtāyām ity uktam| atrāntare codayati --- svarūpahānād iti|
analyzed: bhogaḥ sukha ādi ākāraḥ śabda ādi anubhava upavargaḥ sattva puruṣa anya tā anubhavaḥ tat ca etat ubhayam api ājānataḥ jaḍāyāḥ buddheḥ puruṣa chāyā āpattyā iti puruṣasya eva tathā ca puruṣa bhoga apavargayoḥ kṛtayoḥ dṛśyasya bhoga apavarga artha tā samāpyate iti bhoga apavarga artha tāyām kṛtāyām iti uktam atra antare codayati sva rūpa hānāt iti

original: pariharati --- na tu vinaśyatīti||2.21||
analyzed: pariharati na tu vinaśyati iti

original: kṛtārthaṃ prati naṣṭam apy anaṣṭaṃ tadanyasādhāraṇatvāt||2.22||
analyzed: kṛtārtham prati naṣṭam api anaṣṭam tad anya sādhāraṇa tvāt

original: nanv atyantānupalabhyaṃ kathaṃ na vinaśyatīty āśayavān pṛcchati --- kasmād iti| sūtreṇottaram āha --- kṛtārthaṃ prati naṣṭam apy anaṣṭaṃ tadanyasādhāraṇatvāt| kṛto'rtho yasya puruṣasya sa tathā| taṃ prati naṣṭam apy anaṣṭaṃ tad dṛśyaṃ kutaḥ sarvān puruṣān kuśalān akuśalān prati sādhāraṇatvāt| vyācaṣṭe --- kṛtārtham ekam iti| nāśo 'darśanam|
analyzed: nanu atyanta anupalabhyam katham na vinaśyati iti āśayavān pṛcchati kasmāt iti sūtreṇa uttaram āha kṛtārtham prati naṣṭam api anaṣṭam tad anya sādhāraṇa tvāt kṛtaḥ ūrthaḥ yasya puruṣasya sa tathā tam prati naṣṭam api anaṣṭam tat dṛśyam kutas sarvān puruṣān kuśalān akuśalān prati sādhāraṇa tvāt vyācaṣṭe kṛtārtham ekam iti nāśaḥ darśanam

original: anaṣṭaṃ tu dṛśyam anyapuruṣasādhāraṇatvāt| tasmād dṛśyāt parasyātmanaś caitanyaṃ rūpaṃ tena tad iha śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇaprasiddham avyaktam anavayavam ekam anāśrayaṃ vyāpi nityaṃ viśvakāryaśaktimat| yady api kuśalena taṃ prati kṛtakāryaṃ na dṛśyate tathāpy akuśalena dṛśyamānaṃ na nāsti|
analyzed: anaṣṭam tu dṛśyam anya puruṣa sādhāraṇa tvāt tasmāt dṛśyāt parasya ātmanaḥ caitanyam rūpam tena tat iha śruti smṛti itihāsa purāṇa prasiddham avyaktam an avayavam ekam anāśrayam vyāpi nityam viśva kārya śaktimat yadi api kuśalena tam prati kṛta kāryam na dṛśyate tathā api akuśalena dṛśyamānam na na asti

original: na hi rūpam andhena na dṛśyata iti cakṣuṣmatāpi dṛśyamānam abhāvaprāptaṃ bhavati| na ca pradhānavad eka eva puruṣas tannānātvasya janmamaraṇasukhaduḥkhopabhogamuktisaṃsāravyavasthayā siddheḥ| ekatvaśrutīnāṃ ca pramāṇāntaravirodhāt kathaṃcid deśakālavibhāgābhāvena bhaktyāpy upapatteḥ| prakṛtyekatvapuruṣanānātvayoś ca śrutyaiva sākṣāt pratipādanāt|
analyzed: na hi rūpam andhena na dṛśyate iti cakṣuṣmatā api dṛśyamānam abhāva prāptam bhavati na ca pradhāna vat ekaḥ eva puruṣaḥ tad nānātvasya janma maraṇa sukha duḥkha upabhoga mukti saṃsāra vyavasthayā siddheḥ ekatva śrutīnām ca pramāṇa antara virodhāt kathaṃcid deśa kāla vibhāga abhāvena bhaktyā api upapatteḥ prakṛti ekatva puruṣa nānātvayoḥ ca śrutyā eva sākṣāt pratipādanāt

original: "ajām ekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpāḥ| ajo hy eko juṣamāṇo'nuśete jahāty enāṃ bhuktabhogām ajo'nyaḥ" iti śrutiḥ|
analyzed: ajām ekām lohita śukla kṛṣṇām bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānām sarūpāḥ ajaḥ hi ekaḥ juṣamāṇaḥ anuśete jahāti enām bhukta bhogām ajaḥ nyaḥ iti śrutiḥ

original: asyā eva śruteś cānena sūtreṇārtho'nūdita iti| yato dṛśyaṃ naṣṭam apy anaṣṭaṃ puruṣāntaraṃ praty asti ato dṛgdarśanaśaktyor nityatvād anādiḥ saṃyogo vyākhyātaḥ| atraivāgaminām anumatim āha --- tathā coktam iti| dharmiṇāṃ guṇānām ātmabhir anādisaṃyogād dharmamātrāṇāṃ mahadādīnām apy anādiḥ saṃyoga iti|
analyzed: asyāḥ eva śruteḥ ca anena sūtreṇa arthaḥ unūditaḥ iti yatas dṛśyam naṣṭam api a naṣṭam puruṣa antaram prati asti atas dṛś darśana śaktyoḥ nitya tvāt anādiḥ saṃyogaḥ vyākhyātaḥ atra eva āgaminām anumatim āha tathā ca uktam iti dharmiṇām guṇānām ātmabhiḥ anādi saṃyogāt dharma mātrāṇām mahat ādīnām api anādiḥ saṃyogaḥ iti

original: ekaikasya mahadādeḥ saṃyogo'nādir apy anitya eva yady api tathāpi sarveṣāṃ mahadādīnāṃ nityaḥ puruṣāntarāṇāṃ sādhāraṇatvād ata uktaṃ dharmamātrāṇām iti| mātragrahaṇena vyāptiṃ gamayati| ata etad bhavati --- yady apy ekasya mahataḥ saṃyogo'tītatām āpannas tathāpi mahadantarasya puruṣāntareṇa saṃyogo nātīta iti nitya uktaḥ||2.22||
analyzed: ekaikasya mahat ādeḥ saṃyogaḥ ūna ādiḥ api anityaḥ eva yadi api tathā api sarveṣām mahat ādīnām nityaḥ puruṣa antarāṇām sādhāraṇa tvāt atas uktam dharma mātrāṇām iti mātra grahaṇena vyāptim gamayati atas etat bhavati yadi api ekasya mahataḥ saṃyoga utīta tām āpannaḥ tathā api mahat antarasya puruṣa antareṇa saṃyogaḥ na atītaḥ iti nityaḥ uktaḥ

original: svasvāmiśaktyoḥ svarūpopalabdhihetuḥ saṃyogaḥ||2.23||
analyzed: sva svāmi śaktyoḥ sva rūpa upalabdhi hetuḥ saṃyogaḥ

original: tad evaṃ tādarthye saṃyogakāraṇa ukte prāsaṅgike pradhānanityatve saṃyogasāmānyanityatve hetau cokte saṃyogasya yat svarūpam asādhāraṇo viśeṣa iti yāvat tadabhidhitsayedaṃ sūtraṃ pravavṛte --- svasvāmiśaktyoḥ svarūpopalabdhihetuḥ saṃyogaḥ| yato dṛśyaṃ tadartham atas tajjanitam upakāraṃ bhajamānaḥ puruṣas tasya svāmī bhavati|
analyzed: tat evam tādarthye saṃyoga kāraṇe ukte prāsaṅgike pradhāna nitya tve saṃyoga sāmānya nitya tve hetau ca ukte saṃyogasya yat svarūpam asādhāraṇaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti yāvat tad abhidhitsayā idam sūtram pravavṛte sva svāmi śaktyoḥ sva rūpa upalabdhi hetuḥ saṃyogaḥ yatas dṛśyam tad artham atas tad janitam upakāram bhajamānaḥ puruṣaḥ tasya svāmī bhavati

original: bhavati ca tad dṛśyam asya svaṃ sa cānayoḥ saṃyogaḥ śaktimātreṇa vyavasthitas tatsvarūpopalabdhihetus tad etad bhāṣyam avadyotayati --- puruṣaḥ svāmī yogyatāmātreṇa dṛśyena svena yogyatayaiva darśanārthaṃ saṃyuktaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam| syād etat|
analyzed: bhavati ca tat dṛśyam asya svam sa ca anayoḥ saṃyogaḥ śakti mātreṇa vyavasthitaḥ tad sva rūpa upalabdhi hetuḥ tat etat bhāṣyam avadyotayati puruṣaḥ svāmī yogyatā mātreṇa dṛśyena svena yogyatayā eva darśana artham saṃyuktaḥ śeṣam sugamam syāt etat

original: draṣṭuḥ svarūpopalabdhir apavṛjyate'nenety apavarga ukto na ca mokṣaḥ sādhanavāṃs tathā saty ayaṃ mokṣatvād eva cyavetety ata āha --- darśanakāryāvasāno buddhiviśeṣeṇa saha puruṣaviśeṣasya saṃyoga iti darśanaṃ viyogakāraṇam uktam| kathaṃ punar darśanakāryāvasānatvaṃ saṃyogasyety ata āha --- darśanam iti|
analyzed: draṣṭuḥ sva rūpa upalabdhiḥ apavṛjyate enena iti apavargaḥ uktaḥ na ca mokṣaḥ sādhanavān tathā sati ayam mokṣa tvāt eva cyaveta iti atas āha darśana kārya avasānaḥ buddhi viśeṣeṇa saha puruṣa viśeṣasya saṃyogaḥ iti darśanam viyoga kāraṇam uktam katham punar darśana kārya avasāna tvam saṃyogasya iti atas āha darśanam iti

original: tataḥ kim ity ata āha --- adarśanam avidyā saṃyoganimittam ity uktam| uktam arthaṃ spaṣṭayati --- nātreti| nanu darśanam adarśanaṃ virodhi nivartayatu bandhasya kuto nivṛttir ity ata āha --- darśanasyeti| buddhyādiviviktasyātmanaḥ svarūpāvasthānaṃ mokṣa ukto na tasya sādhanaṃ darśanam api tv adarśananivṛtter ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: tatas kim iti atas āha adarśanam avidyā saṃyoga nimittam iti uktam uktam artham spaṣṭayati na atra iti nanu darśanam adarśanam virodhi nivartayatu bandhasya kutas nivṛttiḥ iti atas āha darśanasya iti buddhi ādi viviktasya ātmanaḥ svarūpa avasthānam mokṣaḥ uktaḥ na tasya sādhanam darśanam api tu adarśana nivṛtteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: asādhāraṇaṃ saṃyogahetum adarśanaviśeṣaṃ grahītum adarśanamātraṃ vikalpayati --- kiṃ cedam iti| paryudāsaṃ gṛhītvāha --- kiṃ guṇānām adhikāraḥ kāryārambhaṇasāmarthyaṃ tato hi saṃyogaḥ saṃsārahetur upajāyate| prasajyapratiṣedhaṃ gṛhītvā dvitīyaṃ vikalpam āha --- āhosvid iti|
analyzed: asādhāraṇam saṃyoga hetum adarśana viśeṣam grahītum adarśana mātram vikalpayati kim ca idam iti paryudāsam gṛhītvā āha kim guṇānām adhikāraḥ kārya ārambhaṇa sāmarthyam tatas hi saṃyogaḥ saṃsāra hetuḥ upajāyate prasajya pratiṣedham gṛhītvā dvitīyam vikalpam āha āhosvit iti

original: darśito viṣayaḥ śabdādiḥ sattvapuruṣānyatā ca yena cittena tasya tadviṣayasyānutpādaḥ| etad eva sphorayati --- svasmin dṛśye śabdādau sattvapuruṣānyatāyāṃ ceti| tāvad eva pradhānaṃ viceṣṭate na yāvad dvividhaṃ darśanam abhinirvartayati| niṣpāditobhayadarśanaṃ tu nivartata iti| paryudāsa eva tṛtīyaṃ vikalpam āha --- kim arthavattā guṇānām|
analyzed: darśitaḥ viṣayaḥ śabda ādiḥ sattva puruṣa anya tā ca yena cittena tasya tad viṣayasya anutpādaḥ etat eva sphorayati svasmin dṛśye śabda ādau sattva puruṣa anya tāyām ca iti tāvat eva pradhānam viceṣṭate na yāvat dvividham darśanam abhinirvartayati niṣpādita ubhaya darśanam tu nivartate iti paryudāsaḥ eva tṛtīyam vikalpam āha kim arthavat tā guṇānām

original: satkāryavādasiddhau hi bhāvināv api bhogāpavargārthāv avyapadeśyatayā sta ity arthaḥ| paryudāsa eva caturthaṃ vikalpam āha --- athāvidyā pratisargakāle svacittena saha niruddhā pradhānasāmyam āgatā vāsanārūpeṇa svacittotpattibījam| tena darśanād anyāvidyāvāsanaivādarśanam uktā|
analyzed: satkārya vāda siddhau hi bhāvinau api bhoga apavarga arthau a vyapadeśya tayā staḥ iti arthaḥ paryudāsaḥ eva caturtham vikalpam āha atha avidyā pratisarga kāle sva cittena saha niruddhā pradhāna sāmyam āgatā vāsanā rūpeṇa sva citta utpatti bījam tena darśanāt anya avidyā vāsanā eva adarśanam uktā

original: paryudāsa eva pañcamaṃ vikalpam āha --- kiṃ sthitisaṃskārasya pradhānavartinaḥ sāmyapariṇāmaparamparāvahinaḥ kṣaye gatir mahadādivikārārambhas taddhetuḥ saṃskāraḥ pradhānasya gatisaṃskāras tasyābhivyaktiḥ kāryonmukhatvam|
analyzed: paryudāsaḥ eva pañcamam vikalpam āha kim sthiti saṃskārasya pradhāna vartinaḥ sāmya pariṇāma paramparā vahinaḥ kṣaye gatiḥ mahat ādi vikāra ārambhaḥ tad hetuḥ saṃskāraḥ pradhānasya gati saṃskāraḥ tasya abhivyaktiḥ kārya unmukha tvam

original: tadubhayasaṃskārasadbhāve matāntarānumatim āha --- yatredam uktam aikāntikatvaṃ vyāsedhadbhiḥ, pradhīyate janyate vikārajātam aneneti pradhānaṃ tac cet sthityaiva varteta na kadācid gatyā tato vikārākaraṇān na pradhīyate tena kiṃcid ity apradhānaṃ syāt| atha gatyaiva varteta na kadācid api sthityā tatrāha --- tathā gatyaiveti|
analyzed: tad ubhaya saṃskāra sadbhāve mata antara anumatim āha yatra idam uktam aikāntika tvam vyāsedhadbhiḥ pradhīyate janyate vikāra jātam anena iti pradhānam tat ced sthityā eva varteta na kadācid gatyā tatas vikāra akaraṇāt na pradhīyate tena kiṃcid iti apradhānam syāt atha gatyā eva varteta na kadācid api sthityā tatra āha tathā gatyā eva iti

original: kvacit pāṭhaḥ "sthityai gatyai" iti| tādarthye caturthī, evakāraś ca draṣṭavyaḥ| sthityai cen na varteta na kvacid vikāro vinaśyet| tathā ca bhāvasya sato'vināśino notpattir apīti vikāratvād eva cyaveta|
analyzed: kvacid pāṭhaḥ sthityai gatyai iti tādarthye caturthī eva kāraḥ ca draṣṭavyaḥ sthityai ced na varteta na kvacid vikāraḥ vinaśyet tathā ca bhāvasya sataḥ vināśinaḥ na utpattiḥ api iti vikāra tvāt eva cyaveta

original: evaṃ ca na pradhīyate'tra kiṃcid ity apradhānaṃ syāt tad ubhayathā sthityā gatyā cāsya vṛttiḥ pradhānavyavahāraṃ labhate nānyathaikāntābhyupagame| na kevalaṃ pradhāne kāraṇāntareṣv api parabrahmatanmāyāparamāṇvādiṣu kalpiteṣu samānaś carco vicāraḥ|
analyzed: evam ca na pradhīyate itra kiṃcid iti apradhānam syāt tat ubhayathā sthityā gatyā ca asya vṛttiḥ pradhāna vyavahāram labhate na anyathā ekānta abhyupagame na kevalam pradhāne kāraṇa antareṣu api para brahma tad māyā paramāṇu ādiṣu kalpiteṣu samānaḥ carcaḥ vicāraḥ

original: tāny api hi sthityaiva vartamānāni vikārākaraṇād akāraṇāni syuḥ, gatyaiva vartamānāni vikāranityatvād akāraṇāni syur iti ca| paryudāsa eva ṣaṣṭhaṃ vikalpam āha --- darśanaśaktir eveti| yathā prajāpativrate nekṣetodyantam ādityam ity anīkṣaṇapratyāsannaḥ saṃkalpo gṛhyata evam ihāpi darśananiṣedhe tatpratyāsannā tanmūlā śaktir ucyate|
analyzed: tāni api hi sthityā eva vartamānāni vikāra akaraṇāt akāraṇāni syuḥ gatyā eva vartamānāni vikāra nitya tvāt akāraṇāni syuḥ iti ca paryudāsaḥ eva ṣaṣṭham vikalpam āha darśana śaktiḥ eva iti yathā prajāpativrate na īkṣeta udyantam ādityam iti an īkṣaṇa pratyāsannaḥ saṃkalpaḥ gṛhyate evam iha api darśana niṣedhe tad pratyāsannā tad mūlā śaktiḥ ucyate

original: sā ca darśanaṃ bhogādilakṣaṇaṃ prasotuṃ draṣṭāraṃ dṛśyena yojayatīti| atraiva śrutim āha --- pradhānasyeti| syād etat| ātmakhyāpanārthaṃ pradhānaṃ pravartata iti śrutir āha na tv ātmadarśanaśakteḥ pravartata ity ata āha --- sarvabodhyabodhasamartha iti|
analyzed: sā ca darśanam bhoga ādi lakṣaṇam prasotum draṣṭāram dṛśyena yojayati iti atra eva śrutim āha pradhānasya iti syāt etat ātma khyāpana artham pradhānam pravartate iti śrutiḥ āha na tu ātma darśana śakteḥ pravartate iti atas āha sarva bodhya bodha samarthaḥ iti

original: prāk pravṛtteḥ pradhānasya nātmakhyāpanamātraṃ pravṛttau prayojakam asāmarthye tadayogāt tasmāt sāmarthyaṃ pravṛtteḥ prayojakam iti śrutyārthād uktam ity arthaḥ| darśanaśaktiḥ pradhānāśrayety aṅgīkṛtya ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpaḥ| imām evobhayāśrayām āsthāya saptamaṃ vikalpam āha --- ubhayasya puruṣasya ca dṛśyasya cādarśanaṃ darśanaśaktir dharma ity eke|
analyzed: prāk pravṛtteḥ pradhānasya na ātma khyāpana mātram pravṛttau prayojakam asāmarthye tad ayogāt tasmāt sāmarthyam pravṛtteḥ prayojakam iti śrutyā arthāt uktam iti arthaḥ darśana śaktiḥ pradhāna āśrayā iti aṅgīkṛtya ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpaḥ imām eva ubhaya āśrayām āsthāya saptamam vikalpam āha ubhayasya puruṣasya ca dṛśyasya ca adarśanam darśana śaktiḥ dharmaḥ iti eke

original: syād etan mṛṣyāmahe dṛśyasyeti, tasya sarvaśaktyāśrayatvān na draṣṭur iti punar mṛṣyāmaḥ| na hi tadādhārā jñānaśaktis tatra jñānasyāsamavāyād anyathā pariṇāmāpattir ity ata āha --- tatredam iti|
analyzed: syāt etat mṛṣyāmahe dṛśyasya iti tasya sarva śakti āśraya tvāt na draṣṭuḥ iti punar mṛṣyāmaḥ na hi tad ādhārā jñāna śaktiḥ tatra jñānasya asamavāyāt anyathā pariṇāma āpattiḥ iti atas āha tatra idam iti

original: bhavatu dṛśyātmakaṃ tathāpi tasya jaḍatvena tadgataśaktikāryaṃ darśanam api jaḍam iti na śakyaṃ taddharmatvena vijñātuṃ jaḍasya svayam aprakāśatvād ato dṛśer ātmanaḥ pratyayaṃ caitanyacchāyāpattim apekṣya darśanaṃ taddharmatvena bhavati jñāyate viṣayeṇa viṣayiṇo lakṣaṇāt|
analyzed: bhavatu dṛśya ātmakam tathā api tasya jaḍa tvena tad gata śakti kāryam darśanam api jaḍam iti na śakyam tad dharma tvena vijñātum jaḍasya svayam aprakāśa tvāt atas dṛśeḥ ātmanaḥ pratyayam caitanya chāyā āpattim apekṣya darśanam tad dharma tvena bhavati jñāyate viṣayeṇa viṣayiṇaḥ lakṣaṇāt

original: nanv etāvatāpi dṛśyadharmatvam asya jñānasya bhavati na tu puruṣadharmatvam apīty ata āha --- tathā puruṣasyeti| satyaṃ puruṣasyānātmabhūtam eva tathāpi dṛśyabuddhisattvasya yaḥ pratyayaś caitanyacchāyāpattis tam apekṣya puruṣadharmatveneva na tu puruṣadharmatvena|
analyzed: nanu etāvatā api dṛśya dharma tvam asya jñānasya bhavati na tu puruṣa dharma tvam api iti atas āha tathā puruṣasya iti satyam puruṣasya anātma bhūtam eva tathā api dṛśya buddhi sattvasya yaḥ pratyayaḥ caitanya chāyā āpattiḥ tam apekṣya puruṣa dharma tvena iva na tu puruṣa dharma tvena

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- caitanyabimbodgrāhitayā buddhicaitanyayor abhedād buddhidharmāś caitanyadharmā iva cakāsatīti| aṣṭamaṃ vikalpam āha --- darśanaṃ jñānam eva śabdādīnām adarśanaṃ na tu sattvapuruṣānyatāyā iti kecit| yathā cakṣū rūpe pramāṇam api rasādāv apramāṇam ucyate|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati caitanya bimba udgrāhitayā buddhi caitanyayoḥ abhedāt buddhi dharmāḥ caitanya dharmāḥ iva cakāsati iti aṣṭamam vikalpam āha darśanam jñānam eva śabda ādīnām adarśanam na tu sattva puruṣa anya tāyāḥ iti kecid yathā cakṣuḥ rūpe pramāṇam api rasa ādau apramāṇam ucyate

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- sukhādyākāraśabdādijñānāni svasiddhyanuguṇatayā draṣṭṛdṛśyasaṃyogam ākṣipantīti| tad evaṃ vikalpya caturthaṃ vikalpaṃ svīkartum itareṣāṃ vikalpānāṃ sāṃkhyaśāstragatānāṃ sarvapuruṣasādhāraṇyena bhogavaicitryābhāvaprasaṅgena dūṣayati --- ity ete śāstragatā iti||2.23||
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati sukha ādi ākāra śabda ādi jñānāni sva siddhi anuguṇa tayā draṣṭṛ dṛśya saṃyogam ākṣipanti iti tat evam vikalpya caturtham vikalpam svīkartum itareṣām vikalpānām sāṃkhya śāstra gatānām sarva puruṣa sādhāraṇyena bhoga vaicitrya abhāva prasaṅgena dūṣayati iti ete śāstra gatāḥ iti

original: tasya hetur avidyā||2.24||
analyzed: tasya hetuḥ avidyā

original: caturthaṃ vikalpaṃ nirdhārayituṃ sūtram avatārayati --- yas tu pratyakcetanasya svabuddhisaṃyoga iti| pratīpam añcati prāpnotīti pratyag asādhāraṇas tu saṃyoga ekaikasya puruṣasyaikaikayā buddhyā vaicitryahetuḥ| sūtraṃ paṭhati --- tasyeti| nanv avidyā viparyayajñānaṃ tasya bhogāpavargayor iva svabuddhisaṃyogo hetuḥ|
analyzed: caturtham vikalpam nirdhārayitum sūtram avatārayati yaḥ tu pratyak cetanasya sva buddhi saṃyogaḥ iti pratīpam añcati prāpnoti iti pratyak asādhāraṇaḥ tu saṃyogaḥ ekaikasya puruṣasya ekaikayā buddhyā vaicitrya hetuḥ sūtram paṭhati tasya iti nanu avidyā viparyaya jñānam tasya bhoga apavargayoḥ iva sva buddhi saṃyogaḥ hetuḥ

original: asaṃyuktāyāṃ buddhau tadanutpattes tat katham avidyā saṃyogabhedasya hetur ity ata āha --- viparyayajñānavāsaneti| sargāntarīyāyā avidyāyāḥ svacittena saha niruddhāyā api pradhāne'sti vāsanā tadvāsanāvāsitaṃ ca pradhānaṃ tattatpuruṣasaṃyoginīṃ tādṛśīm eva buddhiṃ sṛjati| evaṃ pūrvapūrvasargeṣv ity anāditvād adoṣaḥ|
analyzed: asaṃyuktāyām buddhau tad anutpatteḥ tat katham avidyā saṃyoga bhedasya hetuḥ iti atas āha viparyaya jñāna vāsanā iti sarga antarīyāyāḥ avidyāyāḥ sva cittena saha niruddhāyāḥ api vāsanā tad vāsanā vāsitam ca pradhānam tat tatpuruṣa saṃyoginīm tādṛśīm eva buddhim sṛjati evam pūrva pūrva sargeṣu iti anādi tvāt adoṣaḥ

original: ata eva pratisargāvasthāyāṃ na puruṣo mucyata ity āha --- viparyayajñāneti| yadā puruṣakhyātiṃ kāryaniṣṭhāṃ prāptā tadā viparyayajñānavāsanāyā bandhakāraṇasyābhāvān na punar āvartata ity āha --- sā tv iti| atra kaścin nāstikaḥ kaivalyaṃ paṇḍakopākhyānenopahasati| paṇḍakopākhyānam āha --- mugdhayeti|
analyzed: atas eva pratisarga avasthāyām na puruṣaḥ mucyate iti āha viparyaya jñāna iti yadā puruṣa khyātim kārya niṣṭhām prāptā tadā viparyaya jñāna vāsanāyāḥ bandha kāraṇasya abhāvāt na punar āvartate iti āha sā tu iti atra kaścid nāstikaḥ kaivalyam paṇḍaka upākhyānena upahasati paṇḍaka upākhyānam āha mugdhayā iti

original: kimartham ity arthaśabdo nimittam upalakṣayati prayojanasyāpi nimittatvāt| paṇḍakopākhyānena sāmyam āpādayati --- tathedaṃ vidyamānaṃ guṇapuruṣānyatājñānaṃ cittanivṛttiṃ na karoti, paravairāgyeṇa jñānaprasādamātreṇa sasaṃskāraṃ niruddhaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ kariṣyatīti kā pratyāśā| yasmin saty eva yad bhavati tat tasya kāryam| na tu yasminn asatīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kimartham iti artha śabdaḥ nimittam upalakṣayati prayojanasya api nimitta tvāt paṇḍaka upākhyānena sāmyam āpādayati tathā idam vidyamānam guṇa puruṣa anya tā jñānam citta nivṛttim na karoti para vairāgyeṇa jñāna prasāda mātreṇa sa saṃskāram niruddham vinaṣṭam kariṣyati iti kā pratyāśā yasmin sati eva yat bhavati tat tasya kāryam na tu yasmin asati iti bhāvaḥ
