original: atraikadeśimatena parihāram āha --- tatreti| īṣadaparisamāpta ācārya ācāryadeśīyaḥ| ācāryas tu vāyuprokte kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ---
analyzed: atra eka deśi matena parihāram āha tatra iti īṣat aparisamāptaḥ ācāryaḥ ācārya deśīyaḥ ācāryaḥ tu vāyuprokte kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ

original: "ācinoti ca śāstrārtham ācāre sthāpayaty api| svayam ācarate yasmād ācāryas tena cocyate" iti|
analyzed: ācinoti ca śāstra artham ācāre sthāpayati api svayam ācarate yasmāt ācāryaḥ tena ca ucyate iti

original: bhogavivekakhyātirūpapariṇatabuddhinivṛttir eva mokṣaḥ| na ca buddhisvarūpanivṛttiḥ| sā ca dharmameghāntavivekakhyātipratiṣṭhāyā anantaram eva bhavati saty api buddhisvarūpamātrāvasthāna ity arthaḥ| etad eva sphorayati --- adarśanasya bandhakāraṇasyābhāvād buddhinivṛttiḥ| tac cādarśanaṃ bandhakāraṇaṃ darśanān nivartate|
analyzed: bhoga viveka khyāti rūpa pariṇata buddhi nivṛttiḥ eva mokṣaḥ na ca buddhi svarūpa nivṛttiḥ sā ca dharmameghānta viveka khyāti pratiṣṭhāyāḥ anantaram eva bhavati sati api buddhi svarūpa mātra avasthāne iti arthaḥ etat eva sphorayati adarśanasya bandha kāraṇasya abhāvāt buddhi nivṛttiḥ tat ca adarśanam bandha kāraṇam darśanāt nivartate

original: darśananivṛttis tu paravairāgyasādhyā| saty api buddhisvarūpāvasthāne mokṣa iti bhāvaḥ| ekadeśimatam upanyasya svamatam āha --- tatra cittanivṛttir eva mokṣaḥ| nanūktaṃ darśane nivṛtte'cirāc cittasvarūpanivṛttir bhavatīti kathaṃ darśanakāryety ata āha --- kimartham asthāne mativibhrama iti|
analyzed: darśana nivṛttiḥ tu para vairāgya sādhyā satī api buddhi svarūpa avasthāne mokṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ eka deśi matam upanyasya sva matam āha tatra citta nivṛttiḥ eva mokṣaḥ nanu uktam darśane nivṛtte cirāt citta svarūpa nivṛttiḥ bhavati iti katham darśana kāryā iti atas āha kimartham asthāne mati vibhramaḥ iti

original: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ --- yadi darśanasya sākṣāc cittanivṛttau kāraṇabhāvam aṅgīkurvīmahi tata evam upālabhyemahi| kiṃ tu vivekadarśanaṃ prakarṣakāṣṭhāṃ prāptaṃ nirodhasamādhibhāvanāprakarṣakrameṇa cittanivṛttimatpuruṣasvarūpāvasthānopayogīty ātiṣṭhāmahe tat katham upālabhyemahīti||2.24||
analyzed: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ yadi darśanasya sākṣāt citta nivṛttau kāraṇa bhāvam aṅgīkurvīmahi tatas evam upālabhyemahi kim tu viveka darśanam prakarṣa kāṣṭhām prāptam nirodha samādhi bhāvanā prakarṣa krameṇa citta nivṛttimat puruṣa sva rūpa avasthāna upayogi iti ātiṣṭhāmahe tat katham upālabhyemahi iti

original: tadabhāvāt saṃyogābhāvo hānaṃ tad dṛśeḥ kaivalyam||2.25||
analyzed: tad abhāvāt saṃyoga abhāvaḥ hānam tat dṛśeḥ kaivalyam

original: tad evaṃ vyūhadvayam uktvā tṛtīyavyūhābhidhānāya sūtram avatārayti --- heyaṃ duḥkham iti| tadabhāvāt saṃyogābhāvo hānaṃ tad dṛśeḥ kaivalyam| vyācaṣṭe --- tasyeti| asti hi mahāpralaye'pi saṃyogābhāvo'ta uktam ātyantika iti| duḥkhoparamo hānam iti puruṣārthatā darśitā| śeṣam atirohitam||2.25||
analyzed: tat evam vyūha dvayam uktvā tṛtīya vyūha abhidhānāya sūtram avatārayti heyam duḥkham iti tad abhāvāt saṃyoga abhāvaḥ hānam tat dṛśeḥ kaivalyam vyācaṣṭe tasya iti asti hi mahāpralaye api saṃyoga abhāva utaḥ uktam ātyantikaḥ iti duḥkha uparamaḥ hānam iti puruṣa artha tā darśitā śeṣam ati rohitam

original: vivekakhyātir aviplavā hānopāyaḥ||2.26||
analyzed: viveka khyātiḥ aviplavā hāna upāyaḥ

original: hānopāyalakṣaṇaṃ caturthaṃ vyūham ākhyātuṃ sūtram avatārayati --- atheti| vivekakhyātir aviplavā hānopāyaḥ| āgamānumānābhyām api vivekakhyātir asti| na cāsau vyutthānaṃ tatsaṃskāraṃ vā nivartayati tadvato'pi tadanuvṛtter iti tannivṛttyartham aviplaveti| viplavo mithyājñānaṃ tadrahitā|
analyzed: hāna upāya lakṣaṇam caturtham vyūham ākhyātum sūtram avatārayati atha iti viveka khyātiḥ aviplavā hāna upāyaḥ āgama anumānābhyām api viveka khyātiḥ asti na ca asau vyutthānam tad saṃskāram vā nivartayati tadvataḥ api tad anuvṛtteḥ iti tad nivṛtti artham aviplavā iti viplavaḥ mithyājñānam tad rahitā

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- śrutamayena jñānena vivekaṃ gṛhītvā yuktimayena ca vyavasthāpya dīrghakālanairantaryasatkārāsevitāyā bhāvanāyāḥ prakarṣaparyantaṃ samadhigatā sākṣātkāravatī vivekakhyātir nivartitasavāsanamithyājñānā nirviplavā hānopāya iti| śeṣaṃ sugamaṃ bhāṣyam||2.26||
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati śruta mayena jñānena vivekam gṛhītvā yukti mayena ca vyavasthāpya dīrgha kāla nairantarya satkāra āsevitāyāḥ bhāvanāyāḥ prakarṣa paryantam samadhigatā sākṣātkāravatī viveka khyātiḥ nivartita sa vāsana mithyājñānā nirviplavā hāna upāyaḥ iti śeṣam sugamam bhāṣyam

original: tasya saptadhā prāntabhūmiḥ prajñā||2.27||
analyzed: tasya saptadhā prānta bhūmiḥ prajñā

original: vivekakhyātiniṣṭhāyāḥ svarūpam āha sūtreṇa --- tasya saptadhā prāntabhūmiḥ prajñā| vyācaṣṭe --- tasyeti pratyuditakhyāter vartamānakhyāter yoginaḥ pratyāmnāyaḥ parāmarśaḥ|
analyzed: viveka khyāti niṣṭhāyāḥ svarūpam āha sūtreṇa tasya saptadhā prānta bhūmiḥ prajñā vyācaṣṭe tasya iti pratyudita khyāteḥ vartamāna khyāteḥ yoginaḥ pratyāmnāyaḥ parāmarśaḥ

original: aśuddhir evāvaraṇaṃ cittasattvasya tad eva malaṃ tasyāpagamāc cittasya pratyayāntarānutpāde tāmasarājasavyutthānapratyayānutpāde nirviplavavivekakhyātiniṣṭhām āpannasya saptaprakāraiva prajñā vivekino bhavati| viṣayabhedāt prajñābhedaḥ| prakṛṣṭo 'nto yāsāṃ bhūmīnām avasthānāṃ tās tathoktāḥ| yataḥ paraṃ nāsti sa prakarṣaḥ|
analyzed: aśuddhiḥ eva āvaraṇam citta sattvasya tat eva malam tasya apagamāt cittasya pratyaya antara anutpāde tāmasa rājasa vyutthāna pratyaya anutpāde nirviplava viveka khyāti niṣṭhām āpannasya sapta prakārā eva prajñā vivekinaḥ bhavati viṣaya bhedāt prajñā bhedaḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ ntaḥ yāsām bhūmīnām avasthānām tāḥ tathā uktāḥ yatas param na asti sa prakarṣaḥ

original: prāntā bhūmayo yasyāḥ prajñāyā vivekakhyāteḥ sā tathoktā| tā eva saptaprakārāḥ prāntabhūmīr udāharati --- tadyatheti| tatra puruṣaprayatnaniṣpādyāsu catasṛṣu bhūmiṣu prathamām udāharati --- parijñātaṃ heyam| yāvat kila prādhānikaṃ tat sarvaṃ pariṇāmatāpasaṃskārair guṇavṛttivirodhād duḥkham eveti heyaṃ tat parijñātam|
analyzed: prāntāḥ bhūmayaḥ yasyāḥ prajñāyāḥ viveka khyāteḥ sā tathā uktā tāḥ eva sapta prakārāḥ prāntabhūmīḥ udāharati tat yathā iti tatra puruṣa prayatna niṣpādyāsu catasṛṣu bhūmiṣu prathamām udāharati parijñātam heyam yāvat kila prādhānikam tat sarvam pariṇāma tāpa saṃskāraiḥ guṇa vṛtti virodhāt duḥkham eva iti heyam tat parijñātam

original: prāntatāṃ darśayati --- nāsya punaḥ kiṃcid aparijñātaṃ parijñeyam asti| dvitīyām āha --- kṣīṇā iti| prāntatām āha --- na punar iti| tṛtīyām āha --- sākṣātkṛtaṃ pratyakṣeṇa niścitaṃ mayā saṃprajñātāvasthāyām eva nirodhasamādhisādhyaṃ hānaṃ, na punar asyāḥ paraṃ niścetavyam astīti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: prānta tām darśayati na asya punar kiṃcid a parijñātam parijñeyam asti dvitīyām āha kṣīṇāḥ iti prānta tām āha na punar iti tṛtīyām āha sākṣātkṛtam pratyakṣeṇa niścitam mayā saṃprajñāta avasthāyām eva nirodha samādhi sādhyam hānam na punar asyāḥ param niścetavyam asti iti śeṣaḥ

original: caturthīm āha --- bhāvito niṣpādito vivekakhyātirūpo hānopāyo nāsyāḥ paraṃ bhāvanīyam astīti śeṣaḥ| eṣā catuṣṭayī kāryā vimuktiḥ samāptiḥ, kāryatayā prayatnavyāpyatā darśitā| kvacit pāṭhaḥ kāryavimuktir iti| kāryāntareṇa vimuktiḥ prajñāyā ity arthaḥ| prayatnaniṣpādyānuniṣpādanīyām aprayatnasādhyāṃ cittavimuktim āha --- cittavimuktis tu trayī|
analyzed: caturthīm āha bhāvitaḥ niṣpāditaḥ viveka khyāti rūpaḥ hāna upāyaḥ na asyāḥ param bhāvanīyam asti iti śeṣaḥ eṣā catuṣṭayī kāryā vimuktiḥ samāptiḥ kārya tayā prayatna vyāpya tā darśitā kvacid pāṭhaḥ kārya vimuktiḥ iti kārya antareṇa vimuktiḥ prajñāyāḥ iti arthaḥ prayatna niṣpādya anuniṣpādanīyām aprayatna sādhyām citta vimuktim āha citta vimuktiḥ tu trayī

original: prathamām āha --- caritādhikārā buddhiḥ| kṛtabhogāpavargakāryety arthaḥ| dvitīyām āha --- guṇā iti| prāntatām āha --- na caiṣām iti| tṛtīyām āha --- etasyām avasthāyām iti| etasyām avasthāyāṃ jīvann eva puruṣaḥ kuśalo mukta ity ucyate caramadehatvād ity āha --- etām iti|
analyzed: prathamām āha carita adhikārā buddhiḥ kṛta bhoga apavarga kāryā iti arthaḥ dvitīyām āha guṇāḥ iti prāntatām āha na ca eṣām iti tṛtīyām āha etasyām avasthāyām iti etasyām avasthāyām jīvan eva puruṣaḥ kuśalaḥ muktaḥ iti ucyate carama deha tvāt iti āha etām iti

original: anaupacārikaṃ muktam āha --- pratiprasave pradhānalaye'pi cittasya muktaḥ kuśala ity eva bhavati guṇātītatvād iti||2.27||
analyzed: anaupacārikam muktam āha pratiprasave pradhāna laye pi cittasya muktaḥ kuśalaḥ iti eva bhavati guṇa atīta tvāt iti

original: yogāṅgānuṣṭhānād aśuddhikṣaye jñānadīptir ā vivekakhyāteḥ||2.28||
analyzed: yogāṅga anuṣṭhānāt aśuddhi kṣaye jñāna dīptiḥ viveka khyāteḥ

original: tad evaṃ caturo vyūhān uktvā tanmadhyapatitasya hānopāyasya vivekakhyāter godohanādivat prāgasiddher asiddhasya copāyatvābhāvāt siddhyupāyān vaktum ārabhata ity āha --- siddheti| tatrābhidhāsyamānānāṃ sādhanānāṃ yena prakāreṇa vivekakhyātyupāyatvaṃ tad darśayati sūtreṇa --- yogāṅgānuṣṭhāṇād aśuddhikṣaye jñānadīptir ā vivekakhyāteḥ|
analyzed: tat evam caturaḥ vyūhān uktvā tad madhya patitasya hāna upāyasya viveka khyāteḥ godohana ādi vat prāk asiddheḥ asiddhasya ca upāya tva abhāvāt siddhi upāyān vaktum ārabhate iti āha siddha iti tatra abhidhāsyamānānām sādhanānām yena prakāreṇa viveka khyāti upāya tvam tat darśayati sūtreṇa yogāṅga anuṣṭhāṇāt aśuddhi kṣaye jñāna dīptiḥ viveka khyāteḥ

original: yogāṅgāni hi yathāyogaṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭadvāreṇāśuddhiṃ kṣiṇvanti| pañcaparvaṇo viparyayasyety upalakṣaṇaṃ puṇyāpuṇyayor api jātyāyurbhogahetutvenāśuddhirūpatvād iti| śeṣaṃ sugamam| nānāvidhasya kāraṇabhāvasya darśanād yogāṅgānuṣṭhānasya kīdṛśaṃ kāraṇatvam ity ata āha --- yogāṅgānuṣṭhānam iti| aśuddhyā viyojayati buddhisattvam ity aśuddher viyogakāraṇam|
analyzed: yogāṅgāni hi yathāyogam dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa dvāreṇa aśuddhim kṣiṇvanti pañca parvaṇaḥ viparyayasya iti upalakṣaṇam puṇya apuṇyayoḥ api jāti āyuḥ bhoga hetu tvena aśuddhi rūpa tvāt iti śeṣam sugamam nānāvidhasya kāraṇa bhāvasya darśanāt yogāṅga anuṣṭhānasya kīdṛśam kāraṇa tvam iti atas āha yogāṅga anuṣṭhānam iti aśuddhyā viyojayati buddhi sattvam iti aśuddheḥ viyoga kāraṇam

original: dṛṣṭāntam āha --- yathā paraśur iti| paraśuś chedyaṃ vṛkṣaṃ mūlena viyojayati| aśuddhyā viyojayad buddhisattvaṃ vivekakhyātiṃ prāpayati yathā dharmaḥ sukham| tathā yogāṅgānuṣṭhānaṃ vivekakhyāteḥ prāptikāraṇaṃ nānyena prakāreṇety āha --- vivekakhyātes tv iti| nānyatheti pratiṣedhaśravaṇāt pṛcchati --- kati caitānīti| uttaram --- navaiveti|
analyzed: dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā paraśuḥ iti paraśuḥ chedyam vṛkṣam mūlena viyojayati aśuddhyā viyojayat buddhi sattvam viveka khyātim prāpayati yathā dharmaḥ sukham tathā yogāṅga anuṣṭhānam viveka khyāteḥ prāpti kāraṇam na anyena prakāreṇa iti āha viveka khyāteḥ tu iti na anyathā iti pratiṣedha śravaṇāt pṛcchati kati ca etāni iti uttaram nava eva iti

original: tāni darśayati kārikayā --- tadyathā --- utpattīti| atrodāharaṇāny āha --- tatrotpattikāraṇam iti| mano hi vijñānam avyapadeśyāvasthāto'panīya vartamānāvasthām āpādayad utpattikāraṇaṃ vijñānasya| sthitikāraṇaṃ manasaḥ puruṣārthatā| asmitāyā utpannaṃ manas tāvad avatiṣṭhate na yāvad dvividhaṃ puruṣārtham abhinirvartayati|
analyzed: tāni darśayati kārikayā tat yathā utpatti iti atra udāharaṇāni āha tatra utpatti kāraṇam iti manaḥ hi vijñānam a vyapadeśya avasthātaḥ upanīya vartamāna avasthām āpādayat utpatti kāraṇam vijñānasya sthiti kāraṇam manasaḥ puruṣa artha tā asmitāyāḥ utpannam manaḥ tāvat avatiṣṭhate na yāvat dvividham puruṣa artham abhinirvartayati

original: atha nirvartitapuruṣārthadvayaṃ sthiter apaiti| tasmāt svakāraṇād utpannasya manaso'nāgatapuruṣārthatā sthitikāraṇam| dṛṣṭāntam āha --- śarīrasyeveti| pratyakṣajñānanimittam indriyadvārā vā svato vā viṣayasya saṃskriyābhivyaktis tasyāḥ kāraṇaṃ yathā rūpasyālokaḥ| vikārakāraṇaṃ manaso viṣayāntaram|
analyzed: atha nirvartita puruṣa artha dvayam sthiteḥ apaiti tasmāt sva kāraṇāt utpannasya manasaḥ ūnāgata puruṣa artha tā sthiti kāraṇam dṛṣṭāntam āha śarīrasya iva iti pratyakṣa jñāna nimittam indriya dvārā vā svatas vā viṣayasya saṃskriyā abhivyaktiḥ tasyāḥ kāraṇam yathā rūpasya ālokaḥ vikāra kāraṇam manasaḥ viṣaya antaram

original: yathā hi mṛkaṇḍoḥ samāhitamanaso vallakīvipañcyamānapañcamasvaraśravaṇasamanantaram unmīlitākṣasya svarūpalāvaṇyayauvanasaṃpannām apsarasaṃ pramlocām īkṣamāṇasya samādhim apahāya tasyāṃ saktaṃ mano babhūveti| atraiva nidarśanam āha --- yathāgniḥ pākyasya taṇḍulādeḥ kaṭhināvayavasaṃniveśasya praśithilāvayavasaṃyogalakṣaṇasya vikārasya kāraṇam|
analyzed: yathā hi mṛkaṇḍoḥ samāhita manasaḥ vallakī vipañcyamāna pañcama svara śravaṇa samanantaram unmīlita akṣasya sva rūpa lāvaṇya yauvana saṃpannām apsarasam pramlocām īkṣamāṇasya samādhim apahāya tasyām saktam manaḥ babhūva iti atra eva nidarśanam āha yathā agniḥ pākyasya taṇḍula ādeḥ kaṭhina avayava saṃniveśasya praśithila avayava saṃyoga lakṣaṇasya vikārasya kāraṇam

original: sata eva viṣayasya pratyayakāraṇaṃ dhūmajñānam agnijñānasyeti| jñāyata iti jñānam agniś cāsau jñānaṃ cety agnijñānaṃ tasya| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- vartamānasyaivāgner jñeyasya pratyayakāraṇatayā kāraṇam iti| autsargikī nirapekṣāṇāṃ kāraṇānāṃ kāryakriyā prāptis tasyāḥ kutaścid apavādo 'prāptiḥ|
analyzed: sataḥ eva viṣayasya pratyaya kāraṇam dhūma jñānam agni jñānasya iti jñāyate iti jñānam agniḥ ca asau jñānam ca iti agni jñānam tasya etat uktam bhavati vartamānasya eva agneḥ jñeyasya pratyaya kāraṇa tayā kāraṇam iti autsargikī nirapekṣāṇām kāraṇānām kārya kriyā prāptiḥ tasyāḥ kutaścid prāptiḥ

original: yathā nimnopasarpaṇasvabhāvānām apāṃ pratibandhaḥ setunā tathehāpi buddhisattvasya sukhaprakāśaśīlasya svābhāvikī sukhavivekakhyātijanakatā prāptiḥ| sā kutaścid adharmāt tamaso vā pratibandhān na bhavati| dharmād yogāṅgānuṣṭhānād vā tadapanaye tadapratibaddhavṛttisvabhāvata eva tajjanakatayā tad āpnoti|
analyzed: yathā nimna upasarpaṇa svabhāvānām apām pratibandhaḥ setunā tathā iha api buddhi sattvasya sukha prakāśa śīlasya svābhāvikī sukha viveka khyāti janaka tā prāptiḥ sā kutaścid adharmāt tamasaḥ vā pratibandhāt na bhavati dharmāt yogāṅga anuṣṭhānāt vā tad apanaye tad apratibaddha vṛtti svabhāvataḥ eva tad janaka tayā tat āpnoti

original: yathā vakṣyati --- "nimittam aprayojakaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ varaṇabhedas tu tataḥ kṣetrikavat" iti| tad evaṃ vivekakhyātilakṣaṇakāryāpekṣayā prāptikāraṇam uktam| avāntarakāryāpekṣayā tu tad eva viyogakāraṇam ity āha --- viyogakāraṇam iti|
analyzed: yathā vakṣyati nimittam aprayojakam prakṛtīnām varaṇa bhedaḥ tu tatas kṣetrika vat iti tat evam viveka khyāti lakṣaṇa kārya apekṣayā prāpti kāraṇam uktam avāntara kārya apekṣayā tu tat eva viyoga kāraṇam iti āha viyoga kāraṇam iti

original: anyatvakāraṇam āha --- anyatvakāraṇaṃ yathā suvarṇakāraḥ suvarṇasya, kaṭakakuṇḍalakeyūrādibhyo bhinnābhinnasya bhedavivakṣayā kaṭakādibhinnasyābhedavivakṣayā kaṭakādyabhinnasya suvarṇasya kuṇḍalād anyatvam| tathā ca kaṭakakārī suvarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalād abhinnāt suvarṇād anyat kurvann anyatvakāraṇam|
analyzed: anya tva kāraṇam āha anya tva kāraṇam yathā suvarṇakāraḥ suvarṇasya kaṭaka kuṇḍala keyūra ādibhyaḥ bhinna abhinnasya bheda vivakṣayā kaṭaka ādi bhinnasya abheda vivakṣayā kaṭaka ādi abhinnasya suvarṇasya kuṇḍalāt anya tvam tathā ca kaṭaka kārī suvarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalāt abhinnāt suvarṇāt anyat kurvan anya tva kāraṇam

original: agnir api pākyasyānyatvakāraṇaṃ yady api tathāpi dharmiṇo dharmayoḥ pulākatvataṇḍulatvayor bhedāvivakṣayā dharmayor upajanāpāye'pi dharmyanuvartata iti na tasyānyatvaṃ śakyaṃ vaktum iti vikāramātrakāraṇatvam uktam iti na saṃkaraḥ| na ca saṃsthānabhedo dharmiṇo 'nyatvakāraṇam iti vyākhyeyam| suvarṇakāra ity asyāsaṃgateḥ|
analyzed: agniḥ api pākyasya anya tva kāraṇam yadi api tathā api dharmiṇaḥ dharmayoḥ pulāka tva taṇḍula tvayoḥ bheda avivakṣayā dharmayoḥ upajana apāye pi dharmī anuvartate iti na tasya anya tvam śakyam vaktum iti vikāra mātra kāraṇa tvam uktam iti na saṃkaraḥ na ca saṃsthāna bhedaḥ dharmiṇaḥ nya tva kāraṇam iti vyākhyeyam suvarṇakāraḥ iti asya asaṃgateḥ

original: bāhyam anyatvakāraṇam upanyasyādhyātmikam udāharati --- evam ekasyeti| avidyā kamanīyeyaṃ kanyaketyādijñānam| tanmohayogāt sa eva strīpratyayo mūḍho viṣaṇṇo bhavati caitrasya maitrasya puṇyavato bata kalatraratnam etan na tu mama bhāgyahīnasyeti| evaṃ sapatnījanasya tasyāṃ dveṣaḥ strīpratyayasya duḥkhatve|
analyzed: bāhyam anya tva kāraṇam upanyasya ādhyātmikam udāharati evam ekasya iti avidyā kamanīyā iyam kanyakā ityādi jñānam tad moha yogāt saḥ eva strī pratyayaḥ mūḍhaḥ viṣaṇṇaḥ bhavati caitrasya maitrasya puṇyavataḥ bata kalatra ratnam etat na tu mama bhāgya hīnasya iti evam sapatnī janasya tasyām dveṣaḥ strī pratyayasya duḥkha tve

original: evaṃ maitrasya tasyā bhartū rāgas tasyaiva strīpratyayasya sukhatve| tattvajñānaṃ tvaṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjāsamūhaḥ strīkāyaḥ sthānabījādibhir aśucir iti vivekināṃ mādhyasthye vairāgye kāraṇam iti| dhṛtikāraṇaṃ śarīram indriyāṇāṃ vidhārakam indriyāṇi ca śarīrasya sāmānyā karaṇavṛttir hi prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca tadabhāve śarīrapātāt|
analyzed: evam maitrasya tasyāḥ bhartuḥ rāgaḥ tasya eva strī pratyayasya sukha tve tattva jñānam tvak māṃsa medaḥ sthi majjā samūhaḥ strī kāyaḥ sthāna bīja ādibhiḥ aśuciḥ iti vivekinām mādhyasthye vairāgye kāraṇam iti dhṛti kāraṇam śarīram indriyāṇām vidhārakam indriyāṇi ca śarīrasya sāmānyā karaṇa vṛttiḥ hi prāṇa ādyāḥ vāyavaḥ pañca tad abhāve śarīrapātāt

original: evaṃ māṃsādikāyāṅgānām api parasparavidhāryavidhārakatvam| evaṃ mahābhūtāni pṛthivyādīni manuṣyavaruṇasūryagandhavahaśaśilokanivāsināṃ śarīrāṇāṃ, tāni ca parasparaṃ, pṛthivyāṃ hi gandharasarūpasparśaśabdaguṇāyāṃ pañca mahābhūtāni parasparaṃ vidhāryavidhārakabhāvenāvasthitāny apsu catvāri tejasi trīṇi dve ca mātariśvanīti|
analyzed: evam māṃsa ādi kāya aṅgānām api paraspara vidhārya vidhāraka tvam evam mahābhūtāni pṛthivī ādīni manuṣya varuṇa sūrya gandhavaha śaśi loka nivāsinām śarīrāṇām tāni ca parasparam pṛthivyām hi gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabda guṇāyām pañca mahābhūtāni parasparam vidhārya vidhāraka bhāvena avasthitāni apsu catvāri tejasi trīṇi dve ca mātariśvani iti

original: tairyagyaunamānuṣadaivatādīni ca vidhāryavidhārakabhāvenāvasthitāni| nanv ādhārādheyabhāvarahitānāṃ kutas tattvam ity ata āha --- parasparārthatvād iti| manuṣyaśarīraṃ hi paśupakṣimṛgasarīsṛpasthāvaraśarīropayogena dhriyate| evaṃ vyāghrādiśarīram api manuṣyapaśumṛgādiśarīropayogena| evaṃ paśumṛgādiśarīram api sthāvarādyupayogena|
analyzed: tairyagyauna mānuṣa daivata ādīni ca vidhārya vidhāraka bhāvena avasthitāni nanu ādhāra ādheya bhāva rahitānām kutas tattvam iti atas āha paraspara artha tvāt iti manuṣya śarīram hi paśu pakṣi mṛga sarīsṛpa sthāvara śarīra upayogena dhriyate evam vyāghra ādi śarīram api manuṣya paśu mṛga ādi śarīra upayogena evam paśu mṛga ādi śarīram api sthāvara ādi upayogena

original: evaṃ daivaśarīram api manuṣyopahṛtacchāgamṛgakapiñjalamāṃsājyapuroḍāśasahakāraśākhāprastarādibhir ijyamānaṃ tadupayogena| evaṃ devatāpi varadānavṛṣṭyādibhir manuṣyādīni dhārayatīty asti parasparārthatvam ity arthaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam||2.28||
analyzed: evam daiva śarīram api manuṣya upahṛta chāga mṛga kapiñjala māṃsa ājya puroḍāśa sahakāra śākhā prastara ādibhiḥ ijyamānam tad upayogena evam devatā api vara dāna vṛṣṭi ādibhiḥ manuṣya ādīni dhārayati iti asti paraspara artha tvam iti arthaḥ śeṣam sugamam

original: yamaniyamāsanaprāṇāyāmapratyāhāradhāraṇādhyānasamādhayo 'ṣṭāv aṅgāni||2.29||
analyzed: yama niyama āsana prāṇāyāma pratyāhāra dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhayaḥ ṣṭāv aṅgāni

original: saṃprati nyūnādhikasaṃkhyāvyavacchedārthaṃ yogāṅgāny avadhārayati --- tatra yogāṅgāny avadhāryanta iti| yamaniyamāsanaprāṇāyāmapratyāhāradhāraṇādhyānasamādhayo 'ṣṭāv aṅgāni| abhyāsavairāgyaśraddhāvīryādayo 'pi yathāyogam eteṣv eva svarūpato nāntarīyakatayā cāntarbhāvayitavyāḥ||2.29||
analyzed: saṃprati nyūnādhika saṃkhyā vyavaccheda artham yoga aṅgāni avadhārayati tatra yoga aṅgāni avadhāryante iti yama niyama āsana prāṇāyāma pratyāhāra dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhayaḥ ṣṭāv aṅgāni abhyāsa vairāgya śraddhā vīrya ādayaḥ pi yathāyogam eteṣu eva svarūpataḥ nāntarīyaka tayā ca antar bhāvayitavyāḥ

original: ahiṃsāsatyāsteyabrahmacaryāparigrahā yamāḥ||2.30||
analyzed: ahiṃsā satya asteya brahmacarya aparigrahāḥ yamāḥ

original: yamaniyamādyaṅgāny uddiśya yamanirdeśakaṃ sūtram avatārayati --- tatreti| ahiṃsāsatyāsteyabrahmacaryāparigrahā yamāḥ| yogāṅgam ahiṃsām āha --- sarvatheti| īdṛśīm ahiṃsāṃ stauti --- uttare ceti| tanmūlā ity ahiṃsām aparipālya kṛtā apy akṛtakalpā niṣphalatvād ity arthaḥ| tatsiddhiparatayaivānuṣṭhānam|
analyzed: yama niyama ādi aṅgāni uddiśya yama nirdeśakam sūtram avatārayati tatra iti ahiṃsā satya asteya brahmacarya aparigrahāḥ yamāḥ yoga aṅgam ahiṃsām āha sarvathā iti īdṛśīm ahiṃsām stauti uttare ca iti tad mūlāḥ iti ahiṃsām a paripālya kṛtāḥ api akṛta kalpāḥ niṣphala tvāt iti arthaḥ tad siddhi para tayā eva anuṣṭhānam

original: ahiṃsā cen mūlam uttareṣāṃ kathaṃ te'hiṃsāsiddhiparā ity ata āha --- tatpratipādanāyeti| siddhir jñānaṃ notpattir ity arthaḥ| syād etat| ahiṃsājñānārthā yady uttare kṛtaṃ tair anyata eva tadavagamād ity ata āha --- tadavadāteti| yady uttare nānuṣṭhīyerann ahiṃsā malinā syād asatyādibhir ity arthaḥ| atraivāgamikānāṃ saṃmatim āha --- tathā ceti|
analyzed: ahiṃsā ced mūlam uttareṣām katham te hiṃsā siddhi parāḥ iti atas āha tad pratipādanāya iti siddhiḥ jñānam na utpattiḥ iti arthaḥ syāt etat ahiṃsā jñāna arthāḥ yadi uttare kṛtam taiḥ anyatas eva tad avagamāt iti atas āha tad avadāta iti yadi uttare na anuṣṭhīyeran ahiṃsā malinā syāt asatya ādibhiḥ iti arthaḥ atra eva āgamikānām saṃmatim āha tathā ca iti

original: sugamam| satyalakṣaṇam āha --- yathārthe vāṅmanase iti| yathāśabdaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ pūrayati --- yathā dṛṣṭam iti| pratisaṃbandhinaṃ tathāśabdaṃ pratikṣipati --- tathā vāṅmanaś ca vivakṣāyāṃ kartavyāyām iti|
analyzed: sugamam satya lakṣaṇam āha yathā arthe vāc manase iti yathāśabdam sākāṅkṣam pūrayati yathā dṛṣṭam iti pratisaṃbandhinam tathāśabdam pratikṣipati tathā vāc manaḥ ca vivakṣāyām kartavyāyām iti

original: anyathā tu na satyam etat sopapattikam āha --- paratra puruṣe svabodhasaṃkrāntaye svabodhasadṛśabodhajananāya vāg uktoccāritā, ataḥ sā yadi na vañcitā vañcikā yathā droṇācāryeṇa svatanayāśvatthāmamaraṇam āyuṣman satyadhanāśvatthāmā hata iti pṛṣṭasya yudhiṣṭhirasya prativacanaṃ hastinam abhisaṃdhāya satyaṃ hato'śvatthāmeti, tad idam uktasyottaraṃ
analyzed: anyathā tu na satyam etat sa upapattikam āha paratra puruṣe sva bodha saṃkrāntaye sva bodha sadṛśa bodha jananāya vāc uktā uccāritā atas sā yadi na vañcitā vañcikā yathā droṇa ācāryeṇa sva tanaya aśvatthāma maraṇam āyuṣman satya dhana aśvatthāmā hataḥ iti pṛṣṭasya yudhiṣṭhirasya prativacanam hastinam abhisaṃdhāya satyam hata uśvatthāmā iti tat idam uktasya uttaram

original: na yudhiṣṭhirasya svabodhaṃ saṃkrāmayati --- svabodho hy asya hastihananaviṣaya indriyajanmā, na cāsau saṃkrāntaḥ kiṃ tv anya eva tasya tanayavadhabodho jāta iti| bhrāntā vā bhrāntijā vā, bhrāntiś ca vivakṣāsamaye vā jñeyārthāvadhāraṇasamaye vā|
analyzed: na yudhiṣṭhirasya sva bodham saṃkrāmayati sva bodhaḥ hi asya hasti hanana viṣayaḥ indriya janmā na ca asau saṃkrāntaḥ kim tu anyaḥ eva tasya tanaya vadha bodhaḥ jātaḥ iti bhrāntā vā bhrānti jā vā bhrāntiḥ ca vivakṣā samaye vā jñeya artha avadhāraṇa samaye vā

original: pratipattyā vandhyā pratipattivandhyā yathārthān prati mlecchabhāṣā pratipattivandhyā, niṣprayojanā vā syād iti yathānapekṣitābhidhānā vāk tatra hi paratra svabodhasya saṃkrāntir apy asaṃkrāntir eva niṣprayojanatvād iti| evaṃlakṣaṇam api satyaṃ parāpakāraphalaṃ satyābhāsaṃ na tu satyam ity āha --- eṣeti|
analyzed: pratipattyā vandhyā pratipatti vandhyā yathā arthān prati mleccha bhāṣā pratipatti vandhyā niṣprayojanā vā syāt iti yathā anapekṣita abhidhānā vāc tatra hi paratra sva bodhasya saṃkrāntiḥ api asaṃkrāntiḥ eva niṣprayojana tvāt iti evaṃlakṣaṇam api satyam para apakāra phalam satya ābhāsam na tu satyam iti āha eṣā iti

original: tadyathā satyatapasas taskaraiḥ sārthagamanaṃ pṛṣṭasya sārthagamanābhidhānam iti| abhidhīyamānoccāryamāṇā| śeṣaṃ sugamam| abhāvasya bhāvādhīnanirūpaṇatayā steyalakṣaṇam āha --- steyam aśāstrapūrvakam iti| viśeṣeṇa sāmānyaṃ lakṣyata ity arthaḥ| mānasavyāpārapūrvakatvād vācanikakāyikavyāpārayoḥ prādhānyān manovyāpāra ukto'spṛhārūpam iti|
analyzed: tat yathā satyatapasaḥ taskaraiḥ sārtha gamanam pṛṣṭasya sārtha gamana abhidhānam iti abhidhīyamānā uccāryamāṇā śeṣam sugamam abhāvasya bhāva adhīna nirūpaṇa tayā steya lakṣaṇam āha steyam aśāstra pūrvakam iti viśeṣeṇa sāmānyam lakṣyate iti arthaḥ mānasa vyāpāra pūrvaka tvāt vācanika kāyika vyāpārayoḥ prādhānyāt manaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti

original: brahmacaryasvarūpam āha --- gupteti| saṃyatopastho'pi hi strīprekṣaṇatadālāpakandarpāyatanatadaṅgasparśanasakto na brahmacaryavān iti tannirāsāyoktaṃ guptendriyasyeti| indriyāntarāṇy api tatra lolupāni rakṣaṇīyānīti| aparigrahasvarūpam āha --- viṣayāṇām iti|
analyzed: brahmacarya svarūpam āha gupta iti saṃyata upasthaḥ api hi strī prekṣaṇa tad ālāpa kandarpa āyatana tad aṅga sparśana saktaḥ na brahmacaryavān iti tad nirāsāya uktam gupta indriyasya iti indriya antarāṇi api tatra lolupāni rakṣaṇīyāni iti aparigraha svarūpam āha viṣayāṇām iti

original: tatra saṅgadoṣa ukto bhogābhyāsam anu vivardhante rāgāḥ kauśalāni cendriyāṇām iti, hiṃsālakṣaṇaś ca doṣo nānupahatya bhūtāny upabhogaḥ saṃbhavatīti| aśāstrīyāṇām ayatnopanatānām api viṣayāṇāṃ ninditapratigrahādirūpārjanadoṣadarśanāc chāstrīyāṇām apy upārjitānāṃ ca rakṣaṇādidoṣadarśanād asvīkaraṇam aparigrahaḥ||2.30||
analyzed: tatra saṅga doṣaḥ uktaḥ bhoga abhyāsam anu vivardhante rāgāḥ kauśalāni ca indriyāṇām iti hiṃsā lakṣaṇaḥ ca doṣaḥ na an upahatya bhūtāni upabhogaḥ saṃbhavati iti aśāstrīyāṇām ayatna upanatānām api viṣayāṇām nindita pratigraha ādi rūpa arjana doṣa darśanāt śāstrīyāṇām api upārjitānām ca rakṣaṇa ādi doṣa darśanāt asvīkaraṇam aparigrahaḥ

original: jātideśakālasamayānavacchinnāḥ sārvabhaumā mahāvratam||2.31||
analyzed: jāti deśa kāla samaya anavacchinnāḥ sārvabhaumāḥ mahāvratam

original: sāmānyata uktā yādṛśāḥ punar yoginām upādeyās tādṛśān vaktuṃ sūtram avatārayati --- te tv iti| jātideśakālasamayānavacchinnāḥ sārvabhaumā mahāvratam| sarvāsu jātyādilakṣaṇāsu bhūmiṣu viditāḥ sārvabhaumāḥ| ahiṃsādaya ity anyatrāpy avaccheda ūhanīyaḥ| sugamaṃ bhāṣyam||2.31||
analyzed: sāmānyatas uktāḥ yādṛśāḥ punar yoginām upādeyāḥ tādṛśān vaktum sūtram avatārayati te tu iti jāti deśa kāla samaya anavacchinnāḥ sārvabhaumāḥ mahāvratam sarvāsu jāti ādi lakṣaṇāsu bhūmiṣu viditāḥ sārvabhaumāḥ ahiṃsā ādayaḥ iti anyatra api avacchedaḥ ūhanīyaḥ sugamam bhāṣyam

original: śaucasaṃtoṣatapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānāni niyamāḥ||2.32||
analyzed: śauca saṃtoṣa tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni niyamāḥ

original: śaucādiniyamān ācaṣṭe --- śaucasaṃtoṣatapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānāni niyamāḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- śaucam iti| ādiśabdena gomayādayo gṛhyante| gomūtrayāvakādi medhyaṃ tasyābhyavaharaṇādi| ādiśabdād grāsaparimāṇasaṃkhyāniyamādayo grāhyāḥ| medhyābhyavaharaṇādijanitam iti vaktavye medhyābhyavaharaṇādi cety uktaṃ kārye kāraṇopacārāt|
analyzed: śauca ādi niyamān ācaṣṭe śauca saṃtoṣa tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni niyamāḥ vyācaṣṭe śaucam iti ādi śabdena gomaya ādayaḥ gṛhyante go mūtra yāvaka ādi medhyam tasya abhyavaharaṇa ādi ādi śabdāt grāsa parimāṇa saṃkhyā niyama ādayaḥ grāhyāḥ medhya abhyavaharaṇa ādi janitam iti vaktavye medhya abhyavaharaṇa ādi ca iti uktam kārye kāraṇa upacārāt

original: cittamalā madamānāsūyādayas tadapanayo manaḥśaucam| prāṇatrāṇamātrahetor abhyadhikasyānupāditsā saṃtoṣaḥ prāg eva svīkaraṇaparityāgād iti śeṣaḥ| kāṣṭhamaunam iṅgitenāpi svābhiprāyāprakāśanam| avacanamātram ākāramaunam| parikṣīṇavitarkajāla iti vitarko vakṣyamāṇaḥ saṃśayaviparyayau veti| etāvatā śuddho'bhisaṃdhir uktaḥ|
analyzed: citta malāḥ mada māna asūyā ādayaḥ tad apanayaḥ manaḥ śaucam prāṇa trāṇa mātra hetoḥ abhyadhikasya anupāditsā saṃtoṣaḥ prāk eva svīkaraṇa parityāgāt iti śeṣaḥ kāṣṭha maunam iṅgitena api sva abhiprāya aprakāśanam avacana mātram ākāra maunam parikṣīṇa vitarka jālaḥ iti vitarkaḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ saṃśaya viparyayau vā iti etāvatā śuddhaḥ abhisaṃdhiḥ uktaḥ

original: ete ca yamaniyamā viṣṇupurāṇa uktāḥ ---
analyzed: ete ca yama niyamāḥ viṣṇupurāṇe uktāḥ

original: "brahmacaryam ahiṃsāṃ ca satyāsteyāparigrahān| seveta yogī niṣkāmo yogyatāṃ svamano nayan|| svādhyāyaśaucasaṃtoṣatapāṃsi niyatātmavān| kurvīta brahmaṇi tathā parasmin pravaṇaṃ manaḥ|| ete yamāḥ saniyamāḥ pañca pañca prakīrtitāḥ| viśiṣṭaphaladāḥ kāmyā niṣkāmānāṃ (niṣkāmāṇāṃ) vimuktidāḥ" iti||2.32||
analyzed: brahmacaryam ahiṃsām ca satya asteya aparigrahān seveta yogī niṣkāmaḥ yogyatām sva manaḥ nayan svādhyāya śauca saṃtoṣa tapāṃsi niyata ātmavān kurvīta brahmaṇi tathā parasmin pravaṇam manaḥ ete yamāḥ sa niyamāḥ pañca pañca prakīrtitāḥ viśiṣṭa phala dāḥ kāmyāḥ niṣkāmānām niṣkāmāṇām vimukti dāḥ iti

original: vitarkabādhane pratipakṣabhāvanam||2.33||
analyzed: vitarka bādhane pratipakṣa bhāvanam

original: "śreyāṃsi bahuvighnāni" ity eṣām apavādasaṃbhave tatpratīkāropadeśaparaṃ sūtram avatārayati --- eteṣāṃ yamaniyamānām iti| sūtraṃ --- vitarkabādhane pratipakṣabhāvanam| vitarkāṇāṃ bhāṣye nāsti tirohitam iva kiṃcana||2.33||
analyzed: śreyāṃsi bahu vighnāni iti eṣām apavāda saṃbhave tad pratīkāra upadeśa param sūtram avatārayati eteṣām yama niyamānām iti sūtram vitarka bādhane pratipakṣa bhāvanam vitarkāṇām bhāṣye na asti tirohitam iva kiṃcana

original: vitarkā hiṃsādayaḥ kṛtakāritānumoditā lobhakrodhamohapūrvakā mṛdumadhyādhimātrā duḥkhājñānānantaphalā iti pratipakṣabhāvanam||2.34||
analyzed: vitarkāḥ hiṃsā ādayaḥ kṛta kārita anumoditāḥ lobha krodha moha pūrvakāḥ mṛdu madhya adhimātrāḥ duḥkha ajñāna ananta phalāḥ iti pratipakṣa bhāvanam

original: tatra vitarkāṇāṃ svarūpaprakārakāraṇadharmaphalabhedān pratipakṣabhāvānāviṣayān pratipakṣabhāvanāsvarūpābhidhitsayā sūtreṇāha --- vitarkā hiṃsādayaḥ kṛtakāritānumoditā lobhakrodhamohapūrvakā mṛdumadhyādhimātrā duḥkhājñānānantaphalā iti pratipakṣabhāvanam| vyācaṣṭe --- tatra hiṃseti|
analyzed: tatra vitarkāṇām svarūpa prakāra kāraṇa dharma phala bhedān pratipakṣa bhāvān āviṣayān pratipakṣa bhāvanā svarūpa abhidhitsayā sūtreṇa āha vitarkāḥ hiṃsā ādayaḥ kṛta kārita anumoditāḥ lobha krodha moha pūrvakāḥ mṛdu madhya adhimātrāḥ duḥkha ajñāna ananta phalāḥ iti pratipakṣa bhāvanam vyācaṣṭe tatra hiṃsā iti

original: prāṇabhṛdbhedasyāparisaṃkhyeyatvān niyamavikalpasamuccayāḥ saṃbhavino hiṃsādiṣu| tatrādharmatas tamaḥsamudreke sati caturvidhaviparyayalakṣaṇasyājñānasyāpy udaya ity ajñānaphalatvam apy eteṣām iti| duḥkhājñānānantaphalatvam eva hi pratipakṣabhāvanaṃ tadvaśād ebhyo nivṛtter iti|
analyzed: prāṇabhṛt bhedasya aparisaṃkhyeya tvāt niyama vikalpa samuccayāḥ saṃbhavinaḥ hiṃsā ādiṣu tatra adharmataḥ tamaḥ samudreke sati caturvidha viparyaya lakṣaṇasya ajñānasya api udaye iti ajñāna phalatvam api eteṣām iti duḥkha ajñāna ananta phalatvam eva hi pratipakṣa bhāvanam tad vaśāt ebhyaḥ nivṛtteḥ iti

original: tad eva pratipakṣabhāvanaṃ sphorayati --- vadhyasya paśvāder vīryaṃ prayatnaṃ kāyavyāpārahetuṃ prathamam ākṣipati yūpaniyojanena| tena hi paśor aprāgalbhyaṃ bhavati| śeṣam atisphuṭam||2.34||
analyzed: tat eva pratipakṣa bhāvanam sphorayati vadhyasya paśu ādeḥ vīryam prayatnam kāya vyāpāra hetum prathamam ākṣipati yūpa niyojanena tena hi paśoḥ a prāgalbhyam bhavati śeṣam ati sphuṭam

original: ahiṃsāpratiṣṭhāyāṃ tatsaṃnidhau vairatyāgaḥ||2.35||
analyzed: ahiṃsā pratiṣṭhāyām tad saṃnidhau vaira tyāgaḥ

original: uktā yamaniyamās tadapavādakānāṃ ca vitarkāṇāṃ pratipakṣabhāvanāto hānir uktā, saṃpraty apratyūhaṃ yamaniyamābhyāsāt tatsiddhiparijñānasūcakāni cihnāny upanyasyati yatparijñānād yogī tatra tatra kṛtakṛtyaḥ kartavyeṣu pravartata ity āha (ti) --- yadeti (pratipakṣeti)| ahiṃsāpratiṣṭhāyāṃ tatsaṃnidhau vairatyāgaḥ|
analyzed: uktāḥ yama niyamāḥ tad apavādakānām ca vitarkāṇām pratipakṣa bhāvanātaḥ hāniḥ uktā saṃprati apratyūham yama niyama abhyāsāt tad siddhi parijñāna sūcakāni cihnāni upanyasyati yad parijñānāt yogī tatra tatra kṛtakṛtyaḥ kartavyeṣu pravartate iti āha yadā iti pratipakṣa iti ahiṃsā pratiṣṭhāyām tad saṃnidhau vaira tyāgaḥ

original: śāśvatikavirodhā apy aśvamahiṣamūṣakamārjārāhinakulādayo 'pi bhagavataḥ pratiṣṭhitāhiṃsasya saṃnidhānāt taccittānukāriṇo vairaṃ parityajantīti||2.35||
analyzed: śāśvatika virodhāḥ api aśva mahiṣa mūṣaka mārjāra ahi nakula ādayaḥ bhagavataḥ pratiṣṭhita ahiṃsasya saṃnidhānāt tad citta anukāriṇaḥ vairam parityajanti iti

original: satyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ kriyāphalāśrayatvam||2.36||
analyzed: satya pratiṣṭhāyām kriyā phala āśraya tvam

original: satyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ kriyāphalāśrayatvam| kriyāsādhyau dharmādharmau kriyā tatphalaṃ ca svarganarakādi te evāśrayatīty āśrayas tasya bhāvas tattvaṃ tad asya bhagavato vāco bhavatīti| kriyāśrayatvam āha --- dhārmika iti| phalāśrayatvam āha --- svargam iti| amoghāpratihatā||2.36||
analyzed: satya pratiṣṭhāyām kriyā phala āśraya tvam kriyā sādhyau dharma adharmau kriyā tad phalam ca svarga naraka ādi te eva āśrayati iti āśrayaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam tat asya bhagavataḥ vācaḥ bhavati iti kriyā āśraya tvam āha dhārmikaḥ iti phala āśraya tvam āha svargam iti amogha apratihata ātman

original: asteyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ sarvaratnopasthānam||2.37||
analyzed: asteya pratiṣṭhāyām sarva ratna upasthānam

original: asteyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ sarvaratnopasthānam| subodham||2.37||
analyzed: asteya pratiṣṭhāyām sarva ratna upasthānam su bodham

original: brahmacaryapratiṣṭhāyāṃ vīryalābhaḥ||2.38||
analyzed: brahmacarya pratiṣṭhāyām vīrya lābhaḥ

original: svajānumaṇḍalaṃ pāṇinā triḥ parāmṛśya cchoṭikāvacchinnaḥ kālo mātrā tābhiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśatā mātrābhiḥ parimitaḥ prathama udghāto mṛduḥ| sa eva dviguṇīkṛto dvitīyo madhyamaḥ| sa eva triguṇīkṛtas tṛtīyas tīvraḥ| tam imaṃ saṃkhyāparidṛṣṭaṃ prāṇāyāmam āha --- saṃkhyābhir iti|
analyzed: sva jānu maṇḍalam pāṇinā tris parāmṛśya choṭikā avacchinnaḥ kālaḥ mātrā tābhiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśatā mātrābhiḥ parimitaḥ prathamaḥ udghātaḥ mṛduḥ saḥ eva dviguṇīkṛtaḥ dvitīyaḥ madhyamaḥ saḥ eva triguṇīkṛtaḥ tṛtīyaḥ tīvraḥ tam imam saṃkhyā paridṛṣṭam prāṇāyāmam āha saṃkhyābhiḥ iti

original: svasthasya hi puṃsaḥ śvāsapraśvāsakriyāvacchinnena kālena yathoktacchoṭikākālaḥ samānaḥ| prathamodghātakarmatāṃ nīta udghāto vijito vaśīkṛto nigṛhītaḥ| kṣaṇānām iyattā kālo vivakṣitaḥ| śvāsapraśvāseyattā saṃkhyeti kathaṃcid bhedaḥ| sa khalv ayaṃ pratyaham abhyasto divasapakṣamāsādikrameṇa deśakālapracayavyāpitayā dīrghaḥ|
analyzed: svasthasya hi puṃsaḥ śvāsa praśvāsa kriyā avacchinnena kālena yathā ukta śoṭikā kālaḥ samānaḥ prathama udghāta karma tām nītaḥ udghātaḥ vijitaḥ vaśīkṛtaḥ nigṛhītaḥ kṣaṇānām iyat tā kālaḥ vivakṣitaḥ śvāsa praśvāsa iyat tā saṃkhyā iti kathaṃcid bhedaḥ sa khalu ayam pratyaham abhyastaḥ divasa pakṣa māsa ādi krameṇa deśa kāla pracaya vyāpi tayā dīrghaḥ

original: paramanaipuṇyasamadhigamanīyatayā ca sūkṣmo na tu mandatayā||2.50||
analyzed: parama naipuṇya samadhigamanīya tayā ca sūkṣmaḥ na tu manda tayā

original: bāhyābhyantaraviṣayākṣepī caturthaḥ||2.51||

evaṃ trayo viśeṣā lakṣitāḥ| caturthaṃ lakṣayati --- bāhyābhyantaraviṣayākṣepī caturthaḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- deśakālasaṃkhyābhir iti| ākṣipto 'bhyāsavaśīkṛtād rūpād avaropitaḥ so'pi dīrghasūkṣma eva tatpūrvako bāhyābhyantaraviṣayaprāṇāyāmo deśakālasaṃkhyādarśanapūrvakaḥ|
analyzed: evam trayaḥ viśeṣāḥ lakṣitāḥ caturtham lakṣayati bāhya ābhyantara viṣaya ākṣepī caturthaḥ vyācaṣṭe deśa kāla saṃkhyābhiḥ iti ākṣiptaḥ bhyāsa vaśīkṛtāt rūpāt avaropitaḥ saḥ api dīrgha sūkṣmaḥ eva tad pūrvakaḥ bāhya ābhyantara viṣaya prāṇāyāmaḥ deśa kāla saṃkhyā darśana pūrvakaḥ

original: na cāsau caturthas tṛtīya iva sakṛtprayatnād ahnāya jāyate kiṃ tv abhyasyamānas tāṃ tām avasthām āpannas tattadavasthāvijayānukrameṇa bhavatīty āha --- bhūmijayād iti| nanūbhayor gatyabhāvaḥ stambhavṛttāv apy astīti ko'smād asya viśeṣa ity ata āha --- tṛtīya iti| anālocanapūrvaḥ sakṛtprayatnanirvartitas tṛtīyaḥ|
analyzed: na ca asau caturthaḥ tṛtīyaḥ iva sakṛt prayatnāt ahne jāyate kim tu abhyasyamānaḥ tām tām avasthām āpannaḥ tad tad avasthā vijaya anukrameṇa bhavati iti āha bhūmi jayāt iti nanu ubhayoḥ gati abhāvaḥ stambha vṛttau api asti iti kaḥ smāt asya viśeṣaḥ iti atas āha tṛtīyaḥ iti anālocana pūrvaḥ sakṛt prayatna nirvartitaḥ tṛtīyaḥ

original: caturthas tv ālocanapūrvo bahuprayatnanirvartanīya iti viśeṣaḥ| tayoḥ pūrakarecakayor viṣayo'nālocito'yaṃ tu deśakālasaṃkhyābhir ālocita ity arthaḥ||2.51||
analyzed: caturthaḥ tu ālocana pūrvaḥ bahu prayatna nirvartanīyaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ tayoḥ pūraka recakayoḥ tu deśa kāla saṃkhyābhiḥ ālocitaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tataḥ kṣīyate prakāśāvaraṇam||2.52||
analyzed: tatas kṣīyate prakāśa āvaraṇam

original: prāṇāyāmasyāvāntaraprayojanam āha --- tataḥ kṣīyate prakāśāvaraṇam| āvriyate'nena buddhisattvaprakāśa ity āvaraṇaṃ kleśaḥ pāpmā ca| vyācaṣṭe --- prāṇāyāmān iti| jñāyate'neneti jñānaṃ buddhisattvaprakāśo vivekasya jñānaṃ vivekajñānam| vivekajñānam āvṛṇotīti vivekajñānāvaraṇīyam|
analyzed: prāṇāyāmasya avāntara prayojanam āha tatas kṣīyate prakāśa āvaraṇam buddhi sattva prakāśaḥ iti āvaraṇam kleśaḥ pāpmā ca vyācaṣṭe prāṇāyāmān iti jñāyate inena iti jñānam buddhi sattva prakāśaḥ vivekasya jñānam viveka jñānam viveka jñānam āvṛṇoti iti viveka jñāna āvaraṇīyam

original: bhavyageyapravacanīyādīnāṃ kartari nipātanasya pradarśanārthatvāt kopanīyarañjanīyavad atrāpi kartari kṛtyapratyayaḥ| karmaśabdena tajjanyam apuṇyaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ kleśaṃ [ca] lakṣayati| atraivāgaminām anumatim āha --- yat tad ācakṣata iti| mahāmoho rāgaḥ, tadavinirbhāgavartiny avidyāpi tadgrahaṇena gṛhyate| akāryam adharmaḥ|
analyzed: bhavya geya pravacanīya ādīnām kartari nipātanasya pradarśana artha tvāt kopanīya rañjanīya vat atra api kartari kṛtya pratyayaḥ karma śabdena tad janyam apuṇyam tad kāraṇam kleśam ca lakṣayati atra eva āgaminām anumatim āha yat tat ācakṣate iti mahā mohaḥ rāgaḥ tad avinirbhāga vartinī avidyā api tad grahaṇena gṛhyate akāryam adharmaḥ

original: nanu prāṇāyāma eva cet pāpmānaṃ kṣiṇoti kṛtaṃ tarhi tapasety ata āha --- durbalaṃ bhavatīti| na tu sarvathā kṣīyate'tas tatprakṣayāya tapo'pekṣyata iti| atrāpy āgaminām anumatim āha --- tathā coktam iti|
analyzed: nanu prāṇāyāmaḥ eva ced pāpmānam kṣiṇoti kṛtam tarhi tapasā iti atas āha durbalam bhavati iti na tu sarvathā kṣīyate itas tad prakṣayāya tapaḥ upekṣyate iti atra api āgaminām anumatim āha tathā ca uktam iti

original: manur apy āha --- "prāṇāyamair dahed doṣān" iti|
analyzed: manuḥ api āha prāṇāyamaiḥ dahet doṣān iti

original: prāṇāyāmasya yogāṅgatā viṣṇupurāṇoktā ---
analyzed: prāṇāyāmasya yoga aṅga tā viṣṇupurāṇa uktā

original: "prāṇākhyam anilaṃ vaśyam abhyāsāt kurute tu yaḥ| prāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sabījo'bīja eva ca|| paraspareṇābhibhavaṃ prāṇāpānau yadānilau| kurutas tadvidhānena tṛtīyaṃ saṃyamāt tayoḥ" iti||2.52||
analyzed: prāṇa ākhyam anilam vaśyam abhyāsāt kurute tu yaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sa bījaḥ bījaḥ eva ca paraspareṇa abhibhavam prāṇa apānau yadā anilau kurutaḥ tad vidhānena tṛtīyam saṃyamāt tayoḥ iti

original: dhāraṇāsu ca yogyatā manasaḥ||2.53||
analyzed: dhāraṇāsu ca yogya tā manasaḥ

original: kiṃ ca --- dhāraṇāsu ca yogyatā manasaḥ| prāṇāyāmo hi manaḥ sthirīkurvan dhāraṇāsu yogyaṃ karoti||2.53||
analyzed: kim ca dhāraṇāsu ca yogya tā manasaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ hi manaḥ sthirīkurvan dhāraṇāsu yogyam karoti

original: svaviṣayāsaṃprayoge cittasvarūpānukāra ivendriyāṇāṃ pratyāhāraḥ||2.54||
analyzed: sva viṣaya asaṃprayoge citta svarūpa anukāraḥ iva indriyāṇām pratyāhāraḥ

original: tad evaṃ yamādibhiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ saṃyamāya pratyāhāram ārabhate| tasya lakṣaṇasūtram avatārayituṃ pṛcchati --- atheti| svaviṣayāsaṃprayoge cittasvarūpānukāra ivendriyāṇāṃ pratyāhāraḥ|
analyzed: tat evam yama ādibhiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ saṃyamāya pratyāhāram ārabhate tasya lakṣaṇa sūtram avatārayitum pṛcchati atha iti sva viṣaya asaṃprayoge citta svarūpa anukāraḥ iva indriyāṇām pratyāhāraḥ

original: cittam api mohanīyarañjanīyakopanīyaiḥ śabdādibhir viṣayair na saṃprayujyate tadasaṃprayogāc cakṣurādīny api na saṃprayujyanta iti so'yam indriyāṇāṃ cittasvarūpānukāraḥ| yat punas tattvaṃ cittam abhiniviśate na tadindriyāṇi bāhyaviṣayāṇīty ananukāro'pi| ata uktam anukāra iveti|
analyzed: cittam api mohanīya rañjanīya kopanīyaiḥ śabda ādibhiḥ viṣayaiḥ na saṃprayujyate tad asaṃprayogāt cakṣuḥ ādīni api na saṃprayujyante iti saḥ uyam indriyāṇām citta sva rūpa anukāraḥ yat punar tattvam cittam abhiniviśate na tat indriyāṇi bāhya viṣayāṇi iti an anukāraḥ api atas uktam anukāraḥ iva iti

original: svaviṣayāsaṃprayogasya sādhāraṇasya dharmasya cittānukāranimittatvaṃ saptamyā darśayati --- sveti| anukāraṃ vivṛṇoti --- cittanirodha iti| dvayor nirodhahetuś ca prayatnas tulya iti sādṛśyam| atraiva dṛṣṭāntam āha --- yathā madhukararājam iti| dārṣṭāntike yojayati --- tatheti| atrāpi viṣṇupurāṇavākyam ---
analyzed: sva viṣaya asaṃprayogasya sādhāraṇasya dharmasya citta anukāra nimitta tvam saptamyā darśayati sva iti anukāram vivṛṇoti citta nirodhaḥ iti dvayoḥ nirodha hetuḥ ca prayatnaḥ tulyaḥ iti sādṛśyam atra eva dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā madhukararājam iti dārṣṭāntike yojayati tathā iti atra api viṣṇupurāṇa vākyam

original: "śabdādiṣv anuṣaktāni nigṛhyākṣāṇi yogavit| kuryāc cittānukārīṇi pratyāhāraparāyaṇaḥ"||
analyzed: śabda ādiṣu anuṣaktāni nigṛhya akṣāṇi yoga vid kuryāt citta anukārīṇi pratyāhāra parāyaṇaḥ

original: tasya prayojanaṃ tatraiva darśitam ---
analyzed: tasya prayojanam tatra eva darśitam

original: "vaśyatā paramā tena jāyate niścalātmanām| indriyāṇām avaśyais tair na yogasādhakaḥ" iti||2.54||
analyzed: vaśya tā paramā tena jāyate niścala ātmanām indriyāṇām avaśyaiḥ taiḥ na yoga sādhakaḥ iti

original: tataḥ paramā vaśyatendriyāṇām||2.55||
analyzed: tatas paramā vaśya tā indriyāṇām

original: (iti śrīpatañjaliviracitayogasūtreṣu dvitīyaḥ sādhanapādaḥ||2||)
analyzed: iti śrī patañjali viracita yoga sūtreṣu dvitīyaḥ sādhana pādaḥ

original: asyānuvādakaṃ sūtram --- tataḥ paramā vaśyatendriyāṇām| nanu santi kim anyā aparamā indriyāṇāṃ vaśyatā yā apekṣya parameyam ucyate, addhā tā darśayati --- śabdādiṣv iti| etad eva vivṛṇoti --- saktī rāgo vyasanam| kayā vyupattyā (vyutpattyā), vyasyati kṣipati nirasyaty enaṃ śreyasa iti| tadabhāvo'vyasanaṃ vaśyatā|
analyzed: asya anuvādakam sūtram tatas paramā vaśyatā indriyāṇām nanu santi kim anyāḥ aparamāḥ indriyāṇām vaśyatā yāḥ apekṣya paramā iyam ucyate addhā tāḥ darśayati śabda ādiṣu iti etat eva vivṛṇoti saktiḥ rāgaḥ vyasanam kayā vyupattyā vyutpattyā vyasyati kṣipati nirasyati enam śreyasaḥ iti tad abhāvaḥ vyasanam vaśyatā

original: aparām api vaśyatām āha --- aviruddhā śrutyādyaviruddhaśabdādisevanaṃ tadviruddheṣv apravṛttiḥ, saiva nyāyyā nyāyād anapetā yataḥ| aparām api vaśyatām āha --- śabdādisaṃprayoga iti| śabdādiṣv indriyāṇāṃ saṃprayogaḥ svecchayā bhogyeṣu khalv ayaṃ svatantro na bhogyatantra ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: aparām api vaśyatām āha aviruddhā śruti ādi aviruddha śabda ādi sevanam tad viruddheṣu apravṛttiḥ sā eva nyāyyā nyāyāt anapetā yatas aparām api vaśyatām āha śabda ādi saṃprayogaḥ iti śabda ādiṣu indriyāṇām saṃprayogaḥ sva icchayā bhogyeṣu khalu ayam svatantraḥ na bhogya tantraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: aparām api vaśyatām āha --- rāgadveṣābhāve sukhaduḥkhaśūnyaṃ mādhyasthyena śabdādijñānam ity eke| sūtrakārābhimatāṃ vaśyatāṃ paramarṣisaṃmatām āha --- cittasyaikāgryāt sahendriyair apravṛttir eva śabdādiṣv iti jaigīṣavyaḥ| asyāḥ paramatām āha --- paramā tv iti| tuśabdo vaśyatāntarebhyo viśinaṣṭi|
analyzed: aparām api vaśyatām āha rāga dveṣa abhāve sukha duḥkha śūnyam mādhyasthyena śabda ādi jñānam iti eke sūtrakāra abhimatām vaśyatām parama ṛṣi saṃmatām āha cittasya aikāgryāt saha indriyaiḥ apravṛttiḥ eva śabda ādiṣu iti jaigīṣavyaḥ asyāḥ paramatām āha paramā tu iti tuśabdaḥ vaśyatā antarebhyaḥ viśinaṣṭi

original: vaśyatāntarāṇi hi viṣayāśīviṣasaṃprayogaśālitayā kleśaviṣasaṃparkaśaṅkāṃ nāpakrāmanti| na hi viṣavidyāvitprakṛṣṭo'pi vaśīkṛtabhujaṃgamo bhujaṃgamam aṅke nidhāya svapiti viśrabdhaḥ| iyaṃ tu vaśyatā vidūrīkṛtanikhilaviṣayavyatiṣaṅgā nirāśaṅkatayā paramety ucyate| netarendriyajayavad iti|
analyzed: vaśyatā antarāṇi hi viṣaya āśīviṣa saṃprayoga śāli tayā kleśa viṣa saṃparka śaṅkām nā apakrāmanti na hi viṣa vidyā vid prakṛṣṭaḥ api vaśīkṛta bhujaṃgamaḥ bhujaṃgamam aṅke nidhāya svapiti viśrabdhaḥ iyam tu vaśyatā vidūrīkṛta nikhila viṣaya vyatiṣaṅgā nirāśaṅka tayā paramā iti ucyate na itara indriya jaya vat iti

original: yathā yatamānasaṃjñāyām ekendriyajaye'pīndriyāntarajayāya prayatnāntaram apekṣante na caivaṃ cittanirodhe bāhyendriyanirodhāya prayatnāntarāpekṣety arthaḥ||2.55||
analyzed: yathā yatamāna saṃjñāyām eka indriya jaye ipi indriya antara jayāya prayatna antaram apekṣante na ca evam citta nirodhe bāhya indriya nirodhāya prayatna antara apekṣā iti arthaḥ

original: kriyāyogaṃ jagau kleśān vipākān karmaṇām iha| tadduḥkhatvaṃ tathā vyūhān pāde yogasya pañcakam|| iti||1||
analyzed: kriyāyogam jagau kleśān vipākān karmaṇām iha tad duḥkha tvam tathā vyūhān pāde yogasya pañcakam iti

original: iti śrīvācaspatimiśraviracitāyāṃ pātañjalayogasūtrabhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ sādhanapādaḥ||2||
analyzed: iti śrī vācaspatimiśra viracitāyām pātañjala yoga sūtra bhāṣya vyākhyāyām dvitīyaḥ sādhana pādaḥ

original: tatra tṛtīyo vibhūtipādaḥ|
analyzed: tatra tṛtīyaḥ vibhūti pādaḥ

original: deśabandhaś cittasya dhāraṇā||3.1||
analyzed: deśa bandhaḥ cittasya dhāraṇā

original: prathamadvitīyapādābhyāṃ samādhis tatsādhanaṃ coktam| tṛtīyapāde tatpravṛttyanuguṇāḥ śraddhotpādahetavo vibhūtayo vaktavyāḥ| tāś ca saṃyamasādhyāḥ| saṃyamaś ca dhāraṇādhyānasamādhisamudāya iti vibhūtisādhanatayā pañcabhyaś ca yogāṅgebhyo bahiraṅgebhyo'syāṅgatrayasyāntaraṅgatayā viśeṣajñāpanārtham atra trayasyopanyāsaḥ|
analyzed: prathama dvitīya pādābhyām samādhiḥ tad sādhanam ca uktam tṛtīya pāde tad pravṛtti anuguṇāḥ śraddhā utpāda hetavaḥ vibhūtayaḥ vaktavyāḥ tāḥ ca saṃyama sādhyāḥ saṃyamaḥ ca dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhi samudāyaḥ iti vibhūti sādhana tayā pañcabhyaḥ ca yogāṅgebhyaḥ bahiraṅgebhyaḥ sya aṅga trayasya antaraṅga tayā viśeṣa jñāpana artham atra trayasya upanyāsaḥ

original: tatrāpi ca dhāraṇādhyānasamādhīnāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvena niyatapaurvāparyatvāt tadanurodhenopanyāse krama iti prathamaṃ dhāraṇā lakṣaṇīyety āha --- uktānīti| deśabandhaś cittasya dhāraṇā| ādhyātmikadeśam āha --- nābhicakra iti| ādiśabdena tālvādayo grāhyāḥ| bandhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ| bāhyadeśam āha --- bāhya iti|
analyzed: tatra api ca dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhīnām kārya kāraṇa bhāvena niyata paurvāparya tvāt tad anurodhena upanyāse kramaḥ iti prathamam dhāraṇā lakṣaṇīyā iti āha uktāni iti deśa bandhaḥ cittasya dhāraṇā ādhyātmika deśam āha nābhi cakre iti ādi śabdena tālu ādayaḥ grāhyāḥ bandhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ bāhya deśam āha bāhyaḥ iti

original: bāhye ca na svarūpeṇa cittasya saṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavatīty uktaṃ vṛttimātreṇa jñānamātreṇeti| atrāpi purāṇam ---
analyzed: bāhye ca na sva rūpeṇa cittasya saṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavati iti uktam vṛtti mātreṇa jñāna mātreṇa iti atra api purāṇam

original: "prāṇāyāmena pavanaṃ pratyāhāreṇa cendriyam| vaśīkṛtya tataḥ kuryāc cittasthānaṃ śubhāśraye" śubhāśrayā bāhyā hiraṇyagarbhavāsavaprajāpatiprabhṛtayaḥ| idaṃ ca tatroktam ---
analyzed: prāṇāyāmena pavanam pratyāhāreṇa ca indriyam vaśīkṛtya tatas kuryāt citta sthānam śubha āśraye śubha āśrayāḥ bāhyāḥ hiraṇyagarbha vāsava prajāpati prabhṛtayaḥ idam ca tatra uktam

original: "mūrtaṃ bhagavato rūpaṃ sarvopāśrayaniḥspṛham| eṣā vai dhāraṇā jñeyā yac cittaṃ tatra dhāryate|| tac ca mūrtaṃ hare rūpaṃ yad vicintyaṃ narādhipa| tac chrūyatām anādhārā dhāraṇā nopapadyate|| prasannavadanaṃ cārupadmapatranibhekṣaṇam| sukapolaṃ suvistīrṇalalāṭaphalakojjvalam|| samakarṇāntavinyastacārukuṇḍalabhūṣaṇam|
analyzed: mūrtam bhagavataḥ rūpam sarva upāśraya niḥspṛham eṣā vai dhāraṇā jñeyā yat cittam tatra dhāryate tat ca mūrtam hareḥ rūpam yat vicintyam narādhipa tat śrūyatām anādhārā dhāraṇā na upapadyate prasanna vadanam cāru padma patra nibha īkṣaṇam su kapolam su vistīrṇa lalāṭa phalaka ujjvalam sama karṇa anta vinyasta cāru kuṇḍala bhūṣaṇam

original: kambugrīvaṃ suvistīrṇaśrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam|| valīvibhaṅginā magnanābhinā codareṇa ca| pralambāṣṭabhujaṃ viṣṇum athavāpi caturbhujam|| samasthitorujaṅghaṃ ca svastikāṅghrivarāmbujam| cintayed brahmabhūtaṃ taṃ pītanirmalavāsasam|| kirīṭacārukeyūrakaṭakādivibhūṣitam| śārṅgacakragadākhaḍgaśaṅkhākṣavalayānvitam||
analyzed: kambu grīvam su vistīrṇa śrīvatsa aṅkita vakṣasam valī vibhaṅginā magna nābhinā ca udareṇa ca pralamba aṣṭa bhujam viṣṇum athavā api caturbhujam samasthita ūru jaṅgham ca svastika aṅghri vara ambujam cintayet brahma bhūtam tam pīta nirmala vāsasam kirīṭa cāru keyūra kaṭaka ādi vibhūṣitam śārṅga cakra gadā khaḍga śaṅkha akṣa valaya anvitam

original: cintayet tanmayo yogī samādhāyātmamānasam| tāvad yāvad dṛḍhībhūtā tatraiva nṛpa dhāraṇā|| etad ātiṣṭhato'nyad vā svecchayā karma kurvataḥ| nāpayāti yadā cittaṃ siddhāṃ manyeta tāṃ tadā" iti||3.1||
analyzed: cintayet tad mayaḥ yogī samādhāya ātma mānasam tāvat yāvat dṛḍhībhūtā tatra eva nṛpa dhāraṇā etat ātiṣṭhataḥ anyat vā sva icchayā karma kurvataḥ na apayāti yadā cittam siddhām manyeta tām tadā iti

original: tatra pratyayaikatānatā dhyānam||3.2||
analyzed: tatra pratyaya eka tāna tā dhyānam

original: dhāraṇāsādhyaṃ dhyānaṃ lakṣayati --- tatra pratyayaikatānatā dhyānam| ekatānataikāgratā| sugamaṃ bhāṣyam| atrāpi purāṇam ---
analyzed: dhāraṇā sādhyam dhyānam lakṣayati tatra pratyaya eka tāna tā dhyānam eka tāna tā ekāgra tā sugamam bhāṣyam atra api purāṇam

original: "tadrūpapratyayaikāgryasaṃtatiś cānyaniḥspṛhā| tad dhyānaṃ prathamair aṅgaiḥ ṣaḍbhir niṣpādyate nṛpa" iti||3.2||
analyzed: tad rūpa pratyaya aikāgrya saṃtatiḥ ca anya niḥspṛhā tat dhyānam prathamaiḥ aṅgaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ niṣpādyate nṛpaḥ iti

original: tad evārthamātranirbhāsaṃ svarūpaśūnyam iva samādhiḥ||3.3||
analyzed: tat eva artha mātra nirbhāsam sva rūpa śūnyam iva samādhiḥ

original: dhyānasādhyaṃ samādhiṃ lakṣayati --- tad evārthamātranirbhāsaṃ svarūpaśūnyam iva samādhiḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- dhyānam eveti| dhyeyākāranirbhāsam iti| dhyeyākārasyaiva nirbhāso na dhyānākārasyeti| ata evāha --- śūnyam iti| nanu śūnyaṃ cet kathaṃ dhyeyaṃ prakāśetety ata āha --- iveti| atraiva hetum āha --- dhyeyasvabhāvāveśād iti| atrāpi purāṇam ---
analyzed: dhyāna sādhyam samādhim lakṣayati tat eva artha mātra nirbhāsam svarūpa śūnyam iva samādhiḥ vyācaṣṭe dhyānam eva iti dhyeya ākāra nirbhāsam iti dhyeya ākārasya eva nirbhāsaḥ na dhyāna ākārasya iti atas eva āha śūnyam iti nanu śūnyam ced katham dhyeyam prakāśeta iti atas āha iva iti atra eva hetum āha dhyeya svabhāva āveśāt iti atra api purāṇam

original: "tasyaiva kalpanāhīnaṃ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ hi yat| manasā dhyānaniṣpādyaṃ samādhiḥ so'bhidhīyate" iti||
analyzed: tasya eva kalpanā hīnam sva rūpa grahaṇam hi yat manasā dhyāna niṣpādyam samādhiḥ saḥ abhidhīyate iti

original: dhyeyād dhyānasya bhedaḥ kalpanā taddhīnam ity arthaḥ| aṣṭāṅgayogam uktvā khāṇḍikyāya keśidhvaja upasaṃjahāra ---
analyzed: dhyeyāt dhyānasya bhedaḥ kalpanā tad hīnam iti arthaḥ aṣṭāṅga yogam uktvā khāṇḍikyāya keśidhvajaḥ upasaṃjahāra

original: "kṣetrajñaḥ karaṇī jñānaṃ karaṇaṃ tad acetanam| niṣpādya muktikāryaṃ vai kṛtakṛtyaṃ nivartate" iti||3.3||
analyzed: kṣetrajñaḥ karaṇī jñānam karaṇam tat acetanam niṣpādya mukti kāryam vai kṛtakṛtyam nivartate iti

original: trayam ekatra saṃyamaḥ||3.4||
analyzed: trayam ekatra saṃyamaḥ

original: dhāraṇādhyānasamādhir ity etattrayasya tatra tatra niyujyamānasya prātisvikasaṃjñoccāraṇe gauravaṃ syād iti lāghavārthaṃ paribhāṣāsūtram avatārayati --- trayam ekatra saṃyamaḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- ekaviṣayāṇīti (tad etad iti)| vācakatvaśaṅkām apanayati --- tad asyeti| tantryate vyutpādyate yogo yena śāstreṇa tat tantraṃ tadbhavā tāntrikī|
analyzed: dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhiḥ iti etad trayasya tatra tatra niyujyamānasya prātisvika saṃjñā uccāraṇe gauravam syāt iti lāghava artham paribhāṣā sūtram avatārayati trayam ekatra saṃyamaḥ vyācaṣṭe eka viṣayāṇi iti tat etat iti vācaka tva śaṅkām apanayati tat asya iti tantryate vyutpādyate yogaḥ yena śāstreṇa tat tantram tad bhavā tāntrikī
