original: saṃyamapradeśāḥ "pariṇāmatrayasaṃyamāt" ityevamādayaḥ||3.4||
analyzed: saṃyama pradeśāḥ pariṇāma traya saṃyamāt iti evamādayaḥ

original: tajjayāt prajñālokaḥ||3.5||
analyzed: tat jayāt prajñālokaḥ

original: saṃyamavijayasyābhyāsasādhanasya phalam āha --- tajjayāt prajñālokaḥ| pratyayāntarānabhibhūtasya nirmalapravāhe'vasthānam ālokaḥ prajñāyāḥ| sugamaṃ bhāṣyam||3.5||
analyzed: saṃyama vijayasya abhyāsa sādhanasya phalam āha tad jayāt prajñā ālokaḥ pratyaya antara anabhibhūtasya nirmala pravāha iva sthānam ālokaḥ prajñāyāḥ sugamam bhāṣyam

original: tasya bhūmiṣu viniyogaḥ||3.6||
analyzed: tasya bhūmiṣu viniyogaḥ

original: kva punar viniyuktasya saṃyamasya phalam etad ity ata āha --- tasya bhūmiṣu viniyogaḥ| bhūmiṃ viśeṣayati bhāṣyakāraḥ --- tasyeti| jitāyā bhūmer yānantarā bhūmir avasthājitā tatra viniyogaḥ| sthūlaviṣaye savitarke samādhau vaśīkṛte saṃyamena saṃyamasyāvijite nirvitarke viniyogaḥ| tasminn api vaśīkṛte savicāre viniyogaḥ|
analyzed: kva punar viniyuktasya saṃyamasya phalam etat iti atas āha tasya bhūmiṣu viniyogaḥ bhūmim viśeṣayati bhāṣyakāraḥ tasya iti jitāyāḥ bhūmeḥ yā anantarā bhūmiḥ avasthā jitā tatra viniyogaḥ sthūla viṣaye sa vitarke samādhau vaśīkṛte saṃyamena saṃyamasya avijite nirvitarke viniyogaḥ tasmin api vaśīkṛte sa vicāre viniyogaḥ

original: evaṃ nirvicāre viniyoga ity arthaḥ| ata eva sthūlaviṣayasamāpattisiddhau satyāṃ purāṇe tattadāyudhabhūṣaṇāpanayena sūkṣmaviṣayaḥ samādhir avatāritaḥ ---
analyzed: evam nirvicāre viniyogaḥ iti arthaḥ atas eva sthūla viṣaya samāpatti siddhau satyām purāṇe tad tad āyudha bhūṣaṇa apanayena sūkṣma viṣayaḥ samādhiḥ avatāritaḥ

original: "tataḥ śaṅkhagadācakraśārṅgādirahitaṃ budhaḥ| cintayed bhagavadrūpaṃ praśāntaṃ sākṣasūtrakam|| yadā ca dhāraṇā tasminn avasthānavatī tataḥ| kirīṭakeyūramukhair bhūṣaṇai rahitaṃ smaret|| tadaikāvayavaṃ devaṃ so'haṃ ceti punar budhaḥ| kuryāt tato hy aham iti praṇidhānaparo bhavet||" iti||
analyzed: tatas śaṅkha gadā cakra śārṅga ādi rahitam budhaḥ cintayet bhagavat rūpam praśāntam sa akṣasūtrakam yadā ca dhāraṇā tasmin avasthānavatī tatas kirīṭa keyūra mukhaiḥ bhūṣaṇaiḥ rahitam smaret tadā eka avayavam devam saḥ ham ca iti punar budhaḥ kuryāt tatas hi aham iti praṇidhāna paraḥ bhavet iti

original: kasmāt punar adharāṃ bhūmiṃ vijityottarāṃ vijayate viparyayaḥ kasmān na bhavatīty ata āha --- na hy ajitādharabhūmir iti| na hi śilāhradād gaṅgāṃ prati prasthito'prāpya meghavanaṃ gaṅgāṃ prāpnoti| īśvaraprasādāj jitottarabhūmikasya ceti kasmāt tadarthasyottarabhūmivijayasya pratyāsannasyānyata eveśvarapraṇidhānād evāvagatatvāt|
analyzed: kasmāt punar adharām bhūmim vijitya uttarām vijayate viparyayaḥ kasmāt na bhavati iti atas āha na hi ajita adhara bhūmiḥ iti na hi śilāhradāt gaṅgām prati prasthitā u prāpya meghavanam gaṅgām prāpnoti īśvara prasādāt jita uttara bhūmikasya ca iti kasmāt tad arthasya uttara bhūmi vijayasya pratyāsannasya anyatas eva īśvara praṇidhānāt eva avagata tvāt

original: niṣpāditakriye karmaṇy aviśeṣādhāyinaḥ sādhanasya sādhananyāyātipātād iti| syād etad āgamataḥ sāmānyato'vagatānām apy avāntarabhūmibhedānāṃ kutaḥ paurvāparyāvagatir ity ata āha --- bhūmer asyā iti| jitaḥ pūrvo yoga uttarasya yogasya jñānapravṛttyadhigamahetuḥ| avasthaivāvasthāvān ity abhipretyaitad draṣṭavyam||3.6||
analyzed: niṣpādita kriye karmaṇi aviśeṣa ādhāyinaḥ sādhanasya sādhana nyāya atipātāt iti syāt etat āgamataḥ sāmānyatas uvagatānām api avāntarabhūmi bhedānām kutas paurvāparya avagatiḥ iti atas āha bhūmeḥ asyāḥ iti jitaḥ pūrvaḥ yogaḥ uttarasya yogasya jñāna pravṛtti adhigama hetuḥ avasthā eva avasthāvān iti abhipretya etat draṣṭavyam

original: trayam antaraṅgaṃ pūrvebhyaḥ||3.7||
analyzed: trayam antaraṅgam pūrvebhyaḥ

original: kasmāt punar yogāṅgatvāviśeṣe'pi saṃyamasya tatra tatra viniyogo nerareṣāṃ pañcānām ity ata āha --- trayam antaraṅgaṃ pūrvebhyaḥ| tad idaṃ sādhanatrayaṃ sādhyasamānaviṣayatvenāntaraṅgaṃ na tv evaṃ yamādayas tasmāt te bahiraṅgā ity arthaḥ||3.7||
analyzed: kasmāt punar yoga aṅga tva aviśeṣa ipi saṃyamasya tatra tatra viniyogaḥ pañcānām iti atas āha trayam antaraṅgam pūrvebhyaḥ tat idam sādhana trayam sādhya samāna viṣaya tvena antaraṅgam na tu evam yama ādayaḥ tasmāt te bahiraṅgāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tad api bahiraṅgaṃ nirbījasya||3.8||
analyzed: tat api bahiraṅgam nirbījasya

original: sādhanatrayasya saṃprajñāta evāntaraṅgatvaṃ na tv asaṃprajñāte tasya nirbījatayā taiḥ saha samānaviṣayatvābhāvāt teṣu ciraniruddheṣu saṃprajñātaparamakāṣṭhāparanāmajñānaprasādarūpaparavairāgyānantaram utpādāc cety āha --- tad iti| tad api bahiraṅgaṃ nirbījasya|
analyzed: sādhana trayasya saṃprajñāte eva antaraṅga tvam na tu asaṃprajñāte tasya nirbīja tayā taiḥ saha samāna viṣaya tva abhāvāt teṣu cira niruddheṣu saṃprajñāta parama kāṣṭhā apara nāma jñāna prasāda rūpa para vairāgya anantaram utpādāt ca iti āha tat iti tat api bahiraṅgam nirbījasya

original: samānaviṣayatvam antaraṅgatvaprayojakam iha na tu tadanantarabhāvas tasya bahiraṅgeśvarapraṇidhānavartitayā savyabhicāratvād iti sthite savyabhicāram apy antaraṅgalakṣaṇaṃ tadanantarabhāvitvam asya nāsti| tasmād dūrāpetāntaraṅgatā saṃyamasyāsaṃprajñāta iti darśayituṃ tadabhāve bhāvād ity uktam||3.8||
analyzed: samāna viṣaya tvam antaraṅga tva prayojakam iha na tu tad anantara bhāvaḥ tasya bahiraṅga īśvara praṇidhāna vartitayā savyabhicāra tvāt iti sthite savyabhicāram api antaraṅga lakṣaṇam tad anantara bhāvi tvam asya na asti tasmāt dūra apeta antaraṅga tā saṃyamasya asaṃprajñātaḥ iti darśayitum tad abhāve bhāvāt iti uktam

original: vyutthānanirodhasaṃskārayor abhibhavaprādurbhāvau nirodhakṣaṇacittānvayo nirodhapariṇāmaḥ||3.9||
analyzed: vyutthāna nirodha saṃskārayoḥ abhibhava prādurbhāvau nirodha kṣaṇa citta anvayaḥ nirodha pariṇāmaḥ

original: pariṇāmatrayasaṃyamād ity atropayokṣyamāṇapariṇāmatrayaṃ pratipipādayiṣur nirbījaprasaṅgena pṛcchati --- atheti| vyutthānasaṃprajñātayoś cittasya sphuṭatarapariṇāmabhedapracayānubhavān na praśnāvatāro nirodhe tu nānubhūyate pariṇāmaḥ| na cānanubhūyamāno nāsti, cittasya triguṇatayā calatvena guṇānāṃ kṣaṇam apy apariṇāmasyāsaṃbhavād ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: pariṇāma traya saṃyamāt iti atra upayokṣyamāṇa pariṇāma trayam pratipipādayiṣuḥ nirbīja prasaṅgena pṛcchati atha iti vyutthāna saṃprajñātayoḥ cittasya sphuṭatara pariṇāma bheda pracaya anubhavāt na praśna avatāraḥ nirodhe tu na anubhūyate pariṇāmaḥ na ca ananubhūyamānaḥ na asti cittasya triguṇa tayā calatvena guṇānām kṣaṇam api apariṇāmasya asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ

original: praśnottaraṃ sūtram --- vyutthānanirodhasaṃskārayor abhibhavaprādurbhāvau nirodhakṣaṇacittānvayo nirodhapariṇāmaḥ| asaṃprajñātaṃ samādhim apekṣya saṃprajñāto vyutthānam| nirudhyate 'neneti nirodho jñānaprasādaḥ paraṃ vairāgyaṃ tayor vyutthānanirodhasaṃskārayor abhibhavaprādurbhāvau|
analyzed: praśna uttaram sūtram vyutthāna nirodha saṃskārayoḥ abhibhava prādurbhāvau nirodha kṣaṇa citta anvayaḥ nirodha pariṇāmaḥ asaṃprajñātam samādhim apekṣya saṃprajñātaḥ vyutthānam nirudhyate nena iti nirodhaḥ jñāna prasādaḥ param vairāgyam tayoḥ vyutthāna nirodha saṃskārayoḥ abhibhava prādurbhāvau

original: tatra vyutthānasaṃskārasyābhibhavo nirodhasaṃskārasyāvirbhāvaś cittasya dharmiṇo nirodhakṣaṇasya nirodhāvasarasya dvayor avasthayor anvayaḥ| na hi cittaṃ dharmi saṃprajñātāvasthāyām asaṃprajñātāvasthāyāṃ ca saṃskārābhibhavaprādurbhāvayoḥ svarūpeṇa bhidyata iti|
analyzed: tatra vyutthāna saṃskārasya abhibhavaḥ nirodha saṃskārasya āvirbhāvaḥ cittasya dharmiṇaḥ nirodha kṣaṇasya nirodha avasarasya dvayoḥ avasthayoḥ anvayaḥ na hi cittam dharmi saṃprajñāta avasthāyām asaṃprajñāta avasthāyām ca saṃskāra abhibhava prādurbhāvayoḥ svarūpeṇa bhidyate iti

original: nanu yathottare kleśā avidyāmūlā avidyānivṛttau nivartanta iti na tu tannivṛttau pṛthak prayatnāntaram āsthīyata evaṃ vyutthānapratyayamūlāḥ saṃskārā vyutthānapratyayanivṛttāv eva nivartanta iti tannivṛttau na nirodhasaṃskāro'pekṣitavya ity ata āha --- vyutthānasaṃskārā iti|
analyzed: nanu yathā uttare kleśāḥ avidyā mūlāḥ avidyā nivṛttau nivartante iti na tu tad nivṛttau pṛthak prayatna antaram āsthīyate evam vyutthāna pratyaya mūlāḥ saṃskārāḥ vyutthāna pratyaya nivṛttau eva nivartante iti tad nivṛttau na nirodha saṃskāra upekṣitavyaḥ iti atas āha vyutthāna saṃskārāḥ iti

original: na kāraṇamātranivṛttiḥ kāryanivṛttihetur mā bhūt kuvindanivṛttāv api paṭasya nivṛttir api tu yatkāraṇātmakaṃ yatkāryaṃ tatkāraṇanivṛttau tatkāryanivṛttiḥ| uttare ca kleśā avidyātmāna ity uktam atas tannivṛttau teṣāṃ nivṛttir upapannā| na tv evaṃ pratyayātmānaḥ saṃskārāś ciraniruddhe pratyaye saṃprati smaraṇadarśanāt|
analyzed: na kāraṇa mātra nivṛttiḥ kārya nivṛtti hetuḥ mā bhūt kuvinda nivṛttau api paṭasya nivṛttiḥ api tu yad kāraṇa ātmakam yat kāryam tad kāraṇa nivṛttau tad kārya nivṛttiḥ uttare ca kleśāḥ avidyā ātmānaḥ iti uktam atas tad nivṛttau teṣām nivṛttiḥ upapannā na tu evam pratyaya ātmānaḥ saṃskārāḥ cira niruddhe pratyaye saṃprati smaraṇa darśanāt

original: tasmāt pratyayanivṛttāv api tannivṛttau nirodhasaṃskārapracaya evopāsanīya ity arthaḥ| sugamam anyat||3.9||
analyzed: tasmāt pratyaya nivṛttau api tad nivṛttau nirodha saṃskāra pracayaḥ eva upāsanīyaḥ iti arthaḥ sugamam anyat

original: tasya praśāntavāhitā saṃskārāt||3.10||
analyzed: tasya praśānta vāhitā saṃskārāt

original: sarvathā vyutthānasaṃskārābhibhave tu balavatā nirodhasaṃskāreṇa cittasya kīdṛśaḥ pariṇāma ity ata āha --- tasya praśāntavāhitā saṃskārāt| vyutthānasaṃskāramalarahitanirodhasaṃskāraparamparāmātravāhitā praśāntavāhitā| kasmāt punaḥ saṃskārapāṭavam apekṣate na tu saṃskāramātram ity ata āha --- tatsaṃskāramāndya iti| tad iti nirodhaṃ parāmṛśati|
analyzed: sarvathā vyutthāna saṃskāra abhibhave tu balavatā nirodha saṃskāreṇa cittasya kīdṛśaḥ pariṇāmaḥ iti atas āha tasya praśānta vāhitā saṃskārāt vyutthāna saṃskāra mala rahita nirodha saṃskāra paramparā mātra vāhitā praśānta vāhitā kasmāt punar saṃskāra pāṭavam apekṣate na tu saṃskāra mātram iti atas āha tad saṃskāra māndye iti tat iti nirodham parāmṛśati

original: ye tu nābhibhūyata iti paṭhanti te tadā vyutthānaṃ parāmṛśanti||3.10||
analyzed: ye tu na abhibhūyate iti paṭhanti te tadā vyutthānam parāmṛśanti

original: sarvārthataikāgratayoḥ kṣayodayau cittasya samādhipariṇāmaḥ||3.11||

saṃprajñātasamādhipariṇāmāvasthāṃ cittasya darśayati --- sarvārthataikāgratayoḥ kṣayodayau cittasya samādhipariṇāmaḥ| vikṣiptatā sarvārthatā| san na vinaśyatīti kṣayas tirobhāvo nāsad utpadyata iti udaya āvirbhāvaḥ|
analyzed: saṃprajñāta samādhi pariṇāma avasthām cittasya darśayati sarva artha tā ekāgra tayoḥ kṣaya udayau cittasya samādhi pariṇāmaḥ vikṣipta tā sarva artha tā sat na vinaśyati iti kṣayaḥ tirobhāvaḥ na asat utpadyate iti udayaḥ āvirbhāvaḥ

original: svātmabhūtayoḥ sarvārthataikāgratayor dharmayor yāv apāyopajanau sarvārthatāyā apāya ekāgratāyā upajanas tayor anugataṃ cittaṃ samādhīyate pūrvāparībhūtasādhyamānasamādhiviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti||3.11||
analyzed: sva ātma bhūtayoḥ sarvārthatā ekāgratayoḥ dharmayoḥ yau apāya upajanau sarvārthatāyāḥ apāyaḥ ekāgratāyāḥ upajanaḥ tayoḥ anugatam cittam samādhīyate pūrva aparībhūta sādhyamāna samādhi viśeṣaṇam bhavati iti

original: tataḥ punaḥ śāntoditau tulyapratyayau cittasyaikāgratāpariṇāmaḥ||3.12||
analyzed: tatas punar śānta uditau tulya pratyayau cittasya ekāgra tā pariṇāmaḥ

original: tataḥ punaḥ śāntoditau tulyapratyayau cittasyaikāgratāpariṇāmaḥ| punaḥ samādheḥ pūrvāparībhūtāyā avasthāyāḥ samādhiniṣpattau satyāṃ śāntoditāv atītavartamānau, tulyau ca tau pratyayau ceti tulyapratyayau| ekāgratāyāṃ tu dvayoḥ sādṛśyam| samāhitacittasyeti samādhiniṣpattir darśitā| tathaivaikāgram eva|
analyzed: tatas punar śānta uditau tulya pratyayau cittasya ekāgra tā pariṇāmaḥ punar samādheḥ pūrvāparībhūtāyāḥ avasthāyāḥ samādhi niṣpattau satyām śānta uditau atīta vartamānau tulyau ca tau pratyayau ca iti tulya pratyayau ekāgra tāyām tu dvayoḥ sādṛśyam samāhita cittasya iti samādhi niṣpattiḥ darśitā tathā eva ekāgram eva

original: avadhim āha --- ā samādhibhreṣād bhraṃśād iti||3.12||
analyzed: avadhim āha ā samādhi bhreṣāt bhraṃśāt iti

original: etena bhūtendriyeṣu dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāpariṇāmā vyākhyātāḥ||3.13||
analyzed: etena bhūta indriyeṣu dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmāḥ vyākhyātāḥ

original: prāsaṅgikaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇaupayikaṃ ca bhūtendriyapariṇāmaṃ vibhajate --- etena bhūtendriyeṣu dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāpariṇāmā vyākhyātāḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- eteneti| nanu cittapariṇatimātram uktaṃ na tu tatprakārā dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāpariṇāmās tat kathaṃ teṣām atideśa ity ata āha --- tatra vyutthānanirodhayor iti|
analyzed: prāsaṅgikam ca vakṣyamāṇa aupayikam ca bhūta indriya pariṇāmam vibhajate etena bhūta indriyeṣu dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmāḥ vyākhyātāḥ vyācaṣṭe etena iti nanu citta pariṇati mātram uktam na tu tad prakārāḥ dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmāḥ tat katham teṣām atideśaḥ iti atas āha tatra vyutthāna nirodhayoḥ iti

original: dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāśabdāḥ paraṃ noccāritā na tu dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāpariṇāmā noktā iti saṃkṣepārthaḥ| tathā hi vyutthānanirodhasaṃskārayor ity atraiva sūtre dharmapariṇāma uktaḥ| imaṃ ca dharmapariṇāmaṃ darśayatā tenaiva dharmādhikaraṇo lakṣaṇapariṇāmo'pi sūcita evety āha --- lakṣaṇapariṇāma iti| lakṣyate 'neneti lakṣaṇaṃ kālabhedaḥ|
analyzed: dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā śabdāḥ param na uccāritāḥ na tu dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmāḥ na uktāḥ iti saṃkṣepa arthaḥ tathā hi vyutthāna nirodha saṃskārayoḥ iti atra eva sūtre dharma pariṇāmaḥ uktaḥ imam ca dharma pariṇāmam darśayatā tena eva dharma adhikaraṇaḥ lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ api sūcitaḥ eva iti āha lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ iti lakṣyate nena iti lakṣaṇam kāla bhedaḥ

original: tena hi lakṣitaṃ vastu vastvantarebhyaḥ kālāntarayuktebhyo vyavacchidyata iti| nirodhas trilakṣaṇaḥ| asyaiva vyākhyānaṃ tribhir adhvabhir yuktaḥ| adhvaśabdaḥ kālavacanaḥ| sa khalv anāgatalakṣaṇam adhvānaṃ prathamaṃ hitvā, tat kim adhvavaddharmatvam apy atipatati nety āha --- dharmatvam anatikrānto vartamānalakṣaṇaṃ pratipannaḥ|
analyzed: tena hi lakṣitam vastu vastu antarebhyaḥ kāla antara yuktebhyaḥ vyavacchidyate iti nirodhaḥ tri lakṣaṇaḥ asya eva vyākhyānam tribhiḥ adhvabhiḥ yuktaḥ adhva śabdaḥ kāla vacanaḥ sa khalu anāgata lakṣaṇam adhvānam prathamam hitvā tat kim adhva vat dharma tvam api atipatati na iti āha dharma tvam an atikrāntaḥ vartamāna lakṣaṇam pratipannaḥ

original: ya eva nirodho'nāgata āsīt sa eva saṃprati vartamāno na tu nirodho 'nirodha ity arthaḥ| vartamānatāsvarūpavyākhyānam --- yatrāsya svarūpeṇa svocitārthakriyākāriṇā rūpeṇābhivyaktiḥ samudācāraḥ| eṣo'sya prathamam anāgatam adhvānam apekṣya dvitīyo'dhvā|
analyzed: yaḥ eva nirodhaḥ nāgataḥ āsīt saḥ eva saṃprati vartamānaḥ na tu nirodhaḥ nirodhaḥ iti arthaḥ vartamānatā svarūpa vyākhyānam yatra asya sva rūpeṇa sva ucita arthakriyā kāriṇā rūpeṇa abhivyaktiḥ samudācāraḥ eṣaḥ usya prathamam anāgatam adhvānam apekṣya dvitīyaḥ ūdhvā

original: syād etad anāgatam adhvānaṃ hitvā ced vartamānatām āpannas tāṃ ca hitvātītatām āpatsyate hanta bhor adhvanām utpādavināśau syātām| na ceṣyete, na hy asata utpādo nāpi sato vināśa ity ata āha --- na cātītānāgatābhyāṃ sāmānyātmanāvasthitābhyāṃ viyukta iti|
analyzed: syāt etat anāgatam adhvānam hitvā ced vartamāna tām āpannaḥ tām ca hitvā atīta tām āpatsyate hanta bhoḥ adhvanām utpāda vināśau syātām na ca iṣyete na hi asataḥ utpādaḥ na api sataḥ vināśaḥ iti atas āha na ca atīta anāgatābhyām sāmānya ātmanā avasthitābhyām viyuktaḥ iti

original: anāgatasya nirodhasya vartamānatālakṣaṇaṃ darśayitvā vartamānavyutthānasyātītatāṃ tṛtīyam adhvānam āha --- tathā vyutthānam iti| tat kiṃ nirodha evānāgato na vyutthānaṃ nety āha --- evaṃ punar vyutthānam iti| vyutthānajātyapekṣayā punarbhāvo na vyaktyapekṣayā| na hy atītaṃ punarbhavatīti| svarūpābhivyaktir arthakriyākṣamasyāvirbhāvaḥ|
analyzed: anāgatasya nirodhasya vartamāna tā lakṣaṇam darśayitvā vartamāna vyutthānasya atīta tām tṛtīyam adhvānam āha tathā vyutthānam iti tat kim nirodhaḥ eva anāgataḥ na vyutthānam na iti āha evam punar vyutthānam iti vyutthāna jāti apekṣayā punarbhāvaḥ na vyakti apekṣayā na hi atītam punar bhavati iti svarūpa abhivyaktiḥ arthakriyā kṣamasya āvirbhāvaḥ

original: sa caivaṃlakṣaṇapariṇāma uktas tajjātīyeṣu paunaḥpunyena vartata ity ata āha --- evaṃ punar iti| dharmapariṇāmasūcitam evāvasthāpariṇāmam āha --- tatheti| dharmāṇāṃ vartamānādhvanāṃ balavattvābalavattve avasthā tasyāḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ tāratamyaṃ pariṇāmaḥ| upasaṃharati --- eṣa iti|
analyzed: sa ca evaṃlakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ uktaḥ tad jātīyeṣu paunaḥpunyena vartate iti atas āha evam punar iti dharma pariṇāma sūcitam eva avasthā pariṇāmam āha tathā iti dharmāṇām vartamāna adhvanām balavat tva abalavat tve avasthā tasyāḥ pratikṣaṇam tāratamyam pariṇāmaḥ upasaṃharati eṣaḥ iti

original: pariṇāmabhedānāṃ saṃbandhibhedān nirdhārayati --- tatrānubhavānusārād dharmiṇa iti| tat kim eṣa pariṇāmo guṇānāṃ kādācitko nety āha --- evam iti| kasmāt punar ayaṃ pariṇāmaḥ sadātana ity ata āha --- calaṃ ceti| co hetvarthaḥ| vṛttaṃ pracāraḥ| etad eva kuta ity ata āha --- guṇasvābhāvyam iti| uktam atraiva purastāt|
analyzed: pariṇāma bhedānām saṃbandhi bhedān nirdhārayati tatra anubhava anusārāt dharmiṇaḥ iti tat kim eṣa pariṇāmaḥ guṇānām kādācitkaḥ na iti āha evam iti kasmāt punar ayam pariṇāmaḥ sadātanaḥ iti atas āha calam ca iti caḥ hetu arthaḥ vṛttam pracāraḥ etat eva kutas iti atas āha guṇa svābhāvyam iti uktam atra eva purastāt

original: so'yaṃ trividho'pi cittapariṇāmo bhūtendriyeṣu sūtrakāreṇa nirdiṣṭa ity āha --- eteneti| eṣa dharmapariṇāmabhedo dharmadharmiṇor bhedam ālakṣya| tatra bhūtānāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ dharmiṇāṃ gavādir ghaṭādir vā dharmapariṇāmaḥ| dharmāṇāṃ cātītānāgatavartamānarūpatā lakṣaṇapariṇāmaḥ|
analyzed: saḥ ayam trividhaḥ api citta pariṇāmaḥ bhūta indriyeṣu sūtrakāreṇa nirdiṣṭaḥ iti āha etena iti eṣa dharma pariṇāma bhedaḥ dharma dharmiṇoḥ bhedam ālakṣya tatra bhūtānām pṛthivī ādīnām dharmiṇām gavādiḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ vā dharma pariṇāmaḥ dharmāṇām ca atīta anāgata vartamāna rūpatā lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ

original: vartamānalakṣaṇāpannasya gavāder bālyakaumārayauvanavārdhakyam avasthāpariṇāmaḥ| ghaṭādīnām api navapurātanatāvasthāpariṇāmaḥ| evam indriyāṇām api dharmiṇāṃ tattannīlādyālocanaṃ dharmapariṇāmo dharmasya vartamānatādilakṣaṇapariṇāmo vartamānalakṣaṇasya ratnādyālocanasya sphuṭatvāsphuṭatvādir avasthāpariṇāmaḥ|
analyzed: vartamāna lakṣaṇa āpannasya gavādeḥ bālya kaumāra yauvana vārdhakyam avasthā pariṇāmaḥ ghaṭa ādīnām api nava purātana tā avasthā pariṇāmaḥ evam indriyāṇām api dharmiṇām tat tat nīla ādi ālocanam dharma pariṇāmaḥ dharmasya vartamāna tā ādi lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ vartamāna lakṣaṇasya ratna ādi ālocanasya sphuṭa tva asphuṭa tva ādiḥ avasthā pariṇāmaḥ

original: so'yam evaṃvidho bhūtendriyapariṇāmo dharmiṇo dharmalakṣaṇāvasthānāṃ bhedam āśritya veditavyaḥ| abhedam āśrityāha --- paramārthatas tv iti| tuśabdo bhedapakṣād viśinaṣṭi| pāramārthikatvam asya jñāpyate na tv anyasya pariṇāmatvaṃ niṣidhyate| kasmāt --- dharmisvarūpamātro hīti|
analyzed: saḥ ayam evaṃvidhaḥ bhūta indriya pariṇāmaḥ dharmiṇaḥ dharma lakṣaṇa avasthānām bhedam āśritya veditavyaḥ abhedam āśritya āha paramārthataḥ tu iti tuśabdaḥ bheda pakṣāt viśinaṣṭi pāramārthika tvam asya jñāpyate na tu anyasya pariṇāma tvam niṣidhyate kasmāt dharmi svarūpa mātraḥ hi iti

original: nanu yadi dharmivikriyaiva dharmaḥ katham asaṃkarapratyayo loke pariṇāmeṣv ity ata āha --- dharmadvāreti| dharmaśabdena dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāḥ parigṛhyante| taddvāreṇa dharmiṇa eva vikriyety ekā cāsaṃkīrṇā ca| taddvārāṇām abhede'pi dharmiṇaḥ parasparasaṃkarāt|
analyzed: nanu yadi dharmi vikriyā eva dharmaḥ katham asaṃkara pratyayaḥ loke pariṇāmeṣu iti atas āha dharma dvāra iti dharma śabdena dharma lakṣaṇa avasthāḥ parigṛhyante tad dvāreṇa dharmiṇaḥ eva vikriyā iti ekā ca asaṃkīrṇā ca tad dvārāṇām abhede pi dharmiṇaḥ paraspara saṃkarāt

original: nanu dharmāṇām abhinnatve dharmiṇo'dhvanāṃ ca bhede dharmiṇo 'nanyatvena dharmeṇāpīha dharmivad bhavitavyam ity ata āha --- tatra dharmasyeti| bhāvaḥ saṃsthānabhedaḥ| suvarṇāder yathā bhājanasya rucakasvastikavyapadeśabhedo bhavati tanmātram anyathā bhavati na tu dravyaṃ suvarṇam asuvarṇatām upaiti atyantabhedābhāvād iti|
analyzed: nanu dharmāṇām abhinna tve dharmiṇā adhvanām ca bhede dharmiṇaḥ na anya tvena dharmeṇa api iha dharmi vat bhavitavyam iti atas āha tatra dharmasya iti bhāvaḥ saṃsthāna bhedaḥ suvarṇa ādeḥ yathā bhājanasya rucaka svastika vyapadeśa bhedaḥ bhavati tad mātram anyathā bhavati na tu dravyam suvarṇam a suvarṇa tām upaiti atyanta bheda abhāvāt iti

original: vakṣyamāṇābhisaṃdhir ekāntavādinaṃ bauddham utthāpayati --- apara āheti| dharmā eva hi rucakādayas tathotpannāḥ paramārthasanto na punaḥ suvarṇaṃ nāma kiṃcid ekam anekeṣv anugataṃ dravyam iti| yadi punar nivartamāneṣv api dharmeṣu dravyam anugataṃ bhavet tato na citiśaktivat pariṇametāpi tu kauṭasthyenaiva parivarteta|
analyzed: vakṣyamāṇa abhisaṃdhiḥ ekānta vādinam bauddham utthāpayati aparaḥ āha iti dharmāḥ eva hi rucaka ādayaḥ tathā utpannāḥ paramārtha santaḥ na punar suvarṇam nāma kiṃcid ekam anekeṣu anugatam dravyam iti yadi punar nivartamāneṣu api dharmeṣu dravyam anugatam bhavet tatas na citi śakti vat pariṇameta api tu kauṭasthyena eva parivarteta

original: pariṇāmātmakaṃ rūpaṃ parihāya rūpāntareṇa kauṭasthyena parivartanaṃ parivṛttiḥ| yathā citiśaktir anyathānyathābhāvaṃ bhajamāneṣv api guṇeṣu svarūpād apracyutā kūṭasthanityaivaṃ suvarṇādy api syān na ceṣyate| tasmān na dravyam atiriktaṃ dharmebhya iti| pariharati --- ayam adoṣa iti| kasmāt| ekāntatānabhyupagamāt|
analyzed: pariṇāma ātmakam rūpam parihāya rūpa antareṇa kauṭasthyena parivartanam parivṛttiḥ yathā citi śaktiḥ anyathā anyathābhāvam bhajamāneṣu api guṇeṣu svarūpāt apracyutā kūṭastha nityā evam suvarṇa ādi api syāt na ca iṣyate tasmāt na dravyam atiriktam dharmebhyaḥ iti pariharati ayam adoṣaḥ iti kasmāt ekānta tā anabhyupagamāt

original: yadi citiśakter iva dravyasyaikāntikīṃ nityatām abhyupagacchema tata evam upālabhyemahi| na tv aikāntikīṃ nityatām ātiṣṭhāmahe kiṃ tu tad etat trailokyaṃ na tu dravyamātraṃ vyakter arthakriyākāriṇo rūpād apaiti| kasmān nityatvapratiṣedhāt pramāṇena|
analyzed: yadi citi śakteḥ iva dravyasya aikāntikīm nitya tām abhyupagacchema tatas evam upālabhyemahi na tu aikāntikīm nitya tām ātiṣṭhāmahe kim tu tat etat trailokyam na tu dravya mātram vyakteḥ arthakriyā kāriṇaḥ rūpāt apaiti kasmāt nitya tva pratiṣedhāt pramāṇena

original: yadi hi ghaṭo vyakter nāpeyāt kapālaśarkarācūrṇādiṣv avasthāsv api vyakto ghaṭa iti pūrvavad upalabdhyarthakriye kuryāt tasmād anityaṃ trailokyam| astu tarhy anityam evopalabdhyarthakriyārahitatvena gaganāravindavad atitucchatvād ity ata āha --- apetam apy asti, nātyantatucchatā yenaikāntato'nityaṃ syād ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: yadi hi ghaṭaḥ vyakteḥ na apeyāt kapāla śarkarā cūrṇa ādiṣu avasthāsu api vyaktaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti pūrvavat upalabdhi arthakriye kuryāt tasmāt anityam trailokyam astu tarhi anityam eva upalabdhi arthakriyā rahita tvena gagana aravinda vat ati tuccha tvāt iti atas āha apetam api asti na atyanta tuccha tā yena ekāntataḥ nityam syāt iti arthaḥ

original: kasmād vināśapratiṣedhāt pramāṇena| tathā hi yat tucchaṃ na tat kadācid apy upalabdhyarthakriye karoti| yathā gaganāravindam| karoti caitat trailokyaṃ kadācid upalabdhyarthakriye iti| tathotpattimaddravyatvadharmalakṣaṇāvasthāyogitvādayo'py atyantatucchagagananalinanaraviṣāṇādivyāvṛttāḥ sattvahetava udāhāryāḥ|
analyzed: kasmāt vināśa pratiṣedhāt pramāṇena tathā hi yat tuccham na tat kadācid api upalabdhi arthakriye karoti yathā gagana aravindam karoti ca etat trailokyam kadācid upalabdhi arthakriye iti tathā utpattimat dravya tva dharma lakṣaṇa avasthāyogi tva ādayaḥ api atyanta tuccha gagana nalina naraviṣāṇa ādi vyāvṛttāḥ sattva hetavaḥ udāhāryāḥ

original: tathā ca dharmī nātyantaṃ nityo yena citiśaktivat kūṭasthanityaḥ syāt kiṃ tu kathaṃcin nityaḥ| tathā ca pariṇāmīti siddham| etena mṛtpiṇḍādyavasthāsu kāryāṇāṃ ghaṭādīnām anāgatānāṃ sattvaṃ veditavyam| syād etat|
analyzed: tathā ca dharmī na atyantam nityaḥ yena citiśakti vat kūṭastha nityaḥ syāt kim tu kathaṃcid nityaḥ tathā ca pariṇāmi iti siddham etena mṛd piṇḍa ādi avasthāsu kāryāṇām ghaṭa ādīnām anāgatānām sattvam veditavyam syāt etat

original: apetam api ced asti kasmāt pūrvavan nopalabhyata ity ata āha --- saṃsargāt svakāraṇalayāt saukṣmyaṃ darśanānarhatvaṃ tataś cānupalabdhir iti| tad evaṃ dharmapariṇāmaṃ samarthya lakṣaṇapariṇāmam api lakṣaṇānāṃ parasparānugamanena samarthayate --- lakṣaṇapariṇāma iti| ekaikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇāntarābhyāṃ samanugatam ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: apetam api ced asti kasmāt pūrvavat na upalabhyate iti atas āha saṃsargāt sva kāraṇa layāt saukṣmyam darśana anarha tvam tatas ca anupalabdhiḥ iti tat evam dharma pariṇāmam samarthya lakṣaṇa pariṇāmam api lakṣaṇānām paraspara anugamanena samarthayate lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ iti ekaikam lakṣaṇam lakṣaṇa antarābhyām samanugatam iti arthaḥ

original: nanv ekalakṣaṇayoge lakṣaṇāntare nānubhūyete tat kathaṃ tadyoga ity ata āha --- yathā puruṣa iti| na hy anubhavābhāvaḥ pramāṇasiddham apalapati, tadutpāda eva tatra tatsadbhāve pramāṇam asata utpādāsaṃbhavān naraviṣāṇavad iti| paroktaṃ doṣam utthāpayati --- atra lakṣaṇapariṇāma iti|
analyzed: nanu eka lakṣaṇa yoge lakṣaṇa antare na anubhūyete tat katham tad yogaḥ iti atas āha yathā puruṣaḥ iti na hi anubhava abhāvaḥ pramāṇa siddham apalapati tad utpādaḥ eva tatra tad sadbhāve pramāṇam asataḥ utpāda asaṃbhavāt nara viṣāṇa vat iti para uktam doṣam utthāpayati atra lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ iti

original: yadā dharmo vartamānas tadaiva yady atīto'nāgataś ca tadā trayo'py adhvānaḥ saṃkīryerann anukrameṇa cādhvanāṃ bhāve'sadutpādaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| pariharati --- tasya parihāra iti| vartamānataiva hi dharmāṇām anubhavasiddhā tataḥ prākpaścātkālasaṃbandham avagamayati| na khalv asad utpadyate na ca sad vinaśyati|
analyzed: yadā dharmaḥ vartamānaḥ tadā eva yadi atīta unāgataḥ ca tadā trayaḥ api adhvānaḥ saṃkīryeran anukrameṇa ca adhvanām bhāve sat utpāda prasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ pariharati tasya parihāraḥ iti vartamāna tā eva hi dharmāṇām anubhava siddhā tatas prāk paścāt kāla saṃbandham avagamayati na khalu asat utpadyate na ca sat vinaśyati

original: tad idam āha --- evaṃ hi na cittam iti| krodhottarakālaṃ hi cittaṃ rāgadharmakam anubhūyate| yadā ca rāgaḥ krodhasamaye'nāgatatvena nāsīt katham asāv utpadyetānutpannaś ca katham anubhūyeteti| bhavatv evaṃ tathāpi kuto'dhvanām asaṃkara iti pṛcchati --- kiṃ ceti| kiṃ kāraṇam asaṃkare| caḥ punararthe|
analyzed: tat idam āha evam hi na cittam iti krodha uttara kālam hi cittam rāga dharmakam anubhūyate yadā ca rāgaḥ krodha samayena āgata tvena na āsīt katham asau utpadyeta anutpannaḥ ca katham anubhūyeta iti bhavatu evam tathā api kutodhvanām asaṃkaraḥ iti pṛcchati kim ca iti kim kāraṇam asaṃkare caḥ punararthe

original: uttaram āha --- trayāṇāṃ lakṣaṇānāṃ yugapan nāsti saṃbhavaḥ| kasminn ekasyāṃ cittavṛttau| krameṇa tu lakṣaṇānām ekatamasya svavyañjakāñjanasya bhāvo bhavet saṃbhavel lakṣyādhīnanirūpaṇatayā lakṣaṇānāṃ lakṣyākāreṇa tadvattā| atraiva pañcaśikhācāryasaṃmatim āha --- uktaṃ ceti| etac ca prāg eva vyākhyātam| upasaṃharati --- tasmād iti|
analyzed: uttaram āha trayāṇām lakṣaṇānām yugapad na asti saṃbhavaḥ kasmin ekasyām citta vṛttau krameṇa tu lakṣaṇānām ekatamasya sva vyañjaka añjanasya bhāvaḥ bhavet saṃbhavet lakṣya adhīna nirūpaṇatayā lakṣaṇānām lakṣya ākāreṇa tadvattā atra eva pañcaśikha ācārya saṃmatim āha uktam ca iti etat ca prāk eva vyākhyātam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: āvirbhāvatirobhāvarūpaviruddhadharmasaṃsargād asaṃkaro'dhvanām iti| dṛṣṭāntam āha --- yathā rāgasyeti| pūrvaṃ krodhasya rāgasaṃbandhāvagamo darśita iti| idānīṃ tu viṣayāntaravartino rāgasya viṣayāntaravartinā rāgāntareṇa saṃbandhāvagama iti| dārṣṭāntikam āha --- tathā lakṣaṇasyetīti|
analyzed: āvirbhāva tirobhāva rūpa viruddha dharma saṃsargāt asaṃkara udhvanām iti dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā rāgasya iti pūrvam krodhasya rāga saṃbandha avagamaḥ darśitaḥ iti idānīm tu viṣaya antara vartinaḥ rāgasya viṣaya antara vartinā rāga antareṇa saṃbandha avagamaḥ iti dārṣṭāntikam āha tathā lakṣaṇasya iti iti

original: nanu saty apy anekāntābhyupagame'bhedo'stīti dharmalakṣaṇāvasthānyatve tadabhinnasya dharmiṇo'py anyatvaprasaṅgaḥ| sa eva ca neṣyate tadanugamānubhavavirodhād ity ata āha --- na dharmī tryadhvā yatas tadabhinnā dharmās tryadhvānaḥ| dharmāṇām adhvatrayayogam eva sphorayati --- te lakṣitā abhivyaktā vartamānā iti yāvat|
analyzed: nanu sati api anekānta abhyupagama bhedaḥ usti iti dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā anyatve tad abhinnasya dharmiṇā api anyatva prasaṅgaḥ saḥ eva ca na iṣyate tad anugama anubhava virodhāt iti atas āha na dharmī tri adhvā yatas tad abhinnāḥ dharmāḥ tri adhvānaḥ dharmāṇām adhva traya yogam eva sphorayati te lakṣitāḥ abhivyaktāḥ vartamānāḥ iti yāvat

original: alakṣitā anabhivyaktā anāgatā atītā iti (atītāś ceti) yāvat| tatra lakṣitās tāṃ tām avasthāṃ balavattvadurbalatvādikāṃ prāpnuvanto 'nyatvena pratinirdiśyante'vasthāntarato na dravyāntarataḥ| avasthāśabdena dharmalakṣaṇāvasthā ucyante| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- anubhava eva hi dharmiṇo dharmādīnāṃ bhedābhedau vyavasthāpayati|
analyzed: alakṣitāḥ anabhivyaktāḥ anāgatāḥ atītāḥ iti atītāḥ ca iti yāvat tatra lakṣitāḥ tām tām avasthām balavat tva durbala tva ādikām prāpnuvantaḥ na dravya antarataḥ avasthā śabdena dharma lakṣaṇa avasthāḥ ucyante etat uktam bhavati anubhavaḥ eva hi dharmiṇaḥ dharma ādīnām bheda abhedau vyavasthāpayati

original: na hy aikāntike'bhede dharmādīnāṃ dharmiṇo dharmirūpavad dharmāditvam| nāpy aikāntike bhede gavāśvavad dharmāditvam|
analyzed: na hi aikāntike bhede dharma ādīnām dharmiṇaḥ dharmi rūpa vat dharma ādi tvam na api aikāntike bhede gavāśva vat dharma ādi tvam

original: sa cānubhavo'naikāntikatvam avasthāpayann api dharmādiṣūpajanāpāyadharmakeṣv api dharmiṇam ekam anugamayan dharmāṃś ca parasparato vyāvartayan pratyātmam anubhūyata iti tadanusāriṇo vayaṃ na tam ativartya svecchayā dharmānubhavān vyavasthāpayitum īśmaha iti| atraiva laukikaṃ dṛṣṭāntam āha --- yathaikā rekheti|
analyzed: sa ca anubhavaḥ na aikāntika tvam avasthāpayan api dharma ādiṣu upajana apāya dharmakeṣu api dharmiṇam ekam anugamayan dharmān ca parasparataḥ vyāvartayan pratyātmam anubhūyate iti tad anusāriṇaḥ vayam na tam ativartya sva icchayā dharma anubhavān vyavasthāpayitum īśmahe iti atra eva laukikam dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā ekā rekhā iti

original: yathā tad eva rekhāsvarūpaṃ tattatsthānāpekṣayā śatāditvena vyapadiśyata evaṃ tad eva dharmirūpaṃ tattaddharmalakṣaṇāvasthābhedenānyatvena pratinirdiśyata ity arthaḥ| dārṣṭāntikārthaṃ dṛṣṭāntāntaram āha --- yathā caikatve'pīti| atrāntare paroktaṃ doṣam utthāpayati --- avastheti|
analyzed: yathā tat eva rekhā svarūpam tat tat sthāna apekṣayā śata ādi tvena vyapadiśyate evam tat eva dharmi rūpam tat tat dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā bhedena anyatvena pratinirdiśyate iti arthaḥ dārṣṭāntika artham dṛṣṭānta antaram āha yathā ca ekatve api iti atra antare para uktam doṣam utthāpayati avasthā iti

original: avasthāpariṇāme dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāpariṇāme kauṭasthyadoṣaprasaṅga ukto dharmidharmalakṣaṇāvasthānām| pṛcchati --- katham iti| uttaram --- adhvano vyāpāreṇeti| dadhnaḥ kila yo 'nāgato'dhvā tasya vyāpāraḥ kṣīrasya vartamānatvaṃ tena vyavahitatvād dhetoḥ| yadā dharmo dadhilakṣaṇaḥ svavyāpāraṃ dādhikādyārambhaṃ kṣīre sann api na karoti tadānāgataḥ|
analyzed: avasthā pariṇāme dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāme kauṭasthya doṣa prasaṅgaḥ uktaḥ dharmi dharma lakṣaṇa avasthānām pṛcchati katham iti uttaram adhvanaḥ vyāpāreṇa iti dadhnaḥ kila yaḥ nāgataḥ ūdhvā tasya vyāpāraḥ kṣīrasya vartamāna tvam tena vyavahita tvāt hetoḥ yadā dharmaḥ dadhi lakṣaṇaḥ sva vyāpāram dādhika ādi ārambham kṣīre san api na karoti tadā anāgataḥ

original: yadā karoti tadā vartamānaḥ| yadā kṛtvā nivṛttaḥ sann eva svavyāpārād dādhikādyārambhāt tadātīta iti| evaṃ traikālye'pi sattvād dharmadharmiṇor lakṣaṇānām avasthānāṃ ca kauṭasthyaṃ prāpnoti| sarvadā sattā hi nityatvaṃ, caturṇām api ca sarvadā sattve'sattve vā notpādaḥ, tāvanmātraṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ kūṭasthanityatāyāḥ|
analyzed: yadā karoti tadā vartamānaḥ yadā kṛtvā nivṛttaḥ san eva sva vyāpārāt dādhika ādi ārambhāt tadā atītaḥ iti evam traikālye api sattvāt dharma dharmiṇoḥ lakṣaṇānām avasthānām ca kauṭasthyam prāpnoti sarvadā sattā hi nitya tvam caturṇām api ca sarvadā sattve sattve vā na utpādaḥ tāvanmātram ca lakṣaṇam kūṭastha nitya tāyāḥ

original: na hi citiśakter api kūṭasthanityāyāḥ kaścid anyo viśeṣa iti bhāvaḥ| pariharati --- nāsau doṣaḥ, kasmād guṇinityatve 'pi guṇānāṃ vimardo'nyonyābhibhāvyābhibhāvakatvaṃ tasya vaicitryāt|
analyzed: na hi citi śakteḥ api kūṭastha nityāyāḥ kaścid anyaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ pariharati na asau doṣaḥ kasmāt guṇi nitya tve pi guṇānām tasya vaicitryāt

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- yady api sarvadā sattvaṃ caturṇām api guṇiguṇānāṃ tathāpi guṇavimardavaicitryeṇa tadātmabhūtatadvikārāvirbhāvatirobhāvabhedena pariṇāmaśālitayā na kauṭasthyam| citiśaktes tu na svātmabhūtavikārāvirbhāvatirobhāva iti kauṭasthyam| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadi api sarvadā sattvam caturṇām api guṇi guṇānām tathā api guṇa vimarda vaicitryeṇa tad ātma bhūta tad vikāra āvirbhāva tirobhāva bhedena pariṇāma śāli tayā na kauṭasthyam citi śakteḥ tu na sva ātma bhūta vikāra āvirbhāva tirobhāvaḥ iti kauṭasthyam yathā āhuḥ

original: "nityaṃ tam āhur vidvāṃso yatsvabhāvo na naśayti" iti|
analyzed: nityam tam āhuḥ vidvāṃsaḥ yad svabhāvaḥ na naśayti iti

original: vimardavaicitryam eva vikāravaicitrye hetuṃ prakṛtau vikṛtau ca darśayati --- yathā saṃsthānaṃ pṛthivyādipariṇāmalakṣaṇam ādimad dharmamātraṃ vināśi tirobhāvi śabdādīnāṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhatanmātrāṇāṃ svakāryam apekṣyāvināśinām atirobhāvinām| prakṛtau darśayati --- evaṃ liṅgam iti|
analyzed: vimarda vaicitryam eva vikāra vaicitrye hetum prakṛtau vikṛtau ca darśayati yathā saṃsthānam pṛthivī ādi pariṇāma lakṣaṇam ādimat dharmamātram vināśi tirobhāvi śabda ādīnām śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandha tanmātrāṇām sva kāryam apekṣya avināśinām atirobhāvinām prakṛtau darśayati evam liṅgam iti

original: tasmin vikārasaṃjñā na tv evaṃ vikāravatī citiśaktir iti bhāvaḥ| tad evaṃ parīkṣakasiddhāṃ vikṛtiṃ prakṛtiṃ codāhṛtya vikṛtāv eva lokasiddhāyāṃ guṇavimardavaicitryaṃ dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāpariṇāmavaicitryahetum udāharati --- tatredam udāharaṇam iti| na cāyaṃ niyamo lakṣaṇānām evāvasthāpariṇāma iti|
analyzed: tasmin vikāra saṃjñā na tu evam vikāravatī citi śaktiḥ iti bhāvaḥ tat evam parīkṣaka siddhām vikṛtim prakṛtim ca udāhṛtya vikṛtau eva loka siddhāyām guṇa vimarda vaicitryam dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāma vaicitrya hetum udāharati tatra idam udāharaṇam iti na ca ayam niyamaḥ lakṣaṇānām eva avasthā pariṇāmaḥ iti

original: sarveṣām eva dharmalakṣaṇāvasthābhedānām avasthāśabdavācyatvād eka evāvasthāpariṇāmaḥ sarvasādhāraṇa ity āha --- dharmiṇo'pīti| vyāpakaṃ pariṇāmalakṣaṇam āha --- avasthitasya dravyasyeti| dharmaśabda āśritatvena dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāvācakaḥ||3.13||
analyzed: sarveṣām eva dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā bhedānām avasthā śabda vācya tvāt ekaḥ eva avasthā pariṇāmaḥ sarva sādhāraṇaḥ iti āha dharmiṇā api iti vyāpakam pariṇāma lakṣaṇam āha avasthitasya dravyasya iti dharma śabdaḥ āśrita tvena dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā vācakaḥ

original: śāntoditāvyapadeśyadharmānupātī dharmī||3.14||
analyzed: śānta udita avyapadeśya dharma anupātī dharmī

original: yasyaiṣa trividhaḥ pariṇāmas taṃ dharmiṇaṃ sūtreṇa lakṣayati --- tatra --- śāntoditāvyapadeśyadharmānupātī dharmī| dharmo'syāstīti dharmīti nāvijñāte dharme sa śakyo jñātum iti dharmaṃ darśayati --- yogyateti| dharmiṇo dravyasya mṛdādeḥ śaktir eva cūrṇapiṇḍaghaṭādyutpattiśaktir eva dharmas teṣāṃ tatrāvyaktatvena bhāva iti yāvat|
analyzed: yasya eṣa trividhaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tam dharmiṇam sūtreṇa lakṣayati tatra śānta udita avyapadeśya dharma anupātī dharmī dharmaḥ usya asti iti dharmī iti na avijñāte dharme sa śakyaḥ jñātum iti dharmam darśayati yogyatā iti dharmiṇaḥ dravyasya mṛd ādeḥ śaktiḥ eva cūrṇa piṇḍa ghaṭa ādi utpatti śaktiḥ eva dharmaḥ teṣām tatra avyakta tvena bhāvaḥ iti yāvat

original: nanv evam avyaktatayā santas te tataḥ prādurbhavantu| udakāharaṇādayas tu taiḥ svakāraṇād anāsāditāḥ kutaḥ prāptā ity ata uktaṃ --- yogyatāvacchinneti| yo'sau ghaṭādīnām utpattiśaktiḥ sodakāharaṇādiyogyatāvacchinnā, tenodakāharaṇādayo'pi ghaṭādibhiḥ svakāraṇād eva prāptā iti nākasmikā iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu evam avyakta tayā santaḥ te tatas prādurbhavantu udaka āharaṇa ādayaḥ tu taiḥ sva kāraṇāt anāsāditāḥ kutas prāptāḥ iti atas uktam yogyatā avacchinnā iti yā asau ghaṭa ādīnām utpatti śaktiḥ sā udaka āharaṇa ādi yogyatā avacchinnā tena udaka āharaṇa ādayaḥ api ghaṭa ādibhiḥ sva kāraṇāt eva prāptāḥ iti na ākasmikāḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: athavā ke dharmiṇa ity atrottaraṃ --- yogyatāvacchinnā dharmiṇa iti| ko dharma ity atrottaraṃ śaktir eva dharmas teṣāṃ yogyataiva dharma ity arthaḥ| atas tadvān dharmīti siddhaṃ bhavati| tatsadbhāve pramāṇam āha --- sa ca phalaprasavabhedānumita ekasya dharmiṇo'nyaś cānyaś ca cūrṇapiṇḍaghaṭādirūpa ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: athavā ke dharmiṇaḥ iti atra uttaram yogyatā avacchinnāḥ dharmiṇaḥ iti kaḥ dharmaḥ iti atra uttaram śaktiḥ eva dharmaḥ teṣām yogyatā eva dharmaḥ iti arthaḥ atas tadvān dharmī iti siddham bhavati tad sadbhāve pramāṇam āha sa ca phala prasava bheda anumitaḥ ekasya dharmiṇaḥ nyaḥ ca anyaḥ ca cūrṇa piṇḍa ghaṭa ādi rūpaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kāryabhedadarśanāc ca bhinna iti yāvat| paridṛṣṭa upalabdhaḥ| tatrānubhavārohiṇo vartamānasya mṛtpiṇḍasya śāntāvyapadeśyābhyāṃ mṛccūrṇamṛdghaṭābhyāṃ bhedam āha --- tatra vartamāna iti| yadi na bhidyeta piṇḍavac cūrṇaghaṭayor api tadvad eva svavyāpāravyāptiprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kārya bheda darśanāt ca bhinnaḥ iti yāvat paridṛṣṭaḥ upalabdhaḥ tatra anubhava ārohiṇaḥ vartamānasya mṛd piṇḍasya śānta avyapadeśyābhyām mṛd cūrṇa mṛd ghaṭābhyām bhedam āha tatra vartamānaḥ iti yadi na bhidyeta piṇḍa vat cūrṇa ghaṭayoḥ api tadvat eva sva vyāpāra vyāpti prasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: avyaktasya tu piṇḍasya noktaṃ bhedasādhanaṃ saṃbhavatīty āha --- yadā tv iti| ko'sau kena bhedasādhanena bhidyeteti| tad evaṃ dharmāṇāṃ bhedasādhanam abhidhāya taṃ bhedaṃ vibhajate --- tatra ye khalv iti| uditā iti vartamānā ity arthaḥ| adhvanāṃ paurvāparyaṃ niyamayati --- te ceti| codayati --- kimartham iti|
analyzed: avyaktasya tu piṇḍasya na uktam bheda sādhanam saṃbhavati iti āha yadā tu iti kaḥ asau kena bheda sādhanena bhidyeta iti tat evam dharmāṇām bheda sādhanam abhidhāya tam bhedam vibhajate tatra ye khalu iti uditāḥ iti vartamānāḥ iti arthaḥ adhvanām paurvāparyam niyamayati te ca iti codayati kimartham iti

original: kiṃnimittam atītasyānantarā na bhavanti vartamānāḥ| hetum āha siddhāntī --- pūrvapaścimatāyā abhāvāt| viṣayeṇa viṣayiṇīm anupalabdhiṃ sūcayati| anupalambham evopalambhavaidharmyeṇa darśayati --- yathānāgatavartamānayor iti| upasaṃharati --- tat tasmād anāgata eva samanantaraḥ pūrvatvena bhavati vartamānasya nātītaḥ|
analyzed: kiṃnimittam atītasya anantarāḥ na bhavanti vartamānāḥ hetum āha siddhāntī pūrva paścima tāyāḥ abhāvāt viṣayeṇa viṣayiṇīm anupalabdhim sūcayati anupalambham eva upalambha vaidharmyeṇa darśayati yathā anāgata vartamānayoḥ iti upasaṃharati tat tasmāt anāgataḥ eva samanantaraḥ pūrva tvena bhavati vartamānasya na atītaḥ

original: atītasya vartamānaḥ pūrvatvena samanantaro nāvyapadeśyaḥ| tasmād adhvanāṃ yaviṣṭho'tīta iti siddham| syād etad anubhūyamānānubhūtatayoditātītau śakyāv unnetum avyapadeśyās tu punar dharmā avyapadeśyatayaivaṃ śakyā nonnetum ity āśayavān pṛcchati --- athāvyapadeśyāḥ ke keṣu samīkṣāmahe| atrottaram āha --- sarvaṃ sarvātmakam iti| yatroktam iti|
analyzed: atītasya vartamānaḥ pūrva tvena samanantaraḥ na a vyapadeśyaḥ tasmāt adhvanām yaviṣṭha utītaḥ iti siddham syāt etat anubhūyamāna anubhūta tayā udita atītau śakyau unnetum avyapadeśyāḥ tu punar dharmāḥ a vyapadeśya tayā evam śakyāḥ na unnetum iti āśayavān pṛcchati atha avyapadeśyāḥ ke keṣu samīkṣāmahe atra uttaram āha sarvam sarva ātmakam iti yatra uktam iti

original: tad evopapādayati --- jalabhūmyor iti| jalasya hi rasarūpasparśaśabdavato bhūmeś ca gandharasarūpasparśaśabdavatyāḥ pāriṇāmikaṃ vanaspatilatāgulmādiṣu mūlaphalaprasavapallavādigatarasādivaiśvarūpyaṃ dṛṣṭam| so'yam anevamātmikāyā bhūmer anīdṛśasya vā jalasya na pariṇāmo bhavitum arhati| upapāditaṃ hi nāsad utpadyata iti|
analyzed: tat eva upapādayati jala bhūmyoḥ iti jalasya hi rasa rūpa sparśa śabdavataḥ bhūmeḥ ca gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabdavatyāḥ pāriṇāmikam vanaspati latā gulma ādiṣu mūla phala prasava pallava ādi gata rasa ādi vaiśvarūpyam dṛṣṭam saḥ uyam anevam ātmikāyāḥ bhūmeḥ anīdṛśasya vā jalasya na pariṇāmaḥ bhavitum arhati upapāditam hi na asat utpadyate iti

original: tathā sthāvarāṇāṃ pāriṇāmikaṃ jaṅgameṣu manuṣyapaśumṛgādiṣu rasādivaicitryaṃ dṛṣṭam| upayuñjānā hi te phalādīni rūpādibhedasaṃpadam āsādayanti| evaṃ jaṅgamānāṃ pāriṇāmikaṃ sthāvareṣu dṛṣṭam| rudhirāvasekāt kila dāḍimīphalāni tālaphalamātrāṇi bhavanti| upasaṃharati --- evaṃ sarvaṃ jalabhūmyādi sarvarasādyātmakam|
analyzed: tathā sthāvarāṇām pāriṇāmikam jaṅgameṣu manuṣya paśu mṛga ādiṣu rasa ādi vaicitryam dṛṣṭam upayuñjānāḥ hi te phala ādīni rūpa ādi bheda saṃpadam āsādayanti evam jaṅgamānām pāriṇāmikam sthāvareṣu dṛṣṭam rudhira avasekāt kila dāḍimī phalāni tāla phala mātrāṇi bhavanti upasaṃharati evam sarvam jala bhūmi ādi sarva rasa ādi ātmakam

original: tatra hetum āha --- jātyanucchedena jalatvabhūmitvādijāteḥ sarvatra pratyabhijñāyamānatvenānucchedāt| nanu sarvaṃ cet sarvātmakaṃ hanta bhoḥ sarvasya sarvadā sarvatra sarvathā saṃnidhānāt samānakālaṃ bhāvānāṃ vyaktiḥ prasajyeta, na khalu saṃnihitāvikalakāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vilambitum arhatīty ata āha --- deśakāleti|
analyzed: tatra hetum āha jāti anucchedena jala tva bhūmi tva ādi jāteḥ sarvatra pratyabhijñāyamāna tvena anucchedāt nanu sarvam ced sarva ātmakam hanta bhoḥ sarvasya sarvadā sarvatra sarvathā saṃnidhānāt samāna kālam bhāvānām vyaktiḥ prasajyeta na khalu saṃnihita avikala kāraṇam kāryam vilambitum arhati iti atas āha deśa kāla iti

original: yady api kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ tathāpi yo yasya kāryasya deśo yathā kuṅkumasya kāśmīraḥ| teṣāṃ sattve'pi pāñcālādiṣu na samudācāra iti na kuṅkumasya pāñcālādiṣv abhivyaktiḥ| evaṃ nidāghe na prāvṛṣaḥ samudācāra iti na tadā śālīnām| evaṃ na mṛgī manuṣyaṃ prasūte na tasyāṃ manuṣyākārasamudācāra iti|
analyzed: yadi api kāraṇam sarvam sarva ātmakam tathā api yaḥ yasya kāryasya deśaḥ yathā kuṅkumasya kāśmīraḥ teṣām sattve pi pāñcāla ādiṣu na samudācāraḥ iti na kuṅkumasya pāñcāla ādiṣu abhivyaktiḥ evam nidāghe na prāvṛṣaḥ samudācāraḥ iti na tadā śālīnām evam na mṛgī manuṣyam prasūte na tasyām manuṣya ākāra samudācāraḥ iti

original: evaṃ nāpuṇyavān sukharūpaṃ bhuṅkte na tasmin puṇyanimittasya samudācāra iti| tasmād deśakālākāranimittānām apabandhād apagamān na samānakālam ātmanāṃ bhāvānām abhivyaktir iti| tad evaṃ dharmān vibhajya teṣu dharmiṇo'nugamaṃ darśayati --- ya eteṣv iti| sāmānyaṃ dharmirūpaṃ viśeṣo dharmas tadātmobhayātmaka ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: evam na apuṇyavān sukha rūpam bhuṅkte na tasmin puṇya nimittasya samudācāraḥ iti tasmāt deśa kāla ākāra nimittānām apabandhāt apagamāt na samāna kālam ātmanām bhāvānām abhivyaktiḥ iti tat evam dharmān vibhajya teṣu dharmiṇaḥ anugamam darśayati yaḥ eteṣu iti sāmānyam dharmi rūpam viśeṣaḥ dharmaḥ tad ātmā ubhaya ātmakaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tad evam anugataṃ dharmiṇaṃ darśayitvā tam anicchato vaināśikasya kṣaṇikaṃ vijñānamātraṃ cittam icchato'niṣṭaprasaṅgam uktaṃ smārayati --- yasya tv iti| vastupratyabhijñānāc ceti| na hi devadattena dṛṣṭaṃ yajñadattaḥ pratyabhijānāti| tasmād yaś cānubhavitā sa eva pratyabhijñāteti||3.14||
analyzed: tat evam anugatam dharmiṇam darśayitvā tam an icchataḥ vaināśikasya kṣaṇikam vijñānamātram cittam icchataḥ aniṣṭa prasaṅgam uktam smārayati yasya tu iti vastu pratyabhijñānāt ca iti na hi devadattena dṛṣṭam yajñadattaḥ pratyabhijānāti tasmāt yaḥ ca anubhavitā saḥ eva pratyabhijñātā iti

original: kramānyatvaṃ pariṇāmānyatve hetuḥ||3.15||

kramānyatvaṃ pariṇāmānyatve hetuḥ| kim ekasya dharmiṇa eka eva dharmalakṣaṇāvasthālakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāma uta bahavo dharmalakṣaṇāvasthālakṣaṇāḥ pariṇāmāḥ| tatra kiṃ prāptam ekatvād dharmiṇa eka eva pariṇāmaḥ| na hi ekarūpāt kāraṇāt kāryabhedo bhavitum arhati tasyākasmikatvaprasaṅgād ityevaṃ prāpta ucyate --- kramānyatvāt pariṇāmānyatvam|
analyzed: krama anya tvam pariṇāma anya tve hetuḥ kim ekasya dharmiṇaḥ ekaḥ eva dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā lakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmaḥ uta bahavaḥ dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā lakṣaṇāḥ pariṇāmāḥ tatra kim prāptam ekatvāt dharmiṇaḥ ekaḥ eva pariṇāmaḥ na hi eka rūpāt kāraṇāt kārya bhedaḥ bhavitum arhati tasya ākasmika tva prasaṅgāt iti evam prāptaḥ ucyate krama anya tvāt pariṇāma anya tvam

original: ekasyā mṛdaś cūrṇapiṇḍaghaṭakapālakaṇākārā pariṇatiparamparā kramavatī laukikaparīkṣakair adhyakṣaṃ samīkṣyate| anyac cedaṃ cūrṇapiṇḍayor ānantaryam anyac ca piṇḍaghaṭayor anyac ca ghaṭakapālayor anyac ca kapālakaṇayor ekatra parasyānyatra pūrvatvāt| so'yaṃ kramabhedaḥ pariṇāma ekasminn avakalpamānaḥ pariṇāmabhedam āpādayati|
analyzed: ekasyāḥ mṛdaḥ cūrṇa piṇḍa ghaṭa kapāla kaṇa ākārā pariṇati paramparā kramavatī laukika parīkṣakaiḥ adhyakṣam samīkṣyate anyat ca idam cūrṇa piṇḍayoḥ ānantaryam anyat ca piṇḍa ghaṭayoḥ anyat ca ghaṭa kapālayoḥ anyat ca kapāla kaṇayoḥ ekatra parasya anyatra pūrva tvāt saḥ ayam krama bhedaḥ pariṇāmaḥ ekasmin avakalpamānaḥ pariṇāma bhedam āpādayati

original: eko'pi ca mṛddharmī kramopanipātitattatsahakārisamavadhānakrameṇa kramavatīṃ pariṇāmaparamparām udvahan nainām ākasmikayatīti bhāvaḥ| dharmapariṇāmānyatvaval lakṣaṇapariṇāmānyatve 'vasthāpariṇāmānyatve ca samānaṃ kramānyatvaṃ hetur iti| tad etad bhāṣyeṇāvadyotyate --- ekasya dharmiṇa iti| kramakramavator abhedam āsthāya sa tasya krama ity uktam|
analyzed: ekaḥ api ca mṛd dharmī krama upanipāti tad tad sahakāri samavadhāna krameṇa kramavatīm pariṇāma paramparām udvahan na enām ākasmikayati iti bhāvaḥ dharma pariṇāma anya tva vat lakṣaṇa pariṇāma anya tve vasthā pariṇāma anya tve ca samānam krama anya tvam hetuḥ iti tat etat bhāṣyeṇa avadyotyate ekasya dharmiṇaḥ iti krama kramavatoḥ abhedam āsthāya sa tasya kramaḥ iti uktam

original: tathāvasthāpariṇāmakrama iti| tathā hi --- kīnāśena koṣṭhāgāre prayatnasaṃrakṣitā api hi vrīhayo hāyanair atibahubhiḥ pāṇisparśamātraviśīryamāṇāvayavasaṃsthānāḥ paramāṇubhāvam anubhavanto dṛśyante| na cāyam abhinavānām akasmād eva prādurbhavitum arhati|
analyzed: tathā avasthā pariṇāma kramaḥ iti tathā hi kīnāśena koṣṭhāgāre prayatna saṃrakṣitāḥ api hi vrīhayaḥ hāyanaiḥ atibahubhiḥ pāṇi sparśa mātra viśīryamāṇa avayava saṃsthānāḥ paramāṇu bhāvam anubhavantaḥ dṛśyante na ca ayam abhinavānām akasmāt eva prādurbhavitum arhati

original: tasmāt kṣaṇaparamparākrameṇa sūkṣmasūkṣmatarasūkṣmatamabṛhadbṛhattarabṛhattamādikrameṇa prāpteṣu viśiṣṭo'yaṃ lakṣyata iti| tad idaṃ kramānyatvaṃ dharmadharmibhedapakṣa evety āha --- ta eta iti| ā vikārebhya ā cāliṅgād āpekṣiko dharmadharmibhāvo mṛdāder api tanmātrāpekṣayā dharmatvād ity āha --- dharmo 'pīti|
analyzed: tasmāt kṣaṇa paramparā krameṇa sūkṣma sūkṣmatara sūkṣmatama bṛhat bṛhattara bṛhattama ādi krameṇa prāpteṣu viśiṣṭaḥ yam lakṣyate iti tat idam krama anya tvam dharma dharmi bheda pakṣe eva iti āha te ete iti ā vikārebhyaḥ ā ca aliṅgāt āpekṣikaḥ dharma dharmi bhāvaḥ mṛd ādeḥ api tanmātra apekṣayā dharma tvāt iti āha dharmaḥ pi iti

original: yadā paramārthadharmiṇy aliṅge'bhedopacāraprayogas taddvāreṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyadvāreṇa dharmy eva dharma iti yāvat| tadaika eva pariṇāmo dharmipariṇāma evety arthaḥ| dharmalakṣaṇāvasthānāṃ dharmisvarūpābhiniveśāt| tad anena dharmiṇo dūrotsāritaṃ kūṭasthanityatvam ity uktaprāyam|
analyzed: yadā paramārtha dharmiṇi aliṅga ibheda upacāra prayogaḥ tad dvāreṇa sāmānādhikaraṇya dvāreṇa dharmī eva dharmaḥ iti yāvat tadā ekaḥ eva pariṇāmaḥ dharmi pariṇāmaḥ eva iti arthaḥ dharma lakṣaṇa avasthānām dharmi svarūpa abhiniveśāt tat anena dharmiṇaḥ dūra utsāritam kūṭastha nitya tvam iti ukta prāyam

original: dharmapariṇāmaṃ pratipādayan prasaṅgena cittadharmāṇāṃ prakārabhedam āha --- cittasyeti| paridṛṣṭāḥ pratyakṣā aparidṛṣṭāḥ parokṣās tatra pratyayātmakāḥ pramāṇādayo rāgādayaś ca| vastumātrā ity aprakāśarūpatām āha| syād etad aparidṛṣṭāś cen na santy evety ata āha --- anumānena prāpito vastumātreṇa sadbhāvo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ|
analyzed: dharma pariṇāmam pratipādayan prasaṅgena citta dharmāṇām prakāra bhedam āha cittasya iti paridṛṣṭāḥ pratyakṣāḥ aparidṛṣṭāḥ parokṣāḥ tatra pratyaya ātmakāḥ pramāṇa ādayaḥ rāga ādayaḥ ca vastu mātrāḥ iti aprakāśa rūpatām āha syāt etat aparidṛṣṭāḥ ced na santi eva iti atas āha anumānena prāpitaḥ vastu mātreṇa sadbhāvaḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ

original: paścānmānasādharmyād āgamo'py anumānam| saptāparidṛṣṭān kārikayā saṃgṛhṇāti --- nirodheti| nirodho vṛttīnām asaṃprajñātāvasthā cittasyāgamataḥ saṃskāraśeṣabhāvo'numānataś ca samadhigamyate| dharmagrahaṇena puṇyāpuṇye upalakṣayati| kvacit karmeti pāṭhas tatrāpi tajjanite puṇyāpuṇye eva gṛhyete|
analyzed: paścāt māna sādharmyāt āgamaḥ api anumānam sapta aparidṛṣṭān kārikayā saṃgṛhṇāti nirodha iti nirodhaḥ vṛttīnām asaṃprajñāta avasthā cittasya āgamataḥ saṃskāra śeṣa bhāvaḥ anumānataḥ ca samadhigamyate dharma grahaṇena puṇya apuṇye upalakṣayati kvacid karma iti pāṭhaḥ tatra api tad janite puṇya apuṇye eva gṛhyete

original: te cāgamataḥ sukhaduḥkhopabhogadarśanād vānumānato gamyete| saṃskāras tu smṛter anumīyate| evaṃ triguṇatvāc cittasya calaṃ ca guṇavṛttam iti pratikṣaṇaṃ pariṇāmo'numīyate| evaṃ jīvanaṃ prāṇadhāraṇaṃ prayatnabhedo'saṃviditaś cittasya dharmaḥ śvāsapraśvāsābhyām anumīyate|
analyzed: te ca āgamataḥ sukha duḥkha upabhoga darśanāt vā anumānataḥ gamyete saṃskāraḥ tu smṛteḥ anumīyate evam triguṇa tvāt cittasya calam ca guṇa vṛttam iti pratikṣaṇam pariṇāmaḥ anumīyate evam jīvanam prāṇa dhāraṇam cittasya dharmaḥ śvāsa praśvāsābhyām anumīyate

original: evaṃ cetasaś ceṣṭā kriyā yathā yathā tais tair indriyaiḥ śarīrapradeśair vā saṃprayujyate| sāpi tatsaṃyogād evānumīyate| evaṃ śaktir apy udbhūtānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ sūkṣmāvasthā cetaso dharmasthūlakāryānubhavād evānumīyata iti||3.15||
analyzed: evam cetasaḥ ceṣṭā kriyā yathā yathā taiḥ taiḥ indriyaiḥ śarīra pradeśaiḥ vā saṃprayujyate sā api tad saṃyogāt eva anumīyate evam śaktiḥ api udbhūtānām kāryāṇām sūkṣma avasthā cetasaḥ dharma sthūla kārya anubhavāt eva anumīyate iti

original: pariṇāmatrayasaṃyamād atītānāgatajñānam||3.16||

ataḥ param ā pādaparisamāpteḥ saṃyamaviṣayas tadvaśīkārasūcanī vibhūtiś ca vaktavyā| tatroktaprakāraṃ pariṇāmatrayam eva tāvat prathamam upāttasakalayogāṅgasya yoginaḥ saṃyamaviṣayatayopakṣipati --- pariṇāmatrayasaṃyamād atītānāgatajñānam|
analyzed: atas param pāda parisamāpteḥ saṃyama viṣayaḥ tad vaśīkāra sūcanī vibhūtiḥ ca vaktavyā tatra ukta prakāram pariṇāma trayam eva tāvat prathamam upātta sakala yoga aṅgasya yoginaḥ saṃyama viṣaya tayā upakṣipati pariṇāma traya saṃyamāt atīta anāgata jñānam

original: nanu yatra saṃyamas tatraiva sākṣātkaraṇaṃ tat kathaṃ pariṇāmatrayasaṃyamo'tītānāgataṃ sākṣātkārayed ity ata āha --- tena pariṇāmatrayaṃ sākṣātkriyamāṇaṃ teṣu pariṇāmeṣv anugate ye atītānāgate tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ saṃpādayati|
analyzed: nanu yatra saṃyamaḥ tatra eva sākṣātkaraṇam tat katham pariṇāma traya saṃyama utīta anāgatam sākṣātkārayet iti atas āha tena pariṇāma trayam sākṣātkriyamāṇam teṣu pariṇāmeṣu anugate ye atīta anāgate tad viṣayam jñānam saṃpādayati

original: śabdārthapratyayānām itaretarādhyāsāt saṃkaras tatpravibhāgasaṃyamāt sarvabhūtarutajñānam||3.17||
analyzed: śabda artha pratyayānām itaretara adhyāsāt saṃkaraḥ tad pravibhāga saṃyamāt sarva bhūta ruta jñānam

original: ayam aparaḥ saṃyamasya viṣaya upakṣipyate --- śabdārthapratyayānām itaretarādhyāsāt saṃkaras tatpravibhāgasaṃyamāt sarvabhūtarutajñānam| atra vācakaṃ śabdam ācikhyāsuḥ prathamaṃ tāvad vāgvyāpāraviṣayam āha --- tatra vāg vāgindriyaṃ varṇavyañjakam aṣṭasthānam| yathāha ---
analyzed: ayam aparaḥ saṃyamasya viṣayaḥ upakṣipyate śabda artha pratyayānām itaretara adhyāsāt saṃkaraḥ tad pravibhāga saṃyamāt sarva bhūta ruta jñānam atra vācakam śabdam ācikhyāsuḥ prathamam tāvat vāc vyāpāra viṣayam āha tatra vāc vāc indriyam varṇa vyañjakam aṣṭa sthānam yathā āha

original: "aṣṭau sthānāni varṇānām uraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śiras tathā| jihvāmūlaṃ ca dantāś ca nāsikauṣṭhau ca tālu ca" iti||
analyzed: aṣṭau sthānāni varṇānām uraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śiraḥ tathā jihvā mūlam ca dantāḥ ca nāsikā oṣṭhau ca tālu ca iti

original: sā vāg varṇeṣv eva yathālokapratītisiddheṣv arthavatī na ca vācaka ity arthaḥ| śrotravyāpāraviṣayaṃ nirūpayati --- śrotraṃ punar dhvaner udānasya vāgindriyābhighātino yaḥ pariṇatibhedo varṇātmā tenākāreṇa pariṇataṃ tanmātraviṣayaṃ na tu vācakaviṣayam ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: sā vāc varṇeṣu eva yathā loka pratīti siddheṣu arthavatī na ca vācakaḥ iti arthaḥ śrotra vyāpāra viṣayam nirūpayati śrotram punar dhvaneḥ udānasya vāc indriya abhighātinaḥ yaḥ pariṇati bhedaḥ varṇa ātmā tena ākāreṇa pariṇatam tanmātra viṣayam na tu vācaka viṣayam iti arthaḥ

original: yathālokapratītisiddhebhyo varṇebhyo vācakaṃ bhinatti --- padaṃ punar vācakaṃ punar nādānusaṃhārabuddhinirgrāhyaṃ yathāpratītisiddhān nādān varṇān pratyekaṃ gṛhītvānu paścād yā saṃharaty ekatvam āpādayati gaur ity etad ekaṃ padam iti tayā padaṃ gṛhyate|
analyzed: yathā loka pratīti siddhebhyaḥ varṇebhyaḥ vācakam bhinatti padam punar vācakam punar nāda anusaṃhāra buddhi nirgrāhyam yathā pratīti siddhān nādān varṇān pratyekam gṛhītvā anu paścāt yā saṃharati ekatvam āpādayati gauḥ iti etat ekam padam iti tayā padam gṛhyate

original: yady api prācyo'pi buddhayo varṇākāraṃ padam eva pratyekaṃ gocarayanti tathāpi na viśadaṃ prathate| carame tu vijñāne tad ativiśadam iti nādānusaṃhārabuddhinirgrāhyam uktam| yas tu vaijātyād ekapadānubhavam avijñāya varṇān eva vācakān ātiṣṭhate taṃ pratyāha --- varṇā iti|
analyzed: yadi api prācyaḥ api buddhayaḥ varṇa ākāram padam eva pratyekam gocarayanti tathā api na viśadam prathate carame tu vijñāne tat ati viśadam iti nāda anusaṃhāra buddhi nirgrāhyam uktam yaḥ tu vaijātyāt eka pada anubhavam a vijñāya varṇān eva vācakān ātiṣṭhate tam pratyāha varṇāḥ iti

original: te khalv amī varṇāḥ pratyekaṃ vācyaviṣayāṃ dhiyam ādadhīran nāgadantakā iva śikyāvalambanaṃ saṃhatā vā grāvāṇa iva piṭharadhāraṇam| na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ| ekasmād arthapratīter anutpatter utpattau vā dvitīyādīnām anuccāraṇaprasaṅgo niṣpāditakriye karmaṇi viśeṣānādhāyinaḥ sādhanasya sādhananyāyātipātāt| tasmād dvitīyaḥ pariśiṣyate|
analyzed: te khalu amī varṇāḥ pratyekam vācya viṣayām dhiyam ādadhīran nāgadantakāḥ iva śikya avalambanam saṃhatāḥ vā grāvāṇaḥ iva piṭhara dhāraṇam na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ ekasmāt artha pratīteḥ anutpatteḥ utpattau vā dvitīya ādīnām anuccāraṇa prasaṅgaḥ niṣpādita kriye karmaṇi viśeṣa an ādhāyinaḥ sādhanasya sādhana nyāya atipātāt tasmāt dvitīyaḥ pariśiṣyate

original: saṃbhavati hi grāvṇāṃ saṃhatānāṃ piṭharadhāraṇam ekasamayabhāvitvāt| varṇānāṃ tu yaugapadyāsaṃbhavo'taḥ parasparam anugrāhyānugrāhakatvāyogāt saṃbhūyāpi nārthadhiyam ādadhate| te padarūpam ekam asaṃspṛśantas tādātmyenāta evānupasthāpayanta āvirbhūtās tirobhūtā ayaḥśalākākalpāḥ pratyekam apadasvarūpā ucyante|
analyzed: saṃbhavati hi grāvṇām saṃhatānām piṭhara dhāraṇam eka samaya bhāvi tvāt varṇānām tu yaugapadya asaṃbhava ūtaḥ parasparam anugrāhya anugrāhaka tva ayogāt saṃbhūya api na artha dhiyam ādadhate te pada rūpam ekam a saṃspṛśantaḥ tādātmyena atas eva anupasthāpayantaḥ āvirbhūtāḥ tirobhūtāḥ ayaḥ śalākā kalpāḥ pratyekam apada svarūpāḥ ucyante

original: yadi punaḥ padam ekaṃ tādātmyena spṛśeyur varṇās tato noktadoṣaprasaṅga ity āha --- varṇaḥ punar ekaikaḥ padātmā sarvābhidhānaśaktipracitaḥ sarvābhir abhidhānaśaktibhir nicito gogaṇagauranagetyādiṣu hi gakāro gotvādyarthābhidhāyiṣu dṛṣṭa iti tattadabhidhānaśaktiḥ|
analyzed: yadi punar padam ekam tādātmyena spṛśeyuḥ varṇāḥ tatas na ukta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti āha varṇaḥ punar ekaikaḥ pada ātmā sarva abhidhāna śakti pracitaḥ sarvābhiḥ abhidhāna śaktibhiḥ nicitaḥ go gaṇa gaura naga ityādiṣu hi gakāraḥ go tva ādi artha abhidhāyiṣu dṛṣṭaḥ iti tat tat abhidhāna śaktiḥ

original: evaṃ somaśocir ityādiṣv īśvarādyarthābhidhāyiṣu padeṣv ovarṇo dṛṣṭa iti so'pi tattadabhidhānaśaktiḥ| evaṃ sarvatrohanīyam|
analyzed: evam somaśociḥ ityādiṣu īśvara ādi artha abhidhāyiṣu padeṣu o varṇaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti saḥ api tad tad abhidhāna śaktiḥ evam sarvatra ūhanīyam

original: sa caikaiko varṇo gakārādiḥ sahakāri yad varṇāntaram okārādi tad eva pratiyogi pratisaṃbandhi yasya sa tathoktas tasya bhāvas tattvaṃ tasmād vaiśvarūpyaṃ nānātvam ivāpanno na tu nānātvam āpannas tasya tattvād eva pūrvo varṇo gakāra uttareṇaukāreṇa gaṇādipadebhyo vyāvartyottaraś caukāro gakāreṇa śocirādipadebhyo vyāvartya viśeṣe gotvavācake
analyzed: sa ca ekaikaḥ varṇaḥ gakāra ādiḥ sahakāri yat varṇa antaram okāra ādi tat eva pratiyogi pratisaṃbandhi yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt vaiśvarūpyam nānātvam iva āpannaḥ na tu nānātvam āpannaḥ tasya tattvāt eva pūrvaḥ varṇaḥ gakāraḥ uttareṇa aukāreṇa gaṇa ādi padebhyaḥ vyāvartya uttaraḥ ca aukāraḥ gakāreṇa śociḥ ādi padebhyaḥ vyāvartya viśeṣe go tva vācake

original: gopadasphoṭe'vasthāpito'nusaṃhārabuddhau| ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ --- arthapratyayo hi varṇair niyatakramatayā parasparam asaṃbhavadbhir aśakyaḥ kartum| na ca saṃskāradvārāgneyādīnām iva paramāpūrve vā svarge vā janayitavye'niyatakramāṇām api sāhityam arthabuddhyupajanane varṇānām iti sāṃprataṃ vikalpāsahatvāt|
analyzed: go pada sphoṭa iva sthāpitaḥ anusaṃhāra buddhau ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ artha pratyayaḥ hi varṇaiḥ niyata krama tayā parasparam asaṃbhavadbhiḥ aśakyaḥ kartum na ca saṃskāra dvāra āgneya ādīnām iva parama apūrve vā svarge vā janayitavye niyata kramāṇām api sāhityam artha buddhi upajanane varṇānām iti sāṃpratam vikalpa asaha tvāt

original: sa khalv ayaṃ varṇānubhavajanyaḥ saṃskāraḥ smṛtiprasavahetur anyo vāgneyādijanya ivāpūrvābhidhāno na tāvad anantaraḥ kalpanāgauravāpatteḥ| sa eva tāvad adṛṣṭapūrvaḥ kalpanīyas tasya ca kramavadbhir varṇānubhavair ekasya janyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti tajjātīyānekāvāntarasaṃskārakalpaneti gauravam|
analyzed: sa khalu ayam varṇa anubhava janyaḥ saṃskāraḥ smṛti prasava hetuḥ anyaḥ vā āgneya ādi janyaḥ iva apūrva abhidhānaḥ na tāvat anantaraḥ kalpanā gaurava āpatteḥ saḥ eva tāvat adṛṣṭa pūrvaḥ kalpanīyaḥ tasya ca kramavadbhiḥ varṇa anubhavaiḥ ekasya janya tvam na saṃbhavati iti tad jātīya aneka avāntara saṃskāra kalpanā iti gauravam

original: na caiṣa jñāpakahetvaṅgam ajñātas tadaṅgatām anubhavatīti| na khalu saṃbandho'rthapratyāyanāṅgam ajñāto'ṅgatām upaiti| smṛtiphalaprasavānumitas tu saṃskāraḥ svakāraṇānubhavaviṣayaniyato na viṣayāntare pratyayam ādhātum utsahate| anyathā yat kiṃcid evaikaikam anubhūya sarvaḥ sarvaṃ jānīyād iti|
analyzed: na ca eṣa jñāpaka hetu aṅgam ajñātaḥ tad aṅga tām anubhavati iti na khalu saṃbandha ūrtha pratyāyana aṅgam ajñāta uṅga tām upaiti smṛti phala prasava anumitaḥ tu saṃskāraḥ sva kāraṇa anubhava viṣaya niyataḥ na viṣaya antare pratyayam ādhātum utsahate anyathā yat kiṃcid eva ekaikam anubhūya sarvaḥ sarvam jānīyāt iti

original: na ca pratyekavarṇānubhavajanitasaṃskārapiṇḍalabdhajanmasmṛtidarpaṇasamārohiṇo varṇāḥ samadhigatasahabhāvā vācakā iti sāṃpratam| kramākramaviparītakramānubhūtānāṃ tatrāviśeṣeṇārthadhījananaprasaṅgāt| na caitat smaraṇajñānaṃ pūrvānubhavavartinīṃ parāparatāṃ gocarayitum arhati|
analyzed: na ca pratyeka varṇa anubhava janita saṃskāra piṇḍa labdha janma smṛti darpaṇa samārohiṇaḥ varṇāḥ samadhigata sahabhāvāḥ vācakāḥ iti sāṃpratam kramākrama viparīta krama anubhūtānām tatra aviśeṣeṇa artha dhī janana prasaṅgāt na ca etat smaraṇa jñānam pūrva anubhava vartinīm para apara tām gocarayitum arhati

original: tasmād varṇebhyo'saṃbhavann arthapratyaya ekapadānubhavam eva svanimittam upakalpayati| na caiṣa pade'pi prasaṅgaḥ| tad dhi pratyekam eva prayatnabhedabhinnā dhvanayo vyañjayantaḥ parasparavisadṛśatattatpadavyañjakadhvanibhis tulyasthānakaraṇaniṣpannāḥ sadṛśāḥ santo 'nyonyavisadṛśaiḥ padaiḥ padam ekaṃ sadṛśam āpādayantaḥ pratiyogibhedena
analyzed: tasmāt artha pratyayaḥ eka pada anubhavam eva sva nimittam upakalpayati na ca eṣa pade api prasaṅgaḥ tat dhi pratyekam eva prayatna bheda bhinnāḥ dhvanayaḥ vyañjayantaḥ paraspara visadṛśa tad tad pada vyañjaka dhvanibhiḥ tulya sthāna karaṇa niṣpannāḥ sadṛśāḥ santaḥ nyonya visadṛśaiḥ padaiḥ padam ekam sadṛśam āpādayantaḥ pratiyogi bhedena

original: tattatsādṛśyānāṃ bhedāt tadupadhānād ekam apy anavayavam api sāvayavam ivānekātmakam ivāvabhāsayanti, yathā niyatavarṇaparimāṇasaṃsthānaṃ mukham ekam api maṇikṛpāṇadarpaṇādayo vibhinnavarṇaparimāṇasaṃsthānam anekam ādarśayanti na paramārthataḥ|
analyzed: tad tad sādṛśyānām bhedāt tad upadhānāt ekam api anavayavam api sa avayavam iva aneka ātmakam iva avabhāsayanti yathā niyata varṇa parimāṇa saṃsthānam mukham ekam api maṇi kṛpāṇa darpaṇa ādayaḥ vibhinna varṇa parimāṇa saṃsthānam anekam ādarśayanti na paramārthataḥ

original: sādṛśyopadhānabhedakalpitā bhāgā eva nirbhāgasya padasya varṇās tena tadbuddhir varṇātmanā padabhede sphoṭam abhedam eva nirbhāgam eva sabhedam iva sabhāgam ivālambate|
analyzed: sādṛśya upadhāna bheda kalpitāḥ bhāgāḥ eva nirbhāgasya padasya varṇāḥ tena tad buddhiḥ varṇa ātmanā pada bhede sphoṭam abhedam eva nirbhāgam eva sa bhedam iva sa bhāgam iva ālambate

original: ato gopadasphoṭabhedasyaikasya gakārabhāgo gaurādipadasphoṭasādṛśyena na nirdhārayanti svabhāginam ity okāreṇa viśiṣṭo nirdhārayaty evam okāro 'pi bhāgaḥ śocirādipadasadṛśatayā na śakto nirdhārayituṃ svabhāginaṃ gopadasphoṭam iti gakāreṇa viśiṣṭo nirdhārayati| asahabhāvinām api ca saṃskāradvāreṇāsti sahabhāva iti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattiḥ|
analyzed: atas go pada sphoṭa bhedasya ekasya gakāra bhāgaḥ gaura ādi pada sphoṭa sādṛśyena na nirdhārayanti sva bhāginam iti okāreṇa viśiṣṭaḥ nirdhārayati evam okāraḥ api bhāgaḥ śociḥ ādi pada sadṛśa tayā na śaktaḥ nirdhārayitum sva bhāginam go pada sphoṭam iti gakāreṇa viśiṣṭaḥ nirdhārayati asahabhāvinām api ca saṃskāra dvāreṇa asti sahabhāvaḥ iti viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva upapattiḥ

original: na ca bhinnaviṣayatvaṃ saṃskārayor bhāgadvayaviṣayayor anubhavayos tajjanmanoś ca saṃskārayor ekapadaviṣayatvāt| kevalabhāgānubhavena padam avyaktam anubhūyate'nusaṃhāradhiyā tu bhāgānubhavayonisaṃskāralabdhajanmanā vyaktam iti viśeṣaḥ|
analyzed: na ca bhinna viṣaya tvam saṃskārayoḥ bhāga dvaya viṣayayoḥ anubhavayoḥ tad janmanoḥ ca saṃskārayoḥ eka pada viṣaya tvāt kevala bhāga anubhavena padam avyaktam anubhūyate anusaṃhāra dhiyā tu bhāga anubhava yoni saṃskāra labdha janmanā vyaktam iti viśeṣaḥ

original: avyaktānubhavāś ca prāñcaḥ saṃskārādhānakrameṇa vyaktam anubhavam ādadhānā dṛṣṭā yathā dūrād vanaspatāv astipratyayā avyaktā vyaktavanaspatipratyayahetavaḥ| na ceyaṃ vidhā varṇānām arthapratyāyane saṃbhavinī| no khalu varṇāḥ pratyekam avyaktam arthapratyayam ādadhaty ante vyaktam iti śakyaṃ vaktum| pratyakṣajñāna eva niyamād vyaktāvyaktatvasya|
analyzed: avyakta anubhavāḥ ca prāñcaḥ saṃskāra ādhāna krameṇa vyaktam anubhavam ādadhānāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ yathā dūrāt vanaspatau asti pratyayāḥ avyaktāḥ vyakta vanaspati pratyaya hetavaḥ na ca iyam vidhā varṇānām artha pratyāyane saṃbhavinī no khalu varṇāḥ pratyekam avyaktam artha pratyayam ādadhati ante vyaktam iti śakyam vaktum pratyakṣa jñāne eva niyamāt vyakta avyakta tvasya

original: varṇādheyas tv arthapratyayo na pratyakṣas tad eṣa varṇebhyo jāyamānaḥ sphuṭa eva jāyeta| na vā jāyeta na tv asphuṭaḥ| sphoṭasya tu dhvanivyaṅgyasya pratyakṣasya sataḥ sphuṭāsphuṭatve kalpyete ity asamānam|
analyzed: varṇa ādheyaḥ tu artha pratyayaḥ na pratyakṣaḥ tat eṣa varṇebhyaḥ jāyamānaḥ sphuṭaḥ eva jāyeta na vā jāyeta na tu asphuṭaḥ sphoṭasya tu dhvani vyaṅgyasya pratyakṣasya sataḥ sphuṭa asphuṭa tve kalpyete iti asamānam

original: evaṃ pratyekavarṇānubhavajanitasaṃskārasahitaśrotralabdhajanmany anusaṃhārabuddhau saṃhatā varṇā ekapadasphoṭabhāvam āpannāḥ prayatnaviśeṣavyaṅgyatayā prayatnaviśeṣasya ca niyatakramāpekṣatayā kramasyānyatve tadabhivyañjakaprayatnaviśeṣābhāvena tadabhivyaktyabhāvaprasaṅgāt kramānurodhino 'rthasaṃketenāvacchinnāḥ saṃketāvacchedam eva laukikaṃ
analyzed: evam pratyeka varṇa anubhava janita saṃskāra sahita śrotra labdha janmani anusaṃhāra buddhau saṃhatāḥ varṇāḥ eka pada sphoṭa bhāvam āpannāḥ prayatna viśeṣa vyaṅgya tayā prayatna viśeṣasya ca niyata krama apekṣa tayā kramasya anya tve tad abhivyañjaka prayatna viśeṣa abhāvena tad abhivyakti abhāva prasaṅgāt krama anurodhinaḥ rtha saṃketena avacchinnāḥ saṃketa avacchedam eva laukikam

original: sabhāgapadaviṣayaṃ darśayanti, iyanto dvitrās tricaturāḥ pañcaṣā vā ete sarvābhidhānaśaktiparivṛtā gakāraukāravisarjanīyāḥ sāsnādimantam artham avadyotayantīti| tat kim idānīṃ saṃketānusāreṇa varṇānām eva vācakatvaṃ tathā ca na padaṃ nāma kiṃcid ekam ity ata āha --- tad eteṣām iti| dhvaninimittaḥ kramo dhvanikramaḥ|
analyzed: sa bhāga pada viṣayam darśayanti iyantaḥ dvitrāḥ tricaturāḥ pañcaṣāḥ vā ete sarva abhidhāna śakti parivṛtāḥ gakāra aukāra visarjanīyāḥ sāsnādimantam artham avadyotayanti iti tat kim idānīm saṃketa anusāreṇa varṇānām eva vācaka tvam tathā ca na padam nāma kiṃcid ekam iti atas āha tat eteṣām iti dhvani nimittaḥ kramaḥ dhvani kramaḥ

original: upasaṃhṛto dhvanikramo yeṣu te tathoktāḥ| buddhyā nirbhāsyate prakāśyata iti buddhinirbhāsaḥ| saṃketāvacchinnāḥ sthūladarśilokāśayānurodhena gakāraukāravisarjanīyā ity uktam| gakārādīnām api tadbhāgatayā tādātmyena vācakatvāt pratītyanusāratas tv ekam eva padaṃ vācakam ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: upasaṃhṛtaḥ dhvani kramaḥ yeṣu te tathā uktāḥ buddhyā nirbhāsyate prakāśyate iti buddhi nirbhāsaḥ saṃketa avacchinnāḥ sthūla darśi loka āśaya anurodhena gakāra okāra visarjanīyāḥ iti uktam gakāra ādīnām api tad bhāga tayā tādātmyena vācaka tvāt pratīti anusārataḥ tu ekam eva padam vācakam iti arthaḥ

original: etad eva spaṣṭayati --- tad ekaṃ padaṃ lokabuddhyā pratīyata iti saṃbandhaḥ| kasmād ekam ity ata āha --- ekabuddhiviṣayo gaur ity ekaṃ padam ity ekākārāyā buddher viṣayo yatas tasmād ekam| tasya vyañjakam āha --- ekaprayatnākṣiptam iti| rasa itipadavyañjakāt prayatnād vilakṣaṇaḥ sara itipadavyañjakaḥ prayatnaḥ|
analyzed: etat eva spaṣṭayati tat ekam padam loka buddhyā pratīyate iti saṃbandhaḥ kasmāt ekam iti atas āha eka buddhi viṣayaḥ gauḥ iti ekam padam iti eka ākārāyāḥ buddheḥ viṣayaḥ yatas tasmāt ekam tasya vyañjakam āha eka prayatna ākṣiptam iti rasaḥ iti pada vyañjakāt prayatnāt vilakṣaṇaḥ saraḥ iti pada vyañjakaḥ prayatnaḥ

original: sa copakramataḥ sara itipadavyaktilakṣaṇaphalāvacchinnaḥ pūrvāparībhūta ekas tadākṣiptaṃ bhāgānāṃ sādṛśyopadhānabhedakalpitānāṃ paramārthasatām abhāvād abhāgam| ata eva pūrvāparībhūtabhāvād akramam| nanu varṇāḥ pūrvāparībhūtās te cāsya bhāgā iti katham akramam abhāgaṃ cety ata āha --- avarṇam|
analyzed: sa ca upakramataḥ saraḥ iti pada vyakti lakṣaṇa phala avacchinnaḥ pūrvāparībhūtaḥ ekaḥ tad ākṣiptam bhāgānām sādṛśya upadhāna bheda kalpitānām paramārtha satām abhāvāt abhāgam atas eva pūrvāparībhūta bhāvāt akramam nanu varṇāḥ pūrvāparībhūtāḥ te ca asya bhāgāḥ iti katham akramam abhāgam ca iti atas āha avarṇam

original: na hy asya varṇā bhāgāḥ kiṃ tu sādṛśyopadhānabhedāt padam eva tena tenākāreṇāparamārthasatā prathate| na hi maṇikṛpāṇadarpaṇādivartīni mukhāni mukhasya paramārthasato'vayavā iti| bauddham anusaṃhārabuddhau viditam antyavarṇapratyayasya vyāpāraḥ saṃskāraḥ pūrvavarṇānubhavajanitasaṃskārasahitas tenopasthāpitaṃ viṣayīkṛtam|
analyzed: na hi asya varṇāḥ bhāgāḥ kim tu sādṛśya upadhāna bhedāt padam eva tena tena ākāreṇa a parama artha satā prathate na hi maṇi kṛpāṇa darpaṇa ādi vartīni mukhāni mukhasya parama artha sataḥ avayavāḥ iti bauddham anusaṃhāra buddhau viditam antya varṇa pratyayasya vyāpāraḥ saṃskāraḥ pūrva varṇa anubhava janita saṃskāra sahitaḥ tena upasthāpitam viṣayīkṛtam

original: varṇānubhavatattatsaṃskārāṇāṃ ca padaviṣayatvam upapāditam adhastāt| syād etad abhāgam akramam avarṇaṃ cet padatattvaṃ kasmād evaṃvidhaṃ kadācin na prathate na hi lākṣārasāvasekopadhānāpāditāruṇabhāvaḥ sphaṭikamaṇis tadapagame svacchadhavalo nānubhūyate tasmāt pāramārthikā eva varṇā ity ata āha --- paratreti|
analyzed: varṇa anubhava tad tad saṃskārāṇām ca pada viṣaya tvam upapāditam adhastāt syāt etat abhāgam akramam avarṇam ced pada tattvam kasmāt evaṃvidham kadācid na prathate na hi lākṣā rasa avaseka upadhāna āpādita aruṇa bhāvaḥ sphaṭika maṇiḥ tad apagame svaccha dhavalaḥ na anubhūyate tasmāt pāramārthikāḥ eva varṇāḥ iti atas āha paratra iti

original: pratipipādayiṣayā varṇair evābhidhīyamānair uccāryamāṇaiḥ śrūyamāṇaiś ca śrotṛbhir anādir yo 'yaṃ vāgvyavahāro vibhaktavarṇapadanibandhanas tajjanitā vāsanā sāpy anādir eva| tadanuviddhayā tadvāsitayā lokabuddhyā vibhaktavarṇarūṣitapadāvagāhinyā siddhavat paramārthavat saṃpratipattyā saṃvādena vṛddhānāṃ padaṃ pratīyate|
analyzed: pratipipādayiṣayā varṇaiḥ eva abhidhīyamānaiḥ uccāryamāṇaiḥ śrūyamāṇaiḥ ca śrotṛbhiḥ anādiḥ yaḥ yam vāc vyavahāraḥ vibhakta varṇa pada nibandhanaḥ tad janitā vāsanā sā api anādiḥ eva tad anuviddhayā tad vāsitayā loka buddhyā vibhakta varṇa rūṣita pada avagāhinyā siddha vat paramārtha vat saṃpratipattyā saṃvādena vṛddhānām padam pratīyate

original: padapratyayasya tu prayatnabhedopanītadhvanibhedād anyato'nutpādāt tasya ca sadā sādṛśyadoṣarūṣitatayā varṇātmanaiva pratyayajanakatvam iti kuto nirupādhinaḥ padasya prathā| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: pada pratyayasya tu prayatna bheda upanīta dhvani bhedāt anyatas anutpādāt tasya ca sadā sādṛśya doṣa rūṣita tayā varṇa ātmanā eva pratyaya janaka tvam iti kutas nirupādhinaḥ padasya prathā yathā āhuḥ

original: "dhvanayaḥ sadṛśātmāno viparyāsasya hetavaḥ| upalambhakam eteṣāṃ viparyāsasya kāraṇam| upāyatvāc ca niyataḥ padadarśitadarśinām| jñānasyaiva ca bādheyaṃ loke dhruvam upaplavaḥ" iti|
analyzed: dhvanayaḥ sadṛśa ātmānaḥ viparyāsasya hetavaḥ upalambhakam eteṣām viparyāsasya kāraṇam upāya tvāt ca niyataḥ pada darśita darśinām jñānasya eva ca bādheyam loke dhruvam upaplavaḥ iti

original: yataḥ padātmā vibhaktavarṇarūṣitaḥ prakāśate'taḥ sthūladarśī loko varṇān eva padam abhimanyamānas tān eva prakārabhedabhājo'rthabhede saṃketayatīty āha --- tasyeti| tasya padasyājānata ekasyāpi saṃketabuddhitaḥ sthūladarśilokahitāya varṇātmanā vibhāgaḥ|
analyzed: yatas pada ātmā vibhakta varṇa rūṣitaḥ prakāśata itas sthūla darśī lokaḥ varṇān eva padam abhimanyamānaḥ tān eva prakāra bheda bhājaḥ artha bhede saṃketayati iti āha tasya iti tasya padasya a jānataḥ ekasya api saṃketa buddhitaḥ sthūla darśi loka hitāya varṇa ātmanā vibhāgaḥ

original: vibhāgam āha --- etāvatāṃ na nyūnānām adhikānāṃ vā, evaṃjātīyako nairantaryakramaviśeṣo 'nusaṃhāra ekabuddhyupagraha ekasyārthasya gotvāder vācaka iti| nanu yady ekasyārthasyāyaṃ śabdo vācaka iti saṃketo hanta bhoḥ śabdārthayor netaretarādhyāsas tarhīty ata āha --- saṃketas tv iti| smṛtāv ātmā svarūpaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ|
analyzed: vibhāgam āha etāvatām na nyūnānām adhikānām vā evaṃjātīyakaḥ nairantarya krama viśeṣaḥ nu saṃhāraḥ eka buddhi upagrahaḥ ekasya arthasya go tva ādeḥ vācakaḥ iti nanu yadi ekasya arthasya ayam śabdaḥ vācakaḥ iti saṃketaḥ hanta bhoḥ śabda arthayoḥ na itaretara adhyāsaḥ tarhi iti atas āha saṃketaḥ tu iti smṛtau ātmā svarūpam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ

original: na hi kṛta ity eva saṃketo'rtham avadhārayaty api tu smaryamāṇaḥ| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- abhinnākāra eva saṃkete kathaṃcid bhedaṃ vikalpya ṣaṣṭhī prayukteti| ya eṣāṃ pravibhāgajñaḥ sa tatra saṃyame bhavati sarvavit sarvabhūtarutajña iti|
analyzed: na hi kṛtaḥ iti eva saṃketa ūrtham avadhārayati api tu smaryamāṇaḥ etat uktam bhavati abhinna ākāraḥ eva saṃkete kathaṃcid bhedam vikalpya ṣaṣṭhī prayuktā iti yaḥ eṣām pravibhāga jñaḥ sa tatra saṃyame bhavati sarva vid sarva bhūta ruta jñaḥ iti
