original: tad evaṃ vikalpitavarṇabhāgam ekam anavayavaṃ padaṃ vyutpādya kalpitapadavibhāgaṃ vākyam ekam anavayavaṃ vyutpādayitum āha --- sarvapadeṣu cāsti vākyaśaktiḥ| ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ --- parapratyāyanāya śabdaḥ prayujyate tatra tad eva ca paraṃ prati pratipādayitavyaṃ yat taiḥ pratipitsitaṃ, tad eva taiḥ pratipitsitaṃ yadupādānādigocaraḥ|
analyzed: tat evam vikalpita varṇa bhāgam ekam anavayavam padam vyutpādya kalpita pada vibhāgam vākyam ekam anavayavam vyutpādayitum āha sarva padeṣu ca asti vākya śaktiḥ ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ para pratyāyanāya śabdaḥ prayujyate tatra tat eva ca param prati pratipādayitavyam yat taiḥ pratipitsitam tat eva taiḥ pratipitsitam yat upādāna ādi gocaraḥ

original: na ca padārthamātraṃ tadgocaraḥ kiṃ tu vākyārtha iti vākyārthaparā eva sarve śabdās tena sa eva teṣām arthaḥ| ato yatrāpi kevalasya padasya prayogas tatrāpi padāntareṇa sahaikīkṛtya tato'rtho gamyate, na tu kevalāt kasmāt tanmātrasyāsāmarthyāt tathā ca vākyam eva tatra tatra vācakaṃ na tu padāni|
analyzed: na ca padārtha mātram tad gocaraḥ kim tu vākya arthaḥ iti vākya artha parāḥ eva sarve śabdāḥ tena saḥ eva teṣām arthaḥ atas yatra api kevalasya padasya prayogaḥ tatra api pada antareṇa saha ekīkṛtya tatas ṛthaḥ gamyate na tu kevalāt kasmāt tad mātrasya asāmarthyāt tathā ca vākyam eva tatra tatra vācakam na tu padāni

original: tadbhāgatayā tu teṣām apy asti vākyārthavācakaśaktiḥ padārtha iva padabhāgatayā varṇānām| tena yathā varṇa ekaikaḥ sarvapadārthābhidhānaśaktiḥ pracita evaṃ padam apy ekaikaṃ sarvavākyārthābhidhānaśaktipracitam| tad idam uktam --- sarvapadeṣu cāsti vākyaśaktir vṛkṣa ity ukte 'stīti gamyate|
analyzed: tad bhāga tayā tu teṣām api asti vākya artha vācaka śaktiḥ padārthaḥ iva pada bhāga tayā varṇānām tena yathā varṇaḥ ekaikaḥ sarva padārtha abhidhāna śaktiḥ pracitaḥ evam padam api ekaikam sarva vākya artha abhidhāna śakti pracitam tat idam uktam sarva padeṣu ca asti vākya śaktiḥ vṛkṣaḥ iti ukte sti iti gamyate

original: adhyāhṛtāstipadasahitaṃ vṛkṣa iti padaṃ vākyārthe vartata iti tadbhāgatvād vṛkṣapadaṃ tatra vartate| kasmāt punar astīti gamyata ity ata āha --- na sattāṃ padārtho vyabhicaratīti| loka eva hi padānām arthāvadhāraṇopāyaḥ|
analyzed: adhyāhṛta astipada sahitam vṛkṣaḥ iti padam vākya arthe vartate iti tad bhāga tvāt vṛkṣa padam tatra vartate kasmāt punar asti iti gamyate iti atas āha na sattām padārthaḥ vyabhicarati iti lokaḥ eva hi padānām artha avadhāraṇa upāyaḥ

original: sa ca kevalaṃ padārtham astyarthenābhisamasya sarvatra vākyārthī karoti so'yam avyabhicāraḥ sattayā padārthasyāta eva śabdavṛttividāṃ vyavahāro yatrānyat kriyāpadaṃ nāsti tatrāstir bhavantīparaḥ prayoktavya iti| kriyābhedāvyabhicāri prātipadikam uktvā kriyābhedaṃ kārakāvyabhicāriṇaṃ darśayati --- tathā ca pacatīty ukta iti|
analyzed: sa ca kevalam padārtham asti arthena abhisamasya sarvatra vākya arthī karoti saḥ yam avyabhicāraḥ sattayā padārthasya atas eva śabda vṛtti vidām vyavahāraḥ yatra anyat kriyā padam na asti tatra āstiḥ bhavanti iparaḥ prayoktavyaḥ iti kriyā bheda avyabhicāri prātipadikam uktvā kriyā bhedam kāraka avyabhicāriṇam darśayati tathā ca pacati iti uktaḥ iti

original: pacatīty ukte hi kārakamātrasya tadanvayayogyasyāvagamād anyavyāvṛttiparas tadbhedānām anuvādaḥ| tad evaṃ bheda eva vākyārtha iti tathānapekṣam api padaṃ vākyārthe vartamānaṃ dṛśyata iti sutarām asti vākyaśaktiḥ padānām ity āha --- dṛṣṭaṃ ceti|
analyzed: pacati iti ukte hi kāraka mātrasya tad anvaya yogyasya avagamāt anya vyāvṛtti paraḥ tad bhedānām anuvādaḥ tat evam bhedaḥ eva vākya arthaḥ iti tathā anapekṣam api padam vākya arthe vartamānam dṛśyate iti sutarām asti vākya śaktiḥ padānām iti āha dṛṣṭam ca iti

original: na caitāvatāpi śrotriyādipadasya svatantrasyaivaṃvidhārthapratyāyanaṃ na yāvad astyādibhir abhisamāso'sya bhavati| tathā cāsyāpi vākyāvayavatvāt kalpitatvam eveti bhāvaḥ| syād etat padānām eva ced vākyaśaktiḥ kṛtaṃ tarhi vākyena tebhya eva tadarthāvasāyād ity ata āha --- tatra vākya iti|
analyzed: na ca etāvatā api śrotriya ādi padasya svatantrasya evaṃvidha artha pratyāyanam na yāvat asti ādibhiḥ abhisamāsaḥ asya bhavati tathā ca asya api vākya avayava tvāt kalpita tvam eva iti bhāvaḥ syāt etat padānām eva ced vākya śaktiḥ kṛtam tarhi vākyena tebhyaḥ eva tad artha avasāyāt iti atas āha tatra vākye iti

original: uktam etan na kevalāt padāt padārthaḥ pratipitsitaḥ pratīyate na yāvad etat padāntareṇābhisamasyata iti| tathā ca vākyāt padāny apoddhṛtya kalpitāni vākyārthāc cāpoddhṛtya tadekadeśaṃ kārakaṃ vā kriyāṃ vā tatpadaṃ prakṛtyādivibhāgakalpanayā vyākaraṇīyam anvākhyeyam| kimarthaṃ punar etāvatā kleśenānvākhyāyata ity ata āha --- anyatheti|
analyzed: uktam etat na kevalāt padāt padārthaḥ pratipitsitaḥ pratīyate na yāvat etat pada antareṇa abhisamasyate iti tathā ca vākyāt padāni apoddhṛtya kalpitāni vākya arthāt ca apoddhṛtya tad eka deśam kārakam vā kriyām vā tat padam prakṛti ādi vibhāga kalpanayā vyākaraṇīyam anvākhyeyam kimartham punar etāvatā kleśena anvākhyāyate iti atas āha anyathā iti

original: ghaṭo bhavati bhavati bhikṣāṃ dehi bhavati tiṣṭhatīti nāmākhyātayoś ca sāmyāt| evam aśvas tvam aśvo yātīti| evam ajāpayaḥ piba, ajāpayaḥ śatrūn iti nāmākhyātasārūpyād anirjñātaṃ nāmatvenākhyātatvena vānvākhyānābhāve niṣkṛṣyājñātaṃ kathaṃ kriyāyāṃ kārake vā vyākriyeta| tasmād vākyāt padāny apoddhṛtya vyākhyātavyāni|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ bhavati bhavati bhikṣām dehi bhavati tiṣṭhati iti nāma ākhyātayoḥ ca sāmyāt evam aśvaḥ tvam aśvaḥ yāti iti evam ajā payaḥ piba ajā payaḥ śatrūn iti nāma ākhyāta sārūpyāt anirjñātam nāma tvena ākhyāta tvena vā anvākhyāna abhāve niṣkṛṣya ajñātam katham kriyāyām kārake vā vyākriyeta tasmāt vākyāt padāni apoddhṛtya vyākhyātavyāni

original: na tv anvākhyānād eva pāramārthiko vibhāgaḥ padānām iti| tad evaṃ śabdarūpaṃ vyutpādya śabdārthapratyayānāṃ saṃketāpāditasaṃkarāṇām asaṃkaram ākhyātum upakramate --- teṣāṃ śabdārthapratyayānāṃ pravibhāgas tadyathā śvetate prāsāda iti kriyārthaḥ śabdaḥ|
analyzed: na tu anvākhyānāt eva pāramārthikaḥ vibhāgaḥ padānām iti tat evam śabda rūpam vyutpādya śabda artha pratyayānām saṃketa āpādita saṃkarāṇām a saṃkaram ākhyātum upakramate teṣām śabda artha pratyayānām pravibhāgaḥ tat yathā prāsādaḥ iti kriyā arthaḥ śabdaḥ

original: sphuṭataro hy atra pūrvāparībhūtāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sādhyarūpāyāḥ siddharūpaḥ kriyārthaḥ śvetata iti bhinnaḥ śabdaḥ| yatrāpi śabdārthayoḥ siddharūpatvaṃ tatrāpy arthād asti śabdasya bheda ity āha --- śvetaḥ prāsāda iti kārakārthaḥ śabdaḥ| abhihitatvāc ca kārakavibhakter abhāvaḥ|
analyzed: sphuṭataraḥ hi atra pūrvāparībhūtāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sādhya rūpāyāḥ siddha rūpaḥ kriyā arthaḥ śvetataḥ iti bhinnaḥ śabdaḥ yatra api śabda arthayoḥ siddha rūpa tvam tatra api arthāt asti śabdasya bhedaḥ iti āha śvetaḥ prāsādaḥ iti kāraka arthaḥ śabdaḥ abhihita tvāt ca kāraka vibhakteḥ abhāvaḥ

original: arthaṃ vibhajate --- kriyākārakātmā tadarthas tayoḥ śabdayor arthaḥ kriyātmā kārakātmā ca| pratyayaṃ vibhajate --- pratyayaś ceti| caśabdena tadartha ity etat padam atrānukṛṣyate| tad atrānyapadārthapradhānaṃ saṃbadhyate| sa eva kriyākārakātmārtho yasya sa tathoktaḥ|
analyzed: artham vibhajate kriyā kāraka ātmā tad arthaḥ tayoḥ śabdayoḥ arthaḥ kriyā ātmā kāraka ātmā ca pratyayam vibhajate pratyayaḥ ca iti caśabdena tad arthaḥ iti etat padam atra anukṛṣyate tat atra anya padārtha pradhānam saṃbadhyate saḥ eva kriyā kāraka ātmā arthaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ

original: nanv abhedena pratīteḥ śabdārthapratyayānāṃ saṃkarāt kutaḥ pravibhāga ity āśayavān pṛcchati --- kasmād iti| uttaram āha --- so'yam ity abhisaṃbandhād iti| saṃketopādhir ekākārapratyayo na tu tāttvika ity arthaḥ| saṃketasya nimittatā darśitā saṃketa iti saptamyā| paramārtham āha --- yas tu śveto'rtha iti| avasthā navapurāṇatvādayaḥ|
analyzed: nanu abhedena pratīteḥ śabda artha pratyayānām saṃkarāt kutas pravibhāgaḥ iti āśayavān pṛcchati kasmāt iti uttaram āha saḥ ayam iti abhisaṃbandhāt iti saṃketa upādhiḥ eka ākāra pratyayaḥ na tu tāttvikaḥ iti arthaḥ saṃketasya nimitta tā darśitā saṃketaḥ iti saptamyā paramārtham āha yaḥ tu śveta ūrthaḥ iti avasthāḥ nava purāṇa tva ādayaḥ

original: sahagataḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ| evaṃ ca pravibhāgasaṃyamād yoginaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ paśumṛgasarīsṛpavayaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ yāni rutāni tatrāpy avyaktaṃ padaṃ tadarthas tatpratyayaś ceti| tad iha manuṣyavacanavācyapratyayeṣu kṛtaḥ saṃyamaḥ samānajātīyatayā teṣv api kṛta eveti| teṣāṃ rutaṃ tadarthabhedaṃ tatpratyayaṃ ca yogī jānātīti siddham||3.17||
analyzed: sahagataḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ evam ca pravibhāga saṃyamāt yoginaḥ sarveṣām bhūtānām paśu mṛga sarīsṛpa vayaḥ prabhṛtīnām yāni rutāni tatra api avyaktam padam tad arthaḥ tad pratyayaḥ ca iti tat iha manuṣya vacana vācya pratyayeṣu kṛtaḥ saṃyamaḥ samāna jātīya tayā teṣu api kṛtaḥ eva iti teṣām rutam tad artha bhedam tad pratyayam ca yogī jānāti iti siddham

original: saṃskārasākṣātkaraṇāt pūrvajātijñānam||3.18||
analyzed: saṃskāra sākṣātkaraṇāt pūrva jāti jñānam

original: saṃskārasākṣātkaraṇāt pūrvajātijñānam| jñānajā hi saṃskārāḥ smṛter hetavo'vidyādisaṃskārā avidyādīnāṃ kleśānāṃ hetavaḥ| vipāko jātyāyurbhogarūpas tasya hetavo dharmādharmarūpāḥ| pūrveṣu bhaveṣv abhisaṃskṛtā niṣpāditāḥ svakāraṇair yathāsaṃskṛtaṃ vyañjanaṃ kṛtam iti gamyate|
analyzed: saṃskāra sākṣātkaraṇāt pūrva jāti jñānam jñāna jāḥ hi saṃskārāḥ smṛteḥ hetavaḥ vidyā ādi saṃskārāḥ avidyā ādīnām kleśānām hetavaḥ vipākaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhoga rūpaḥ tasya hetavaḥ dharma adharma rūpāḥ pūrveṣu bhaveṣu abhisaṃskṛtāḥ niṣpāditāḥ sva kāraṇaiḥ yathā saṃskṛtam vyañjanam kṛtam iti gamyate

original: pariṇāmaceṣṭānirodhaśaktijīvanāny eva dharmāś cittasya tadvad aparidṛṣṭāś cittadharmās teṣu śruteṣv anumiteṣu saparikareṣu saṃyamaḥ saṃskārāṇāṃ dvayeṣāṃ sākṣātkriyāyai samarthaḥ| astu tatra saṃyamāt tatsākṣātkāraḥ pūrvajātisākṣātkāras tu kuta ity ata āha --- na ca deśeti| nimittaṃ pūrvaśarīram indriyādi ca|
analyzed: pariṇāma ceṣṭā nirodha śakti jīvanāni eva dharmāḥ cittasya tadvat a paridṛṣṭāḥ citta dharmāḥ teṣu śruteṣu anumiteṣu sa parikareṣu saṃyamaḥ saṃskārāṇām sākṣātkriyāyai samarthaḥ astu tatra saṃyamāt tad sākṣātkāraḥ pūrva jāti sākṣātkāraḥ tu kutas iti atas āha na ca deśa iti nimittam pūrva śarīram indriya ādi ca

original: sānubandhasaṃskārasākṣātkāra eva nāntarīyakatayā jātyādisākṣātkāram ākṣipatīty arthaḥ| svasaṃskārasaṃyamaṃ parakīyeṣv atidiśati --- paratrāpy evam iti| atra śraddhotpāde hetum anubhavata āvaṭyasya jaigīṣavyeṇa saṃvādam upanyasyati --- atredam ākhyānaṃ śrūyata iti| mahākalpo mahāsargaḥ| tanudhara iti nirmāṇakāyasaṃpad uktā|
analyzed: sānubandha saṃskāra sākṣātkāraḥ eva nāntarīyaka tayā jāti ādi sākṣātkāram ākṣipati iti arthaḥ sva saṃskāra saṃyamam parakīyeṣu atidiśati paratra api evam iti atra śraddhā utpāde hetum anubhavataḥ āvaṭyasya jaigīṣavyeṇa saṃvādam upanyasyati atrā idam ākhyānam śrūyate iti mahā kalpaḥ mahā sargaḥ tanudharaḥ iti nirmāṇa kāya saṃpad uktā

original: bhavyaḥ śobhano vigalitarajastamomala ity arthaḥ| pradhānavaśitvam aiśvaryaṃ tena hi pradhānaṃ vikṣobhya yasmai yādṛśīṃ kāyendriyasaṃpadaṃ ditsati tasmai tādṛśīṃ datte| svakīyāni ca kāyendriyasahasrāṇi nirmāyāntarikṣe divi bhuvi ca yathecchaṃ viharatīti| saṃtoṣo hi tṛṣṇākṣayo buddhisattvasya praśāntatā dharmaḥ||3.18||
analyzed: bhavyaḥ śobhanaḥ vigalita rajaḥ tamaḥ malaḥ iti arthaḥ pradhāna vaśitvam aiśvaryam tena hi pradhānam vikṣobhya yasmai yādṛśīm kāya indriya saṃpadam ditsati tasmai tādṛśīm datte svakīyāni ca kāya indriya sahasrāṇi nirmāya antarikṣe divi bhuvi ca yatheccham viharati iti saṃtoṣaḥ hi tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ buddhi sattvasya praśānta tā dharmaḥ

original: pratyayasya paracittajñānam||3.19||
pratyayasya paracittajñānam| parapratyayasya cittamātrasya sākṣātkaraṇād iti||3.19||
analyzed: pratyayasya para citta jñānam para pratyayasya cittamātrasya sākṣātkaraṇāt iti

original: na ca tat sālambanaṃ tasyāviṣayībhūtatvāt||3.20||
analyzed: na ca tat sa ālambanam tasya a viṣayībhūta tvāt

original: yathā saṃskārasākṣātkāras tadanubandhapūrvajanmasākṣātkāram ākṣipaty evaṃ paracittasākṣātkāro'pi tadālambanasākṣātkāram ākṣiped iti prāpta āha --- na ca tat sālambanaṃ tasyāviṣayībhūtatvāt| sānubandhasaṃskāraviṣayo 'sau saṃyamo'yaṃ tu paracittamātraviṣaya ity abhiprāyaḥ||3.20||
analyzed: yathā saṃskāra sākṣātkāraḥ tad anubandha pūrva janma sākṣātkāram ākṣipati evam para citta sākṣātkāraḥ api tad ālambana sākṣātkāram ākṣipet iti prāptaḥ āha na ca tat sa ālambanam tasya aviṣayībhūta tvāt sa anubandha saṃskāra viṣayaḥ sau saṃyamaḥ yam tu para citta mātra viṣayaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: kāyarūpasaṃyamāt tadgrāhyaśaktistambhe cakṣuṣprakāśāsaṃprayoge'ntardhānam||3.21||
analyzed: kāya rūpa saṃyamāt tad grāhya śakti stambhe cakṣuḥ prakāśa a saṃprayoge ntardhānam

original: kāyarūpasaṃyamāt tadgrāhyaśaktistambhe cakṣuṣprakāśasaṃprayoge'ntardhānam| pañcātmakaḥ kāyaḥ| sa ca rūpavattayā cākṣuṣo bhavati| rūpeṇa hi kāyaś ca tadrūpaṃ ca cakṣurgrahaṇakarmaśaktim anubhavati| tatra yadā rūpe saṃyamaviśeṣo yoginā kriyate tadā rūpasya grāhyaśaktī rūpavatkāyapratyakṣatāhetuḥ stambhyate|
analyzed: kāya rūpa saṃyamāt tad grāhya śakti stambhe cakṣuḥ prakāśa saṃprayoge ntardhānam pañca ātmakaḥ kāyaḥ sa ca rūpavat tayā cākṣuṣaḥ bhavati rūpeṇa hi kāyaḥ ca tat rūpam ca cakṣuḥ grahaṇa karma śaktim anubhavati tatra yadā rūpe saṃyama viśeṣaḥ yoginā kriyate tadā rūpasya grāhya śaktī rūpavat kāya pratyakṣa tā hetuḥ stambhyate

original: tasmād grāhyaśaktistambhe saty antardhānaṃ yoginas tataḥ parakīyacakṣurjanitena prakāśena jñānenāsaṃprayogaś cakṣurjñānāviṣayatvaṃ yoginaḥ kāyasyeti yāvat| tasmin kartavye'ntardhānaṃ kāraṇam ity arthaḥ| eteneti| kāyaśabdasparśarasagandhasaṃyamāt tadgrāhyaśaktistambhe śrotratvagrasanaghrāṇaprakāśāsaṃprayoge'ntardhānam iti sūtram ūhanīyam||3.21||
analyzed: tasmāt grāhya śakti stambhe sati antardhānam yoginaḥ tatas parakīya cakṣuḥ janitena prakāśena jñānena asaṃprayogaḥ cakṣuḥ jñāna aviṣaya tvam yoginaḥ kāyasya iti yāvat tasmin kartavye ntardhānam kāraṇam iti arthaḥ etena iti kāya śabda sparśa rasa gandha saṃyamāt tad grāhya śakti stambhe śrotra tvac rasana ghrāṇa prakāśa asaṃprayoga intardhānam iti sūtram ūhanīyam

original: sopakramaṃ nirupakramaṃ ca karma tatsaṃyamād aparāntajñānam ariṣṭebhyo vā||3.22||
analyzed: sa upakramam nirupakramam ca karma tad saṃyamāt aparāntajñānam ariṣṭebhyaḥ vā

original: sopakramaṃ nirupakramaṃ ca karma tatsaṃyamād aparāntajñānam ariṣṭebhyo vā| āyurvipākaṃ ca karma dvividhaṃ sopakramaṃ nirupakramaṃ ca| yat khalv aikabhavikaṃ karma jātyāyurbhogahetus tad āyurvipākam|
analyzed: sa upakramam nirupakramam ca karma tad saṃyamāt aparāntajñānam ariṣṭebhyaḥ vā āyuḥ vipākam ca karma dvividham sa upakramam nirupakramam ca yat khalu aikabhavikam karma jāti āyuḥ bhoga hetuḥ tat āyuḥ vipākam

original: tac ca kiṃcitkālānapekṣam eva bhogadānāya prasthitaṃ dattabahubhogam alpāvaśiṣṭaphalaṃ pravṛttavyāpāraṃ kevalaṃ tatphalasya sahasā bhoktum ekena śarīreṇāśakyatvād vilambate tad idaṃ sopakramam| upakramo vyāpāras tatsahitam ity arthaḥ| tad eva tu dattastokaphalaṃ tatkālam apekṣya phaladānāya vyāpriyamāṇaṃ kādācitkamandavyāpāraṃ nirupakramam|
analyzed: tat ca kiṃcid kāla anapekṣam eva bhoga dānāya prasthitam datta bahu bhogam alpa avaśiṣṭa phalam pravṛtta vyāpāram kevalam tad phalasya sahasā bhoktum ekena śarīreṇa aśakya tvāt vilambate tat idam sa upakramam upakramaḥ vyāpāraḥ tad sahitam iti arthaḥ tat eva tu datta stoka phalam tad kālam apekṣya phala dānāya vyāpriyamāṇam kādācitka manda vyāpāram nirupakramam

original: etad eva nidarśanābhyāṃ viśadayati --- tatra yatheti| atraivātivaiśadyāya nidarśanāntaraṃ darśayati --- yathā vāgnir iti| parāntaṃ mahāpralayam apekṣyāparānto maraṇam| tasmin karmaṇi dharmādharmayoḥ saṃyamād aparāntajñānam| tataś ca yogī sopakramam ātmanaḥ karma vijñāya bahūn kāyān nirmāya sahasā phalaṃ bhuktvā svecchayā mriyate|
analyzed: etat eva nidarśanābhyām viśadayati tatra yathā iti atra eva ati vaiśadyāya nidarśana antaram darśayati yathā vā agniḥ iti parāntam mahāpralayam apekṣya aparāntaḥ maraṇam tasmin karmaṇi dharma adharmayoḥ saṃyamāt aparānta jñānam tatas ca yogī sa upakramam ātmanaḥ karma vijñāya bahūn kāyān nirmāya sahasā phalam bhuktvā sva icchayā mriyate

original: prāsaṅgikam āha --- ariṣṭebhyo vā| arivat trāsayantīty ariṣṭāni trividhāni maraṇacihnāni| viparītaṃ vā sarvaṃ māhendrajālādivyatirekeṇa grāmanagarādi svargam abhimanyate, manuṣyalokam eva devalokam iti||3.22||
analyzed: prāsaṅgikam āha ariṣṭebhyaḥ vai ari vat trāsayanti iti ariṣṭāni trividhāni maraṇa cihnāni viparītam vā sarvam māhendrajāla ādi vyatirekeṇa grāma nagara ādi svargam abhimanyate manuṣya lokam eva deva lokam iti

original: maitryādiṣu balāni||3.23||
analyzed: maitrī ādiṣu balāni

original: maitryādiṣu balāni| maitryādiṣu saṃyamān maitryādibalāny asya bhavanti| tatra maitrībhāvanāto balaṃ yena jīvalokaṃ sukhākaroti tataḥ sarvahito bhavati| evaṃ karuṇābalāt prāṇino duḥkhād duḥkhahetor vā samuddharati| evaṃ muditābalāj jīvalokasya mādhyasthyam ādhatte|
analyzed: maitrī ādiṣu balāni maitrī ādiṣu saṃyamāt maitrī ādi balāni asya bhavanti tatra maitrī bhāvanātaḥ balam yena jīva lokam sukhākaroti tatas sarva hitaḥ bhavati evam karuṇā balāt prāṇinaḥ duḥkhāt duḥkha hetoḥ vā samuddharati evam muditā balāt jīva lokasya mādhyasthyam ādhatte

original: vakṣyamāṇaupayikaṃ bhāvanākāraṇatvaṃ samādher āha --- bhāvanātaḥ samādhir yaḥ sa saṃyamaḥ| yady api dhāraṇādhyānasamādhitrayam eva saṃyamo na samādhimātraṃ tathāpi samādhyanantaraṃ kāryotpādāt samādheḥ prādhānyāt tatra saṃyama upacaritaḥ| kvacid bhāvanā samādhir iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra bhāvanāsamādhī samūhasya saṃyamasyāvayavau hetū bhavataḥ|
analyzed: vakṣyamāṇa aupayikam bhāvanā kāraṇa tvam samādheḥ āha bhāvanātaḥ samādhiḥ yaḥ sa saṃyamaḥ yadi api dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhi trayam eva saṃyamaḥ na samādhi mātram tathā api samādhi anantaram kārya utpādāt samādheḥ prādhānyāt tatra saṃyamaḥ upacaritaḥ kvacid bhāvanā samādhiḥ iti pāṭhaḥ tatra bhāvanā samādhī samūhasya saṃyamasya avayavau hetū bhavataḥ

original: vīryaṃ prayatnaḥ, tena maitryādibalavataḥ puṃsaḥ sukhitādiṣu pareṣāṃ kartavyeṣu prayatno'vandhyo bhavatīti| upekṣaudāsīnyaṃ, na tatra bhāvanā nāpi sukhādivad bhāvyaṃ kiṃcid astīti||3.23||
analyzed: vīryam prayatnaḥ tena maitrī ādi balavataḥ puṃsaḥ sukhita ādiṣu pareṣām kartavyeṣu prayatnaḥ vandhyaḥ bhavati iti upekṣā audāsīnyam na tatra bhāvanā na api sukha ādi vat bhāvyam kiṃcid asti iti

original: baleṣu hastibalādīni||3.24||
analyzed: baleṣu hasti bala ādīni

original: baleṣu hastibalādīni| yasya bale saṃyamas tasya balaṃ labhata iti||3.24||
analyzed: baleṣu hasti bala ādīni yasya bale saṃyamaḥ tasya balam labhate iti

original: pravṛttyālokanyāsāt sūkṣmavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭajñānam||3.25||
pravṛttyālokanyāsāt sūkṣmavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭajñānam| sūkṣme vyavahite viprakṛṣṭe vārthe saṃyamena vinyasya tam adhigacchati||3.25||
analyzed: pravṛtti āloka nyāsāt sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭa jñānam sūkṣme vyavahite viprakṛṣṭe vā arthe saṃyamena vinyasya tam adhigacchati

original: bhuvanajñānaṃ sūrye saṃyamāt||3.26||
analyzed: bhuvana jñānam sūrye saṃyamāt

original: bhuvanajñānaṃ sūrye saṃyamāt| ā dhruvādito merupṛṣṭhāt| tad evam anena saṃgrahaślokāntena saṃkṣepataḥ sapta lokān upanyasya vistareṇāha --- tatrāvīcer iti| ghanaśabdena pṛthivy ucyate| bhūmiḥ sthānam ity arthaḥ| ete mahānarakā anekopanarakaparivārā boddhavyāḥ| etān eva nāmāntareṇopasaṃharati --- maheti|
analyzed: bhuvana jñānam sūrye saṃyamāt ā dhruva āditaḥ meru pṛṣṭhāt tat evam anena saṃgraha śloka antena saṃkṣepataḥ sapta lokān upanyasya vistareṇa āha tatra avīceḥ iti ghana śabdena pṛthivī ucyate bhūmiḥ sthānam iti arthaḥ ete mahā narakāḥ aneka upanaraka parivārāḥ boddhavyāḥ etān eva nāma antareṇa upasaṃharati mahā iti

original: tasya sūryapracārād rātriṃdivaṃ lagnam iva vartate| yam evāsya bhāgaṃ sūryas tyajati tatra rātriḥ| yam eva bhāgam alaṃkaroti tatra dinam iti| sakalajambūdvīpaparimāṇam āha --- tad etad yojanaśatasāhasram| kiṃbhūtaṃ yojanānāṃ śatasāhasram ity āha --- sumeror diśi diśi tadardhena pañcāśadyojanasahasreṇa vyūḍhaṃ saṃkṣiptam|
analyzed: tasya sūrya pracārāt rātriṃdivam lagnam iva vartate yam eva asya bhāgam sūryaḥ tyajati tatra rātriḥ yam eva bhāgam alaṃkaroti tatra dinam iti sakala jambūdvīpa parimāṇam āha tat etat yojana śata sāhasram kiṃbhūtam yojanānām śata sāhasram iti āha sumeroḥ diśi diśi tad ardhena pañcāśat yojana sahasreṇa vyūḍham saṃkṣiptam

original: yato'sya madhyasthaḥ sumeruḥ samudrāś ca sarṣaparāśikalpā iti dviguṇā dviguṇā iti saṃbandhaḥ| yathā sarṣaparāśir na vrīhirāśir ivocchrito nāpi bhūmisamas tathā samudrā apīty arthaḥ| vicitraiḥ śailair avataṃsair iva saha vartanta iti savicitraśailāvataṃsā dvīpāḥ|
analyzed: yatas asya madhya sthaḥ sumeruḥ samudrāḥ ca sarṣapa rāśi kalpāḥ iti dviguṇāḥ dviguṇāḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ yathā sarṣapa rāśiḥ na vrīhi rāśiḥ iva ucchritaḥ na api bhūmi samaḥ tathā samudrāḥ api iti arthaḥ vicitraiḥ śailaiḥ avataṃsaiḥ iva saha vartante iti sa vicitra śaila avataṃsāḥ dvīpāḥ

original: tad etat sarvaṃ sadvīpavipinanaganagaranīradhimālāvalayaṃ lokālokaparivṛtaṃ viśvaṃbharāmaṇḍalaṃ brahmāṇḍamadhye vyūḍhaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ supratiṣṭhitaṃ saṃsthānaṃ saṃniveśo yasya tat tathoktam| ye yatra prativasanti tatra tān darśayati --- tatra pātāla iti| sumeroḥ saṃniveśam āha --- sumerur iti|
analyzed: tat etat sarvam sa dvīpa vipina naga nagara nīradhi mālā valayam lokāloka parivṛtam viśvaṃbharā maṇḍalam brahmāṇḍa madhye vyūḍham saṃkṣiptam su pratiṣṭhitam saṃsthānam saṃniveśaḥ yasya tat tathā uktam ye yatra prativasanti tatra tān darśayati tatra pātāle iti sumeroḥ saṃniveśam āha sumeruḥ iti

original: tad evaṃ bhūrlokaṃ saprakāram uktvā saprakāram evāntarīkṣalokam āha --- graheti| vikṣepo vyāpāraḥ| svarlokam ādarśayati --- māhendranivāsina iti| devanikāyā devajātayaḥ| ṣaṇṇām api devanikāyānāṃ rūpotkarṣam āha --- sarve saṃkalpasiddhā iti| saṃkalpamātrād evaiṣāṃ viṣayā upanamanti| vṛndārakāḥ pūjyāḥ| kāmabhogino maithunapriyāḥ|

original: tad evaṃ caturṇāṃ devanikāyānāṃ sādhāraṇadharmān uktvā nāmaviśeṣagrahaṇena dharmaviśeṣān āha --- tatreti| acyutā nāma devāḥ sthūlaviṣayadhyānasukhās tena te tṛpyanti| śuddhanivāsā nāma devāḥ sūkṣmaviṣayadhyānasukhās tena te tṛpyanti| satyābhā nāma devā indriyaviṣayadhyānasukhās tena te tṛpyanti|

original: saṃjñāsaṃjñino nāma devā asmitāmātradhyānasukhās tena te tṛpyanti| ta ete sarve saṃprajñātasamādhim upāsate| athāsaṃprajñātasamādhiniṣṭhā videhaprakṛtilayāḥ kasmān na lokamadhye nyasyanta ity ata āha --- videhaprakṛtilayās tv iti| buddhivṛttimanto hi darśitaviṣayā lokayātrāṃ vahanto lokeṣu vartante|
analyzed: saṃjñāsaṃjñinaḥ nāma devāḥ asmitā mātra dhyāna sukhāḥ tena te tṛpyanti te ete sarve saṃprajñāta samādhim upāsate atha asaṃprajñāta samādhi niṣṭhāḥ videha prakṛti layāḥ kasmāt na loka madhye nyasyante iti atas āha videha prakṛti layāḥ tu iti buddhi vṛttimantaḥ hi darśita viṣayāḥ lokayātrām vahantaḥ lokeṣu vartante

original: na caivaṃ videhaprakṛtilayāḥ saty api sādhikāratva ity arthaḥ| tad etad ā satyalokam ā cāvīcer yoginā sākṣātkaraṇīyaṃ, sūryadvāre suṣumnāyāṃ nāḍyām| na caitāvatāpi tatsākṣātkāro bhavatīty ata āha --- evaṃ tāvad anyatrāpi suṣumnāyā anyatrāpi yogopādhyāyopadiṣṭeṣu yāvad idaṃ sarvaṃ jagad dṛṣṭam iti|
analyzed: na ca evam videha prakṛti layāḥ sati api sādhikāra tve iti arthaḥ tat etat ā satyalokam ā ca avīceḥ yoginā sākṣātkaraṇīyam sūrya dvāre suṣumnāyām nāḍyām na ca etāvatā api tad sākṣātkāraḥ bhavati iti atas āha evam tāvat anyatra api suṣumnāyāḥ anyatra api yoga upādhyāya upadiṣṭeṣu yāvat idam sarvam jagat dṛṣṭam iti

original: buddhisattvaṃ hi svabhāvata eva viśvaprakāśanasamarthaṃ tamomalāvṛtaṃ yatraiva rajasodghāṭyate tad eva prakāśayati| sūryadvārasaṃyamodghāṭitaṃ tu bhuvanaṃ prakāśayati| na caivam anyatrāpi prasaṅgas tatsaṃyamasya tāvanmātrodghāṭanasāmarthyād iti sarvam avadātam||3.26||

original: athavānukūlapratikūlavedanīyas tu sukhaduḥkhānubhavo bhogaḥ| na cāyam ātmānam evānukūlayati pratikūlayati vā, svātmani vṛttivirodhād ato'nukūlanīyapratikūlanīyārtho bhogaḥ| sa bhoktātmā tasya dṛśyo bhogya iti| yas tu tasmāt parārthād viśiṣṭa iti| parārthād iti pañcamyanyapadādhyāhāreṇa vyākhyātā|

analyzed: tatas prātibha śrāvaṇa vedana ādarśa āsvāda vārtāḥ jāyante

original: sa ca svārthasaṃyamo na yāvat pradhānaṃ svakāryaṃ puruṣajñānam abhinirvartayati tāvat tasya purastād yā vibhūtīr ādhatte tāḥ sarvā darśayati --- tataḥ prātibhaśrāvaṇavedanādarśāsvādavārtā jāyante| tad anena yogajadharmānugṛhītānāṃ manaḥśrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇānāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prātibhajñānadivyaśabdādyaparokṣahetubhāvā uktāḥ|
analyzed: sa ca sva artha saṃyamaḥ na yāvat pradhānam sva kāryam puruṣa jñānam abhinirvartayati tāvat tasya purastāt yāḥ vibhūtīḥ ādhatte tāḥ sarvāḥ darśayati tatas prātibha śrāvaṇa vedana ādarśa āsvāda vārtāḥ jāyante tat anena yoga ja dharma anugṛhītānām manaḥ śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇānām yathāsaṃkhyam prātibha jñāna divya śabda ādi aparokṣa hetu bhāvāḥ uktāḥ

original: śrotrādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ divyaśabdādyupalambhakānāṃ tāntrikyaḥ saṃjñāḥ śrāvaṇādyāḥ| sugamaṃ bhāṣyam||3.36||
analyzed: śrotra ādīnām pañcānām divya śabda ādi upalambhakānām tāntrikyaḥ saṃjñāḥ śrāvaṇa ādyāḥ sugamam bhāṣyam

original: te samādhāv upasargā vyutthāne siddhayaḥ||3.37||
analyzed: te samādhau upasargāḥ vyutthāne siddhayaḥ

original: kadācid ātmaviṣayasaṃyame pravṛttas tatprabhāvād amūr arthāntarasiddhīr adhigamya kṛtārthamanyaḥ saṃyamād viramed ata āha --- te samādhāv upasargā vyutthāne siddhayaḥ| vyutthitacitto hi tāḥ siddhīr abhimanyate| janmadurgata iva draviṇakaṇikām api draviṇasaṃbhāram| yoginā tu samāhitacittenopanatābhyo'pi tābhyo virantavyam|
analyzed: kadācid ātma viṣaya saṃyame pravṛttaḥ tad prabhāvāt amūḥ artha antara siddhīḥ adhigamya kṛtārtham anyaḥ saṃyamāt viramet atas āha te samādhau upasargāḥ vyutthāne siddhayaḥ vyutthita cittaḥ hi tāḥ siddhīḥ abhimanyate janma durgataḥ iva draviṇa kaṇikām api draviṇa saṃbhāram yoginā tu samāhita cittena upanatābhyaḥ api tābhyaḥ virantavyam

original: abhisaṃhitatāpatrayātyantikopaśamarūpaparamapuruṣārthaḥ sa khalv ayaṃ kathaṃ tatpratyanīkāsu siddhiṣu rajyeteti sūtrabhāṣyayor arthaḥ||3.37||
analyzed: abhisaṃhita tāpa traya ātyantika upaśama rūpa parama puruṣa arthaḥ sa khalu ayam katham tad pratyanīkāsu siddhiṣu rajyeta iti sūtra bhāṣyayoḥ arthaḥ

original: bandhakāraṇaśaithilyāt pracārasaṃvedanāc ca cittasya paraśarīrāveśaḥ||3.38||
analyzed: bandha kāraṇa śaithilyāt pracāra saṃvedanāt ca cittasya para śarīra āveśaḥ

original: tad evaṃ jñānarūpam aiśvaryaṃ puruṣadarśanāntaṃ saṃyamaphalam uktvā kriyārūpam aiśvaryaṃ saṃyamaphalam āha --- bandhakāraṇaśaithilyāt pracārasaṃvedanāc ca cittasya paraśarīrāveśaḥ| samādhibalād iti| bandhakāraṇaviṣayasaṃyamabalāt prādhānyāt samādhigrahaṇam| pracaraty anenāsminn iti pracāraḥ|
analyzed: tat evam jñāna rūpam aiśvaryam puruṣa darśana antam saṃyama phalam uktvā kriyā rūpam aiśvaryam saṃyama phalam āha bandha kāraṇa śaithilyāt pracāra saṃvedanāt ca cittasya para śarīra āveśaḥ samādhi balāt iti bandha kāraṇa viṣaya saṃyama balāt prādhānyāt samādhi grahaṇam pracarati anena asmin iti pracāraḥ

original: cittasya gamāgamādhvāno nāḍyas tasmin pracāre saṃyamāt tadvedanaṃ, tasmāc ca bandhakāraṇaśaithilyān na tena pratibadhyate| apratibaddham apy unmārgeṇa gacchan na svaśarīrād apratyūhaṃ niṣkrāmati| na ca paraśarīram āviśati| tasmāt tatpracāro'pi jñātavyaḥ| indriyāṇi ca cittānusārīṇi paraśarīre yathādhiṣṭhānaṃ niviśanta iti||3.38||
analyzed: cittasya gama āgama adhvānaḥ nāḍyaḥ tasmin pracāre saṃyamāt tad vedanam tasmāt ca bandha kāraṇa śaithilyāt na tena pratibadhyate apratibaddham api unmārgeṇa gacchan na sva śarīrāt apratyūham niṣkrāmati na ca para śarīram āviśati tasmāt tad pracāraḥ api jñātavyaḥ indriyāṇi ca citta anusārīṇi para śarīre yathādhiṣṭhānam niviśante iti

original: udānajayāj jalapaṅkakaṇṭakādiṣv asaṅga utkrāntiś ca||3.39||
analyzed: udāna jayāt jala paṅka kaṇṭaka ādiṣu asaṅgaḥ utkrāntiḥ ca

original: udānajayāj jalapaṅkakaṇṭakādiṣv asaṅga utkrāntiś ca| samastendriyavṛttir jīvanaṃ prāṇādilakṣaṇā prāṇādayo lakṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| dvayīndriyāṇāṃ vṛttir bāhyābhyantarī ca| bāhyā rūpādyālocanalakṣaṇā| ābhyantarī tu jīvanaṃ, sā hi prayatnabhedaḥ śarīropagṛhītamārutakriyābhedahetuḥ sarvakaraṇasādhāraṇaḥ| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: udāna jayāt jala paṅka kaṇṭaka ādiṣu asaṅgaḥ utkrāntiḥ ca samasta indriya vṛttiḥ jīvanam prāṇa ādi lakṣaṇā prāṇa ādayaḥ lakṣaṇam yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā dvayī indriyāṇām vṛttiḥ bāhya ābhyantarī ca bāhyā rūpa ādi ālocana lakṣaṇā ābhyantarī tu jīvanam sā hi prayatna bhedaḥ śarīra upagṛhīta māruta kriyā bheda hetuḥ sarva karaṇa sādhāraṇaḥ yathā āhuḥ

original: "sāmānyakaraṇavṛttiḥ prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca" iti|
analyzed: sāmānya karaṇa vṛttiḥ prāṇa ādyāḥ vāyavaḥ pañca iti

original: tair asya lakṣaṇīyatvāt tasya prayatnasya kriyā kāryaṃ pañcatayī| prāṇa ā nāsikāgrād ā ca hṛdayād avasthitaḥ| aśitapītāhārapariṇatibhedaṃ rasaṃ tatra tatra sthāne samam anurūpaṃ nayan samānaḥ| ā hṛdayād ā ca nābher asyāvasthānam| mūtrapurīṣagarbhādīnām apanayanahetur apānaḥ| ā nābher ā ca pādatalād asya vṛttiḥ|
analyzed: taiḥ asya lakṣaṇīya tvāt tasya prayatnasya kriyā kāryam pañcatayī prāṇaḥ ā nāsikā agrāt ā ca hṛdayāt avasthitaḥ aśita pīta āhāra pariṇati bhedam rasam tatra tatra sthāne samam anurūpam nayan samānaḥ ā hṛdayāt ā ca nābheḥ asya avasthānam mūtra purīṣa garbha ādīnām apanayana hetuḥ apānaḥ ā nābheḥ ā ca pāda talāt asya vṛttiḥ

original: unnayanād ūrdhvaṃ nayanād rasādīnām udānaḥ| ā nāsikāgrād ā ca śiraso vṛttir asya| vyāpī vyānaḥ| eṣām uktānāṃ pradhānaṃ prāṇas tadutkrame sarvotkramaśruteḥ "prāṇam utkrāmantam anu sarve prāṇā utkrāmanti" iti| tad evaṃ prāṇādīnāṃ kriyāsthānabhedena bhedaṃ pratipādya sūtrārtham avatārayati --- udānajayād iti|
analyzed: unnayanāt ūrdhvam nayanāt rasa ādīnām udānaḥ ā nāsikā agrāt ā ca śirasaḥ vṛttiḥ asya vyāpī vyānaḥ eṣām uktānām pradhānam prāṇaḥ tad utkrame sarva utkrama śruteḥ prāṇam utkrāmantam anu sarve prāṇāḥ utkrāmanti iti tat evam prāṇa ādīnām kriyā sthāna bhedena bhedam pratipādya sūtra artham avatārayati udāna jayāt iti

original: udāne kṛtasaṃyamas tajjayāj jalādibhir na pratihanyate| utkrāntiś cārcirādimārgeṇa bhavati prāyaṇakāle| tasmāt tām utkrāntiṃ vaśitvena pratipadyate| prāṇādisaṃyamāt tadvijaye bhūtajaya etāḥ kriyāḥ sthānavijayādibhedāt pratipattavyāḥ||3.39||
analyzed: udāne kṛta saṃyamaḥ tad jayāt jala ādibhiḥ na pratihanyate utkrāntiḥ ca arciḥ ādi mārgeṇa bhavati prāyaṇa kāle tasmāt tām utkrāntim vaśi tvena pratipadyate prāṇa ādi saṃyamāt tad vijaye bhūta jaye etāḥ kriyāḥ sthāna vijaya ādi bhedāt pratipattavyāḥ

original: samānajayāj jvalanam||3.40||
analyzed: samāna jayāt jvalanam

original: samājanayāj jvalanam| tejasaḥ śārīrasyopadhmānam uttejanam||3.40||
analyzed: samājanayāt jvalanam tejasaḥ śārīrasya upadhmānam uttejanam

original: śrotrākāśayoḥ saṃbandhasaṃyamād divyaṃ śrotram||3.41||
analyzed: śrotra ākāśayoḥ saṃbandha saṃyamāt divyam śrotram

original: svārthasaṃyamād anvācayaśiṣṭaṃ śrāvaṇādy uktaṃ saṃprati śrāvaṇādyarthād eva saṃyamāc chrāvaṇādi bhavatīty āha --- śrotrākāśayoḥ saṃbandhasaṃyamād divyaṃ śrotram|
analyzed: sva artha saṃyamāt anvācaya śiṣṭam śrāvaṇa ādi uktam saṃprati śrāvaṇa ādi arthāt eva saṃyamāt śrāvaṇa ādi bhavati iti āha śrotra ākāśayoḥ saṃbandha saṃyamāt divyam śrotram

original: saṃyamaviṣayaṃ śrotrākāśayoḥ saṃbandham ādhārādheyabhāvam āha --- sarvaśrotrāṇām āhaṃkārikāṇām apy ākāśaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīvivaraṃ pratiṣṭhā tadāyatanaṃ śrotraṃ tadupakārāpakārābhyāṃ śrotrasyopakārāpakāradarśanāt| śabdānāṃ ca śrotrasahakāriṇāṃ pārthivādiśabdagrahaṇe kartavye karṇaśaṣkulīsuṣiravarti śrotraṃ svāśrayanabhogatāsādhāraṇaśabdam apekṣate|
analyzed: saṃyama viṣayam śrotra ākāśayoḥ saṃbandham ādhāra ādheya bhāvam āha sarva śrotrāṇām āhaṃkārikāṇām api ākāśam karṇa śaṣkulī vivaram pratiṣṭhā tad āyatanam śrotram tad upakāra apakārābhyām śrotrasya upakāra apakāra darśanāt śabdānām ca śrotra sahakāriṇām pārthiva ādi śabda grahaṇe kartavye karṇa śaṣkulī suṣira varti śrotram sva āśrayana bhoga tā sādhāraṇa śabdam apekṣate

original: gandhādiguṇasahakāribhir ghrāṇādibhir bāhyaṃ pṛthivyādivartigandhādyālocane kārye dṛṣṭam| āhaṃkārikam api ghrāṇrasanatvakcakṣuḥśrotraṃ bhūtādhiṣṭhānam eva bhūtopakārāpakārābhyāṃ ghrāṇādīnām upakārāpakāradarśanād ity uktam|
analyzed: gandha ādi guṇa sahakāribhiḥ ghrāṇa ādibhiḥ bāhyam pṛthivī ādi varti gandha ādi ālocane kārye dṛṣṭam āhaṃkārikam api ghrāṇ rasana tvac cakṣuḥ śrotram bhūta adhiṣṭhānam eva bhūta upakāra apakārābhyām ghrāṇa ādīnām upakāra apakāra darśanāt iti uktam

original: tac cedaṃ śrotram āhaṃkārikam ayaḥpratimam ayaskāntamaṇikalpena vaktṛvaktrasamutpannena vaktrasthena śabdenākṛṣṭaṃ svavṛttiparamparayā vaktṛvaktram āgataṃ śabdam ālocayati| tathā ca digdeśavartiśabdapratītiḥ prāṇabhṛnmātrasya nāsati bādhake'pramāṇīkṛtā bhaviṣyatīti|
analyzed: tat ca idam śrotram āhaṃkārikam ayaḥ pratimam ayaskānta maṇi kalpena vaktṛ vaktra samutpannena vaktra sthena śabdena ākṛṣṭam sva vṛtti paramparayā vaktṛ vaktram āgatam śabdam ālocayati tathā ca diś deśa varti śabda pratītiḥ prāṇabhṛt mātrasya na asati bhaviṣyati iti

original: tathā ca pañcaśikhasya vākyam --- tulyadeśaśravaṇānām ekadeśaśrutitvaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavatīti| tulyadeśāni śravaṇāni śrotrāṇi yeṣāṃ caitrādīnāṃ te tathoktāḥ| sarveṣāṃ śravaṇāny ākāśavartīnīty arthaḥ| tac ca śrotrādhiṣṭhānam ākāśaṃ śabdaguṇatanmātrād utpannaṃ śabdaguṇakaṃ yena śabdena sahakāriṇā pārthivādīñ śabdān gṛhṇāti|
analyzed: tathā ca pañcaśikhasya vākyam tulya deśa śravaṇānām eka deśa śruti tvam sarveṣām bhavati iti tulya deśāni śravaṇāni śrotrāṇi yeṣām caitra ādīnām te tathā uktāḥ sarveṣām śravaṇāni ākāśa vartīni iti arthaḥ tat ca śrotra adhiṣṭhānam ākāśam śabda guṇa tanmātrāt utpannam śabda guṇakam yena śabdena sahakāriṇā pārthiva ādīn śabdān gṛhṇāti

original: tasmāt sarveṣām ekajātīyā śrutiḥ śabda ity arthaḥ| tad anena śrotrādhiṣṭhānatvam ākāśasya śabdaguṇatvaṃ ca darśitam iti| tac caikadeśaśrutitvam ākāśasya liṅgam| sā hy ekajātīyā śabdavyañjikā śrutir yadāśrayā tad evākāśaśabdavācyam| na hīdṛśīṃ śrutim antareṇa śabdavyaktiḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt sarveṣām eka jātīyā śrutiḥ śabdaḥ iti arthaḥ tat anena śrotra adhiṣṭhāna tvam ākāśasya śabda guṇa tvam ca darśitam iti tat ca eka deśa śruti tvam ākāśasya liṅgam sā hi eka jātīyā śabda vyañjikā śrutiḥ yad āśrayā tat eva ākāśa śabda vācyam na hi īdṛśīm śrutim antareṇa śabda vyaktiḥ

original: na cedṛśī śrutiḥ pṛthivyādiguṇas tasya svātmani vyaṅgyavyañjakatvānupapatter iti| anāvaraṇaṃ cākāśaliṅgam| yady ākāśaṃ nābhaviṣyad anyonyasaṃpiṇḍitāni mūrtāni na sūcībhir apy abhetsyanta| tataś ca sarvair eva sarvam āvṛtaṃ syāt| na ca mūrtadravyābhāvamātrād evānāvaraṇam asyābhāvasya bhāvāśritatvena tadabhāve'bhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca īdṛśī śrutiḥ pṛthivī ādi guṇaḥ tasya svātmani vyaṅgya vyañjaka tva anupapatteḥ iti anāvaraṇam ca ākāśa liṅgam yadi ākāśam nā abhaviṣyat anyonya saṃpiṇḍitāni mūrtāni na sūcībhiḥ api abhetsyanta tatas ca sarvaiḥ eva sarvam āvṛtam syāt na ca mūrta dravya abhāva mātrāt eva anāvaraṇam asya abhāvasya bhāva āśrita tvena tad abhāva bhāvāt

original: na ca citiśaktis tadāśrayā bhavitum arhati| apariṇāmitayāvacchedakatvābhāvāt| na ca dikkālādayaḥ pṛthivyādidravyavyatiriktāḥ santi| tasmāt tādṛśaḥ pariṇatibhedo nabhasa eveti sarvam avadātam| anāvaraṇe cākāśaliṅge siddhe yatra yatrānāvaraṇaṃ tatra tatra sarvatrākāśam iti sarvagatatvam apy ākāśasya siddham ity āha --- tathāmūrtasyeti|
analyzed: na ca citi śaktiḥ tad āśrayā bhavitum arhati apariṇāmi tayā avacchedaka tva abhāvāt na ca diś kāla ādayaḥ pṛthivī ādi dravya vyatiriktāḥ santi tasmāt tādṛśaḥ pariṇati bhedaḥ nabhasaḥ eva iti sarvam avadātam anāvaraṇe ca ākāśa liṅge siddhe yatra yatra anāvaraṇam tatra tatra sarvatra ākāśam iti sarvagata tvam api ākāśasya siddham iti āha tathā amūrtasya iti

original: śrotrasadbhāve pramāṇam āha --- śabdagrahaṇeti| kriyā hi karaṇasādhyā dṛṣṭā| yathā chidādir vāsyādisādhyā| tad iha śabdagrahaṇakriyayāpi karaṇasādhyayā bhavitavyaṃ, yac ca karaṇaṃ tac ca śrotram iti| athāsyāś cakṣurādaya eva kasmāt karaṇaṃ na bhavantīty ata āha --- badhirābadhirayor iti| anvayavyatirekābhyām avadhāraṇam|
analyzed: śrotra sadbhāve pramāṇam āha śabda grahaṇa iti kriyā hi karaṇa sādhyā dṛṣṭā yathā chid ādiḥ vāsya ādi sādhyā tat iha śabda grahaṇa kriyayā api karaṇa sādhyayā bhavitavyam yat ca karaṇam tat ca śrotram iti atha asyāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ eva kasmāt karaṇam na bhavanti iti atas āha badhira abadhirayoḥ iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām avadhāraṇam

original: upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat tvagvātayoś cakṣustejaso rasanodakayor nāsikāpṛthivyoḥ saṃbandhasaṃyamād divyatvagādy apy ūhanīyam||3.41||
analyzed: upalakṣaṇam ca etat tvak vātayoḥ cakṣuḥ tejasoḥ rasana udakayoḥ nāsikā pṛthivyoḥ saṃbandha saṃyamāt divya tvak ādi api ūhanīyam

original: kāyākāśayoḥ saṃbandhasaṃyamāl laghutūlasamāpatteś cākāśagamanam||3.42||
analyzed: kāya ākāśayoḥ saṃbandha saṃyamāt laghu tūla samāpatteḥ ca ākāśagamanam

original: kāyākaśayoḥ saṃbandhasaṃyamāl laghutūlasamāpatteś cākāśagamanam| kāyākāśasaṃbandhasaṃyamād vā laghuni vā tūlādau kṛtasaṃyamāt samāpattiṃ cetasas tatsthatadañjanatāṃ labdhveti| siddhikramam āha --- jala iti||3.42||
analyzed: saṃbandha saṃyamāt laghu tūla samāpatteḥ ca ākāśagamanam kāya ākāśa saṃbandha saṃyamāt vā laghuni vā tūla ādau kṛta saṃyamāt samāpattim cetasaḥ tad stha tad añjana tām labdhvā iti siddhi kramam āha jale iti

original: bahir akalpitā vṛttir mahāvidehā tataḥ prakāśāvaraṇakṣayaḥ||3.43||
analyzed: bahis akalpitā vṛttiḥ mahāvidehā tatas prakāśa āvaraṇa kṣayaḥ

original: aparam api paraśarīrāveśahetuṃ saṃyamaṃ kleśakarmavipākakṣayahetuṃ cāha --- bahir akalpitā vṛttir mahāvidehā tataḥ prakāśāvaraṇakṣayaḥ| videhām āha --- śarīrād iti| akalpitāyā mahāvidehāyā ya upāyas tatpradarśanāya kalpitāṃ videhām āha --- sā yadīti| vṛttimātraṃ kalpanājñānamātraṃ tena| mahāvidehām āha --- yā tv iti|
analyzed: aparam api para śarīra āveśa hetum saṃyamam kleśa karma vipāka kṣaya hetum ca āha bahis akalpitā vṛttiḥ mahāvidehā tatas prakāśa āvaraṇa kṣayaḥ videhām āha śarīrāt iti akalpitāyāḥ mahāvidehāyāḥ yaḥ upāyaḥ tad pradarśanāya kalpitām videhām āha sā yadi iti vṛtti mātram kalpanā jñāna mātram tena mahāvidehām āha yā tu iti

original: upāyopeyate kalpitākalpitayor āha --- tatreti| kiṃ paraśarīrāveśamātram ito nety āha --- tataś ceti| tato dhāraṇāto mahāvidehāyā manaḥpravṛtteḥ siddhiḥ| kleśaś ca karma ca tābhyāṃ vipākatrayaṃ jātyāyurbhogāḥ| tad etad rajastamomūlaṃ vigalitarajastamasaḥ sattvamātrād vivekakhyātimātrasamutpādāt|
analyzed: upāya upeyate kalpita akalpitayoḥ āha tatra iti kim para śarīra āveśa mātram itas na iti āha tatas ca iti tatas dhāraṇātaḥ mahāvidehāyāḥ manaḥ pravṛtteḥ siddhiḥ kleśaḥ ca karma ca tābhyām vipāka trayam jāti āyuḥ bhogāḥ tat etat rajaḥ tamaḥ mūlam vigalita rajaḥ tamasaḥ sattva mātrāt viveka khyāti mātra samutpādāt

original: tad etad vipākatrayaṃ rajastamomūlatayā tadātmakaṃ sadbuddhisattvam āvṛṇoti| tatkṣayāc ca nirāvaraṇaṃ yogicittaṃ yathecchaṃ viharati vijānāti ceti||3.43||
analyzed: tat etat vipāka trayam rajaḥ tamaḥ mūla tayā tad ātmakam sat buddhi sattvam āvṛṇoti tad kṣayāt ca nirāvaraṇam yogi cittam yatheccham viharati vijānāti ca iti

original: sthūlasvarūpasūkṣmānvayārthavattvasaṃyamād bhūtajayaḥ||3.44||
sthūlasvarūpasūkṣmānvayārthavattvasaṃyamād bhūtajayaḥ| sthūlaṃ ca svarūpaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ cānvayaś cārthavattvaṃ ceti sthūlasvarūpasūkṣmānvayārthavattvāni teṣu saṃyamāt tajjayaḥ| sthūlam āha --- tatreti|
analyzed: sthūla svarūpa sūkṣma anvaya arthavattva saṃyamāt bhūtajayaḥ sthūlam ca svarūpam ca sūkṣmam ca anvayaḥ ca arthavat tvam ca iti sthūla svarūpa sūkṣma anvaya arthavattvāni teṣu saṃyamāt tajjayaḥ sthūlam āha tatra iti

original: pārthivāḥ pāthasīyās taijasā vāyavīyā ākāśīyāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhā yathāsaṃbhavaṃ viśeṣāḥ ṣaḍjagāndhārādayaḥ śītoṣṇādayo nīlapītādayaḥ kaṣāyamadhurādayaḥ surabhyādayaḥ| ete hi nāmarūpaprayojanaiḥ parasparato bhidyanta iti viśeṣāḥ|
analyzed: pārthivāḥ pāthasīyāḥ taijasāḥ vāyavīyāḥ ākāśīyāḥ śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandhāḥ yathāsaṃbhavam viśeṣāḥ ṣaḍja gāndhāra ādayaḥ śīta uṣṇa ādayaḥ nīla pīta ādayaḥ kaṣāya madhura ādayaḥ surabhya ādayaḥ ete hi nāma rūpa prayojanaiḥ parasparataḥ bhidyante iti viśeṣāḥ

original: eteṣāṃ pañca pṛthivyāṃ gandhavarjaṃ catvāro'psu gandharasavarjaṃ trayas tejasi gandharasarūpavarjaṃ dvau nabhasvati śabda evākāśe| ta eva īdṛśā viśeṣāḥ sahākārādibhir dharmaiḥ sthūlaśabdena paribhāṣitāḥ śāstre| tatrāpi pārthivās tāvad dharmāḥ ---
analyzed: eteṣām pañca pṛthivyām gandha varjam catvāraḥ apsu gandha rasa varjam trayaḥ tejasi gandha rasa rūpa varjam dvau nabhasvati śabdaḥ eva ākāśe te eva īdṛśāḥ viśeṣāḥ saha ākāra ādibhiḥ dharmaiḥ sthūla śabdena paribhāṣitāḥ śāstre tatra api pārthivāḥ tāvat dharmāḥ

original: "ākāro gauravaṃ raukṣyaṃ varaṇaṃ sthairyam eva ca| vṛttir bhedaḥ kṣamā kārṣṇyaṃ kāṭhinyaṃ sarvabhogyatā"||
analyzed: ākāraḥ gauravam raukṣyam varaṇam sthairyam eva ca vṛttiḥ bhedaḥ kṣamā kārṣṇyam kāṭhinyam sarva bhogya tā

original: apāṃ dharmāḥ ---
analyzed: apām dharmāḥ

original: "snehaḥ saukṣmyaṃ prabhā śauklyaṃ mārdavaṃ gauravaṃ ca yat| śaityaṃ rakṣā pavitratvaṃ saṃdhānaṃ caudakā guṇāḥ"||
analyzed: snehaḥ saukṣmyam prabhā śauklyam mārdavam gauravam ca yat śaityam rakṣā pavitra tvam saṃdhānam ca audakāḥ guṇāḥ

original: taijasā dharmāḥ ---
analyzed: taijasāḥ dharmāḥ

original: "ūrdhvabhāk pācakaṃ dagdhṛ pāvakaṃ laghu bhāsvaram| pradhvaṃsy ojasvi vai tejaḥ pūrvābhyāṃ bhinnalakṣaṇam"||
analyzed: ūrdhva bhāj pācakam dagdhṛ pāvakam laghu bhāsvaram pradhvaṃsi ojasvi vai tejaḥ pūrvābhyām bhinna lakṣaṇam

original: vāyavīyā dharmāḥ ---
analyzed: vāyavīyāḥ dharmāḥ

original: "tiryagyānaṃ pavitratvam ākṣepo nodanaṃ balam| calamacchāyatā raukṣyaṃ vāyor dharmāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ"||
analyzed: tiryagyānam pavitra tvam ākṣepaḥ nodanam balam calamacchāya tā raukṣyam vāyoḥ dharmāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ

original: ākāśīyā dharmāḥ ---
analyzed: ākāśīyāḥ dharmāḥ

original: "sarvatogatir avyūho'viṣṭambhaś ceti te trayaḥ| ākāśadharmā vyākhyātāḥ pūrvadharmavilakṣaṇāḥ" iti||
analyzed: sarvatogatiḥ avyūhaḥ viṣṭambhaḥ ca iti te trayaḥ ākāśa dharmāḥ vyākhyātāḥ pūrva dharma vilakṣaṇāḥ iti

original: ta eta ākāraprabhṛtayo dharmās taiḥ saheti| ākāraś ca sāmānyaviśeṣo gotvādiḥ| dvitīyaṃ rūpam āha --- dvitīyaṃ rūpaṃ svasāmānyam| mūrtiḥ sāṃsiddhikaṃ kāṭhinyam| sneho jalaṃ mṛjāpuṣṭibalādhānahetuḥ| vahnir uṣṇatodarye saurye bhaume ca sarvatraiva tejasi samavetoṣṇateti| sarvaṃ caitad dharmadharmiṇor abhedavivakṣayābhidhānam|
analyzed: te ete ākāra prabhṛtayaḥ dharmāḥ taiḥ saha iti ākāraḥ ca sāmānya viśeṣaḥ go tva ādiḥ dvitīyam rūpam āha dvitīyam rūpam sva sāmānyam mūrtiḥ sāṃsiddhikam kāṭhinyam snehaḥ jalam mṛjā puṣṭi bala ādhāna hetuḥ vahniḥ uṣṇa tā udarye saurye bhaume ca sarvatra eva tejasi samaveta uṣṇa tā iti sarvam ca etat dharma dharmiṇoḥ abheda vivakṣayā abhidhānam

original: vāyuḥ praṇāmī vahanaśīlaḥ| tad āha ---
analyzed: vāyuḥ praṇāmī vahana śīlaḥ tat āha

original: "calanena tṛṇādīnāṃ śarīrasyāṭanena ca| sarvagaṃ vāyusāmānyaṃ nāmitvam anumīyate"||
analyzed: calanena tṛṇa ādīnām śarīrasya aṭanena ca sarvagam vāyu sāmānyam nāmi tvam anumīyate

original: sarvatogatir ākāśaḥ sarvatra śabdopalabdhidarśanāt| śrotrāśrayākāśaguṇena hi śabdena pārthivādiśabdopalabdhir ity upapāditam adhastāt| etat svarūpaśabdenoktam| asyaiva mūrtyādisāmānyasya śabdādayaḥ ṣaḍjādaya uṣṇatvādayaḥ śuklatvādayaḥ kaṣāyatvādayaḥ surabhitvādayo mūrtyādīnāṃ sāmānyānāṃ bhedāḥ|
analyzed: sarvatas gatiḥ ākāśaḥ sarvatra śabda upalabdhi darśanāt śrotra āśraya ākāśa guṇena hi śabdena pārthiva ādi śabda upalabdhiḥ iti upapāditam adhastāt etat svarūpa śabdena uktam asya eva mūrti ādi sāmānyasya śabda ādayaḥ ṣaḍja ādayaḥ uṣṇa tva ādayaḥ śukla tva ādayaḥ kaṣāya tva ādayaḥ surabhi tva ādayaḥ mūrti ādīnām sāmānyānām bhedāḥ

original: sāmānyāny api mūrtyādīni jambīrapanasāmalakaphalādīni rasādibhedāt parasparaṃ vyāvartante| tenaiteṣām ete rasādayo viśeṣāḥ| tathā coktam --- ekajātisamanvitānāṃ pratyekaṃ pṛthivyādīnām ekaikayā jātyā mūrtisnehādinā samanvitānām eṣāṃ ṣaḍjādidharmamātravyāvṛttir iti| tad evaṃ sāmānyaṃ mūrtyādy uktaṃ viśeṣāś ca śabdādaya uktāḥ|
analyzed: sāmānyāni api mūrti ādīni jambīra panasa āmalaka phala ādīni rasa ādi bhedāt parasparam vyāvartante tena eteṣām ete rasa ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ tathā ca uktam eka jāti samanvitānām pratyekam pṛthivī ādīnām ekaikayā jātyā mūrti sneha ādinā samanvitānām eṣām ṣaḍja ādi dharma mātra vyāvṛttiḥ iti tat evam sāmānyam mūrti ādi uktam viśeṣāḥ ca śabda ādayaḥ uktāḥ

original: ye cāhuḥ sāmānyaviśeṣāśrayo dravyam iti tān pratyāha --- sāmānyaviśeṣasamudāyo'tra darśane dravyam| ye'pi tadāśrayo dravyam āsthiṣata tair api tatsamudāyo'nubhūyamāno nāpahnotavyaḥ| na ca tadapahnave tayor ādhāro dravyam iti bhavati| tasmāt tad evāstu dravyam| na tu tābhyāṃ tatsamudāyāc ca tadādhāram aparaṃ dravyam upalabhāmahe|
analyzed: ye ca āhuḥ sāmānya viśeṣa āśrayaḥ dravyam iti tān pratyāha sāmānya viśeṣa samudāyaḥ utra darśane dravyam ye api tad āśrayaḥ dravyam āsthiṣata taiḥ api tad samudāyaḥ unubhūyamānaḥ na apahnotavyaḥ na ca tad apahnave tayoḥ ādhāraḥ dravyam iti bhavati tasmāt tat eva astu dravyam na tu tābhyām tad samudāyāt ca tad ādhāram aparam dravyam upalabhāmahe

original: grāvabhyo grāvasamudāyād iva ca tadādhāram aparaṃ pṛthagvidhaṃ śikharam| samūho dravyam ity uktaṃ tatra samūhamātraṃ dravyam iti bhramāpanuttaye samūhaviśeṣo dravyam iti nirdhārayituṃ samūhaprakārān āha --- dviṣṭho hīti| yasmād evaṃ tasmān na samūhamātraṃ dravyam ity arthaḥ| dvābhyāṃ prakārābhyāṃ tiṣṭhatīti dviṣṭhaḥ|
analyzed: grāvabhyaḥ grāva samudāyāt iva ca tad ādhāram aparam pṛthagvidham śikharam samūhaḥ dravyam iti uktam tatra samūha mātram dravyam iti bhrama apanuttaye samūha viśeṣaḥ dravyam iti nirdhārayitum samūha prakārān āha dviṣṭhaḥ hi iti yasmāt evam tasmāt na samūha mātram dravyam iti arthaḥ dvābhyām prakārābhyām tiṣṭhati iti dviṣṭhaḥ

original: ekaṃ prakāram āha --- pratyastamiteti| pratyastamito bhedo yeṣām avayavānāṃ te tathoktāḥ| pratyastamitabhedā avayavā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- śarīravṛkṣayūthavanaśabdebhyaḥ samūhaḥ pratīyamāno'pratītāvayavabhedas tadvācakaśabdāprayogāt samūha eko'vagamyata iti| yutāyutasiddhāvayavatvena cetanācetanatvena codāharaṇacatuṣṭayam|
analyzed: ekam prakāram āha pratyastamita iti pratyastamitaḥ bhedaḥ yeṣām avayavānām te tathā uktāḥ pratyastamita bhedāḥ avayavāḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ etat uktam bhavati śarīra vṛkṣa yūtha vana śabdebhyaḥ samūhaḥ pratīyamāna upratīta avayava bhedaḥ tad vācaka śabda aprayogāt samūhaḥ ekaḥ avagamyate iti yuta ayuta siddha avayava tvena cetana acetana tvena ca udāharaṇa catuṣṭayam

original: yutāyutasiddhāvayavatvaṃ cāgre vakṣyate| dvitīyaṃ prakāram āha --- śabdenopāttabhedāvayavānugataḥ samūha ubhaye devamanuṣyā iti| devamanuṣyā iti hi śabdenobhayaśabdavācyasya samūhasya bhāgau bhinnāv upāttau| nanūbhayaśabdāt tāvad avayavabhedo na pratīyate tat katham upāttabhedāvayavānugata ity ata āha --- tābhyāṃ bhāgābhyām eva samūho'bhidhīyate|
analyzed: yuta ayuta siddha avayava tvam ca agre vakṣyate dvitīyam prakāram āha śabdena upātta bheda avayava anugataḥ samūhaḥ ubhaye deva manuṣyāḥ iti deva manuṣyāḥ iti hi śabdena ubhaya śabda vācyasya samūhasya bhāgau bhinnau upāttau nanu ubhaya śabdāt tāvat avayava bhedaḥ na pratīyate tat katham upātta bheda avayava anugataḥ iti atas āha tābhyām bhāgābhyām eva samūhaḥ abhidhīyate

original: ubhayaśabdena bhāgadvayavāciśabdasahitena samūho vācyaḥ, vākyasya vākyārthavācakatvād iti bhāvaḥ| punar dvaividhyam āha --- sa ceti| bhedena cābhedena ca vivakṣitaḥ| bhedavivakṣitam āha --- āmrāṇāṃ vanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ saṃgha iti| bheda eva ṣaṣṭhīśruteḥ, yathā gargāṇāṃ gaur iti| abhedavivakṣitam āha --- āmravaṇaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃgha iti|
analyzed: ubhaya śabdena bhāga dvaya vāci śabda sahitena samūhaḥ vācyaḥ vākyasya vākya artha vācaka tvāt iti bhāvaḥ punar dvaividhyam āha sa ca iti bhedena ca abhedena ca vivakṣitaḥ bheda vivakṣitam āha āmrāṇām vanam brāhmaṇānām saṃghaḥ iti bhedaḥ eva ṣaṣṭhī śruteḥ yathā gargāṇām gauḥ iti abheda vivakṣitam āha āmravaṇam brāhmaṇa saṃghaḥ iti

original: āmrāś ca te vanaṃ ceti samūhasamūhinor abhedaṃ vivakṣitvā sāmānādhikaraṇyam ity arthaḥ| vidhāntaram āha --- sa punar dvividhaḥ| yutasiddhāvayavaḥ samūhaḥ| yutasiddhāḥ pṛthaksiddhāḥ sāntarālā avayavā yasya sa tathoktaḥ, yūthaṃ vanam iti| sāntarālā hi tadavayavā vṛkṣāś ca gāvaś ca| ayutasiddhāvayavaś ca samūho vṛkṣo gauḥ paramāṇur iti|
analyzed: āmrāḥ ca te vanam ca iti samūha samūhinoḥ abhedam vivakṣitvā sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti arthaḥ vidhā antaram āha sa punar dvividhaḥ yuta siddha avayavaḥ samūhaḥ yuta siddhāḥ pṛthak siddhāḥ sa antarālāḥ avayavāḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ yūtham vanam iti sa antarālāḥ hi tad avayavāḥ vṛkṣāḥ ca gāvaḥ ca ayuta siddha avayavaḥ ca samūhaḥ vṛkṣaḥ gauḥ paramāṇuḥ iti

original: nirantarā hi tadavayavāḥ sāmānyaviśeṣā vā sāsnādayo veti| tad eteṣu samūheṣu dravyabhūtaṃ samūhaṃ nirdhārayati --- ayutasiddheti| tad evaṃ prāsaṅgikaṃ dravyaṃ vyutpādya prakṛtam upasaṃharati --- etat svarūpam ity uktam iti| tṛtīyaṃ rūpaṃ vivakṣuḥ pṛcchati --- atheti| uttaram āha --- tanmātram iti|
analyzed: nirantarāḥ hi tad avayavāḥ sāmānya viśeṣāḥ vā sāsnā ādayaḥ vā iti tat eteṣu samūheṣu dravya bhūtam samūham nirdhārayati ayuta siddha iti tat evam prāsaṅgikam dravyam vyutpādya prakṛtam upasaṃharati etat svarūpam iti uktam iti tṛtīyam rūpam vivakṣuḥ pṛcchati atha iti uttaram āha tanmātram iti

original: tasyaiko'vayavaḥ parimāṇabhedaḥ paramāṇuḥ, sāmānyaṃ mūrtiḥ, śabdādayo viśeṣās tadātmā, ayutasiddhā nirantarā ye'vayavāḥ sāmānyaviśeṣās tadbhedeṣv anugataḥ samudāyaḥ| yathā ca paramāṇuḥ sūkṣmaṃ rūpam evaṃ sarvatanmātrāṇi sūkṣmaṃ rūpam iti| upasaṃharati --- etad iti|
analyzed: tasya ekaḥ avayavaḥ parimāṇa bhedaḥ paramāṇuḥ sāmānyam mūrtiḥ śabda ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ tad ātmā ayuta siddhāḥ nirantarāḥ yevayavāḥ sāmānya viśeṣāḥ tad bhedeṣu anugataḥ samudāyaḥ yathā ca paramāṇuḥ sūkṣmam rūpam evam sarva tanmātrāṇi sūkṣmam rūpam iti upasaṃharati etat iti

original: atha bhūtānāṃ caturthaṃ rūpaṃ khyātikriyāsthitiśīlā guṇāḥ kāryasvabhāvam anupatitum anugantuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| ata evānvayaśabdenoktāḥ| athaiṣāṃ pañcamaṃ rūpam arthavattvaṃ vivṛṇoti --- bhogeti| nanv evam api santu guṇā arthavantas tatkāryāṇāṃ tu kuto'rthavattvam ity ata āha --- guṇā iti| bhautikā goghaṭādayaḥ|
analyzed: atha bhūtānām caturtham rūpam khyāti kriyā sthiti śīlāḥ guṇāḥ kārya svabhāvam anupatitum anugantum śīlam yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ atas eva anvaya śabdena uktāḥ atha eṣām pañcamam rūpam arthavattvam vivṛṇoti bhoga iti nanu evam api santu guṇāḥ arthavantaḥ tad kāryāṇām tu kutas arthavat tvam iti atas āha guṇāḥ iti bhautikāḥ go ghaṭa ādayaḥ

original: tad evaṃ saṃyamaviṣayam uktvā saṃyamaṃ tatphalaṃ cāha --- teṣv iti| bhūtaprakṛtayo bhūtasvabhāvāḥ||3.44||
analyzed: tat evam saṃyama viṣayam uktvā saṃyamam tad phalam ca āha teṣu iti bhūta prakṛtayaḥ bhūta svabhāvāḥ

original: tato'ṇimādiprādurbhāvaḥ kāyasaṃpat taddharmānabhighātaś ca||3.45||
analyzed: tatas ūṇima ādi prādurbhāvaḥ kāya saṃpad tad dharma anabhighātaḥ ca

original: saṃkalpānuvidhāne bhūtānāṃ kiṃ yoginaḥ sidhyatīty ata āha --- tato'ṇimādiprādurbhāvaḥ kāyasaṃpat taddharmānabhighātaś ca| sthūlasaṃyamajayāc catasraḥ siddhayo bhavantīty āha --- tatrāṇimā mahān api bhavaty aṇuḥ| laghimā mahān api laghur bhūtveṣīkātūla ivākāśe viharati| mahimālpo'pi nāganagagaganaparimāṇo bhavati|
analyzed: saṃkalpa anuvidhāne bhūtānām kim yoginaḥ sidhyati iti atas āha tatas ūṇima ādi prādurbhāvaḥ kāya saṃpad tad dharma anabhighātaḥ ca sthūla saṃyama jayāt catasraḥ siddhayaḥ bhavanti iti āha tatra aṇimā mahān api bhavati aṇuḥ laghimā mahān api laghuḥ bhūtvā iṣīkā tūle iva ākāśe viharati mahimā alpaḥ api nāga naga gagana parimāṇaḥ bhavati

original: prāptiḥ sarve bhāvāḥ saṃnihitā bhavanti yoginaḥ| tadyathā bhūmiṣṭha evāṅgulyagreṇa spṛśati candramasam| svarūpasaṃyamavijayāt siddhim āha --- prākāmyam icchānabhighāto nāsya rūpaṃ bhūtasvarūpair mūrtyādibhir hanyate| bhūmāv unmajjati nimajjati ca yathodake|
analyzed: prāptiḥ sarve bhāvāḥ saṃnihitāḥ bhavanti yoginaḥ tat yathā bhūmiṣṭhaḥ eva aṅguli agreṇa spṛśati candramasam sva rūpa saṃyama vijayāt siddhim āha prākāmyam icchā anabhighātaḥ na asya rūpam bhūta svarūpaiḥ mūrti ādibhiḥ hanyate bhūmau unmajjati nimajjati ca yathā udake

original: sūkṣmaviṣayasaṃyamajayāt siddhim āha --- vaśitvaṃ bhūtāni pṛthivyādīni bhautikāni goghaṭādīni teṣu vaśī svatantro bhavati, teṣāṃ tv avaśyas tatkāraṇatanmātrapṛthivyādiparamāṇuvaśīkārāt tatkāryavaśīkāras tena yāni yathāvasthāpayati tāni tathāvatiṣṭhanta ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: sūkṣma viṣaya saṃyama jayāt siddhim āha vaśitvam bhūtāni pṛthivī ādīni bhautikāni go ghaṭa ādīni teṣu vaśī svatantraḥ bhavati teṣām tu avaśyaḥ tad kāraṇa tanmātra pṛthivī ādi paramāṇu vaśīkārāt tad kārya vaśīkāraḥ tena yāni yathā avasthāpayati tāni tathā avatiṣṭhante iti arthaḥ

original: anvayaviṣayasaṃyamajayāt siddhim āha --- īśitṛtvaṃ teṣāṃ bhūtabhautikānāṃ vijitamūlaprakṛtiḥ san yaḥ prabhava utpādo yaś cāpyayo vināśo yaś ca vyūho yathāvadavasthāpanaṃ teṣāṃ īṣṭe| arthavattvasaṃyamāt siddhim āha --- yatra kāmāvasāyitvaṃ satyasaṃkalpatā| vijitaguṇārthavattvo hi yogī yadyadarthatayā saṃkalpayati tat tasmai prayojanāya kalpate|
analyzed: anvaya viṣaya saṃyama jayāt siddhim āha īśitṛ tvam teṣām bhūta bhautikānām vijita mūlaprakṛtiḥ san yaḥ prabhavaḥ utpādaḥ yaḥ ca apyayaḥ vināśaḥ yaḥ ca vyūhaḥ yathāvat avasthāpanam teṣām īṣṭe arthavat tva saṃyamāt siddhim āha yatra kāmāvasāyi tvam satya saṃkalpa tā vijita guṇa arthavat tvaḥ hi yogī yat yat artha tayā saṃkalpayati tat tasmai prayojanāya kalpate

original: viṣam apy amṛtakārye saṃkalpya bhojayañ jīvayatīti| syād etad yathā śaktiviparyāsaṃ karoty evaṃ padārthaviparyāsam api kasmān na karoti| tathā ca candramasam ādityaṃ kuryāt kuhūṃ ca sinīvālīm ity ata āha --- na ca śakto'pīti| na khalv ete yatra kāmāvasāyinas tatrabhavataḥ parameśvarasyājñām atikramitum utsahante|
analyzed: viṣam api amṛta kārye saṃkalpya bhojayan jīvayati iti syāt etat yathā śakti viparyāsam karoti evam padārtha viparyāsam api kasmāt na karoti tathā ca candramasam ādityam kuryāt kuhūm ca sinīvālīm iti atas āha na ca śaktaḥ upi iti na khalu ete yatra kāmāvasāyinaḥ tatrabhavataḥ parameśvarasya ājñām atikramitum utsahante

original: śaktayas tu padārthānāṃ jātideśakālāvasthābhedenāniyatasvabhāvā iti yujyate tāsu tadicchānuvidhānam iti| etāny aṣṭāv aiśvaryāṇi| taddharmānabhighāta iti| aṇimādiprādurbhāva ity anenaiva taddharmānabhighātasiddhau punar upādānaṃ kāyasiddhivad etat sūtropabaddhasakalaviṣayasaṃyamaphalavattvajñāpanāya| sugamam anyat||3.45||
analyzed: śaktayaḥ tu padārthānām jāti deśa kāla avasthā bhedena aniyata svabhāvāḥ iti yujyate tāsu tad icchā anuvidhānam iti etāni aṣṭau aiśvaryāṇi tad dharma anabhighāte iti aṇima ādi prādurbhāvaḥ iti anena eva tad dharma anabhighāta siddhau punar upādānam kāya siddhi vat etat sūtra upabaddha sakala viṣaya saṃyama phalavat tva jñāpanāya sugamam anyat

original: rūpalāvaṇyabalavajrasaṃhananatvāni kāyasaṃpat||3.46||
analyzed: rūpa lāvaṇya bala vajra saṃhanana tvāni kāya saṃpad

original: kāyasaṃpadam āha --- rūpalāvaṇyabalavajrasaṃhananatvāni kāyasaṃpat| vajrasyeva saṃhananam avayavavyūho dṛḍho nibiḍo yasya sa tathoktaḥ||3.46||
analyzed: kāya saṃpadam āha rūpa lāvaṇya bala vajra saṃhanana tvāni kāya saṃpad vajrasya iva saṃhananam avayava vyūhaḥ dṛḍhaḥ nibiḍaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ

original: grahaṇasvarūpāsmitānvayārthavattvasaṃyamād indriyajayaḥ||3.47||

jitabhūtasya yogina indriyajayopāyam āha --- grahaṇasvarūpāsmitānvayārthavattvasaṃyamād indriyajayaḥ| grahaṇaṃ ca svarūpaṃ cāsmitā cānvayaś cārthavattvaṃ ca teṣu saṃyamas tasmād ity arthaḥ| gṛhītir grahaṇaṃ, tac ca grāhyādhīnanirūpaṇam iti grāhyaṃ darśayati --- sāmānyaviśeṣātmeti| grāhyam uktvā grahaṇam āha --- teṣv iti|
analyzed: jita bhūtasya yoginaḥ indriya jaya upāyam āha grahaṇa svarūpa asmitā anvaya arthavattva saṃyamāt indriya jayaḥ grahaṇam ca svarūpam ca asmitā ca anvayaḥ ca arthavattvam ca teṣu saṃyamaḥ tasmāt iti arthaḥ gṛhītiḥ grahaṇam tat ca grāhya adhīna nirūpaṇam iti grāhyam darśayati sāmānya viśeṣa ātmā iti grāhyam uktvā grahaṇam āha teṣu iti

original: vṛttir ālocanaṃ viṣayākārā pariṇatir iti yāvat| ye tv āhuḥ --- sāmānyamātragocarendriyavṛttir iti tān pratyāha --- na ceti| gṛhyata iti grahaṇam| na sāmānyamātragocaraṃ grahaṇam| bāhyendriyatantraṃ hi mano bāhye pravartate| anyathāndhabadhirādyabhāvaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: vṛttiḥ ālocanam viṣaya ākārā pariṇatiḥ iti yāvat ye tu āhuḥ sāmānya mātra gocara indriya vṛttiḥ iti tān pratyāha na ca iti gṛhyate iti grahaṇam na sāmānya mātra gocaram grahaṇam bāhya indriya tantram hi manaḥ bāhye pravartate anyathā andha badhira ādi abhāva prasaṅgāt

original: tad iha yadi na viśeṣaviṣayam indriyaṃ tenāsāv anālocito viśeṣa iti kathaṃ manasānuvyavasīyeta| tasmāt sāmānyaviśeṣaviṣayam indriyālocanam iti| tad etad grahaṇam indriyāṇāṃ prathamaṃ rūpam| dvitīyaṃ rūpam āha --- svarūpaṃ punar iti| ahaṃkāro hi sattvabhāgenātmīyenendriyāṇy ajījanat|
analyzed: tat iha yadi na viśeṣa viṣayam indriyam tena asau anālocitaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti katham manasā anuvyavasīyeta tasmāt sāmānya viśeṣa viṣayam indriya ālocanam iti tat etat grahaṇam indriyāṇām prathamam rūpam dvitīyam rūpam āha svarūpam punar iti ahaṃkāraḥ hi sattva bhāgena ātmīyena indriyāṇi ajījanat

original: ato yat tatra karaṇatvaṃ sāmānyaṃ yac ca niyatarūpādiviṣayatvaṃ viśeṣas tadubhayam api prakāśātmakam ity arthaḥ| teṣāṃ tṛtīyaṃ rūpam iti| ahaṃkāro hīndriyāṇāṃ kāraṇam iti yatrendriyāṇi tatra tena bhavitavyam iti sarvendriyasādhāraṇyāt sāmānyam indriyāṇām ity arthaḥ| caturthaṃ rūpam iti|
analyzed: atas yat tatra karaṇa tvam sāmānyam yat ca niyata rūpa ādi viṣaya tvam viśeṣaḥ tat ubhayam api prakāśa ātmakam iti arthaḥ teṣām tṛtīyam rūpam iti ahaṃkāraḥ hi indriyāṇām kāraṇam iti yatra indriyāṇi tatra tena bhavitavyam iti sarva indriya sādhāraṇyāt sāmānyam indriyāṇām iti arthaḥ caturtham rūpam iti

original: guṇānāṃ hi dvairūpyaṃ vyavaseyātmakatvaṃ vyavasāyātmakatvaṃ ca| tatra vyavaseyātmakatāṃ grāhyatām āsthāya pañca tanmātrāṇi bhūtabhautikāni nirmimīte| vyavasāyātmakatvaṃ tu grahaṇarūpam āsthāya sāhaṃkārāṇīndriyāṇīty arthaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam||3.47||
analyzed: guṇānām hi dvairūpyam vyavaseya ātmaka tvam vyavasāya ātmaka tvam ca tatra vyavaseya ātmaka tām grāhya tām āsthāya pañca tanmātrāṇi bhūta bhautikāni nirmimīte vyavasāya ātmaka tvam tu grahaṇa rūpam āsthāya sa ahaṃkārāṇi indriyāṇi iti arthaḥ śeṣam sugamam

original: tato manojavitvaṃ vikaraṇabhāvaḥ pradhānajayaś ca||3.48||
analyzed: tatas manojavi tvam vikaraṇa bhāvaḥ pradhāna jayaḥ ca

original: pañcarūpendriyajayāt siddhīr āha --- tato manojavitvaṃ vikaraṇabhāvaḥ pradhānajayaś ca| videhānām indriyāṇāṃ karaṇabhāvo vikaraṇabhāvaḥ| deśaḥ kāśmīrādiḥ| kālo 'tītādiḥ| viṣayaḥ sūkṣmādiḥ| sānvayendriyajayāt sarvaprakṛtivikāravaśitvaṃ pradhānajayaḥ| tā etāḥ siddhayo madhupratīkā ity ucyante yogaśāstraniṣṇātaiḥ|
analyzed: pañca rūpa indriya jayāt siddhīḥ āha tatas manojavi tvam vikaraṇa bhāvaḥ pradhāna jayaḥ ca videhānām indriyāṇām karaṇa bhāvaḥ vikaraṇa bhāvaḥ deśaḥ kāśmīra ādiḥ viṣayaḥ sūkṣma ādiḥ sa anvaya indriya jayāt sarva prakṛti vikāra vaśitvam pradhāna jayaḥ tāḥ etāḥ siddhayaḥ madhupratīkāḥ iti ucyante yoga śāstra niṣṇātaiḥ

original: syād etad indriyajayād indriyāṇi saviṣayāṇi vaśyāni bhavantu, pradhānādīnāṃ tatkāraṇānāṃ kim āyātam ity ata āha --- etāś ceti| karaṇānām indriyāṇāṃ pañca rūpāṇi grahaṇādīni teṣāṃ jayāt| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- nendriyamātrajayasyaitāḥ siddhayo'pi tu pañcarūpasya tadantargataṃ ca pradhānādīti||3.48||
analyzed: syāt etat indriya jayāt indriyāṇi sa viṣayāṇi vaśyāni bhavantu pradhāna ādīnām tad kāraṇānām kim āyātam iti atas āha etāḥ ca iti karaṇānām indriyāṇām pañca rūpāṇi grahaṇa ādīni teṣām jayāt etat uktam bhavati na indriya mātra jayasya etāḥ siddhayaḥ api tu pañca rūpasya tad antargatam ca pradhāna ādi iti

original: sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātimātrasya sarvabhāvādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ sarvajñātṛtvaṃ ca||3.49||
analyzed: sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātrasya sarva bhāva adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam sarvajñātṛ tvam ca

original: ta ete jñānakriyārūpaiśvaryahetavaḥ saṃyamāḥ sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa ca svasiddhyupasaṃhārasaṃpāditaśraddhādvāreṇa yadarthās tasyāḥ sattvapuruṣānyatākhyāter avāntaravibhūtīr darśayati --- sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātimātrasya sarvabhāvādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ sarvajñātṛtvaṃ ca|
analyzed: te ete jñāna kriyā rūpa aiśvarya hetavaḥ saṃyamāḥ sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa ca sva siddhi upasaṃhāra saṃpādita śraddhā dvāreṇa yad arthāḥ tasyāḥ sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāteḥ avāntara vibhūtīḥ darśayati sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātrasya sarva bhāva adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam sarvajñātṛ tvam ca

original: nirdhūtarajastamomalatayā vaiśāradyaṃ tataḥ parā vaśīkārasaṃjñā rajastamobhyām upaplutaṃ hi cittasattvam avaśyam āsīt tadupaśame tu tadvaśyaṃ yogino vaśinas tasmin vaśye yoginaḥ sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātimātrarūpapratiṣṭhasya sarvabhāvādhiṣṭhātṛtvam| etad eva vivṛṇoti --- sarvātmāna iti| vyavasāyavyavaseyātmāno jaḍaprakāśarūpā ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: nirdhūta rajaḥ tamaḥ mala tayā vaiśāradyam tatas parā vaśīkāra saṃjñā rajaḥ tamobhyām upaplutam hi citta sattvam avaśyam āsīt tad upaśame tu tat vaśyam yoginaḥ vaśinaḥ tasmin vaśye yoginaḥ sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātra rūpa pratiṣṭhasya sarva bhāva adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam etat eva vivṛṇoti sarva ātmānaḥ iti vyavasāya vyavaseya ātmānaḥ jaḍa prakāśa rūpāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tad anena kriyaiśvaryam uktam| jñānaiśvaryam āha --- sarvajñātṛtvam iti| asyā api dvividhāyāḥ siddher vairāgyāya yogijanaprasiddhāṃ saṃjñām āha --- eṣā viśoketi| kleśāś ca bandhanāni ca karmāṇi tāni kṣīṇāni yasya sa tathā||3.49||
analyzed: tat anena kriyā aiśvaryam uktam jñāna aiśvaryam āha sarvajñātṛ tvam iti asyāḥ api dvividhāyāḥ siddheḥ vairāgyāya yogi jana prasiddhām saṃjñām āha eṣā viśokā iti kleśāḥ ca bandhanāni ca karmāṇi tāni kṣīṇāni yasya sa tathā

original: tadvairāgyād api doṣabījakṣaye kaivalyam||3.50||
analyzed: tad vairāgyāt api doṣa bīja kṣaye kaivalyam

original: saṃyamāntarāṇāṃ puruṣārthābhāsaphalatvād vivekakhyātisaṃyamārthatāṃ darśayituṃ vivekakhyāteḥ paravairāgyopajananadvāreṇa kaivalyaṃ phalam āha --- tadvairāgyād api doṣabījakṣaye kaivalyam| yadāsya yoginaḥ kleśakarmakṣaya evaṃ jñānaṃ bhavati| kiṃbhūtam ity āha --- sattvasyāyaṃ vivekapratyayo dharmaḥ| śeṣaṃ tatra tatra vyākhyātatvāt sugamam||3.50||
analyzed: saṃyama antarāṇām puruṣa artha ābhāsa phala tvāt viveka khyāti saṃyama artha tām darśayitum viveka khyāteḥ para vairāgya upajanana dvāreṇa kaivalyam phalam āha tad vairāgyāt api doṣa bīja kṣaye kaivalyam yadā asya yoginaḥ kleśa karma kṣaye evam jñānam bhavati kiṃbhūtam iti āha sattvasya ayam viveka pratyayaḥ dharmaḥ śeṣam tatra tatra vyākhyāta tvāt sugamam

original: sthānyupanimantraṇe saṅgasmayākaraṇaṃ punar aniṣṭaprasaṅgāt||3.51||
analyzed: sthāni upanimantraṇe saṅga smayā akaraṇam punar aniṣṭa prasaṅgāt

original: saṃprati kaivalyasādhane pravṛttasya yoginaḥ pratyūhasaṃbhave tannirākaraṇakāraṇam upadiśati --- sthānyupanimantraṇe saṅgasmayākaraṇaṃ punar aniṣṭaprasaṅgāt| sthānāni yeṣāṃ santi te sthānino mahendrādayas tair upanimantraṇaṃ tasmin saṅgaś ca smayaś ca na kartavyaḥ punar aniṣṭaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: saṃprati kaivalya sādhane pravṛttasya yoginaḥ pratyūha saṃbhave tad nirākaraṇa kāraṇam upadiśati sthāni upanimantraṇe saṅga smaya akaraṇam punar aniṣṭa prasaṅgāt sthānāni yeṣām santi te sthāninaḥ mahendra ādayaḥ taiḥ upanimantraṇam tasmin saṅgaḥ ca smayaḥ ca na kartavyaḥ punar aniṣṭa prasaṅgāt

original: tatra yaṃ devāḥ sthānair upamantrayante taṃ yoginam ekaṃ nirdhārayituṃ yāvanto yoginaḥ saṃbhavanti tāvata evāha --- catvāra iti| tatra prāthamakalpikasya svarūpam āha --- tatrābhyāsīti| pravṛttamātraṃ na punar vaśīkṛtaṃ jyotir jñānaṃ paracittādiviṣayaṃ yasya sa tathā| dvitīyam āha --- ṛtaṃbharaprajña iti|
analyzed: tatra yam devāḥ sthānaiḥ upamantrayante tam yoginam ekam nirdhārayitum yāvantaḥ yoginaḥ saṃbhavanti tāvataḥ eva āha catvāraḥ iti tatra prāthamakalpikasya svarūpam āha tatra abhyāsī iti pravṛtta mātram na punar vaśīkṛtam jyotiḥ jñānam para citta ādi viṣayam yasya sa tathā dvitīyam āha ṛtaṃbhara prajñaḥ iti

original: yatredam uktam --- "ṛtaṃbharā tatra prajñā" iti| sa hi bhūtendriyāṇi jigīṣuḥ| tṛtīyam āha --- bhūtendriyajayīti| tena hi sthūlādisaṃyamena grahaṇādisaṃyamena ca bhūtendriyāṇi jitāni|
analyzed: yatra idam uktam ṛtaṃbharā tatra prajñā iti sa hi bhūta indriyāṇi jigīṣuḥ tṛtīyam āha bhūta indriya jayī iti tena hi sthūla ādi saṃyamena grahaṇa ādi saṃyamena ca bhūta indriyāṇi jitāni

original: tam evāha --- sarveṣu bhāviteṣu niṣpāditeṣu bhūtendriyajayāt paracittādijñānādiṣu kṛtarakṣābandho yatas tebhyo na cyavate bhāvanīyeṣu niṣpādanīyeṣu viśokādiṣu paravairāgyaparyanteṣu kartavyasādhanavān puruṣaprayatnasya sādhanaviṣayasyaiva sādhyaniṣpādakatvāt| caturtham āha --- caturtha iti|
analyzed: tam eva āha sarveṣu bhāviteṣu niṣpāditeṣu bhūta indriya jayāt para citta ādi jñāna ādiṣu kṛta rakṣā bandhaḥ yatas tebhyaḥ na cyavate bhāvanīyeṣu niṣpādanīyeṣu viśoka ādiṣu para vairāgya paryanteṣu kartavya sādhanavān puruṣa prayatnasya sādhana viṣayasya eva sādhya niṣpādaka tvāt caturtham āha caturthaḥ iti

original: tasya hi bhagavato jīvanmuktasya caramadehasya cittapratisarga eko 'rthaḥ| tad eteṣu yogiṣūpanimantraṇaviṣayaṃ yoginam avadhārayati --- tatra madhumatīm iti| prāthamakalpike tāvan mahendrādīnāṃ tatprāptiśaṅkaiva nāsti| tṛtīyo'pi tair nopanimantraṇīyo bhūtendriyavaśitvenaiva tatprāpteḥ|
analyzed: tasya hi bhagavataḥ jīvanmuktasya carama dehasya citta pratisargaḥ ekaḥ rthaḥ tat eteṣu yogiṣu upanimantraṇa viṣayam yoginam avadhārayati tatra madhumatīm iti prāthamakalpike tāvat mahendra ādīnām tad prāpti śaṅkā eva na asti tṛtīyaḥ api taiḥ na upanimantraṇīyaḥ bhūta indriya vaśi tvena eva tad prāpteḥ

original: caturtho'pi paravairāgyasaṃpatter āsaṅgaśaṅkā dūrotsāritaiveti pāriśeṣyād dvitīya eva ṛtaṃbharaprajñas tadupanimantraṇaviṣaya iti| vaihāyasam ākāśagāmi, akṣayam avināśi, ajaraṃ sadābhinavam| smayakaraṇe doṣam āha --- smayād ayam iti| smayāt susthitaṃmanyo nānityatāṃ bhāvayiṣyati, na tasyāṃ praṇidhāsyatīty arthaḥ| sugamam anyat||3.51||
analyzed: caturthaḥ api para vairāgya saṃpatteḥ āsaṅga śaṅkā dūra utsāritā eva iti pāriśeṣyāt dvitīyaḥ eva ṛtaṃbhara prajñaḥ tad upanimantraṇa viṣayaḥ iti vaihāyasam ākāśa gāmi akṣayam avināśi ajaram sadā abhinavam smaya karaṇe doṣam āha smayāt ayam iti smayāt susthitaṃmanyaḥ na anitya tām bhāvayiṣyati na tasyām praṇidhāsyati iti arthaḥ sugamam anyat

original: kṣaṇatatkramayoḥ saṃyamād vivekajaṃ jñānam||3.52||

uktā kvacit kvacit saṃyamāt sarvajñatā, sā ca na niḥśeṣajñatā| api tu prakāramātravivakṣayā, yathā sarvair vyañjanair bhuktam iti| atra hi yāvanto vyañjanaprakārās tair bhuktam iti gamyate na tu niḥśeṣair iti| asti ca niḥśeṣavacanaḥ sarvaśabdo yathopanītam annaṃ sarvam aśitaṃ prāśakeneti| tatra hi niḥśeṣam iti gamyate|
analyzed: uktā kvacid kvacid saṃyamāt sarvajña tā sā ca na niḥśeṣa jña tā api tu prakāra mātra vivakṣayā yathā sarvaiḥ vyañjanaiḥ bhuktam iti atra hi yāvantaḥ vyañjana prakārāḥ taiḥ bhuktam iti gamyate na tu niḥśeṣaiḥ iti asti ca niḥśeṣa vacanaḥ sarva śabdaḥ yathā upanītam annam sarvam aśitam prāśakena iti tatra hi niḥśeṣam iti gamyate

original: tad iha niḥśeṣajñatālakṣaṇasya vivekajajñānasya sādhanaṃ saṃyamam āha --- kṣaṇatatkramayoḥ saṃyamād vivekajaṃ jñānam| kṣaṇapadārthaṃ nidarśanapūrvakam āha --- yatheti|
analyzed: tat iha niḥśeṣa jña tā lakṣaṇasya viveka ja jñānasya sādhanam saṃyamam āha kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ saṃyamāt viveka jam jñānam kṣaṇa padārtham nidarśana pūrvakam āha yathā iti

original: loṣṭasya hi pravibhajyamānasya yasminn avayave'lpatvatāratamyaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate so 'pakarṣaparyantaḥ paramāṇur yathā tathāpakarṣaparyantaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ, pūrvāparabhāgavikalakālakaleti yāvat| tam eva kṣaṇaṃ prakārāntareṇa darśayati --- yāvatā veti| paramāṇumātraṃ deśam atikrāmed ity arthaḥ| kramapadārtham āha --- tatpravāheti|
analyzed: loṣṭasya hi pravibhajyamānasya yasmin avayava ilpa tva tāratamyam vyavatiṣṭhate saḥ upakarṣa paryantaḥ paramāṇuḥ yathā tathā apakarṣa paryantaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ pūrva apara bhāga vikala kāla kalā iti yāvat tam eva kṣaṇam prakāra antareṇa darśayati yāvatā vā iti paramāṇu mātram deśam atikrāmet iti arthaḥ krama padārtham āha tad pravāha iti
