original: tatpadena kṣaṇaḥ parāmṛśyate| na cedṛśaḥ kramo vāstavaḥ kiṃ tu kālpanikas tasya samāhārarūpasyāyugapadupasthiteṣu vāstavatvena vicārāsahatvād ity āha --- kṣaṇatatkramayor iti|
analyzed: tad padena kṣaṇaḥ parāmṛśyate na ca īdṛśaḥ kramaḥ vāstavaḥ kim tu kālpanikaḥ tasya samāhāra rūpasya ayugapad upasthiteṣu vāstava tvena vicāra asaha tvāt iti āha kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ iti

original: ayugapadbhāvikṣaṇadharmatvāt kramasya kṣaṇasamāhārasyāvāstavatvāt kṣaṇatatkramayor apy avāstavatvaṃ samāhārasya naisargikavaitaṇḍikabuddhyatiśayarahitā laukikāḥ pratikṣaṇa eva vyutthitadarśanā bhrāntā ye kālam īdṛśaṃ vāstavam abhimanyanta iti| tat kiṃ kṣaṇo'py avāstavo nety āha --- kṣaṇas tu vastupatito vāstava ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: ayugapad bhāvi kṣaṇa dharma tvāt kramasya kṣaṇa samāhārasya avāstava tvāt kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ api avāstava tvam samāhārasya naisargika vaitaṇḍika buddhi atiśaya rahitāḥ laukikāḥ pratikṣaṇe eva vyutthita darśanāḥ bhrāntāḥ ye kālam īdṛśam vāstavam abhimanyante iti tat kim kṣaṇaḥ api avāstavaḥ na iti āha kṣaṇaḥ tu vastu patitaḥ vāstavaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kramasyāvalambanam avalambaḥ so'syāstīti krameṇāvalambyate vaikalpikenety arthaḥ| kramasya kṣaṇāvalambanatve hetum āha --- kramaś ceti| kramasyāvāstavatve hetum āha --- na ceti| co hetvarthe| yas tu vaijātyāt sahabhāvam upeyāt taṃ pratyāha --- kramaś ca na dvayor iti| kasmād asaṃbhava ity ata āha --- pūrvasmād iti| upasaṃharati --- tasmād iti|
analyzed: kramasya avalambanam avalambaḥ saḥ usya asti iti krameṇa avalambyate vaikalpikena iti arthaḥ kramasya kṣaṇa avalambana tve hetum āha kramaḥ ca iti kramasya avāstava tve hetum āha na ca iti hetu arthe yaḥ tu vaijātyāt sahabhāvam upeyāt tam pratyāha kramaḥ ca na dvayoḥ iti kasmāt asaṃbhavaḥ iti atas āha pūrvasmāt iti upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: tat kim idānīṃ śaśaviṣāṇāyamānā eva pūrvottarakṣaṇā nety āha --- ye tv iti| anvitāḥ sāmyena samanvāgatā ity arthaḥ| upasaṃharati --- teneti| vartamānasyaivārthakriyāsu svocitāsu sāmarthyād iti||3.52||
analyzed: tat kim idānīm śaśaviṣāṇāyamānāḥ eva pūrva uttara kṣaṇāḥ na iti āha ye tu iti anvitāḥ sāmyena samanvāgatāḥ iti arthaḥ upasaṃharati tena iti vartamānasya eva arthakriyāsu sva ucitāsu sāmarthyāt iti

original: jātilakṣaṇadeśair anyatānavacchedāt tulyayos tataḥ pratipattiḥ||3.53||
analyzed: jāti lakṣaṇa deśaiḥ anyatā anavacchedāt tulyayoḥ tatas pratipattiḥ

original: yady apy etad vivekajaṃ jñānaṃ niḥśeṣabhāvaviṣayam ity agre vakṣyate tathāpy atisūkṣmatvāt prathamaṃ tasya viṣayaviśeṣa upakṣipyate --- jātilakṣaṇadeśair anyatānavacchedāt tulyayos tataḥ pratipattiḥ| laukikānāṃ jātibhedo'nyatāyā jñāpakahetuḥ| tulyā jātir gotvaṃ tulyaś ca deśaḥ pūrvādiḥ| kālākṣīsvastimatyor lakṣaṇabhedaḥ param iti|
analyzed: yadi api etat viveka jam jñānam niḥśeṣa bhāva viṣayam iti agre vakṣyate tathā api ati sūkṣma tvāt prathamam tasya viṣaya viśeṣaḥ upakṣipyate jāti lakṣaṇa deśaiḥ anyatā anavacchedāt tulyayoḥ tatas pratipattiḥ laukikānām jāti bhedaḥ nyatāyāḥ jñāpaka hetuḥ tulyā jātiḥ go tvam tulyaḥ ca deśaḥ pūrva ādiḥ kālākṣī svastimatyoḥ lakṣaṇa bhedaḥ param iti

original: dvayor āmalakayos tulyāmalakatvajātir vartulādi lakṣaṇaṃ tulyaṃ deśabhedaḥ param iti| yadā tu yogijñānaṃ jijñāsunā kenacit pūrvāmalakam anyavyagrasya yogino jñātur uttaradeśa upāvartyata uttaradeśam āmalakaṃ tato'pasārya pidhāya vā tadā tulyadeśatve pūrvam etad uttaram etad iti pravibhāgānupapattiḥ prājñasya laukikasya
analyzed: dvayoḥ āmalakayoḥ tulya āmalaka tva jātiḥ vartula ādi lakṣaṇam tulyam deśa bhedaḥ param iti yadā tu yogi jñānam jijñāsunā kenacid pūrva āmalakam anya vyagrasya yoginaḥ jñātuḥ uttara deśe upāvartyate uttara deśam āmalakam tatā upasārya pidhāya vā tadā tulya deśa tve pūrvam etat uttaram etat iti pravibhāga anupapattiḥ prājñasya laukikasya

original: tripramāṇīnipuṇasyāsaṃdigdhena ca tattvajñānena bhavitavyaṃ vivekajajñānavato yoginaḥ saṃdigdhatvānupapatteḥ| ata uktaṃ sūtrakṛtā --- tataḥ pratipattiḥ| tata iti vyācaṣṭe --- vivekajajñānād iti| kṣaṇatatkramasaṃyamāj jātaṃ jñānaṃ katham āmalakaṃ tulyajātilakṣaṇadeśād āmalakāntarād vivecayatīti pṛcchati --- katham iti|
analyzed: tri pramāṇī nipuṇasya asaṃdigdhena ca tattva jñānena bhavitavyam viveka ja jñānavataḥ yoginaḥ saṃdigdha tva anupapatteḥ atas uktam sūtra kṛtā tatas pratipattiḥ tatas iti vyācaṣṭe viveka ja jñānāt iti kṣaṇa tad krama saṃyamāt jātam jñānam katham āmalakam tulya jāti lakṣaṇa deśāt āmalaka antarāt vivecayati iti pṛcchati katham iti

original: uttaram āha --- pūrvāmalakasahakṣaṇo deśaḥ pūrvāmalakenaikakṣaṇo deśas tena saha nirantarapariṇāma iti yāvat| uttarāmalakasahakṣaṇād deśād uttarāmalakanirantarapariṇāmād bhinno bhavatu deśayor bhedaḥ kim āyātam āmalakabhedasyety ata āha --- te cāmalake svadeśakṣaṇānubhavabhinne, svadeśasahito yaḥ kṣaṇas tasyāmalakasya kālakalā svadeśena
analyzed: uttaram āha pūrva āmalaka sahakṣaṇaḥ deśaḥ pūrva āmalakena eka kṣaṇaḥ deśaḥ tena saha nirantara pariṇāmaḥ iti yāvat uttara āmalaka sahakṣaṇāt deśāt uttara āmalaka nirantara pariṇāmāt bhinnaḥ bhavatu deśayoḥ bhedaḥ kim āyātam āmalaka bhedasya iti atas āha te ca āmalake sva deśa kṣaṇa anubhava bhinne sva deśa sahitaḥ yaḥ kṣaṇaḥ tasya āmalakasya kāla kalā sva deśena

original: sahauttarādharyarūpapariṇāmalakṣitā sā svadeśakṣaṇas tasyānubhavaḥ prāptir vā jñānaṃ vā tena bhinne āmalake yayor āmalakayoḥ pūrvottarābhyāṃ deśābhyām auttarādharyapariṇāmakṣaṇa āsīt tayor deśāntarauttarādharyapariṇāmakṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvam anubhavan saṃyamī te bhinne eva pratyeti|
analyzed: saha auttarādharya rūpa pariṇāma lakṣitā sā sva deśa kṣaṇaḥ tasya anubhavaḥ prāptiḥ vā jñānam vā tena bhinne āmalake yayoḥ āmalakayoḥ pūrva uttarābhyām deśābhyām auttarādharya pariṇāma kṣaṇaḥ āsīt tayoḥ deśa antara auttarādharya pariṇāma kṣaṇa viśiṣṭa tvam anubhavan saṃyamī te bhinne eva pratyeti

original: saṃprati taddeśapariṇāme'pi pūrvabhinnadeśapariṇāmād viśiṣṭasya caitaddeśapariṇāmakṣaṇasya saṃyamataḥ sākṣātkaraṇāt| tad idam uktam --- anyadeśakṣaṇānubhavas tu tayor anyatve hetur iti| anenaiva nidarśanena laukikaparīkṣakasaṃvādādinā paramāṇor apīdṛśasya bhedo yogīśvarabuddhigamyaḥ śraddheya ity āha --- eteneti| apare tu varṇayanti|
analyzed: saṃprati tad deśa pariṇāme api pūrva bhinna deśa pariṇāmāt viśiṣṭasya ca etad deśa pariṇāma kṣaṇasya saṃyamataḥ sākṣātkaraṇāt tat idam uktam anya deśa kṣaṇa anubhavaḥ tu tayoḥ anya tve hetuḥ iti anena eva nidarśanena laukika parīkṣaka saṃvāda ādinā paramāṇoḥ api īdṛśasya bhedaḥ yogi īśvara buddhi gamyaḥ śraddheyaḥ iti āha etena iti apare tu varṇayanti

original: varṇanam udāharati --- ya iti| vaiśeṣikā hi nityadravyavṛttayo'ntyā viśeṣā ity āhuḥ| tathā hi --- yogino muktāṃs tulyajātideśakālān vyavadhirahitān parasparato bhedena pratyekaṃ tattvena ca pratipadyante| tasmād asti kaścid antyo viśeṣa iti| tathā ca sa eva nityānāṃ paramāṇvādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ bhedaka iti| tad etad dūṣayati --- tatrāpīti|
analyzed: varṇanam udāharati ye iti vaiśeṣikāḥ hi nitya dravya vṛttayaḥ antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ iti āhuḥ tathā hi yoginaḥ muktān tulya jāti deśa kālān vyavadhi rahitān parasparataḥ bhedena pratyekam tattvena ca pratipadyante tasmāt asti kaścid antyaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti tathā ca saḥ eva nityānām paramāṇu ādīnām dravyāṇām bhedakaḥ iti tat etat dūṣayati tatra api iti

original: jātideśalakṣaṇāny udāhṛtāni| mūrtiḥ saṃsthānaṃ yathaikaṃ viśuddhāvayavasaṃsthānopapannam apasārya tasminn eva deśe'nyavyagrasya draṣṭuḥ kutsitāvayavasaṃniveśa upāvartyate tadā tasya saṃsthānabhedena bhedapratyayaḥ, śarīraṃ vā mūrtis tatsaṃbandhenātmanāṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ muktātmanāṃ vā bhūtacareṇa yādṛśatādṛśena bheda iti sarvatra
analyzed: jāti deśa lakṣaṇāni udāhṛtāni mūrtiḥ saṃsthānam yathā ekam viśuddha avayava saṃsthāna upapannam apasārya tasmin eva deśeni avyagrasya draṣṭuḥ kutsita avayava saṃniveśaḥ upāvartyate tadā tasya saṃsthāna bhedena bheda pratyayaḥ śarīram vā mūrtiḥ tad saṃbandhena ātmanām saṃsāriṇām mukta ātmanām vā bhūta careṇa yādṛśa tādṛśena bhedaḥ iti sarvatra

original: bhedapratyayasyānyathāsiddher nāntyaviśeṣakalpanā| vyavadhir bhedakāraṇam| yathā kuśapuṣkaradvīpayor deśasvarūpayor iti| yato jātideśādibhedā lokabuddhigamyā ata uktaṃ --- kṣaṇabhedas tu yogibuddhigamya eveti|
analyzed: bheda pratyayasya anyathā siddheḥ na antya viśeṣa kalpanā vyavadhiḥ bheda kāraṇam yathā kuśa puṣkara dvīpayoḥ deśa svarūpayoḥ iti yatas jāti deśa ādi bhedāḥ loka buddhi gamyāḥ atas uktam kṣaṇabhedaḥ tu yogi buddhi gamyaḥ eva iti

original: evakāraḥ kṣaṇabhedam avadhārayati na yogibuddhigamyatvaṃ, tena bhūtacareṇa dehasaṃbandhena muktātmanām api bhedo yogibuddhigamya unneya iti| yasya tūktā bhedahetavo na santi tasya pradhānasya bhedo nāstīty ācaāryo mene| yasmād ūce "kṛtārthaṃ prati naṣṭam apy anaṣṭaṃ tadanyasādhāraṇatvāt" iti| tad āha --- mūrtivyavadhīti|
analyzed: eva kāraḥ kṣaṇa bhedam avadhārayati na yogi buddhi gamya tvam tena bhūtacareṇa deha saṃbandhena mukta ātmanām api bhedaḥ yogi buddhi gamyaḥ unneyaḥ iti yasya tu uktāḥ bheda hetavaḥ na santi tasya pradhānasya bhedaḥ na asti iti ācaāryaḥ mene yasmāt ūce kṛtārtham prati naṣṭam api anaṣṭam tad anya sādhāraṇa tvāt iti tat āha mūrti vyavadhi iti

original: uktabhedahetūpalakṣaṇam etat| jaganmūlasya pradhānasya pṛthaktvaṃ bhedo nāstīty arthaḥ||3.53||
analyzed: ukta bheda hetu upalakṣaṇam etat jagat mūlasya pradhānasya pṛthaktvam bhedaḥ na asti iti arthaḥ

original: tārakaṃ sarvaviṣayaṃ sarvathāviṣayam akramaṃ ceti vivekajaṃ jñānam||3.54||
analyzed: tārakam sarva viṣayam sarvathāviṣayam akramam ca iti viveka jam jñānam

original: tad evaṃ viṣayaikadeśaṃ vivekajajñānasya darśayitvā vivekajaṃ jñānaṃ lakṣayati --- tārakaṃ sarvaviṣayaṃ sarvathāviṣayam akramaṃ ceti vivekajaṃ jñānam| vivekajaṃ jñānam iti lakṣyanirdeśaḥ| śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇam| saṃsārasāgarāt tārayatīti tārakam| pūrvasmāt prātibhād viśeṣayati --- sarvathāviṣayam iti| paryāyā avāntaraviśeṣāḥ|
analyzed: tat evam viṣaya eka deśam viveka ja jñānasya darśayitvā viveka jam jñānam lakṣayati tārakam sarva viṣayam sarvathā viṣayam akramam ca iti viveka jam jñānam viveka jam jñānam iti lakṣya nirdeśaḥ śeṣam lakṣaṇam saṃsāra sāgarāt tārayati iti tārakam pūrvasmāt prātibhāt viśeṣayati sarvathā viṣayam iti paryāyāḥ avāntara viśeṣāḥ

original: ata eva vivekajaṃ jñānaṃ paripūrṇaṃ nāsya kvacit kiṃcit kathaṃcit kadācid agocara ity arthaḥ| āstāṃ tāvaj jñānāntaraṃ saṃprajñāto'pi tāvad asyāṃśaḥ| tasmād ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ paripūrṇam ity āha --- asyaivāṃśo yogapradīpaḥ saṃprajñātaḥ| kim upakramaḥ kim avasānaś cāsāv ity āha --- madhumatīm iti| ṛtaṃbharā prajñaiva madhu modakāraṇatvāt|
analyzed: atas eva viveka jam jñānam paripūrṇam na asya kvacid kiṃcid kathaṃcid kadācid agocaraḥ iti arthaḥ āstām tāvat jñāna antaram saṃprajñātaḥ api tāvat asya aṃśaḥ tasmāt atas param kim paripūrṇam iti āha asya eva aṃśaḥ yoga pradīpaḥ saṃprajñātaḥ kim upakramaḥ kim avasānaḥ ca asau iti āha madhumatīm iti ṛtaṃbharā prajñā eva madhu moda kāraṇa tvāt

original: yathoktaṃ prajñāprāsādam āruhyeti| tadvatī madhumatī dhiyo'vasthā tām upādāya yāvad asya parisamāptiḥ saptadhā prāntabhūmiḥ prajñā| ata eva vivekajaṃ jñānaṃ tārakaṃ bhavati| tadaṃśasya yogapradīpasya tārakatvād iti||3.54||
analyzed: yathā uktam prajñā prāsādam āruhya iti tadvatī madhumatī dhiyaḥ vasthā tām upādāya yāvat asya parisamāptiḥ saptadhā prānta bhūmiḥ prajñā atas eva viveka jam jñānam tārakam bhavati tad aṃśasya yoga pradīpasya tāraka tvāt iti

original: sattvapuruṣayoḥ śuddhisāmye kaivalyam iti||3.55||
analyzed: sattva puruṣayoḥ śuddhi sāmye kaivalyam iti

original: (iti śrīpatañjaliviracitayogasūtreṣu tṛtīyo vibhūtipādaḥ||3||)
analyzed: iti śrī patañjali viracita yoga sūtreṣu tṛtīyaḥ vibhūti pādaḥ

original: tad evaṃ paramparayā kaivalyasya hetūn savibhūtīn saṃyamān uktvā sattvapuruṣānyatājñānaṃ sākṣāt kaivalyasādhanam ity atra sūtram avatārayati --- prāpteti| vivekajaṃ jñānaṃ bhavatu mā vā bhūt sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātis tu kaivalyaprayojikety arthaḥ| sattvapuruṣayoḥ śuddhisāmye kaivalyam iti| itiḥ sūtrasamāptau|
analyzed: tat evam paramparayā kaivalyasya hetūn sa vibhūtīn saṃyamān uktvā sattva puruṣa anya tā jñānam sākṣāt kaivalya sādhanam iti atra sūtram avatārayati prāptā iti viveka jam jñānam bhavatu mā vā bhūt sattva puruṣa anya tā khyātiḥ tu kaivalya prayojikā iti arthaḥ sattva puruṣayoḥ śuddhi sāmye kaivalyam iti itiḥ sūtra samāptau

original: īśvarasya pūrvoktaiḥ saṃyamair jñānakriyāśaktimato'nīśvarasya vā samanantaroktena saṃyamena vivekajajñānabhāgina itarasya vānutpannajñānasya na vibhūtiṣu kācid apekṣāstīty āha --- na hīti| nanu yady anapekṣitā vibhūtayaḥ kaivalye vyarthas tarhi tāsām upadeśa ity ata āha --- sattvaśuddhidvāreṇeti| itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā|
analyzed: īśvarasya pūrva uktaiḥ saṃyamaiḥ vā samanantara uktena saṃyamena viveka ja jñāna bhāginaḥ itarasya vā anutpanna jñānasya na vibhūtiṣu kācid apekṣā asti iti āha na hi iti nanu yadi anapekṣitāḥ vibhūtayaḥ kaivalye vyarthaḥ tarhi tāsām upadeśaḥ iti atas āha sattva śuddhi dvāreṇa iti itthaṃbhūta lakṣaṇe tṛtīyā

original: nātyantam ahetavaḥ kaivalye vibhūtayaḥ kiṃ tu na sākṣād ity arthaḥ| jñānaṃ vivekajam upakrāntaṃ yac ca pāramparyeṇa kāraṇaṃ tad aupacārikaṃ na tu mukhyaṃ, paramārthas tu khyātir eva mukhyam ity arthaḥ| jñānād iti prasaṃkhyānād ity arthaḥ||3.55||
analyzed: na atyantam ahetavaḥ kaivalye vibhūtayaḥ kim tu na sākṣāt iti arthaḥ jñānam viveka jam upakrāntam yat ca pāramparyeṇa kāraṇam tat aupacārikam na tu mukhyam paramārthaḥ tu khyātiḥ eva mukhyam iti arthaḥ jñānāt iti prasaṃkhyānāt iti arthaḥ

original: "atrāntaraṅgāṇy aṅgāni pariṇāmāḥ prapañcitāḥ| saṃyamād bhūtasaṃyogas tāsu jñānaṃ vivekajam" iti ||
analyzed: atra antaraṅgāṇi aṅgāni pariṇāmāḥ prapañcitāḥ saṃyamāt bhūta saṃyogaḥ tāsu jñānam viveka jam iti

original: iti śrīvācaspatimiśraviracitāyāṃ pātañjalabhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ tattvavaiśāradyāṃ vibhūtipādas tṛtīyaḥ||3||
analyzed: iti śrī vācaspatimiśra viracitāyām pātañjala bhāṣya vyākhyāyām tattvavaiśāradyām vibhūti pādaḥ tṛtīyaḥ

original: tatra caturthaḥ kaivalyapādaḥ|
analyzed: tatra caturthaḥ kaivalya pādaḥ

original: janmauṣadhimantratapaḥsamādhijāḥ siddhayaḥ||4.1||
analyzed: janma auṣadhi mantra tapaḥ samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ

original: tad evaṃ prathamadvitīyatṛtīyapādaiḥ samādhitatsādhanatadvibhūtayaḥ prādhānyena vyutpāditāḥ| itarat tu prāsaṅgikam aupodghātikaṃ coktam ihedānīṃ taddhetukaṃ kaivalyaṃ vyutpādanīyam|
analyzed: tat evam prathama dvitīya tṛtīya pādaiḥ samādhi tad sādhana tad vibhūtayaḥ prādhānyena vyutpāditāḥ itarat tu prāsaṅgikam aupodghātikam ca uktam iha idānīm tad hetukam kaivalyam vyutpādanīyam

original: na caitat kaivalyabhāgīyaṃ cittaṃ paralokaṃ ca paralokinaṃ vijñānātiriktaṃ cittakaraṇakasukhādyātmakaśabdādyupabhoktāram ātmānaṃ ca prasaṃkhyānaparamakāṣṭhāṃ ca vinā vyutpādya śakyaṃ vaktum iti tad etat sarvam atra pāde vyutpādanīyam itarac ca prasaṅgād upodghātād vā|
analyzed: na ca etat kaivalya bhāgīyam cittam para lokam ca para lokinam vijñāna atiriktam citta karaṇaka sukha ādi ātmaka śabda ādi upabhoktāram ātmānam ca prasaṃkhyāna parama kāṣṭhām ca vinā vyutpādya śakyam vaktum iti tat etat sarvam atra pāde vyutpādanīyam itarat ca prasaṅgāt upodghātāt vā

original: tatra prathamaṃ siddhacitteṣu kaivalyabhāgīyaṃ cittaṃ nirdhārayitukāmaḥ pañcatayīṃ siddhim āha --- janmauṣadhimantratapaḥsamādhijāḥ siddhayaḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- dehāntariteti| svargopabhogabhāgīyāt karmaṇo manuṣyajātīyācaritāt kutaścin nimittāl labdhaparipākāt kvacid devanikāye jātamātrasyaiva divyadehāntaritā siddhir aṇimādyā bhavatīti|
analyzed: tatra prathamam siddha citteṣu kaivalya bhāgīyam cittam nirdhārayitu kāmaḥ pañcatayīm siddhim āha janma auṣadhi mantra tapaḥ samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ vyācaṣṭe deha antaritā iti svarga upabhoga bhāgīyāt karmaṇaḥ manuṣya jātīya ācaritāt kutaścid nimittāt labdha paripākāt kvacid devanikāye jāta mātrasya eva divya deha antaritā siddhiḥ aṇima ādyā bhavati iti

original: oṣadhisiddhim āha --- asurabhavaneṣv iti| manuṣyo hi kutaścin nimittād asurabhavanam upasaṃprāptaḥ kamanīyābhir asurakanyābhir upanītaṃ rasāyanam upayujyājarāmaraṇatvam anyāś ca siddhīr āsādayati| ihaiva vā rasāyanopayogena yathā māṇḍavyo munī rasopayogād vindhyavāsīti| mantrasiddhim āha --- mantrair iti| tapaḥsiddhim āha --- tapaseti|
analyzed: oṣadhi siddhim āha asura bhavaneṣu iti manuṣyaḥ hi kutaścid nimittāt asura bhavanam upasaṃprāptaḥ kamanīyābhiḥ asura kanyābhiḥ upanītam rasāyanam upayujya ajara amaraṇa tvam anyāḥ ca siddhīḥ āsādayati iha eva vā rasāyana upayogena yathā māṇḍavyaḥ muniḥ rasa upayogāt vindhya vāsī iti mantra siddhim āha mantraiḥ iti tapaḥ siddhim āha tapasā iti

original: saṃkalpasiddhim āha --- kāmarūpīti| yad eva kāmayate'ṇimādi tad ekapade'sya bhavatīti| yatra kāmayate śrotuṃ vā mantuṃ vā tatra tad eva śṛṇoti manute veti| ādiśabdād darśanādayaḥ saṃgṛhītā iti||4.1||
analyzed: saṃkalpa siddhim āha kāmarūpī iti yat eva kāmayate iṇima ādi tat bhavati iti yatra kāmayate śrotum vā mantum vā tatra tat eva śṛṇoti manute vā iti ādi śabdāt darśana ādayaḥ saṃgṛhītāḥ iti

original: jātyantarapariṇāmaḥ prakṛtyāpūrāt||4.2||
analyzed: jāti antara pariṇāmaḥ prakṛti āpūrāt

original: samādhijāḥ siddhayo vyākhyātā adhastane pāde| atha catasṛṣu siddhiṣv auṣadhādisādhanāsu teṣām eva kāyendriyāṇāṃ jātyantarapariṇatir iṣyate| sā punar na tāvad upādānamātrāt| na hi tāvanmātram upādānaṃ nyūnādhikadivyādivyabhāve'sya bhavati| no khalv avilakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryavailakṣaṇyāyālam|
analyzed: samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ vyākhyātāḥ adhastane pāde atha catasṛṣu siddhiṣu auṣadha ādi sādhanāsu teṣām eva kāya indriyāṇām jāti antara pariṇatiḥ iṣyate sā punar na tāvat upādāna mātrāt na hi tāvanmātram upādānam bhavati no khalu avilakṣaṇam kāraṇam kārya vailakṣaṇyāya alam

original: māsyākasmikatvaṃ bhūd ity āśaṅkya pūrayitvā sūtraṃ paṭhati --- tatra kāyendriyāṇām anyajātīyapariṇatānāṃ --- jātyantapariṇāmaḥ prakṛtyāpūrāt| manuṣyajātipariṇatānāṃ kāyendriyāṇāṃ yo devatiryagjātipariṇāmaḥ sa khalu prakṛtyāpūrāt| kāyasya hi prakṛtiḥ pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni| indriyāṇāṃ ca prakṛtir asmitā, tadavayavānupraveśa āpūras tasmād bhavati|
analyzed: mā asya ākasmika tvam bhūt iti āśaṅkya pūrayitvā sūtram paṭhati tatra kāya indriyāṇām anya jātīya pariṇatānām jāti anta pariṇāmaḥ prakṛti āpūrāt manuṣya jāti pariṇatānām kāya indriyāṇām yaḥ deva tiryak jāti pariṇāmaḥ sa khalu prakṛti āpūrāt kāyasya hi prakṛtiḥ pṛthivī ādīni bhūtāni indriyāṇām ca prakṛtiḥ asmitā tad avayava anupraveśaḥ āpūraḥ tasmāt bhavati

original: tad idam āha --- pūrvapariṇāmeti| nanu yady āpūreṇānugrahaḥ kasmāt punar asau na sadātana ity ata āha --- dharmādīti| tad anena tasyaiva śarīrasya bālyakaumārayauvanavārdhakādīni ca nyagrodhadhānāyāṃ nyagrodhatarubhāvaś ca vahnikaṇikāyās tṛṇarāśiniveśitāyā vā prodbhavajjvālāsahasrasamāliṅgitagaganamaṇḍalatvaṃ ca vyākhyātam||4.2||
analyzed: tat idam āha pūrva pariṇāma iti nanu yadi āpūreṇa anugrahaḥ kasmāt punar asau na sadātanaḥ iti atas āha dharma ādi iti tat anena tasya eva śarīrasya bālya kaumāra yauvana vārdhaka ādīni ca nyagrodha dhānāyām nyagrodha taru bhāvaḥ ca vahni kaṇikāyāḥ tṛṇa rāśi niveśitāyāḥ vā prodbhavat jvālā sahasra samāliṅgita gagana maṇḍala tvam ca vyākhyātam

original: nimittam aprayojakaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ varaṇabhedas tu tataḥ kṣetrikavat||4.3||
analyzed: nimittam aprayojakam prakṛtīnām varaṇa bhedaḥ tu tatas kṣetrika vat

original: prakṛtyāpūrād ity uktaṃ tatredaṃ saṃdihyate --- kim āpūraḥ prakṛtīnāṃ svābhāviko dharmādinimitto veti| kiṃ prāptaṃ satīṣv api prakṛtiṣu kadācid āpūrād dharmādinimittaśravaṇāc ca tannimitta eveti prāptam| evaṃ prāpta āha --- nimittam aprayojakaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ varaṇabhedas tu tataḥ kṣetrikavat|
analyzed: prakṛti āpūrāt iti uktam tatra idam saṃdihyate kim āpūraḥ prakṛtīnām svābhāvikaḥ dharma ādi nimittaḥ vā iti kim prāptam satīṣu api prakṛtiṣu kadācid āpūrāt dharma ādi nimitta śravaṇāt ca tad nimittaḥ eva iti prāptam evam prāptaḥ āha nimittam aprayojakam prakṛtīnām varaṇa bhedaḥ tu tatas kṣetrika vat

original: satyaṃ dharmādayo nimittaṃ na tu prayojakās teṣām api prakṛtikāryatvāt| na ca kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ prayojayati tasya tadadhīnotpattitayā kāraṇaparatantratvāt| svatantrasya ca prayojakatvāt| na khalu kulālam antareṇa mṛddaṇḍacakrasalilādaya utpitsitenotpannena vā ghaṭena prayujyante| kiṃ tu svatantreṇa kulālena| na ca puruṣārtho'pi pravartakaḥ|
analyzed: satyam dharma ādayaḥ nimittam na tu prayojakāḥ teṣām api prakṛti kārya tvāt na ca kāryam kāraṇam prayojayati tasya tad adhīna utpatti tayā kāraṇa paratantra tvāt svatantrasya ca prayojaka tvāt na khalu kulālam antareṇa mṛd daṇḍa cakra salila ādayaḥ utpitsitena utpannena vā ghaṭena prayujyante kim tu svatantreṇa kulālena na ca puruṣa arthaḥ api pravartakaḥ

original: kiṃ tu taduddeśeneśvaraḥ| uddeśyatāmātreṇa puruṣārthaḥ pravartaka ity ucyate| utpitsos tv asya puruṣārthasyāvyaktasya sthitikāraṇatvaṃ yuktam| na caitāvatā dharmādīnām animittatā pratibandhāpanayanamātreṇa kṣetrikavad upapatter īśvarasyāpi dharmādhiṣṭhānārthaṃ pratibandhāpanaya eva vyāpāro veditavyaḥ| tad etan nigadavyākhyātena bhāṣyeṇoktam||4.3||
analyzed: kim tu tad uddeśena īśvaraḥ uddeśya tā mātreṇa puruṣa arthaḥ pravartakaḥ iti ucyate utpitsoḥ tu asya puruṣa arthasya avyaktasya sthiti kāraṇa tvam yuktam na ca etāvatā dharma ādīnām animitta tā pratibandha apanayana mātreṇa kṣetrika vat upapatteḥ īśvarasya api dharma adhiṣṭhāna artham pratibandha apanayaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ veditavyaḥ tat etat nigada vyākhyātena bhāṣyeṇa uktam

original: nirmāṇacittāny asmitāmātrāt||4.4||
analyzed: nirmāṇa cittāni asmitā mātrāt

original: prakṛtyāpūreṇa siddhīḥ samarthya siddhivinirmitanānākāyavarticittaikatvanānātve vicārayati --- yadā tv iti| tatra nānāmanastve kāyānāṃ praticittam abhiprāyabhedād ekābhiprāyānurodhaś ca parasparapratisaṃdhānaṃ ca na syātāṃ puruṣāntaravat|
analyzed: prakṛti āpūreṇa siddhīḥ samarthya siddhi vinirmita nānā kāya varti citta ekatva nānātve vicārayati yadā tu iti tatra nānā manaḥ tve kāyānām praticittam abhiprāya bhedāt eka abhiprāya anurodhaḥ ca paraspara pratisaṃdhānam ca na syātām puruṣa antara vat

original: tasmād ekam eva cittaṃ pradīpavad visāritayā bahūn api nirmāṇakāyān vyāpnotīti prāpta āha --- nirmāṇacittāny asmitāmātrāt| yad yāvaj jīvaccharīraṃ tat sarvam ekaikāsādhāraṇacittānvitaṃ dṛṣṭam| tadyathā caitramaitrādiśarīram| tathā ca nirmāṇakāyā iti siddhaṃ teṣām api prātisvikaṃ mana ity abhiprāyeṇāha --- asmitāmātram iti||4.4||
analyzed: tasmāt ekam eva cittam pradīpa vat visāritayā bahūn api nirmāṇa kāyān vyāpnoti iti prāptaḥ āha nirmāṇa cittāni asmitā mātrāt yat yāvat jīvat śarīram tat sarvam ekaika asādhāraṇa citta anvitam dṛṣṭam tat yathā caitra maitra ādi śarīram tathā ca nirmāṇa kāyāḥ iti siddham teṣām api prātisvikam manaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha asmitā mātram iti

original: pravṛttibhede prayojakaṃ cittam ekam anekeṣām||4.5||
analyzed: pravṛtti bhede prayojakam cittam ekam anekeṣām

original: yad uktam anekacittatva ekābhiprāyānurodhaś ca pratisaṃdhānaṃ ca na syātām iti tatrottaraṃ sūtram --- pravṛttibhede prayojakaṃ cittam ekam anekeṣām| abhaviṣyad eṣa doṣo yadi cittam ekaṃ nānākāyavarti manonāyakaṃ na niramāsyat, tannirmāṇe tv adoṣaḥ|
analyzed: yat uktam aneka citta tve eka abhiprāya anurodhaḥ ca pratisaṃdhānam ca na syātām iti tatra uttaram sūtram pravṛtti bhede prayojakam cittam ekam anekeṣām abhaviṣyat eṣa doṣaḥ yadi cittam ekam nānā kāya varti manaḥ nāyakam na niramāsyat tad nirmāṇe tu adoṣaḥ

original: na caikaṃ gṛhītvā kṛtaṃ prātisvikair manobhiḥ kṛtaṃ vā nāyakanirmāṇena nijasyaiva manaso nāyakatvād iti vācyam| pramāṇasiddhasya niyogaparyanuyogānupapatter iti| atra purāṇaṃ bhavati ---
analyzed: na ca ekam gṛhītvā kṛtam prātisvikaiḥ manobhiḥ kṛtam vā nāyaka nirmāṇena nijasya eva manasaḥ nāyaka tvāt iti vācyam pramāṇa siddhasya niyoga paryanuyoga anupapatteḥ iti atra purāṇam bhavati

original: "ekas tu prabhuśaktyā vai bahudhā bhavatīśvaraḥ| bhūtvā yasmāt tu bahudhā bhavaty ekaḥ punas tu saḥ|| tasmāc ca manaso bhedā jāyante caita eva hi| ekadhā sa dvidhā caiva tridhā ca bahudhā punaḥ|| yogīśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikaroti ca| prāpnuyād viṣayān kaiścit kaiścid ugraṃ tapaś caret|| saṃharec ca punas tāni sūryo raśmigaṇān iva" iti||
analyzed: ekaḥ tu prabhu śaktyā vai bahudhā bhavati īśvaraḥ bhūtvā yasmāt tu bahudhā bhavati ekaḥ punar tu saḥ tasmāt ca manasaḥ bhedāḥ jāyante ca ete eva hi ekadhā sa dvidhā ca eva tridhā ca bahudhā punar yogi īśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikaroti ca prāpnuyāt viṣayān kaiścid kaiścid ugram tapaḥ caret saṃharet ca punar tāni sūryaḥ raśmi gaṇān iva iti

original: tad etenābhiprāyeṇāha --- bahūnāṃ cittānām iti||4.5||
analyzed: tat etena abhiprāyeṇa āha bahūnām cittānām iti

original: tatra dhyānajam anāśayam||4.6||
analyzed: tatra dhyāna jam anāśayam

original: tad evam uditeṣu pañcasu siddhacitteṣv apavargabhāgīyaṃ cittaṃ nirdhārayati --- tatra dhyānajam anāśayam| āśerata ity āśayāḥ karmavāsanāḥ kleśavāsanāś ca| ta ete na vidyante yasmiṃs tad anāśayaṃ cittam apavargabhāgīyaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ| yato rāgādinibandhanā pravṛttir nāsty ato nāsti puṇyapāpābhisaṃbandhaḥ|
analyzed: tat evam uditeṣu pañcasu siddhacitteṣu apavarga bhāgīyam cittam nirdhārayati tatra dhyāna jam anāśayam āśerate iti āśayāḥ karma vāsanāḥ kleśa vāsanāḥ ca te ete na vidyante yasmin tat anāśayam cittam apavarga bhāgīyam bhavati iti arthaḥ yatas rāga ādi nibandhanā pravṛttiḥ na asti atas na asti puṇya pāpa abhisaṃbandhaḥ

original: kasmāt punā rāgādijanitā pravṛttir nāstīty ata āha --- kṣīṇakleśatvād iti| dhyānajasyānāśayasya mano'ntarebhyo viśeṣaṃ darśayitum itareṣām āśayavattām āha --- itareṣāṃ tv iti||4.6||
analyzed: kasmāt punar rāga ādi janitā pravṛttiḥ na asti iti atas āha kṣīṇa kleśa tvāt iti dhyāna jasya anāśayasya manaḥ ntarebhyaḥ viśeṣam darśayitum itareṣām āśayavat tām āha itareṣām tu iti

original: karmāśuklākṛṣṇaṃ yoginas trividham itareṣām||4.7||
analyzed: karma aśukla akṛṣṇam yoginaḥ trividham itareṣām

original: tatraiva ca hetuparaṃ sūtram avatārayati --- yata iti| karmāśuklākṛṣṇaṃ yoginas trividham itareṣām| padaṃ sthānam| cartuṣu samavetā catuṣpadī| yad yāvad bahiḥsādhanasādhyaṃ tatra sarvatrāsti kasyacit pīḍā| na hi vrīhyādisādhane'pi karmaṇi parapīḍā nāsty avaghātādisamaye 'pi pipīlikādivadhasaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: tatra eva ca hetu param sūtram avatārayati yatas iti karma aśukla akṛṣṇam yoginaḥ trividham itareṣām padam sthānam ca ṛtuṣu samavetā catuṣpadī yat yāvat bahis sādhana sādhyam tatra sarvatra asti kasyacid pīḍā na hi vrīhi ādi sādhane pi karmaṇi para pīḍā na asti avaghāta ādi samaye pi pipīlika ādi vadha saṃbhavāt

original: antato bījādivadhena stambādibhedotpattipratibandhāt| anugrahaś ca dakṣiṇādinā brāhmaṇāder iti| śuklā tapaḥsvādhyāyadhyānavatām asaṃnyāsinām| śuklatvam upapādayati --- sā hīti| aśuklākṛṣṇā saṃnyāsinām| saṃnyāsino darśayati --- kṣīṇeti| karmāsaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: antatas bīja ādi vadhena stamba ādi bheda utpatti pratibandhāt anugrahaḥ ca dakṣiṇā ādinā brāhmaṇa ādeḥ iti śuklā tapaḥ svādhyāya dhyānavatām asaṃnyāsinām śukla tvam upapādayati sā hi iti aśukla akṛṣṇā saṃnyāsinām saṃnyāsinaḥ darśayati kṣīṇā iti karma asaṃbhavāt

original: karmasaṃnyāsino hi na kvacid bahiḥsādhanasādhye karmaṇi pravṛttā iti na caiṣām asti kṛṣṇaḥ karmāśayaḥ| yogānuṣṭhānasādhyasya karmāśayaphalasyeśvare samarpaṇān na śuklaḥ karmāśayaḥ| niratyayaphalo hi śukla ucyate| yasya phalam eva nāsti kutas tasya niratyayaphalatvam ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: karma saṃnyāsinaḥ hi na kvacid bahis sādhana sādhye karmaṇi pravṛttāḥ iti na ca eṣām asti kṛṣṇaḥ karma āśayaḥ yoga anuṣṭhāna sādhyasya karma āśaya phalasya īśvare samarpaṇāt na śuklaḥ karma āśayaḥ niratyaya phalaḥ hi śuklaḥ ucyate yasya phalam eva na asti kutas tasya niratyaya phala tvam iti arthaḥ

original: tad evaṃ catuṣṭayīṃ karmajātim uktvā katamā kasyety avadhārayati --- tatrāśuklam iti||4.7||
analyzed: tat evam catuṣṭayīm karma jātim uktvā katamā kasya iti avadhārayati tatra aśuklam iti

original: tatas tadvipākānuguṇānām evābhivyaktir vāsanānām||4.8||
analyzed: tatas tad vipāka anuguṇānām eva abhivyaktiḥ vāsanānām

original: karmāśayaṃ vivicya kleśāśayagatim āha --- tatas tadvipākānuguṇānām evābhivyaktir vāsanānām| yajjātīyasya puṇyajātīyasyāpuṇyajātīyasya vā karmaṇo yo vipāko divyo vā nārako vā jātyāyurbhogas tasya vipākasyānuguṇāḥ| tā evāha --- yā vāsanāḥ karmavipākam anuśerate'nukurvanti| divyabhogajanitā hi divyakarmavipākānuguṇā vāsanāḥ|
analyzed: karma āśayam vivicya kleśa āśaya gatim āha tatas tad vipāka anuguṇānām evā abhivyaktiḥ vāsanānām yad jātīyasya puṇya jātīyasya apuṇya jātīyasya vā karmaṇaḥ yaḥ vipākaḥ divyaḥ vā nārakaḥ vā jāti āyuḥ bhogaḥ tasya vipākasya anuguṇāḥ tāḥ eva āha yāḥ vāsanāḥ karma vipākam anuśeratenukurvanti divya bhoga janitāḥ hi divya karma vipāka anuguṇāḥ vāsanāḥ

original: na hi manuṣyabhogavāsanābhivyaktau divyakarmaphalopabhogasaṃbhavaḥ| tasmāt svavipākānuguṇā eva vāsanāḥ karmābhivyañjanīyā iti bhāṣyārthaḥ||4.8||
analyzed: na hi manuṣya bhoga vāsanā abhivyaktau divya karma phala upabhoga saṃbhavaḥ tasmāt sva vipāka anuguṇāḥ eva vāsanāḥ karma abhivyañjanīyāḥ iti bhāṣya arthaḥ

original: jātideśakālavyavahitānām apy ānantaryaṃ smṛtisaṃskārayor ekarūpatvāt||4.9||
analyzed: jāti deśa kāla vyavahitānām api ānantaryam smṛti saṃskārayoḥ eka rūpa tvāt

original: syād etat| manuṣyasya prāyaṇānantaram adhigatamārjārabhāvasyānantaratayā manuṣyavāsanāyā evābhivyaktvā bhavitavyam| na khalv asti saṃbhavo yad anantaradivasānubhūtaṃ na smaryate vyavahitadivasānubhūtaṃ ca smaryata ity ata āha --- jātideśakālavyavahitānām apy ānantaryaṃ smṛtisaṃskārayor ekarūpatvāt|
analyzed: syāt etat manuṣyasya prāyaṇa anantaram adhigata mārjāra bhāvasya anantara tayā manuṣya vāsanāyāḥ eva abhivyaktvā bhavitavyam na khalu asti saṃbhavaḥ yat anantara divasa anubhūtam na smaryate vyavahita divasa anubhūtam ca smaryate iti atas āha jāti deśa kāla vyavahitānām api ānantaryam smṛti saṃskārayoḥ eka rūpa tvāt

original: bhavatu vṛṣadaṃśavāsanāyā jātyādivyavadhis tathāpi tasyāḥ phalata ānantaryaṃ vṛṣadaṃśavipākena karmaṇā tasyā eva svavipākānuguṇāyā abhivyaktau tatsmaraṇasamutpādād ity āha --- vṛṣadaṃśavipākodaya iti| udety asmād ity udayaḥ karmāśayaḥ| punaś ca svavyañjakāñjana evodiyāt, abhivyajyeta vipākārambhābhimukhaḥ kriyetety arthaḥ|
analyzed: bhavatu vṛṣadaṃśa vāsanāyāḥ jāti ādi vyavadhiḥ tathā api tasyāḥ phalataḥ ānantaryam vṛṣadaṃśa vipākena karmaṇā tasyāḥ eva sva vipāka anuguṇāyāḥ abhivyaktau tad smaraṇa samutpādāt iti āha vṛṣadaṃśa vipāka udaye iti udeti asmāt iti udayaḥ karma āśayaḥ punar ca sva vyañjaka añjanaḥ evā udiyāt abhivyajyeta vipāka ārambha abhimukhaḥ kriyeta iti arthaḥ

original: abhisaṃskārakriyā upādāya gṛhītvā vyajyeta| yadi vyajyeta svavipākānuguṇā eva vāsanā gṛhītvā vyajyetety arthaḥ| ānantaryam eva phalataḥ kāraṇadvārakam upapādya kāryadvārakam upapādayati --- kutaś ca smṛtīti| ekarūpatā sādṛśyam| tad evāha --- yatheti|
analyzed: abhisaṃskāra kriyāḥ upādāya gṛhītvā vyajyeta yadi vyajyeta sva vipāka anuguṇāḥ eva vāsanāḥ gṛhītvā vyajyeta iti arthaḥ ānantaryam eva phalataḥ kāraṇa dvārakam upapādya kārya dvārakam upapādayati kutas ca smṛti iti eka rūpa tā sādṛśyam tat eva āha yathā iti

original: nanv anubhavasarūpāś cet saṃskārās tathā saty anubhavā viśarārava ity ete'pi viśarāravaḥ kathaṃ cirabhāvine'nubhavāya kalperann ity ata āha --- te ca karmavāsanānurūpāḥ| yathāpūrvaṃ sthāyi kṣaṇikakarmanimittam apy evaṃ kṣaṇikānubhavanimitto'pi saṃskāraḥ sthāyī kiṃcid bhedādhiṣṭhānaṃ ca sārūpyam anyathābhede tattvena sādṛśyānupapatter ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu anubhava sarūpāḥ ced saṃskārāḥ tathā sati anubhavāḥ viśarāravaḥ iti ete api viśarāravaḥ katham cirabhāvinā inubhavāya kalperan iti atas āha te ca karma vāsanā anurūpāḥ yathāpūrvam sthāyi kṣaṇika karma nimittam api evam kṣaṇika anubhava nimittaḥ api saṃskāraḥ sthāyī kiṃcid bheda adhiṣṭhānam ca sārūpyam anyathā abhede tattvena sādṛśya anupapatteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: sugamam anyat||4.9||
analyzed: sugamam anyat

original: tāsām anāditvaṃ cāśiṣo nityatvāt||4.10||
analyzed: tāsām anādi tvam ca āśiṣaḥ nitya tvāt

original: syāt etad vyajyeran pūrvapūrvatarajanmābhisaṃskṛtā vāsanāḥ| yadi pūrvapūrvatarajanmasadbhāve pramāṇaṃ syāt tad eva tu nāsti| na ca jātamātrasya jantor harṣaśokadarśanamātraṃ pramāṇaṃ bhavitum arhati, padmādisaṃkocavikāsavat svābhāvikatvena tadupapatter ity ata āha --- tāsām anāditvaṃ cāśiṣo nityatvāt|
analyzed: syāt etat vyajyeran pūrva pūrvatara janma abhisaṃskṛtāḥ vāsanāḥ yadi pūrva pūrvatara janma sadbhāve pramāṇam syāt tat eva tu nā asti na ca jāta mātrasya jantoḥ harṣa śoka darśana mātram pramāṇam bhavitum arhati padma ādi saṃkoca vikāsa vat svābhāvika tvena tad upapatteḥ iti atas āha tāsām anādi tvam ca āśiṣaḥ nitya tvāt

original: tāsāṃ vāsanānām anāditvaṃ ca na kevalam ānantaryam iti cārthaḥ| āśiṣo nityatvāt| ātmāśiṣo vāsanānām anāditve nityatvāvyabhicārād iti| nanu svābhāvikatvenāpy upapatter asiddham āśiṣo nityatvam ity ata āha --- yeyam iti| nāstikaḥ pṛcchati --- kasmāt| uttaraṃ --- jātamātrasya jantor iti|
analyzed: tāsām vāsanānām anādi tvam ca na kevalam ānantaryam iti ca arthaḥ āśiṣaḥ nitya tvāt ātma āśiṣaḥ vāsanānām anādi tve nitya tva avyabhicārāt iti nanu svābhāvika tvena api upapatteḥ asiddham āśiṣaḥ nitya tvam iti atas āha yā iyam iti nāstikaḥ pṛcchati kasmāt uttaram jāta mātrasya jantoḥ iti

original: ata evaitasmiñ janmany ananubhūtamaraṇadharmakasya maraṇam eva dharmaḥ so'nanubhūto yena sa tathoktas tasya mātur aṅkāt praskhalataḥ kampamānasya māṅgalyacakrādilāñchitaṃ taduraḥsūtram atigāḍhaṃ pāṇigrāham avalambamānasya bālakasya kampabhedānumitā dveṣānuṣakte duḥkhe yā smṛtis tannimitto maraṇatrāsaḥ kathaṃ bhaved iti|
analyzed: atas eva etasmin janmani ananubhūta maraṇa dharmakasya maraṇam eva dharmaḥ saḥ unanubhūtaḥ yena sa tathā uktaḥ tasya mātuḥ aṅkāt praskhalataḥ kampamānasya māṅgalya cakra ādi lāñchitam tat uraḥ sūtram atigāḍham pāṇigrāham avalambamānasya bālakasya kampa bheda anumitā dveṣa anuṣakte duḥkhe yā smṛtiḥ tad nimittaḥ maraṇa trāsaḥ katham bhavet iti

original: nanūktaṃ svabhāvād ity ata āha --- na ca svābhāvikaṃ vastu nimittam upādatte gṛhṇāti svotpattau| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- bālakasyedṛśo dṛśyamānaḥ kampo bhayanibandhana īdṛśakampatvād asmadādikampavat| bālakasya bhayaṃ dveṣaduḥkhasmṛtinimittaṃ bhayatvād asmadādibhayavat|
analyzed: nanu uktam svabhāvāt iti atas āha na ca svābhāvikam vastu nimittam upādatte gṛhṇāti sva utpattau etat uktam bhavati bālakasya īdṛśaḥ dṛśyamānaḥ kampaḥ bhaya nibandhanaḥ īdṛśa kampa tvāt asmat ādi kampa vat bālakasya bhayam dveṣa duḥkha smṛti nimittam bhaya tvāt asmat ādi bhaya vat

original: āgāmipratyavāyotprekṣālakṣaṇaṃ ca bhayaṃ na duḥkhasmṛtimātrād bhavati, api tu yato bibheti tasya pratyavāyahetubhāvam anumāya saṃpraty api pratyavāyaṃ bhayaṃ ca vidadhyād iti śaṅkate| tasmād yajjātīyād anubhūtacarād dveṣānuṣaktaṃ duḥkham upapāditaṃ tasya smaraṇāt tajjātīyasyānubhūyamānasya tadduḥkhahetutvam anumāya tato bibheti|
analyzed: āgāmi pratyavāya utprekṣā lakṣaṇam ca bhayam na duḥkha smṛti mātrāt bhavati api tu yatas bibheti tasya pratyavāya hetu bhāvam anumāya saṃprati api pratyavāyam bhayam ca vidadhyāt iti śaṅkate tasmāt yad jātīyāt anubhūta carāt dveṣa anuṣaktam duḥkham upapāditam tasya smaraṇāt tad jātīyasya anubhūyamānasya tad duḥkha hetu tvam anumāya tatas bibheti

original: na ca bālakenāsmiñ janmani skhalanasyānyatra duḥkhahetutvam avagatam| na ca tādṛśaṃ duḥkham upalabdham| tasmāt prāgbhavīyo 'nubhavaḥ pariśiṣyate| tac caitad evaṃ prayogam ārohati --- jātamātrasya bālasya smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhavanibandhanā smṛtitvād asmadādismṛtivad iti| na ca padmasaṃkocavikāsāv api svābhāvikau|
analyzed: na ca bālakena asmin janmani skhalanasya anyatra duḥkha hetu tvam avagatam na ca tādṛśam duḥkham upalabdham tasmāt prāgbhavīyaḥ nubhavaḥ pariśiṣyate tat ca etat evam prayogam ārohati jāta mātrasya bālasya smṛtiḥ pūrva anubhava nibandhanā smṛti tvāt asmad ādi smṛti vat iti na ca padma saṃkoca vikāsau api svābhāvikau

original: na hi svābhāvikaṃ kāraṇāntaram apekṣate, vahner auṣṇyaṃ praty api kāraṇāntarāpekṣāprasaṅgāt| tasmād āgantukam aruṇakarasaṃparkamātram eva kamalinīvikāsakāraṇam| saṃkocakāraṇaṃ ca saṃskāraḥ sthitisthāpaka iti| evaṃ smitādyanumitaharṣādayo'pi prāci bhave hetavo veditavyāḥ| tad āstāṃ tāvat prakṛtam upasaṃharati --- tasmād iti|
analyzed: na hi svābhāvikam kāraṇa antaram apekṣate vahneḥ auṣṇyam prati api kāraṇa antara apekṣā prasaṅgāt tasmāt āgantukam aruṇa kara saṃparka mātram eva kamalinī vikāsa kāraṇam saṃkoca kāraṇam ca saṃskāraḥ sthiti sthāpakaḥ iti evam smita ādi anumita harṣa ādayaḥ api prāci bhave hetavaḥ veditavyāḥ tat āstām tāvat prakṛtam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: nimittaṃ labdhavipākakālaṃ karma| pratilambho'bhivyaktiḥ| prasaṅgataś cittaparimāṇavipratipattiṃ nirācikīrṣur vipratipattim āha --- ghaṭaprāsādeti| dehapradeśavartikāryadarśanād dehād bahiḥ sadbhāve cittasya na pramāṇam asti| na caitad aṇuparimāṇaṃ dīrghaśaṣkulībhakṣaṇādāv aparyāyeṇa jñānapañcakānutpādaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: nimittam labdha vipāka kālam karma pratilambhaḥ abhivyaktiḥ prasaṅgataḥ citta parimāṇa vipratipattim nirācikīrṣuḥ vipratipattim āha ghaṭa prāsāda iti deha pradeśa varti kārya darśanāt dehāt bahis sadbhāve cittasya na pramāṇam asti na ca etat aṇu parimāṇam dīrgha śaṣkulī bhakṣaṇa ādau aparyāyeṇa jñāna pañcaka anutpāda prasaṅgāt

original: na cānanubhūyamānakramakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇam asti| na caikam aṇu mano nānādeśair indriyair aparyāyeṇa saṃbandhum arhati| tat pāriśeṣyāt kāyaparimāṇaṃ cittaṃ ghaṭaprāsādavartipradīpavat| saṃkocavikāśau puttikāhastidehayor asyotpatsyete| śarīraparimāṇam evākāraḥ parimāṇaṃ yasyety apare pratipannāḥ| nanv evaṃ katham asya kṣetrabījasaṃyogaḥ|
analyzed: na ca ananubhūyamāna krama kalpanāyām pramāṇam asti na ca ekam aṇu manaḥ nānā deśaiḥ indriyaiḥ aparyāyeṇa saṃbandhum arhati tat pāriśeṣyāt kāya parimāṇam cittam ghaṭa prāsāda varti pradīpa vat saṃkoca vikāśau puttikā hasti dehayoḥ asya utpatsyete śarīra parimāṇam eva ākāraḥ parimāṇam yasya iti apare pratipannāḥ nanu evam katham asya kṣetra bīja saṃyogaḥ

original: na khalv etad anāśrayaṃ mṛtaśarīrān mātṛpitṛdehavartinī lohitaretasī prāpnoti paratantratvāt| na hi sthāṇvādiṣv agacchatsu tacchāyā gacchati| na cāgacchati paṭe tadāśrayaṃ citraṃ gacchati| tathā ca na saṃsāraḥ syād ity ata āha --- tathā cāntarābhāvaḥ saṃsāraś ca yukta iti|
analyzed: na khalu etat anāśrayam mṛta śarīrāt mātṛ pitṛ deha vartinī lohita retasī prāpnoti paratantra tvāt na hi sthāṇu ādiṣu agacchatsu tad chāyā gacchati na ca āgacchati paṭe tad āśrayam citram gacchati tathā ca na saṃsāraḥ syāt iti atas āha tathā ca antara abhāvaḥ saṃsāraḥ ca yuktaḥ iti

original: tathā ca śarīraparimāṇatve dehāntaraprāptaye pūrvadehatyāgo dehāntaraprāptiś cāntarāsyātivāhikaśarīrasaṃyogād bhavatas tena khalv ayaṃ dehāntare saṃcaret| tathā ca purāṇam ---
analyzed: tathā ca śarīra parimāṇa tve deha antara prāptaye pūrva dehatyāgaḥ deha antara prāptiḥ ca antarā asya ātivāhika śarīra saṃyogāt bhavataḥ tena khalu ayam deha antare saṃcaret tathā ca purāṇam

original: "aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ niścakarṣa yamo balāt" iti|
analyzed: aṅguṣṭha mātram puruṣam niścakarṣa yamaḥ balāt iti

original: so'yam antarābhāvaḥ| ata eva saṃsāraś ca yukta iti| tad etad amṛṣyamāṇaḥ svamatam āha --- vṛttir evāsya vibhunaś cittasya saṃkocavikāsinīty ācāryaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ pratipede| idam atrākūtaṃ --- yady anāśrayaṃ cittaṃ na dehāntarasaṃcāri katham etad ātivāhikam āśrayate, tatrāpi dehāntarakalpanāyām anavasthā|
analyzed: saḥ ayam antara abhāvaḥ atas eva saṃsāraḥ ca yuktaḥ iti tat etat amṛṣyamāṇaḥ sva matam āha vṛttiḥ eva asya vibhunaḥ cittasya saṃkoca vikāsinī iti ācāryaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ pratipede idam atra ākūtam yadi anāśrayam cittam na deha antara saṃcāri katham etat ātivāhikam āśrayate tatra api deha antara kalpanāyām anavasthā

original: na cāsya dehān niṣkarṣaḥ sātivāhikasya saṃbhavati| niṣkṛṣṭasya cetasas tatsaṃbandhāt| astu tarhi sūkṣmaśarīram evā sargād ā ca mahāpralayān niyataṃ cittānām adhiṣṭhānaṃ ṣāṭkauśikaśarīram adhyavarti| tena hi cittam ā satyalokād ā cāvīces tatra tatra śarīre saṃcarati| niṣkarṣaś cāsyopapannaḥ ṣāṭkauśikāt kāyāt|
analyzed: na ca asya dehāt niṣkarṣaḥ sa ātivāhikasya saṃbhavati niṣkṛṣṭasya cetasaḥ tad saṃbandhāt astu tarhi sūkṣmaśarīram eva ā sargāt ā ca mahāpralayāt niyatam cittānām adhiṣṭhānam ṣāṭkauśika śarīram adhyavarti tena hi cittam ā satya lokāt ā ca avīceḥ tatra tatra śarīre saṃcarati niṣkarṣaḥ ca asya upapannaḥ ṣāṭkauśikāt kāyāt

original: tatra hi tadantarābhāvas tasya niyatatvāt| na cāsyāpi sadbhāve pramāṇam asti| na khalv etad adhyakṣagocaraḥ| na ca saṃsāro'syānumānam| ācāryamatenāpy upapatteḥ| āgamas tu puruṣasya niṣkarṣam āha| na ca cittaṃ vā sūkṣmaśarīraṃ vā puruṣaḥ kiṃ tu citiśaktir apratisaṃkramā| na cāsyā niṣkarṣaḥ saṃbhavatīty aupacāriko vyākhyeyaḥ|
analyzed: tatra hi tad antara abhāvaḥ tasya niyata tvāt na ca asya api sadbhāve pramāṇam asti na khalu etat adhyakṣa gocaraḥ na ca saṃsāraḥ sya anumānam ācārya matena api upapatteḥ āgamaḥ tu puruṣasya niṣkarṣam āha na ca cittam vā sūkṣmaśarīram vā puruṣaḥ kim tu citi śaktiḥ apratisaṃkramā na ca asyāḥ niṣkarṣaḥ saṃbhavati iti aupacārikaḥ vyākhyeyaḥ

original: tathā ca citeś cittasya ca tatra tatra vṛttyabhāva eva niṣkarṣārthaḥ| yac ca smṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu maraṇānantaraṃ pretaśarīraprāptis tadvimokaś ca sapiṇḍīkaraṇādibhir ity uktaṃ tad anujānīmaḥ| ātivāhikatvaṃ tasya na mṛṣyāmahe| na cātrāsti kaścid āgamaḥ| labdhaśarīra eva ca yamapuruṣair api pāśabaddho nīyate| na tv ātivāhikaśarīraḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca citeḥ cittasya ca tatra tatra vṛtti abhāvaḥ eva niṣkarṣa arthaḥ yat ca smṛti itihāsa purāṇeṣu maraṇa anantaram preta śarīra prāptiḥ tad vimokaḥ ca sapiṇḍīkaraṇa ādibhiḥ iti uktam tat anujānīmaḥ ātivāhika tvam tasya na mṛṣyāmahe na ca atra asti kaścid āgamaḥ labdha śarīraḥ eva ca yama puruṣaiḥ api pāśa baddhaḥ nīyate na tu ātivāhika śarīraḥ

original: tasmād āhaṃkārikatvāc cetaso 'haṃkārasya ca gaganamaṇḍalavat trailokyavyāpitvād vibhutvaṃ manasaḥ| evaṃ ced asya vṛttir api vibhvīti sarvajñatāpattir ity ata uktaṃ vṛttir evāsyeti| syād etat| cittamātrādhīnāyā vṛtteḥ saṃkocavikāsau kutaḥ kādācitkāv ity ata āha --- tac ca cittaṃ dharmādinimittāpekṣam| vṛttau nimittaṃ vibhajate --- nimittaṃ ceti|
analyzed: tasmāt āhaṃkārika tvāt cetasaḥ haṃkārasya ca gagana maṇḍala vat trailokya vyāpi tvāt vibhu tvam manasaḥ evam ced asya vṛttiḥ api vibhvī iti sarvajña tā āpattiḥ iti atas uktam vṛttiḥ eva asya iti syāt etat citta mātra adhīnāyāḥ vṛtteḥ saṃkoca vikāsau kutas kādācitkau iti atas āha tat ca cittam dharma ādi nimitta apekṣam vṛttau nimittam vibhajate nimittam ca iti

original: ādigrahaṇenendriyadhanādayo gṛhyante| śraddhādīty atrāpi vīryasmṛtyādayo gṛhyante| āntaratve saṃmatim ācāryāṇām āha --- tathā coktam| vihāro vyāpāraḥ| prakṛṣṭaṃ śuklaṃ, tayor bāhyābhyantarayor madhye| jñānavairāgye tajjanito dharmaḥ (tajjanitau dharmau) kena bāhyasādhyena dharmeṇātiśayyete abhibhūyete|
analyzed: ādi grahaṇena indriya dhana ādayaḥ gṛhyante śraddhā ādi iti atra api vīrya smṛti ādayaḥ gṛhyante āntara tve saṃmatim ācāryāṇām āha tathā ca uktam vihāraḥ vyāpāraḥ prakṛṣṭam śuklam tayoḥ bāhya abhyantarayoḥ madhye jñāna vairāgye tad janitaḥ dharmaḥ tad janitau dharmau kena bāhya sādhyena dharmeṇa atiśayyete abhibhūyete

original: jñānavairāgyajāv eva dharmau tam abhibhavataḥ, bījabhāvād apanayata ity arthaḥ| atraiva suprasiddham udāharaṇam āha --- daṇḍakāraṇyam iti||4.10||
analyzed: jñāna vairāgya jau eva dharmau tam abhibhavataḥ bīja bhāvāt apanayataḥ iti arthaḥ atra eva su prasiddham udāharaṇam āha daṇḍaka araṇyam iti

original: hetuphalāśrayālambanaiḥ saṃgṛhītatvād eṣām abhāve tadabhāvaḥ||4.11||
analyzed: hetu phala āśraya ālambanaiḥ saṃgṛhīta tvāt eṣām abhāve tad abhāvaḥ

original: athaitāś cittavṛttayo vāsanāś cānādayaś cet katham āsām ucchedaḥ| na khalu citiśaktir anādir ucchidyata ity ata āha --- hetuphalāśrayālambanaiḥ saṃgṛhītatvād eṣām abhāve tadabhāvaḥ| anāder api samucchedo dṛṣṭaḥ| tadyathānāgatatvasyeti savyabhicāratvād asādhanam| citiśaktis tu vināśakāraṇābhāvān na vinaśyati, na tv anāditvāt|
analyzed: atha etāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ vāsanāḥ ca anādayaḥ ced katham āsām ucchedaḥ na khalu citi śaktiḥ anādiḥ ucchidyate iti atas āha hetu phala āśraya ālambanaiḥ saṃgṛhīta tvāt eṣām abhāve tad abhāvaḥ anādeḥ api samucchedaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tat yathā anāgata tvasya iti savyabhicāra tvāt asādhanam citi śaktiḥ tu vināśa kāraṇa abhāvāt na vinaśyati na tu anādi tvāt

original: uktaṃ ca vāsanānām anādīnām api samucchede kāraṇaṃ sūtreṇeti| anugrahopaghātāv api dharmādharmādinimittam upalakṣayataḥ| tena surāpānādayo'pi saṃgṛhītā bhavanti| netrī nāyikā| atraiva hetum āha --- mūlam iti| pratyutpannatā vartamānatā na tu dharmasvarūpotpādaḥ| atraiva hetum āha --- na hīti| yad abhimukhībhūtaṃ vastu kāminīsaṃparkādi|
analyzed: uktam ca vāsanānām anādīnām api samucchede kāraṇam sūtreṇa iti anugraha upaghātau api dharma adharma ādi nimittam upalakṣayataḥ tena surā pāna ādayaḥ api saṃgṛhītāḥ bhavanti netrī nāyikā atra eva hetum āha mūlam iti pratyutpanna tā vartamāna tā na tu dharma svarūpa utpādaḥ atra eva hetum āha na hi iti yat abhimukhībhūtam vastu kāminī saṃparka ādi

original: vyāpakābhāve vyāpyasyābhāva iti sūtrārthaḥ||4.11||
analyzed: vyāpaka abhāve vyāpyasya abhāvaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ

original: atītānāgataṃ svarūpato'sty adhvabhedād dharmāṇām||4.12||
analyzed: atīta anāgatam svarūpataḥ asti adhva bhedāt dharmāṇām

original: uttarasūtram avatārayituṃ śaṅkate --- nāstīti| asata iti tu saṃpātāyātaṃ nidarśanāya vā| atītānāgataṃ svarūpato 'sty adhvabhedād dharmāṇām| nāsatām utpādo na satāṃ vināśaḥ kiṃ tu satām eva dharmāṇām adhvabhedapariṇāma evodayavyayāv iti sūtrārthaḥ| anubhūtā prāptā yena vyaktis tat tathā| saṃprati vyaktir nāstīti yāvat|
analyzed: uttara sūtram avatārayitum śaṅkate na asti iti asataḥ iti tu saṃpāta āyātam nidarśanāya vā atīta anāgatam svarūpataḥ sti adhva bhedāt dharmāṇām na asatām utpādaḥ na satām vināśaḥ kim tu satām eva dharmāṇām adhva bheda pariṇāmaḥ eva udaya vyayau iti sūtra arthaḥ anubhūtā prāptā yena vyaktiḥ tat tathā saṃprati vyaktiḥ na asti iti yāvat

original: itaś ca traikālye 'pi dharmaḥ sann ity āha --- yadi ceti| na hy asañjñānaviṣayaḥ saṃbhavatīti nirupākhyatvād viṣayāvabhāsaṃ hi vijñānaṃ nāsati viṣaye bhavati| traikālyaviṣayaṃ ca vijñānaṃ yoginām asmadādīnāṃ ca vijñānam asati viṣaye notpannaṃ syāt| utpadyate ca| tasmād atītānāgate sāmānyarūpeṇa samanugate sta iti|
analyzed: itas ca traikālye dharmaḥ san iti āha yadi ca iti na hi asañjñāna viṣayaḥ saṃbhavati iti nirupākhya tvāt viṣaya avabhāsam hi vijñānam na asati viṣaye bhavati traikālya viṣayam ca vijñānam yoginām asmat ādīnām ca vijñānam asati viṣaye na utpannam syāt utpadyate ca tasmāt atīta anāgate sāmānya rūpeṇa samanugate staḥ iti

original: evam anubhavato jñānaṃ viṣayasattve hetur uktam| uddeśyatvād apy anāgatasya viṣayatvena sattvam evety āha --- kiṃ ca bhogabhāgīyasyeti| kuśalo nipuṇaḥ| anuṣṭheye'pi ca yad yan nimittaṃ tat sarvaṃ naimittike saty eva viśeṣam ādhatte| yathā kāṇḍalāvavedādhyāyādayaḥ| na khalv ete kāṇḍalāvādayo 'santam utpādayanti|
analyzed: evam anubhavataḥ jñānam viṣaya sattve hetuḥ uktam uddeśya tvāt api anāgatasya viṣaya tvena sattvam eva iti āha kim ca bhoga bhāgīyasya iti kuśalaḥ nipuṇaḥ anuṣṭheye api ca yat yat nimittam tat sarvam naimittike sati eva viśeṣam ādhatte yathā kāṇḍalāva veda adhyāya ādayaḥ na khalu ete santam utpādayanti

original: sata eva tu tatprāptivikārau kurvanti| evaṃ kulālādayo'pi sata eva ghaṭasya vartamānībhāvahetava ity āha --- sataś ceti| yadi tu vartamānatvābhāvād atītānāgatayor asattvaṃ hanta bho vartamānasyāpy abhāvo'tītānāgatatvābhāvāt| adhvaviśiṣṭatayā tu sattvaṃ trayāṇām apy aviśiṣṭam ity abhiprāyeṇāha --- dharmī ceti|
analyzed: sataḥ eva tu tad prāpti vikārau kurvanti evam kulāla ādayaḥ api sataḥ eva ghaṭasya vartamānībhāva hetavaḥ iti āha sataḥ ca iti yadi tu vartamāna tva abhāvāt atīta anāgatayoḥ asattvam hanta bho vartamānasya api abhāva utīta anāgata tva abhāvāt adhva viśiṣṭa tayā tu sattvam trayāṇām api aviśiṣṭam iti abhiprāyeṇa āha dharmī ca iti

original: pratyekam avasthānaṃ pratyavasthitir iti| dravyata iti dravye dharmiṇi sārvavibhaktikas tasiḥ| yady atītānāgatāv atītānāgatatve na stas tarhi vartamānasamaye tattvābhāvān na syātām ity ata āha --- ekasya ceti| prakṛtam upasaṃharati --- iti nābhūtvā bhāva iti||4.12||
analyzed: pratyekam avasthānam pratyavasthitiḥ iti dravyataḥ iti dravye dharmiṇi sārvavibhaktikaḥ tasiḥ yadi atīta anāgatau atīta anāgata tve na staḥ tarhi vartamāna samaye tattva abhāvān na syātām iti atas āha ekasya ca iti prakṛtam upasaṃharati iti na a bhūtvā bhāvaḥ iti

original: te vyaktasūkṣmā guṇātmānaḥ||4.13||
analyzed: te vyakta sūkṣmāḥ guṇa ātmānaḥ

original: syād etat| ayaṃ tu nānāprakāro dharmidharmāvasthāpariṇāmarūpo viśvabhedaprapañco na pradhānād ekasmād bhavitum arhati| na hy avilakṣaṇāt kāraṇāt kāryabhedasaṃbhava ity ata āha --- te vyaktasūkṣmā guṇātmānaḥ| te tryadhvāno dharmā vyaktāś ca sūkṣmāś ca guṇātmāno na traiguṇyātiriktam eṣām asti kāraṇam|
analyzed: syāt etat ayam tu nānā prakāraḥ dharmi dharma avasthā pariṇāma rūpaḥ viśva bheda prapañcaḥ na pradhānāt ekasmāt bhavitum arhati na hi avilakṣaṇāt kāraṇāt kārya bheda saṃbhavaḥ iti atas āha te vyakta sūkṣmāḥ guṇa ātmānaḥ te tri adhvānaḥ dharmāḥ vyaktāḥ ca sūkṣmāḥ ca guṇa ātmānaḥ na traiguṇya atiriktam eṣām asti kāraṇam

original: vaicitryaṃ tu tadāhitānādikleśavāsanānugatād vaicitryāt| yathoktaṃ vāyupurāṇe ---
analyzed: vaicitryam tu tad āhita anādi kleśa vāsanā anugatāt vaicitryāt yathā uktam vāyupurāṇe

original: "vaiśvarūpyāt pradhānasya pariṇāmo'yam adbhutaḥ" iti|
analyzed: vaiśvarūpyāt pradhānasya pariṇāmaḥ ayam adbhutaḥ iti

original: vyaktānāṃ pṛthivyādīnām ekādaśendriyāṇāṃ ca vartamānānām atītānāgatatvaṃ ṣaḍaviśeṣā yathāyogaṃ bhavanti| saṃprati viśvasya nityānityarūpe vibhajan nityarūpam āha --- sarvam idam iti| dṛśyamānaṃ saṃniveśaḥ saṃsthānabhedavān pariṇāma ity arthaḥ| atraiva ṣaṣṭitantraśāstrasyānuśiṣṭiḥ| māyeva na tu māyā| sutucchakaṃ vināśi|
analyzed: vyaktānām pṛthivī ādīnām ekādaśa indriyāṇām ca vartamānānām atīta anāgata tvam ṣaṣ aviśeṣāḥ yathāyogam bhavanti saṃprati viśvasya nitya anitya rūpe vibhajan nitya rūpam āha sarvam idam iti dṛśyamānam saṃniveśaḥ saṃsthāna bhedavān pariṇāmaḥ iti arthaḥ atra eva ṣaṣṭitantra śāstrasya anuśiṣṭiḥ māyā iva na tu māyā su tucchakam vināśi

original: yathā hi māyāhnāyaivānyathā bhavati evaṃ vikārā apy āvirbhāvatirobhāvadharmāṇaḥ pratikṣaṇam anyathā| prakṛtir nityatayā māyāvidharmiṇī paramārtheti||4.13||
analyzed: yathā hi māyā ahnāya eva anyathā bhavati evam vikārāḥ api āvirbhāva tirobhāva dharmāṇaḥ pratikṣaṇam anyathā prakṛtiḥ nitya tayā māyā vidharmiṇī paramārthā iti

original: pariṇāmaikatvād vastutattvam||4.14||

bhavatu traiguṇyasyetthaṃ pariṇāmavaicitryam ekas tu pariṇāmaḥ pṛthivīti vā toyam iti vā kuta ātmana ekatvavirodhād ity āśaṅkya sūtram avatārayati --- yadā tu sarve guṇā iti| pariṇāmaikatvād vastutattvam| bahūnām apy ekaḥ pariṇāmo dṛṣṭaḥ|
analyzed: bhavatu traiguṇyasya ittham pariṇāma vaicitryam ekaḥ tu pariṇāmaḥ pṛthivī iti vā toyam iti vā kutas ātmanaḥ eka tva virodhāt iti āśaṅkya sūtram avatārayati yadā tu sarve guṇāḥ iti pariṇāma eka tvāt vastu tattvam bahūnām api ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ

original: tadyathā gavāśvamahiṣamātaṅgānāṃ rumānikṣiptānām eko lavaṇatvajātīyalakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmo vartitailānalānāṃ ca pradīpa iti| evaṃ bahutve'pi guṇānāṃ pariṇāmaikatvaṃ, tatas tanmātrabhūtabhautikānāṃ pratyekaṃ tattvam ekatvam| grahaṇātmakānāṃ sattvapradhānatayā prakāśātmanām ahaṃkārāvāntarakāryāṇāṃ karaṇabhāvenaikaḥ pariṇāmaḥ śrotram indriyam|
analyzed: tat yathā gavāśva mahiṣa mātaṅgānām rumā nikṣiptānām ekaḥ lavaṇa tva jātīya lakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmaḥ varti taila analānām ca pradīpaḥ iti evam bahutve api guṇānām pariṇāma ekatvam tatas tanmātra bhūta bhautikānām pratyekam tattvam ekatvam grahaṇa ātmakānām sattva pradhāna tayā prakāśa ātmanām ahaṃkāra avāntara kāryāṇām karaṇa bhāvena ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ śrotram indriyam

original: teṣām eva guṇānāṃ tamaḥpradhānatayā jaḍatvena grāhyātmakānāṃ śabdatanmātrabhāvenaikaḥ pariṇāmaḥ śabdo viṣayaḥ| śabda iti śabdatanmātram| viṣaya iti jaḍatvam āha na tu tanmātrasya śrotraviṣayatvasaṃbhava iti| śeṣaṃ sugamam| atha vijñānavādinaṃ vaināśikam utthāpayati --- nāsty artho vijñānavisahacara iti|
analyzed: teṣām eva guṇānām tamaḥ pradhāna tayā jaḍa tvena grāhya ātmakānām śabda tanmātra bhāvena ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ śabdaḥ viṣayaḥ śabdaḥ iti śabda tanmātram viṣayaḥ iti jaḍa tvam āha na tu tanmātrasya śrotra viṣaya tva saṃbhavaḥ iti śeṣam sugamam atha vijñāna vādinam vaināśikam utthāpayati na asti arthaḥ vijñāna visahacaraḥ iti

original: yadi hi bhūtabhautikāni vijñānamātrād bhinnāni bhaveyus tatas tadutpattikāraṇam īdṛśaṃ pradhānaṃ kalpyeta, na tu tāni vijñānātiriktāni santi paramārthataḥ| tat kathaṃ pradhānakalpanaṃ kathaṃ ca grahaṇānām indriyāṇām ahaṃkāravikārāṇāṃ kalpaneti| tathā hi --- jaḍasyārthasya svayam aprakāśatvān nāsty artho vijñānavisahacaraḥ| sāhacaryaṃ saṃbandhaḥ|
analyzed: yadi hi bhūta bhautikāni vijñāna mātrāt bhinnāni bhaveyuḥ tatas tad utpatti kāraṇam īdṛśam pradhānam kalpyeta na tu tāni vijñāna atiriktāni santi paramārthataḥ tat katham pradhāna kalpanam katham ca grahaṇānām indriyāṇām ahaṃkāra vikārāṇām kalpanā iti tathā hi jaḍasya arthasya svayam aprakāśa tvāt na asti arthaḥ vijñāna visahacaraḥ sāhacaryam saṃbandhaḥ

original: tadabhāvo visahacaratvam| vir abhāvārthaḥ| vijñānāsaṃbandho nāsti vyavahārayogya ity arthaḥ| asti tu jñānam arthavisahacaraṃ tasya svayaṃprakāśatvena svagocarāstitāvyavahāre kartavye jaḍam arthaṃ pratyapekṣābhāvāt| tad anena vedyatvasahopalambhaniyamau sūcitau vijñānavādinā|
analyzed: tad abhāvaḥ visahacara tvam viḥ abhāva arthaḥ vijñāna asaṃbandhaḥ na asti vyavahāra yogyaḥ iti arthaḥ asti tu jñānam artha visahacaram tasya svayam prakāśa tvena sva gocara astitā vyavahāre kartavye jaḍam artham pratyapekṣā bhāvāt tat anena vedya tva sahopalambha niyamau sūcitau vijñāna vādinā

original: tau caivaṃ prayogam ārohataḥ --- yad vedyate yena vedanena tat tato na bhidyate| yathā jñānasyātmā| vedyante ca bhūtabhautikānīti viruddhavyāptopalabdhir niṣedhyabhedaviruddhenābhedena vyāptaṃ vedyatvaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ svavyāpakam abhedam upasthāpayat tadviruddhaṃ bhedaṃ pratikṣipatīti| tathā yad yena niyatasahopalambhaṃ tat tato na bhidyate|

analyzed: yathā ekasmāt candrāt dvitīyaḥ candraḥ niyata saha upalambhaḥ ca arthaḥ jñānena iti vyāpaka viruddha upalabdhiḥ niṣedhya bheda vyāpaka aniyama viruddhaḥ niyamaḥ niyamam nivartayan tad vyāptam bhedam pratikṣipati iti syāt etat arthaḥ ced na bhinnaḥ jñānāt katham bhinna vat pratibhāsate iti atas āha kalpitam iti yathā āhuḥ vaināśikāḥ

original: kalpitatvaṃ viśadayati --- jñānaparikalpaneti| nirākaroti --- ta iti| te kathaṃ śraddheyavacanāḥ syur iti saṃbandhaḥ| pratijñānam upasthitaṃ pratyupasthitam| katham --- tatheti| yathā yathāvabhāsata idaṃkārāspadatvena tathā tathā svayam upasthitaṃ na tu kalpanopakalpitaṃ vijñānaviṣayatāpannam| svamāhātmyeneti vijñānakāraṇatvam arthasya darśayati|
analyzed: kalpita tvam viśadayati jñāna parikalpanā iti nirākaroti te iti te katham śraddheya vacanāḥ syuḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ pratijñānam upasthitam pratyupasthitam katham tathā iti yathā yathā avabhāsate idaṃkāra āspada tvena tathā tathā svayam upasthitam na tu kalpanā upakalpitam vijñāna viṣaya tā āpannam sva māhātmyena iti vijñāna kāraṇa tvam arthasya darśayati

original: yasmād arthena svakīyayā grāhyaśaktyā vijñānam ajani tasmād arthasya grāhakaṃ tad evaṃbhūtaṃ vastu katham apramāṇātmakena vikalpavijñānabalena vikalpasyāprāmāṇikatvāt tadbalasyāpi tadātmano'pramāṇātmakatvaṃ, tena vastusvarūpam utsṛjyopaplutaṃ kṛtvā| upagṛhyeti kvacid pāṭhaḥ| tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| tad evāpalapantaḥ śraddhātavyavacanāḥ syur iti|
analyzed: yasmāt arthena svakīyayā grāhya śaktyā vijñānam ajani tasmāt arthasya grāhakam tat evaṃbhūtam vastu katham apramāṇa ātmakena vikalpa vijñāna balena vikalpasya aprāmāṇika tvāt tad balasya api tad ātmanā upramāṇa ātmaka tvam tena vastu svarūpam utsṛjya upaplutam kṛtvā upagṛhya iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ tatra api saḥ eva arthaḥ tat eva apalapantaḥ śraddhātavya vacanāḥ syuḥ iti

original: idam atrākūtam --- sahopalambhaniyamaś ca vedyatvaṃ ca hetū saṃdigdhavyatirekatayā naikāntikau| tathā hi --- jñānākārasya bhūtabhautikāder yad etad bāhyatvaṃ sthūlatvaṃ ca bhāsete na te jñāne saṃbhavataḥ| tathā hi nānādeśavyāpitā sthaulyaṃ vicchinnadeśatā ca bāhyatvam| na caikavijñānasya nānādeśavyāpitā vicchinnadeśatā copapadyate|
analyzed: idam atra ākūtam saha upalambha niyamaḥ ca vedya tvam ca hetū saṃdigdha vyatireka tayā na aikāntikau tathā hi jñāna ākārasya bhūta bhautika ādeḥ yat etat bāhya tvam sthūla tvam ca bhāsete na te jñāne saṃbhavataḥ tathā hi nānā deśa vyāpi tā sthaulyam vicchinna deśa tā ca bāhya tvam na ca eka vijñānasya nānā deśa vyāpi tā vicchinna deśa tā ca upapadyate

original: taddeśatvātaddeśatvalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmasaṃsargasyaikatrāsaṃbhavāt saṃbhave vā trailokyasyaikatvaprasaṅgāt| ata evāstu vijñānabheda iti cet| hanta bhoḥ paramasūkṣmagocarāṇāṃ pratyayānāṃ parasparavārtānabhijñānāṃ svagocaramātrajāgarūkāṇāṃ kutastyo'yaṃ sthūlāvabhāsaḥ| na ca vikalpagocaro'bhilāpaḥ saṃsargābhāvād viśadapratibhāsatvāc ca|
analyzed: tad deśa tva a tad deśa tva lakṣaṇa viruddha dharma saṃsargasya ekatra asaṃbhavāt saṃbhave vā trailokyasya ekatva prasaṅgāt atas eva astu vijñāna bhedaḥ iti ced hanta bhoḥ parama sūkṣma gocarāṇām pratyayānām paraspara vārtā anabhijñānām sva gocara mātra jāgarūkāṇām kutastyaḥ yam sthūla avabhāsaḥ na ca vikalpa gocaraḥ abhilāpaḥ saṃsarga abhāvāt viśada pratibhāsa tvāt ca

original: na ca sthūlam ālocitaṃ yatas tadupādhikasya viśadatā bhavet tatpṛṣṭhabhāvinaḥ| na cāvikalpavad vikalpo'pi svākāramātragocaras tasya cāsthūlatvān na sthūlagocaro bhavitum arhati| tasmād bāhye ca pratyaye sthūlasya bāhyasya cāsaṃbhavād alīkam etad āsthātavyam| na cālīkaṃ vijñānād abhinnaṃ vijñānasya tadvat tucchatvaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: na ca sthūlam ālocitam yatas tad upādhikasya viśada tā bhavet tad pṛṣṭha bhāvinaḥ na ca avikalpa vat vikalpaḥ api sva ākāra mātra gocaraḥ tasya ca asthūla tvāt na sthūla gocaraḥ bhavitum arhati tasmāt bāhye ca pratyaye sthūlasya bāhyasya ca asaṃbhavāt alīkam etat āsthātavyam na ca alīkam vijñānāt abhinnam vijñānasya tadvat tuccha tva prasaṅgāt

original: tathā ca vedyatvasyābhedavyāpyatvābhāvāt kuto bhedapratipakṣatvam| sahopalambhaniyamaś ca sadasator iva vijñānasthaulyayoḥ sator api svabhāvād vā kutaścit pratibandhād vopapatsyate| tasmād anaikāntikatvād etau hetvābhāsau vikalpamātram eva bāhyābhāve prasuvāte| na ca pratyakṣamāhātmyaṃ vikalpamātreṇāpodyate|
analyzed: tathā ca vedya tvasya abheda vyāpya tva abhāvāt kutas bheda pratipakṣa tvam saha upalambha niyamaḥ ca sat asatoḥ iva vijñāna sthaulyayoḥ satoḥ api svabhāvāt vā kutaścid pratibandhāt vā upapatsyate tasmāt anaikāntika tvāt etau hetvābhāsau vikalpa mātram eva bāhya abhāve prasuvāte na ca pratyakṣa māhātmyam vikalpa mātreṇa apodyate

original: tasmāt sādhūktaṃ katham apramāṇātmakena vikalpajñānabaleneti| etena pratyayatvam api svapnādipratyayadṛṣṭāntena nirālambanatvasādhanam apāstam| prameyavikalpas tv avayavivyavasthāpanena pratyuktaḥ| vistaras tu nyāyakaṇikāyām anusaraṇīya iti tad iha kṛtaṃ vistareṇeti||4.14||
analyzed: tasmāt sādhu uktam katham apramāṇa ātmakena vikalpa jñāna balena iti etena pratyaya tvam api svapna ādi pratyaya dṛṣṭāntena nirālambana tva sādhanam apāstam prameya vikalpaḥ tu avayavi vyavasthāpanena pratyuktaḥ vistaraḥ tu nyāya kaṇikāyām anusaraṇīyaḥ iti tat iha kṛtam vistareṇa iti

original: vastusāmye cittabhedāt tayor vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ||4.15||
analyzed: vastu sāmye citta bhedāt tayoḥ vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ

original: tad evam utsūtraṃ bhāṣyakṛd vijñānātiriktasthāpane yuktim uktvā sautrīṃ yuktim avatārayati --- kutaś caitad iti| vastusāmye cittabhedāt tayor vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ| yannānātve yasyaikatvaṃ tat tato'tyantaṃ bhidyate| yathā caitrasya jñānam ekaṃ bhinnebhyo devadattaviṣṇumitramaitrapratyayebhyo bhidyate|
analyzed: tat evam utsūtram bhāṣyakṛt vijñāna atirikta sthāpane yuktim uktvā sautrīm yuktim avatārayati kutas ca etat iti vastu sāmye citta bhedāt tayoḥ vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ yat nānātve yasya ekatvam tat tatas utyantam bhidyate yathā caitrasya jñānam ekam bhinnebhyaḥ devadatta viṣṇumitra maitra pratyayebhyaḥ bhidyate

original: jñānanānātve 'pi cārtho na bhidyata iti bhavati vijñānebhyo'nyaḥ| abhedaś cārthasya jñānabhede'pi pramātQṇāṃ parasparapratisaṃdhānād avasīyate| asti hi raktadviṣṭavimūḍhamadhyasthānām ekasyāṃ yoṣiti pratīyamānāyāṃ pratisaṃdhānaṃ yā tvayā dṛśyate saiva mayāpīti|
analyzed: jñāna nānātve pi ca arthaḥ na bhidyate iti bhavati vijñānebhyaḥ nyaḥ abhedaḥ ca arthasya jñāna bhede pi pramātṇām paraspara pratisaṃdhānāt avasīyate asti hi rakta dviṣṭa vimūḍha madhyasthānām ekasyām yoṣiti pratīyamānāyām pratisaṃdhānam yā tvayā dṛśyate sā eva mayā api iti

original: tasmād vastusāmye cittabhedāj jñānabhedāt tayor arthajñānayor vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ svarūpabhedopāyaḥ| sukhajñānaṃ kāntāyāṃ kāntasya, sapatnīnāṃ duḥkhajñānam| caitrasya tu tām avindato mūḍhajñānaṃ viṣādaḥ| syād etat|
analyzed: tasmāt vastu sāmye citta bhedāt jñāna bhedāt tayoḥ artha jñānayoḥ vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ svarūpa bheda upāyaḥ sukha jñānam kāntāyām kāntasya sapatnīnām duḥkha jñānam caitrasya tu tām a vindataḥ mūḍha jñānam viṣādaḥ syāt etat

original: ya ekasya cittena parikalpitaḥ kāminīlakṣaṇo'rthas tenaivānyeṣām api cittam uparajyata iti sādhāraṇam upapadyata ity ata āha --- na cānyeti| tathā saty ekasmin nīlajñānavati sarva eva nīlajñānavantaḥ syur iti| nanv arthavādinām apy eko'rthaḥ kathaṃ sukhādibhedabhinnavijñānahetuḥ|
analyzed: yaḥ ekasya cittena parikalpitaḥ kāminī lakṣaṇaḥ ūrthaḥ tena eva anyeṣām api cittam uparajyate iti sādhāraṇam upapadyate iti atas āha na ca anyā iti tathā sati ekasmin nīla jñānavati sarve eva nīla jñānavantaḥ syuḥ iti nanu arthavādinām api ekaḥ ūrthaḥ katham sukha ādi bheda bhinna vijñāna hetuḥ

original: na hy avilakṣaṇāt kāraṇāt kāryabhedo yukta ity ata āha --- sāṃkhyapakṣa iti| ekasyaiva bāhyasya vastunas traiguṇyapariṇāmasya trairūpyam upapannam| evam api sarveṣām aviśeṣeṇa sukhaduḥkhamohātmakaṃ vijñānaṃ syād ity ata āha --- dharmādinimittāpekṣaṃ rajaḥsahitaṃ sattvaṃ dharmāpekṣaṃ sukhajñānaṃ janayati|
analyzed: na hi avilakṣaṇāt kāraṇāt kārya bhedaḥ yuktaḥ iti atas āha sāṃkhya pakṣaḥ iti ekasya eva bāhyasya vastunaḥ traiguṇya pariṇāmasya trairūpyam upapannam evam api sarveṣām aviśeṣeṇa sukha duḥkha moha ātmakam vijñānam syāt iti atas āha dharma ādi nimitta apekṣam rajaḥ sahitam sattvam dharma apekṣam sukha jñānam janayati

original: sattvam eva tu vigalitarajaskaṃ vidyāpekṣaṃ mādhyasthyajñānam iti| te ca dharmādayo na sarve sarvatra puruṣe santi kiṃ tu kaścit kvacid ity upapannā vyavastheti| atra kecid āhuḥ prāvādukā jñānasahabhūr evārtho bhogyatvāt sukhādivad iti|
analyzed: sattvam eva tu vigalita rajaskam vidyā apekṣam mādhyasthya jñānam iti te ca dharma ādayaḥ na sarve sarvatra puruṣe santi kim tu kaścid kvacid iti upapannā vyavasthā iti atra kecid āhuḥ prāvādukāḥ eva arthaḥ bhogya tvāt sukha ādi vat iti

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- bhavatv artho jñānād vyatiriktas tathāpy asau jaḍatvān na jñānam antareṇa śakyaḥ pratipattum| jñānena tu bhāsanīyaḥ| tathā ca jñānasamaya evāsti nānyadā pramāṇābhāvād iti| tad etad utsūtraṃ tāvad dūṣayati bhāṣyakāraḥ --- ta etayā dvāreti|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati bhavatu arthaḥ jñānāt vyatiriktaḥ tathā api asau jaḍa tvāt na jñānam antareṇa śakyaḥ pratipattum jñānena tu bhāsanīyaḥ tathā ca jñāna samayaḥ eva asti na anyadā pramāṇa abhāvāt iti tat etat utsūtram tāvat dūṣayati bhāṣyakāraḥ te etayā dvārā iti

original: vastu khalu sarvacittasādhāraṇam anekakṣaṇaparamparohyamānaṃ pariṇāmātmakam anubhūyate laukikaparīkṣakaiḥ| tac ced vijñānena saha bhaven nūnam evaṃvidham evaṃ ced idamaṃśasyopari ko'yam anurodho yena so 'pi nāpahnūyetety arthaḥ||4.15||
analyzed: vastu khalu sarva citta sādhāraṇam aneka kṣaṇa paramparā uhyamānam pariṇāma ātmakam anubhūyate laukika parīkṣakaiḥ tat ced vijñānena saha bhavet nūnam evaṃvidham evam ced idam aṃśasya upari kaḥ yam anurodhaḥ yena saḥ pi na apahnūyeta iti arthaḥ

original: yad vā vivekaviṣayam āsīt tad eva ca nirodhaṃ samāpadyate tadā ghaṭajñānasya vā vivekajñānasya vābhāvād viveko vā ghaṭo vā jñānabhedamātrajīvanas tannāśān naṣṭa eva syād ity āha --- ekacitteti| kiṃ tat syān na syād ity arthaḥ| saṃbadhyamānaṃ ca cittena tadvastu viveko vā ghaṭo vā kuta utpadyeta|
analyzed: yat vā viveka viṣayam āsīt tat eva ca nirodham samāpadyate tadā ghaṭa jñānasya vā viveka jñānasya vā abhāvāt vivekaḥ vā ghaṭaḥ vā jñāna bheda mātra jīvanaḥ tad nāśāt naṣṭaḥ eva syāt iti āha eka citta iti kim tat syāt na syāt iti arthaḥ saṃbadhyamānam ca cittena tat vastu vivekaḥ vā ghaṭaḥ vā kutas utpadyeta

original: niyatakāraṇānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyibhāvāni hi kāryāṇi na svakāraṇam ativartya kāraṇāntarād bhavitum īśate| mā bhūd akāraṇatve teṣāṃ kādācitkatvavyāghātaḥ| na ca tajjñānakāraṇatvam eva tatkāraṇatvam iti yuktam| āśāmodakasya modakasya copayujyamānasya rasavīryavipākādisāmyaprasaṅgāt| tasmāt sādhūktaṃ saṃbadhyamānaṃ vā (ca) punaś citteneti|
analyzed: niyata kāraṇa anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi bhāvāni hi kāryāṇi na sva kāraṇam ativartya kāraṇa antarāt bhavitum īśate mā bhūt akāraṇa tve teṣām kādācitkatva vyāghātaḥ na ca tad jñāna kāraṇa tvam eva tad kāraṇa tvam iti yuktam āśā modakasya modakasya ca upayujyamānasya rasa vīrya vipāka ādi sāmya prasaṅgāt tasmāt sādhu uktam saṃbadhyamānam vā ca punar cittena iti

original: api ca yo yo'rvāgbhāgaḥ sa sarvo madhyaparabhāgavyāptaḥ| jñānādhīne sadbhāve tv asyānanubhūyamānatvān madhyaparabhāgau na sta iti vyāpakābhāvād arvāgbhāgo'pi na syād ity arthābhāvāt kuto jñānasahabhūr artha ity āha --- ye cāsyeti| anupasthitā ajñātāḥ| upasaṃharati --- tasmād iti| sugamaṃ śeṣam||4.16||
analyzed: api ca yaḥ sa sarvaḥ madhya parabhāga vyāptaḥ jñāna adhīne sadbhāve tu asya ananubhūyamāna tvāt madhya parabhāgau na staḥ iti vyāpaka abhāvāt arvāc bhāgaḥ upi na syāt iti artha abhāvāt kutas jñāna sahabhūḥ arthaḥ iti āha ye ca asya iti anupasthitāḥ ajñātāḥ upasaṃharati tasmāt iti sugamam śeṣam

original: syād etad arthaś cet svatantraḥ, sa ca jaḍasvabhāva iti na kadācit prakāśeta| prakāśane vā jaḍatvam apy asyāpagatam iti bhāvo 'py apagacchet| na jātu svabhāvam apahāya bhāvo vartitum arhati| na cendriyādyādheyo jaḍasvabhāvasyārthasya dharmaḥ prakāśata iti sāṃpratam|
