original: arthadharmatve nīlatvādivat sarvapuruṣasādhāraṇa ity ekaḥ śāstrārtha iti sarva eva vidvāṃsaḥ prasajyeran na jālmaḥ kaścid asti| na cātītānāgatayor dharmaḥ pratyutpanno yuktaḥ| tasmāt svatantro'rtha upalambhaviṣaya iti manorathamātram etad ity ata āha --- taduparāgāpekṣitvāc cittasya vastu jñātājñātam|
analyzed: artha dharma tve nīla tva ādi vat sarva puruṣa sādhāraṇaḥ iti ekaḥ śāstra arthaḥ iti sarve eva vidvāṃsaḥ prasajyeran na jālmaḥ kaścid asti na ca atīta anāgatayoḥ dharmaḥ pratyutpannaḥ yuktaḥ tasmāt svatantraḥ ūrthaḥ upalambha viṣayaḥ iti manoratha mātram etat iti atas āha tad uparāga apekṣi tvāt cittasya vastu jñāta ajñātam

original: jaḍasvabhāvo'py artha indriyapraṇāḍikayā cittam uparañjayati| tad evaṃbhūtaṃ cittadarpaṇam upasaṃkrāntapratibimbā citiśaktiś cittam arthoparaktaṃ cetayamānārtham anubhavati, na tv arthe kiṃcit prākaṭyādikam ādhatte| nāpy asaṃbaddhā cittena tatpratibimbasaṃkrānter uktatvād iti|
analyzed: jaḍa svabhāvaḥ api arthaḥ indriya praṇāḍikayā cittam uparañjayati tat evaṃbhūtam citta darpaṇam upasaṃkrānta pratibimbā citi śaktiḥ cittam artha uparaktam cetayamāna artham anubhavati na tu arthe kiṃcid prākaṭya ādikam ādhatte na api asaṃbaddhā cittena tad pratibimba saṃkrānteḥ ukta tvāt iti

original: yady api ca sarvagatatvāc cittasya cendriyasya cāhaṃkārikasya viṣaye nāsti saṃbandhas tathāpi yatra śarīre vṛttimac cittaṃ tena saha saṃbandho viṣayāṇām ity ayaskāntamaṇikalpā ity uktam| ayaḥsadharmakaṃ cittam iti| indriyapraṇāḍikayābhisaṃbandhyoparañjayanti| ata eva cittaṃ pariṇāmīty āha --- vastuna iti||4.17||
analyzed: yadi api ca sarvagata tvāt cittasya ca indriyasya ca āhaṃkārikasya viṣaye na asti saṃbandhaḥ tathā api yatra śarīre vṛttimat cittam tena saha saṃbandhaḥ viṣayāṇām iti ayaskānta maṇi kalpāḥ iti uktam ayaḥ sadharmakam cittam iti indriya praṇāḍikayā abhisaṃbandhya uparañjayanti atas eva cittam pariṇāmi iti āha vastunaḥ iti

original: sadā jñātāś cittavṛttayas tatprabhoḥ puruṣasyāpariṇāmitvāt||4.18||
analyzed: sadā jñātāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ tad prabhoḥ puruṣasya apariṇāmi tvāt

original: tad evaṃ cittavyatirekiṇam artham avasthāpya tebhyaḥ pariṇatidharmakebhyo vyatiriktam ātmānam ādarśayituṃ tadvaidharmyam apariṇāmitvam asya vaktuṃ pūrayitvā sūtraṃ paṭhati --- yasya tu tad eva cittaṃ viṣayas tasya --- sadā jñātāś cittavṛttayas tatprabhoḥ puruṣasyāpariṇāmitvāt|
analyzed: tat evam citta vyatirekiṇam artham avasthāpya tebhyaḥ pariṇati dharmakebhyaḥ vyatiriktam ātmānam ādarśayitum tad vaidharmyam apariṇāmi tvam asya vaktum pūrayitvā sūtram paṭhati yasya tu tat eva cittam viṣayaḥ tasya sadā jñātāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ tad prabhoḥ puruṣasya apariṇāmi tvāt

original: kṣiptamūḍhavikṣiptaikāgratāvasthitaṃ cittam ā nirodhāt sarvadā puruṣeṇānubhūyate vṛttimat tat kasya hetor yataḥ puruṣo'pariṇāmī pariṇāmitve cittavat puruṣo'pi jñātājñātaviṣayo bhavet| jñātaviṣaya eva tv ayam| tasmād apariṇāmī| tataś ca pariṇāmibhyo'tiricyata iti| tad etad āha --- yadi cittavad iti|
analyzed: kṣipta mūḍha vikṣipta ekāgra tā avasthitam cittam nirodhāt sarvadā puruṣeṇa anubhūyate vṛttimat tat kasya hetoḥ yatas puruṣa upariṇāmī pariṇāmi tve citta vat puruṣaḥ api jñāta ajñāta viṣayaḥ bhavet jñāta viṣayaḥ eva tu ayam tasmāt apariṇāmī tatas ca pariṇāmibhyaḥ atiricyate iti tat etat āha yadi citta vat iti

original: sadā jñātatvaṃ tu manasaḥ savṛttikasya tasya yaḥ prabhuḥ svāmī bhokteti yāvat| tasya prabhoḥ puruṣasyāpariṇāmitvam anumāpayati| tathā cāpariṇāminas tasya puruṣasya pariṇāminaś cittād bheda iti bhāvaḥ||4.18||
analyzed: sadā jñāta tvam tu manasaḥ sa vṛttikasya tasya yaḥ prabhuḥ svāmī bhoktā iti yāvat tasya prabhoḥ puruṣasya apariṇāmi tvam anumāpayati tathā ca apariṇāminaḥ tasya puruṣasya pariṇāminaḥ cittāt bhedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: na tat svābhāsaṃ dṛśyatvāt||4.19||
analyzed: na tat su ābhāsam dṛśya tvāt

original: atra vaināśikam utthāpayati --- syād āśaṅketi| ayam arthaḥ --- syād etad evaṃ yadi cittam ātmano viṣayaḥ syāt, api tu svaprakāśam etad viṣayābhāsaṃ pūrvacittaṃ pratītya samutpannaṃ tat kutaḥ puruṣasya sadājñātaviṣayatvaṃ kutastarāṃ vāpariṇāmitayā pariṇāminaś cittād bheda iti| na tat svābhāsaṃ dṛśyatvāt|
analyzed: atra vaināśikam utthāpayati syāt āśaṅkā iti ayam arthaḥ syāt etat evam yadi cittam ātmanaḥ viṣayaḥ syāt api tu sva prakāśam etat viṣaya ābhāsam pūrva cittam pratītya samutpannam tat kutas puruṣasya sadā ajñāta viṣaya tvam kutastarām vā apariṇāmi tayā pariṇāminaḥ cittāt bhedaḥ iti na tat sva ābhāsam dṛśya tvāt

original: bhaved etad evaṃ yadi svasaṃvedanaṃ cittaṃ syān na tv etad asti| tad dhi pariṇāmitayā nīlādivad anubhavavyāpyaṃ yac cānubhavavyāpyaṃ na tat svābhāsaṃ bhavitum arhati svātmani vṛttivirodhāt| na hi tad eva kriyā ca karmakārakaṃ ca| na hi pākaḥ pacyate chidā vā chidyate| puruṣas tv apariṇāmī nānubhavakarmeti nāsmin svayaṃprakāśatā na yujyate|
analyzed: bhavet etat evam yadi sva saṃvedanam cittam syāt na tu etat asti tat hi pariṇāmi tayā nīla ādi vat anubhava vyāpyam yat ca anubhava vyāpyam na tat sva ābhāsam bhavitum arhati sva ātmani vṛtti virodhāt na hi tat eva kriyā ca karma kārakam ca na hi pākaḥ pacyate chidā vā chidyate puruṣaḥ tu apariṇāmī na anubhava karma iti na asmin svayaṃprakāśa tā na yujyate

original: aparādhīnaprakāśatā hy asya svayaṃprakāśatā nānubhavakarmatā| tasmād dṛśyatvād darśanakarma cittaṃ na svābhāsam| ātmaprakāśapratibimbatayaiva cittasya tadvṛttiviṣayāḥ prakāśanta iti bhāvaḥ| nanu dṛśyo'gniḥ svayaṃprakāśaś ca| na hi yathā ghaṭādayo'gninā vyajyanta evam agnir agnyantareṇety ata āha --- na cāgnir atreti| kasmāt| na hīti|
analyzed: apara adhīna prakāśa tā hi asya svayaṃprakāśa tā na anubhava karma tā tasmāt dṛśya tvāt darśana karma cittam na su ābhāsam ātma prakāśa pratibimba tayā eva cittasya tad vṛtti viṣayāḥ prakāśante iti bhāvaḥ nanu dṛśya ugniḥ svayaṃprakāśaḥ ca na hi yathā ghaṭa ādayaḥ ugninā vyajyante evam agniḥ agni antareṇa iti atas āha na ca agniḥ atra iti kasmāt na hi iti

original: mā nāmāgnir agnyantarāt prakāśiṣṭa vijñānāt tu prakāśata iti na svayaṃ prakāśata iti na vyabhicāra ity arthaḥ| prakāśaś cāyam iti| ayam iti puruṣasvabhāvāt prakāśād vyavacchinatti, kriyārūpaḥ prakāśa iti yāvat| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- yā yā kriyā sā sā sarvā kartṛkaraṇakarmasaṃbandhena dṛṣṭā|
analyzed: mā nāma agniḥ agni antarāt prakāśiṣṭa vijñānāt tu prakāśate iti na svayam prakāśate iti na vyabhicāraḥ iti arthaḥ prakāśaḥ ca ayam iti ayam iti puruṣa svabhāvāt prakāśāt vyavacchinatti kriyā rūpaḥ prakāśaḥ iti yāvat etat uktam bhavati yā yā kriyā sā sā sarvā kartṛ karaṇa karma saṃbandhena dṛṣṭā

original: yathā pāko dṛṣṭaś caitrāgnitaṇḍulasaṃbandhena yathā vā prakāśanam| tathā ca prakāśo'pi kriyeti tayāpi tathā bhavitavyam| saṃbandhaś ca bhedāśrayo nābhede saṃbhavatīty arthaḥ| kiṃ ca svābhāsaṃ cittam ity agrāhyam eva kasyacid iti śabdārthaḥ| syād etat| mā bhūd grāhyaṃ cittam|
analyzed: yathā pākaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ caitra agni taṇḍula saṃbandhena yathā vā prakāśanam tathā ca prakāśaḥ api kriyā iti tayā api tathā bhavitavyam saṃbandhaḥ ca bheda āśrayaḥ na abhede saṃbhavati iti arthaḥ kim ca su ābhāsam cittam iti agrāhyam eva kasyacid iti śabda arthaḥ syāt etat mā bhūt grāhyam cittam

original: na hi grahaṇasyākāraṇasyāvyāpakasya ca nivṛttau cittanivṛttir ity ata āha --- svabuddhīti| buddhiś cittaṃ, pracārā vyāpārāḥ, sattvāḥ prāṇinaḥ, cittasya vṛttibhedāḥ krodhalobhādayaḥ svāśrayeṇa cittena svaviṣayeṇa ca saha pratyātmam anubhūyamānāś cittasyāgrāhyatāṃ vighaṭayantīty arthaḥ|
analyzed: na hi grahaṇasya akāraṇasya avyāpakasya ca nivṛttau citta nivṛttiḥ iti atas āha sva buddhi iti buddhiḥ cittam pracārāḥ vyāpārāḥ sattvāḥ prāṇinaḥ cittasya vṛtti bhedāḥ krodha lobha ādayaḥ sva āśrayeṇa cittena sva viṣayeṇa ca saha pratyātmam anubhūyamānāḥ cittasya agrāhya tām vighaṭayanti iti arthaḥ

original: svabuddhipracārapratisaṃvedanam eva viśadayati --- kruddho 'ham iti||4.19||
analyzed: sva buddhi pracāra pratisaṃvedanam eva viśadayati kruddhaḥ ham iti

original: ekasamaye cobhayānavadhāraṇam||4.20||
analyzed: eka samaye ca ubhaya anavadhāraṇam

original: ekasamaye cobhayānavadhāraṇam| svābhāsaṃ viṣayābhāsaṃ cittam iti bruvāṇo na tāvad yenaiva vyāpāreṇātmānam avadhārayati tenaiva viṣayam apīti vaktum arhati| na hy avilakṣaṇo vyāpāraḥ kāryabhedāya paryāptas tasmād vyāpārabhedo'ṅgīkartavyaḥ| na ca vaināśikānām utpattibhedātirikto'sti vyāpāraḥ|
analyzed: eka samaye ca ubhaya anavadhāraṇam su ābhāsam viṣaya ābhāsam cittam iti bruvāṇaḥ na tāvat yena eva vyāpāreṇa ātmānam avadhārayati tena eva viṣayam api iti vaktum arhati na hi avilakṣaṇaḥ vyāpāraḥ kārya bhedāya paryāptaḥ tasmāt vyāpāra bheda uṅgīkartavyaḥ na ca vaināśikānām utpatti bheda atiriktaḥ asti vyāpāraḥ

original: na caikasyā evotpatter avilakṣaṇāyāḥ kāryavailakṣaṇyasaṃbhavaḥ| tasyākasmikatvaprasaṅgāt| na caikasyotpattidvayasaṃbhavaḥ| tasmād arthasya ca jñānarūpasya cāvadhāraṇaṃ naikasmin samaya iti| tad etad bhāṣyeṇocyate --- na caikasmin kṣaṇa iti| tathā coktaṃ vaināśikaiḥ ---
analyzed: na ca ekasyāḥ eva utpatteḥ avilakṣaṇāyāḥ kārya vailakṣaṇya saṃbhavaḥ tasya ākasmika tva prasaṅgāt na ca ekasya utpatti dvaya saṃbhavaḥ tasmāt arthasya ca jñāna rūpasya ca avadhāraṇam na ekasmin samaye iti tat etat bhāṣyeṇa ucyate na ca ekasmin kṣaṇe iti tathā ca uktam vaināśikaiḥ

original: "bhūtir yeṣāṃ kriyā saiva kārakaṃ saiva cocyate" iti|
analyzed: bhūtiḥ yeṣām kriyā sā eva kārakam sā eva ca ucyate iti

original: tasmād dṛśyatvam etac cittasya sadātanaṃ svābhāsatvam apanayad draṣṭāraṃ ca draṣṭur apariṇāmitvaṃ ca darśayatīti siddham||4.20||
analyzed: tasmāt dṛśya tvam etat cittasya sadātanam su ābhāsa tvam apanayat draṣṭāram ca draṣṭuḥ apariṇāmi tvam ca darśayati iti siddham

original: cittāntaradṛśye buddhibuddher atiprasaṅgaḥ smṛtisaṃkaraś ca||4.21||
analyzed: citta antara dṛśye buddhi buddheḥ atiprasaṅgaḥ smṛti saṃkaraḥ ca

original: punar vaināaśikam utthāpayati --- syān matiḥ| mā bhūd dṛśyatvena svasaṃvedanam| evam apy ātmā na sidhyati| svasaṃtānavartinā caramacittakṣaṇena svarasaniruddhasvajanakacittakṣaṇagrahaṇād ity arthaḥ| samaṃ ca tajjñānatvenānantaraṃ cāvyavahitatvena samanantaraṃ tena| cittāntaradṛśye buddhibuddher atiprasaṅgaḥ smṛtisaṃkaraś ca|
analyzed: punar vaināaśikam utthāpayati syāt matiḥ mā bhūt dṛśya tvena sva saṃvedanam evam api ātmā na sidhyati sva saṃtāna vartinā carama citta kṣaṇena sva rasa niruddha sva janaka citta kṣaṇa grahaṇāt iti arthaḥ samam ca tad jñāna tvena anantaram ca avyavahita tvena samanantaram tena citta antara dṛśye buddhi buddheḥ atiprasaṅgaḥ smṛti saṃkaraḥ ca

original: buddhir iti cittam ity arthaḥ| nāgṛhītā caramā buddhiḥ pūrvabuddhigrahaṇasamarthā| na hi buddhyāsaṃbaddhā pūrvabuddhir buddhā bhavitum arhati| na hy agṛhītadaṇḍo daṇḍinam avagantum arhati| tasmād anavastheti| vijñānavedanāsaṃjñārūpasaṃskārāḥ skandhāḥ|
analyzed: buddhiḥ iti cittam iti arthaḥ na agṛhītā caramā buddhiḥ pūrva buddhi grahaṇa samarthā na hi buddhyā asaṃbaddhā pūrva buddhiḥ buddhā bhavitum arhati na hi agṛhīta daṇḍaḥ daṇḍinam avagantum arhati tasmāt anavasthā iti vijñāna vedanā saṃjñā rūpa saṃskārāḥ skandhāḥ

original: sāṃkhyayogādayaḥ pravādāḥ sāṃkhyāś ca yogāś ca ta evādayo yeṣāṃ vaiśeṣikādipravādānāṃ te sāṃkhyayogādayaḥ pravādāḥ| sugamam anyat||4.21||
analyzed: sāṃkhya yoga ādayaḥ pravādāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ ca yogāḥ ca te eva ādayaḥ yeṣām vaiśeṣika ādi pravādānām te sāṃkhya yoga ādayaḥ pravādāḥ sugamam anyat

original: citer apratisaṃkramāyās tadākārāpattau svabuddhisaṃvedanam||4.22||
analyzed: citeḥ apratisaṃkramāyāḥ tad ākāra āpattau sva buddhi saṃvedanam

original: syād etat| yadi cittaṃ na svābhāsaṃ nāpi cittāntaravedyam ātmanāpi kathaṃ bhokṣyate cittam| na khalv ātmanaḥ svayaṃprakāśasyāpy asti kācit kriyā| na ca tām antareṇa kartā na cāsaṃbaddhaś cittena karmaṇā tasya bhoktātiprasaṅgād ity āśayavān pṛcchati --- katham iti| sūtreṇottaram āha --- citer apratisaṃkramāyās tadākārāpattau svabuddhisaṃvedanam|
analyzed: syāt etat yadi cittam na sva ābhāsam na api citta antara vedyam ātmanā api katham bhokṣyate cittam na khalu ātmanaḥ svayam prakāśasya api asti kācid kriyā na ca tām antareṇa kartā na ca asaṃbaddhaḥ cittena karmaṇā tasya bhoktā atiprasaṅgāt iti āśayavān pṛcchati katham iti sūtreṇa uttaram āha citeḥ apratisaṃkramāyāḥ tad ākāra āpattau sva buddhi saṃvedanam

original: yat tad avocad vṛttisārūpyam itaratra iti tad itaḥ samutthitam| citeḥ svabuddhisaṃvedanaṃ buddhes tadākārāpattau citipratibimbādhāratayā tadrūpatāpattau satyām|
analyzed: yat tat avocat vṛtti sārūpyam itaratra iti tat itas samutthitam citeḥ sva buddhi saṃvedanam buddheḥ tad ākāra āpattau citi pratibimba ādhāra tayā tad rūpa tā āpattau satyām

original: yathā hi candramasaḥ kriyām antareṇāpi saṃkrāntacandrapratibimbam amalaṃ jalam acalaṃ calam ivālavālam arālam iva candramasam avabhāsayati evaṃ vināpi citivyāpāram upasaṃkrāntacitipratibimbaṃ cittaṃ svagatayā kriyayā kriyāvatīm asaṃgatām api saṃgatāṃ citiśaktim avabhāsayad bhogyabhāvam āsādayad bhoktṛbhāvam āpādayati tasyā iti sūtrārthaḥ|
analyzed: yathā hi candramasaḥ kriyām antareṇa api saṃkrānta candra pratibimbam amalam jalam acalam calam iva ālavālam arālam iva candramasam avabhāsayati evam vinā api citi vyāpāram upasaṃkrānta citi pratibimbam cittam svagatayā kriyayā kriyāvatīm asaṃgatām api saṃgatām citi śaktim avabhāsayat bhogya bhāvam āsādayat bhoktṛ bhāvam āpādayati tasyāḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ

original: bhāṣyam apy etad artham asakṛt tatra tatra vyākhyātam iti na vyākhyātam atra| buddhivṛttyaviśiṣṭatve jñānavṛtter āgamam udāharati --- tathā coktaṃ --- na pātālam iti| śāśvatasya śivasya brahmaṇo viśuddhasvabhāvasya citicchāyāpannāṃ manovṛttim eva citicchāyāpannatvāc citer apy aviśiṣṭāṃ guhāṃ vedayante|
analyzed: bhāṣyam api etat artham asakṛt tatra tatra vyākhyātam iti na vyākhyātam atra buddhi vṛtti aviśiṣṭa tve jñāna vṛtteḥ āgamam udāharati tathā ca uktam na pātālam iti śāśvatasya śivasya brahmaṇaḥ viśuddha svabhāvasya citi chāyā āpannām manaḥ vṛttim eva citi chāyā āpanna tvāt citeḥ api a viśiṣṭām guhām vedayante

original: tasyām eva guhāyāṃ tad guhyaṃ brahma tadapanaye tu svayaṃprakāśam anāvaraṇam anupasargaṃ pradyotate caramadehasya bhagavata iti||4.22||
analyzed: tasyām eva guhāyām tat guhyam brahma tad apanaye tu svayam prakāśam an āvaraṇam an upasargam pradyotate carama dehasya bhagavataḥ iti

original: draṣṭṛdṛśyoparaktaṃ cittaṃ sarvārtham||4.23||
analyzed: draṣṭṛ dṛśya uparaktam cittam sarva artham

original: tad evaṃ dṛśyatvena cittasya pariṇāminas tadatiriktaḥ pumān apariṇatidharmopapāditaḥ saṃprati lokapratyakṣam apy atra pramāṇayati --- ataś caitad iti| avaśyaṃ caitad ity arthaḥ| draṣṭṛdṛśyoparaktaṃ cittaṃ sarvārtham|
analyzed: tat evam dṛśya tvena cittasya pariṇāminaḥ tad atiriktaḥ pumān a pariṇati dharma upapāditaḥ saṃprati loka pratyakṣam api atra pramāṇayati atas ca etat iti avaśyam ca etat iti arthaḥ draṣṭṛ dṛśya uparaktam cittam sarva artham

original: yathā hi nīlādyanuraktaṃ cittaṃ nīlādyarthaṃ pratyakṣeṇaivāvasthāpayati evaṃ draṣṭṛcchāyāpattyā tadanuraktaṃ cittaṃ draṣṭāram api pratyakṣeṇāvasthāpayati| asti hi tryākāraṃ jñānaṃ nīlam ahaṃ saṃpratyemīti| tasmāj jñeyavat tajjñātāpi pratyakṣasiddho'pi na vivicyāvasthāpito yathā jale candramaso bimbam| na tv etāvatā tad apratyakṣam|
analyzed: yathā hi nīla ādi anuraktam cittam nīla ādi artham pratyakṣeṇa eva avasthāpayati evam draṣṭṛ chāyā āpattyā tad anuraktam cittam draṣṭāram api pratyakṣeṇa avasthāpayati asti hi tri ākāram jñānam nīlam aham saṃpratyemi iti tasmāt jñeya vat tad jñātā api pratyakṣa siddhaḥ api na vivicya avasthāpitaḥ yathā jale candramasaḥ bimbam na tu etāvatā tat apratyakṣam

original: na cāsya jalagatatve tad apramāṇam iti candrarūpe'py apramāṇaṃ bhavitum arhati| tasmāc cittapratibimbatayā caitanyagocarāpi cittavṛttir na caitanyāgocareti| tad idaṃ sarvārthatvaṃ cittasyeti| tad etad āha --- mano hīti| na kevalaṃ tadākārāpattyā mantavyenārthenoparaktaṃ mano'pi tu svayaṃ ceti|
analyzed: na ca asya jala gata tve tat apramāṇam iti candra rūpe ipi apramāṇam bhavitum arhati tasmāt citta pratibimba tayā caitanya gocarā api citta vṛttiḥ na caitanya agocarā iti tat idam sarva artha tvam cittasya iti tat etat āha manaḥ hi iti na kevalam tad ākāra āpattyā mantavyena arthena uparaktam manaḥ api tu svayam ca iti

original: cakāro bhinnakramaḥ puruṣeṇety asyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| tacchāyāpattiḥ puruṣasya vṛttiḥ| iyaṃ ca caitanyacchāyāpattiś cittasya vaināśikair abhyupetavyā| katham anyathā citte caitanyam eta āropayāṃ babhūvur ity āha --- tad aneneti| kecid vaināśikā bāhyārthavādinaḥ| apare vijñānamātravādinaḥ|
analyzed: cakāraḥ bhinnakramaḥ puruṣeṇa iti asya anantaram draṣṭavyaḥ tad chāyā āpattiḥ puruṣasya vṛttiḥ iyam ca caitanya chāyā āpattiḥ cittasya vaināśikaiḥ abhyupetavyā katham anyathā citte caitanyam ete āropayām babhūvuḥ iti āha tat anena iti kecid vaināśikāḥ bāhya artha vādinaḥ apare vijñāna mātra vādinaḥ

original: nanu yadi cittam eva draṣṭrākāraṃ dṛśyākāraṃ cānubhūyate hanta cittād abhinnāv evāstāṃ draṣṭṛdṛśyau| yathāhuḥ ---
analyzed: nanu yadi cittam eva draṣṭṛ ākāram dṛśya ākāram ca anubhūyate hanta cittāt abhinnau eva āstām draṣṭṛ dṛśyau yathā āhuḥ

original: "abhinno'pi hi buddhyātmā viparyāsitadarśanaiḥ| grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedavān iva lakṣyate" iti||
analyzed: abhinnaḥ api hi buddhi ātmā viparyāsita darśanaiḥ grāhya grāhaka saṃvitti bhedavān iva lakṣyate iti

original: tat katham ete'nukampanīyā ity ata āha --- samādhiprajñāyām iti| te khalūktābhir upapattibhiś cittātiriktaṃ puruṣam abhyupagamyāpy aṣṭāṅgayogopadeśena samādhiprajñāyām ātmagocarāyām avatārya bodhayitavyāḥ| tadyathā --- samādhiprajñāyāṃ prajñeyo'rtha ātmā pratibimbībhūto'nyaḥ kasmāt tasyātmana ālambanībhūtatvāt|
analyzed: tat katham etena nukampanīyāḥ iti atas āha samādhi prajñāyām iti te khalu uktābhiḥ upapattibhiḥ citta atiriktam puruṣam abhyupagamya api aṣṭāṅga yoga upadeśena samādhi prajñāyām ātma gocarāyām avatārya bodhayitavyāḥ tat yathā samādhi prajñāyām prajñeyaḥ ūrthaḥ ātmā pratibimbībhūtaḥ anyaḥ kasmāt tasya ātmanaḥ ālambanībhūta tvāt

original: atha cittād abhinnam eva kasmān nālambanaṃ bhavatīti yadi yuktibodhito'pi vaiyātyād vadet tatra hetum āha --- sa ced ātmarūpo'rthaś cittamātraṃ syān na tu tato vyatiriktas tataḥ kathaṃ prajñayaiva prajñārūpam avadhāryeta svātmani vṛttivirodhāt| upasaṃharati --- tasmād iti| samīcīnopadeśenānukampitā bhavantīty āha --- evam iti|
analyzed: atha cittāt abhinnam eva kasmāt na ālambanam bhavati iti yadi yukti bodhitaḥ api vaiyātyāt vadet tatra hetum āha sa ced ātma rūpaḥ ṛthaḥ cittamātram syāt na tu tatas vyatiriktaḥ tatas katham prajñayā eva prajñā rūpam avadhāryeta svātmani vṛtti virodhāt upasaṃharati tasmāt iti samīcīna upadeśena anukampitāḥ bhavanti iti āha evam iti

original: jātitaḥ svabhāvata ity arthaḥ||4.23||
analyzed: jātitaḥ svabhāvataḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tad asaṃkhyeyavāsanābhiś citram api parārthaṃ saṃhatyakāritvāt||4.24||
analyzed: tat asaṃkhyeya vāsanābhiḥ citram api para artham saṃhatya kāri tvāt

original: cittātiriktātmasadbhāve hetvantaram avatārayati --- kutaś ceti| tad asaṃkhyeyavāsanābhiś citram api parārthaṃ saṃhatyakāritvāt| yady apy asaṃkhyeyāḥ karmavāsanāḥ kleśavāsanāś ca cittam evādhiśerate na tu puruṣam|
analyzed: citta atirikta ātma sadbhāve hetu antaram avatārayati kutas ca iti tat asaṃkhyeya vāsanābhiḥ citram api para artham saṃhatya kāri tvāt yadi api asaṃkhyeyāḥ karma vāsanāḥ kleśa vāsanāḥ ca cittam eva adhiśerate na tu puruṣam

original: tathā ca vāsanādhīnā vipākāś cittāśrayatayā cittasya bhoktṛtām āvahanti, bhoktur arthe ca bhogyam iti sarvaṃ cittārthaṃ prāptaṃ, tathāpi tac cittam asaṃkhyeyavāsanāvicitram api parārtham| kasmāt| saṃhatyakāritvād iti sūtrārthaḥ| vyācaṣṭe --- tad etad iti|
analyzed: tathā ca vāsanā adhīnāḥ vipākāḥ citta āśraya tayā cittasya bhoktṛtām āvahanti bhoktuḥ arthe ca bhogyam iti sarvam citta artham prāptam tathā api tat cittam asaṃkhyeya vāsanā vicitram api para artham kasmāt saṃhatya kāri tvāt iti sūtra arthaḥ vyācaṣṭe tat etat iti

original: syād etac cittaṃ saṃhatyāpi kariṣyati svārthaṃ ca bhaviṣyati kaḥ khalu virodha iti yadi kaścid brūyāt taṃ pratyāha --- saṃhatyakāriṇeti| sukhacittam iti bhogam upalakṣayati| tena duḥkhacittam api draṣṭavyam| jñānam ity apavarga uktaḥ| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- sukhaduḥkhe citte pratikūlānukūlātmake nātmani saṃbhavataḥ| svātmani vṛttivirodhāt|
analyzed: syāt etat cittam saṃhatya api kariṣyati sva artham ca bhaviṣyati kaḥ khalu virodhaḥ iti yadi kaścid brūyāt tam pratyāha saṃhatya kāriṇā iti sukha cittam iti bhogam upalakṣayati tena duḥkha cittam api draṣṭavyam jñānam iti apavargaḥ uktaḥ etat uktam bhavati sukha duḥkhe citte pratikūla anukūla ātmake na ātmani saṃbhavataḥ sva ātmani vṛtti virodhāt

original: na cānyo'pi saṃhatyakārī sākṣāt paramparayā vā sukhaduḥkhe vidadhānas tābhyām anukūlanīyaḥ pratikūlanīyo vā| tasmād yaḥ sākṣāt paramparayā vā na sukhaduḥkhayor vyāpriyate sa evābhyām anukūlanīyaḥ pratikūlanīyo vā| sa ca nityodāsīnaḥ puruṣa evam apavṛjyate yena jñānena tasyāpi jñeyatantratvāt svātmani ca vṛttivirodhān na jñānārthatvam|
analyzed: na ca anyaḥ api saṃhatya kārī sākṣāt paramparayā vā sukha duḥkhe vidadhānaḥ tābhyām anukūlanīyaḥ pratikūlanīyaḥ vā tasmāt yaḥ sākṣāt paramparayā vā na sukha duḥkhayoḥ vyāpriyate saḥ eva ābhyām anukūlanīyaḥ pratikūlanīyaḥ vā sa ca nitya udāsīnaḥ puruṣaḥ evam apavṛjyate yena jñānena tasya api jñeya tantra tvāt svātmani ca vṛtti virodhāt na jñāna artha tvam

original: na bāhyaviṣayād asmād apavargasaṃbhavo videhaprakṛtilayānām apavargāsaṃbhavāt| tasmāt tajjñānam api puruṣārtham eva na tat svārthaṃ nāpi paramātrārtham| saṃhataparārthatve cānavasthāprasaṅgād asaṃhataparārthasiddhir iti||4.24||
analyzed: na bāhya viṣayāt asmāt apavarga saṃbhavaḥ videha prakṛti layānām apavarga asaṃbhavāt tasmāt tat jñānam api puruṣa artham eva na tat svārtham nā api paramātra artham saṃhata para artha tve ca anavasthā prasaṅgāt asaṃhata para artha siddhiḥ iti

original: viśeṣadarśina ātmabhāvabhāvanānivṛttiḥ||4.25||

tad evaṃ kaivalyamūlabījaṃ yuktimayam ātmadarśanam uktvā tadupadeśādhikṛtaṃ puruṣam anadhikṛtapuruṣāntarād vyāvṛttam āha --- viśeṣadarśina ātmabhāvabhāvanānivṛttiḥ| yasyātmabhāve bhāvanāsti tasyāṣṭāṅgayogopadeśād anutiṣṭhato yuñjānasya tatparipākāc cittasattvapuruṣayor viśeṣadarśanād ātmabhāvabhāvanā nivartate|
analyzed: tat evam kaivalya mūla bījam yukti mayam ātma darśanam uktvā tad upadeśa adhikṛtam puruṣam anadhikṛta puruṣa antarāt vyāvṛttam āha viśeṣa darśinaḥ ātma bhāva bhāvanā nivṛttiḥ yasya ātma bhāve bhāvanā asti tasya aṣṭāṅga yoga upadeśāt anutiṣṭhataḥ yuñjānasya tad paripākāt citta sattva puruṣayoḥ viśeṣa darśanāt ātma bhāva bhāvanā nivartate

original: yasyātmabhāvabhāvanaiva nāsti nāstikasya tasyopadeśānadhikṛtasyāpariniścitātmatatparalokabhāvasya nopadeśo na viśeṣadarśanaṃ nātmabhāvabhāvanānivṛttir iti sūtrārthaḥ| nanv ātmabhāvabhāvanāyāś cittavartinyāḥ kuto'vagama ity ata āha --- yathā prāvṛṣīti|
analyzed: yasya ātma bhāva bhāvanā eva nā asti nāstikasya tasya upadeśa anadhikṛtasya apariniścita ātma tad para loka bhāvasya na upadeśaḥ na viśeṣa darśanam na ātma bhāva bhāvanā nivṛttiḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ nanu ātma bhāva bhāvanāyāḥ citta vartinyāḥ kutas avagamaḥ iti atas āha yathā prāvṛṣi iti

original: prāgbhavīyaṃ tattvadarśanabījam apavargabhāgīyaṃ yat karmāṣṭāṅgayogānuṣṭhānaṃ tad ekadeśānuṣṭhānaṃ vā tadabhinirvartitam astīty anumīyate| tasya cātmabhāvabhāvanāvaśyam eva svābhāvikī vastvabhyāsaṃ vināpi pravartate| anadhikāriṇam āgamināṃ vacanena darśayati --- yasyābhāvād idam iti|
analyzed: prāgbhavīyam tattva darśana bījam apavarga bhāgīyam yat karma aṣṭāṅga yoga anuṣṭhānam tat eka deśa anuṣṭhānam vā tad abhinirvartitam asti iti anumīyate tasya ca ātma bhāva bhāvanā avaśyam eva svābhāvikī vastu abhyāsam vinā api pravartate anadhikāriṇam āgaminām vacanena darśayati yasya abhāvāt idam iti

original: pūrvapakṣo nāsti karmaphalaṃ paralokino 'bhāvāt paralokābhāva iti, tatra rucir aruciś ca nirṇaye pañcaviṃśatitattvaviṣaye| ātmabhāvabhāvanā prāg vyākhyātā| viśeṣadarśinaḥ parāmarśam āha --- cittasyaiveti| tasya (asya) viśeṣadarśanakuśalasyātmabhāvabhāvanā nivartata iti||4.25||
analyzed: pūrvapakṣaḥ na asti karma phalam paralokinaḥ bhāvāt paraloka abhāvaḥ iti tatra ruciḥ aruciḥ ca nirṇaye pañcaviṃśati tattva viṣaye ātma bhāva bhāvanā prāk vyākhyātā viśeṣa darśinaḥ parāmarśam āha cittasya eva iti tasya asya viśeṣa darśana kuśalasya ātma bhāva bhāvanā nivartate iti

original: tadā vivekanimnaṃ kaivalyaprāgbhāraṃ cittam||4.26||
analyzed: tadā viveka nimnam kaivalya prāgbhāram cittam

original: atha viśeṣadarśinaḥ kīdṛśaṃ cittam ity ata āha --- tadā vivekanimnaṃ kaivalyaprāgbhāraṃ cittam| nigadavyākhyātam||4.26||
analyzed: atha viśeṣa darśinaḥ kīdṛśam cittam iti atas āha tadā viveka nimnam kaivalya prāgbhāram cittam nigada vyākhyātam

original: tacchidreṣu pratyayāntarāṇi saṃskārebhyaḥ||4.27||
analyzed: tad chidreṣu pratyaya antarāṇi saṃskārebhyaḥ

original: syād etad viśeṣadarśanaṃ ced vivekaniṣṭhaṃ, na jātu cittaṃ vyutthitaṃ syāt| dṛśyate cāsya bhikṣām aṭato vyutthitam ity ata āha --- tacchidreṣu pratyayāntarāṇi saṃskārebhyaḥ| pratyayeti| pratīyate yena sa pratyayaś cittasattvaṃ tasmād vivekaś citeḥ|
analyzed: syāt etat viśeṣa darśanam ced viveka niṣṭham na jātu cittam vyutthitam syāt dṛśyate ca asya bhikṣām aṭataḥ vyutthitam iti atas āha tad chidreṣu pratyaya antarāṇi saṃskārebhyaḥ pratyaya iti pratīyate yena sa pratyayaḥ citta sattvam tasmāt vivekaḥ citeḥ

original: tena nimnasya jānāmīti sākṣānmokṣo vivicya darśito na jānāmīti mohas tanmūlāv ahaṃkāramamakārāv aham asmīti vā mameti vā darśitau| kṣīyamāṇāni ca tāni bījāni ceti samāsaḥ| pūrvasaṃskārebhyo vyutthānasaṃskārebhyaḥ||4.27||
analyzed: tena nimnasya jānāmi iti sākṣāt mokṣaḥ vivicya darśitaḥ na jānāmi iti mohaḥ tad mūlau ahaṃkāra mamakārau aham asmi iti vā mama iti vā darśitau kṣīyamāṇāni ca tāni bījāni ca iti samāsaḥ pūrva saṃskārebhyaḥ vyutthāna saṃskārebhyaḥ

original: hānam eṣāṃ kleśavad uktam||4.28||
analyzed: hānam eṣām kleśa vat uktam

original: syād etat saty api vivekavijñāne vyutthānasaṃskārā yadi pratyayāntarāṇi prasuvate kas tarhi hānahetur eteṣāṃ yataḥ pratyayāntarāṇi na punaḥ prasuvīrann ity ata āha --- hānam eṣāṃ kleśavad uktam| aparipakvavivekajñānasyākṣīyamāṇā vyutthānasaṃskārāḥ pratyayāntaraṃ prasuvate na tu paripakvavivekajñānasya kṣīṇāḥ pratyayāntarāṇi prasotum arhanti|
analyzed: syāt etat sati api viveka vijñāne vyutthāna saṃskārāḥ yadi pratyaya antarāṇi prasuvate kaḥ tarhi hāna hetuḥ eteṣām yatas pratyaya antarāṇi na punar prasuvīran iti atas āha hānam eṣām kleśa vat uktam aparipakva viveka jñānasya akṣīyamāṇāḥ vyutthāna saṃskārāḥ pratyaya antaram prasuvate na tu paripakva viveka jñānasya kṣīṇāḥ pratyaya antarāṇi prasotum arhanti

original: yathā vivekacchidrasamutpannā api kleśā na saṃskārāntaraṃ prasuvate tat kasya hetos tad ete kleśā vivekajñānavahnidagdhabījabhāvā iti| evaṃ vyutthānasaṃskārā apīti|
analyzed: yathā viveka chidra samutpannāḥ api kleśāḥ na saṃskāra antaram prasuvate tat kasya hetoḥ tat ete kleśāḥ viveka jñāna vahni dagdha bīja bhāvāḥ iti evam vyutthāna saṃskārāḥ api iti

original: atha vyutthānasaṃskārā vivekajñānasaṃskārair niroddhavyā vivekasaṃskārāś ca nirodhasaṃskārair nirodhasaṃskārāṇāṃ tv abāhyaviṣayatvaṃ darśitaṃ nirodhopāyaḥ prāyaś cintanīya ity ata āha --- jñānasaṃskārās tv iti| paravairāgyasaṃskārā ity arthaḥ||4.28||
analyzed: atha vyutthāna saṃskārāḥ viveka jñāna saṃskāraiḥ niroddhavyāḥ viveka saṃskārāḥ ca nirodha saṃskāraiḥ nirodha saṃskārāṇām tu abāhya viṣaya tvam darśitam nirodha upāyaḥ prāyas cintanīyaḥ iti atas āha jñāna saṃskārāḥ tu iti para vairāgya saṃskārāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: prasaṃkhyāne'py akusīdasya sarvathā vivekakhyāter dharmameghaḥ samādhiḥ||4.29||
analyzed: prasaṃkhyāne api akusīdasya sarvathā viveka khyāteḥ dharmameghaḥ samādhiḥ

original: tad evaṃ sūtrakāro vyutthānanirodhopāyaṃ prasaṃkhyānam uktvā prasaṃkhyānanirodhopāyam āha --- prasaṃkhyāne'py akusīdasya sarvathā vivekakhyāter dharmameghaḥ samādhiḥ| tataḥ prasaṃkhyānān na kiṃcit sarvabhāvādhiṣṭhātṛtvādi prārthayate| pratyuta tatrāpi kliśnāti pariṇāmitvadoṣadarśanena viraktaḥ sarvathā vivekakhyātir eva bhavati|
analyzed: tat evam sūtrakāraḥ vyutthāna nirodha upāyam prasaṃkhyānam uktvā prasaṃkhyāna nirodha upāyam āha prasaṃkhyāne api akusīdasya sarvathā viveka khyāteḥ dharmameghaḥ samādhiḥ tatas prasaṃkhyānāt na kiṃcid sarva bhāva adhiṣṭhātṛ tva ādi prārthayate pratyuta tatra api kliśnāti pariṇāmi tva doṣa darśanena viraktaḥ sarvathā viveka khyātiḥ eva bhavati

original: etad eva vivṛṇoti --- tatrāpīti| yadā vyutthānapratyayā bhaveyus tadā nāyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sarvathā vivekakhyātir yatas tasya na pratyayāntarāṇi bhavanti tataḥ sarvathā vivekakhyātir iti| tadāsya dharmameghaḥ samādhir bhavati| etad uktaṃ bhavati --- prasaṃkhyāne viraktas tannirodham icchan dharmameghaṃ samādhim upāsīta|
analyzed: etat eva vivṛṇoti tatra api iti yadā vyutthāna pratyayāḥ bhaveyuḥ tadā na ayam brāhmaṇaḥ sarvathā viveka khyātiḥ yatas tasya na pratyaya antarāṇi bhavanti tatas sarvathā viveka khyātiḥ iti tadā asya dharma meghaḥ samādhiḥ bhavati etat uktam bhavati prasaṃkhyāne viraktaḥ tad nirodham icchan dharma megham samādhim upāsīta

original: tadupāsane ca sarvathā vivekakhyātir bhavati| tathā ca taṃ niroddhuṃ pārayatīti||4.29||
analyzed: tad upāsane ca sarvathā viveka khyātiḥ bhavati tathā ca tam niroddhum pārayati iti

original: tataḥ kleśakarmanivṛttiḥ||4.30||

tasya ca prayojanam āha --- tataḥ kleśakarmanivṛttiḥ| kasmāt punar jīvann eva vidvān vimukto bhavati| uttaraṃ --- yasmād iti| kleśakarmavāsaneddhaḥ kila karmāśayo jātyādinidānam| na cāsati nidāne nidānī bhavitum arhati| yathāhātra bhagavān akṣapādaḥ --- "vītarāgajanmādarśanāt" iti||4.30||
analyzed: tasya ca prayojanam āha tatas kleśa karma nivṛttiḥ kasmāt punar jīvan eva vidvān vimuktaḥ bhavati uttaram yasmāt iti kleśa karma vāsanā iddhaḥ kila karma āśayaḥ jāti ādi nidānam na ca asati nidāne nidānī bhavitum arhati yathā āha atra bhagavān akṣapādaḥ vīta rāga janma adarśanāt iti

original: tadā sarvāvaraṇamalāpetasya jñānasyānantyāj jñeyam alpam||4.31||
analyzed: tadā sarva āvaraṇa mala apetasya jñānasya ānantyāt jñeyam alpam

original: athaivaṃ dharmameghe sati kīdṛśaṃ cittam ity ata āha --- tadā sarvāvaraṇamalāpetasya jñānasyānantyāj jñeyam alpam| āvriyate cittasattvam ebhir ity āvaraṇāni malāḥ kleśakarmāṇi sarve ca ta āvaraṇamalāś ceti sarvāvaraṇamalās tebhyo'petasya cittasattvasya jñānasya jñāyate'nenety anayā vyutpattyānantyād aparimeyatvāj jñeyam alpam|
analyzed: atha evam dharma meghe sati kīdṛśam cittam iti atas āha tadā sarva āvaraṇa mala apetasya jñānasya ānantyāt jñeyam alpam āvriyate citta sattvam ebhiḥ iti āvaraṇāni malāḥ kleśa karmāṇi sarve ca te āvaraṇa malāḥ ca iti sarva āvaraṇa malāḥ tebhyaḥ upetasya citta sattvasya jñānasya jñāyate inena iti anayā vyutpattyā ānantyāt aparimeya tvāt jñeyam alpam

original: yathā hi śaradi ghanapaṭalamuktasya caṇḍārciṣaḥ paritaḥ pradyotamānasya prakāśānantyāt prakāśyā ghaṭādayo'lpāḥ prakāśante, evam apagatarajastamasaś cittasattvasya prakāśānantyād alpaṃ prakāśyam iti| tad etad āha --- sarvair iti| etad eva vyatirekamukhena (vyatirekamukheṇa) sphorayati --- āvarakeṇa tamasābhibhūtam iti|
analyzed: yathā hi śaradi ghana paṭala muktasya caṇḍa arciṣaḥ paritas pradyotamānasya prakāśa ānantyāt prakāśyāḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ ulpāḥ prakāśante evam apagata rajaḥ tamasaḥ citta sattvasya prakāśa ānantyāt alpam prakāśyam iti tat etat āha sarvaiḥ iti etat eva vyatireka mukhena vyatireka mukheṇa sphorayati āvarakeṇa tamasā abhibhūtam iti

original: kriyāśīlena rajasā pravartitam ata evodghāṭitaṃ pradeśād apanītaṃ tama ity arthaḥ| ata eva sarvān dharmāñ jñeyān mehati varṣati prakāśaneneti dharmamegha ity ucyate| nanv ayam astu dharmameghaḥ samādhiḥ savāsanakleśakarmāśayapraśamahetuḥ| atha saty apy asmin kasmān na jāyate punar jantur ity ata āha --- yatredam uktam iti|
analyzed: kriyā śīlena rajasā pravartitam atas eva udghāṭitam pradeśāt apanītam tamaḥ iti arthaḥ atas eva sarvān dharmān jñeyān mehati varṣati prakāśanena iti dharma meghaḥ iti ucyate nanu ayam astu dharma meghaḥ samādhiḥ sa vāsana kleśa karma āśaya praśama hetuḥ atha sati api asmin kasmāt na jāyate punar jantuḥ iti atas āha yatra idam uktam iti

original: kāraṇasamucchedād api cet kāryaṃ kriyate hanta bho maṇivedhādayo 'ndhādibhyo bhaveyuḥ pratyakṣāḥ| tathā cānupapannārthatāyām ābhāṇako laukika upapannārthaḥ syāt --- avidhyad andho maṇim iti| āvayad grathitavān| pratyamuñcat pinaddhavān abhyapūjayat stutavān iti||4.31||
analyzed: kāraṇa samucchedāt api ced kāryam kriyate hanta bho maṇi vedha ādayaḥ ndha ādibhyaḥ bhaveyuḥ pratyakṣāḥ tathā ca anupapanna artha tāyām ābhāṇakaḥ laukikaḥ upapanna arthaḥ syāt avidhyat andhaḥ maṇim iti āvayat grathitavān pratyamuñcat pinaddhavān abhyapūjayat stutavān iti

original: tataḥ kṛtārthānāṃ pariṇāmakramasamāptir guṇānām||4.32||
analyzed: tatas kṛtārthānām pariṇāma krama samāptiḥ guṇānām

original: nanu dharmameghasya parā kāṣṭhā jñānaprasādamātraṃ paraṃ vairāgyaṃ samūlaghātam apahantu vyutthānasamādhisaṃskārān sakleśakarmāśayān guṇās tu svata eva vikārakaraṇaśīlāḥ kasmāt tādṛśam api puruṣaṃ prati dehendriyādīn nārabhanta ity ata āha --- tataḥ kṛtārthānāṃ pariṇāmakramasamāptir guṇānām|
analyzed: nanu dharma meghasya parā kāṣṭhā jñāna prasāda mātram param vairāgyam sa mūla ghātam apahantu vyutthāna samādhi saṃskārān sa kleśa karma āśayān guṇāḥ tu svatas eva vikāra karaṇa śīlāḥ kasmāt tādṛśam api puruṣam prati deha indriya ādīn na ārabhante iti atas āha tatas kṛtārthānām pariṇāma krama samāptiḥ guṇānām

original: śīlam idaṃ guṇānāṃ yad amī yaṃ prati kṛtārthās taṃ prati na pravartanta iti bhāvaḥ||4.32||
analyzed: śīlam idam guṇānām yat amī yam prati kṛtārthāḥ tam prati na pravartante iti bhāvaḥ

original: kṣaṇapratiyogī pariṇāmāparāntanirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ||4.33||

atrāntare pariṇāmakramaṃ pṛcchati --- atha ko'yam iti| kṣaṇapratiyogī pariṇāmāparāntanirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ| pariṇāmakramaḥ kṣaṇapratiyogī kṣaṇaḥ pratisaṃbandhī yasya sa tathoktaḥ| kṣaṇapracayāśraya ity arthaḥ| na jātu kramaḥ kramavantam antareṇa śakyo nirūpayitum| na caikasyaiva kṣaṇasya kramaḥ| tasmāt kṣaṇapracayāśrayaḥ pariśiṣyate|
analyzed: atra antare pariṇāma kramam pṛcchati atha kaḥ yam iti kṣaṇa pratiyogī pariṇāmāparānta nirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ pariṇāma kramaḥ kṣaṇa pratiyogī kṣaṇaḥ pratisaṃbandhī yasya sa tathā uktaḥ kṣaṇa pracaya āśrayaḥ iti arthaḥ na jātu kramaḥ kramavantam antareṇa śakyaḥ nirūpayitum na ca ekasya eva kṣaṇasya kramaḥ tasmāt kṣaṇa pracaya āśrayaḥ pariśiṣyate

original: tad idam āha --- kṣaṇānantaryeti| pariṇāmakrame pramāṇam āha --- pariṇāmasyeti| navasya hi vastrasya prayatnasaṃrakṣitasyāpi cireṇa purāṇatā dṛśyate| so'yaṃ pariṇāmasyāparāntaḥ paryavasānaṃ, tena hi pariṇāmasya kramaḥ| tataḥ prāg api purāṇatāyāḥ sūkṣmasūkṣmatarasūkṣmatamasthūlasthūlatarasthūlatamatvādīnāṃ paurvāparyam anumīyate|
analyzed: tat idam āha kṣaṇa ānantarya iti pariṇāma krame pramāṇam āha pariṇāmasya iti navasya hi vastrasya prayatna saṃrakṣitasya api cireṇa purāṇa tā dṛśyate saḥ uyam pariṇāmasya apara antar paryavasānam tena hi pariṇāmasya kramaḥ tatas prāk api purāṇa tāyāḥ sūkṣma sūkṣmatara sūkṣmatama sthūla sthūlatara sthūlatama tva ādīnām paurvāparyam anumīyate

original: etad eva vyatirekamukhena (vyatirekamukheṇa) darśayati --- na hīti| ananubhūto'prāptaḥ kramakṣaṇo yayā sā tathoktā| nanv eṣa kramaḥ pradhānasya na saṃbhavati tasya nityatvād ity ata āha --- nityeṣu ceti| bahuvacanena sarvanityavyāpitāṃ kramasya pratijānīte| tatra nityānāṃ prakārabhedaṃ darśayitvā nityavyāpitāṃ kramasyopapādayati --- dvayīti|
analyzed: etat eva vyatireka mukhena vyatireka mukheṇa darśayati na hi iti ananubhūta uprāptaḥ krama kṣaṇaḥ yayā sā tathā uktā nanu eṣa kramaḥ pradhānasya na saṃbhavati tasya nitya tvāt iti atas āha nityeṣu ca iti bahuvacanena sarva nitya vyāpi tām kramasya pratijānīte tatra nityānām prakāra bhedam darśayitvā nitya vyāpi tām kramasya upapādayati dvayī iti

original: nanu kūṭasthaṃ svabhāvād apracyutam astu nityaṃ pariṇāmi sadaiva svarūpāc cyavamānaṃ kathaṃ nityam ity ata āha --- yasminn iti| dharmalakṣaṇāvasthānām udayavyayadharmatvaṃ dharmiṇas tu tattvād avighāta eveti| atha kiṃ pariṇāmāparāntanirgrāhyatā sarvatra kramasya nety āha --- tatra guṇadharmeṣu buddhyādiṣv iti|
analyzed: nanu kūṭastham svabhāvāt apracyutam astu nityam pariṇāmi sadā eva svarūpāt cyavamānam katham nityam iti atas āha yasmin iti dharma lakṣaṇa avasthānām udaya vyaya dharma tvam dharmiṇaḥ tu tattvāt avighātaḥ eva iti atha kim pariṇāma apara anta nirgrāhya tā sarvatra kramasya na iti āha tatra guṇa dharmeṣu buddhi ādiṣu iti

original: yato labdhaparyavasāno dharmāṇāṃ vināśāt pradhānasya tu pariṇāmakramo na labdhaparyavasānaḥ| nanu pradhānasya dharmarūpeṇa pariṇāmād astu pariṇāmakramaḥ| puruṣasya tv apariṇāminaḥ kutaḥ pariṇāmakrama ity ata āha --- kūṭastheti| tatra baddhānāṃ cittāvyatirekābhimānāt tatpariṇāmena pariṇāmādhyāsaḥ|
analyzed: yatas labdha paryavasānaḥ dharmāṇām vināśāt pradhānasya tu pariṇāma kramaḥ na labdha paryavasānaḥ nanu pradhānasya dharma rūpeṇa pariṇāmāt astu pariṇāma kramaḥ puruṣasya tu apariṇāminaḥ kutas pariṇāma kramaḥ iti atas āha kūṭastha iti tatra baddhānām citta avyatireka abhimānāt tad pariṇāmena pariṇāma adhyāsaḥ

original: muktānāṃ cāstikriyām upādāyāvāstavo'pi pariṇāmo mohakalpitaḥ śabdasya puraḥsaratayā tatpṛṣṭho vikalpo 'stikriyām upādatta iti| guṇeṣv alabdhaparyavasānaḥ pariṇāmakrama ity uktam| tad asahamānaḥ pṛcchati --- atheti| sthityeti mahāpralayāvasthāyām| gatyeti sṛṣṭau|
analyzed: muktānām ca astikriyām upādāya avāstavaḥ api pariṇāmaḥ moha kalpitaḥ śabdasya puraḥsara tayā tad pṛṣṭhaḥ vikalpaḥ ustikriyām upādatte iti guṇeṣu alabdha paryavasānaḥ pariṇāma kramaḥ iti uktam tat asahamānaḥ pṛcchati atha iti sthityā iti mahāpralaya avasthāyām gatyā iti sṛṣṭau

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati --- yady ānantyān na pariṇāmasamāptiḥ saṃsārasya hanta bhoḥ kathaṃ mahāpralayasamaye sarveṣām ātmanāṃ sahasā samucchidyeta kathaṃ ca sṛṣṭyādau sahasotpadyeta saṃsāraḥ| tasmād ekaikasyātmano muktikrameṇa sarveṣāṃ vimokṣād ucchedaḥ sarveṣāṃ saṃsārasya krameṇeti pradhānapariṇāmakramaparisamāptiḥ|
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadi ānantyāt na pariṇāma samāptiḥ saṃsārasya hanta bhoḥ katham mahāpralaya samaye sarveṣām ātmanām sahasā samucchidyeta katham ca sṛṣṭi ādau sahasā utpadyeta saṃsāraḥ tasmāt ekaikasya ātmanaḥ mukti krameṇa sarveṣām vimokṣāt ucchedaḥ sarveṣām saṃsārasya krameṇa iti pradhāna pariṇāma krama parisamāptiḥ

original: evaṃ ca pradhānasyāpy anityatvaprasaṅgaḥ| na cāpūrvasattvaprādurbhāva iṣyate yenānantyaṃ syāt| tathā saty anāditvavyāhateḥ sakalaśāstrārthabhaṅgaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| uttaram āha --- avacanīyam anuttarārham etat| ekāntata etasyāvacanīyatāṃ darśayitum ekāntavacanīyaṃ praśnaṃ darśayati asti praśna iti|
analyzed: evam ca pradhānasya api anitya tva prasaṅgaḥ na ca apūrva sattva prādurbhāvaḥ iṣyate yena ānantyam syāt tathā sati anādi tva vyāhateḥ sakala śāstra artha bhaṅga prasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ uttaram āha avacanīyam anuttara arham etat ekāntataḥ etasya avacanīya tām darśayitum ekānta vacanīyam praśnam darśayati asti praśnaḥ iti

original: sarvo jāto mariṣyatīti praśnottaram --- oṃ bho iti| satyaṃ bho ity arthaḥ| avibhajya vacanīyam uktvā pravibhajya vacanīyaṃ praśnam āha --- atha sarva iti| vibhajya vacanīyatām āha --- vibhajyeti| vibhajya vacanīyam eva praśnāntaraṃ vispaṣṭārtham āha --- tathā manuṣyeti| ayaṃ tv avacanīya ekāntataḥ|
analyzed: sarvaḥ jātaḥ mariṣyati iti praśna uttaram om bho iti satyam bho iti arthaḥ a vibhajya vacanīyam uktvā pravibhajya vacanīyam praśnam āha atha sarve iti vibhajya vacanīya tām āha vibhajya iti vibhajya vacanīyam eva praśna antaram vispaṣṭa artham āha tathā manuṣya iti ayam tu avacanīyaḥ ekāntataḥ

original: na hi sāmānyena kuśalākuśalapuruṣasaṃsārasyāntavattvam anantavattvaṃ vā śakyam ekāntato vaktum| yathā prāṇabhṛnmātrasya śreyastvam aśreyastvaṃ vā naikāntataḥ śakyam avadhārayitum| yathā jātamātrasya maraṇam ekāntataḥ| vibhajya punaḥ śakyāvadhāraṇam ity āha --- kuśalasyeti|
analyzed: na hi sāmānyena kuśala akuśala puruṣa saṃsārasya antavat tvam anantavat tvam vā śakyam ekāntataḥ vaktum yathā prāṇabhṛt mātrasya śreyaḥ tvam aśreyaḥ tvam vā na ekāntataḥ śakyam avadhārayitum yathā jāta mātrasya maraṇam ekāntataḥ vibhajya punar śakya avadhāraṇam iti āha kuśalasya iti

original: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ --- krameṇa mokṣe sarveṣāṃ mokṣāt saṃsāroccheda ity anumānaṃ, tac cāgamasiddhamokṣāśrayaṃ, tathā cābhyupagatamokṣapratipādakāgamapramāṇabhāvaḥ kathaṃ tam evāgamaṃ pradhānavikāranityatāyām apramāṇīkuryāt| tasmād āgamabādhitaviṣayam etad anumānaṃ na pramāṇam|
analyzed: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ krameṇa mokṣe sarveṣām mokṣāt saṃsāra ucchedaḥ iti anumānam tat ca āgama siddha mokṣa āśrayam tathā ca abhyupagata mokṣa pratipādaka āgama pramāṇa bhāvaḥ katham tam eva āgamam pradhāna vikāra nitya tāyām a pramāṇīkuryāt tasmāt āgama bādhita viṣayam etat anumānam na pramāṇam

original: śrūyate hi śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu sargapratisargaparamparāyā anāditvam anantatvaṃ ceti| api ca sarveṣām evātmanāṃ saṃsārasya na tāvad yugapaducchedaḥ saṃbhavī| na hi paṇḍitarūpāṇām apy anekajanmaparamparābhyāsapariśramasādhyā vivekakhyātipratiṣṭhā| kiṃ punaḥ prāṇabhṛnmātrasya sthāvarajaṅgamāder ekadākasmād bhavitum arhati|
analyzed: śrūyate hi śruti smṛti itihāsa purāṇeṣu sarga pratisarga paramparāyāḥ anādi tvam ananta tvam ca iti api ca sarveṣām eva ātmanām saṃsārasya na tāvat yugapad ucchedaḥ saṃbhavī na hi paṇḍita rūpāṇām api aneka janma paramparā abhyāsa pariśrama sādhyā viveka khyāti pratiṣṭhā kim punar prāṇabhṛt mātrasya sthāvara jaṅgama ādeḥ ekadā akasmāt bhavitum arhati

original: na ca kāraṇāyaugapadye kāryayaugapadyaṃ yujyate| krameṇa tu vivekakhyātāv asaṃkhyeyānāṃ krameṇa muktau na saṃsārocchedo'nantatvāj jantūnām asaṃkhyeyatvād iti sarvam avadātam||4.33||
analyzed: na ca kāraṇa ayaugapadye kārya yaugapadyam yujyate krameṇa tu viveka khyātau asaṃkhyeyānām krameṇa muktau na saṃsāra uccheda ūnanta tvāt jantūnām asaṃkhyeya tvāt iti sarvam avadātam

original: puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā citiśaktir iti||4.34||
analyzed: puruṣa artha śūnyānām guṇānām pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyam svarūpa pratiṣṭhā vā citi śaktiḥ iti

original: (iti śrīpatañjaliviracitayogasūtreṣu caturthaḥ kaivalyapādaḥ||4||)
analyzed: iti śrī patañjali viracita yoga sūtreṣu caturthaḥ kaivalya pādaḥ

original: kaivalyarūpāvadhāraṇaparasya sūtrasyāvāntarasaṃgatim āha --- guṇādhikāreti| puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā citiśaktir iti|
analyzed: kaivalya rūpa avadhāraṇa parasya sūtrasya avāntara saṃgatim āha guṇa adhikāra iti puruṣa artha śūnyānām guṇānām pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyam svarūpa pratiṣṭhā vā citiśaktiḥ iti

original: kṛtakaraṇīyatayā puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ yaḥ pratiprasavaḥ svakāraṇe pradhāne layas teṣāṃ kāryakāraṇātmakānāṃ guṇānāṃ vyutthānasamādhinirodhasaṃskārā manasi līyante mano 'smitāyām asmitā liṅge liṅgam aliṅga iti| yo'yaṃ guṇānāṃ kāryakāraṇātmakānāṃ pratisargas tat kaivalyam|
analyzed: kṛta karaṇīya tayā puruṣa artha śūnyānām yaḥ pratiprasavaḥ sva kāraṇe pradhāne layaḥ teṣām kārya kāraṇa ātmakānām guṇānām vyutthāna samādhi nirodha saṃskārāḥ manasi līyante manaḥ smitāyām asmitā liṅge liṅgam aliṅgaḥ iti yaḥ yam guṇānām kārya kāraṇa ātmakānām pratisargaḥ tat kaivalyam

original: yaṃ kaṃcit puruṣaṃ prati pradhānasya mokṣaḥ svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā puruṣasya mokṣa ity āha --- svarūpeti| asti hi mahāpralaye'pi svarūpapratiṣṭhā citiśaktiḥ| na cāsau mokṣa ity ata āha --- punar iti| sautra itiśabdaḥ śāstraparisamāptau||4.34||
analyzed: yam kaṃcid puruṣam prati pradhānasya mokṣaḥ svarūpa pratiṣṭhā vā puruṣasya mokṣaḥ iti āha sva rūpa iti asti hi mahāpralaye pi sva rūpa pratiṣṭhā citiśaktiḥ na ca asau mokṣaḥ iti atas āha punar iti sautraḥ iti śabdaḥ śāstra parisamāptau

original: muktyarhacittaṃ paralokameyajñasiddhaye dharmaghanaḥ samādhiḥ| dvayī ca muktiḥ pratipāditāsmin pāde prasaṅgād api cānyad uktam||1|| nidānaṃ tāpānām uditam atha tāpāś ca kathitāḥ sahāṅgair aṣṭābhir vihitam iha yogadvayam api|| kṛto mukter adhvā guṇapuruṣabhedaḥ sphuṭataro viviktaṃ kaivalyaṃ parigalitatāpā citir asau||2||
